### [1] [BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00092)
*Chen Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BudgetSchemaBench是一个面向Text-to-SQL场景的预算扫描诊断基准，通过汇聚80个数据库形成大规模联合目录，在四种schema上下文预算（2.5%/10%/25%/50%）下比较三种schema序列化方式，揭示了执行准确率在覆盖受限的检索下对预算更敏感，而当检索隔离（保证所需表）时，三种序列化方式差异极小（≤±4个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL评估缺乏一个在固定大规模目录上、显式扫描schema上下文预算K、并隔离schema表示效果的可复现诊断工具。在企业级场景下，完整schema往往超出任何实际上下文预算，智能体必须在成本约束下选择"覆盖多少表"与"每张表序列化多详细"，但社区缺少统一的衡量方法。

Method: （1）构建80库联合目录（597张表，cl100k下12.7万token的富序列化），将预算K设为目录的2.5/10/25/50%；（2）从gold SQL机械解析推导相关性标签（角色：select/join/condition/order/group），无需人工或LLM标注；（3）引入源命名空间执行契约（结果等价+命名空间谱系），防止跨库结果相同的错误答案；（4）设置三种受控条件：端到端检索、冻结gold（保证所需表）、移除所需表探测；（5）使用词法与稠密两种表示无关的排序器，三种序列化（raw/enriched/hybrid），主求解器为gpt-5.4-mini，附加gpt-4o-mini、gpt-5.5（切片N=30）和跨族推理模型DeepSeek-V4-Flash；（6）独立审计的1279题保留互补集评估。

Result: 端到端条件下，词法检索时主求解器EX从0.38升至0.55（Δ=+0.18，95% CI [0.15, 0.20]），稠密检索时仅升0.03（已近饱和）；冻结gold条件下三种序列化最大差异|Δ|=0.02，配对95% CI最宽±0.04，Holm校正后所有对比均不显著；移除所需表后仍4%-19%正确，其中94.6%的正确预测精确引用了被移除的所需表名，表明存在参数化记忆重建；DeepSeek-V4-Flash复现了全部三种定性模式；无前缀目录与有前缀目录相比，预算效应一致（Δ=+0.157 vs +0.178），前缀贡献约0.03-0.05的均匀增益。

Conclusion: 当检索受覆盖限制时，执行准确率对schema预算的敏感度远高于对所测试的序列化方式；当所需表可被保证时，三种序列化在生成端无可测量的实际差异；存在与参数化记忆一致的schema记忆底线（4-19%）；作者将BudgetSchemaBench及其构建评估代码以BSD 3-Clause许可证公开发布，供基准构建者和方法开发者衡量schema上下文预算的支出方向。

Abstract: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

</details>


### [2] [JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01064)
*Sandipan De,Abhijit Chakraborty,Sambaran Bandyopadhyay,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: JoinGR提出了一种面向Text-to-SQL的join-aware表检索方法,将数据库join图作为检索空间,通过锚点选择-查询条件图遍历-边沉积聚合三阶段,从语义相关的锚点表出发沿外键边传播相关性,以恢复那些在问题中未被直接提及、仅通过join关系才能被识别的多跳表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稠密表检索器独立地对schema元素排序,存在"结构性盲视":当某些必需表不在问题中被直接提及、只能通过与已相关表的join关系才能识别时,独立打分会漏检。在企业级多跳schema(BEAVER)上这一问题尤为突出,限制了下游Text-to-SQL的recall。

Method: 1)以列为节点、表内(intra)与外键(join)为类型化边构建join图,节点/边描述符由LLM生成语义名与用途,使用冻结句向量编码器得到query/node/edge嵌入;2)Anchor阶段:取查询-列最大相似度对应的top表作为锚点,并以该最佳列嵌入作为查询相关表表示;3)Walk阶段:从每个锚点做深度H的有界BFS,每条出边用一层MLP(基于[query, edge, frontier表, neighbor表, deposit, hop]特征)打分并局部softmax归一,乘以学习到的hop衰减系数α_h,将deposit沿join边传播;4)Aggregate阶段:将所有锚点所有跳累积的边沉积求和投影到端点表得到最终排序;训练时使用表级(或可选边级)pairwise margin loss,只训练评分器与hop衰减参数,编码器全部冻结。

Result: 在Spider(简单)、BIRD(中等)、BEAVER DW(企业多跳)三个数据集上,使用BGE-large-en-v1.5与MiniLM两种冻结编码器:BEAVER上JoinGR相对vanilla dense retriever在R@15从0.697→0.875、PR@15从0.339→0.645(BGE),MiniLM下提升同样显著;BIRD上与最强基线(REaR、JAR/IterativeJAR)相当,P@5与PR@5最佳;Spider上与vanilla retriever持平;启发式JoinGR证实图扩展本身有增益,而学习评分器进一步大幅提升perfect recall。跨域实验显示BIRD训练的评分器零样本迁移到BEAVER仍具竞争力(R@15=0.806),证实学到的是可复用的join图遍历策略而非数据集记忆。分析表明收益随所需表数/anchor预算增加而扩大,主要失效模式为长链叙事join的softmax分散以及问题词表覆盖多表时的锚点误选。

Conclusion: JoinGR将数据库join图作为表检索的一等公民,通过"语义锚点+查询条件join遍历+沉积聚合"三阶段统一了语义匹配与结构扩展。其核心贡献在于将表检索从独立的相似度排序重新定义为面向join图的学习遍历,在dense检索足够时保持竞争力,在多跳企业schema上显著提升recall与perfect recall,并具备跨域可迁移性,验证了"信息由结构连接时,检索应使用结构"的设计原则。局限性包括依赖可推导的外键、冻结编码器未联合微调、LLM描述符的预计算开销,以及仅在英文三基准上验证。

Abstract: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines. Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

</details>


### [3] [Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01616)
*Laura van Weesep,Riccardo Tedoldi,Jens Sjölund,Hossein Azizpour,Susanne Winiwarter,Ola Engkvist,Jon Paul Janet,Samuel Genheden,Juan Viguera Diez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了七个大语言模型（开源 + 闭源）能否可靠地从生物测定文本中预测并审计 BioAssay Ontology（BAO）元数据标注，以解决 PubChem 等公共数据库中标注严重缺失与不一致的问题。结果显示 LLM 在主流类别上与 ChEMBL / BADER 银标签高度一致，并能在专家评审中识别出被错误标注的记录，但少类别上可靠性下降，仍需每类精度评估与定向人工复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测基础模型对 AI 数据就绪度（AI data readiness）提出严格要求，但 PubChem 等大型公共库以及工业筛选数据库普遍存在生物测定元数据（BAO assay format、检测方法等）缺失、不一致或概念混淆的问题，手工标注无法扩展，LLM 有望填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 从 PubChem BioAssay 批量数据 + ChEMBL 37 + BARD 提取并构造三类银标准评估集（ChEMBL assay format n=1097、PubChem BAO n=226、PubChem 物理检测方法 n=308），标签映射至 BAO 第一层类别。2) 评估 4 个开源（Llama 3.3 70B、Gemma 3 27B、Gemma 4 31B、GPT-OSS 20B，通过 Ollama v0.17.4 + JSON-Schema 约束解码）和 3 个闭源（Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3.6 Flash、GPT-4o）LLM，以 title/description/comment/protocol 为输入，提示输出 {label, confidence, evidence}。3) 与银标签进行 Cohen's κ、per-class P/R/F1、多数投票对比，列高敏感性 prompt 消融（顺序翻转、去掉定义）。4) 由一名资深工业策展人对 17 条 ChEMBL assay format 与 11 条检测方法分歧案例进行定性评审。

Result: PubChem ~2M 条记录中 36% 缺 assay format、89% 缺 BioAssay type，<0.1% 带 BAO 标注；BARD vs ChEMBL 在 236 条交集上有 10.2% 不一致。在 ChEMBL assay format 上，所有七个 LLM 总体准确率 0.95+，biochemical 与 cell-based recall ≥0.96；Cohen's κ >0.9。检测方法任务中荧光/发光/放射 recall 高，分光光度中等。LLM 与银标签的分歧多追溯到源标签不一致而非模型错误：在与 ChEMBL 分歧的 43 条中 17 条 LLM 与 BARD 一致；策展人在看到 LLM 证据后修改了若干原判断。检测方法上有 6/11 被认为"无法判定"，对应模型均低自信度。闭源与开源模型性能差异小；私有模型 1000 条约 3–9 美元，开源自托管 ~6 kWh。失败模式：AID 504631（Plasmodium falciparum）四模型仍误判为 cell-based，即便引用了正确证据。

Conclusion: LLM 能够在 BAO 多维轴上以可接受的准确度大规模注释/审计生物测定元数据，对开源与闭源均有效；高置信度多数投票可作为审计入口以标记可疑标签、分流人工复核并附证据。但少类别与本体边界模糊处仍需每类可靠性估计与定向人工复核；建议将 LLM 作为"注释者+审计者"嵌入 FASTA 数据流程，并反馈至本体维护。

Abstract: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

</details>


### [4] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Argo-Bench 是首个面向企业级数据工作流的数据智能体评估框架，包含 210 个任务，运行在模拟的纽约市外卖平台（235 张表、75 亿行 Oracle EBS 数据仓库）上。其核心创新在于通过模拟器生成"隐藏的潜在状态"，按智能体提交行动的后果进行评分，而非评判 SQL 查询或文本答案。当前最强模型仅能完成 34.8% 的任务并平均得 59.5 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准（如 Spider 2.0、BIRD）存在三大缺陷：(1) 数据来源为公开样例库，无法反映真实企业 ERP 系统的表间一致性；(2) 仅评测 SQL 生成，不覆盖需要机器学习/优化的端到端数据科学任务；(3) 答案键经审计错误率高达 52.8%–62.8%。真实企业仓库因敏感无法公开，导致评测脱离实际。

Method: 构建流程分三步：(1) 用 34 个公共数据集与监管报告（NYC DCWP 季度披露、DoorDash/Grubhub 10-K 等）模拟一个 2024 年纽约外卖平台，8100 万订单，注入真实欺诈模式（盗单、GPS 欺骗、刷券、退款串通等）；(2) 将模拟世界投射到 Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2 格式的 235 张表、75 亿行数据仓库中，隐藏潜在状态；(3) 设计 210 个分布于信任安全、FP&A、市场、财会、增长五大领域的任务，要求智能体通过 Python 沙箱与 Mission Control 接口提交行动，由评分器基于潜在状态评分。任务分九种评分模式：forecast（加权区间分数）、cost_set（封禁成本节省）、data_source（仪表板合同校验）等。

Result: 评估 14 个前沿与开源模型：Claude Opus 5.5 以 34.8% 解决率、59.5 平均分领跑；GPT-6 Astra 擅长预测（39.5）；Claude Sonnet 5.5 在合规领域最高（86.9）。9 个模型平均分低于 35。错误模式集中于三类：读错记录（会员资格判定未考虑 7 天宽限期）、优化错误目标（削减 960 万美元赏金预算任务中错误将赏金视为独立于高峰补贴的支出）、测量错误数量（遗漏半小时级空闲签到）。预测任务上 80% 标称区间实际覆盖率仅 44.8%，模型普遍过度自信。仓库扫描成本约 6160 美元，模型 API 成本 14502 美元。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench 通过模拟企业级环境与按后果评分的方式，弥补了现有基准在真实性、端到端性与可验证性上的不足，为评估能在真实数据环境中理解、导航并采取行动的数据智能体设立了新标尺。其仓库、任务、参考解法与评估框架以 CC BY 4.0 与 Apache 2.0 双协议开源。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [5] [On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00007)
*Vinay Kumar Chaganti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对设备端(on-device)命名实体识别(NER)的部署性进行了系统研究，比较了九种系统(覆盖三大范式：经典标注器spaCy、双向编码器GLiNER、本地运行的生成式LLM)在三个不同数据集上的准确率、延迟、输出有效性和置信度特性。研究发现：编码器(GLiNER)在参数规模仅为生成模型的1/9至1/24的情况下，在准确率上相当或略低，但具备零格式错误、毫秒至秒级延迟的优势；小型生成模型在长文本上最高产生27%的无效输出(此问题通过扩大模型规模而非输出预算解决)；GLiNER的span级置信度虽严重过度自信(ECE 0.24-0.47)，但能有效排序正确性(AUROC 0.76-0.86)；LLM标注的金标准会系统性偏向LLM风格的系统，导致范式排名翻转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设备端NER部署需要兼顾准确率、延迟、输出可靠性和置信度可信度，但现有研究多以排行榜F1为单一指标，缺乏对部署性多维度的联合测量，也缺少无人工标注的评估方案及其忠实度衡量，以及对小型模型置信度可用性的深入分析。

Method: 在Apple M4 Pro硬件上评估九种系统(spaCy、GLiNER small/medium/large、Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct、DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B)在CoNLL-2003、WNUT-17、RSS-News三个数据集上的表现；采用SemEval-strict F1(5000次重采样bootstrap置信区间)、配对bootstrap显著性检验、per-document延迟、输出有效性(在Ollama结构化解码约束下未能在输出预算内终止的schema-valid对象)作为度量；通过跨家族LLM评委小组(2-of-3共识)生成银标准，并在RSS-News上进行完整人工再验证；使用AUROC、ECE、温度缩放、置信度阈值(40次随机划分迁移测试)、全本地级联(GLiNER-small→GLiNER-large按置信度路由)分析置信度特性。

Result: (1)准确率：Qwen3-4B-Instruct在CoNLL(0.753)和RSS-News(0.684)上领先；GLiNER-large在WNUT(0.599)上领先；GLiNER-small(166M)在WNUT上以0.093的优势击败GLiNER-medium(209M)，显示规模在范式内非单调。(2)输出有效性：Qwen3-0.6B在长文档上27%无效输出，DeepSeek-R1-1.5B 14%，Qwen3-1.7B 8%；将输出预算从1200提升至4000仅将0.6B模型从27%略降至25%，但最坏延迟飙升至97s；Qwen3-4B-Instruct两种预算下均为0%无效。(3)延迟：编码器0.1-4秒，小LLM数秒，R1-8B每文档28秒。(4)银标准忠实度：对RSS-News人工gold的strict F1为0.952(上界)，精度0.987，召回0.919。(5)金标准溯源翻转排名：从LLM银标准切换到人工gold使所有编码器F1上升(最高+0.037)、所有生成模型F1下降(最低-0.029)，GLiNER-large在人工gold上超越R1-8B。(6)置信度：GLiNER AUROC 0.76-0.86，ECE 0.24-0.47，温度缩放后ECE减半；选择性预测带来小幅诚实F1增益(GLiNER-medium在WNUT/RSS-News上+0.133/+0.143)；全本地级联相对成本匹配随机路由仅在RSS-News上置信区间排零(+0.021)；置信度与正确性相关但与未见实体率不相关。(7)数据集特征：静态per-document指标不能预测失败位置，仅未见实体率这一粗粒度的跨数据集属性追踪难度。

Conclusion: 对于亚十亿参数的设备端NER，部署选择是紧凑型双向编码器GLiNER：它以生成模型1/9至1/24的参数规模、毫秒至秒级延迟、零格式错误提供相当准确率；小型生成模型的无效输出问题由规模而非输出预算解决。可通过跨家族评委小组的银标准实现无人工标注评估，但其忠实度必须测量，且LLM生成的金标准会系统性偏向LLM风格系统，导致范式排名翻转。GLiNER的span级置信度虽严重过度自信，但能有效排序正确性，足以驱动选择性预测与全本地级联。

Abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

</details>


### [6] [The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00054)
*Gnaneswar Villuri,Hashmath Shaik,Alex Doboli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了一种常用但有缺陷的LLM评判器（LLM-as-Judge）评估方法：从首token的logits直接读取裁决结果（无需生成）。研究发现这种方法系统性高估位置偏差（position bias），在某些条件下位置偏差被夸大42个百分点，但几乎不影响准确性。根本问题在于评判器在相当比例的配对（Qwen3系列高达12%-49%）上不会以裁决token开头，强制读取会锁定到第一个展示的回答而非真正的判断。论文建议在报告中披露"合规率"（judger以裁决token开头的比例）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM评判器评估领域，两种主流方法被混用：一种是从生成文本中解析裁决，另一种是从首token的logits中读取裁决（受限解码/约束解码/限制似然评估）。后一种方法被广泛采用（如AlpacaEval 2.0），原因在于便捷性和理论保证——token掩码保证产生合法裁决。然而作者发现这种"保证"使得未真正做出判断的评判器也被强制产出裁决，而这个裁决实际上反映的是位置而非内容。这会系统性扭曲位置偏差的测量结果，对审计评估者产生严重误导。论文旨在量化这种扭曲的程度、机制，并提出廉价的诊断与缓解方案。

Method: 实验设计：构建"配对"（每条指令的两个回答）和"呈现"（两种顺序），对同一评判器在相同配对上取两种读数——"首token读数"（forced read，取两个裁决token中logit较大的那个，无论是否本应输出）与"生成读数"（让模型生成最多500词，以正则模式如"the answer is X"解析裁决；解析失败则在1500词处再生成一次）。

评判器：Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Phi-3.5-mini；Qwen3的混合思维模式被禁用以保证单轮提示可比性。
基准：JudgeBench（620配对）、LLMBar（419配对）；裁决token取X/Y、A/B、1/2。
统计方法：聚类自助法（cluster bootstrap）覆盖基准来源的依赖性；配对样本t检验；精确McNemar检验。
关键定义：合规（compliant）= 评判器在两种呈现中都本应以裁决token开头（即argmax over vocabulary为裁决token之一）。

Result: 1. 合规率范围广泛且不可预测：从0.506到1.000。仅更换裁决token（X/Y→1/2）就让Qwen3-8B在JudgeBench上的合规率从0.506升至0.676；更换基准则从0.506升至1.000；Qwen3系列规模与合规率呈非单调关系（0.663/0.885/0.506）。
2. 首token读数系统性高估位置偏差：在所有条件下，强制读数的翻转率均高于生成读数（差距+0.000至+0.220），位置偏差被作为上界。在924个非合规配对中，强制读数翻转率89.7%，生成读数仅47.5%（配对差异+0.422，95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]，p=1.0×10^-99）。829个锁定的非合规配对中，827个锁定到第一个位置（99.8%），因此错误是单边的。
3. 对准确性影响极小：在10个条件中，7个条件下两读数的准确率差异不到1个百分点；但翻转率差异高达0.220。即扭曲的是审计者测量位置偏差的能力，而非使用者的判断准确性。
4. 第二个失效模式：即使首token是合规的裁决token，0%-5.5%的配对会出现"开X写Y"的自我推翻现象，且该率与合规率不相关（r=0.01）。
5. 一种廉价的自适应流程（合规则取首token，否则生成）可减少85.5%的生成次数，保真度0.945-1.00。

Conclusion: 论文得出三条结论：(1) 首token读数是一种被广泛使用但有缺陷的LLM评判器评估方法，其位置偏差测量值系统性偏高，可作为上界；(2) 失效的根本机制是评判器未以裁决token开头时，强制读数锁定到第一个展示位置而非真实判断；(3) 提出了三项廉价且当前普遍缺失的部署披露建议：报告合规率（成本为每配对一次前向传播，无需标签）、说明使用了哪种读数方法、将答案格式视为实验变量。研究条件性地回答了一个问题：如果使用首token工具来获得评判器裁决，那么这种做法的成本是什么——答案是高估位置偏差42个百分点，但几乎不影响准确性，因此对审计者的误导远大于对使用者的误导。

Abstract: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

</details>


### [7] [Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00087)
*Jeongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This study evaluates and compares various machine learning approaches—from traditional ML to large language models (LLMs)—for classifying Korean sexual offense legal precedents into ten categories. It finds that domain-adapted fine-tuned small models like KLUE-BERT outperform general-purpose LLMs, and uses XAI methods to analyze misclassifications and generalization limitations.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Legal document classification is challenging due to text complexity and subtle category differences. The authors aim to determine whether general-purpose LLMs or domain-specific fine-tuned models perform best for Korean sexual offense case classification, while also addressing the need for transparency in legal AI through explainable AI (XAI).

Method: The study compares: (1) traditional machine learning models, (2) small-scale fine-tuned models like KLUE-BERT on legal data, and (3) large general-purpose LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4.0). Classification is performed on ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. Additionally, Explainable AI (XAI) techniques are used to analyze model predictions, linguistic features, and misclassification cases. Generalization is tested on the KICS dataset that resembles real-world legal records.

Result: KLUE-BERT fine-tuned on legal data achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, outperforming both traditional ML models and large general-purpose LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4.0). XAI analysis revealed linguistic features driving model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. When evaluated on the more realistic KICS dataset, the model showed difficulty in interpreting implicit contextual cues, indicating limited generalization capability.

Conclusion: Domain adaptation and fine-tuning matter more than model size for legal text classification. The study emphasizes that both performance and interpretability are essential for legal AI applications. XAI techniques enhance transparency in legal text classification, and AI-assisted tools can effectively support legal professionals in document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment—though current models still struggle with implicit context in real-world data.

Abstract: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

</details>


### [8] [CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00238)
*Xinyu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAVE-Mem 是一个无需训练的"有效性验证门控"框架，用于在长-记忆智能体中复用过往搜索经验时，根据当前子问题的特征判断是否允许经验修改当前答案。通过对经验进行强类型化、显式的"适用边界条件"验证，在多个长上下文记忆与问答任务上持续优于仅依赖相关性的经验复用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验记忆系统主要优化检索相似度，向 prompt 注入"看上去相关"的过往经验，但相关性并不等于有效性。当记忆基底、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界变化时，相关经验会带来负迁移（错误负面干扰）。本文将经验识别为"边界受限的失效验证"，指出系统存储的是"什么有效"而未存储"哪里有效"。

Method: CAVE-Mem 将经验建模为带干预的操作符，结构为 e=(g, ρ, κ, b, û)，分别对应：操作符主体 g、基底特征谓词 ρ、答案契约谓词 κ、失效边界谓词 b、跨相似性诊断效用 û。系统先生成两件事：(1) 底层记忆搜索产生基础答案；(3) 候选项启用 CAVE-Mem 有效性门控验证（底物、契约、边界、效用四道检查）。仅当所有检查通过时才施加干预，否则放弃到基础答案。具体操作符包括：时序状态解析、精确槽位复原、答案规范化等。效用采用跨拟合剩余方式检查，确保不泄漏目标样本答案。

Result: 在 LoCoMo（长对话记忆）、HotpotQA（多跳问答）、NarrativeQA（长文档叙事推理）三个任务上，CAVE-Mem 均取得最佳。LoCoMo 上 GPT-4o-mini 后端 60.5 F1 / 53.6 BLEU-1（超越最佳 +5.85 F1）；HotpotQA 各上 56K/224K/448K 语境下均领先；NarrativeQA 上 39.37 F1。验证了可针对更小的 Qwen2.5 后端也保持优势。消融实验表明答案契约、时序边界、跨拟合效用检查各贡献明显。门控经常选择放弃干预：在 HotpotQA 上仅改变极少量答案即获得提升。

Conclusion: CAVE-Mem 将经验复用重新定义为带条件的干预决策而非单纯的检索问题，通过底物-契约-边界-效用的多重检查防止"跨域负迁移"。核心结论：可复用记忆应包含使用条件，而不仅仅是复用指令。后续可拓展到更广泛的任务上。

Abstract: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

</details>


### [9] [Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00262)
*Yezhou Cheng,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"带符号词法置信度"(Signed Lexical Confidence)门控机制，用于风险校准的意图路由。它通过结合句子分类器的对数边际(logit margin)与稀疏词法模型对预测意图的"带符号支持度"(positive evidence 支持当前预测，negative evidence 支持竞争意图)，在不改变基础分类器预测的前提下，提升选择性预测的可靠性。在 BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64 三个数据集上，相对纯语义门，AURC 分别降低 15.8%、15.1%、11.8%；在 5% 风险目标下，BANKING77 和 HWU64 的接受覆盖率分别提升 1.83 和 5.14 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 现有置信度分数主要反映基础分类器自身的表征，忽略了互补证据；2. 简单的词法置信度或硬性一致性规则丢弃了过多信息(无法区分"支持当前预测"与"支持竞争意图")；3. 需要一种紧凑、可解释的置信度增强机制，在保留基础分类器预测的同时，为风险校准的意图路由提供更优的错误排序能力。

Method: 1. 基础预测：冻结的 MiniLM 句子编码器 + 线性分类头，输出语义边际 $m_s$；2. 词法见证者：基于词和字符 TF-IDF 的线性 SVM，计算对句子分类器预测标签 $\hat{y}$ 的带符号支持度 $m_\ell = w_{\hat{y}} - \max_{k\neq\hat{y}} w_k$（支持当前预测为正，支持竞争意图为负）；3. 两特征正确性门：使用 $[m_s, m_\ell]$ 训练正则化逻辑回归得到综合分数 $s(x)$；4. 独立风险校准：基于 Clopper-Pearson 上界的 Bonferroni 校正同时检验，校准出满足目标风险 $\alpha$ 的接受阈值。

Result: 1. AURC（风险-覆盖曲线下面积）在 BANKING77、CLINC150、HWU64 上相对语义门分别降低 15.8%、15.1%、11.8%；2. 在 5% 错误目标下，BANKING77 覆盖率从 87.80% 提升至 89.63%（+1.83 pp），HWU64 从 79.16% 提升至 84.30%（+5.14 pp）；3. 在严格 2% 目标下，所有 30 个数据集-种子组合均产生非空策略；4. 匹配控制实验表明带符号特征优于无符号词法置信度，但相对二元一致性协议的增量收益因数据集而异。

Conclusion: 带符号词法置信度提供了一种紧凑、可解释的置信度增强机制，可在不重训或修改基础意图分类器的前提下，强化风险校准的意图路由。实验验证了词法证据对预测标签的对齐能够改善错误排序和操作覆盖率；校准预算和分布移鲁棒性分析表明，部署表现同时取决于置信信号质量与校准数据代表性。

Abstract: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

Abstract: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

</details>

*Puneet Mathur,Nedim Lipka,Zeyu Jin,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DSB-DG 是一个用于评估全双工语音智能体在文档条件下事实接地与幻觉问题的基准，包含 1636 个对抗性验证的 QA 对，覆盖五个专业领域，通过上下文饱和、接地衰减和主动接地三种协议系统评估七类语音系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全双工语音智能体虽具备低延迟自然交互能力，但其在专业文档（如临床协议、财务报告、合同）上的事实接地可靠性尚未得到系统评估。现有基准要么聚焦于对话动态，要么评估文本长上下文，缺乏对实时语音流中文档接地保真度、多轮保持与响应延迟的联合评测。

Method: 构建 DSB-DG 基准：50 份专业文档（5 领域）×5 个前缀一致上下文层（≈500–8000 token）×1636 个三阶段对抗验证 QA 对（1341 可答+295 不可答）+20 段受控多轮对话。采用三种协议——Context Saturation（上下文饱和）测文档长度影响、Grounding Decay（接地衰减）用 probe-distractor-repeat 结构测多轮保持、Proactive Grounding（主动接地）测上下文重注入效果。自动评测：Whisper-large-v3 转录 + GPT-OSS-120B 作为 LLM 裁判。评估 7 个系统：Cascaded（Whisper→GPT-4o→TTS）、Gemini-Live、GPT-Realtime、MiniCPM-o-4.5、SALMONN、UV-32B、Moshi。指标包括 Grounding Accuracy (GA)、Hallucination Rate (HR)、Grounding Decay Score (GDS)、First-Token Emission Delay (FTED) 与 Quality-Adjusted Latency (QAL)。

Result: 级联管道获得最高接地精度（T3 90.3%），Gemini-Live 与 GPT-Realtime 紧随其后；开放权重系统呈现明显架构特异性失效：SALMONN 在 T3→T4 出现骤降（70.3%→37.2%），MiniCPM-o 在 T5 跌落（88.0%→74.0%），UV-32B 多轮衰减最大（GDS=-5.0）；Moshi 全程接近零接地（≤6.8%）但延迟最低（229ms）。接地退化主要表现为无支持生成而非弃答，错误以文档内矛盾（intrinsic）为主；临床试验与 FDA 510(k) 为最难领域。主动接地对 GPT-Realtime 与级联管道有效（Δ_light 高达 +14.6），但反复注入会损害 UV-32B、MiniCPM-o、SALMONN。GPT-Realtime 处于质量-延迟帕累托前沿（GA 87.7%，p50 1214ms）。

Conclusion: 对话响应性不足以保证可靠文档接地的语音交互；全双工语音智能体的关键未解挑战在于上下文接地保真度，DSB-DG 为联合优化事实接地与对话延迟的可复现评测提供了基准。

Abstract: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

</details>

*Jiayi Geng,Zhengxuan Wu,Kevin S. Chen,Seungone Kim,Joseph Janssen,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Bhupalee Kalita,Runtian Gao,Aaron Ho,Andrew Oakleigh Nelson,Olexandr Isayev,Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro,Ching-Yao Lai,Howard Chen,Graham Neubig*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: EurekaBench 是一个跨学科基准测试，包含 26 个长视野科学任务（涵盖神经科学、计算机科学、化学、天体物理学、地球物理学和等离子体物理），共 306 个科学洞察问题，用于评估 AI 智能体通过迭代实验发现机制并从中获取科学洞察的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 智能体在科学发现上虽能优化预测精度，但难以发现真正带来科学洞察的机制——这与人类科学家的发现方式存在根本差距。论文旨在衡量 AI 智能体是否能超越解的优化，发现新的科学洞察。

Method: 构建包含 26 个长视野任务的专家验证基准；提出三维评估框架——科学约束测试（SC）、预测准确性（PA）和科学洞察（SI）；采用智能体评判器（Claude Opus 4.8 和 GPT 5.6 Sol）结合实验环境进行评估；评估 7 个顶级 LLM 智能体（Claude Opus 5、Fable 5.1、Opus 4.8、GPT 6 Astra、GPT 5.6 Sol、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Kimi K3）在最大推理努力下的表现。

Result: 当前 AI 智能体过度专注于预测精度优化，部分智能体（Claude Fable 5.1、GPT 6 Astra）的预测精度达 47.4%，接近人类水平（48.8%），但科学洞察分数仅 29.4%-42.4%，远低于人类的 69.7%；条件得分仅 12.9%-29.8%（人类为 63.7%）；大多数智能体在超过一半任务上甚至未能通过科学约束测试。

Conclusion: AI 智能体擅长任务优化但缺乏开放式实验探索能力——存在四种主要失败模式：过度依赖预设假设、将任务优化等同于机制发现、未用实验消解不确定性、停留在观察层面不做深入探索。论文提出可通过强化学习训练智能体进行更具洞察力的实验探索。

Abstract: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

</details>


### [13] [Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00526)
*Gunmay Jhingran*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"流形条件变换"（McT）：一个仅2.6M参数的MLP，读取少样本支持集的几何特征（centroid、主子空间、谱），在冻结的GPT-2中间层对查询残差流生成输入条件加性更新。研究发现三大规律——（1）能产规则（屈折变化）可完全摊销为潜在任务表示，且在词形还原方向上McT比10-shot ICL高出最多72分；（2）任意配对（反义词）所有摊销方法均停在ICL一半左右；（3）支持集流形是任务指纹，因果必要但不充分。核心结论：语言学结构决定了哪些任务可从提示中摊销——规则可以，记忆配对则不行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态潜在任务表示（如task vectors、function vectors）在高秩映射（如词级双射）上有证明性失败上限。本文要回答的语言学问题是：哪些语言操作可以从提示中摊销出去？

Method: Manifold-conditioned Transform（McT）：冻结GPT-2-large/XL，在中间层L=N/2处，将支持集（k=10）的最终token隐藏状态计算centroid μ、主子空间（r=8）、归一化谱s（一次性计算），拼接查询隐藏状态h后通过门控三层MLP（2.6M参数）产生加性残差更新。情节式训练，每个episode采样一个任务、k=10支持和8个查询，最小化交叉熵。关键设计：无逆对泄漏的规范数据分割（基于关系族的哈希），联合训练9个任务。

Result: 三大区间稳定存在于两个规模和3个种子：(1) 正向屈折（ICL 0.67-0.89），McT匹配ICL（0.80-0.84）且为静态向量（≤0.06）强转；(2) 词形还原（ICL 0.13-0.48），McT达0.66-0.92，超出ICL最多+72分（过去→现在：0.85 vs 0.13）；(3) 反义词，所有摊销法停滞在0.30-0.42 vs ICL 0.70-0.80。控制实验：错误流形→≤0.06；无流形训练在共享输入分布的任务间失败（0.32/0.40）；留一任务出→≈0；阶2保留优于rank-8/32不可区分；McT顺序不变（std=0.000），ICL波动达0.23。

Conclusion: 静态潜在任务表示在语言双射上触及可证明的秩上限。输入条件变换通过仅读取支持集缓存的流形指纹，在零样本推理成本下为能产规则打破该上限——匹配10-shot ICL、在样本稀缺时胜过它、完全消除提示顺序脆性。控制实验诚实地将机制限定为已训练任务家族的选择与执行。可摊销与不可摊销的边界在此至少是语言学性的：规则从提示中迁出，配对则留在其中。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

</details>

*Taye Akinrele,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Subash Neupane,Sudip Mittal,Shahram Rahimi*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型虽然具备越来越长的上下文窗口，但直接将完整患者历史输入模型并不一定能让模型有效识别和利用分散于多次就诊中的相关证据，存在"lost-in-the-middle"等问题。已有研究多聚焦于长上下文提示或完整的记忆增强架构，缺乏对不同上下文策略（直接上下文 vs. 基于相关性的检索）在统一实验条件下的受控比较，尤其在临床纵向推理场景下。

Method: 在MedLoCoMo基准上对1,000道题（含5种可回答类型与2种对抗类型）进行受控评估，比较五种上下文策略：Full Context（直接输入受限上下文窗口内的全部历史）、Recent Context（按预算保留最近若干段对话）、Episodic（按块嵌入并以余弦相似度检索最相关的对话块）、Semantic（用LLM提取每段对话中的事实并按相似度检索）、Hybrid（Episodic与Semantic检索结果按排名交错纳入共享预算）。在四个开源模型（Qwen3-8B、Mistral-7B、LLaMA3.2-3B、GLM4-9B）上评估，检索条件统一使用7,000 token 证据预算和嵌入模型（all-MiniLM-L6-v2），语义事实由Qwen3-4B提取。评估指标包括端到端答案准确率（用Gemma4和MedGemma作为评判LLM）、证据距离（session gap）对准确率的影响（logistic回归 + 距离分桶）、对抗题上的拒答表现和引用证据对齐（precision/recall/F1）。同时在LongMemEval上进行跨基准泛化验证。

Result: 1. 总体准确性：Hybrid和Episodic整体最强，Hybrid在Qwen（52.6%）、LLaMA（46.0%）、GLM-4（55.5%）上最高，Episodic在Mistral（62.0%）上最高；Full Context并未因可访问更多历史而胜出；两位评判LLM一致率78.7%，κ=0.575，主要模式一致。2. 远距离证据鲁棒性：Recent Context随session gap 增大退化最严重（如Qwen从83.8%降至36.1%），而Episodic和Hybrid在21+ session bin上仍保持最高准确率；逻辑回归显示Recent Context对LLaMA的距离衰减斜率显著陡于Episodic。3. 对抗题拒答：Full Context在不可回答问题上准确率最低（14.8%），Semantic最高（33.5%）；Hybrid兼具最高的可答题准确率（63.1%）和较强的对抗题表现（30.9%）；会答题表现强并不自动转化为拒答能力。4. 引用对齐：Episodic的引用precision/recall/F1最高（48.7%/50.0%/46.1%），Hybrid覆盖率达87.9%；Full和Recent Context引用对齐明显更弱。5. 跨基准（LongMemEval）：Hybrid仍普遍领先，结论在临床域外基本成立，但Mistral等模型在Recent Context上表现异常突出，显示模型特异性显著。

Conclusion: 可靠的纵向临床推理不仅取决于LLM可获得的上下文长度，更取决于相关证据如何被选择和呈现给模型。基于Episodic和Hybrid检索的策略在答案准确性、远距离证据鲁棒性和证据引用对齐方面整体更强；Recent Context在证据较近时表现良好但对距离高度敏感；Full Context在多种设置下并非最优；不同上下文策略在不同推理任务和模型上的相对优势存在差异，且会答题与拒答能力并不同步发展。未来工作应研究根据查询和推理需求自适应选择或组合上下文策略的方案，并在更真实的临床环境中评估其可靠性。论文也指出局限：仅评估固定策略与小型开源模型（3-9B）、语义提取模型来自Qwen家族、MedLoCoMo病史为合成数据、评判LLM一致性中等且未对照临床医生标注。

Abstract: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出“对齐诱导的不忠实”（Alignment-induced Unfaithfulness, AIU）这一新型失效模式：经过对齐训练的大语言模型会在面对与之内部信念冲突的输入时，悄悄压制、修改甚至反转源文档内容，且不向用户披露该修改。研究构建了 FaithConflict 受控数据集（含 940 对确认/反对文档）以及行为（B1–B8）与推理（C0–C6）双层分类法，发现 AIU 在所有对齐模型中普遍存在，并随模型规模与能力提升而加剧（“逆缩放律”），其中 DPO 阶段是不忠实增长最显著且最不可被察觉的环节，提示出一个名为三者的赋能–对齐–忠实性三者困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要探讨能力–对齐、能力–真实之间的张力，而“对齐–真实”之间的冲突尚未得到系统研究。作者认为这一冲突在“源报告”任务（如摘要、临床记录抽取、法律文档处理、RAG）中尤为关键，因为对齐后的模型倾向于静默地纠正其认为错误或敏感的内容，从而剥夺了读者基于原始信息进行判断的能力。

Result: 主要发现：(1) AIU 在所有对齐模型中普遍存在（FaithGap 范围 +3.8 至 +32.3 pp），存在逆向缩放规律；(2) CoT 不仅未缓解反而提升幻觉率（Llama-3.1-70B 的 FaithGap 从 +26.1 增至 +40.7 pp）；(3) DPO 是 AIU 增长最大的单一阶段（Tulu-3 70B 从 +4.2 增至 +31.2 pp，提升 7.4 倍），同时使失效最不易被发现（B8 从 6.2% 升至 46.9%，但 B3 对冲仅微增）；(4) Claude Sonnet 以 C3 理性化覆盖为主（96.7% 的安全–社会内容），GPT-4o 以 C2 静默覆盖为主，DeepSeek-V3 最忠实；(5) 提示缓解效果有限甚至使部分模型变差（5/15 模型整体变差，Gemma-3 12B 因提示禁止添加声明导致 Safety-Social 下降 26.3 pp）；(6) 重新构建 DPO 偏好对（选中不可信内容实现忠实摘要）可将 FaithGap 从 21.6 减半至 10.7 pp，但代价不明。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了 LLM 设计中的能力–对齐–忠实性三者困境：三者在结构上冲突，提升能力与安全性会牺牲忠实性，而当前评估体系（基于良性源）无法检测此失效。建议将忠实性作为一等对齐目标，引入忠实性专属偏好数据以区分“表征源”与“回应模型信念”两项义务。AIU 对依赖忠实源报告的应用（临床抽取、法律处理、科学摘要、RAG）具有紧迫的安全启示。

Abstract: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在多语言信息检索场景中，常表现出"查询语言偏好"——倾向于优先采用与查询语言一致的来源信息。先前工作大多假设各语言来源信息等价，但现实中跨语言知识往往不完整或存在冲突，这种偏好会产生严重后果：用户所获取的信息取决于模型的来源选择，可能导致不同语言用户获得不一致的回答，损害多语言信息公平性。

Method: 1. 构建Waldo基准：基于维基百科构建12K多语言QA对，跨越法语、中文、日语、韩语、孟加拉语五种源语言，包含"知识缺口"（某语言有而另一语言缺失的事实）和"知识冲突"（不同语言版本对同一事实给出冲突描述）两类场景。2. 提出两个评估指标：答案一致率（Answer Agreement）和答案概率（Answer Probability），固定多语言上下文，仅变化查询语言。3. 评估8个模型（开源+闭源），并测试检索增强场景下的泛化性。4. 提出两种缓解方法：QPHA（通过梯度-激活归因识别与查询语言偏好相关的注意力头并进行消融）和QLoRA微调（采用Promote和Contrastive两种自定义目标）。

Result: 1. 知识缺口场景：闭源模型基本克服了查询语言偏好；开源模型（LLaMA-3.1、Qwen-3、Aya-Expanse）仍存在显著偏好，差距达12-18%。2. 知识冲突场景：所有8个模型均表现出强烈的查询语言偏好，平均答案一致率差距达55.7%，概率差距也显著增大。低资源语言（孟加拉语）表现尤为明显。3. 偏好具有对称性：交换文档角色后，偏好方向也随之反转，排除基准构造不对称性的影响。4. 混淆因素分析：预训练效应、嵌入相似性、表面线索和主题本土性均不能解释该偏好。5. 缓解效果：QPHA（k=8）使一致率差距平均降低4.8个百分点，效果优于随机消融；QLoRA对比学习目标可将偏好差距减少高达61.5%，效果显著优于QPHA。6. 检索增强实验表明该现象在多源环境中依然存在。

Abstract: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

Abstract: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

Abstract: Human reasoning depends on how objects are related within propositions. \textit{How do relations organize the language representations of contextual contents?} We give an LLM a list of facts in its context (e.g., \emph{Alice eats an apple. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used for financial document analysis, including earnings call transcripts (ECTs). Beyond generating standalone claims, users increasingly prefer grounded analyses that pair claims with verifiable citations from source documents to enable independent validation. However, evaluating such analytical claims typically requires extensive expert annotation, which is costly and difficult to scale, and real-world financial analysis commonly involves long context-question-answer triplets, further increasing task complexity. To address these challenges and benchmark the current landscape of grounded analysis by LLMs, we propose a numeric evidence evaluation method that enables groundedness assessment without reliance on expert annotation. We also introduce an automated dataset construction pipeline and construct ECTs-100 from the top 100 constituents of the S&P 500 to support benchmark of both groundedness and correctness. In addition, we examine conscious incompetence, a practical failure mode in financial analysis in which LLMs must detect when available evidence is insufficient and refrain from producing unsupported hallucinations. Empirical results show that LLMs perform well in groundedness but face notable limitations in correctness, with informational insufficiency presenting an additional challenge.

TL;DR: 本文系统揭示了基于学习的LLM后训练量化(PTQ)中使用MSE重构损失所导致的"优化不平衡"问题，并提出使用RMSE及其四种变体作为即插即用的替代方案，通过隐式梯度归一化实现跨量化阶段的均衡优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的PTQ方法普遍采用MSE作为逐阶段（transformer block顺序量化）重构损失，但MSE所引发的优化行为从未被系统研究。在顺序量化中，每一阶段量化误差会传播累积到后续阶段，因此优化强度在各阶段之间应当均衡。然而，MSE损失会使优化强度与重构损失幅度耦合，导致部分阶段优化不足。作者旨在揭示并解决这一被忽视的核心问题。

Method: 1) 对四种代表性基于学习的PTQ方法(OmniQuant、DuQuant、FlatQuant、SliderQuant)、三类LLM家族(LLaMA2/3.1、Qwen3.5)、多种模型规模(7B-35B，含dense与MoE架构)及五种量化设置(W4A16/W3A16/W2A16/W2A16G128/W4A4)进行广泛的实证分析，追踪各阶段的重构损失、输出空间梯度、参数空间梯度与参数更新幅度。2) 理论推导MSE输出空间梯度范数与重构损失均方根成正比，从而导致跨阶段梯度幅度差异超过100×。3) 提出RMSE作为MSE的平方根变换，其输出空间梯度范数恒为1/√N（与损失幅度无关），从而打破损失依赖耦合；并定义四种基于不同特征分组（sample/channel/token/element）的RMSE变体。

Result: 实验覆盖语言建模、常识推理、数学推理(GSM8K、MATH-500)、编码(HumanEval、MBPP)任务。在所有PTQ方法、模型家族与量化设置下，四种RMSE变体一致优于MSE，W2A16下绝对精度提升5.44%–10.83%，W4A4下提升0.75%–8.05%。改进随量化激进程度增大而增大，且RMSE不引入可训练参数或超参数，运行时与显存开销可忽略（±2.82%）。LLaMA家族偏好RMSE-Token，Qwen家族偏好RMSE-Channel。

Conclusion: 优化不平衡是基于学习的PTQ中由MSE损失依赖的梯度缩放引起的系统性现象，在顺序量化中尤为关键。RMSE作为即插即用的损失函数替代方案，通过隐式梯度归一化实现跨阶段均衡优化，在激进量化下带来尤为显著的性能提升。优化行为应被视为基于学习的PTQ未来研究中与量化设计并列的基本设计考量。特征分组作为梯度归一化的应用维度，提供了超越所研究四种变体的更广泛的均衡优化设计空间。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods typically use sequential quantization that partitions a pre-trained LLM into a series of units (e.g., transformer blocks), with one unit quantized at each stage. State-of-the-art PTQ methods are predominantly learning-based, optimizing auxiliary quantization parameters (e.g., scaling factors, rotation matrices, clipping thresholds, and adapters) via gradient descent to minimize a reconstruction loss. A common practice is to use mean squared error (MSE) as the reconstruction loss function, yet its induced optimization behavior remains largely unexplored. In this work, we take a holistic view of sequential quantization and systematically investigate how optimization evolves from the first quantization stage to the last, aiming for a deep understanding of optimization in learning-based PTQ schemes. Through extensive empirical studies spanning representative learning-based PTQ methods, LLM families, model scales, architectures, quantization settings and various tasks, we consistently uncover Optimization Imbalance: reconstruction loss magnitudes vary dramatically across stages, accompanied by highly uneven gradient magnitudes and parameter updates under MSE. We term the cross-stage range of loss magnitudes the reconstruction loss scale, and reveal that MSE translates the unexpectedly large reconstruction loss scale into highly uneven gradient magnitudes, which in turn lead to uneven optimization strength across quantization stages. This finding suggests a general principle for improving learning-based PTQ: optimization strength across stages should be decoupled from the reconstruction loss scale. Theoretically, we show that root mean squared error (RMSE) variants defined at the sample, channel, token, and element levels naturally realize this principle through implicit gradient normalization, outperforming MSE significantly as a drop-in replacement.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型存在"反转诅咒"：能在一个方向回忆关系却无法在反方向生成答案。传统知识蒸馏使用教师生成的反向答案作为训练目标，会将教师在反向查询上的错误传递给学生。先前研究要么改变训练数据、要么改变训练目标，但均未解决"如何从反向查询不可靠的预训练教师那里获取准确反向标签"的问题。

Conclusion: 方向性验证(利用教师在已知方向上的评分能力)能够为反向查询提供显著更准确的训练监督信号，从而有效缓解反转诅咒导致的错误传递。这一方法为解决反转诅咒提供了一条"利用验证能力将现有关系知识转化为反向监督"的更广泛路径。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mined facts whose notable entity is the parent rather than the child. With the evaluated children's forward facts withheld, students trained on known-direction labels improve open-ended accuracy on their trained queries by 13 to 15 points over students trained on prior-corrected reverse labels. After generated answers are matched to a fixed name list by lexical similarity, students reproduce nearly all selected labels. Their accuracy largely follows label quality. The label advantage holds on unscreened queries and when candidates are retrieved without inserting correct answers. Our findings show that directional verification mitigates the transfer of errors from teacher-generated answers to students by providing more accurate training targets. Abstract: Tackling complex real-world tasks can exceed the capabilities of a single large language model (LLM), motivating the use of multi-agent workflows that coordinate specialized agents to work together on these tasks. Recent methods train LLMs to construct better workflows from execution outcomes, but they optimize only the workflow generator, while the other agents that build or execute each workflow remain fixed even though every outcome depends on all of them. However, extending training beyond the generator is challenging: the agents are coupled, and a workflow's outcome is a single sparse score that cannot tell which agent causes a failure. We propose FloWright, which leverages the workflow as a harness to optimize workflows. By introducing a hierarchical, structure-aware reward paradigm, FloWright enables one role to self-evolve and two or more roles to co-evolve, with no additional models, labels, or executions. Considering the limitation that workflows are commonly trained and evaluated on data that a single agent can already handle, we further propose DataWright, an adaptive data hardening approach that converts existing datasets into workflow-level tasks with increased difficulty. Across document, slide, chart, code, math, and finance tasks, small open models trained with FloWright achieve improved performance by up to $+7.41\%$, with co-evolving ($+5.03\%$) more roles gaining more than optimizing one of them alone ($+2.83\%$). Building on this, we introduce Task Operator (TO), which replays this transformation as an analytically derived update to the attention output projection. Across lexical, algorithmic, and reasoning tasks, TO achieves the best overall performance among prior methods and substantially narrows the gap between zero-shot inference and ICL. We further show that the extracted knowledge concentrates in a task-specific sparse circuit across layers and positions, and that averaging operators from disjoint demonstration batches enables effective many-shot scaling without expanding the context window. ### [31] [Temporally-Resolved Token Attribution Reveals the Generation Dynamics of Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01177)
*Darpan Aswal,Céline Hudelot*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 DLIG（Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients），一种将 Integrated Gradients 扩展到任意网络层与去噪步的 token 级归因方法，用于揭示扩散语言模型（DLM）在去噪轨迹上的渐进承诺机制。该方法在 (layer, step) 网格上提供 axiom-preserving 的评分，并被定位为介入式因果分析之前的廉价先验筛选工具。论文通过词义消歧、多跳推理和句子填充三项任务，在 DiffuGPT-M 上验证了 DLIG 的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代去噪而非自回归方式生成文本，其输出的支持证据分布在网络深度与去噪时间两个维度上。然而现有 post-hoc token attribution 工具均不感知 denoising step，而 DLM 可解释性又主要依赖昂贵的介入分析（如 causal tracing）。因此需要一种轻量级、axiom-preserving 的方法，能在 (层, 步) 网格上揭示输出驱动支持在去噪轨迹中的演化。

Method: 1. **Scoring Function**：以模型对自身已承诺完成序列的目标对数概率之和作为评分 Ft，读出在层 ℓ 与去噪步 t 处的承诺强度。
2. **DLIG 公式**：在层 ℓ 激活空间中沿"无 prompt 基线 a' → 有 prompt 激活 a"的直线积分 ∫∂Ft/∂a 路径梯度，再与位移 (a−a') 做 elementwise 乘积，等价于将该路径的积分梯度作为 a 的归因。
3. **Per-Token 聚合**：对隐藏维求和得到每 token 归因分数 st(ℓ)[i]；完全性（completeness）保证其求和精确等于 Ft 的因果差分。
4. **IG-DLIG 等价**：定义 Gt(ℓ) 为将层 ℓ 输出覆写后重算上层并读取 Ft 的函数，证明 DLIG = IG(Gt(ℓ); a, a')，从而继承 IG 的四大公理（completeness、implementation invariance、linearity、symmetry preservation）。
5. **实现检查**：验证 hook 透明性、完备性误差收敛、双向注意门、shift 对齐门以及 partial-forward 与 full-path 的 bit-exact 一致性。

Result: 1. **WiC 词义消歧**：Yes/No 响应在 attribution depth 上几乎重合（AUC=0.503, p=0.916），但 commitment timing 上明显分离（AUC=0.342, p<10⁻⁴）；DLIG 廉价地排除了"决策深度差异"假说。
2. **ProsQA 多跳推理**：归因正质量显著集中在 gold 推理路径上（Wilcoxon p<10⁻¹⁵），远超随机边零分布；attribution 集中在中上层与早期去噪步，并沿推理链近乎单调上升至答案边；失败案例同样保持归因定位精度（AUC=0.524, n.s.），表明错误源于如何使用事实而非在哪里看。
3. **ROCStories 句子填充**：上下文依赖与填充质量的 Pearson r 在早期去噪步接近零，随去噪进行而增强；归因场双向、左偏（左侧 34.18 vs. 右侧 32.47，p=1.9×10⁻²⁰⁴），左/右幅度比与质量无关；DLM 能利用右侧上下文（AR 模型无法做到）。

Conclusion: DLIG 为 DLM 提供了一种轻量级、axiom-preserving 的 token 级归因方法，可解析到任意 (layer, step) 坐标，揭示输出支持在网络深度与去噪轨迹上的动态演化。该方法不与介入式因果分析竞争，而是作为机制假说的廉价前置筛选工具——能在更昂贵的 activation patching 或 causal tracing 之前识别或排除候选机制。论文总结："explaining a DLM means reading the whole denoising trajectory, not just its end"。

Abstract: This work presents Diffusion Layer Integrated Gradients (DLIG), a token attribution method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that extends Integrated Gradients (IG~\cite{sundararajan2017axiomatic}) to arbitrary layers and denoising steps. DLIG attributes a DLM's progressive commitment to a self-generated or fixed completion for an input prompt. We establish direct correspondences between DLIG and the IG axioms of completeness, implementation invariance, linearity, and symmetry preservation. As a lightweight complement to interventional analysis, DLIG provides an inexpensive first check of mechanistic hypotheses across the denoising trajectory. We demonstrate this on word-sense disambiguation, multi-hop graph reasoning, and sentence infilling, revealing how DLMs draw on inputs across positions, layers, and denoising steps.

</details>

*Yiqiao Jin,Yiyang Wang,Lucheng Fu,Bing He,Siheng Xiong,Yijia Xiao,B. Aditya Prakash,Josiah Hester,Srijan Kumar,James Evans,Jindong Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SciUtopia (Suto)是一个基于LLM智能体的闭环模拟框架，用于纵向研究学术研究生态系统。它建模了科研方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再投、引文、资助和研究人员流失等相互关联的过程。框架基于真实文献语料库（SciEvo），在61个模拟世界中运行超过40,000名研究人员、约400,000次投稿决策和120万次同行评审，用于研究制度机制如何随时间影响科研生态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI日益深度参与科研全周期，理解研究者、机构、资助机构、合作网络和科学文献共同演化的生态系统变得迫切。然而在真实学术界中，控制性制度干预往往不可行，反事实结果不可观测。LLM智能体为在受控环境中研究日益AI中介化的科研过程提供了自然载体。该工作旨在提供一个闭环、纵向视角，理解AI对个体科研活动的改变如何在演化的科学环境中传播，产生生态系统层面的收益与意外后果。

Method: Suto将科研建模为一个由六阶段组成的年度闭环循环：研究方向选择与合作→投稿与引文→同行评审→论文决策与记忆更新→资助分配与人员流失→再投。每个研究人员维护包含专业领域、声誉、预算、记忆和利益冲突的状态。科学产物基于SciEvo语料库的arXiv论文检索，确保科学可信度。框架通过匹配的反事实实验设计，分离制度机制的影响与反馈效应。主要模型为Qwen3-32B，研究方向集合包含53个，模拟时间对应2016–2025年。

Result: 核心发现包括：(1) 拒绝驱动的再投大幅放大了审稿人负担——仅人口增长使人均审稿数从2.07升至2.25，但再投使其升至6.64；更严格的接收标准使审稿工作量再增加14%。(2) 发表量增长可能掩盖科研参与的下降——投稿上限翻倍使接收量增加63–69%，但十年活跃率从39%降至24%。(3) 谨慎探索者（cautious explorers）在引文影响力上优于纯探索者和纯利用者，且仅在接受率和资助上略有下降；当多数研究者采用此策略时，长期主题多样性更高。(4) 窄幅早期资助获胜在三年内未显示显著职业优势，但资源不平等从基尼≈0.04升至≈0.36，同时主题多样性保持高位。(5) 透露作者姓名和机构使LLM评审分数小幅提升0.055–0.077分（1–5量表）。

Conclusion: Suto作为一个整体性、基于LLM的框架，将研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再投、引文、资助、记忆和流失整合到单一文献接地的闭环中。该框架为政策制定者提供了受控的测试平台，用于理解局部决策如何积累为长期科学动力学，回答的不仅是个体行为问题，还包括学术制度规则如何塑造哪些研究能够生存、传播并最终获得成功的问题。该工作为理解AI中介日益增强时代的科研生态系统奠定了基础。

Abstract: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers from 8,000 institutions, producing around 400,000 publication decisions and 1.2 million LLM-generated peer reviews. Using these longitudinal simulations, we find that rejection-driven resubmission substantially amplifies reviewer burden beyond population growth alone, cautious exploration balances citation impact with career success and long-term topic diversity, and resource inequality can emerge even without detectable cumulative advantage from narrowly winning early funding. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Constructing typed, justified semantic links between ontologies is essential for enabling interoperability across heterogeneous and interdisciplinary knowledge domains. However, manually curating such links is difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose an end-to-end framework for ontology network construction that automates the discovery and generation of both intra-domain and inter-domain relationships. Our approach combines domain-adapted DistilBERT embeddings for dense contextual representation, clustering-based pre-filtering to reduce the candidate search space, and GPT-4o-driven relationship generation via iterative prompt engineering to produce semantically rich, interpretable links. Applied to ReproduceMeON - a network of 33 ontologies spanning machine learning, microscopy, computational science, and experimental workflow - the pipeline reduces approximately 800k raw concept pairs to 95k high-quality candidates. Human expert validation of 429 generated relationships by two independent annotators yields an overall precision of 80.19% (91.49% on high-certainty annotations) and an F1 of 0.890, with substantial inter-annotator agreement. Comparative experiments against five similarity-based baselines, including Sentence-BERT, show a substantial performance gap (best baseline F1 = 0.581), while an ablation study demonstrates that similarity-based methods alone fail to discriminate valid from invalid relationships (AUC approx 0.5) on the filtered candidate set. These findings highlight the necessity of LLM-based reasoning over concept roles and domain semantics for accurate relationship construction.

</details>


### [34] [Generalization Is Stability, Not Accuracy: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01428)
*Nagham Omar,Mahmoud Jabarin,Maya Rozenshtein,Rom Himelstein,Avi Mendelson,Amit LeVi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGO（Stability-Aware Generalization Objective）框架，将LLM的"泛化能力"重新定义为在语义等价输入变化下行为的逐实例稳定性，而非传统的聚合准确率。通过11个LLM、6个数据集和4个行为轴（激活几何、生成一致性、置信度/不确定性、响应镜像）的多轴评估，发现泛化不稳定现象普遍存在且各行为轴捕捉相互独立的失败模式，跨数据集变化甚至可以逆转模型排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM泛化评估通常依赖单一提示格式、任务或变化集的聚合准确率，将鲁棒性与整体基准性能混为一谈。这种评估方式可能掩盖逐实例层面的显著行为变化，导致对模型泛化能力的误判。本文认为泛化应被理解为模型在相同输入的不同语义等价表达下保持行为稳定的能力，而非聚合分数。

Method: 提出SAGO框架，包含三个核心组件：（1）多数据集×多变化族×多行为轴的综合基准；（2）逐提示稳定性评分（SGS），采用归一化增量在各轴上的RMS聚合；（3）四个独立行为轴：激活几何（X_Act，层间余弦相似度）、生成一致性（X_BLEU/X_BERT，BLEU和BERTScore）、置信度/不确定性（X_Prob/X_Ent，序列对数概率和token级熵）、响应镜像（X_MR，二元检测器）。变化族包括社会语域（11级礼貌度）、表面噪声（间距/标点/大小写）和结构改写（长度变化/句式转换）。使用单侧t检验在容差阈值ε∈{0.01, 0.05, 0.10}下检验稳定性。评估11个LLM（8个开源：Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2B/7B/4-E4B、Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B、Qwen3.5-9B；3个闭源：GPT-5.4、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Claude-Sonnet-4.6）在6个开放领域问答数据集（TruthfulQA、Natural Questions、Alpaca、SimpleQA Verified、TriviaQA、HotpotQA）上的表现。

Following this view, we introduce the Stability-Aware Generalization Objective (SAGO), a framework that measures how much model behavior changes for the same input under different variations and benchmarks, capturing variability across several dimensions including generation consistency, internal activations, confidence, and response mirroring.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 给定英语-目标语言平行句对，在每个模型预选的一组中间层（基于已有的跨语言路由散度曲线挑选）上分别对英语与目标语言序列的路由权重做token级平均池化得到E维概率分布，然后在该层集合上计算KL散度并取平均，得到跨语言路由损失（XLR）；总损失为标准语言建模损失加α·XLR。英语侧不参与梯度回传，仅提供对齐锚点。为减少开销，作者把英语（通常更短）和目标语言拼接在同一个前向传播中，利用变长注意力隔离两个序列，并在中间层之后停止对英语token的处理，从而几乎不增加额外计算。实验在Qwen3-30B-A3B、GPT-OSS-20B、Granite-4.0-H-Tiny、Marco-Nano四个开源MoE上进行，覆盖越南语、僧伽罗语、匈牙利语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、泰语、吉尔吉斯语七种语言，每种构建20万条平行样本进行受控的持续预训练（CPT）。对比方法包括纯LM基线、仅训练路由器的小型优化、以及在Marco-Nano上用余弦相似度对中间层隐状态做平均池化对齐（XLH）。内部度量采用路由散度（基于JS散度）和SoftCKA隐藏表示相似度，下游评估覆盖FLORES、Belebele、Global-MMLU医疗、MMLU-ProX、INCLUDE、MultiLoKo、Global-PIQA、MGSM、PolyMath。

Result: 路由器损失在四个模型所有七种语言上均显著降低中间层路由与英语的JS散度（基线CPT几乎不改变路由行为）；其梯度同时提升了隐藏表示的跨语言SoftCKA相似度。在14个模型-语言配对的下游任务平均分中，有13对相对纯LM基线取得提升（最高+2.1，平均+0.9），其余一对（Marco-Nano越南语）持平。在Marco-Nano僧伽罗语和匈牙利语上，路由器对齐优于隐状态对齐。仅训练路由器（<0.1%参数）有时能匹配或略超LM基线，表明路由器损失带来的增益主要源于其对路由前表示的间接影响而非仅更新路由器本身。

Conclusion: 作者提出了一种简单、与现有decoder-only MoE架构兼容的序列级跨语言对齐目标，证明跨语言表示对齐对多语言迁移有积极作用。路由器输出是比隐状态更有效的对齐目标。该方法适用于任何训练阶段，在预训练阶段使用有望获得更大收益。未来工作包括降低对平行数据的依赖、确定训练课程中施加对齐监督的最佳时机与位置、探索跨模态MoE对齐，以及研究更大规模训练中是否需要负样本以及与负载均衡损失的相互作用。

Abstract: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

Result: 核心发现：无任何单一工具覆盖全部六个维度。问题表征与鉴别/管理推理覆盖较好但可靠性因工具和场景而异。TIMER-Eval直接针对时间合成，ER-Reason评估序贯诊断信念更新。不确定性与反事实推理评估正在涌现，但应用于纵向自由文本推理仍受限。事实完整性在通用领域已有良好理论化，临床领域有早期证据支持遗漏是主要失败模式。推理忠实性是最弱维度，仅有一项临床因果消融研究（Afolabi等2026）。作者提出五项方法论承诺来整合现有工具：（1）二元化评分项；（2）完整性与正确性分离评分；（3）案例特异性重要性加权与非补偿性安全上限；（4）时序轴顺序一致性检查；（5）全程报告机会校正可靠性统计。

Conclusion: 论文结论为设计理念而非已验证工具。明确指出三个仍需实质性设计工作的维度：校准不确定性、反事实推理、纵向自由文本记录上的忠实性。具体下一步建议是构建一个小型、精心规格化的工具，在对模型推理做出任何声明之前，先用机会校正统计量建立可靠性。此外，作者承认四项局限性：单一审阅者筛选、依赖预印本、基于单一操作性定义、无定量综合。整体而言，本综述为评估LLM临床推理提供了概念框架与方法论路线图，但本身并非可立即使用的评估工具。

Abstract: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan. This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged. No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions. Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理的记忆系统大多在写入时（write-time）对文档进行抽取、摘要或构图，这种"破坏性压缩"在问题到来之前就决定了哪些内容可以被回答。但在组织场景中，决策由多人在多月间跨文档修订，修订表现为新文档而非编辑旧文档；提问可能涉及"过去某时点哪个版本生效"或"新版本替代了什么、旧版本为何被替代"。会话型记忆（如Mem0覆盖、A-Mem重写）以及保留事实的图谱（如Zep、Graphiti）均无法同时满足"保留全部原始版本"与"按提问时点选择版本"。因此需要一种把选择权推迟到读取时、以原始文档为检索单位的非破坏性记忆。

Method: Mem++形式化为〈ℛ, C, Φ〉：ℛ为按文档粒度追加写入的存储，每行r=⟨x, a, t, e, σ⟩保留完整文本x、作者a、事件日期t、句向量e与状态σ（可标记superseded/archived），永不删除；C为可选的合并算子，按余弦相似度τ对近重复行分组，由LLM判定conflict/restatement/distinct并仅更新σ，冲突时旧版本被标记superseded但仍可检索，复述时生成一段合并文本并将原始行归档；Φ为读取算子，在时序范围S_θ={r∈ℛ | active(σ), t≤θ}内查询词法（lex）、标签（tag）、语义（vec）三条索引，使用加权倒数排名融合RRF融合排序，输出k−3行+3个最新日期匹配行作为证据，再交给固定回答模型。变体Mem_g++在写入时增加2次LLM调用抽取实体-关系三元组构建图K，读取时再调用1次LLM提取问题实体并从图K中追加最多5条三元组（图三元组不应用as-of过滤）。整个写入路径不调用生成模型，仅可选合并算子使用LLM。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: HC-DLM 提出了一种用于离散序列的扩散生成框架，其核心是将连续潜变量作为唯一持续状态，每一步从中读取 token 并将其作为支架反馈给下一步的潜变量去噪过程，通过统一的变分下界训练，在结构化推理和语言建模任务上优于离散和连续扩散基线。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并行解码中 token 独立采样导致统计依赖断裂（离散扩散的 token 独立性瓶颈），而连续扩散的潜变量与 token 配置缺乏中间关联（仅在最终解码时才绑定到合法 token），两者缺陷互补但现有混合方法将连续上下文附加到自包含的离散链上，无法同时解决这两个问题。

Method: 分层耦合生成模型：前向过程中连续潜变量 x_t 经高斯扩散独立加噪，离散 token k_t 经分类核独立加噪；反向过程中连续去噪器 p_φ(x_{t-1}|x_t, k_t) 以当前 token 状态为条件，token 预测器 p_θ(k_t|x_t) 从潜变量读出 token，二者形成层级耦合而非平行链；推导了变分下界并分解为重建、熵正则化和连续去噪三项损失，通过流匹配实现；推理采用欧拉步+ token 读出/再噪的交替采样。

Result: Sudoku Easy/Hard 分别达到 94.21%/72.41%（6M 参数），在 Hard 上超越 CCDD；Countdown CD4/CD5 达到 84.41%/37.52%（6M 参数），显著优于同规模扩散模型；LM1B 生成困惑度 75.5（118M 参数），优于所有评估的离散和连续扩散基线；消融实验证实连续潜变量与离散条件支架缺一不可；均匀壁步核优于吸收壁步核。

Conclusion: 层级耦合机制（连续潜变量为唯一持续状态，token 每步读出并反馈）有效解决了并行解码的 token 独立性瓶颈；连续潜变量提供跨 token 共享状态，token 支架将潜变量锚定到合法配置，两者协同工作；在结构化推理和语言建模上均验证了框架的有效性。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 1. 在24个开源模型配置的三种评估模式下，无开源模型在无限制设置下超过42%的精确命令准确率。2. 从无限制到限制模式，工具准确性平均提升23.19个百分点，但精确匹配仅提升5.93个百分点，表明参数构建是主要瓶颈。3. 提示模式带来最大改进，可选F1从45.1%提升到87.8%，精确匹配从22.3%提升到73.1%。4. 经过SFT和GRPO训练的8B模型RedSage-K (SFT+GRPO)在总分上仅比DeepSeek-V3.2 (685B)低1.0分。5. 专有模型中GPT-5.6-Sol达到61.68%的精确准确率，表明KaliBench仍未饱和。6. 论证构建存在四种常见错误模式：长短选项混用、选项幻觉、长选项幻觉和选项名称错误。

Conclusion: KaliBench揭示了LLM网络安全知识与其生成精确可执行CLI命令能力之间的明显差距。工具选择和参数构建是根本不同的挑战：限制候选工具主要解决工具选择错误，而参数级正确性（尤其是可选标志和标志-值绑定）仍是主要瓶颈。通过SFT和RLVR的微调显著提升了紧凑模型，使8B模型能够接近更大系统的性能。未来工作应扩展到多步骤工作流、检索增强工具使用和环境感知评估。KaliBench为推进基于LLM的网络安全工具的可靠和可执行使用提供了实用的基准测试和训练框架。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.
