<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR严重依赖可验证数据，合成数据流水线通过掩码真实文本让模型生成干扰项，但这种方式使正确性信号与来源信号纠缠——模型理论上可能学到"识别合成文本"而非真正推理。此前审计多关注干扰项强度或答案位置偏差，但均未触及选项文本本身的来源差异；更关键的是，"可检测"和"被利用"是两个必须分开的问题。

Abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

TL;DR: 本文提出CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees），一种针对一次性块草稿器（one-pass block drafters）的解码策略。它将块草稿器已经评分但被丢弃的候选token打包成一棵树，通过一次目标模型前向传播进行验证，并通过成本感知停止规则自动选择树宽度，无需遍历不同宽度。在8种硬件和模型配置下，CAST均优于标准链式解码，最高加速43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准推测解码在块草稿器（如DFlash）评分整个候选token块后，仅验证top-scoring的链并丢弃其他候选。由于这些候选已经完成评分，验证更多候选仅增加目标模型计算而不增加草稿成本。现有针对自回归草稿器的自适应树构建方法不适用于块草稿器场景，且最佳树宽度因部署环境（GPU型号、并发数等）而异，遍历搜索每个部署的最佳宽度成本高昂。

Method: 1. **预算最优候选树**：理论证明在固定信念下，保留前缀质量最高的N个字符串构成的前缀闭合树可最大化期望接受token数。CAST使用块草稿器的plug-in分数（各位置边际分布之积）对候选排序，采用best-first扩展构建树。2. **成本感知停止规则（定理2）**：当下一个候选的前缀质量 ≥ 当前吞吐量 × 边际成本时继续添加节点。即 `ρ_(N+1) ≥ (g(N)+1)/ℓ(N) · c₁`。3. **共享预算分配（负载下）**：全局best-first扩展在并发请求间分配验证预算，证明为最优（命题2）。4. **分布保持证明**：在精确算术下，CAST在贪婪和采样（T>0）解码下均不改变目标输出分布（定理3）。5. **采样验证器**：实现递归无替换推测采样。

Result: 在3代GPU（H100 SXM、Blackwell RTX PRO 6000、A6000）和2个模型家族（Qwen3、LLaMA-3.1）共8种配置下评估，CAST在预测宽度上均优于标准DFlash链，平均加速20-36%，最高43%（单领域）。在H100 SXM上，Qwen3-8B平均5.62×加速于自回归解码；Blackwell上因验证成本在n=128处出现核边界跳跃，128-token树仅比链快2.4%，而预测宽度（N*=63）的树快19.8%。在采样解码（T=1）下增益保持在22-37%。在B=16并发下，全局best-first分配比最佳静态宽度提升吞吐量7.0%，B=32时提升13.7%。

Conclusion: CAST通过恢复一次性块草稿器丢弃的候选并自动选择树宽度，在不改变目标模型、草稿器权重或解码规则的前提下，显著加速LLM推理。成本感知停止规则仅需一次延迟测量即可适配每个部署，预测宽度在8种设置中与扫描最佳宽度差距不超过1.7个百分点。该方法还扩展到并发场景下的共享预算分配，为推测解码的部署自适应提供了实用方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at this https URL .

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VERITYGATE 是一个针对结构化证据上 LLM 叙述的"模式层面忠实性"验证框架，包含四个机械检查门（证据ID存在性、实体白名单、数字绑定、声明类型规则），配套有配对基准测试（每个设置 900 实例）和单轮修复流程。在信用卡组合优化案例中，该框架以模式层面契约而非叙事层面忠实性为核心，揭示了 GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 三种后端在结构化证据上的失败模式及修复效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 即使获得后端的完整证据图，仍会编造内容（如虚构不存在的卡片ID、四舍五入改变数字含义、发明可信但无依据的事实）。在受监管领域，一次幻觉即可造成法律后果（如 Air Canada 案、纽约市 MyCity 聊天机器人违规、律师因 AI 虚构判例被制裁）。现有防御措施（安全对齐、约束解码、LLM-as-judge）均不足以应对"仅引用我所提供数据"这一需求，且 LLM 评判存在位置偏差（83% 偏好 slot A），更偏好流畅但无依据的叙述。

Method: 核心方法是四门验证分类法：(G1) 证据ID存在性——集合成员检查；(G2) 实体白名单——集合成员检查；(G3) 数字绑定——精确字符串成员检查（含 0–3 小整数惯例）；(G4) 声明类型规则——类型规则检查（如 COMPARISON 类必须引用 WINNER_BY_CATEGORY 证据）。框架包含三个阶段：(1) 证据图构建（含 SHA-256 摘要实现确定性），(2) 四门验证，(3) 单轮推理时修复流程（将失败声明连同具体错误返回 LLM）。案例研究采用混合整数线性规划（MILP）作为后端，生成 1–3 张最优信用卡组合。基准测试在 r=0 和 r=1 各 900 实例（50 用户档案 × 3 目标 × 3 叙述者 × 接地/非接地两变体），使用配对引导置信区间，并辅以小型人类研究和反平衡 LLM-as-judge 协议。

One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. ### [51] [Sentence Specificity Scores for Collaborative Technical Documentation: A Domain-Transfer Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01046)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技术文档是人与 AI 队友之间持久共享上下文的重要载体，而句子层面的特异性（具体性）分数决定了文档信息的细节丰富度与传达精度。然而，现有特异性预测器主要在新闻等通用领域训练，迁移至技术文档领域时其分数的可解读性与实际决策价值尚未得到系统检验。

2) 对应性检验：通过 60 组人工控制编辑（增/减特异性/中性）检验方向响应；与 GranuScore（语义粒度指标）比较秩一致性；由 3 位非专家标注 80 句试点，以及 Qwen3-14B、Gemma4-12B、GPT-OSS-20B/120B 作为匹配 LLM 评判员。
3) 决策价值测试：使用 Gemma4-12B 与 GPT-OSS-120B 对 60 个技术源句生成各 3 个分数盲候选（每集 180 个），由 1 位盲评者按 5 分量表评定方向有效性；比较基于分数的后生成排序策略与"首选候选"基线的方向有效选择率，采用 20,000 次源级 bootstrap 估计增益区间。

Result: 1) 跨语料排序与逐句秩一致性因预测器而异：ST–Adapt 在 GitHub 语料上 Spearman ρ=0.07，Ansible 上 ρ=-0.066，Wikipedia 上 ρ=0.51；严格过滤与 token 长度标准化改变差异但无法调和。
2) 标准化后所有 Wikipedia-技术域 SpeciTeller 间隙仍为正（标准化间隙保留原幅度 49.1%–94.5%）。
3) 控制编辑下 SpeciTeller 在 GitHub 增/减特异编辑方向一致性达 100%，Ansible 增特异 75%、减特异 91.7%；试点中 SpeciTeller 与合并人工标签的秩相关性在 GitHub ρ=.715 [.518, .844]，Ansible ρ=.480 [.126, .723]。
4) Gemma 候选集：SpeciTeller 排序将方向有效选择率从 71.7% 提升至 83.3%（+11.7 分 [+1.7, +21.7]）；增益集中在"增特异"请求上。
5) GPT-OSS-120B 候选集：SpeciTeller 增益 +5.0 分 [-6.7, +16.7]，所有主单分区间包含零；只有次要共识规则（SpeciTeller + 三次 Adapt + 方向对齐 GranuScore）获得 +11.7 分 [+1.7, +21.7]。

TL;DR: AURAL提出了一种面向语音语言模型的自适应潜在推理框架，用GMM建模多种潜在推理路径，并通过联合块预测将串行前向次数降至最低，在Qwen2.5-Omni上将首字延迟从1.22秒降至0.10秒（11.8倍加速），同时保持与CoT-RL相当的性能。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音语言模型需要在"高智能"与"快速响应"之间取得平衡。显式CoT推理虽然提升理解与推理能力，但生成中间推理token会显著增加延迟；将细粒度声学线索用文字描述会进一步拉长CoT并增加延迟。现有潜在推理方法存在三个局限：(1)单路径监督，无法保留多个合理的推理延续；(2)推理预算固定，不随问题难度自适应；(3)性能常落后于显式CoT。缺乏带可靠推理轨迹的大规模语音语料也是制约因素。

Abstract: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. ### [53] [Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01592)
*Alessandro Turrin,Patrik Okanovic,Torsten Hoefler,Nezihe Merve Gürel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个面向流式场景的LLM在线主动模型选择框架Online LLM Picker，通过方差-熵联合信息量准则选择最有价值的prompt进行标注，以最小标注预算从候选模型中识别最优LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试无法可靠反映真实流式数据上的LLM性能，而oracle标注成本高昂难以大规模获取；且现有主动模型选择方法多聚焦分类任务或离线pool-based设定，缺乏面向LLM生成任务与在线流式场景的解决方案。

Result: 在10个数据集、130+ LLM上：相比最优基线节省高达71.67%标注成本；在流式顺序生成中将regret降低至多2.51×；在40个设置中的36个实现最低95th百分位精度差距。

Conclusion: Online LLM Picker 是首个面向LLM生成任务的在线主动模型选择框架，能够在有限标注预算下高效且稳健地从大量候选LLM中识别最优模型，显著降低标注成本并减少实际部署中的regret。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

</details>


### [54] [Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01984)
*Hyunsik Kim,Youngmoon Jung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出UBE(Universal Byte-Level Encoding)，通过UTF-8/UTF-16双字符集路由(1-2字节走UTF-8，3-4字节走UTF-16)降低BBPE分词器中3字节BMP脚本的编码下界，从而减少跨脚本token预算差异，同时保持标准BPE训练和精确解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: UTF-8 BBPE分词器对不同脚本的"编码下界"(encoding floor)不同：ASCII为1字节，西里尔/阿拉伯/希伯来为2字节，CJK等3字节BMP脚本为3字节，非BMP为4字节。当学习到的merge无法覆盖某些跨度时，这些脚本只能回退到字节级分解，导致高token开销、可压缩上下文缩小、按token计费成本上升。BBPE16用UTF-16全局替换能降CJK下界但抬高了ASCII下界。

Method: UBE采用确定性按字符路由规则：UTF-8字节长度≤2的字符走UTF-8路径(GPT-2可见字节字母表256符号)；3-4字节字符走UTF-16路径(UTF-16LE字节映射到PUA区U+E100-E1FF另256符号)。双字符集共512符号，标准BPE合并规则不变；解码器根据符号所属字母表判断编码路径，在切换时刷新缓冲区，保证精确往返解码。可与SuperBPE/SCRIPT边界策略及MYTE形态学映射组合。

Result: 内在评估：在FLORES-200(204语言)的9种核心tokenizer-vocab组合下，UBE将token溢价的Gini系数降低6%–14%(主要设置101-lang/32K降低9.4%)，Wilcoxon检验在8/9种组合中p<0.01。低覆盖3字节脚本收益最大(Santali降34.7%、Central Atlas Tamazight降31.9%)，而英文token数也微降(-0.3%)。Unicode 17审计中UBE精确往返全部1,155,724测试输入，MYTE仅恢复1,138,306。LM实验(182M/32K, 1.3B/32K, 64K, 128K)：UBE与BBPE的LM质量基本持平(BPB Gini差异小且跨种子不稳定)。源字节匹配对比中UBE的BPB和BPB Gini均最低。端到端推理上Amharic的prompt处理速度提升+45.0%，英文提升+3.9%。

Conclusion: UBE是一种可逆、无需语言标识的字节级表征层，通过降低3字节BMP脚本的编码下界显著减少跨语言token预算差异(尤其是小词表16K–64K与低覆盖脚本)，同时保留标准BPE训练和精确解码，并与现有边界策略和形态学表征正交可组合。LM质量与BBPE相当，下游优势主要体现在上下文容量和prompt处理速度上。最适用于紧凑词表、混合脚本部署以及低覆盖3字节BMP语言场景；主要限制是En-only/16K等极窄覆盖下UBE仅在37/204语言胜出，且不能作为现有checkpoint的drop-in替换。

Abstract: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

</details>


### [55] [SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00045)
*Yasmina El Kacemi,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究基于SCM（刻板印象内容模型）的公平性正则化对法律文档分类中公平性与SHAP解释忠实性之间关系的影响。在ECtHR数据集上对比LegalBERT基线与SCM正则化变体，发现干预虽未改善人口统计公平性，却持续降低了SHAP解释的充分性（sufficiency），且该效应源于对比正则化本身而非warmth-competence结构，表明公平性与解释忠实性是解耦的独立结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer模型（如LegalBERT）在法律决策支持中的广泛应用引发了对公平性与解释透明度的双重担忧。然而这两类属性通常被独立评估，一个会改变公平性的去偏干预是否也会改变解释忠实性（即解释反映模型真实推理的程度），仍是开放问题。该问题对高风险法律AI的审计与问责具有直接意义。

Method: 在LexGLUE的ECtHR alleged-violations语料（11,000条判决，多标签10个ECHR条款分类）上对比LegalBERT基线与SCM启发的对比正则化变体。正则化使用38个warmth-competence反义词对（19+19），通过对比边际损失（margin=0.5）推动反义词对的上下文嵌入余弦相似度≤-0.5。λ在{0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5}网格中按验证F1选择。控制条件包括：(1) shuffled-pair control——随机配对以剥离SCM结构；(2) 传统人口统计词对去偏控制（含gender轴与ethnicity轴）。评估三个维度：macro F1、DPD/EOD/DI公平性指标、SHAP与Integrated Gradients解释忠实性（充分性与完备性，k∈{1%,5%,10%}）。5个随机种子（42,13,7,21,100），多标签阈值独立调优。

Result: 核心发现是公平性与解释忠实性的解耦：(1) 公平性零结果——SCM正则化在两个公平性定义（DPD、EOD）、ethnicity轴（更可靠）、NER-based分组及人口统计词对控制下均未减少人口统计差异，λ扫描中无一达到预设阈值ΔDPD≥0.05；(2) 性能基本不变——基线0.670±0.013 vs SCM 0.656±0.012（5种子均值差-0.014，单种子42曾显示+0.014为种子伪影）；(3) 解释充分性持续退化——SCM在所有5个种子、3个阈值下均增加SHAP充分性（更不忠实），非重叠置信带，Integrated Gradients方向一致；完备性基本不变；(4) shuffled-pair控制重现了性能平稳+公平性平稳+充分性退化的全部模式，说明效应源于对比正则化本身而非warmth-competence结构。跨编码器复制（BERT-base、RoBERTa-base）显示4/6运行重现退化，RoBERTa上效应最显著。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是确立公平性与解释忠实性的解耦：同一干预在未能减少人口统计差异的同时却持续降低SHAP解释忠实性，且两者均不受性能影响。这意味着在法律NLP审计中，解释行为的变化不能作为公平性的代理指标——更"连贯"的解释不能等同于更"公平"的模型。公平性必须直接测量。该结论扩展了Brandl et al.(2024)在合理性（plausibility）层面的正交性发现，揭示在严格的忠实性准则下正交性是不对称的（一者不变、一者持续移动）。未来工作应使用结构化案例元数据改进群体操作化、并测试在公平性干预确实改变公平性的设置下解耦是否仍然成立。

Abstract: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

</details>


### [56] [Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00070)
*Antonela Tommasel,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批判性地审视了将人类心理学中的偏见构念（如隐性偏见、内隐联想、锚定效应、框架效应等）迁移到大型语言模型（LLM）偏见评估中的做法，指出由于构念、主体和评估情境三个层面的失配，直接套用人类心理学测量工具会产生"推断鸿沟"。论文提出了一个分析框架，将偏见相关发现区分为四种解释层次：分布关联、可观察行为、规范性伤害和心理类比，以澄清不同评估设计所能支持的合理主张范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着指令微调与安全训练使LLM在直接询问时倾向于给出规范性可接受的回答，研究者越来越多地采用源自人类心理学的偏见构念（如隐性偏见、锚定效应、确认偏差等）来探测LLM的偏见。然而，这些构念原本为研究人类认知与社会行为而开发，其心理测量学基础（反应时差异、问卷作答等）与LLM评估所使用的方法（模型输出概率差异、文本补全、排序等）之间存在根本差异，导致基于模型侧证据得出的偏见结论可能被过度解读为与人类偏见等价。论文旨在揭示这一推断鸿沟，并为研究者提供更精确的解读框架。

Method: 论文采用概念性、理论性的批判分析路径，而非实证研究方法：(1) 系统梳理现有LLM偏见评估文献中两类人类构念迁移——社会认知偏见（如IAT启发的探测）以及判断与推理中的认知偏见（如锚定、框架效应）；(2) 借鉴心理学与社会科学的效度理论（构念效度、外在效度、测量工具效度），识别出三类失配来源——构念失配、主体失配、评估情境失配；(3) 构建一个分析框架，将偏见相关发现区分为四种解释层次：分布关联、可观察行为、规范性伤害、心理类比，并阐明每一层次所需的模型侧证据、相关失配及额外的支持需求；(4) 通过IAT启发式与锚定式评估的具体案例，展示框架如何改变对现有实证发现的解读。

Result: 论文未开展实证研究，而是产出以下理论成果：(1) 识别出人类偏见构念迁移到LLM评估时存在的三类失配——构念失配（模型侧测量是否真正捕捉到目标理论构念）、主体失配（人类与LLM在学习过程、机制和响应模态上的差异）、评估情境失配（提示模板、人口属性标签、解码策略等对结果的调节）；(2) 构建了一个包含四种解释层次的分析框架（详见表1），明确每一层次对应的典型模型侧证据、所涉及的主要失配及所需的额外支持；(3) 通过对Bai et al. (2025)的IAT启发式研究、Rutinowski et al. (2024)的政治偏见研究、Salecha et al. (2024)的社会赞许性偏差研究以及Takenami et al. (2025)的锚定效应研究等具体案例的分析，展示了框架的应用方式及其对结论精确化的作用。

Conclusion: 论文得出以下结论：(1) 人类衍生的偏见构念为评估LLM提供了有价值的资源，但不能未经审视地迁移到LLM评估中；(2) 当通过模型概率、生成输出、排序或答案偏移进行操作化时，证据与解释之间的关系变为间接的；(3) 三类失配（构念、主体、评估情境）并不否定心理范式作为LLM评估工具的价值，但表明关于模型偏见的声明需要更精确地表述；(4) 通过区分分布关联、可观察行为、规范性伤害和心理类比四种解释层次，该框架将偏见评估定位为既是测量任务，也是科学解释问题；(5) 随着LLM嵌入日常生活任务，NLP研究不仅需要更好的探测工具，还需要更清晰地说明这些工具能揭示什么、不能揭示什么。该论文的主要局限在于它是概念性贡献而非实证评估，且聚焦于两类偏见构念，未涵盖所有心理学概念在LLM评估中的应用（如人格、情绪、道德判断、心智理论等）。

Abstract: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

</details>


### [57] [FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00096)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FACET是WMT 2026自动翻译质量评估任务的免参考提交方案，将翻译质量评估分解为三个独立提示轮次：流利度（Fluency）、准确性（Accuracy）和一致性（Consistency），每个评估维度只接收其所需的上下文，使用单一固定模型GPT-4.1-mini完成，无需任何训练组件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于LLM的翻译质量评估方法通常在单个提示中同时评估多种错误类型，导致所有判断都基于相同上下文，而不同错误类型实际需要不同的证据。作者主张翻译质量评估应按错误类型分解，使每个评估维度只接收其判断所需的输入。

Method: FACET采用非对称输入设计：Accuracy评估接收源语言和目标语言句子，判断意义是否保留；Fluency评估仅接收目标语言句子，判断目标语言是否规范；Consistency评估接收整个目标语言文档，判断重复出现的实体和术语是否保持一致渲染。三个评估轮次独立运行后合并结果，生成三类输出：错误跨度标注、质量分数和无错误标签。还提交了不含Consistency轮的FACET-C用于消融分析。

Result: 在WMT26测试集的21个语言对上评估FACET，系统排名将人工后期编辑翻译排在首位（平均排名1.3），而从零开始的人工翻译居中（13.3）。Consistency评估改变了10.1%段落的分数，但对系统排名影响极小。定性分析展示了Consistency评估能检测到跨段落的实体不一致错误（如同一设施在不同段落使用不同名称），而这些错误无法通过单独的段落评估发现。

Conclusion: FACET通过分解评估而非单提示或训练指标构建翻译质量评估器，展示了不同错误类型需要不同上下文的原则。在缺乏黄金标注的情况下，其预测的系统排名符合预期。文档级Consistency评估在段落级评分下贡献有限，这归因于当前模型在长上下文中追踪重复项目的可靠性不足。未来的改进方向包括更强的长上下文模型或直接奖励文档级一致性的评分方案。

Abstract: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

</details>


### [58] [Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00164)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对韩语方言NLP中"合成数据可恢复多少真实数据增益"这一问题展开研究，主要贡献是揭示了"度量-构造耦合"（metric-construction coupling）现象：当合成管道的特征词典与评分器的词典重叠时，会严重高估合成数据恢复率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩语方言语料库存在许可限制（可发布模型权重但不可重新分发数据），因此研究者采用基于规则的合成方法。但现有研究未报告：在同一基准、同一基模型、同一服务配置下，合成监督究竟恢复了多少真实数据增益，且未按能力维度（体现为分别评估各项技能）进行度量。核心发现并非恢复率数值本身，而是其结构——恢复率在维度间差异巨大，且在生成维度上依赖于评估资源是否独立于生成管道。

Method: 1. 提出KoDialectBench基准：1,000个项目覆盖五个地区（江原、庆尚、全罗、忠清、济州），三个任务维度（理解T1、识别T2、生成T3），通过哈希标识符和评分代码发布，用户从自己许可的副本重建项目。
2. 设计恢复率协议：(arm - base) / (arm R - base)，在Qwen3.8-27B (bf16)基模型上进行实验，使用相同的LoRA设置。
3. 设置多个对照臂：arm R（真实数据参考，8,600个）、arm C、SK5、SK6（同配置不同种子）、SK4（26,600个合成样本）等，以及关键的"构造不相交"臂SK12-D9b（从合成规则中保留20%的标记类型用于评分）。
4. 定义度量-构造覆盖率（MCC）：评估词典与构造词典交集占评估词典的比例。
5. 进行MCC扫描实验：固定评估词典大小为1,168个/地区，仅改变与构造词典的重叠比例（从0到1），观察测得恢复率变化。

Result: 1. 恢复率按维度差异显著：最佳合成臂（SK4）在地区识别上恢复91.2%真实数据增益，但理解仅63.7%。
2. 生成维度的结果依赖于度量选择：部署的标记词典报告方言度恢复92.3%、地区匹配119.3%（后者超过真实数据参考），而基于参考的生成仅72.4%。
3. 发现标记度量的评分词典完全包含在转换规则可发射的词典中（不相交测试返回空集）。
4. SK12-D9b（构造不相交臂，与SK5大小匹配）将方言度恢复从91.8%降至8.1%，地区匹配从101.9%降至25.6%；但三个管道独立的度量恢复了60.4%（压缩chrF）、未下降，反而略有上升（+3.3、+2.0、+2.3点）。
5. MCC扫描显示：恢复率从MCC=0时的-54.8%单调上升至MCC=1时的84.8%，端点区间不重叠。
6. 频次加权覆盖率作为预测指标略优于类型覆盖率（r=0.854 vs 0.841）。

Conclusion: 共享的构造和评估词典会大幅膨胀合成数据恢复率的估计。论文提出三方面贡献：(i) KoDialectBench基准，采用许可证兼容的重建方案发布；(ii) 恢复率协议及其两个对照失效案例；(iii) 演示词典方言度量与构造访问的混淆以及不相交性检测方法；(iv) MCC覆盖率统计及其扫描；(v) 构造时间干预（标记词典分割前进行合成，使规则与评分器不共享精确形式）。论文将这种度量-构造耦合视为度量失效而非结果，并展示了检测方法。强调未来工作应构建既独立于构造又具有强区分性的外部评估器（如基于已发表的方言词典）。

Abstract: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

</details>


### [59] [A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00223)
*Imad Lakim,Ebtesam Almazrouei,Ibrahim Abu Alhaol,Merouane Debbah,Julien Launay*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了对极端规模语言模型"Noor"（最大130亿参数的多任务阿拉伯语模型）整个项目生命周期碳足迹的整体评估框架，涵盖数据收集、研发、预训练、未来推理及国际合作等所有环节，发现推理成本和外部因素对总碳排放预算影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大规模语言模型广泛应用，其环境（碳）影响引发关注。然而现有ML论文中的碳排放报告通常仅限于训练阶段的算力消耗，忽略了数据准备、研发、推理等环节，亟需更全面的评估方法。

Method: 提出整体性（holistic）碳足迹评估方法，将整个项目生命周期分为五个阶段量化核算：①数据收集与存储成本；②研究与开发预算；③预训练成本；④未来推理（serving）估算；⑤国际合作等外部因素（exogenous costs）。以极端规模阿拉伯语多任务模型Noor（最大13B参数）为案例进行研究。

Result: 研究发现：①推理成本对总碳排放预算具有显著影响；②数据收集、存储、研发及国际合作等外部因素同样不可忽视；③仅关注训练阶段的碳排放报告会严重低估模型项目的真实环境负担。

Conclusion: 整体碳足迹评估揭示了常被忽视的排放来源，论文最后讨论了减少极端规模模型碳排放的可行路径（pathways），为未来大规模模型开发中的可持续实践提供参考。

Abstract: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

</details>


### [60] [Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00402)
*Anca Dinu,Andra-Maria Florescu,Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Stefana-Arina Tabusca,Claudiu Creanga,Andreiana Mihail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文对意大利语和罗马尼亚语的"brain rot"（脑腐）迷因进行了多模态比较分析，基于自建的CRIB数据集（240个TikTok视频），从文本、声音、视觉三个维度探究流行度驱动因素及两种语言版本的文化语言差异。研究发现：文本情感、荒诞度、押韵等与流行度无显著相关，而罗马尼亚语视频的快速剪辑和节奏显著预测流行度；跨语言对比显示意大利语版本更负面、更高困惑度、更押韵、音域更广更响亮，罗马尼亚语版本频谱更亮、音高变化更不规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Brain rot是2024年牛津年度词汇，指过度消费低质网络内容导致的精神退化，其本身也是一种由生成式AI创造的荒诞、超现实、失调的多模态短视频内容。意大利语brain rot（如Ballerina Cappuccina）在2025年初迅速走红并传播至其他语言。然而，目前缺乏计算语言学层面的研究来理解其流行驱动因素及跨文化语言差异。该研究选择意大利语和罗马尼亚语进行对比，因为两者同属罗曼语族、共享威权统治历史记忆，但又在宗教传统、地缘政治和文化生产上存在差异，且两者在文化和计算研究中均被低估。

Method: 方法包含：(1) 数据集构建——CRIB（Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot），240个TikTok视频，按语言和流行度（流行/不流行，阈值10万播放或1万点赞）分层采样，每语种120个（4个子类别各20个）；(2) 文本分析——使用XLM-RoBERTa进行情感分析，paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM计算语义相似度，GPT-2计算困惑度，自定义押韵系数；(3) 音频分析——使用Demucs分离人声，librosa的pyin算法提取音高轮廓，MFCCs、谱质心、谱带宽、谱滚降、过零率、谱通量等频谱特征，onset检测计算音节率，superb/wav2vec2-base-superb-er进行语音情感分类；(4) 视频分析——使用Gemini Flash 2.5多模态模型提取视觉属性（剪辑速度、节奏、主体运动、叙事逻辑、荒诞度等）；(5) 统计分析——ANOVA、Mann-Whitney U检验、MANOVA、Pearson相关，Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正。

Result: 流行度驱动因素：文本特征（情感、荒诞度、押韵）和声音情感均与流行度无显著相关；罗马尼亚语视频中，更快的剪辑速度（Pearson r=0.17, p=0.023）和更快整体节奏（p=0.049）是流行度的显著预测因子，但此关联在意大利语中几乎不存在（r=0.005）。跨语言差异：意大利brain rot文本负面情绪更高（M=0.67 vs 0.24）、困惑度更高（M=218.74 vs 163.91, p<0.001）、押韵系数更高（M=0.222 vs 0.178, p=0.0001）；音频上意大利语音域更广、音量更大（F0方差和范围显著更大，rms_mean更高），罗马尼亚音频谱质心更高（更亮）、谱带宽更高、零交叉率更高、音高斜率熵更高（更不规则的音高变化）。语义相似度跨语言无显著差异。

Conclusion: Brain rot的流行主要不依赖文本内容，而是依赖视觉动态性（尤其在罗马尼亚文化中）。意大利和罗马尼亚brain rot在文本情感、困惑度、押韵密度以及声学特征（音域、亮度、音高变化规律性）上呈现显著差异，反映了各自的文化生产规范和语言合成模型的差异。手动分析揭示其核心特征为音调、文本、音乐和图像之间的失调，融合婴儿语、童谣与不当话题，结合民间文化、流行文化和政治讽刺元素。未来研究将扩展至其他罗曼语族语言，并将流行度建模为连续变量。

Abstract: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的RAG系统评估指标(如BLEU、ROUGE)在低资源语言(LRL)中因缺乏高质量参考数据而效果不佳。虽然Ragas框架提供了参考无关的评估指标,但其原始验证以英语为中心,依赖过时的gpt-3.5-turbo模型,对罗马尼亚语等低资源语言的适用性存在显著空白。本文旨在填补这一空白,探索LLM-as-a-Judge范式在罗马尼亚语RAG评估中的可行性。

Abstract: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

</details>

We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

</details>


### [63] [Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00540)
*Zhanyu Chen,Jaap Jumelet*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了六个LLM家族在101种语言上的语法能力，发现后训练会损害语法能力（对齐税），且低资源语言受损最严重；后训练模型保留了无法通过显式提示表达的知识（表达缺口），但此现象仅在高资源语言中可测量；母语提示能恢复低资源语言中被隐藏的能力，表明仅高资源语言可直接从无提示概率中探测，呼吁采用语言知情的、多范式的评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于多语言LLM语法能力的结论因评估方法而差异巨大，且评估范式、后训练与语言资源可用性之间的交互作用尚未被系统研究。现有工作要么只关注高资源语言，要么只用单一评估方法（log-probability），无法揭示评估方法本身对结论的影响。

Method: 使用MultiBLiMP基准（101种语言、121,305个最小对）评估六个LLM家族（Gemma 3/4、Llama 3.1/3.2、Qwen 3/3.5、TinyAya）的base与post-trained模型。提出四种评估方法：直接概率（Direct）、元语言QA（Meta）、英语提示概率、英语母语提示代词概率。引入三个核心指标：归一化对齐税（Normalized Alignment Tax）、表达缺口（Inarticulate Gap）和提示增益（Prompt Gain）。通过回归分析、跨家族比较和项目级分析量化语言资源、后训练与评估范式对语法能力的交互影响。

Result: （1）后训练一致损害语法能力，归一化对齐税从1B模型的35.9%（Low/Zero）降至27B的20.6%，但降低幅度不均匀，低资源语言始终承担最高税负；Gemma 4 (31B)对齐税最高(30.9%)，TinyAya (3.35B)最低(1.4%)，表明对齐税是模型家族特有而非由规模决定。（2）表达缺口在89.3%超高资源、86.8%高资源、92.5%中资源、66.7%低资源语言对中为正，表明后训练模型保留了无法通过聊天界面表达的知识；但低资源语言因基线接近随机而难以测量此缺口；Llama 3 (0.219)和TinyAya (0.198)缺口最大，Gemma 4呈负缺口(-0.062)。（3）母语提示对低资源语言带来不成比例的增益，揭示了直接评估中被低估的能力；项目级分析显示78.2%的项目被base和PT共同解决，仅11.6%的翻转形成总税负，低资源语言项目损失率(25.4%)远超高资源(8.0%)，在控制边界margin后资源层级效应仍然独立存在。

Conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用语言知情的、多范式的协议以避免系统性低估低资源语言能力。结论对语法的测量高度依赖评估方法：元语言提示在可比基础能力下准确率从55%（Llama 3）到84%（Gemma 4）不等，将语法知识与指令遵循能力混淆。母语提示可作为缓解措施——为目标语言提供本地化指令能持续提升低资源语言准确率，表明当前直接评估方法可能低估了低资源语言的实际能力。未来研究应报告多种评估范式而非依赖单一方法。

Abstract: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

</details>


### [64] [Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00621)
*Wenchao Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对对话回复生成中Seq2Seq模型回复多样性不足（即"模式坍缩"）的问题，本文提出"解码器混合"（Mixture of Decoders, MoD）方法。该方法在条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架中引入离散潜在变量y，每个y对应一个专用解码器（VAD），使各解码器学习不同主题，从而提高生成回复的多样性。同时提出"提名-投票"两阶段解码算法和基于GloVe嵌入k-means聚类的半监督学习策略来解决潜在变量退化问题。在Persona数据集上的实验表明，MoD在BLEU、ROUGE-L、词向量余弦相似度、n-gram多样性等自动指标以及人工A/B测试中均优于Seq2Seq、VAD和MoS等基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Seq2Seq对话回复生成模型普遍存在"模式坍缩"（modal collapse）问题，即模型倾向于学习退化的单模态分布，导致生成的回复缺乏多样性、偏向通用无趣的回答。问题的根源在于对话回复本质上是多模态的一对多映射，而现有模型难以捕捉这种多模态特性。

Method: 在CVAE框架下引入离散潜在变量y表示混合成分，每个y对应一个独立的VAD（变分自回归解码器）。模型对响应分布p(w|x)进行混合建模：先由先验网络p(y|x)选择混合成分，再由对应的解码器生成回复。采用mean-field变分推断，通过最大化ELBO学习参数。为解决离散潜在变量退化问题，提出半监督策略：通过GloVe词向量的加权和对语句嵌入后做k-means聚类生成伪标签，并将高频"dull"回复强制分配到特定混合。解码阶段采用"提名-投票"（Nominate-Vote）两阶段策略：先对每个解码器独立进行beam search生成候选池，再由各解码器对所有候选评分并按混合先验概率加权排序。

Result: 在Persona数据集（词汇量约20000）上，当混合数K=3时：MoD相比Seq2Seq基线在Distinct uni-gram（353→617）、bi-gram（931→2106）、tri-gram（1499→3744）上大幅提升，BLEU从0.135提升到0.169，ROUGE-L从0.155提升到0.170。人工A/B测试中，MoD相比VAD和MoS的胜率均超过40%，败率低于30%。半监督MoD的混合解码器展现出明确的主题专化（如娱乐、教育、对话开场、食物、职业等），各混合间的pairwise BLEU显著降低（0.58→0.22），证实了多样性的提升来源于解码器的专化。模型参数量随混合数线性增长O(KEH)，远少于MoS的O(KEV)。

Conclusion: MoD方法成功地将混合模型与Seq2Seq结合用于对话回复生成，通过离散潜在变量实现了对潜在主题或对话行为的可解释建模，并利用半监督学习引入了先验知识。实验证实各解码器确实学到了差异化的主题专化，从而显著提升回复多样性，同时参数量增长可控。未来可通过更细粒度的语言学特征进一步改进半监督信号以提升性能。

Abstract: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

</details>


### [65] [Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00656)
*Jiangang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Lingtai 提出了一种无需训练的"概念遥测层"，通过将残差流投影到领域特定的概念锚点库上，在代码生成和数学推理任务中实时生成每步的概念坐标信号。研究发现该信号与预测不确定性存在稳健关联，但其函数形式因任务而异；同时揭示了执行轨迹的"指纹"具有强局部惯性但弱重新实例化不变性。该方法不能作为稳定的正确性信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理过程如同黑箱，缺少在线、无需训练探针的观测手段来揭示模型内部的中间计算过程。现有方法（学习型探针、稀疏自编码器、输出层不确定性度量）各有局限：需要训练数据、成本高昂或无法触及内部计算。该研究旨在探索一种无监督、命名坐标的运行时测量空间，并明确界定其能揭示与不能揭示的内容。

Method: 1) **概念锚点构建（CNCE）**：从领域语料库提取高频术语，构建 TF-IDF 加权共现网络，通过三角形检测和子图扩展生成命名概念；用目标模型自身编码概念标题，以最后一标记残差作为锚点中心（代码 161 个，数学 1552 个锚点）。2) **概念遥测**：在冻结层将残差流通过 RBF 核投影到锚点库，生成每步的 K 维活动向量；提取活动方差 K_var 和有效参与度作为标量统计。3) **审计协议**：以问题为推理单位，比较预测熵跨概念活动十分位的关联，进行问题身份、标记位置、标记类型等多重对照。4) **执行指纹协议**：对 402 个完成的 MBPP 片段构建冻结库，通过居中自裕度进行自检索测试，区分局部扰动（控制 Panel A）与自然重新执行（Panel B）。5) **匹配正确性审计**：在 163 个 HumanEval 重放问题上进行位置匹配的预输出 AUROC 检验。

Result: 1) **不确定性关联稳健**：四种配置下，CNCE 对随机锚点的问题级配对 log-ratio 优势为 47/50、47/50、40/50、50/50；关联在问题身份、位置、标记类型控制下均存活；K-means 和 PCA 的关联明显较弱或方向不一致。2) **功能形式任务依赖**：HumanEval 单调、MBPP U 形、GSM8K 慢后陡。3) **原始信号为共模主导**：有效参与度在两个域接近满维度。4) **执行指纹**：精确重放余弦 0.99996；k=128 扰动下 top-1 自检索 74-77%；但新鲜重新执行仅 8.5% 检索率（释义 3.3%，排列零 0.1%）。弹性对齐下差距依然存在（DTW 11.7-16.0% vs k=32 时 62.0%）。5) **正确性审计失败**：匹配协议下 K_var 未能提供稳定正确性坐标（AUROC 在同步点跌至 0.494，等同随机），早期未匹配 F1=0.81/0.84 的声明被推翻。6) **开销**：161 锚点代码实现每标记解码额外 0.7-1.6%，输出标记不变，峰值显存增加约 1 MB。

Conclusion: Lingtai 暴露了两种有界结构：(1) 跨任务复现但功能形式任务依赖的不确定性关联活动信号；(2) 局部鲁棒但重新实例化脆弱的执行轨迹指纹。两者均不是通用正确性信号——在测试协议下，标量概念活动未提供稳定正确性坐标。贡献被定位为"测量加边界"：提供一种训练免费的概念遥测层用于运行时内部计算观测，并通过受控实验明确划定其能力边界。架构意义在于"作用域绑定事件记忆"——外部结果可绑定到产生它的片段，仅在相似片段重演时被检索（约 8% 新鲜、3% 释义检索率）。

Abstract: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

</details>


### [66] [PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00664)
*Rashid Azraf Jahin,Saadman Sajid,Khan Raiyan Ibne Reza,Sumaiya Tabassum Nimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PhysicsMate 是首个基于孟加拉国 NCTB 9-10 年级物理课程的大孟加拉语 QA 基准（1,834 对），配套包含一个 1,760 节点 / 2,600 边的多关系知识图谱。研究者在统一的 LoRA 配置下对 Qwen3 系列（0.6B / 1.7B / 4B）进行微调，分别获得 +5.5、+15.0、+23.3 百分点的闭卷准确率提升。4B 模型经 4-bit 量化后可离线部署，适用于资源受限环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语（母语者超 3 亿）在教育型 NLP 中代表性不足；现有的孟加拉语基准（如 BEnQA、BnMMLU、P6Jiggasha）要么不针对中学物理，要么不对齐国家课程，无法满足课堂对精确术语、SI 单位与公式推导的需求。该工作旨在填补"课程对齐 + 中学物理 QA"基准的空缺，并探索小模型在受限硬件上的可部署性。

Method: 四阶段流水线：(1) 对 NCTB 9-10 年级物理课本（13 章 359 页）进行 Gemini Flash Lite 的页面级 OCR 与 Markdown 规范化，再以 3 页滑动窗口做结构化抽取，得到 811 个语义单元；(2) 基于预定义的 10 类本体（概念/物理量/定律/公式/定义/图/例题/实体/题目/HSC 主题）构建多关系知识图谱（30 种关系）；(3) 由知识节点生成 1,834 对孟加拉语 QA，按章节分层划分 Train/Val/Test=1374/185/275；(4) 用统一 LoRA（r=16, α=32, dropout=0.05，作用于 7 个线性投影层，3 epoch，8-bit AdamW，4-bit NF4 加载底座）微调 Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B，并对比 GPT-4o-mini 与 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 的零样本表现。评估指标包括 Token F1、多语 BERTScore 与 LLM-as-a-Judge 准确率。

Result: LoRA 微调在三个规模上单调提升准确率（+5.5pp → +15.0pp → +23.3pp），Qwen3-4B 微调后达 50.9% LLM-judge 准确率、Token F1=0.350、BERTScore=0.782，Token F1 与 BERTScore 超越云端基线（GPT-4o-mini 69.5%、Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 82.9% 准确率但词面重叠更低）。节点类型诊断显示结构化知识收益最大：物理量 +93.9%、定律 +56.6%、定义 +56.1%；实体类知识收益最小（+8.7%）。定性分析表明微调可消除虚构的空间光学规则并补全电路功率推导步骤。

Conclusion: 课程对齐的低秩适配在不同规模均有效，且收益随容量单调增长；结构化、单一规范表述的知识最能从 LoRA 中获益，而松散实体知识几乎不变。该框架可推广到 NCTB 其他学科与南亚（NCERT/CBSE、WBBSE、巴基斯坦联邦委员会等）同类课程。研究者同时强调四项局限：纯文本评测、LLM 评判而非人工标注、judge 与基线之一同源（Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 自评）、单一课程覆盖；并警示不可将模型作为无人监督的自动评分工具，应作为教师辅助与评估基准，并需明确 NCTB 教材的版权与出处。

Abstract: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

</details>


### [67] [Bayesian Fine-tuning Yields Language Models that are as Bayesian as their Beliefs Allow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00679)
*Polina Tsvilodub,Andreas Waldis,Linlu Qiu,Tal Linzen,Michael Franke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型（LM）在不确定性推理任务中是否真正实现了贝叶斯决策，而不仅仅是表面上产生贝叶斯行为。作者提出了四个递进的要求（R1行为、R2表征、R3因果使用信念、R4计算策略），并在Gemma-2 9B、Llama-3.1 8B、Qwen-2.5 7B上对比了经贝叶斯信号微调的BayesLM与经真实标签微调样本 oracle的OracleLM。结果表明BayesLM在行为、表征和计算层面都比OracleLM更符合贝叶斯决策，但仍未达到完全贝叶斯决策者的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）多基于真实标签（oracle标签）对模型进行训练，这可能导致模型在处理需以概率推断为规范解的任务时，仅学到表层的模式匹配，而非真正的贝叶斯推理。表面上看起来符合贝叶斯的行为（如推荐正确的选项）并不一定意味着模型内部也在进行贝叶斯计算；模型可能基于非贝叶斯的中间表征（如信念）做出同样的行为选择。因此，需要对一种行为模式（贝叶斯决策）在行为、表征和计算三个层面进行系统检验，揭示贝叶斯微调与oracle微调的差异，并深入理解模型是否在内部真正实现了贝叶斯推理。

Method: 采用四个递进的要求来检验语言模型是否构成贝叶斯决策者：R1（行为层面）通过Bayes准确率和策略散度评估模型行为；R2（表征层面）通过线性探针（linear probe）从模型隐藏状态中解码先验、似然、后验及选择策略；R3（因果使用层面）通过原型补丁（prototype patching）在中间层注入特定先验，观察推荐是否改变；R4（计算层面）通过跨模型补丁和神经符号模型（neuro-symbolic model，即将探针信念代入规范贝叶斯策略计算）来评估模型从信念到选择的转化是否与规范贝叶斯决策一致。任务为五轮的航班推荐任务，使用三种模型变体（StartLM、BayesLM、OracleLM）和四个测试集（original、shuffled、low noise、high noise）。

Result: 在Gemma-2 9B上：R1：BayesLM的Bayes准确率为0.84，显著高于OracleLM的0.69，二者在shuffled和low noise测试集上无显著差异，high noise上准确率下降；R2：在15-25中间层可线性解码先验/后验/似然量，BayesLM信念散度低至0.25（OracleLM为0.40），解码策略与BayesAssist接近；R3：原型补丁在BayesLM层18-25可达0.77平衡准确率（OracleLM仅0.52），干预需跨多个层或标记；R4：神经符号模型BayesLM将信念转化为选择策略时几乎与规范策略一致（+0.02提升），OracleLM则仅+0.09；跨模型补丁显示BayesLM的信念可提升OracleLM的平衡准确率（0.52→0.61），但反向注入OracleLM信念会降低BayesLM的表现（0.77→0.61）。Llama-3.1 8B和Qwen-2.5 7B上呈现一致模式，但Qwen的R3效果较弱。整体上BayesLM表现为“如其信念所允许的那样贝叶斯”，但非完全贝叶斯决策者。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯监督微调不仅在LM中安装了一致的概率内部表征，还安装了一个至少部分使用其表征信息的读取机制，从而产生更优的选择策略；oracle标签微调无法安装这种级别且该级别的贝叶斯信念和使用机制。结果凸显了精细化监督（nuances supervision）的优势：行为层面不能完全反映模型是否真正在内部进行贝叶斯推理，需要结合表征和计算的分析视角。贝叶斯微调使LM“如其信念所允许的那样贝叶斯”，但LM本质上仍是语言模型，存在分布式信息、噪声解码等局限。未来工作应扩展到其他具有规范贝叶斯解的任务，并探索LM前向传播中信念更新与策略转化的实现机制。

Abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used for tasks that require reasoning about hidden variables from a few observations, for which Bayesian inference is the normatively correct solution. While supervised fine-tuning of an LM on the outputs of an optimal $\textit{Bayesian}$ model leads to near-Bayesian behavior, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the true answers for the task falls short of it. But behavior alone does not tell us $\textit{why}$ tuning on a $\textit{Bayesian}$ or an $\textit{oracle}$ (true answers) signal differs: whether the resulting LM represents Bayesian beliefs, acts on them, or turns them into a choice the way Bayes' rule does. To compare them, we formulate increasingly demanding requirements for an LM to count as a Bayesian decision maker, spanning its behavior, representations, and computations, and test them on a flight recommendation task. The Bayes-trained LM acts Bayesian, encodes quantities of Bayes' rule in its middle layers, and uses the encoded belief for the recommendation to a certain extent. The oracle-trained LM differs from it both in the beliefs it holds and whether it reads beliefs out into recommendations. Exchanging beliefs between the LMs transfers a part of the Bayesian advantage. Bayes fine-tuning thus installs usable Bayesian beliefs in an LM for reasoning under uncertainty in a way standard SFT on oracle answers cannot, highlighting the advantage of nuanced supervision.

</details>


### [68] [Towards Robust Numerical Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00689)
*Peter Røysland Aarnes,Vinay Setty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了大型语言模型在数值声明验证任务中对数值扰动的脆弱性，提出通过参数高效对抗微调（QLoRA）显著提升鲁棒性，并发现小型Qwen3模型（0.6B–8B）在标签翻转扰动上可达98.7%准确率，超越GPT-5.4 Pro和Gemini 2.5 Flash等前沿闭源模型，且鲁棒性可跨域跨语言迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在声明验证中应用广泛，但对数值推理存在显著脆弱性——即使数值微小变化也会导致准确率急剧下降。这种脆弱性在前沿模型中依然存在，限制了LLM在事实核查等高风险场景中的可靠性，需要系统性的解决方案。

Method: 基于QuanTemp数据集构建六类数值扰动（数制转换、近似化、区间化、遮蔽、随机替换、否定），采用QLoRA和软提示微调两种参数高效方法对Qwen3系列模型（0.6B–8B）进行对抗微调，评估在标签翻转、标签保持等多种评估方向上的表现，并通过留一法消融分析训练组合的影响，在VitaminC（证据侧扰动）和CLEF 2025西班牙语（跨语言）数据集上测试泛化能力。

Result: 对抗微调使QLoRA微调的Qwen3-8B模型在标签翻转扰动上达到97.67%的微平均准确率，远超GPT-5.4 Pro（74.0%）和Gemini 2.5 Flash（73.9%），且在跨数据集西班牙语评估中将标签翻转准确率从73.71%提升至97.07%（+23.36pp）；消融分析显示Masked和Numeration扰动是必要的、而Approximation和Random是冗余的；联合训练VitaminC和QuanTemp的混合模型在两个领域同时取得最佳性能。

Conclusion: 标准微调使模型学会确认声明的表面形式而非根据证据验证，导致标签翻转输入上准确率崩塌至个位数；对抗微调通过反事实样本恢复近完美准确率，组合策略比扰动多样性更重要，Masked和Numeration扰动不可或缺而Approximation和Random冗余；鲁棒性可跨语言跨领域迁移，表明模型学到了泛化的数值决策边界而非记忆特定编辑模式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for claim verification, yet remain brittle for numerical reasoning: even small changes in value can sharply degrade accuracy. We show that this brittleness persists in frontier LLMs, but can be mitigated through adversarial fine-tuning on numerically perturbed examples. Using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, small Qwen3 models (0.6B$\unicode{x2013}$8B) reach 98.7% accuracy on label-flipping perturbations, outperforming larger zero-shot models and frontier systems (GPT-5.4 Pro (74.0%) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (73.9%)). The gains generalise to unseen perturbation types, indicating robust numerical decision boundaries rather than memorised edits. Robustness also transfers without target-domain data, significantly improving cross-lingual performance in Spanish. We further show that the same fine-tuning recipe confers robustness to evidence-side perturbations, using the VitaminC dataset.

</details>


### [69] [Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00779)
*Cathy Jiao,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统论证了在LLM合成数据筛选中，个体级信号（individual-level signals）不足以有效筛选训练数据，必须引入捕捉样本间交互作用的组级信号（group-level signals）。论文通过预训练和后训练两阶段的受控实验证明：组级oracle评分优于个体级代理oracle评分，且优势集中在生成类任务上；随着训练管线中合成数据比例上升，仅有结合组级信号的数据筛选方法能避免模型退化并超越基线；最后提出基于组内梯度多样性（within-group gradient diversity）的低开销诊断方法，用于在有限算力预算下指导组级评分的分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据已成为LLM训练不可或缺的部分，但大规模使用会导致模型生成能力退化（即"模型坍缩"）。现有数据筛选实践普遍依赖个体级信号（独立评估每个样本的训练效用），但合成数据的同质性和样本间交互效应使得个体级筛选可能无效。因此需要回答的核心问题是：在合成数据筛选中，应该使用什么样的信号来决定哪些数据值得训练？

Method: 方法框架包含三个层面：（1）形式化定义个体oracle评分和组oracle评分，将个体代理oracle定义为组oracle的均值近似；（2）通过控制实验构建具有相同个体代理评分但不同组合多样性的候选数据组，对比组oracle选择、个体代理oracle选择和随机选择的下游表现；（3）提出组内梯度多样性作为预测个体-组oracle差距的诊断量，证明其与oracle gap的理论界（Proposition 5.1），并据此设计预算分配策略。理论基础是将差距表示为(βη²/2)σ²_G的上界，其中σ²_G为组内梯度协方差的迹。实验设置涵盖预训练（Repro-400M + FLAN参考集）和后训练（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct + GPQA参考集），比较了GradSim、FineWeb-Edu、BM25等个体级方法和GMRel、GREATS等组级方法在不同复述因子（r=1,10,50）下的表现。

Result: 核心结果包括：（1）在所有任务设置和组大小下，组oracle选择均优于随机选择和个体代理oracle选择，其中生成类任务获益最大（相对提升+16.9% vs 个体代理的+6.3%和随机的+4.7%），多选题任务上三者相当；（2）随着训练管线合成化程度提高（r增大），个体级筛选方法（GradSim、FineWeb-Edu、BM25）在生成任务上出现退化，而组级方法（GMRel、GREATS）保持优势；当r=50时，将GMRel的关系权重增强3倍可提升4.7%的相对下游性能；（3）组内梯度多样性与oracle gap的Spearman相关性达0.58-0.63，显著优于Vendi（0.44-0.48）和压缩比（0.40-0.57）等无梯度指标；在20%组oracle调用预算下，GradDiv_q=0.1仅用27%的显存即可恢复74%的全量组oracle召回率。

Conclusion: 该研究的核心结论是：合成数据的有效筛选必须依赖组级信号而非个体级信号，因为样本间的交互效应（amplification和cancellation）使个体级评分系统性低估或高估数据集的真实训练价值。随着LLM训练管线对合成数据的依赖加深，数据筛选方法需更显式地建模样本间关系（放大关系权重）。在算力受限场景下，组内梯度多样性是预测个体-组oracle差距的高效诊断量，可用于指导有限的组级评分预算分配——仅对梯度多样性高的组调用组oracle，可在低开销下恢复大部分组级信号带来的收益。该工作为开发可扩展的、显式建模关系结构的组级数据筛选方法提供了方向。

Abstract: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that this is insufficient for synthetic data, and that group-level signals (i.e., estimates of utility that account for interactions among data samples) are necessary for effective data curation. First, we show that individual-level signals are blind to how samples jointly affect training: synthetic datasets with different compositions can be indistinguishable under individual-level influence yet differ sharply under group-level influence, and curating by the latter yields better downstream performance, particularly in generative capability. Second, we find that group-level signals matter more as training pipelines become increasingly synthetic: among widely used data curation methods, only those incorporating them improve over baseline, with gains increasing when weights capturing relations among samples are amplified. Finally, we translate these findings into practice -- for model developers under a compute budget, we offer a cheap diagnostic that prioritizes which groups of synthetic data most need group-level estimation, recovering much of the benefit of full group-level scoring at a fraction of the compute cost.

</details>


### [70] [Can large language models unlock discrete data in ophthalmic diagnostic reports?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00795)
*Umair A. Zaidi,An-Lun Wu,Wei-Chun Lin,Thomas S. Hwang,Michelle R. Hribar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究评估了GPT-4o辅助的两种提示策略（Schema-Constrained与Prompt-Only）在从眼科诊断PDF报告中提取结构化数据时的准确性与效率。结果显示，两种方法在小型概念验证数据集上均具有较高的准确性，并显著减少处理时间，但各自具有互补的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 眼科诊断报告（如视野检查、OCT）的结构化数据提取传统上依赖手动操作，耗时且效率低下。利用大语言模型（LLM）自动化此过程可显著提高效率。本研究旨在比较两种LLM提示策略在提取准确性、格式准确性和处理时间方面的表现，以确定最佳实践。

Method: 研究使用了20份去识别的眼科诊断报告（涵盖视野检查、OCT青光眼概览、OCT RNFL单次检查和OCT厚度图，每类5份）。采用两种GPT-4o辅助流程：Schema-Constrained（使用预定义JSON Schema的结构化输出模式）和Prompt-Only（使用详细指令提示后通过Python转换为JSON），并与人工核对的真实数据进行比较。主要指标包括数值准确性、格式准确性和提取时间。

Result: 数值准确性方面，Schema-Constrained在视野检查和RNFL单次检查中达到100.00%，在青光眼概览中为97.45%，在厚度图中为98.00%；Prompt-Only在所有四类报告中均达到100.00%。格式准确性方面，Schema-Constrained在所有报告中均为100.00%；Prompt-Only在RNFL单次检查中为90.14%，其余为100.00%。提取时间方面，手动审查平均为56.51秒/份，而Schema-Constrained为5.04秒，Prompt-Only为4.70秒，减少约92%。

Conclusion: 在本研究的小型概念验证数据集中，通用的LLM辅助流程能以高准确性和显著减少的处理时间从眼科诊断PDF中提取结构化数据。Prompt-Only在数值准确性上表现最佳，而Schema-Constrained在格式合规性上具有100%的准确性。这两种互补的优势支持进一步评估用于研究和临床数据提取的混合、具备验证意识的流程。

Abstract: Objective: To assess the accuracy and efficiency of a large language model (LLM) using two prompt strategies to extract structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports. Methods: Twenty deidentified reports across four types (Visual Field, OCT Glaucoma Overview, OCT retinal nerve fiber layer Single Exam, and OCT Thickness Map; n = 5 each) were processed using two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines and compared with a reconciled manual ground truth. Schema-Constrained used Structured Output mode with a predefined JSON Schema; Prompt-Only used a detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON. Outcomes were value accuracy, formatting accuracy, and extraction time. Results: Schema-Constrained value accuracy was 100.00% for Visual Field and RNFL Single Exam, 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview, and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only achieved 100.00% across all four report types. Formatting accuracy was 100.00% for Schema-Constrained across all report types and 100.00% for Prompt-Only except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction. Conclusions: In this small proof-of-concept dataset, general-purpose LLM-assisted pipelines extracted structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDFs with high accuracy and substantially reduced processing time. Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy. These complementary strengths support further evaluation of hybrid, validation-aware workflows for research and clinical data abstraction.

</details>

Abstract: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.

### [72] [DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00883)

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DeBERTa-ConPara检测器，通过2×2×2因子实验揭示Unicode预处理的应用位置（训练vs推理）对对抗鲁棒性影响截然相反：训练时归一化会通过去重删除对抗监督信号，推理时归一化则是有效的防御手段；最终采用"原始训练+ 推理归一化"配置，在RAID隐藏测试集上达到99.61% AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成文本检测器在面对部署条件下的领域偏移、生成器变化以及对抗性表面扰动（如同形异义字符替换、零宽Unicode字符插入）时性能急剧下降，且现有评估隐含目标域标签可用的假设，与真实部署不符。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 攻击感知预处理流水线——基于Unicode同形异义字符表映射、NFKD分解、零宽字符移除等六步规范化；(2) 上下文Transformer编码器（microsoft/deberta-v3-large）；(3) 受监督对比学习与释义增强（ConPara）；并设计62维手工语言学特征融合分支。通过2×2×2因子设计独立变化预处理在训练/推理阶段的应用以及特征分支的有无，全部提交隐藏测试。

Result: 最优配置（无特征分支、原始训练、推理归一化）在RAID隐藏测试集达到99.61% AUROC、99.01% TPR@5%FPR和96.57% TPR@1%FPR；HC3 Plus与MAGE固定阈值下平均平衡准确率93.14%。增益集中在两类攻击：同形异义字符替换从11.05%提升至96.98%、零宽空格插入从1.12%提升至96.98%。该效应在Fast-DetectGPT零样本检测器中复现，表明属于攻击机制而非模型特有。负结果包括：(1) 释义增强与ConPara对比学习未提升最优配置；(2) 手工特征融合分支在分布内有饱和效应无贡献，在分布外（SemEval-2024上损失23.4pp TPR@1%FPR，HC3-SI上损失7.7pp，诗歌领域损失49.8pp）有害。推理归一化在无Unicode扰动的基准上完全惰性，符合机制预测。

Conclusion: 在域内准确率之外需关注部署鲁棒性。Unicode归一化能有效中和零宽字符与同形异义字符攻击，但仅在推理阶段有效；训练阶段归一化会因去重而消除对抗监督信号。该防御是数据中心的而非架构相关的：所有三种子词分词器均将同形异义字符替换词碎片化为子词而非未知标记，证实该漏洞属于子词分词本身。推理归一化是无学习参数的确定性步骤，可被现有检测器无需重训练直接采用。该方法仅在英语域、生成器和攻击下验证；多语言扩展、人类辅助式写作与个性化AI模仿仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Robust detection of AI-generated text under deployment conditions is challenging: distribution shifts across domains and generators, adversarial perturbations of the input surface, and the absence of target-domain labels for threshold calibration all degrade detectors that perform well in-domain. We present DeBERTa-ConPara, a deployment-oriented detector combining attack-aware Unicode preprocessing with a contextual transformer encoder trained over HC3 Plus, M4, MAGE and RAID. Our central finding is that preprocessing acts in opposite directions depending on where it is applied: normalising the training corpus deduplicates it, collapsing 35.4% of RAID rows into copies of their clean siblings and deleting the adversarial supervision, whereas normalising at inference is an effective defence. A factorial varying the two placements independently identifies raw training with normalised inference as the best configuration, reaching 99.61% AUROC, 99.01% TPR@5% FPR and 96.57% TPR@1% FPR on the official RAID hidden test, alongside 93.14% average balanced accuracy across HC3 Plus and MAGE under a fixed threshold. The gain is confined to two of twelve attack classes: homoglyph and zero-width-space insertion rise from 11.05% and 1.12% to 96.98%. The same signature reproduces in a zero-shot detector of different architecture, showing the effect belongs to the attacks rather than to our model. We additionally report two negative results: semantic-invariance augmentation through paraphrasing and supervised contrastive learning (ConPara) does not improve the best configuration, and the handcrafted feature-fusion branch is inert in distribution and harmful outside it.

</details>

*Jungwon Park,Changin Choi,Jimyeong Kim,Nojun Kwak,Wonjong Rhee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文是关于大语言模型(LLM)高效任务适配方法的综述,提出了一个统一的分类框架,根据任务信息的编码位置(模型权重、输入提示或注入的任务嵌入)将现有方法系统地组织为三大范式:基于权重、基于提示和基于嵌入的适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型规模不断增大,完全微调变得昂贵甚至不可行,推动了参数高效微调(PEFT)、上下文学习(ICL)等高效任务适配方法的发展。然而这些方法在各范式内独立演进,其跨范式关系和权衡(尤其是新兴的基于嵌入的适配方法)尚未得到充分探索,亟需一个统一的分类框架来整合这些研究方向。

Method: 作者提出了一个统一的分类法,按"任务信息在何处及如何编码"将高效任务适配方法分为三大范式:(1)基于权重的适配(Weight-Based),包括单任务适配(LoRA变体、Adapter、BitFit、(IA)³等)和多任务适配(多任务PEFT、模型合并);(2)基于提示的适配(Prompt-Based),包括指令优化(ProTeGi、GEPA等)和演示优化(KATE、DPP、RL方法、LLM生成演示、many-shot ICL);(3)基于嵌入的适配(Embedding-Based),包括ICL衍生的任务嵌入(Task Vectors、Function Vectors等)和学习的任务嵌入(Prompt Tuning、LIVE、LTV等)。该综述还提供了系统的方法对比表、与先前PEFT/ICL综述的详细对比、定量元分析以及跨范式的开放问题讨论。

Result: 综述的主要贡献包括:(1)首次提出涵盖三种范式的统一分类法;(2)首次将新兴的基于嵌入的适配方法纳入专项综述,澄清其与ICL和PEFT的关系;(3)识别跨范式开放问题(混合组合适配、数据效率与合成监督、评估基准、行为与上下文信息编码)。定量分析显示,基于嵌入的方法(如SITE)仅用约1K参数即可达到与10-shot ICL相当甚至更好的性能(58.04 vs 47.17 on BBH),且推理运行时与LoRA相当,远低于ICL和FV方法。

Conclusion: 该综述通过"任务信息编码位置"这一统一视角,连接了基于权重、基于提示和基于嵌入的三大适配范式,系统性地分析了它们的优势、局限性和权衡关系,强调了新兴的基于嵌入的适配方法的潜力(参数高效、推理开销低),同时也指出了该领域面临的开放挑战,为未来研究方向(混合适配、合成数据利用、更复杂的评估基准等)提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed across diverse downstream tasks, efficient task adaptation has emerged as a central challenge. In response, a wide range of task adaptation methods have been proposed, spanning parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in-context learning, and embedding-injection approaches. However, these lines of work have largely evolved within individual paradigms, leaving their cross-paradigm relationships and trade-offs underexplored, especially for recently emerging embedding-based adaptations. This survey presents a unified framework that categorizes task adaptation methods by where and how task information is encoded: model weights, input prompts, or injected task embeddings. We provide a comprehensive taxonomy that integrates these paradigms, analyze their key strengths and limitations to explain how different adaptation paradigms have evolved, clarify relationships across paradigms, and highlight open problems for future research.

</details>

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency. We use an agentic ensemble of small language models (SLMs) with an SLM-judge-mediated feedback loop as a case study for such beyond-leaderboard evaluation. On the 541-prompt IFEval benchmark, the best ensemble achieves 97.34% strict prompt accuracy, exceeding the strongest standalone LLM baseline, gpt-5.4, by 5.81 percentage points while operating in a lower-cost regime. We then analyze the tokenomics and operational behavior behind this gain, including cost per sample, token composition, useful-output goodput, feedback-loop recovery, latency decomposition, and performance across instruction categories and constraint counts. Our results show that agentic SLM ensembles can trade additional test-time tokens and orchestration overhead for improved instruction-following fidelity, motivating multi-dimensional evaluation protocols for future agentic AI systems.

### [75] [Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention for Conversational LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00958)
*Wanyang Hong,Zhaoning Zhang,Yi Chen,Libo Zhang,Baihui Liu,Linbo Qiao,Zhiliang Tian,Dongsheng Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: REA提出一种基于角色感知的对话上下文管理框架，通过将持久性全局指令与情节性对话历史分别处理来解决LLM多轮对话中的"累积上下文衰退"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在多轮对话中常因注意力被污染、稀释和漂移而丢失早期指令和相关上下文信息，导致性能随对话轮次增加而下降。现有方法（扩大上下文窗口、压缩、检索）未能明确区分"持续性指令"与"情节性内容"的不同持久化需求。

Method: REA包含三个核心组件：(1) 指令记忆（IM）通过Qwen3-0.6B分类器识别全局指令并保留在专用前缀中；(2) 情节记忆（EM）采用双LoRA架构（LoRA_cmp压缩，LoRA_gen生成）对模型回复进行非对称压缩，用户输入保留原文；(3) 启发式上下文检索（HCR）根据余弦相似度阈值（τ_low=0.5, τ_high=0.7）对历史轮次选择原始文本、压缩表示或省略三种粒度。

Conclusion: REA验证了基于角色的上下文管理是一种维持对话连续性和指令遵循性的实用方法，核心贡献在于为不同功能角色（持久性指令 vs 情节性内容）设计差异化的持久化和表示策略。

Abstract: Large language models often lose track of persistent instructions and relevant information as multi-turn conversations grow. We study this cumulative contextual decay through three related failure modes: attention pollution, dilution, and drift. We propose REA (Role-aware Heuristic Episodic Attention), a context-management framework that assigns different persistence and representation policies to instructions and episodic interactions. Instructional Memory retains identified global constraints in a dedicated prefix. Episodic Memory preserves user inputs and compresses model replies, while heuristic retrieval selects raw text, compressed representations, or omission for each historical turn. On Long-MT-Bench+, REA improves the judge score from 6.32 to 7.36 on a 10-point scale, a 16.5% relative gain over the Vanilla baseline, and reduces average latency by 2.91$\times$. These results support role-aware context management as a practical approach to maintaining conversational continuity and instruction adherence.

</details>


### [76] [Scaling and Distilling Text Embeddings for Better Diffusibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01016)
*Zekai Zhang,Yunjie Tian,Yanjin He,Xiaoyan Zhang,Dongdi Zhao,Qing Qu,Di Fu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究连续扩散语言模型(DLMs)中"可扩散性"(diffusibility)的文本嵌入空间问题。作者通过实验发现:(1)在同一系列内缩放嵌入模型(T5 → T5Gemma-1 → T5Gemma-2)能显著改善生成性能;(2)但强嵌入(T5Gemma-2)过于判别性,导致生成过程常落入"无效嵌入";(3)通过将T5Gemma-2的解码概率作为软标签蒸馏到学生编码器,可构建更连接、更易扩散的潜空间。最终中等规模DLM在OpenWebText上达到Gen. PPL 17.8(真实文本PPL 15.4),超过GPT-2-M的Gen. PPL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型(DLMs)作为自回归(AR)生成的替代方案,在文本嵌入构成的潜空间中进行潜在扩散。然而,现有研究要么联合修改嵌入和扩散模型,要么使用较旧的嵌入模型,难以孤立分析嵌入空间贡献,也未充分发挥现代嵌入模型的潜力。核心问题:哪种嵌入构成最可扩散的潜空间?本文旨在独立研究嵌入空间对连续DLMs扩散性的影响。

Method: 方法分两步:(1)嵌入缩放实验——固定ELF扩散框架,系统比较T5-small/base、T5Gemma-1-S/B、T5Gemma-2-270M及ModernBERT等嵌入模型在相同扩散训练下的性能。(2)嵌入蒸馏——将T5Gemma-2教师编码器蒸馏为9层学生编码器,使用教师解码器在真实文本上的top-256概率分布作为软标签,通过KL散度损失训练学生,使语义相似的候选词嵌入在空间中更接近,同时保持编码-解码机制不变。

Result: 主要结果:(1)缩放嵌入将Gen. PPL在相同熵下降低约40%,T5Gemma-2是唯一达到真实文本熵的嵌入;(2)原始T5Gemma-2生成中,平均每1024-token序列有142个"不确定"位置,其中109个是"无效"嵌入(远离所有候选词);(3)蒸馏后,不确定位置降至42个,无效降至12个;(4)在OWT-1024上,Student+ELF-B达到Gen. PPL 31.2,Student+ELF-M达到Gen. PPL 17.8,均优于T5Gemma-2基线和GPT-2-M(20.8);(5)LM1B上一致改进;(6)蒸馏以少量判别能力损失(SST-2: 89.4→78.1)换取扩散性显著提升;(7)学生编码器将编码成本减半。

Conclusion: 结论:(1)缩放文本嵌入能提升连续DLMs的扩散性,为该方向提供强基线;(2)强判别性嵌入存在"分离问题",使生成易落入无效嵌入;(3)通过解码概率蒸馏可在保持重建能力的同时显著改善嵌入几何结构,形成更连接、更易扩散的潜空间;(4)设计DLMs的嵌入空间与设计扩散过程同等重要,且提供了一种可扩展的实用路径。未来方向包括少步/单步生成、实际规模模型、以及直接将AR基础模型适配为DLM嵌入(跳过中间表示)。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language generation. Recent advances in continuous DLMs, which apply latent diffusion to continuous text embeddings, raise a practical question: which embedding makes the best latent space, i.e., the most diffusible? To answer this, we search through different embeddings and find that scaling the embedding model to stronger ones within the same family (T5 to T5Gemma-1 to T5Gemma-2) greatly improves generative performance. But the raw T5Gemma-2 embeddings are still not optimal. They are so discriminative that even the embeddings of plausible alternative words are separated, which makes the generation vulnerable to imperfect sampling. Consequently, continuous diffusion often fails to reach any of them and ends up at an invalid embedding instead. To address this, we distill T5Gemma-2 into a student encoder that learns the teacher's decoded probabilities as soft labels. Learning from such soft labels makes the student pull the alternative embeddings closer while maintaining the encoding-decoding mechanism. The distilled embeddings form a more connected and diffusible latent space, improving over the vanilla T5Gemma-2 embeddings. As a result, our medium-sized DLM achieves Gen. PPL 17.8 (against real-text PPL 15.4) at real-text entropy on OpenWebText, outperforming GPT-2-M on Gen. PPL.

</details>


### [77] [LawCompass: Navigating from Legal QA to Multi-Agent Deep Research with Grounded Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01027)
*Xiaoxia Cheng,Linnan Wang,Jiahao Ma,Zhichuan Ye,Xuemei Zhou,Chuanyu Tong,Bo Jiang,Qing Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LawCompass是一个面向中国法律领域的统一证据驱动系统，将传统法律问答升级为多智能体深度研究，整合法律问答、专业检索和深度研究三大功能，并通过强制引用机制保证输出可追溯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律助手大多局限于多轮对话式问答，无法支持需要系统性证据检索、多步推理和报告级合成的复杂法律任务。法律信息检索本质上是一个渐进过程，需从直接查询过渡到结构化法律权威审查，最终实现跨法条、案例与实证证据的深度分析。

Method: 基于RAG框架构建统一系统，包含三大模块：(1) Legal QA模块采用记忆存储、意图路由器（含启发式规则与LLM语义分类两层级）、检索引擎和答案生成器；(2) Professional Retrieval模块通过查询改写、双路径检索（原始查询+改写查询，关键词+向量）提升检索质量；(3) Deep Research模块采用基于LangGraph协调的Planner-Executor-Synthesis多智能体工作流，将复杂任务分解为3-5个子任务并行执行后合成结构化报告。所有模块共享Evidence-Grounded Generation组件，采用"层次感知源排序"（按法律效力位阶排序）和"强制引用约束"（编号源标签+可点击链接）。数据来源包括22万条法规（法宝网）、10万条裁判文书（中国裁判文书网）的Milvus向量数据库，并集成Tavily实时网页搜索。

Result: 检索质量评估（20个法律查询）：双路径检索P@5达79.0、nDCG@5达90.9、平均相关性得分1.28，优于仅用原始查询或仅用改写查询。用户研究（5分Likert量表）：非法律背景用户组整体满意度4.4，法律背景用户组4.1；Deep Research价值评分最高（法律组4.2、非法律组4.5）。案例研究以"被辞退可以赔多少钱"为例，生成了包含问题概述、详细法律分析、相关法条、案例参考、风险提示和免责声明六部分的完整中英双语研究报告。

Conclusion: LawCompass通过将异构法律源、面向任务的检索和协调的多智能体工作流相结合，使用户能够从直接法律信息查询过渡到复杂的报告级研究。检索评估、用户研究和代表性案例研究验证了该系统在支持实际法律研究任务方面的有效性，为将对话式AI转变为可信且有证据支撑的法律研究辅助工具提供了实用且可扩展的范式，但仍受限于本地数据库更新频率以及多阶段流程带来的延迟和计算成本。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have significantly democratized access to legal information. Nevertheless, most existing legal assistants remain confined to multi-turn conversational QA, failing to support complex legal tasks that require systematic evidence retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and report-level synthesis. In this paper, we present LawCompass, an evidence-grounded legal assistant that navigates the transition from standard Legal QA to multi-agent deep research. LawCompass provides three task-oriented functions: Legal QA, which delivers precise, evidence-backed answers to legal questions; Professional Retrieval, which enables structured exploration of statutes and judicial cases via query rewriting; and Deep Research, which employs a multi-agent workflow to decompose complex legal tasks and synthesize comprehensive research reports. Crucially, LawCompass maintains explicit citation links across all modules, empowering users to directly verify system outputs against original legal sources. Evaluation results demonstrate that LawCompass provides a practical and scalable paradigm for transforming conversational AI into trustworthy and evidence-grounded legal research assistance.

</details>


### [78] [Probe with Participation Trophies: Random-Reward RL as a Probe of LLM Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01066)
*Yu Mao,Lei Yu,Zining Zhu,Yusheng Zheng,Haohang Li,Freda Shi,Yutong Yin,Zhaoran Wang,Jingcheng Niu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将"虚假奖励悖论"与模型的"可达性"联系起来，提出随机奖励强化学习（RL）作为探针工具，旨在解决探针性能究竟揭示模型什么的争论。作者在 OLMo-2 等多个 LLM 检查点上发现训练响应存在三个不同阶段：休眠期（Dormant）、接受期（Receptive）和自学期（Autodidactic）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚假奖励悖论——即随机奖励也能提升大语言模型性能——的发现挑战了人们对 RL 训练机制的传统理解。现有两种主流解释（数据污染或 RL 训练机制本身）均不完整。作者旨在重新审视这一现象，探究其真正根源，并利用随机奖励 RL 作为探针来揭示模型的"可达性"——即从当前状态出发能通过进一步训练达到何种水平。

Method: 提出"可达性"（Reachability）框架，将其定义为在固定训练过程、信息供给和预算约束下，模型从当前状态能取得的最高期望任务性能。引入"随机奖励可达性"作为无正确性反馈的探针，并证明随机奖励信号不通过奖励通道传递正确性信息。利用 OLMo-2、SmolLM2-1.7B 和 OLMo-3-7B 的多个训练检查点，在合成算术（GSM）、代码生成（MBPP）和组合查找等任务上进行系统实验。同时进行共享rollout交叉训练实验和训练输入控制实验，以分离学习者状态和输入信息对训练响应的影响。

Result: 研究发现：（1）两个初始准确率相同（3.5%）的 OLMo 检查点，在相同正确性奖励 RL 下最佳运行分别达到 8.5% 和 55%，表明当前性能不能完全反映训练潜力；（2）训练响应存在三阶段模式——早期预训练为"休眠期"（即使正确奖励也无改进）、后期预训练为"接受期"（正确奖励有效但随机奖励无效）、中期训练为"自学期"（随机奖励也能产生大幅增益）；（3）相同的数字掩码 SFT 分析也呈现相似顺序，表明该模式并非特定于 RL 机制；（4）任务模板信息（数学指令和格式标记）对训练响应至关重要——移除模板后，即使保留随机奖励，模型响应也几乎无变化。

Conclusion: 随机奖励 RL 可作为有效的探针工具，揭示模型在无正确性反馈条件下的可达性，回答了探针究竟是揭示模型能力还是从自身监督中学习任务这一长期争论。LLM 能力发展遵循可预测的三阶段模式：休眠→接受→自学。该框架有助于理解何时及为何模型会变得对后训练产生响应，为深入理解 LLM 能力涌现提供了新的视角。

Abstract: We connect the spurious-reward paradox to a model's reachability and propose random-reward reinforcement learning (RL) as a useful tool for the probing enterprise, addressing a decade-long debate over what probing performance actually reveals about a model. There are two prevailing explanations for the surprising finding that even random rewards can improve the performance of large language models (LLMs): one attributes the gains to particular mechanisms within RL training; the other to data contamination. Our results motivate a different view: spurious-reward RL can probe a model's reachability, or what further training can attain from its current state under specified constraints, beyond what is reflected in its current performance. Two OLMo checkpoints with the same accuracy on synthetic arithmetic (3.5%), for example, reach 8.5% and 55% in their best runs under the same correctness-rewarded RL. Examining OLMo checkpoints across pre-training and mid-training reveals three distinct regimes of training response: early on, RL produces little improvement even when correct answers are rewarded; later in pre-training, rewarding correct answers becomes effective while random rewards remain weak; and, upon entering mid-training, even random rewards can produce large gains. A similar ordering appears in a number-masked supervised fine-tuning (SFT) analysis of these checkpoints, suggesting that the pattern is not specific to a particular RL mechanism. Moreover, RL with random rewards offers a distinctive perspective on what training can make an LLM do, since its reward signal supplies no information about which answers are correct. By asking what training can attain without correctness feedback, it addresses the label-leakage side of a central problem in decodability-based probing: whether a successful probe reveals the model's capabilities or learns the task itself.

</details>


### [79] [Precision over Scale: A Polish-Silesian Benchmark and a Translation System Outperforming Open-Source and Commercial Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01082)
*Grzegorz Kulik,Mikołaj Pokrywka,Adam Jatowt,Wojciech Kusa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对低资源方言波兰语-西里西亚语(Silesian)机器翻译,提出新基准SiLTT并对比神经与规则方法,发现规则系统在方言场景下仍优于微调的神经模型和商业系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 西里西亚语(ISO 639-3: szl)是一种资源匮乏的西斯拉夫语言,现有基准如FLORES侧重标准化文本,无法反映真实方言变体;大规模网络挖掘语料噪声大且缺乏语言一致性,导致现有MT系统在方言场景下表现不佳。论文旨在探索数据受限条件下高质量小规模语料与规则方法的有效性。

Method: 构建基于Apertium平台的浅层转移规则系统(31,757词条+2,349语法规则);构建约22k句对的高质量精选语料CBT-22k;采用QLoRA对TranslateGemma-4B进行微调;在SiLTT(1,237句对,新发布)、BOUQuET、FLORES三个基准上评估神经与商业系统(PLLuM、Bielik、NLLB、MADLAD、GPT-5.4、Google Translate、TranslateGemma),使用sacreBLEU和chrF指标。

Result: 规则系统在SiLTT(BLEU 10.3/chrF 34.5)和BOUQuET(BLEU 36.7/chrF 61.0)上均取得最佳成绩;TranslateGemma-FT(CBT-22k)是最强的神经系统,超越GPT-5.4和Google Translate但在方言场景下仍不及规则系统;在FLORES上Google Translate最佳(可能存在训练数据污染);加入NLLB和HPLT语料的混合微调反而因噪声降低了性能。

Conclusion: 在方言和低资源场景下,基于显式语言学先验的规则系统仍具有强大竞争力;高质量精选小规模语料比大规模噪声语料更有效;西里西亚语机器翻译需专门的双语监督,仅靠波兰语能力或偶发的西里西亚语接触不足以胜任;研究发布了SiLTT测试集和最佳神经模型以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Dialectal machine translation remains challenging due to limited data and strong linguistic variation not captured by standard benchmarks, which often assume standardized and well-edited text. We study Polish-Silesian MT using neural and rule-based systems, evaluating on SiLTT - a new Pol-Szl testset, alongside established BOUQuET and FLORES benchmarks. Results show our rule-based system is consistently strongest on SiLTT and BOUQuET datasets and that TranslateGemma fine-tuned on a curated dataset improves over strong neural baselines but does not surpass the rule-based system in dialectal settings. We release SiLTT and our best neural model to support further research.

</details>


### [80] [AgSpec: Pushing the Limits of Retrieval-Based Speculative Decoding in Coding Agent Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01108)
*Sumin Lee,Sukmin Cho,Suengjae Lim,Youngjin Kwon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AgSpec是一个面向编码代理流水线的检索式推测解码框架，通过引入编码代理感知的语料库组织（会话/工作区/全局）和代理感知的草稿长度控制（离线剖析上限+在线验证反馈自适应），在多个基准测试中显著优于现有检索式推测解码方法和EAGLE-3，最高可实现4.76×的自回归解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的检索式推测解码方法在编码代理场景中存在两个关键不足：(1) 语料库覆盖不全——会话历史和仓库工作区中的可复用文本未被纳入，或以与代理输出格式不同的形式存储；(2) 草稿长度策略静态——固定的草稿长度上限或仅基于匹配长度的缩放策略忽略了不同代理角色间的接受长度差异及其随轮次的漂移。这两个限制导致现有方法无法充分利用编码代理流水线中的可复用文本。

Method: AgSpec是构建在现有检索引擎（如SAM-Decoding的后缀自动机、SuffixDecoding的后缀树）之上的框架，包含两大核心设计：(1) **编码代理感知检索**：将语料库按来源分为会话语料库（保留会话轨迹）、工作区语料库（以代理发射格式索引打开的文件）和全局语料库，并按来源相关性设置匹配优先级（全局语料库需超出优势margin δ=5才能胜出）；(2) **代理感知草稿长度控制**：通过离线剖析历史轨迹设定每个代理角色的草稿长度上限K_max（基于收支平衡阈值λ），并在线通过验证反馈自适应调整缩放因子α（实现为τ-分位数损失的随机次梯度步骤）。方法保持无训练特性，不修改底层检索引擎。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified和TeamBench两个仓库级多代理基准上，使用Devstral-24B、Gemma3-27B和Qwen3.6-27B三个模型评估，AgSpec在大多数设定下优于PLD、REST、FASTCoder、SuffixDecoding、SAM-Decoding和EAGLE-3：批量大小1下吞吐量加速达2.4-4.4×，批量大小16下达1.1-4.8×自回归解码加速；在LiveCodeBench（无仓库）和Terminal-Bench（单代理）上也保持有效；消融实验显示会话语料库贡献最大（AL提升1.6-2.1×），工作区语料库和在线α自适应分别带来额外显著收益。

Conclusion: 检索式推测解码在编码代理场景中应与代理流水线结构对齐——按照代理会话产生的文本进行索引，并以代理发射的格式存储，同时为每个代理量身定制草稿长度。AgSpec作为一个正交于检索引擎的框架，可在不修改现有引擎的前提下显著加速编码代理解码，且在更广泛的编码代理工作负载上具有泛化能力。

Abstract: Retrieval-based speculative decoding (SD) drafts tokens by copying continuations from existing text, which suits coding agents that repeatedly reproduce code, logs, and earlier attempts. Yet existing methods fall short in agent pipelines: much of the reusable text is missing from their corpora or stored in a form that differs from what the agent emits, and their draft lengths ignore that accept length varies across agents and drifts over turns. We present AgSpec, a framework that supplies the corpus and draft-length policies that existing retrieval engines lack in coding-agent pipelines. AgSpec retrieves from session, workspace, and global corpora, retaining the ongoing session trajectory and indexing opened files in the agent's emission format. It bounds each agent's draft length with an offline-profiled cap and adapts the length online from verification feedback. On two repository-level multi-agent coding benchmarks, AgSpec outperforms five retrieval-based drafters and EAGLE-3 in most evaluated settings, raising generation throughput over autoregressive decoding up to 4.37$\times$ at batch size 1 and 4.76$\times$ at batch size 16. AgSpec also remains effective on benchmarks without a repository or a multi-agent pipeline, showing that its gains generalize to coding agents broadly.

</details>


### [81] [Counting and Min-Cost Encoding for Tokenization in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01127)
*Shuming Shi,Xiang Zhang,Hao Yu,Wenbo Fei,Changjian Wang,Zhan Wang,Guoqing Pang,Guangye Yu,Quan Lu,Ning Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 Counting and Filtering (CNF) 的词表构建方法和一种名为 Min-Cost Encoding (MCE) 的文本编码算法，用于大语言模型的 tokenization。CNF-MCE 在多个文本类别上实现了比 BPE 更高的压缩率和词表利用率，并在下游任务上保持了与 BPE 可比的性能。


<details>
