Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [193] [From Discovery to Decision: Finite-Budget Recoverability in LLM Voting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01014)
*Shaoang Li,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究固定调用预算下LLM投票的"发现-决策"鸿沟，通过已实现的投票状态和剩余预算刻画可达性，提出精确的恢复阈值和"转换窗口"概念，并开发了一个无标签的精确决策锁定证书，可在保证固定预算输出不变的前提下节省28-30%的推理调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在固定推理预算下，多次采样LLM响应虽然能提高发现正确答案的概率，但并不保证该答案在最终投票中胜出——正确答案可能在被发现时已无法逆转落后，或虽暂时领先却在后续被反超。现有工作缺乏对"发现"与"决策"之间这一结构性鸿沟的精确刻画，亟需一个基于实时投票状态的有限预算可恢复性理论。

Method: 1) 状态理论：定义计数状态v与剩余预算r，推导出每候选y的最小胜出阈值L_y(v)（考虑缺席项与领跑对手的票数与平票优先级），并证明可达胜者集R_r(v)随调用单调收缩、已观测候选集单调扩张，从而形成"转换窗口"。2) 概率层：在iid响应律下给出有限期终点胜出概率Q_r(v;p)的精确递推与多项式封闭式。3) 错误竞争理论：证明合并错误身份保持单次正确性但不改善多数投票；推导出错误概率转移的"枢轴性"状态依赖公式。4) 精确锁定：当可达胜者集为单元素{w}时停止，保证全称输出的固定预算端点不变，并推导锁定时刻的大数定律与中心极限定理。5) 实证验证：跨多种协议（forced-choice MMLU-Pro、GSM-Symbolic、原生生成、公共GSM8K/MATH、Word16机制任务、思考模式）进行前向预测、错误竞争干预（输入置换）与物理执行实验。

Result: 1) 发现-决策鸿沟普遍存在：公共MATH上从B=16到1024，70B覆盖率从80%升至95.2%，但多数投票准确率停滞在约60%；81-98%的"已覆盖但未选中"失败在正确答案首次出现时仍可恢复，仅在发现后才丧失可达性。2) 状态条件预测：AUC达0.825，较持久性基线和纯响应律预测显著更优。3) 输入置换效应：Word16上Qwen3.5-4B原始多数投票准确率提升21.1个百分点（57.42%→78.52%），单次正确性几乎不变（-0.22点），且与选择器强交互——在多重集过滤下增益降至5.9点。4) 精确锁定节省28.35%（MMLU-Pro）和30.26%（GSM）的调用，公共GSM8K上8B/70B节省达39.6%/47.1%，预测精度在±0.13点内，并经物理执行验证节省26.2-36.6%的顺序请求时间、节省41.9%的思考模式生成token，所有固定预算输出均得到保持。

Conclusion: 本文建立的有限预算可恢复性框架将LLM投票的发现、恢复、选择与锁定分离为五个独立事件，为何时何地追加推理调用、何时可安全停止提供了精确判据。错误身份竞争而非单纯错误频率决定终点结果，输入置换等表征多样化策略具有可观收益，但与选择器强耦合。精确决策锁定作为一个无需金标准、适用于依赖响应与弃权的证书，可在不改变任何固定预算输出的前提下稳定节省大量推理资源，为测试时计算提供了理论基础与实用工具。

Abstract: Voting over multiple LLM responses is a common primitive in test-time scaling and ensemble inference. Collecting more responses can expand the candidate pool and increase the chance that a correct answer is discovered. Under a fixed call budget, a discovered answer still needs to accumulate enough support within the remaining calls to become the final plurality winner, creating a discovery-to-decision gap. In this work, we characterize this gap through the realized vote state and remaining call budget. We derive a sharp recoverability threshold and show that, as sampling proceeds, the observed candidate set can only expand while the set of reachable endpoint winners can only contract, inducing a candidate-level conversion window. Under a specified iid response law, the same state yields exact finite-horizon endpoint probabilities. We further show that merging wrong-answer identities preserves single-call correctness and cannot improve plurality accuracy, and that the effect of redistributing wrong-answer probability depends on the realized vote state. Singleton reachability yields a gold-free exact locking certificate. For a known answer universe, its first trigger is the earliest prefix at which all admissible continuations yield the same fixed-budget output. Empirically, most discovered-but-unselected correct answers lose reachability only after discovery. In a controlled Word16 study, input permutation improves raw-plurality accuracy by 21.1 points with essentially unchanged single-call correctness. Exact locking saves 28-30% of calls at a 16-call budget while preserving every fixed-budget output.

</details>


### [194] [Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01017)
*Xuehang Guo,Haoyu Wang,Shengyu Chen,Zach Chen,Wei Cheng,Qingyun Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出InFlowOp框架，通过统一的标签无关成本度量实现多智能体工作流的构建与流程内优化，并构建了需要多智能体协作的Braid基准测试，在多个领域和模型上显著超越单智能体基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多智能体工作流构建面临两大挑战：(1) 在不确定性下如何良好构建工作流——任务分解粒度、专家智能体分配及新专家创建的决策均需预先确定；(2) 如何低成本地优化工作流——定位故障通常需要参考答案、评分结果或训练评估器，而修复需对整个工作流进行重执行、重搜索或重训练。此外，现有工作流评测基准多在单智能体即可解决的任务上，无法有效衡量多智能体协作的必要性。

Method: 提出InFlowOp两阶段框架：(1) 构建阶段——通过统一的标签无关成本（智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度 vs 运行成本）构建成本矩阵，采用双向成本驱动的原子合并（Coalesce）：自顶向下原子分解 + 自底向上按成本合并，确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，无合适智能体时创建新专家；(2) 流程内动态优化阶段——执行中检测每个子任务是否违反其契约（输入/输出条件），通过成本排序的阶梯（先重分配、再重分解）在故障处局部修正，仅重做受影响的闭包，不丢失已有执行进度。提出Braid基准：包含19个评测臂、8个领域，通过分布式与锚定两种组合方式构造需要多智能体协调的任务，并设有分离、路由、泄露、可答性四项质量控制。

Result: 在8个领域、6个模型骨干（Qwen3.5 4B/9B、GPT-5-mini/5.4-mini/5.4/5.6-luna）上的评测显示：InFlowOp相比单LLM基线提升最高+21.90%，相比单智能体基线（匹配计算预算下）提升+7.15%至+11.97%，其中流程内优化贡献+9.64%。消融实验表明：(1) 简单的贪心分解构建工作流（15.49%）甚至低于单智能体（17.38%），说明增益来自"如何分解"而非"是否分解"；(2) 动态成本矩阵优于静态（+2.55%~+3.15%），动态智能体池优于静态（+3.29%~+4.49%）；(3) 成功记录驱动的演化画像有效，失败记录反而损害性能；(4) 全局定位局部化几乎不触发且会降低精度（-1.41%~-1.63%）；(5) Best-of-N（4倍计算）始终低于InFlowOp。

Conclusion: 本文证明了用一个标签无关的成本度量同时驱动工作流构建与流程内优化是可行且高效的：构建阶段让分解粒度成为成本的产出而非预设；优化阶段以故障而非工作流为单位付费，使工作流永远不会比构建出来的更差。Braid基准填补了工作流级评测的空白，验证了多智能体协作在真正需要协作的任务上的必要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [195] [Beyond Final Accuracy: Auditing Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01042)
*Shixuan Li,Wei Yang,Peiyu Zhang,Anzhe Cheng,Heng Ping,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一个名为ICR（Independent–Communicate–Revise）的受控评估框架，用于审计LLM多智能体系统中的通信行为。研究通过将通信效果分解为"纠错率"（CR）和"保持率"（PR），并设置无消息基线控制来分离通信增益与单纯推理增益，在四个推理基准上揭示了文本与潜在通信之间被聚合准确率所掩盖的不同修订行为模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统性能提升存在根本性的归因模糊：难以区分这些提升究竟来自有效的通信、有利的智能体架构，还是仅仅来自额外的推理。同时，最终准确率将"被纠正的错误"和"被破坏的正确答案"混合为单一结果，掩盖了通信如何改变决策的过程。因此需要一个能够分离这些因素的评估方法。

Method: ICR框架包含三个阶段：(1)独立生成与缓存——智能体独立解题并冻结初始记录；(2)通信与修订——构造从发送者到接收者的定向修订事件，固定初始轨迹不变；(3)审计修订结果——按收发双方初始正确性的四种状态分层计算指标：纠错率CR（错接收者+对发送者）、保持率PR（对接收者+错发送者）、两者皆错的恢复率SR、两者皆对的保持率SCR。设置No Message控制来量化额外推理的贡献。使用选择指数SI=(CR+PR)/2作为汇总统计量。在四个基准（MedQA、ARC-C、GSM8K、GPQA-D）和HumanEval+上评估文本通信（No Message、Answer Only、Full Text）与潜在通信（StateBridge、LatentMAS）。还比较了两种接收者策略（Critical Evaluation与Structured Verification）。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1)聚合准确率能掩盖截然不同的CR-PR轮廓——Full Text的高纠错常伴随显著的破坏，StateBridge的强保持伴随错过纠错机会；(2)相比仅传输答案，完整推理在所有四个基准上都增加了纠错但降低了保持，即更丰富的消息同时放大了有益和有害影响；(3)在MedQA和GPQA-D上，结构化验证策略使所有通道向更高保持和更低纠错移动，但选择性变化随通道和任务而异；(4)两者皆错的恢复率很低（0.30%-2.55%），表明没有正确同伴时纠错难以发生；(5)GSM8K上四个修订条件的估计全集准确率仅差0.11个百分点，但PR差异达27.17个百分点。

Conclusion: 通信质量不能被视为通道的内在属性，而应被视为消息内容、传递接口和接收者策略联合作用的结果。ICR框架通过将评估重新定位为选择性修订，提供了一个统一的框架来审视消息内容和接收者策略如何共同产生收益和危害，挑战了将聚合准确率作为多智能体系统通信效果评价指标的充分性。

Abstract: Multi-agent communication aims to help agents benefit from one another's information. Yet improvements in system performance leave a fundamental ambiguity: do they reflect effective communication, a favorable agent architecture, or simply additional reasoning? Because communication methods are commonly evaluated within the systems they were designed for, these factors are difficult to disentangle. Final accuracy further merges corrected errors and corrupted answers into a single outcome, obscuring how communication changes decisions. We introduce Independent--Communicate--Revise (ICR), a controlled framework that evaluates communication as answer revision following independent reasoning. ICR fixes initial reasoning trajectories, measures correction and preservation conditional on both agents' initial correctness, and uses a no-message revision control to quantify gains beyond additional reasoning. Across four reasoning benchmarks, our audit of textual and latent communication reveals that similar aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behaviors. Compared with transmitting answers alone, full reasoning increases correction while reducing preservation on all four benchmarks, so richer messages amplify beneficial and harmful influence alike. Receiver-policy comparisons on MedQA and GPQA-D further show that a structured verification policy shifts every channel toward greater preservation and lower correction, while its effect on selectivity varies across channels and tasks. These findings challenge treating communication quality as an intrinsic property of a channel. ICR therefore recenters evaluation on selective revision, providing a unified framework for examining how message content and receiver policies jointly produce benefits and harms.

</details>


### [196] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"空洞承诺"(Empty Commitment)概念,指智能体在当前轮次承诺的某个超出本轮的action,其工具集和运行时根本无法执行该承诺。与"毁诺"不同,空洞性仅从智能体的配置即可判定,无需后续轨迹。作者基于承诺语义学给出形式化定义,区分三类失败(capability/temporal/agentive)、"锚定"条件,以及响应级结果分类,并设计了一个通过五个逐步增加持久性affordance的实验装置来测量空洞承诺率的协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体常以"明天提醒你""构建完成后通知你""下次记住"等方式承诺跨越会话的行为,但这些承诺是否可行取决于部署环境(是否有调度器、记忆库等)。先前工作关注事后是否毁诺、是否夸大已完成的工作,却忽略了"承诺在说出瞬间就根本不可能"这一更前置的问题。论文基于Searle言语行为理论,提出承诺预设说话者具备执行能力这一条件常常被违反,亟需一个可从配置直接判定的诊断框架。

Method: (1) 形式化定义:在Singh承诺六元组⟨x,y,φ,α,ρ,δ⟩基础上,定义affordance集ΦA(工具+四项持久性属性:轮后运行、定时调度、跨会话记忆、第三方委托)。(2) 失败三型:capability(无工具能做α)、temporal(α落在agent不运行且无法调度的时点)、agentive(需第三方但无法委托)。(3) 锚定条件:当存在启用工具时,agent在同轮调用它才为anchored,否则为unanchored。(4) 结果分类:false_claim / empty / unanchored / anchored / done_now / over_refusal / deferral / other。(5) 测量协议:五个装置C0–C4分别对应无工具→加调度器→加记忆→加工单委托,各分inferred/stated两种变体、两类persona,共20种条件,辅以单轮请求、五类任务和确定性规则+LLM判定器。

Result: 论文为框架/协议阶段,尚未报告多模型评估的实证结果。提出待回答的四个开放问题:(Q1)持久性未声明时各结果分布及主导失败类型;(Q2)启用工具存在时模型多常承诺却不调用;(Q3)声明环境能否降低失败率及带来多少over_refusal;(Q4)在公开的tool-less智能体日志中此类承诺有多普遍。结论强调承诺质量受限于运行时,协议为单轮+mock工具,LLM标签需人审,多模型评估正在进行中。

Conclusion: 智能体对未来的承诺仅与其运行时能力相当。论文定义并区分了空洞承诺、虚假action声明和未锚定承诺,这些都可从一轮响应与部署配置中直接判定。其测量协议(单轮、mock工具、20种条件)使该现象可被系统性度量,为后续多模型基准评估提供了可复现的脚手架,并提醒社区:"声明运行环境"既可能降低失败率,也可能引发过度拒绝,需要在评估中同时追踪以避免假性修复。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [197] [Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01048)
*Rishab Alagharu,Hongji Pu,Zeeshan Memon,Xinyuan Song,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Network World Model（网络世界模型），将LLM编码代理与图神经网络仿真器结合，用于复杂网络上的算法自动设计。该模型作为快速评估器，支持在八个网络任务上设计算法，在141个设置中138个达到或超过最强基线，且比蒙特卡洛仿真快多达14.5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂网络（如社交、传染病网络）中，选择干预措施（如种子节点、疫苗接种）需评估长期扩散结果，而蒙特卡洛仿真成本高昂，成为算法迭代设计中的瓶颈。现有学习方法通常针对特定任务，缺乏通用性。需要一种既能准确预测干预后网络动态、又能支持算法迭代设计的快速评估环境。

Method: 1) Network World Model：动作条件化的图神经网络仿真器，通过外生干预算子T_exo精确应用动作（修改节点状态、边或权重），再由结构化转移头预测下一步扩散；2) 编码代理搜索循环：以世界模型为评估器，通过完整rollout、动作级credit和反事实probe提供反馈，使用六种算子（crossover、synthesize、from_scratch、refine、parameters、simplify）结合探索-利用调度进行LLM驱动的算法搜索；3) 理论分析：证明算法选择遗憾与转移误差、horizon和搜索次优性的关系，并证明精确干预能消除动作语义误差。

Result: 在八个任务（影响力最大化、自适应影响力最大化、关键节点检测、影响力阻断、传染病控制、源定位、级联重建、级联预测）和五种扩散模型（IC、LT、CLT、SIR、SIS）上，设计的算法在141个设置中的138个匹配或超过最强基线；世界模型rollout速度比蒙特卡洛仿真快4-14.5倍；在网络Science上三个不同LLM（GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna）结果接近，表明提升不依赖于特定编码模型。

Conclusion: 学习得到的网络动态能够支持可靠的算法选择，并可将学习动力学从单纯预测扩展到跨多种任务的复杂网络算法迭代设计与评估。

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [198] [Improving Math Reasoning through Value-guided Informative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01080)
*Shaohuai Liu,Yuning Wu,Haoran Liu,Enzo Jia,Devin Chen,Kai Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出APIVIS框架，将有限预算的Gumbel搜索作为chunk级数学推理的策略改进算子融入RLVR训练流程，通过混合直接与搜索响应的rollout组以及选择性监督（InfoSFT）解决搜索带来的多样性无法保证策略改进以及组内奖励一致时GRPO学习信号消失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR（如GRPO）依赖rollout多样性产生组内相对优势，但独立采样常产生表面变异的相似推理路径；当组内奖励完全相同时，组内相对优势消失，GRPO梯度为零。已有方法将搜索引入RLVR以增加多样性，但多样性本身并不能保证搜索诱导的rollout策略优于当前策略，也未提供策略改进的理论保证。

Method: APIVIS包含三个核心组件：(1) 将推理过程分解为变长chunk（以双换行、答案标签或EOS为边界），将Gumbel sequential halving应用于chunk级搜索，由冻结的价值模型（DeepSeek-VM-1.5B）评估候选前缀；(2) 混合策略rollout组——每组包含3个直接采样响应和3个搜索生成响应，搜索找到的改进产生组内对比信号；(3) 选择性监督InfoSFT——仅对价值改进的搜索chunk施加SFT损失，当GRPO组梯度为零时仍可提供学习信号。理论方面证明了在精确价值函数下，值引导选择保证状态级和完整响应的策略改进；在价值估计误差有界（|Q̂−Q^π|≤ε）下，至多K个搜索状态的性能下降不超过2Kε。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B-Base和Qwen3-4B-Base上的实验显示，APIVIS在MATH-500、AIME-2024、AIME-2025和OlympiadBench四个基准上的平均Avg@16分别为27.79%和40.02%，分别比GRPO提升2.53和3.20个百分点，超过LATR、TS-LLM和MCTS-alpha等搜索基线。消融实验表明Gumbel搜索算子比MCTS-alpha在同一布局下提升3.03点，InfoSFT进一步贡献0.70点。搜索chunk预算K=10时效果最优（40.02%），K=5和20分别为39.20%和39.84%，呈非单调关系。训练统计显示搜索响应比直接响应的终端奖励分别高6.30%（1.7B）和5.41%（4B）。计算成本方面，APIVIS在4B规模上需要160.51 GPU小时，约为GRPO（50.57）的3.2倍。

Conclusion: APIVIS首次将chunk级值引导Gumbel搜索作为RLVR中的策略改进算子，在理论和实验上证明了搜索可以保证优于当前策略的rollout分布，且通过选择性监督解决了组奖励一致时的可学习性问题。局限性包括价值模型冻结（不随策略更新）、单轮数学任务的评估范围、单训练种子的实验设置，以及未完全解耦混合组构建的独立贡献。未来工作方向包括协同训练价值模型与策略、监控候选排序质量作为价值模型重训信号，以及将APIVIS扩展到多轮推理任务。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the mathematical reasoning capabilities of large language models. Recent work introduces search into RLVR rollouts to increase trajectory diversity, but diversity alone does not ensure that the search-induced rollout policy improves upon the current policy. To address this gap, we propose APIVIS, a training-time framework that adapts finite-budget Gumbel search to chunk-level mathematical reasoning. APIVIS combines direct and searched responses within each rollout group, allowing improvements found by search to produce informative relative rewards. It further applies selective supervision to search-improved tokens, preserving a learning signal when uniform group rewards render GRPO ineffective. We show that exact value-guided selection improves the expected verifier reward at each searched state and that this guarantee extends to the complete rollout policy, with a corresponding approximate guarantee under bounded value-estimation error. Experiments on widely recognized mathematical reasoning benchmarks and different model scales demonstrate substantial improvements over competitive search-based methods, validating the effectiveness of APIVIS.

</details>


### [199] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: YouRA 是一个面向自主科研 agent 的有状态架构，通过将研究状态、证据指针与失败历史作为持久化结构外部化，解决端到端科研 agent 中论文主张与实际实验脱节的问题。在 MLR-Bench 的 10 任务子集上，三个匹配 backbone 下 YouRA 在总体评分上均优于 MLR-Agent 和 AI Scientist V2，且消融实验证实四个核心组件各自独立贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端自主科研 agent 已可生成完整论文，但论文中的断言常与实际执行的实验脱节。该差距是结构性的：研究状态、失败历史与断言-证据对齐在长流程中未作为持久化、可验证的状态被维护。具体表现为：上下文与证据碎片化（状态隐式嵌于对话历史，易截断/幻觉）；缺乏结构化失败记忆（约 80% 的 case 出现伪造实验结果）；不可靠的工作流控制（任务执行与流程决策共享同一对话）。三项局限均根源于研究轨迹未作为显式持久化结构跨流程维护。

Method: YouRA 由三个核心组件构成：(1) Verification State Architecture (VSA)：基于 YAML 的中心化状态文件，记录假设、门控结果、路由决策与证据指针，满足门驱动推进、可审计历史、研究者指令即状态变更三条不变式；(2) Independent Controller：独立 LLM 上下文（GPT-5.2），消费 VSA 与反思记录以驱动生命周期转换、恢复升级与多角色辩论/审查，将控制与任务执行解耦；(3) Stateful Reflection：将失败记录为结构化课程，并通过三级路由（有界修复、假设重设、问题重置）执行恢复。流程含 10 个阶段（问题界定→文献接地→假设辩论→验证规划→假设循环（实验设计→实现规划→编码与验证）→证据检查→手稿起草→对抗式事实审查→手稿精修），由 Claude Code 作为执行宿主，集成 Archon/Exa/Semantic Scholar/Serena/Clear Thought 五个 MCP 工具。假设辩论采用六角色协议（Dr. Nova/Prof. Vera/Dr. Sage/Prof. Pax/Dr. Ally/Prof. Rex），最多 20 轮。评估使用 MLR-Bench 预定义 10 任务子集，三个 backbone（Sonnet 4.5/Opus 4.5/Sonnet 4.6），四评审 panel（Grok 4.3/GPT-5.4/Gemini 3.1 Pro/Claude Opus 4.6），并辅以基于 MLR-Bench 幻觉分类法的自动化诊断与双分析器（Opus 4.6 与 GPT-5.4）的数据来源诊断。

Result: 端到端总体评分：YouRA 在 30 个匹配 (backbone, task) 单元上，配对符号翻转置换检验显示 YouRA vs MLR-Agent ΔOverall=+0.85（p=0.006，Holm 校正后 p=0.012），vs AI Scientist V2 ΔOverall=+0.64（p=0.044，Holm 校正后 p=0.044），三个 backbone 均为正向。幻觉诊断：自动化标记精度 75.2%（Wilson 95% CI [69.7%, 80.0%]），精度-校正后 YouRA 与 AI Scientist V2 无统计差异（p=0.571），均显著优于 MLR-Agent（p=0.003）。数据来源：保守双分析器口径下 YouRA 27/30 真实数据，AI Scientist V2 17/30，MLR-Agent 11/30。消融：四个组件（MCP/Reflection/VSA/Independent Controller）任一移除均显著降低 Overall（Holm 校正后 p≤0.007），drop 量分别为 −1.13/−0.87/−1.13/−1.12，但两两对比 drop 大小无显著差异（所有 Holm 校正后 p=1.000），无法可靠排序组件重要性。操作遥测：30 任务共产生 86 次存档级路由事件，其中 5 次重设假设、81 次问题重置，骨干越强（如 Sonnet 4.6）补偿越多但无法完全弥补组件缺失。Idea/Proposal 上游阶段 201 任务对比中，MLR-Agent 在 Sonnet 4.5 下 Idea 阶段 Overall 显著更高（Δ=−0.35，p=0.001），与端到端结果形成对比。

Conclusion: YouRA 通过将研究状态、执行证据与失败历史外部化为显式持久化结构，缓解了自主科研 agent 中论文主张与实验脱节的根本问题。VSA、独立控制器与状态化反思三者缺一不可（移除任一核心状态组件在两个 backbone 上使 YouRA 低于两个基线）。人类验证的幻觉计数与数据来源诊断共同表明，YouRA 的分数优势并非源自更多捏造内容。然而标量端到端评分本身无法区分质量提升与更具说服力的伪造，必须配合诊断手段核验论文主张与执行证据的对应关系。局限：实验限于 ML/DL 任务；评测采用与原 MLR-Bench 不同的评审 LLM；评审上下文长度限制可能对代码/日志密集论文不利；系统间工具配置与 token 预算不可比，亟需统一资源约束下的标准基准。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: this https URL .

</details>


### [200] [Beyond State-of-the-Art: Standardising Environmental Impact Metrics for AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01116)
*Lachlan McGinness,Dan Pagendam,Robert Offner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对AI研究中缺乏环境影响的标准化报告这一问题，基于对NeurIPS 2025全部5,285篇论文的自动化文献综述，提出了一套标准化的可持续性度量方法、LLM推理碳排放估算启发式，以及"最小完成任务模型(SMAJ)"框架，并开源了相关工具包carbonbenchmark。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能力与普及度不断增长，但其环境足迹（碳排放）却鲜有报告。AI研究界缺乏标准化的碳核算实践，仅约1%的NeurIPS 2025论文提及可持续性，亟需建立统一的报告标准与效率评估框架，以遏制以环境代价换取边际精度提升的做法。

Method: 1) 对NeurIPS 2025的5,285篇接收论文进行自动化文献综述，使用8个LLM提取LLM使用、计算成本报告、碳足迹提及等指标，通过一致性分析与GLMM+Dunnett检验选出最小模型(Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite)完成全量标注；2) 理论层面提出基于学习曲线的训练可持续性指标k（指数模型、延迟指数模型）与α、β（幂律模型），通过最小二乘拟合（scipy.optimize.curve_fit）从训练曲线中提取；3) 定义SMAJ框架：先找到HP模型，再筛选落入其不确定度范围内的可接受模型集，最后取其中计算成本最低者；4) 基于Kaplan公式(FLOPs=2nN)结合NVIDIA能效数据与美国平均电网碳强度(0.384 kg/kWh)给出推理碳估算公式。开发carbonbenchmark工具包，集成codecarbon实现端到端测量与报告。

Result: 文献综述显示约40%论文使用LLM，40%报告了某种形式的计算成本，但仅约1%提及可持续性。理论证明指数与幂律学习曲线模型均无一般闭式解析解（依赖Abel-Ruffini不可能定理）。实验验证k值越高，训练所需CO2越少，幂律模型拟合最佳，延迟指数模型次之。碳转换系数约为5.67×10⁻²⁰ kg CO₂/FLOP；以n=5×10¹⁰估算，2100亿token约对应1200 kg CO₂。本研究自身排放2.49 kg CO₂。

Conclusion: 作者提出三项核心建议：(1) AI企业应公开基础模型碳足迹，特别是活跃参数n等关键信息；(2) 所有研究论文应强制报告CO₂排放，并将k值作为训练碳效率基准；(3) 倡导"SMAJ"取代"SotA"成为新的研究目标范式，优先考虑计算效率与环境问责。同时承认以CO₂作为评估指标可能对电网较脏或硬件较差的地区研究者不公平，未来需引入更公平的多维度指标（FLOPs、水耗、能源结构等），并将carbonbenchmark扩展至更多领域与模型规模。

Abstract: As the capabilities and ubiquity of Large Language Models (LLMs) grow, so does their environmental footprint. Despite calls for responsible AI, the machine learning community lacks standardised practices for carbon accounting. Our automated literature review of the 5,285 papers accepted to NeurIPS 2025 reveals that reporting of environmental impact is nearly non-existent. To catalyse a shift toward sustainable AI, we define standardised sustainability metrics for evaluating model training efficiency, accompanied by simple heuristics to estimate the carbon cost of LLM inference. We implement these metrics in carbonbenchmark, a drop-in software solution for tracking and reporting emissions. Finally, to combat the pursuit of marginal accuracy gains at disproportionate environmental costs, we formalise the `Smallest Model that Achieves the Job' (SMAJ), a framework which challenges the field to prioritise computational efficiency and environmental accountability alongside traditional `State-of-the-Art' (SotA) accuracy.

</details>


### [201] [AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01119)
*Zhicheng Feng,Yubo Zhao,Xuefeng Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为AbsorbEvo的智能体框架，用于微波吸收体的自主逆向设计。该框架能够将自然语言描述的性能目标转化为设计方案，并通过全波仿真进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能微波吸收体的设计需要电磁理论、材料科学和仿真编程方面的专业知识，且优化过程耗时。因此需要一种自动化、专家化的逆设计方法，降低设计门槛并提高效率。

Method: 采用候选进化策略（candidate evolution strategy），结合语言推理、基于物理的预测和历史反馈。具体包括：(1) 大语言模型根据任务目标和计算历史提出参数调整的方向和幅度；(2) 将定向增量与全局采样结合生成候选设计；(3) 使用低成本预测模型作为物理先验对候选进行排序；(4) 仅对高排名设计进行全波仿真；(5) 通过物理有效性检查的结果用于评估性能并指导后续搜索；(6) 从训练任务中提炼文本技能（textual skills），在新任务中独立验证后使用。

Result: 在相同的提案预算下，在留出的AbsorbBench-36任务上的评估结果：任务成功率方面，AbsorbEvo达到79.17%，而通用智能体为25.00%，随机搜索仅为12.50%；平均最佳覆盖率方面，AbsorbEvo为0.7816，通用智能体为0.6434，随机搜索为0.6448。

Conclusion: 通过将语言推理和基于物理的反馈集成到设计决策中，AbsorbEvo为微波吸收体的自然语言驱动自主逆向设计提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience from training tasks is further distilled into textual skills, which are independently validated before use in new tasks. Under identical proposal budgets on held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved a task success rate of 79.17%, versus 25.00% for a generic agent and 12.50% for random search. Its mean best coverage was 0.7816, compared with 0.6434 and 0.6448, respectively. By integrating language reasoning and physics-based feedback into design decisions, AbsorbEvo provides a methodological foundation for natural-language-driven autonomous inverse design of microwave absorbers.

</details>


### [202] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CortexBridge 是一种轻量级适配器，将任意EEG导联布局映射到共享的皮层潜在空间，解决EEG基础模型在不同蒙太奇之间迁移困难的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型通常基于固定的通道词汇或有限的导联布局进行预训练，当电极配置变化时迁移困难。头皮坐标驱动的方法仍停留在传感器空间，缺乏跨蒙太奇的统一解剖学表征。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 坐标感知的皮层传输（coordinate-aware cortical transport），通过多头交叉注意力结合EEG统计特征与电极/图谱坐标生成稀疏的电极到ROI路由矩阵W；(2) 更深层的皮层潜在空间建模，利用多尺度高斯核扩散和可学习的潜在查询将R=300个Schaefer图谱ROI池化为L=64个潜在通道；(3) 基础模型适配，通过残差门控接口将原始信号与皮层表征注入冻结的预训练编码器，仅训练约0.1M参数。

Result: 在三个冻结基础模型（EEGPT、LaBraM、CBraMod）和五个MOABB数据集上，15次评估中13次获得提升。EEGPT平均提升0.80%，LaBraM提升0.70%，CBraMod提升3.26%。最大提升出现在CBraMod的12类SSVEP分类（Nakanishi2015）上，达13.02%。可视化显示SSVEP表征在Yeo视觉网络中更集中，验证了任务相关的空间组织。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐可作为异构EEG蒙太奇到预训练基础模型之间可学习且具有解剖学依据的路由机制，提供跨基础模型的通用、解剖索引化的接口。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [203] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将指令微调大语言模型嵌入到六个Snowdrop支持的DSGE模拟器中进行货币政策生成与预测的强化学习框架。通过PPO（带学习价值函数）与GRPO（无critic的组相对基线）的对比实验，重点研究多回合长期信用分配问题，并结合语义位移条件、奖励几何设计、轨迹预热和跨模拟器迁移等消融实验，验证基于模拟经济后果而非语言流畅性来评判政策行动的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型可以生成语言流畅的经济政策建议，但这并不能保证其行动与经济动态一致。本文旨在通过将LLM置于DSGE模拟器闭环中，使政策生成成为基于模拟后果的重复控制问题，而非单次语言生成。重点解决两个问题：政策传导延迟导致的多回合信用分配难题，以及即时行动惩罚可能导致的"不作为低谷"探索难题。

Method: 1. 构建统一的Python RL接口封装六个Snowdrop DSGE模型（QPM、SW、GSW、Ireland、MVF、RBC），支持状态克隆、持久冲击、滚动预测和不可逆转移；2. 采用Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct作为策略模型，4-bit量化+LoRA适配；3. 使用PPO（γ=0.99, λ=0.95, clip=0.2, 4个epoch）作为主方法，GRPO（每prompt采样4条轨迹）作为匹配基线；4. 通过变换器编码器将连续话语窗口编码为方向性语义状态s_t=[z_t; (z_t-z_{t-1})/||z_t-z_{t-1}||; cos(z_t,z_{t-1})]作为噪声冲击观测；5. 奖励函数为r_t = c·tanh(Δ_t) - ρ||u_t||² - p_invalid - p_semantic，其中Δ_t为归一化损失改进；6. 通过基于规则的随机化策略生成轨迹预热库；7. 使用McKibbin-Fernando COVID-19情景和ECB Jarociński-Karadi冲击作为外部验证。

Result: 1. 模拟器验证：QPM单位名义利率冲击和SW多冲击测试均产生预期的非平凡转移；2. 信用分配诊断：PPO的critic可通过GAE将终端奖励传播到前序token，而vanilla GRPO在组内回报相同时归一化优势为零；3. 奖励校准诊断：揭示了"奖励视野反转"现象——短期得分恶化但长期稳定的干预可能被错误评估；4. 提出六个研究问题对应的六个假设；5. 确认性表格使用TBD占位符，待重跑日志填充，未声称具体数值结果。

Conclusion: 本文将政策生成重新定义为与显式经济模型的重复交互，核心贡献是通用控制接口而非新DSGE模型。LLM选择有界动作，模拟器决定其条件后果，下一决策从已提交经济状态开始。实验设计分离了主要主张：PPO vs GRPO测试多回合信用分配；奖励与视野消融测试经济目标；轨迹预热测试探索；语义与跨模拟器消融测试策略是否使用方向性语言及在结构假设间迁移的能力。最终评判标准不是政策听起来是否令人信服，而是其在显式模型假设下能否改善明确报告的经济结果。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation. This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [204] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文审计了LLM智能体环境中并发动作的提交（settlement）机制,实现了类型化的快照-合同,并测试顺序敏感度、有效进展和回复一致性。在28,800次排列试验与2,160次多步脚本回合中,五种排他性策略（联合拒绝、顺序、随机抽奖、循环槽位与固定ID）被保持相互竞争。关键发现:在六智能体门口任务中,保守拒绝仅使31.25%的智能体完成,而随机抽奖达到90.28%（配对差异55.03个百分点,95%自助区间50.00-68.06）。所有策略都保持测试的空间约束,但优先级仲裁仍未能达到独立小实例最优。完整状态日志能精确重放156个检查点,并拒绝了1,332次构建的腐败尝试。该研究仅关注空间执行而非社会公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 并发动作在LLM智能体环境中需要冲突处理,即使每个代理的动作单独有效。研究目标是审计代理动作的提交机制,验证顺序不变性、约束保持与可重现性,为多智能体模拟的实验设计提供精确证据。

Method: 1. 类型化合同与作用域空间不变性论证（基于slot-journal contract与快照-合同）；2. 五种受限的公正性策略：联合拒绝、顺序优先、固定ID、随机抽奖与循环槽位；3. 独立可行性子集预言机与保留多步压力条件；4. 序列化状态重放与错误注入与明确信任限制；5. 使用24个正式种子、三种任务家族、多负载与五种策略的脚本机制测试（2,160回合）；6. 28,800次穷尽置换试验（8个六智能体原型×720顺序×5策略）；8. 回归审计与完整状态重放审计（检查序列号/状态哈希/反向检查）。

Result: 1. 标准布局六智能体门口任务中,拒绝完成率31.25%,顺序89.58%,固定ID 91.67%,随机抽奖90.28%,循环槽位88.89%；2. 随机抽奖50000百分点的改进（自助区间50.00-68.06）；3. 所有策略保持测试的空间约束；4. 156个检查点与12个最终状态被完全重放,1,332个越界被拒绝；5. 顺序不变性需以固定优先级为前提,但优先级仲裁仍未能达到独立预言机最优（120例中,拒绝465,顺序895,固定ID895,拟随机888,循环887）；6. 全智能体完成率分别为0%/50%/62.5%/62.5%/50%；8. LLM五条目代理运行均无尾随季节。

Conclusion: 顺序不变性、约束保持、进展与重放是不同特性。优先级在脚本瓶颈中提升进展,但不保证最优或公平。重放仅证明一致性而非真实性。代理在受限空间任务与未明示债权人公平转移限制了公平转移。本研究不声称人类有效性、广泛公平优势或公平转移仅关注空间执行机制。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [205] [ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01140)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Xi Zhu,Weizhi Zhang,Minghao Guo,Ye Li,Hamid Palangi,Jiaxuan You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReSolve提出了一种无需训练的选择性生成式调解推理框架，通过复用已生成候选解的推导过程而非简单投票聚合答案，在130道竞赛数学题上将四候选投票准确率从91-92提升至99-100，且相比八样本自洽性减少46-47%的token消耗，但未确立对额外采样的准确率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自洽性等方法在采样多个解时仅基于最终答案投票，丢弃了中间推导和不完整论证中的有用推理。论文提出将已生成的候选推导视为可复用的推理计算资源，在候选答案分歧或缺失时通过生成式调解恢复有用工作，而非盲目增加独立采样。

Method: ReSolve采用无需训练的选择性生成式调解策略：(1) 采样4个候选解；(2) 控制器根据答案直方图划分为5种状态（无答案、一致、主导答案、两组对立、碎片化分歧）；(3) 仅在分歧或无答案时调用同一Qwen3-4B模型读取候选推导并进行调解（最多3次调用）；(4) 实施接受规则和稳定性检查。包含完全推理过程为输入的Full版本与仅保留答案键和投票数的Answer-only消融、通用验证指令的Uniform消融、始终调用always-on控制等进行对比。

Result: 在130道竞赛数学题（AIME24/25、CMIMC25、HMMT25各30/30/40/30题）的两个独立候选池F2/F3上：Hybrid评分下ReSolve正确100/99题，四候选投票91/92题，八样本自洽性94/96题，统一调解97/99题；相比SC@4的16次修复无破坏；相比SC@8节省46.3%和47.2%的token；移除可见推导后准确率降至93；选择性调用相比始终调用节省约54%调解token；统计检验显示对SC@4显著（combined p=0.0003），对SC@8不显著（p=0.093），对Uniform无显著差异（p=0.51）。

Conclusion: 实验支持将候选推导作为可复用推理计算资源的设计原则，在候选分歧或缺乏答案时读取和扩展已有推导可以恢复投票丢弃的有用工作；可见推导的贡献和选择性调用均有控制实验支持。但未证明对额外采样的准确率优势，未证明特定路由指令的必要性，也未将token节省转化为延迟优势。该方法在数学推理的4B模型上评估，泛化性需进一步验证。

Abstract: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

</details>


### [206] [When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01188)
*Haotian Chen,Jingkun Yu,Yuning Zhang,Bowen Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对基于骨架的动作正确性分类中"特定运动关节选择"带来的增益进行了一次审计式研究。作者使用 REHAB24-6 数据集（10 名受试者、1057 次重复动作）测试了手动选取关节子集相比全关节输入的 AUROC 增益，发现该增益强烈依赖于评估聚合方式、随机对照集合的结构以及分类器选择：在池化跨受试者评估下 kNN 增益为 0.055，但在受试者内评估下仅 0.020，且置信区间包含零；同时在 1000 个维度匹配的随机子集中有 14 个能达到手动选择的效果，若进一步匹配双侧结构和躯干特征则升至 145 个，表明手动选择并无显著优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于骨架的动作正确性分类中，运动特异性关节子集选择常被用作先验知识来提升性能，但这种增益究竟是来自运动学的领域知识，还是来自特征维度缩减、子集结构偏差或评估方式的差异，并不清楚。尤其在小样本受试者队列中，这些混淆因素可能放大虚假的性能提升。作者旨在通过控制变量审计，检验关节选择声称的稳健性。

Method: 方法学核心是"审计式对照设计"：(1) 使用受试者不交叉的 10 折留出协议；(2) 对比两种 AUROC 聚合方式——池化跨受试者排序（$A_P$）与受试者内等权排序（$A_W$）；(3) 生成两类随机参考子集——仅维度匹配（1000 个）与维度+双侧结构+躯干特征均匹配（1000 个）；(4) 加入时间序列控制（帧排序、帧洗牌、统计摘要）；(5) 跨分类器（kNN、LR、RBF-SVM、RF、随机卷积）评估增益；(6) 使用 4999 次配对受试者聚类自助法构建置信区间。

Result: 关键结果包括：(1) kNN 手动子集增益从池化 AUROC 的 0.055 降至受试者内 AUROC 的 0.020，两者 95% CI 均包含零；(2) 1000 个维度匹配随机子集中有 14 个达到手动池化结果，加入结构匹配后升至 145 个（14.5%）；(3) RBF-SVM 是唯一在受试者内仍保持正向增益的模型（0.045, 95% CI [.013, .080]）；(4) LR 和随机卷积模型在受试者内评估下增益为负；(5) 排序和洗牌的时间控制进一步削弱了手动选择优势的物理解释。

Conclusion: 本文的结论是：关节选择带来的性能增益强烈依赖于学习器、排序估计量和参考集合设计。手动关节子集并不具备一致的、超越结构匹配随机子集的优越性。在小样本、领域特定的康复评估场景中，宣称关节选择的临床或方法学价值需要明确估计量定义和结构适当的对照设计；本研究本身不建立新算法或临床获益，外部独立队列的复验是必要前提。

Abstract: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

</details>


### [207] [Federated Agent Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01195)
*Qiang Yang,Zhiqiang Kou,Xueyi Zhang,Dong-Dong Wu,Hanlin Gu,Jing Guo,Yang Liu,Di Jiang,Qian Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出联邦智能体优化（FAO）框架，解决跨组织LLM智能体在保护隐私的同时通过受控信息交换进行协作优化的多目标问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在私有环境中积累大量有价值的经验（任务执行、工具使用、反馈、本地知识），但由于隐私和所有权约束，这些经验被锁定在本地。传统联邦学习仅优化模型参数，而智能体能力涵盖策略、记忆、工具、奖励和结构化知识等多个组件，因此需要一种更广泛的优化范式。

Method: 1）将每个客户端智能体形式化为(π, ℳ, 𝒯, ℛ, 𝒪)五组件结构；2）定义类型化更新Δ_k = (Δ^π, Δ^ℳ, Δ^𝒯, Δ^ℛ, Δ^𝒪)，各块可为空，涵盖向量/文本/结构三种形式；3）建立多目标优化公式，权衡智能体效用、隐私泄漏（通过差分隐私保证或攻击优势度量）和通信成本；4）按被联邦化的智能体组件对方法进行分类（策略、记忆、工具、奖励、结构化知识）；5）建立改进循环Update = ρ∘α，描述从抽象、保护、聚合到本地适应的四阶段过程；6）提出门控适应机制保证个体理性。

Result: 1）提出FAO作为多目标问题，提供了Pareto最优性的两种标量化形式（加权形式与约束形式）的理论保证；2）建立五组件分类法，涵盖15种代表性方法；4）证明通过Hoeffding不等式和并联合界，门控机制能保证Pr[CG_k≥0]≥1−η（确保参与约束不被打破）；3）量化报告各组件通信负载差异约三个数量级（适配器76MB vs 技能补丁99–281KB）。

Conclusion: FAO框架将联邦优化从模型参数扩展到智能体完整能力的协作优化，为跨组织智能体协作提供原则性基础。识别出三大关键挑战：性能-隐私-通信的耦合权衡、异构参与者间的公平贡献与利益分配、联邦收益的可靠评估。论文提出五个未来研究方向：转移能力的可靠可执行性、隐私保护与安全防护、公平贡献与利益分配、可靠评估机制、全生命周期成本建模，共同构建可信联邦智能体系统。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in private environments and accumulate valuable experience from task execution, tool use, feedback, and local knowledge. Yet such experience is distributed across organizations and cannot be directly shared because of privacy and proprietary constraints. Conventional federated learning is insufficient for this setting, as agent capabilities extend beyond model parameters to memory, tools, rewards, skills, and structured knowledge. In this paper, we formulate \textbf{Federated Agent Optimization (FAO)}, which studies how distributed agents can collaboratively improve through controlled information exchange while keeping raw data, complete trajectories, and private knowledge local. We define FAO as a multi-objective problem balancing agent utility, privacy leakage, and communication cost, and organize its optimization space across policy, memory, tool use, reward, and structured knowledge and skills. We further characterize how private experience can be abstracted, protected, aggregated, and adapted into transferable capabilities, providing a unified view of how agents can benefit from one another without direct experience sharing. Finally, we identify the key challenges of FAO and outline several promising directions for future research toward trustworthy federated agent systems.

</details>


### [208] [Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01207)
*Ziyi Chen,Yan Zhang,Jianhui Wei,Daoan Zhang,Zuozhu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DARS提出了一种基于依赖图的步级奖励塑形方法，通过任务谓词及其前置关系建模，将验证、失效和修复事件转化为有符号的逐步奖励，以解决智能体强化学习中仅依赖终态奖励导致的信用分配困难问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端结果奖励对中间步骤贡献几乎无指导作用；基于时间折扣或熵的现有方法忽略了一个关键事实：建立在未修正错误之上的工作是无意义的，而独立分支上的工作仍然有效。失败的回合中所有步骤的未来奖励都为零，无法区分有用进展和错误。

Method: 核心方法DARS将任务进度表示为由前置关系连接的谓词集合（依赖图），由标注器为每步标注验证（V）、失效（B）、修复（P）事件；通过图距离指数衰减计算依赖权重 w_i(t) = e^(-λd_i(t))，定义有向图势能 Φ_G(t) = (1/M)ΣS_i(t)w_i(t)，并以势能变化经裁剪后得到有符号逐步奖励 r̃_t。该奖励通过通用接口嵌入GiGPO的步级通道或token级接口，不改变原有rollout策略与优化器。

Result: 在五类任务上验证：ALFWorld 1.5B上比同预算GiGPO提升+10.0点（96.9% vs 86.9%）；WebShop 7B继续训练后成功率+4.2点、任务分+1.5点；Search-R1共享池QA准确率+4.4点、保留集+2.1点；AEPO+DARS在AIME24/25上达67.5%（+9.6点相对于初始化）；无工具推理在1.7B和4B上均超过OmniOPD。消融实验证明步级信用、依赖衰减（λ=1为合理默认）和图拓扑各自均有贡献。可蒸馏8B标注器在ALFWorld上达到与API标注器相当性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模任务依赖结构提供了一种超越终端奖励的实用信用分配方法。DARS通过依赖图势能将验证、失效与修复事件转化为可审计、有符号的逐步奖励，与现有RL方法正交集成，在代理式与推理任务上均取得一致改进。限制在于未系统探索规模效应，且对谓词与前置关系不明确的任务适用性待验证。

Abstract: When training large language models with reinforcement learning, terminal rewards provide little guidance about which steps matter. Common methods for assigning step credit overlook that work built on uncorrected mistakes is wasted while independent work remains valid. With only a final success/failure reward, every step in a failed episode has zero total future reward, even when it made progress. We propose Dependency-Aware Reward Shaping (DARS), which represents task progress as predicates linked by prerequisite relations and assigns step-level credit over the dependency graph. An annotator marks which predicates each step verifies, invalidates, or repairs. Verified predicates are discounted according to graph distance from the nearest broken prerequisite, while independent predicates are unaffected. Repairs update these weights based on any errors that remain; invalidated predicates need re-verification to regain credit. A fixed potential converts these annotations into signed per-step rewards. A common reward and annotation interface allows DARS to integrate with a range of reasoning and agentic training methods, such as GiGPO and ARPO/AEPO, without changing their rollout strategies or optimizers. Across five task families and models from 1.5B to 8B, DARS improves success by up to 10 points over GiGPO trained with the same budget and harness (ALFWorld), raises the WebShop task score and Search-R1 QA accuracy, complements AEPO's entropy-based training on AIME24/25 with a Python interpreter, and exceeds OmniOPD in controlled tool-free reasoning comparisons at 1.7B and 4B. Ablations show that step-level credit, dependency attenuation, and graph topology each contribute. On ALFWorld, a distilled 8B annotator matches the API annotator, enabling DARS to run efficiently without a frontier judge. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [209] [Reputation, Strategy, and Emotion Effects on Generative AI Cooperation: A Comparison Across Reasoning and Non-Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01222)
*Celso de Melo,Zishan Feng,James Hale,Kazunori Terada,Giorgio Coricelli,Jonathan Gratch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过迭代囚徒困境实验，系统比较了推理型与非推理型前沿生成式AI模型在合作行为上的差异，操纵声誉、策略和情绪三个因素，发现推理模型对策略和声誉的依赖更集中，情绪效应减弱，且博弈论理解力（Potemkin效应）显著降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式AI在经济和社会互动中扮演越来越自主的角色，理解其合作倾向及塑造该倾向的信号变得至关重要。研究旨在探究前沿Gen AI模型如何在社会困境中导航，刻画其异质性合作模式，并评估其促进或损害社会福祉的倾向。

Method: 采用迭代囚徒困境（20轮）实验，3×2×3被试间设计：声誉（负面/未知/正面）×策略（敲诈/慷慨）×情绪（竞争/中性/合作）。使用脚本化的虚拟代理对手，其面部表情基于先前验证的情绪评估范式。研究一测试非推理模型（Claude 3.5、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o），每条件39次运行；研究二测试推理模型（Claude 4.6、Gemini 3、GPT-5.2），每条件10次运行。另引入和谐博弈（合作占严格优势）作为诊断工具检测Potemkin效应。还对开源模型进行了补充测试。

Result: 研究一（非推理模型）：三个因素均显著影响合作——策略（η²ₚ=0.555）影响最大，其次声誉（0.184）和情绪（0.036）；Claude 3.5合作率最高（56.8%），GPT-4o最低（42.9%）；和谐博弈中仅约60%合作率，存在Potemkin效应。研究二（推理模型）：策略（0.844）和声誉（0.252）影响更集中，情绪无主效应；和谐博弈100%合作，Potemkin效应几乎消除；末轮行为异质性显著——Claude 4.6持续合作，GPT-5.2系统末轮背叛，Gemini 3表现条件化。情绪效应减弱并非社会敏感性丧失，而是层级化线索加权策略的体现。

Conclusion: Gen AI模型日益成为复杂但异质的社会行动者，能追踪声誉、战略互惠并解读非言语信号。推理模型对博弈论结构有更深理解，但模型间合作剖面（尤其末轮可利用性）差异显著，凸显开发标准化合作基准对负责任部署的实践价值。不同模型最优合作诱发策略不同，部署前需进行模型特定特征化。

Abstract: As generative AI (Gen AI) systems take on increasingly autonomous roles in economically and socially consequential interactions, understanding their propensity to cooperate -- and the signals that shape this propensity -- has become essential. We examine cooperative behavior in frontier Gen AI models using the iterated prisoner's dilemma, manipulating counterpart reputation (positive, unknown, negative), strategy (extortion vs. generosity), and non-verbal emotional signaling (facial expressions conveying competitive or cooperative appraisals). In a first study with non-reasoning models (Claude 3.5, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o), cooperation was systematically shaped by all three factors, paralleling patterns long documented in human behavioral research, though models varied substantially in how heavily each factor was weighted. A second study with reasoning models (Claude 4.6, Gemini 3, GPT-5.2) revealed a more concentrated reliance on strategy and reputation, a near-elimination of the Potemkin effect observed in non-reasoning models (evidenced by near-uniform cooperation in a diagnostic harmony game), and a more conditional role for emotion consistent with a hierarchical cue-weighting strategy rather than a simple loss of social sensitivity. Reasoning models also showed heterogeneous end-game behavior, ranging from sustained cooperation to systematic last-round defection effect, revealing model-specific exploitability profiles with direct practical relevance for deployment in negotiation and other multi-round interactions. Together, these findings characterize Gen AI models as increasingly sophisticated, though heterogeneous, social actors, and underscore the practical value of developing standardized cooperation benchmarks to inform the responsible deployment of Gen AI in interactive, socially consequential settings.

</details>


### [210] [HHR: Hierarchical Hash Retrieval for Efficient LLM Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01230)
*Lianjun Liu,Tiantian Zheng,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HHR（Hierarchical Hash Retrieval），一种用于高效LLM长上下文推理的粗到细分层哈希检索框架，通过Geometry-Aware Key Routing（GKR）和Learned Hash Projection（LHP）解决哈希检索中汉明距离与注意力相关性失配的问题，在LongBench和RULER基准上超越现有方法，并在128K上下文长度下实现最高3.30倍解码加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哈希稀疏注意力通过将Query和Key编码为二进制码并利用汉明距离选择Key，但存在关键缺陷：Query-Key logits同时依赖方向相似性和特征幅值，而哈希二值化丢弃了幅值信息，引发假阳性（方向相似但logit低的Key被错误保留）和假阴性（logit高但方向差异大的Key被遗漏）两类检索失败。

Method: HHR采用粗到细的两阶段框架。GKR（几何感知关键路由）将Keys分页，通过学习头部级正交变换（Cayley变换参数化）重分布幅值信息以获得更具判别力的页面级logit上界，用recall/precision/align三损失联合训练以早期剪枝低logit页面。LHP（学习哈希投影）在GKR保留的候选集上学习头部级投影矩阵，使用tanh软松弛实现梯度训练，结合检索损失与正交性、位间去相关、位平衡正则化，使汉明距离与Query-Key相关性对齐。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B三种模型上，LongBench平均分达46.96/44.46/45.66，超过SOTA分别1.10/2.82/2.69分；RULER上分别达85.05/76.23/82.71；在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 128K上下文长度下实现3.30×解码加速和2.83×端到端加速；消融实验验证GKR和LHP的互补性及训练开销低（联合训练仅18.93-28.45分钟）。

Conclusion: HHR通过解决哈希二值化丢弃特征幅值的核心问题，在多个LLM和基准上实现了性能与效率的优异权衡，为长上下文LLM推理提供了一种有效的稀疏注意力方案，未来可与KV量化等压缩技术结合进一步提升性能。

Abstract: Efficient long-context inference is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet it poses a severe computational bottleneck. Hash-based retrieval offers an efficient alternative by encoding queries and keys into binary codes and using Hamming distance for key selection. However, this leads to a critical mismatch between Hamming distance and attention relevance. Query-Key logits depend jointly on directional similarity and feature magnitudes, whereas hash binarization discards magnitude information, causing both false-positive retrieval of low-logit keys and false-negative omission of high-logit keys. To address these failures, we propose Hierarchical Hash Retrieval (HHR), a coarse-to-fine framework that progressively improves retrieval accuracy through Geometry-Aware Key Routing (GKR) and Learned Hash Projection (LHP). GKR learns a head-wise orthogonal transformation to redistribute feature magnitudes and derive more discriminative page-level logit bounds, enabling effective pruning of low-logit keys while preserving important candidates. LHP then learns a head-wise projection space that aligns Hamming distance with the true Query-Key relevance ranking for fine-grained retrieval. By combining GKR and LHP, HHR suppresses false positives and recovers false negatives, substantially improving the fidelity of hash-based sparse attention. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that HHR achieves superior performance over existing methods. For example, on LongBench, HHR improves the average score by 1.10 points and, at a context length of 128K, achieves up to a 3.30x decoding speedup and a 2.83x end-to-end speedup for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [211] [Learning to Ask: Information Acquisition for SLM-LLM Collaboration, under a budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01236)
*Yongjun Kim,Xiaoxiao Li,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将 SLM-LLM 协作重新定义为一个信息获取问题：在 API 预算约束下，SLM 作为主要推理者，通过"ask_advisor"工具在推理瓶颈处有针对性地查询黑盒 LLM 顾问（而非委派整个推理过程）。作者提出了一个三阶段 RLVR 训练框架，分别学习何时调用、如何构造自包含的预算感知查询，以及如何整合协作到推理流程中。在数学推理和编程任务上，该方法在性能-成本权衡上优于现有协作基线，并可零成本迁移到其他顾问模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 SLM-LLM 协作方法主要将协作视为计算分配问题（决定哪个模型处理哪部分推理），但在黑盒 API 场景下，问题级路由粒度过粗，细粒度逐步切换又因反复传输完整推理上下文导致输入 token 开销过大。因此需要一种更高效的信息获取方式，让 SLM 在关键瓶颈处进行有针对性的查询，避免重复上下文传输。

Method: 1）将 SLM-LLM 协作形式化为带 API 预算约束的约束优化问题，每条推理轨迹最多调用一次顾问；2）三阶段 RLVR（基于 GRPO）训练框架：阶段1用 SLM 独立成功率作为粗粒度监督信号，训练 SLM 选择性调用；阶段2训练独立的 QMaker 生成自包含、预算感知的查询（包含内容请求和响应指令）；阶段3使用非对称奖励（前/后调用采用不同目标）联合优化 SLM 对完整协作流程的使用。所有阶段使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，顾问使用 4-bit 量化的 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。

Result: 在 MATH500、AMC23、AIME25/26、LiveCodeBench v6 上，相比 FrugalGPT、AutoMix、RouteLLM 等问题级路由方法和 STEER、TRIM 等细粒度协作方法，本方法在低到中等 API 成本下形成更优的准确率-成本 Pareto 前沿；在 AMC23 上甚至超越问题级 Oracle（因为 Oracle 只能为每个问题选择一个模型）。学到的策略展现：(1) 调用率随问题难度正相关（ρ=0.72-0.75），(2) 查询类型随预算从变换型子问题转为完整任务请求，(3) 困难问题中调用位置更早，(4) 编程任务中出现"先求解再咨询"的模式。此外，无需重训练即可迁移到未见过的顾问模型家族。附录还展示了敏感文本过滤实验，敏感感知的 QMaker 将泄漏率从 5.6% 降至 0.1%。

Conclusion: 将 SLM-LLM 协作重新定义为信息获取问题是一个有效且实用的方向，优于传统的计算分配范式。三阶段 RLVR 框架能够学到具有选择性、预算感知且可迁移的协作行为，为成本受限的 SLM-LLM 协作提供了 SLM 中心化的解决思路。未来工作包括多轮交互下的查询策略与 SLM 的协同适应。

Abstract: Collaboration between a small language model (SLM) and a large language model (LLM) offers an opportunity to combine the efficiency of smaller models with the strong reasoning capabilities of larger ones. Existing approaches primarily frame such collaboration as a computation allocation problem, determining which model should handle each portion of the reasoning process. In black-box API-based settings, however, this paradigm can be inefficient due to coarse-grained delegation or repeated transmission of context across model switches. In this work, we instead formulate SLM-LLM collaboration as an information acquisition problem, under an API budget constraint. The SLM remains the primary reasoner and selectively queries a black-box LLM advisor only when needed, issuing targeted queries rather than delegating the reasoning process itself. To realize this strategy, we develop a three-stage RLVR framework that learns whether to call the advisor, how to formulate useful queries, and how to integrate the collaboration into the reasoning process by jointly refining advisor invocation and information use. Across mathematical reasoning and coding tasks, our approach improves the performance--cost tradeoff over existing collaboration baselines and, in some settings, matches or exceeds oracle problem-level routing. Finally, we show that our strategy can transfer to other advisor model families, without further training.

</details>


### [212] [Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graphs for Dynamic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01249)
*Yan Luo,Selim-Antoine Lali,Jeremy Moebel,Iliass Khoutaibi,Ahmadou Aidara,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出动态任务路由（dynamic task routing）评估范式与Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph（RIAG）方法。该方法将六个广泛使用的基准数据集重新封装为带有事件流的动态路由场景，通过确定性解析器选择有效文档版本，并基于版本键缓存进行高效复用。RIAG采用有界的多智能体图（至多四次调用），在31,119个回合和373,428次查询上实现了54.24%的联合路由-回答准确率，调用成本仅为0.62次/查询，显著优于最强基线Debate的32.22%（18.00次/查询）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的推理评估范式将任务固定呈现，无法测试智能体在面对事件流修订（如延迟报告、过期指令、撤销指令）时是否能够正确传播更新、保留未受影响的工作或重建历史任务绑定。因此需要一种新的评估设置来隔离路由决策与内容编辑，并设计能够高效处理可修订事件流的多智能体推理系统。

Method: RIAG由三个核心组件构成：(1) 确定性解析器ρ，根据可见事件前缀和查询时间t，返回在世界时间wt下有效的文档版本，无需模型调用；(2) 基于SHA-256版本键的记忆化模块，仅当文档版本与推理配置完全匹配时复用缓存解；(3) 有界、暴露感知的调用图G=(V,E)，缓存未命中时启动求解器v_s和检查器v_c的独立提交（不互相暴露对方输出），仅在不一致或格式失败时调用审计器v_a和修复器v_r，最多四次调用/文档版本。系统在每次查询时重新计算路由，无训练、无学习路由器，仅使用黑盒模型接口。

Result: 在完整集合上，均匀RIAG达到54.24%联合准确率（100%选择准确率，0.62次调用/查询），异构RIAG达到49.78%（98.81%选择准确率，0.63次调用/查询），均显著优于最强对比方法Debate的32.22%（18.00次调用/查询）。在五种查询类别（baseline、changed、propagation、preservation、historical）上，均匀RIAG保持53.89%-54.50%的稳定准确率，而所有传统方法从baseline到historical下降24-29个百分点。MATH上76.9%的查询通过缓存复用解决，无需新模型调用。解析器可迁移到Graph-of-Agents，在MATH上将选择准确率从58.30-61.12%提升至99.35-99.87%。

Conclusion: RIAG通过将确定性时间解析与任务推理分离，实现了可靠的时间绑定和选择性复用，在六个动态任务路由数据集上以远少于传统方法的调用成本取得了更高的联合准确率。解析器组件可作为可复用前端与其他推理图架构组合。实验表明，准确的任务绑定和时间复用比重复审议或模型多样性更重要；异构模型配置虽增加了响应多样性，但反而降低了最终准确率。该工作为面向可修订事件流的智能体评估与设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Conventional reasoning protocols present a fixed, preselected task, so they cannot test whether an agent propagates relevant updates, preserves unaffected work, or reconstructs a historical task binding. We therefore study \emph{dynamic task routing}, in which an event stream revises task bindings and a system must select the document version valid at each query time before solving it. To study this problem, we repurpose six widely used benchmarks: MMLU, MMLU-Pro, MedMCQA, MATH, GPQA, and HumanEval into 31{,}119 dynamic episodes comprising 373{,}428 temporally categorized queries. This setting exposes a central trade-off: recomputing after every event wastes work, whereas unguarded reuse returns stale conclusions. We introduce the Revision-Aware Independent Agent Graph (RIAG), a bounded multi-agent policy that separates deterministic temporal resolution from task reasoning. RIAG caches solutions by immutable document identity, starts each fresh task with two unexposed attempts, and conditionally invokes audit and repair, using at most four calls per document version. On this collection, homogeneous RIAG achieves 54.24\% joint routing-and-answer accuracy at 0.62 calls/query, compared with 32.22\% at 18.00 calls/query for the strongest comparison method; heterogeneous RIAG reaches 49.78\% at 0.63 calls/query.

</details>


### [213] [DeFA: Dependency-Guided Failure Attribution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01256)
*Bo Deng,Xinlei Zheng,Yi Wei,Kang Zhou,Chongyang Tao,Renzhao Liang,Xuanren Chen,Lifan Guo,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DeFA是一个面向LLM智能体执行轨迹的依赖引导失败归因框架，通过构建事件依赖图和失败传播图来定位决策性错误步骤、负责任的智能体和错误类别，并在Who&When和Who&When Pro基准上达到了最优的归因精度，同时其诊断反馈可将Trace2Skill的下游任务准确率提升6-15个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的执行轨迹中，错误与可见后果之间往往相隔多步，使得精确定位决策性错误步骤成为一项困难任务。现有归因方法多依赖全局判断、顺序检查或二分搜索，难以有效关联分散的证据与错误传播路径，因此需要一种能够同时理解步骤内容和步骤间依赖关系的归因方法。

Method: DeFA首先将轨迹压缩为规范化形式，由LLM归纳协议规则并通过确定性解释器构建协议边集E_p；然后将轨迹划分为多个段，每段结合详细内容和其余段的摘要形成分析视图；在每个段内通过LLM恢复语义依赖（局部边与跨段边），合并为事件依赖图G_c。接着使用候选召回模型识别可能违反任务要求的事件，并通过LLM追踪候选的上下游来源与影响，结合图边与推理边构建失败传播图G_f。最后由裁决LLM结合任务、传播图和证据视图，通过反事实推理比较各候选步骤，输出决策性错误步骤、负责任智能体和错误类别。

Result: 在Who&When基准上，DeFA在三种骨干模型下均取得最高的Agent准确率和精确Step准确率，Step精度相对最强基线提升7.6-9.8个百分点（GLM-5.2下达52.7%）。在Who&When Pro的300条文本轨迹上，Agent和Step准确率同样领先所有骨干模型，Mode准确率在分类对齐方法中最高达34.0-41.0%。在100条多模态轨迹上，Step精度达到78-80%，Mode准确率达49-50%，均优于所有基线。消融实验验证了分段、事件依赖图和失败传播图各自的贡献：移除传播边使Step精度下降12.5个百分点。将DeFA集成至Trace2Skill后，下游SpreadsheetBench任务准确率较原生流水线提升6-15个百分点（平均9.0）。

Conclusion: DeFA通过将协议关系与语义依赖整合为事件依赖图，并进一步构建失败传播图，有效追踪错误的引入、传递和采纳过程，从而实现精准的失败归因。该方法在文本和多模态轨迹上均表现优异，且其诊断反馈可直接驱动智能体技能进化。然而方法依赖于模型对长轨迹中依赖关系的正确解读，在长轨迹上的精确Step准确率仍然有限，且下游效用评估仅限电子表格场景，未来工作需改进长轨迹中的关系识别并拓展诊断反馈的应用范围。

Abstract: Errors in LLM agent executions and their visible consequences can be separated by many steps, making decisive-error localization a matter of understanding both step content and step dependencies. We introduce DeFA, a dependency-guided framework for agent failure attribution. DeFA first combines protocol relations and semantic dependencies into an event dependency graph spanning the trajectory. It then identifies events that may violate task requirements and traces their sources and subsequent effects to construct a failure propagation graph. Finally, DeFA uses step evidence and the steps' roles in failure propagation to identify the decisive error, responsible agent, and error category. To support long trajectories, DeFA partitions executions into segments and combines the current segment's detailed content with summaries of the other segments, giving local diagnosis access to global execution context. Across Who and When and the Who and When Pro text subset, DeFA achieves the highest responsible-agent and exact step accuracy with all evaluated backbones, and the highest failure-mode accuracy among taxonomy-aligned methods on Pro. Further experiments on image and video trajectories demonstrate its applicability to multimodal failure attribution. Ablations support the contributions of segmentation, the event dependency graph, and the failure propagation graph. Using DeFA's diagnostic feedback for skill evolution in Trace2Skill improves downstream task accuracy by 6-15 percentage points over the native pipeline, showing that the diagnoses can also support agent improvement on subsequent tasks.

</details>


### [214] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对电气工程大班教学中反馈不及时的难题，设计并试点了一款基于生成式AI的即时脚手架式反馈练习平台，将人工监督前置至解题答案的事先核验环节，从而兼顾反馈的即时性与可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型电气工程课堂师生比高，及时且具体的反馈难以持续；学生遇到困难时常需数日才能获知错误原因，严重削弱学习效果。GenAI虽可扩展对话式反馈，但用于评分会引发信任与责任问题，而人工复核又会导致反馈延迟，形成"即时性"与"可信性"之间的张力。

Method: 设计并试点一款GenAI练习平台，在学生自主练习阶段提供即时、脚手架式的对话反馈；将人工监督从实时评分迁移至前置的答案核验环节；通过学生使用情况调查，了解其参与方式、对反馈价值与可靠性的感知，并提炼对其他工程学科的可迁移经验。

Result: （摘要未给出定量结果）研究目标在于揭示学生如何与该工具互动、如何评价其反馈的价值与可靠性，以及经验对其他工程学科的适用性。

Conclusion: 该平台通过"前置核验+即时生成"的工作流有望化解反馈即时性与可信性之间的张力，可作为其他工程学科规模化高质量反馈的参考方案。

Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

</details>


### [215] [SCOPE-AD: Sequential cost-aware ordinal-belief planning with energy-based models for diagnostic agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01278)
*Ziwen Yu,Ivan Koychev,Elizabeth Coulthard,Ting Zhou,Bolin Chen,Dian Hong,Zinuo You,Yujiao Wang,Anthony Mulholland,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SCOPE-AD提出了一种面向阿尔茨海默病（AD）诊断的成本敏感型序贯决策框架，将CN-MCI-AD分类建模为基于有序信念的序贯证据获取问题。该方法结合掩码感知有序信念模型、离线训练的基于能量的教师策略，并通过策略蒸馏部署为Qwen代理，在ADNI数据集上以极低平均获取成本（$50.46）实现了77.70%的Macro-F1，显著优于对比方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AD诊断本质上是序贯证据获取过程，临床医生需在异构测试成本和患者负担下决定是否及获取何种补充检查。现有固定模态预测器无法联合决策获取哪些测试或何时证据已充分；多数序贯诊断方法针对鉴别诊断而非有序的CN-MCI-AD连续谱，且无法在统一决策空间中比较诊断风险与成本调整后的获取收益。

Method: 1) 掩码感知有序信念模型：独立编码器融合已获取模态特征，通过有序阈值（CN/MCI边界）和温度校准输出CN-MCI-AD后验概率；2) 离线基于能量的规划（EBM）：在回顾性训练记录上构建有限时域软备份Bellman目标，结合分类误差和有序距离的复合风险函数，训练EBM教师策略；3) 规划器到代理策略蒸馏：将EBM软策略通过KL散度匹配蒸馏到MLP学生和Qwen3.5-9B（QLoRA微调）部署代理；4) 部署时代理在可用性和预算硬掩码下选择获取或诊断动作，未获取值不可见。

Result: 在ADNI基准（2218受试者，1552/333/333划分）上，SCOPE-AD取得77.70% Macro-F1，平均获取成本仅$50.46，比最强基线ACTMED在Macro-F1上提升9.34个百分点，成本降低98.4%。认知评估占获取请求的99.8%，策略平均每例仅请求约1个模态。消融实验显示：有序信念和EBM规划器均贡献显著（去除后Macro-F1分别降至67.20%和61.10%）。全模态评估仅额外提升1.89个Macro-F1百分点，但成本增加116.7倍。类别召回率：CN 92.67%、MCI 63.91%、AD 75.18%。

Conclusion: SCOPE-AD通过有序信念建模、EBM规划和策略蒸馏的统一框架，实现了CN-MCI-AD诊断中性能与成本的高效权衡。实验证明选择性获取优于全模态使用：认知评估提供大部分可达诊断价值且成本低廉，而其他模态边际收益有限。未来工作将扩展至纵向患者记录和动态疾病进展建模。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis requires sequential evidence acquisition under heterogeneous test costs and patient burden. Fixed-modality predictors do not jointly decide which test to acquire or when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. We propose SCOPE-AD (Sequential Cost-Aware Ordinal-Belief Planning with Energy-Based Models for Diagnostic Agents) for cost-aware classification of cognitively normal (CN), mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and AD cases. A mask-aware ordinal model represents uncertainty along the ordered CN--MCI--AD continuum. Retrospective training records provide sampled Bellman targets for an energy-based teacher, whose action distributions are distilled into a Qwen policy. At deployment, the agent selects acquisition or diagnosis actions under availability and budget constraints without access to unacquired values. After each acquisition, the evidence and ordinal belief are updated before the next decision. On ADNI, SCOPE-AD achieves 77.70\% Macro-F1 at an average acquisition cost of \$50.46, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 9.34 percentage points. Full-modality evaluation raises Macro-F1 by only 1.89 points while increasing acquisition cost by 116.7 times. These results support selective acquisition for cost-effective diagnosis.

</details>


### [216] [Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01282)
*Antonio Emanuele Cinà,Giovanni Scodeller,Cecilia Caterina Pasquale,Silvia Siri,Davide Anguita,Fabio Roli,Simona Sacone,Luca Oneto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于智能交通系统和物流（ITS&L）领域中可信DataOps和MLOps的综合综述论文，系统性地综述了数据运维、机器学习运维及可信AI在ITS&L中的整合应用、工具、实践和案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI/ML在智能交通与物流领域的广泛应用，数据量大、速度快、异构性高（3V挑战）以及模型持续更新、可信度不足等问题日益突出。现有综述多将DataOps、MLOps和可信AI（TAI）割裂讨论，缺乏面向ITS&L领域的三者协同视角，且对MLOps、LLMOps、AgentOps等新兴实践在该领域的实际落地关注不足。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 本文采用系统性文献综述方法：在Scopus和Google Scholar中以"DataOps""MLOps""Trustworthy AI""ITS&L"等关键词检索近10年相关综述类论文，构建元综述表格（Table I）以识别研究空白。随后将ITS&L划分为六大应用领域（车辆控制、交通管理、运输管理系统、旅客信息服务、货运与供应链物流、应急管理），分别针对DataOps、MLOps（含LLMOps）和TAI三大主题，从动机—生命周期—开源/商用工具—对比分析—案例研究五个维度展开论述，最终提炼开放挑战与未来方向。

Result: 论文的主要成果包括：（1）提出面向ITS&L的DataOps八阶段生命周期（采集、处理、存储、分析可视化、发布、部署、监控、反馈）并对比开源（Kafka、Spark、Hadoop、Flink、dbt、Airflow等）与商用（GCD、EMR、ADF）工具；（2）提出MLOps八阶段生命周期并综述Metaflow、ZenML、BentoML、Kubeflow、Apollo等开源工具及VertexAI、Watson Studio、Azure ML、SageMaker等商用平台，同时讨论LLMOps专用工具（Hugging Face、vLLM、LangChain、Deepchecks）及AgentOps这一新兴方向；（3）将TAI分解为可持续性、鲁棒性、可解释性、公平性、隐私五个维度，系统梳理各维度的指标与工具；（4）按六大应用领域汇总DataOps、MLOps、TAI的案例研究（表IV共统计153篇DataOps、82篇TAI相关参考文献）并指出研究空白。

Conclusion: 论文得出以下结论：DataOps在ITS&L中已较为成熟，而MLOps的系统化应用仍显不足；现有工作极少将DataOps、MLOps和TAI整合于统一框架；TAI各原则的研究关注度不均衡（隐私与可持续性较多，公平性与可解释性偏少）；案例研究在不同ITS&L子领域分布不均（车辆控制与交通管理居多，应急管理偏少）。面向未来，随着LLM、生成式AI与智能体系统的兴起，MLOps正向LLMOps和AgentOps演进，AI系统的可信保障将从模型层面扩展至完整的数据-AI生态系统层面。论文主张推动DataOps、MLOps与TAI的深度融合，以支撑下一代可靠、透明、可持续且合规的智能交通与物流服务。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios. The paper concludes with a discussion of persisting challenges and future prospects in this rapidly advancing field, aiming to serve as a vital resource for researchers, industry practitioners, and policy makers. Overall, this work not only establishes a foundational understanding of DataOps and MLOps in ITS\&L but also charts a path for further research and innovation in developing more efficient, sustainable, and trustworthy intelligent transportation and logistics systems.

</details>


### [217] [ITC-MoE: Importance-guided Token-aware Compression for MoE Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01296)
*Lianjun Liu,Shipeng Li,You Huang,Weiqi Yan,Mingte Qiu,Huazhong Liu,Xiaofeng Zhu,Yunshan Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ITC-MoE 提出了一种面向 MoE 扩散语言模型的低秩压缩框架，通过重要性引导的 Tucker 分解自适应分配各模式秩预算，并结合 token 感知的热/冷 token 差异化处理，在大幅降低计算和存储开销的同时保持生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE 扩散语言模型存在专家参数冗余和扩散解码中高昂的推理开销问题。现有低秩压缩方法多针对自回归 MoE LLM 设计，采用静态分解和固定秩分配，无法适配 MoE DLM 的两大特性：跨模式非均匀冗余和 token 级别利用率差异。

Method: 框架包含两个组件：(1) IATC 通过激活和梯度二阶矩加权变换后进行 Tucker 分解，并利用可学习秩截断在固定参数预算下自适应分配专家/输入/输出三个模式的秩；(2) TCR 对压缩敏感的热 token 施加轻量低秩补偿，对路由集中的冷 token 限制候选专家集。配合共享因子执行策略加速推理。

Result: 在 SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32 和 LLaDA2.0-mini 上的零样本评测中，30% 压缩率下 MultiArith 保持 96.33% 准确率，端到端加速最高达 7.22×，在所有任务上一致优于 D²-MoE、TD-MoE 等基线，且在极低压缩率(3%)下加速也显著优于仅做推理加速的 TEAM 方法。

Conclusion: ITC-MoE 通过联合利用跨模式非均匀冗余和 token 级利用率变化，在 MoE DLM 的压缩效率与生成质量之间取得了优越的平衡，为扩散语言模型的高效部署提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible parallel decoding and increased model capacity, but their large number of expert parameters incurs substantial computation and storage costs. Existing low-rank MoE compression methods largely rely on static factorization and fixed rank allocation, which overlook the distinctive properties of MoE DLMs. Specifically, we identify two properties: cross-mode non-uniform redundancy, where parameter redundancy and sensitivity to rank truncation vary across the input, output, and expert modes, and token-wise utilization variation, where hot and cold tokens exhibit distinct spectral characteristics and expert activation patterns. To address these challenges, we propose ITC-MoE, an Importance-guided Token-aware Compression framework for MoE DLMs. ITC-MoE consists of two complementary components. First, Importance-guided Adaptive Tucker Compression (IATC) incorporates activation and gradient importance into expert weight transformation, jointly factorizes expert weights across multiple modes, and adaptively allocates ranks under a fixed parameter budget. Second, Token-aware Compensation and Routing (TCR) applies lightweight low-rank compensation to compression-sensitive hot tokens and restricts the candidate expert set for cold tokens with concentrated routing patterns. By jointly adapting compression capacity and inference execution to both parameter redundancy and token-wise variation, ITC-MoE substantially reduces the computation and storage costs of MoE DLMs while preserving their generation quality. For example, on SDAR-30B-A3B-Chat-b32, ITC-MoE maintains an accuracy of 96.33% on MultiArith under a 30% compression budget, while achieving up to a 7.22x end-to-end speedup. The code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [218] [Questionnaire-Guided Disaggregation of Energy Appliance Use for Domestic Smart Meter Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01297)
*Achal Nanjundamurthy,Rupam Misra,Suzanne Little,Alan F. Smeaton*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种针对爱尔兰30分钟分辨率智能电表数据的无标签能耗分解（disaggregation）系统。该系统结合了高功率负载的事件检测与基于问卷调查的估算方法，将家庭总用电分解为9类电器用电。在UK-DALE和REFIT两个公开基准数据集上，该混合方法在所有建筑物的整体分解误差均低于签名规则方法和加性FHMM方法，并能为用户提供节能建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 爱尔兰智能电表以30分钟为周期采样，远低于现有NILM（非侵入式负荷监测）研究中常用的1-6秒采样率，使得单个电器事件难以在采样中直接观察。同时，有监督方法需要子电表标注数据，而这在爱尔兰家庭中并不存在。作者认为在极低采样率下，将使用数据与家庭申报信息（如问卷）相结合比仅从信号中提取更有价值。

Method: 系统采用三层混合架构：1）**路径路由**：根据问卷中申报的供暖/热水方式将家庭分配至三条处理路径（PATH A：全热泵；PATH B：热水热泵+非电供暖；PATH C：燃气/燃油锅炉+电浸没式加热备份）；2）**检测与估算**：高功率负载（EV充电、浸没式热水器、烹饪、洗衣机）通过事件检测识别，分布式低功率类别（照明、消费电子等）通过问卷计数乘以基于国家统计数据的常数估算；3）**能量守恒与同行基准**：强制9类总和等于总用电量，并通过年度消费层级和冬夏比将家庭分组用于同行比较。比较方法包括基于签名规则的mprn_v3方法和加性FHMM方法。

Result: 在UK-DALE 4个建筑（76楼月）和REFIT 20个住宅（366楼月）上，混合方法在所有24个建筑的整体9类分解MAD均最低；UK-DALE building 1的54个月配对Wilcoxon检验显示混合方法在53/54和54/54个月上优于签名和FHMM方法（Holm校正后p<0.001）。在2,968户爱尔兰智能电表的规模化应用中发现约9.5%的家庭检测到EV充电占比超5%。问卷中电器清单字段贡献最大，单独加入可使误差降低2.82%。然而在已计量的4类子集上，混合方法并非最优，说明其优势主要来自对不存在负载的正确零分配。

Conclusion: 研究表明在30分钟采样率下，简短问卷（尤其是3项电器清单）比深层信号分析能带来更大精度提升，整体分解层面与电器层面的评价指标在部分计量的基准上可能对相同方法给出相反排名。未来工作需审计自身测量仪器并分解评价指标以避免错误归因。

Abstract: Ireland's smart metering programme records electricity use at 30-minute resolution, with smart meters installed in over 80\% of households as of late 2025. While this is useful for billing of smart, time-of-use tariffs, it is too coarse to capture use of domestic appliances. We present a label-free disaggregation system that breaks usage data into 9 appliance categories by combining event detection for high-power loads with questionnaire-guided estimation. Our evaluation draws on four datasets: a calibration household with a commercial comparator, two public benchmarks (UK-DALE and REFIT) with per-appliance sub-metering, and a smart meter dataset of more than 4,800 years of use from 2,968 Irish consumers. Compared against two independently developed disaggregation systems our hybrid method combining analysis of usage data with questionnaire results, achieves the lowest whole-decomposition error on all buildings across the datasets, with better month-level performance over 54 paired months ($p<0.001$, Holm-corrected). Our method provides useful advice on a household's energy consumption patterns and advice on how to reduce or shift usage on some appliances in order to reduce costs.

</details>


### [219] [DAYJOB: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Professional Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01306)
*Stephanie Finley,Liudas Panavas,Thomas Mikkelson,Cam Hinton,Stacey Ganss,Bradley Monton,Emily Kendall,Michelle Spradlin,Lydia Bye,Michael O'Brien,Lauren Ylvisaker,Derek Ray,Suhaas Garre,Sushant Mehta,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DAYJOB 是一个由医疗和金融领域专业人士构建的、用于评估智能体完成真实长程专业工作能力的基准测试。其核心特点是给出简短请求和包含大量异构文件的工作区，由专家二元评分标准严格评判。当前主流大模型在该基准上表现普遍较差，最强的 Claude Opus 5.5 也仅通过约 24% 的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的智能体基准（如 GDPval、APEX）要么提示过于详细，要么局限于软件/网络环境，而医疗、金融基准多测试知识问答或受限工具使用，难以评估智能体处理真实工作中"简短请求+异构文件+需自主判断前提是否成立"的能力。该论文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建了 130 个基于 Harbor 容器环境的任务（医疗 50 个，金融 80 个），每个任务附带专家二元评分标准（中位数 47.5 和 57.5 条标准）。智能体在容器中操作，评判智能体（基于 Claude Opus 4.8）打开交付文件、重新计算数值并对每条标准给出二元判定，只有所有标准都通过才算任务成功。评估了来自 13 个开发方的 30 个模型配置，每个任务运行 5 次。

Result: 最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5（adaptive/max）在医疗和金融任务上的严格通过率分别为 24.7% 和 23.9%，中位数配置仅为 0.6% 和 2.5%。19 个配置在两个领域得分均低于 5%。即便放宽至 95% 标准通过率，头部模型得分也仅提升约 2-3 倍。两个领域的模型排序高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.82）。案例研究表明，智能体常接受记录中已反驳的前提（如错误诊断），或在错误输入基础上构建出逻辑一致但结论错误的分析。

Conclusion: DAYJOB 证明当前智能体在处理真实长程专业工作方面能力有限，尤其难以识别错误前提和关键事实。论文公开了全部医疗任务和 50 个金融任务、评估工具包及排行榜，并计划扩展至其他专业领域。

Abstract: Professional work often starts with a brief request that leaves the professional to work out what is needed, which documents matter, and whether the request's premise holds. We introduce DAYJOB, a benchmark of 130 tasks built by professionals in healthcare (50) and finance (80). The tasks are estimated to take a professional 13.6 hours on average in healthcare and 16.6 in finance. Each task is a containerized Harbor environment with an expert rubric of binary criteria (median 47.5 and 57.5 per task) that an agentic judge applies to the delivered files, and an attempt passes only if it meets every criterion. Across 30 model configurations from 13 developers, the strongest, Claude Opus 5.5, passes 24.7% of healthcare and 23.9% of finance attempts, and the median configuration passes 0.6% and 2.5%. In case studies, agents accept premises that the record contradicts and carry wrong inputs through otherwise consistent analyses. We release all healthcare tasks, 50 of the 80 finance tasks, the evaluation harness, and the leaderboard.

</details>


### [220] [ProtoFlow: Prototype-Guided Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01320)
*Shibo Feng,Wanjin Feng,Yang Qiu,Deheng Ye,Peilin Zhao,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ProtoFlow 提出了一种结合向量量化（VQ）表示与原型先验流匹配（Flow Matching）的高维多元时间序列预测框架。其核心创新在于利用 VQ 码本中学到的原型（prototype centers、频率、局部协方差）作为流匹配的源先验分布，而非传统的高斯先验，从而避免自回归（AR）方法的训练-推理不一致问题，并支持仅需 3-5 步 ODE 采样的高效推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 高维多元时间序列预测中，扩散模型推理需多步去采样成本高；VAE 框架更高效，但基于 VQ 的方法通常采用自回归 token 生成，存在 teacher forcing 训练与自回归推理之间的 exposure bias / rollout mismatch 问题。\n2. 现有流匹配方法通常以高斯先验初始化源分布，但未利用任何学习到的数据结构，忽略了潜在空间中已存在的代表性结构信息。\n3. 关键观察：VQ 码本已捕获代表性的潜在原型（prototype），可用作更信息丰富的流匹配先验，从而加速训练收敛并减少采样步数。

Method: 两阶段框架：\n- **Stage 1（向量量化 tokenizer）**：使用相似度驱动（cosine similarity）的 VQ-VAE 将未来目标序列编码为离散潜在表示。采用 ℓ2 归一化后的余弦相似度进行码字分配，使用重建损失 + 余弦 commitment loss 训练，并采用 EMA 更新码本与重置未使用条目。\n- **Stage 2（码本先验整流流匹配）**：\n  - **码本先验构建**：源分布为混合模型 p_Z(z) = Σ π_k · p_k(z; μ_k, B_k, σ_k, γ)，其中 π_k 为训练阶段统计的频率权重，μ_k 为码字中心（prototype），(B_k, σ_k) 描述局部 PCA 主方向与尺度，γ 控制扰动幅度，采样后做 ℓ2 归一化。\n  - **流匹配**：以码本先验为源，目标为 VQ 量化后的未来潜在序列，使用 DiT 参数化向量场 v_θ，进行条件整流流（线性插值 + 速度场回归）。\n  - **推理**：从码本先验采样源点，仅需 3-5 步 Euler ODE 积分，解码得到预测。\n- **架构**：DiT-based 向量场，条件包括历史上下文（Conv + Transformer-XL 编码）与未来时间特征；流时间嵌入控制 adaptive LayerNorm。\n- **理论动机**：证明最小整流传输代价等于 2-Wasserstein 距离平方，若码本先验的 W₂ 距离小于高斯先验，则最优传输代价更小。

Result: 在 Solar、Electricity、Traffic、Taxi、Wikipedia 五个高维基准数据集、48/96 步预测长度下，ProtoFlow 在 20 项对比中取得 18 项最佳或并列最佳：\n- 相比 TSFlow（流匹配基线）平均降低 CRPS_sum 13.6%、NRMSE_sum 17.4%；\n- 相比 FlowTime 分别降低 42.6% 与 34.4%；\n- 相比强扩散基线 NsDiff 平均降低 22.0% 与 14.6%；\n- 采样效率显著：仅需 3 步（Wikipedia 5 步）ODE 采样，而 TSFlow 需 16 步、NsDiff 需 20 步；\n- 推理速度比 TSFlow 快 3.66–3.90×；\n- 相比 ProtoFlow-G（高斯先验变体）训练收敛更快，W₂ 传输距离更小，采样步数敏感性更低；\n- 消融实验验证了 VQ 表示 + 非自回归 FM + 频率加权原型先验三者结合的必要性；\n- 码本大小 K=256 在多数数据集上效果最佳。

Conclusion: ProtoFlow 证明了将 VQ 码本的结构信息（中心、频率、局部统计）用作流匹配源先验是有效的，相比高斯先验可实现更小的 Wasserstein 传输距离、更快的训练稳定性和更少采样步数下的准确预测。这为生成式时间序列预测中"表征学习与源先验设计的一体化"提供了新方向。局限性：原型先验基于全局训练统计固定，未根据具体预测上下文自适应调整概率分配，未来可探索上下文相关的原型加权。

Abstract: Generative modeling has shown strong promise for multivariate time mseries (MTS) forecasting, especially scale to high-dimensional settings. Diffusion-based methods achieve competitive performance but typically require many sampling steps at inference. VAE-based non-iterative forecasting frameworks have therefore emerged as an efficient alternative. Within this line of work, vector quantization (VQ) enables controllable latent space modeling by mapping multivariate series into compact discrete representations. Existing VQ-based forecasting methods, however, typically rely on autoregressive (AR) token generation, which suffers from exposure bias and training-inference mismatch. Flow matching provides an efficient non-autoregressive alternative for latent forecasting, but existing formulations usually initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior. We instead observe that the trained VQ codebook already captures representative latent prototypes and can thus serve as a more informative prior for flow matching. Based on this insight, we propose ProtoFlow, a forecasting framework that combines vector-quantized autoencoding with Prototype-prior Flow matching. Our method first maps multivariate sequences into a discrete latent space, then constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook, and finally learns a DiT-based rectified flow to transport samples from this prior to future latent representations conditioned on historical observations. By replacing generic noise initialization with a learned prototype prior, ProtoFlow avoids the rollout mismatch of AR token prediction and promotes faster training convergence. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that it consistently achieves superior forecasting performance with efficient inference.

</details>


### [221] [TRACE: Trajectory Return Attribution and Contrastive Erasure for Multi-Turn Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01323)
*Fengpeng Li,Kemou Li,Qizhou Wang,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACE 提出了一种基于单轮偏好数据训练的 token 级目标函数，通过轨迹感知的自适应加权（TAW）在优选分支上利用参考模型与其拒绝消融副本之间的对数概率对比生成折扣回报，并将后期证据归因于前期 token；同时通过风险局部化代理擦除（RLPE）在拒绝分支上选择参考归一化对数似然差距最大的位置，并将观察到的 token 与策略选出的替代 token 结合构成擦除目标；并以梯度范数惩罚替代保留集。在五个开源模型（1B–27B）和七种多轮攻击的 35 对组合上，TRACE 均取得最低攻击成功率（ASR），平均多轮 ASR 从 52.81% 降至 28.98%，MMLU 与 HellaSwag 最多仅下降 1.23 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的大语言模型常能拒绝单轮有害请求，但当同一目标被分散到多轮对话中时仍会遵从；现有偏好目标在静态上下文上对完整响应打分，无法控制未见历史上的风险。作者将此现象形式化为"轨迹脆弱性"，并证明响应级目标即使具有较大的偏好间隔也无法约束多轮轨迹风险，由此提出基于单轮监督的多轮安全训练问题。

Method: 方法包含三个组件：(1) TAW 将 π_ref 与其拒绝消融副本 π_abl 之间的 token 级对数比 r_j 通过 G_j = r_j + λ G_{j+1} 聚合为折扣回报，按响应内中位数与 MAD 标准化并通过 tanh 映射为权重，使早期 token 能获得后续拒绝相关证据的归因；(2) RLPE 在拒绝分支上按参考归一化对数似然差距选取 top-k 位置，并将观察到的拒绝 token 与当前策略在该位置的高概率替代 token 混合形成擦除目标，采用无参考 logistic 变换的交叉熵损失；(3) 梯度范数惩罚（GNP）以对齐批次本身的梯度范数作为正则项，无需额外保留数据集，通过一阶有限差分近似 Hessian-向量积。理论方面推导出"覆盖-抑制收缩"定理（Theorem 3.3）以及从代理抑制到轨迹风险界的定理（Theorem 4.4），将局部不安全 token 抑制与多轮轨迹风险通过覆盖率 ρ、迁移松弛 ε、泄漏 L 和代理覆盖率 κ 联系起来。

Result: 在 Gemma-3-1B、Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen-3.5-9B、Qwen-3.5-27B 与 Qwen-3.6-27B 五个模型上，对 ActorAttack、Crescendo、MHJ、SafeDialBench、STAR、RACE、X-Teaming 七种多轮攻击以及 GCG、AutoDAN 两种单轮攻击的评估中，TRACE 在全部 35 对模型-攻击组合上取得最低多轮 ASR，平均多轮 ASR 从最强基线的 52.81% 降至 28.98%；MMLU 与 HellaSwag 最多仅下降 1.23 分（在 Gemma-3-1B 上两者反而上升）。折扣 λ=0.5 与 k_proxy=10 为最优设置；消融实验证实 TAW、RLPE 与 GNP 三组件均对最终性能有贡献，移除 π_abl 或替换为保留损失均会导致 ASR 上升和效用下降。在 Llama-3.1-8B 上观察到 ASR 与 XSTest 过度拒答率之间的权衡（ξ 越小则过度拒答越少但 ASR 越高）。
