### [250] [vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01718)
*Seok Bin Son,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Soohyun Park,Joongheon Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出vFedProtoQNAS框架，将个性化量子神经架构搜索(QNAS)与基于类原型共享的虚拟联邦学习相结合，解决异设备量子联邦学习(QFL)中因客户端架构不同而无法进行参数平均的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在异构量子联邦学习场景中，客户端设备能力差异大，统一QNN架构不适用；个性化QNAS虽可让各客户端选择适配自身设备的架构，但FedAvg的参数平均假设不再成立——不同架构的相同参数索引可能对应不同的量子门操作，导致语义不一致的参数混合。

Method: 1) 每个客户端采用ProxylessQNAS策略，在设备约束定义的搜索空间内独立搜索并训练客户端专属QNN架构；2) 基于训练后的QNN提取隐层表示，计算类内局部原型(local prototype)；3) 服务器按类加权聚合本地全局原型为全局原型(global prototype)，不传输原始数据和模型参数；5) 客户端使用对比损失(InfoNCE风格)将局部表示拉近正确类全局原型、推远错误类全局原型，进行原型引导的精化训练，同时冻结个性化架构。

Result: 在MNIST(0-3)四类分类、非IID数据、5个客户端的设定下：vFedProtoQNAS准确率达91.25%±0.74%，较FedAvg(87.55%±2.38%)提升3.70%；原型余量均值从-0.143改善至-0.007，正余量比例从43.61%升至53.51%；超参数β_proto在0.05-0.20范围内性能稳定，但设为0.50时因过度约束局部表示而性能下降；在极端非IID(α=0.5)时性能波动显著，表明局部原型可靠性成为瓶颈。

Conclusion: vFedProtoQNAS通过表示层面的原型共享而非参数聚合，有效调和了个性化架构搜索与联邦协作的矛盾；消融实验证实个性化QNAS与原型引导协作提供互补收益，前者适应本地数据和设备能力，后者跨异构客户端传递类级语义知识。

Abstract: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

</details>


### [251] [TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01763)
*Mukund Agarwalla,Chih-Jen Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TopK-Guided，一种训练免费的激活稀疏化方法，针对LLM推理。它结合了有界token级稀疏度自适应（保持实现的稀疏度在目标±δ内）和灵敏度感知的块级预算分配（不同transformer块根据其对稀疏化的灵敏度分配不同的稀疏度预算），在Llama-2-7B和Llama-3-8B上以相同的计算量一致地优于TEAL和WINA，尤其在高稀疏度时增益最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的训练免费激活稀疏化方法在token级自适应性和精确控制实现的稀疏度之间存在权衡：基于阈值的方法（如TEAL）每个token自适应但无法严格控制实现的稀疏度，基于TopK的方法（如WINA）严格控制稀疏度但对所有token应用相同的预算。此外，两种方法在所有transformer块上使用统一的稀疏度预算，而块之间的灵敏度差异很大（早期块明显更敏感）。本文旨在同时解决这两个限制。

Method: TopK-Guided在WINA基础上引入两个互补的修改：(1) TopK-Guided masking：重用TEAL校准的阈值τ来估计每个token的自然稀疏度s^(t)，然后将其裁剪到目标s周围一个窄带±δ内（δ=0.01），得到实际强制执行的token级目标稀疏度s*(t)，最后应用TopK选择；这恢复了token自适应同时保持实现的稀疏度在受控范围内（整个步骤每个token的复杂度为O(d)，使用quickselect代替部分排序）。(2) Sensitivity-aware block sparsity：通过单个校准通道在探测稀疏度s̄下测量每个块的灵敏度e_i（输出相对误差），然后根据e_i相对于平均灵敏度e̅将全局预算s重新分配到每个块s_i中（s_i = s + λ(e̅ - e_i)，裁剪到[0.05, 0.95]）。方法建立在WINA的张量旋转和块内贪心按投影分配的基础上，仅在解码阶段应用稀疏化。

Result: 在Llama-2-7B和Llama-3-8B上，在目标稀疏度s∈{0.3, 0.5, 0.7}下，TopK-Guided在所有12次比较中均获得了最低的C4困惑度和最高的8个下游任务平均准确率（在A100 GPU上评估，使用lm-evaluation-harness）。相对基线的优势在低稀疏度时较小，在高稀疏度（s=0.7）时最大（例如Llama-3-8B在s=0.7时准确率从WINA的55.34%提升到57.85%，从TEAL的52.64%提升）。在Llama-2-7B上的消融研究证实，两个组件各自独立地在大多数设置上匹配或改善了WINA，并且它们具有互补性，组合方法在每个稀疏度水平上都是最佳的。超参数扫描（δ固定为0.01）表明，方法在(s̄, λ)的广泛区域内表现良好，不需要仔细的每设置搜索；区域s̄∈[0.2, 0.6]，λ∈[0.2, 0.4]在所有稀疏度水平上始终表现强劲。在s=0.5上验证时，TEAL的实现的稀疏度持续低于目标（~48% vs 目标50%）且跨数据集波动，而TopK-Guided保持在49.39–49.52%的±δ范围内。TopK-Guided与WINA的计算开销基本相同（仅每个token增加O(d)的掩码开销），并且在架构上与基于旋转的量化方法（如QuaRot）兼容。

Conclusion: TopK-Guided通过两个训练免费的修改（TopK-Guided masking和sensitivity-aware block sparsity）在不增加计算成本的情况下，持续改进了WINA和TEAL。增益在两个模型和所有稀疏度水平上都成立，在最激进的稀疏化下最大，消融证实每个贡献都有帮助。主要限制：评估仅涵盖高达8B参数的decoder-only模型，因此更大规模和其他架构下的行为有待验证；报告的是FLOP级别的节省而非实际墙钟加速，内核级实现留待未来工作。由于TopK-Guided与基于旋转的计算不变模型配合使用，与此类量化方法的结合是向更快的低精度推理迈进的自然下一步。

Abstract: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.

</details>


### [252] [VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01766)
*Bingjun Luo,Yuhuan Fan,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VideoEvolve 提出在冻结的视频-语言模型外围自动进化"harness"（执行工作流+指令），用 Cloze-Structured Harness Representation 保留阶段接口，用 Branch-Guided Harness Evolution 基于执行反馈做局部编辑、保留非冠军分支并以验证集决定是否继承，从而在五个时序定位基准上获得稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 围绕冻结视频-语言模型的 agent 中，harness（工作流+指令）对预测质量影响巨大，但手动调优成本高、修改一处易影响全局。2) 现有程序化 agent 设计（ADAS、Meta-Harness、DGM 等）未针对视频时序定位的多阶段信息流（观察-假设-验证-仲裁）做接口稳定化的编辑表示，也未分离"持续探索"与"接受继承"。3) 因此需要一种能自动改进 harness 同时保持冻结模型不变的方案。

Method: 1) Cloze-Structured Harness Representation：固定六个阶段接口（观察、假设生成、跨检、仲裁、额外资源、终判）和共享状态，阶段内的可执行代码与文本指令可被编辑，候选必须通过接口校验。2) Branch-Guided Harness Evolution：维护 champion（当前接受版本）与 retained code branch（高分但未接受的代码分支），基于开发集执行反馈 E_t（失败、弱点、成功案例、历史尝试）由外部编码 LLM 提出局部修改；分支重置条件为提升或重试耗尽。3) Validation-Guided Harness Selection：在与 champion 同批的开发集上挑选唯一严格提升的候选，再在视频分离的验证集做回归与可靠性校验；通过则替换，否则记录 near miss 与聚合诊断用于有界 repair。4) 算法循环60个 proposal、20轮，单查询限4次 solver 调用、96帧。

Result: 主结果（Qwen-35B 冻结）：在 Charades-STA 达到 R@.5=70.05、mIoU=61.35；ActivityNet R@.5=40.97、mIoU=43.28；QVHighlights R@.5=71.68、mIoU=66.27；ReXTime R@.5=59.17、mIoU=53.93；TimeLens-Bench R@.5=53.53、mIoU=50.73，均超过所列冻结模型工作流，并在 TimeLens 上超过 Time-R1。分支消融显示 Full vs No-Branch 在 Charades-STA/QVHighlights/ReXTime 与 TimeLens macro S（+1.02）上一致更优，搜索求解调用数也更少。组件交换显示指令单独替换即可带来稳定增益（ReXTime R@.5 51.14→74.5→55.70；TimeLens 46.86→53.02），代码增益因基准而异；完整 harness 同时取得最高质量，但增加每查询调用与输入 token。质性上，进化指令加入显式全程扫描与边界检验，进化代码引入条件二次/三次假设与中位融合，可在某些查询中恢复漏报区间，也可能因合并错误假设而放大定位误差。

Conclusion: 自动化 harness 进化是绕开模型训练而显著提升视频时序定位的可行路径；保留阶段接口的 Cloze 表征使工作流与指令协同改进成为可能；指令精修是稳定收益项，代码精修收益具有场景依赖。代码已开源：https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [253] [RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01780)
*Arman Behnam,Sunglyoung Kim,Liangwei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发布了一个名为 RealCompanion 的纵向基准测试数据集，包含 10 段真实用户与 AI 伴侣长达数月的对话记录（共计 27,218 条消息），并通过五层标注文件（对话原文、画像、个性、对话参考答案、问答集）来衡量 AI 对真实人类的理解能力。研究发现：记忆中真正需要调用的历史消息仅占 3.4% 且往往距离很远（最远可达 12,542 条消息）；当前没有任何检测器能在自然对话中判断何时需要检索历史；三个代理系统在重建 persona 上 F1 值相近，但成本相差 31 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对话记忆基准测试主要依赖人工生成的对话和预先设定的人物画像，存在三大根本缺陷：(1) 生成的对话总是让历史成为必需；(2) 人物画像提前声明了用户特征，使回答画像问题变成阅读声明；(3) 编造的历史从不修订，消除了"用户真实身份演化"的现象。因此这些基准无法测试 AI 真正理解真实用户的能力。RealCompanion 旨在通过真实用户与 AI 伴侣的对话记录，填补这一空白。

Method: 数据集构建：从某 AI 伴侣应用的操作数据库中导出 10 名真实用户的对话记录，经匿名化处理后形成五层文件——source（对话原文，唯一非派生层）、profile（用户陈述事实）、persona（用户思维方式与情感倾向）、chat ground truth（对话评估参考答案）、question set（问答评估集）。每条派生记录都引用 source 中的消息标识符，确保可验证性。评估三轨道：(1) Reconstruction 轨道（重建画像与个性）、(2) Chat 轨道（评分对真实消息的回应）、(3) Question 轨道（评分对书面问题的回答）。检索方法包括 Random、Recency、BM25、Oracle 等。对话参考答案的构建采用五阶段流水线（指称消解、证据验证、分类、基础生成、回复验证），每个阶段都记录推理过程。

Result: 三项主要发现：(1) 历史信息很少被用到——按比例抽样的真实对话中只有 3.4% 的消息需要调取前文（即"需求率 π"很小），且当需要时，目标证据距当前消息很远（最远中位数 2,157 条消息）。在供给存储器上下文带来的收益中，96% 来自那些本不需要历史的消息（命题 2 揭示这一现象是结构性而非实验性的）。(2) 没有检测器能判断何时需要历史——对自然对话中的真实消息，最佳检测器 AUROC 仅 0.530-0.601，与随机猜测无异；人工编写的题目存在关键词泄露问题（AUROC 0.802），这意味着检测能力主要来自查询的写作风格而非对话内容；简单地将同一段消息标注为"检索记忆"而非"早期对话"就能让模型使用率提高 10-14 个百分点。(3) 三个代理系统（Claude Opus 5.5、Codex GPT-5.6-sol、Antigravity Gemini 3.8 Flash）重建 persona 的 F1 值都在 0.69-0.70 之间，精度 0.56-0.59，召回率 0.86-0.89，但处理 tokens 数分别为 546M、18M、36M，成本相差 31 倍。检索上，BM25 在远程条目上的 hit@5 为 0.248，是 Recency 的 11 倍，但仍漏掉 3/4 的必需消息。

Conclusion: RealCompanion 是首个基于真实长期人类对话关系的基准测试，回答了"AI 伴侣需要理解用户到什么程度"这一核心问题。其三大核心贡献：(1) 提供了真实对话数据而非生成对话，需求率 π 仅为 3.4% 反映了自然状态而非评估需要；(2) 论证了"何时检索"这一决策（restraint）才是当前系统真正的失败所在，而不仅仅是"检索什么"，并通过命题 2 形式化证明当 π 很小时传统检索对比实验无法识别记忆效应；(3) 证明了仅靠规模扩展无法解决 AI 理解用户身份的根本挑战。论文提出了七项基准构建条件（包括未来实例与相关性、refuence only demand 等），并以开放数据集形式释放，未来可推动 companion AI、对话记忆与个性化研究。

Abstract: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.

</details>


### [254] [Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01781)
*Lu-Chin Chang,Suguman Bansal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Quasar —— 首个在无非终止最大末端分量（MEC-free）MDP 上对可达性目标具有渐近收敛保证的免模型 Q 学习算法，通过将期望终止时间作为加权范数恢复 Bellman 算子的压缩性，将内存从模型法的 O(|S|²|A|) 降至 O(|S||A|)，并在标准基准上以少若干个数量级的样本收敛到最优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前对可达性规范的渐近收敛保证只能通过必须显式估计转移概率的基于模型的方法实现，内存 O(|S|²|A|) 且在大规模乘积 MDP 上代价过高；此外，一般 LTL 目标缺乏 PAC 可学习性，故渐近保证几乎是可获得的最佳结果。需要一种免模型、内存更小的渐近收敛学习算法以推动规范引导强化学习的实际部署。

Method: 在无非终止 MEC 的 MDP 片段上，将经典 Q 学习改造为"无折扣、终端值钳位"的形式（Quasar-Naive），并提出反向回放变体 Quasar-BR。核心证明技巧是用 MDP 自身的期望终止时间 T_s 作为加权范数的权，证明无折扣 Bellman 最优算子在加权最大范数下以 β=1−1/max_s T_s 为压缩因子（此处压缩性的恢复完全依赖于 no-EC 结构假设），再结合 Tsitsiklis 随机逼近引理处理采样噪声，得几乎处处收敛到 Q*；为 Quasar-BR 单独证明需用反向序下重新锚定到回合边界表的鞅差噪声、逐步仿射复合的系数重排二阶扰动以及 A_e→0 的回合步长预算衰减。

Result: 理论结果：Quasar-Naive 与 Quasar-BR 的迭代几乎处处收敛到最优可达性值 Q*，且只依赖结构性 no-EC 假设而不依赖任何数值参数；Quasar 的内存为 O(|S||A|)，相比模型法的 O(|S|²|A|) 二次方级降低；Cor.3 给出诱导的贪心策略最终精确最优。实证结果：在 Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set 全部九个基准上，Quasar-BR 在 36 小时预算内全部达到最终误差 0~2×10⁻¹¹，远优于模型法基线 Staged-PAC（仅在两个基准上达到 <10⁻² 误差，且分别需 2.8×10⁷、9.3×10⁸ 样本，而 Quasar-BR 仅需 5、7 个）；在 V*(i₀)=1 的六个基准上仅需 5–215 个样本即数值精确收敛；并以小例子说明可达性与随机最短路径（SSP）目标既不相互归约也不同解。

Conclusion: Quasar 是首个对可达性目标提供渐近收敛保证的免模型 Q 学习算法，以 O(|S||A|) 内存匹配了基于模型方法的保证，并在标准化基准上以数量级更少的样本大幅优于当前最优（Staged-PAC）。该工作朝规范引导强化学习的实用化迈出了具体一步；最迫切的下一步是将方法推广到含非终止 MEC 的通用 MDP 上。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

</details>


### [255] [Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01787)
*Beining Wu,Zihao Ding,Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对GUI智能体自我改进中"轨迹经验应存入上下文还是权重"的未决问题，提出**组件路由(component routing)**方法：将轨迹拆解为定位器、流程、状态事实、教训四种组件，依据"复发率"与"状态条件性"两个训练前预估属性决策各组件的去向。在三大基座、两环境、三随机种下，发现同一经验池对不同组件的最优去向相反：定位器与教训入权重，流程与状态事实留上下文；规则在留出基座上24/24 cell全部命中；按此路由比所有整轨迹基线及单一更优去向平均再高3.5分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自改进GUI智能体把整条轨迹作为最小经验单元，要么全量微调进权重、要么整条入库按任务相似度检索回填提示。已有工作结论彼此矛盾（工具任务上内化提示胜出、网页任务上提示侧更新胜出），根源在于轨迹混合了性质差异显著的多种成分，束捆策略的最优去向取决于该混合物的组成，但任何关于束捆的结论都受其混合方式左右。

Method: 1. 把每个step分解为四种组件：定位器G(屏幕元素位置)、流程P(三步动作序列)、状态事实S(动作前预条件)、教训L(失败动作↔成功动作偏好对)。2. 在训练前、仅基于轨迹池预估两个属性：复发率r(其key在多少无关任务中再次出现)和状态条件性κ₀(payload是否依赖源状态匹配)。3. 在同一池同一保留检验实例下，对每个组件同时跑上下文路由(C, 检索回填)和权重路由(W, LoRA微调)，对照三个基座家族(GUI-Owl-8B、ScaleCUA-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B)、两环境(MobileGym、AndroidWorld)、三种子。4. 以r和sκ₀为输入拟合线性规则，留出一家族后24/24 cell全部预测对。6. 以"信息差"与"策略差"两参量刻画生产者–消费者差距。

Result: 1. 同一池下四种组件的最优去向不同：定位器入权重Δ=+4.9、教训入权重Δ=+1.5；流程入上下文Δ=-4.2、状态事实入上下文Δ=-4.1。该结论在三基座两环境上稳定。2. 线性规则s = αr - βκ₀ - γ 在24个cell上以100%为留出基座预测最优去向(α∈[9.01,9.32], β∈[4.86,5.28])。3. 依据规则路由相对"全入上下文"、"全入权重"及所有整轨迹基线均领先：在MobileGym上比最佳单去向平均高+3.5-7.8点，比最优整轨迹基线(三试取最佳)高+9.3点；反置路由(去处理器)落后平均+8.9点。4. 干预实验：八倍复制训练样本使流程增益+3.5、状态事实+3.6(往权重方向移动)；去掉状态条件使流程下降3.9、状态事实下降3.4(往上下文方向移动)。5. 读出探针：同组件进入权重后，检索笔记引起行为变化的比例由45%降至16%，高复发率组件降幅最大(Spearman -0.92)。6. 生产者–消费者机制中，上下文收益随信息差上升而增加(Spearman 0.65)，权重收益随策略差上升而下降(Spearman -0.52)，权重收益主要来自于同一消费者自身的"练习"效应。

Conclusion: 轨迹不是自改进GUI智能体的合适经验单元。组件路由基于训练前可预估的复发率与状态条件性两组件智能体，预测各组件应进入上下文还是权重：定位器与教训入权重，流程与状态事实留上下文。该结论在三大基座家族与两环境中稳定、可迁移。规则路由击败整轨迹微调与单一更优去向，验证该结论作为实操指导。生产者和消费者之间的信息差与策略差决定了两个路由的适用场景：笔记能跨越生产者传递，权重不能；权重的主要增益来自消费者自身轨迹的"练习"而非传递。

Abstract: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

</details>


### [256] [LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01800)
*Haochen Zhang,Laura Yao,Zachary Plotkin,Gengwei Zhang,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 LineupRL，一个基于"标题到序列识别"奖励的可验证强化学习 RLVR 流程，用于时间序列描述任务。它使用冻结的 LLM 作为验证器，通过在统计特征匹配的候选集中识别目标序列来奖励生成的描述。在两个描述基准和预测/重建任务上，3B 参数量的 VLM 超越了 72B 教师蒸馏的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列描述任务中，基于合成参考描述的监督微调 SFT 存在两个缺陷：(i) 性能受限于教师模型，无法超越；(iii) 易产生"无根据描述"——流畅但脱离重要特征的输出。现有 RL 奖励方法如 LLM-as-judge 容易被 hack（奖励 hacking），answerability 奖励对模型时间序列理解能力要求过高。因此需要一个满足三个条件的奖励：(i) 抗 reward hacking；(ii) 对验证器时间序列理解能力要求适中；(iii) 奖励时间序列中重要且有区分性的特征。

Method: 核心方法 LineupRL 采用 caption-to-series identification 作为奖励：(1) VLM 策略 π_θ 读取时间序列 x 的折线图 ρ(x) 生成描述 c；(2) 从同长度其他真实序列中，根据统计特征（mean, std, min, max）匹配选出 K-1 个近邻作为干扰项，构造候选集 C(x)={x}∪N(x)，并限制重叠度 η=0.2；(3) 冻结的 LLM 验证器 R（Qwen2.5-14B）读取描述和 K 个候选的原始数值，在 K 次循环位置下识别正确序列，计算 acc(c,x)；(4) 奖励 r(c,x)=λ·acc(c,x)，λ=2；(5) 采用 RLOO 策略梯度方法，K=4，G=8，温度 1.0。学习率 10^-6，KL 系数 0，训练 1200 步。评估采用三个准则：与参考描述的蕴含、识别准确率（caption↔series 两个方向）、以及描述作为信息瓶颈的预测/重建性能。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 在 BEDTime 和 CaTS-Bench 上，LineupRL 在六项指标中均为最佳；(2) 3B VLM 超越 72B 教师 distilled 优于率：以 1/24 参数超越 72B 教师在两个基准所有指标；(3) 在四个预测/重建语料库（ETTh2、ETTm2、Saugeen 河流流量、澳大利亚电力需求）上均获得最低 MSE，五个数据集中显著较低，六个超过 9% 错误率差距。消融实验验证：(a) 14B 验证器最佳（3B/7B 性能下降）；(b) K=4 优于 K=6/8；(c) 最近邻干扰项优于随机干扰项。案例分析显示 LineupRL 能追踪趋势并准确描述关键点，而 LLM-as-judge 倾向于 hack（99.9% 生成描述附有面向评判者的段落），Judge 可忽视。

Conclusion: LineupRL 是一种基于时间序列可识别性的可验证强化学习框架，无需参考描述或学习奖励模型，仅依靠数据本身提供训练信号。3B 描述器超越 SFT 蒸馏、其他 RL 奖励以及 72B 教师模型。消融研究验证了验证器规模、候选数量和干扰项选取规则三个设计决策均合理，最近邻偏好在英语指标上均优于随机干扰。"标题到序列识别"是连续信号描述任务中一种可行的可验证奖励方法。未来工作将拓展到更长序列、多元序列以及非 VLM 的描述器。

Abstract: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.

</details>


### [257] [AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01813)
*Simon Graham,Mostafa Jahanifar,Quoc Dang Vu,Vygante Maskoliunaite,Donatas Petroska,Ruta Barbora Valkiuniene,Ayat Gamal Lashen,Jen Hong Ong,Amede Ogechi Nnorom,Sinclair Couper,Natasha Kardasz,Reshma Agrawal,Brinder Singh Chohan,Jose Luis Solorzano Rendon,Shonali Natu,Arvydas Laurinavicius,Nasir Rajpoot,David Snead*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了AI辅助工具MitPro，用于改进有丝分裂计数的病理评估一致性（率可重复性）和效率。通过一项多中心、多扫描仪、多病理学家参与的配对读片研究，证明MitPro能显著提高评分者间一致性并减少评估时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手动有丝分裂计数是肿瘤分级、诊断和预后评估的重要环节，但耗时且存在病理学家间变异性差异。亟需一种工具来提升一致性并减轻工作负担，同时保留病理学家对最终判断的控制权。

Method: 开发AI工具MitPro，引导病理学家聚焦于预测有丝分裂活性最高的区域并高亮显示有丝分裂图样。在一项回顾性、非干预性配对读者研究中评估其表现：来自3国3中心的385张全切片图像（7种肿瘤类型），使用3种不同扫描仪，13名病理学家参与，每张切片由3名病理学家独立评估（无AI辅助），经过至少2周清洗期后再次评估（AI辅助），比较ICC和评估时间。

Result: AI辅助使组内相关系数（ICC）从0.589提升至0.949。病理学家平均中位评估时间从286.4秒降至127.8秒，平均节省151.8秒/评估。在HALO AP和Sectra图像管理系统及2种其他肿瘤类型中均观察到一致性和效率的改善。AI辅助评估与有丝分裂计数及评分略微升高的趋势相关，符合识别出更多活性热点及减少遗漏陈氏细胞的特点。评分变化频率与常规计数中病理学家间变异相当。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将MitPro作为常规实践中更具一致性和效率的有丝分裂评估辅助工具，同时保留病理学家对区域选择和最终计数的控制权。

Abstract: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.

</details>


### [258] [Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01833)
*Ngoc Phuoc An Vo,Aarya Doshi,Vadim Sheinin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对企业AI智能体技能在持续演进过程中仅评估最终输出会遗漏过程级行为漂移的问题，提出了一种结合结果级与过程级检查的持续评估框架，并在企业Value Aware Resiliency (VAR)系统的Business Value Determination (BVD)技能的Revenue与Productivity两个变体上进行实证。通过240次自动试验（2个技能 × 2个规范变体 × 2个智能体框架 × 3个模型 × 10次），证明即使最终数值正确，92.6%的运行仍存在过程级偏差，依赖归因可将平均6.34个失败检查压缩至2.65个根因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI智能体技能会随着工具API、LLM模型版本和技能规范的更新而持续演进。传统做法仅检查最终输出（如报告、数据库行、金额）是否正确，但智能体可能通过错误路径得到正确结果——调用API时作用域错误、跳过必需的数据库读回、将中间结果写入错误的表。这些过程偏差对仅检查结果的方法不可见，但在持续适配环境下会逐版本累积，造成下游数据完整性破坏或"巧合正确"的输出。因此需要一种能作为持续演进质量门的过程级评估方法。

Method: 提出一个五阶段持续评估流水线：(1) 捕获输入并解析工具调用轨迹；(2) 通过独立Python脚本调用与技能相同的真实API，独立计算每运行的ground truth（避免LLM生成oracle的错误）；(3) 实例化带运行时解析占位符的模板测试用例（如$k8s_host_date_calls在评估时由ground truth填充，而非硬编码）；(4) 进行三层评估——Level 1为预定义的最终数值结果，Level 2为扩展的七个最终状态检查，Level 3为轨迹检查（工具选择、参数、调用顺序、数据库完整性）；(5) 通过作者编写的依赖图报告根因级联归因。LLM法官（claude-sonnet-4-6）仅在精确匹配过于脆弱的语义灵活参数检查中使用，并通过计算器工具执行数值比较。评估对象：2个技能（Revenue 104检查、Productivity 80检查）、2个规范变体（SKILL.md与Skill.txt）、2个智能体框架（Claude Code与Codex）、3个模型（GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude Opus 4.8、Claude Sonnet 4.6），每格10次试验，共240次自动评估。使用Wilson 95%置信区间和非参数bootstrap（20,000重采样）进行统计推断。

Result: 核心结果：(1) 在通过所有适用最终数值检查的175次试验中，162次（92.6%，Wilson 95% CI: 87.7–95.6%）存在至少一个额外的评估器检出偏差；即使将基线扩展为七个最终状态检查，164次通过运行中仍有151次（92.1%）违反轨迹检查。(2) 失败根因家族：数据/数值一致性（106）、缺失阶段或必需工具（66）、allowlist违规（55）、冗余或调用次数违规（43）、作用域/过滤违规（13）等。(3) 依赖归因描述性将平均6.34个失败检查压缩至2.65个根因（减少58%）。(4) 规范变体敏感性因模型与框架而异：Revenue在所有三个模型对比的bootstrap交互区间均排除零，但Productivity仅GPT对比排除零。(5) Claude Code在Revenue TXT变体上准确率高于Codex（86.8–95.7% vs. 82.1–92.6%）；未恢复错误集中在Codex运行（38 vs. 5）。(6) 成本：240次运行总计$859.34（平均$3.58），Codex/Claude Code成本比在Claude模型上为5.9–10.2倍（涉及缓存读取差异），GPT模型上为1.0–1.4倍。

Conclusion: 过程级回归测试补充了最终状态评估，模板测试用例在评估的配置间提供可重用回归覆盖；规范敏感性在框架间发生变化，意味着跨框架迁移时应重新评估每个完整技能规范而非假设规范效应可迁移。但纵向验证在实际API演化下的持久性仍是未来工作。限制包括：单一企业系统、每格仅10次试验（统计效力有限）、MD与TXT是捆绑的规范变体而非受控格式干预、聚合套件得分不编码严重程度且依赖链接检查不独立、执行噪声（83/240含工具或框架错误，Codex上未恢复错误集中）、规范覆盖特定企业领域、oracle与评估快照可能漂移、未测试实际演化下的持久性。

Abstract: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

</details>


### [259] [Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01834)
*Yaodong Yang,Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Xingyu Fan,Weixun Wang,Jinpeng Li,Tianpei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究判断模型（如Jev）在单次调用、无推理文本条件下作为智能体动作选择器的适用边界。研究发现Jev擅长"评估"（从输入描述即可判定的决策），但在需要预测输入中缺失信息的"仿真"类决策上失败。核心方案是让代码执行仿真，Jev专注于评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型（如Jev）能在单次调用中返回每个候选动作的概率，无需推理文本，非常适合作为Agent的动作选择层。然而，目前尚不清楚这类模型可以信赖哪些类型的决策。基准测试分数只反映失败率，无法说明具体在哪类决策上失败。认知双过程理论（System One）认为模型会在直觉选项错误时失败，但这与Jev在认知反射测试（CRT）99%正确率矛盾；"小模型缺乏推理"的观点也无法解释Jev能单独正确预测对手动作的现象。需要一种更精确的分析框架来区分判断模型的能力边界。

Method: 1. 定义核心概念：评估（evaluation，正确选项可从输入描述判定）与仿真（simulation，正确选项依赖对缺失信息的预测）。定义"表层捷径"（surface shortcut）与"诱饵"（lure）：前者是仅基于输入表层信息即可选取候选的简单规则。2. 在四个领域测试：认知反射测试（150道题）、一次性矩阵博弈（3×3，210局）、RLHF（ALFWorld文本游戏134+140个回合）、机械臂控制（DM Control Stacker任务）。3. 对比条件：plain只给原始信息；told增加kinray提供的预测；lookahead调用代码fork运行环境预测；JSON保存完整信息。4. 知识探针：单独询问Jev能否正确预测缺失信息（对手动作、下一子目标），对比其在单次调用同时做预测与决策的表现。5. 在ALFWorld中代码fork运行环境执行每条命令，将结果写入选项描述；在机械臂实验中代码用逆运动学与物理引擎实现技能。

Result: 1. CRT：Jev在99%的问题中选出正确答案（人类仅38%），证明其在评估任务上的强大能力。2. 一次性博弈：误导游戏(市占率与均衡不一致)中Jev准确率降至随机水平（33%），但被告知对手动作后升至98%；单独预测对手动作时正确率90%。4. ALFWorld：误导步骤正确率仅36%，88%错误指向诱饵（提及任务对象的命令）；加入lookahead后正确率升至79%，完整游戏完成率从31%升至87%。5. 机械臂控制：原始扭矩控制Jev无法拾起箱子（0/20），但改用代码仿真的技能后在原生任务上超越手写控制器（9 vs 8），在新指令上大幅领先（22 vs 3/40）。

Conclusion: 研究确定了判断模型的清晰能力边界：评估能力强大，仿真能力缺失。失败原因不是缺乏知识（单独询问时能正确预测），而是在单次调用中同时执行仿真与评估的认知冲突。提出"代码负责仿真，Jev负责评估"的分工原则：代码可通过环境副本、物理引擎或单独调用提供预测，Jev则专注于评估预测结果。在这种分工下，Jev在博弈、ALFWorld和机械臂控制中均成为专家级控制器，并在新指令上展现泛化能力。

Abstract: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

</details>


### [260] [On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01842)
*Haochen Zhang,Jiaheng Guo,Zhen Xu,Zachary Plotkin,Nicholas Konz,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统性地研究了时间序列世界模型(TSWM)的设计选择，发现预测误差最低的模型在机制一致性上接近甚至低于随机水平；引入"方向性监督"损失可显著提升一致性而不影响准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的TSWM被构建为以动作为协变量的预测器，仅在已执行计划下训练和评估预测精度。它们用于比较未执行的计划，但模型对改变计划的响应从未被测试。因此存在两个未解决的问题：哪些设计选择真正影响性能？准确的预测器是否会对改变的计划做出与真实系统一致的响应？

Method: 1) 形式化TSWM问题，分离状态、动作和外生输入，区分连续、模式和事件三种动作；3) 引入机制一致性度量MC，基于已知方向(动作对状态变量)的机制关系；3) 构建包含8个公共数据集(12205个系统)的医学基线，涵盖工程基础设施和临床医疗；4) 系统性研究三个设计选择(预测空间、计划融合、计划编码)在7个骨干网络上的表现；6) 提出方向性监督损失，在决策树中惩罚改变动作时反应中错误符号的部分。

Result: 1) 冻结AE潜在空间平均MAE降低9.9%，门控输出融合平均MAE降低12.7%，两者在所有8个数据集上均有效；时间计划编码对平均MAE的影响最多2.2%；2) 预测误差和机制一致性存在矛盾：误差最低的配置在5个有声明机制的数据集上的4个在机制一致性上达到或低于随机水平，没有设计选择能避免这一点；3) 方向性监督可显著提升机制一致性(被惩罚机制一致性>0.99)，MAE无变化；4) 临床场景中模型可能学习到与机制相反的符号，因为药物是响应状态给药的。

Conclusion: 准确的预测器不准确；冻结潜在空间和输出侧约束提高准确率，但机制一致性需要训练目标驱动而非架构驱动；方向性监督可在不损失预测精度的情况下证明机制一致性接近最大值；未来的方向包括扩展到事件动作、临床验证以及闭环控制评估。

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

</details>


### [261] [Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01845)
*Jim O'Connor,Annika Hoag,Sarah Goyette,Gary B. Parker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在三维棋类游戏Dragonchess中两种自适应AI方法（进化迁移学习CMA-ES与时序差分学习TD(λ)）的表现。作者将原PyGame引擎重写为C++引擎，运行了10,000场循环赛并进行统计检验。结果显示两种自适应方法均显著优于手工启发式基线（Jackman）和普通alpha-beta搜索，但两者之间在统计学上没有显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dragonchess作为一种三维棋类变体，其状态空间（约10^63）远大于标准国际象棋（约10^43），且棋子具有跨层移动能力，传统二维棋类的启发式评估函数难以直接迁移。已有工作证明CMA-ES可以进化转移的Stockfish启发式，但尚不清楚基于自博弈的学习方法能否达到同等性能。本文旨在回答：(1) 自适应方法在Dragonchess中是否普遍有效；(2) TD(λ)自博弈学习能否与CMA-ES进化相媲美。

Method: 1. 引擎重写：将PyGame引擎重写为带alpha-beta搜索和置换表的C++引擎，单局约85ms，16线程下约12局/秒。2. 智能体：(a) CMA-ES智能体——14维棋子价值向量进化转移的Stockfish启发式；(b) TD(λ)智能体——通过自博弈学习40维特征线性评估函数（材质+冻结棋子数、Basilisk上方棋子、王临近度等），参数λ=0.7, γ=1.0, 学习率0.05，使用资格迹、批量50局累加梯度、AdaGrad更新；(c) 简单alpha-beta、Jackman手工权重、随机基线。3. 协议：所有智能体使用相同的alpha-beta深度2，仅评估函数变化；每对智能体进行1000场颜色均衡对局，总计10,000场；采用Bradley-Terry MLE计算Elo评分，二项检验和95% Wilson置信区间评估显著性。

Result: CMA-ES获Elo 1678.4（胜率69.0%），TD(λ)获Elo 1653.1（胜率65.3%），两者统计上无显著差异（TD(λ)对CMA-ES决胜局胜率0.503，95% CI [0.463, 0.544]）。两者均显著优于Jackman（Elo 1592.0）和简单alpha-beta（Elo 1595.2）：CMA-ES对Jackman决胜局胜率0.743（p<10^-32），对alpha-beta为0.758（p<10^-39）；TD(λ)对Jackman为0.601（p<10^-9），对alpha-beta为0.560（p<10^-3）。Jackman与简单alpha-beta无显著差异（胜率0.497，p=0.88），证实增益来自评估函数而非搜索。CMA-ES Elo更高源于对弱基线赢得更决绝且和棋率更高。

Conclusion: 两种机制不同的自适应方法（进化迁移学习与TD(λ)自博弈学习）在Dragonchess中达到相同的强度层级，均显著优于手工启发式和默认材质评估，验证了自适应评估方法在结构复杂、新颖棋类领域的普适性。局限：(1) 强智能体间和棋率高达约40%，反映浅层材质主导博弈的特性；(2) 两种方法使用不同的特征参数化（40维vs 14维），未来可进行表示匹配的研究。

Abstract: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

</details>


### [262] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AVSD-Scenes是一个包含12,291条音频-视觉城市场景描述的数据集，基于TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes数据集构建。采用两阶段自动化流水线：先用Qwen2-Audio-7B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B分别生成音频和视觉描述，再用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B和Gemma-3-27B融合生成多模态描述。实验表明多模态描述在语义对齐、跨模态检索和场景分类上优于单模态描述，文本嵌入单独使用即可达94.5%的场景分类准确率，与音视频嵌入融合后提升至95.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的城市音视频场景数据集（如TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes）仅提供粗粒度的预定义场景标签（如"机场"、"公园"），缺乏对场景上下文、活动和音视频交互的自然语言描述，限制了对真实城市场景的丰富语义表征。同时，联合描述音频和视觉信息的配对数据集仍然有限。

Method: 两阶段自动化数据构建流水线：（1）单模态描述生成——使用Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct从音频中识别声音事件并生成音频描述，使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct从视觉中识别物体/动作并生成视觉描述；（2）多模态融合描述生成——使用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506和Gemma-3-27B-it三个LLM融合两类模态的事件和描述，生成30-60词的统一段落描述。评估框架包括：基于CLIP/CLAP/IMAGEBIND的语义对齐与跨模态检索、SVM场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge（Qwen2.5-14B）及人类主观评估（100样本、4名评估者）。

Result: 多模态描述在语义对齐上优于单模态描述：Qwen3融合描述在CLIP/CLAP和IMAGEBIND上分别获得最高平均相似度（0.3021和0.2561）；跨模态检索中Qwen3融合描述的T→A R@1从单模态的24.99%（CLAP）大幅提升至41.43%，IMAGEBIND T→A R@1从24.40%提升至58.55%；场景分类中描述嵌入单独使用即达94.5%准确率，与音视频嵌入融合后达95.4%，显著优于音视频融合基线（82.19%）；移除场景标签后描述仍保持高度场景判别性，证明其捕获了真正的音视频语义而非仅反映标签信息；LLM评判和人类评估均显示低幻觉率和良好的描述质量。

Conclusion: AVSD-Scenes成功展示了通过自动化流水线生成高质量音视觉场景描述的可行性，多模态描述在语义对齐、跨模态检索和场景分类任务上均优于单模态描述，并能捕获超越传统预定义标签的补充语义信息。未来工作将聚焦于进一步扩展数据集规模并通过减少幻觉来改善多模态描述的语义基础。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [263] [Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01936)
*Meghana Sunil,Shravya V,Shravan Venkatraman,Joe Dhanith PR*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的综述，提出以"效率、防御、交互、推理"为四轴的分类法，系统梳理了2020-2025年RAG领域的最新进展，形式化定义了每个轴线的目标函数和参考算法，并讨论了应用、挑战与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG综述多聚焦于核心架构和标准流水线，缺乏对效率优化、安全防御、用户交互和复杂推理等新兴维度的统一分析。作者旨在提供一个结构化、前瞻性的分类框架，以应对RAG系统从实验原型到大规模部署的转变中所面临的系统性挑战。

Method: 采用基于Snyder框架和PRISMA 2020原则的系统文献综述方法，从Google Scholar、Semantic Scholar和arXiv中检索约780篇文献，时间范围为2020年1月至2025年1月。通过关键词检索与引用雪球法相结合的方式，围绕四个研究问题（RQ1-RQ4）构建四轴分类法，并为每个轴线提出形式化目标函数（公式7-10）和参考算法（算法2-5），辅以跨轴对比表（表II）进行方法比较。

Result: 论文构建了四轴分类法：(1)压缩与效率驱动RAG——提出效用-成本目标函数，涵盖查询优化、结构化压缩、领域自适应检索和评估工具四类方法（如RAPTOR、xRAG、Stochastic RAG）；(2)防御性RAG——提出风险惩罚目标函数，整合毒性、隐私和偏见过滤，包含FILCO、SELF-RAG、PoisonedRAG、FairRAG等系统；(3)交互式用户中心RAG——提出用户条件化目标函数，结合查询相关性、历史对齐和反馈兼容性，代表系统有Chat-REC、PersonaRAG、ERAGent、ISEEQ；(4)复杂推理RAG——提出多步KL散度目标函数与一致性正则化，涵盖IRCoT、GenGround、PlanRAG、G-Retriever等。同时，论文还分析了RAG在开放域QA、代码生成、教育和企业部署中的应用，总结了检索瓶颈、幻觉与可靠性、领域适应、可扩展性和可解释性五大挑战，并指出RL增强、神经-符号融合、多模态检索和改进基准四个未来方向。

Conclusion: RAG正从简单的检索-生成流水线演变为自适应、风险感知、认知结构化的知识增强系统。四个轴线（效率、防御、交互、推理）分别对应不同的核心设计张力，在实际部署中需联合优化。未来RAG将向智能体化（agentic RAG）、LLM即检索器（LLM-as-Retriever）和检索规模定律（retrieval scaling laws）方向发展，成为知识密集型AI系统的核心组织原则。需要在可解释性、安全性、领域适应性和评估基准等方面持续突破，才能构建可靠、透明且可扩展的RAG系统。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

</details>


### [264] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种针对开源大语言模型的"反事实审计"方法，用于评估儿科急诊分诊（ESI）任务中的偏见问题。通过对比10个开源LLM在注入人口学/社会经济变量后的预测变化，发现模型规模增大或医学领域预训练并不能保证偏见降低，而经QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型表现出最低的反事实敏感性（5.27%），同时对临床相关的真实病情信息仍能正确上调分诊等级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊是高风险任务，人口学和社会经济因素可能不当影响病情分级。开源LLM越来越多用于本地化临床决策支持，但其反事实偏见在不同模型族、规模、医学领域模型及领域适配模型之间的差异尚不清晰。

Method: 基于352例真实临床档案和245例外部ESI手册风格vignettes，构建配对反事实变体（仅改变一个注入变量，临床呈现保持固定）。评估10个开源LLM（包括Qwen2.5系列、MedGemma变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS系列及QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B）。指标包括任何反事实偏移、下分诊偏移、上分诊偏移、超过1级ESI的显著偏移、平均偏移和平均绝对偏移。此外进行分层分析、共享偏见结果相关性分析，以及临床相关信息的阳性对照实验。

Result: QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B整体敏感性最低（任意偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），而基础Qwen2.5-7B为16.02%和0.1706。部分更大或医学领域模型（如MedGemma-27B-IT、GPT-OSS-120B）显示出更高的显著偏移率。偏移与分层分析揭示了被聚合指标隐藏的临床重要方向性。共享偏见结果相关性在微调后降低。阳性对照显示微调模型对临床相关信息仍能正确上调分诊。

Conclusion: 模型规模或医学领域预训练不能保证更低偏见，而领域微调（QLoRA）能有效降低反事实敏感性。计数反事实审计是一种轻量级、临床可解释的框架，可在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [265] [Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01995)
*Alessandro Chiesa,Ziyi Guan,Burcu Yildiz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究面向依赖预言机的AI计算的零知识验证问题,证明在随机预言机模型下,这类计算不存在零知识证明(即使允许证明者和验证者运行时间远超计算本身),并指出辩论模型同样存在此局限;但若预言机为每个答案附加密码学签名,则可在仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数的假设下,实现对所有预言机辅助计算的零知识验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统日益基于机密数据(如医疗记录、药物分子结构)产生输出,需要在不泄露原始数据的前提下验证输出正确性。现有研究聚焦于验证效率(验证者比计算快得多),但这对一般预言机辅助计算不可行,需额外假设。本文转向隐私维度,探究在允许验证者运行时间为计算多项式级别的情形下,预言机辅助计算的交互式论证能否实现零知识性。

Method: 采用理论密码学方法,基于随机预言机模型证明不可能性:对一般预言机辅助计算,不存在零知识证明方案,且该不可能性同样适用于辩论模型(可扩展监督的典型模型)。在正向结果中,提出"签名预言机"假设——预言机为其每个答案附加密码学签名,在仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数的条件下,为所有预言机辅助计算构造具有高效证明者和验证者的零知识验证协议。

Result: 负面结果:随机预言机模型下,预言机辅助计算不存在零知识证明,即使证明者与验证者的运行时间远超计算本身;辩论模型亦无法绕开此局限。正面结果:若预言机对每个答案附加密码学签名,则可在仅假设抗碰撞哈希函数存在的前提下,为所有预言机辅助计算构造零知识验证协议,具备高效证明者与验证者,且提供一种既不依赖诚实对手(区别于辩论)、也不依赖计算鲁棒性(区别于此前单证明者协议)的可扩展监督替代方案。

Conclusion: 对一般预言机辅助计算而言,隐私(零知识)与高效验证不可兼得;然而,通过对预言机输出附加密码学签名的合理增强,可同时实现零知识性与可扩展监督,为AI输出的机密数据隐私保护提供了新的理论基础与构造路径。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output. We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight. On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

</details>


### [266] [Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02001)
*Hao Wang,Ting Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mingbird是一个本地优先的智能体框架，专为Windows和Ollama环境下的2-9B小型开源模型设计。其核心观点是：小模型在云规模智能体框架下的失败主要归因于框架（harness）缺陷而非模型能力。论文通过自建的LRAB基准（4框架×4模型×18任务=288单元格）与第三方τ²-bench验证了Mingbird在小型模型上显著优于goose、opencode、agent-mini等基线框架（0.886 vs 0.405–0.631），并通过消融实验识别了关键机制（如完成门finish gate、循环检测anti-loop等）的贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型开源权重模型（2-9B参数）已能在普通笔记本上运行，但现有云规模智能体框架无法让它们完成实际任务。具体失败形式包括：工具预填充溢出上下文、自我纠偏发散、工具演示循环、任务被静默放弃。论文主张：这些失败主要源于框架（scaffold/harness）而非模型本身，并将其视为可通过系统工程解决的设计缺陷。

Method: 方法分为三部分：（1）提出Mingbird框架的10个核心机制（M1-M10）加5环安全模型（M14），每个机制针对特定失败形式——M1字节级净零预填充预算、M2聊天/任务分层、M3完成门与计划重注入、M4签名级反循环、M5格式拯救、M6编辑安全（.bak）、M7弹性层、M8安全边界、M9能力面、M10质量基；（2）构建LRAB受控基准，在同一台机器、同Ollama后端、同预算、同评分器下比较4个框架×4个模型（2B-35B）×18个真实任务，发布全部288个单元格的原始数据；（3）通过留一机制消融实验（leave-one-mechanism-out）在2B模型上量化各机制边际贡献。

Result: 主要结果：（1）LRAB上Mingbird总体得分0.886，显著优于goose（0.631）、opencode（0.479）、agent-mini（0.405）；Mingbird是唯一无小模型悬崖的框架（2B得0.821，而基线仅0.017-0.271）；（2）τ²-bench外部验证（278任务，单一本地4B模型，三臂统一协议）：Mingbird 0.856 vs 原生代理0.791、opencode 0.737；（3）前沿模型探测（同一云端模型驱动四框架）：完好的脚手架间差异仅0.072-0.12，但缺陷脚手架埋葬前沿模型一半以上能力（0.997 vs 0.478）；（4）消融实验：完成门贡献最大（Δ=-0.098），验证反馈次之（-0.048），反循环监控（-0.015），平面预填充接近中性（-0.003），但所有任务级自助法置信区间跨零，效果仅作方向性参考。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：对于小模型而言，框架不是外围胶水，而是能力表面的重要组成部分。同一模型、同一预算下，框架选择可决定0.017到0.821的完成率差距。前沿模型探测从另一方向强化了这一归因：当模型接近天花板时，缺陷脚手架可埋没其一半以上能力。LRAB是自建基准且存在作者偏见，因此论文完整发布了全部288个单元格数据以便独立复算或反驳。Mingbird机制（平面预填充、完成门、循环签名）预计可向更大模型迁移，但目前数据仅覆盖至35B档。论文坦承了主要局限：自建基准、单机平台、单次试验评分、开发-评估重叠、长视野任务批次脆弱性等。

Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $\tau^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

</details>


### [267] [Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02005)
*Ionel Eduard Stan,Paolo Napoletano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA），将多LLM委员会的有类型辩论动作视为对候选答案的可归因概率观测，通过经典标注者模型（Dawid-Skene）按智能体可靠性加权推断，从而在持久对抗者存在下产出已校准的后验概率，并能"反转"不可靠智能体而非仅仅将其边缘化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有委员会聚合方法存在双重失败：(1) 置信度衡量"决断性"而非正确性，均匀一致投票虽报告1.0但实际错误率高达18%，多数方法的ECE超过0.15；(2) 无法识别或折损持续不可靠的智能体，结构性地允许中毒成员俘获最终答案。需要同时满足校准性与鲁棒性两个要求。

Method: 核心方法：将协议管控的有类型动作（Propose/Challenge/Concede）按智能体归类为关于候选答案的签名式背书证据；建立每智能体可靠性θ_i的潜变量模型，使用共轭Beta先验（基于~25个校准标签拟合的μ_i = b + κ(r_i - r̄)）并通过CV选择(b, κ, s)超参数；后验为闭式Beta-Bernoulli形式的乘积（公式2），无需任何额外LLM调用。决策规则在K=2时退化为log(μ_i/(1-μ_i))加权多数——Nitzan-Paroush最优委员会规则，μ_i<1/2时权重变负，使对抗者背书成为反向证据。推广到K>2时使用每智能体混淆矩阵P_i(g'|g)的Dirichlet先验，配合温度τ构成复合似然（公式4）。包含五条性质定理（校准性、置信不变性、先验敏感度有界、鲁棒性机制作用域等）和四类消融实验（粒度、估计量、温度、标签效率）。

Result: 清洁数据（二元4500次试验）：BDA per-agent达到ECE_ew 0.016 vs 多数投票的0.160（最佳免费聚合器），决策准确率提升+1.7个百分点（95% CI [+0.010, +0.024]）。K>2时温度τ修复单币模型的过度自信（PubMedQA: 0.30→0.05, MMLU: 0.18→0.04）。对抗稳健性：面对2/3席位的活性隐蔽联盟，二元k=2上混淆模型从0.734提升至0.892，PubMedQA k=2从0.471提升至0.840（对比多数投票分别崩溃至0.369和0.209）。混淆矩阵通过标签置换对照证实捕获语义稳定的错误结构（PubMedQA上标签身份成分贡献+0.10，MMLU位置选项上则无）。经渗者轴测量显示在20%污染窗口即可触发可靠性权重翻负。

Conclusion: BDA将委员会审议重构为每智能体可靠性估计问题，提供零边际成本的校准概率和在持续对抗者下可反转不可靠席位的决策规则。建议部署混淆模型于答案标签跨任务稳定的场景（需周期重拟合），其结构稳定性假设（错误模式持续）是真实边界；位置性K>2选项下让位于堆叠法，策略漂移间以单币模型为安全回退。校准性由交叉验证的先验获得而非定理赋予；后验对自报告置信度逐位不变（性质3），可抵抗奉承式置信膨胀。整体活动约$220，含可亚8B开放权重委员会（每任务$0.0007）的全部可复现性。

Abstract: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

</details>


### [268] [Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02014)
*Michael Baldea,Linda J. Broadbelt,Marianthi G. Ierapetritou,Akhilesh Jain,Ankur Kumar,Thomas A. Kwan,Fèlix Llovell,Andrew J. Medford,Ilias Mitrai,Joel Paulson,Junyi Qiao,Matthew P. Rivera,Kirti C. Sahu,Lev Sarkisov,Zachary P. Smith,Calvin Tsay,Ching-Mei Wen,Victor M. Zavala,Huacheng Zhang,Dan Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于AI/ML在化学工程中应用的全方位综述性perspective文章，由多位国际学者共同撰写。文章系统地讨论了从原子尺度模拟到工业过程操作的AI/ML应用，强调了从纯黑箱方法向混合物理信息框架转变的总体趋势，并呼吁建立计算可重复性的最低标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学工程领域自1990年代以来就讨论AI/ML的应用，但因计算能力、数据可用性和问题复杂度等限制，工业实践中的广泛落地进展缓慢。近年来GPU计算、大数据和大规模ML模型的突破性进展为该领域带来了新的机遇，促使作者全面审视AI/ML在化学工程各子领域的当前能力、核心挑战和未来方向。核心动机在于：解决预测精度、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性和模型全生命周期管理这五大共性挑战，同时推动领域从纯黑箱模型向物理信息混合框架的范式转变。

Method: 文章按化学工程核心学科领域组织为多个章节：第2节概述方法论（监督学习、强化学习、无监督学习、生成模型与基础模型）；第3节讨论动力学、催化与反应工程（MLIPs、机理生成、覆盖度效应、多尺度耦合、动力学提取）；第4节涵盖热力学、传输与流体力学（多相流分析、混合建模、热力学性质预测、状态方程）；第5节讨论分离过程（精馏、吸附剂如MOF、膜材料、过程建模）；第6节聚焦材料与界面科学（图神经网络、通用ML势、自驱动实验室）；第7节涉及过程系统工程（过程与产品设计、过程控制、供应链管理）；第8节探讨工业应用（数字孪生、混合建模、LLM辅助运营、自主运行）。每节均采用"当前能力-剩余障碍-未来机遇"的结构化分析。

Result: 文章综述了AI/ML在化学工程各领域的代表性应用成果，包括：(1) MLIPs实现DFT级精度（0.2-0.5 eV）但速度快数千倍，已能模拟纳米粒子和微米级表面；(2) GNoME项目发现220万个稳定晶体结构，将已知稳定材料数据库扩大一个数量级；(3) MOF设计从筛选转向生成式（MOFDiff、VAE、ChatMOF等）；(4) 自主实验平台（如A-Lab、Bennett的机器人化学家）实现闭环发现；(5) 工业层面预测性维护（如Shell、Marathon Petroleum）显著减少非计划停机；(6) 数字孪生已部署于Chevron等企业；(7) 混合建模在工业生物柴油和发酵过程中展现外推优势。同时文章也明确指出了若干核心障碍：MLIP外推验证困难、生成材料合成可行性差、模型漂移管理、LLM幻觉风险、可重复性标准缺失等。

Conclusion: AI/ML并未取代化学工程的核心原理，而是对其加以放大和增强。文章最核心的结论是：成功的AI/ML应用必须与第一性原理模型深度融合，遵循守恒定律、热力学一致性和结构约束；这一物理信息混合范式正在成为领域共识。面向未来，文章提出六项关键研究议程：(1) 将守恒定律、热力学和稳定性保证更深入地嵌入学习架构；(2) 发展鲁棒的不确定性量化和分布外检测以保障安全决策；(3) 构建可扩展的多尺度框架以连接材料发现与过程性能；(4) 建立统一、可互操作的企业级分析平台；(5) 制定并强制执行计算可重复性的最低标准（代码、数据分割、训练权重、超参数、软件版本等公开）；(6) 扩展开源数据集的可获得性。LLM作为编排器和副驾驶的角色将提升人机协作效率，但在安全关键场景中应仅充当界面角色而非独立推理引擎。整体上，文章呼吁化学工程社区借鉴相邻计算化学期刊的做法，建立可重复性规范，以推动AI/ML从强大工具集真正演变为化学工程的基础设施。

Abstract: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

</details>


### [269] [SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02023)
*Hyeonmin Lee,Zheng Wei,Kyungmin Kwon,Jumin Seo,Jiwon Park,Hayoung Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SPHERE框架，一种面向VR室内场景生成的LLM增强型自适应系统，通过多模态交互偏好学习与人在环强化学习，实现跨会话的持续个性化空间布局生成。核心创新在于将用户的语音与控制器编辑抽象为层次化空间约束（局部功能+全局拓扑），并通过策略梯度动态更新检索重排器，从而在几何形变下保持稳健的个性化生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的3D室内场景合成管线缺乏跨会话的用户偏好记忆机制，导致用户在多次重复编辑相同空间布局时产生持续的交互摩擦与VR环境下的身体疲劳；同时，现有空间推理多依赖绝对笛卡尔坐标或扁平语义图，无法应对几何尺度与长宽比畸变。

Method: 方法基于Holodeck生成引擎构建四个阶段流程：(1) 多模态融合（Whisper语音转录+控制器选择）经LLM意图解析生成原子编辑指令；(2) 会话终端通过DBSCAN聚类构建Local Context（功能区域内的support/alignment关系）与Global Context（区域间邻接与流通路径）的层次化空间上下文；(3) LLM基于预设关系词汇表（near/far/left_of等）提取对象级、区域内、区域间三级符号空间约束；(4) 双阶段检索（GTE粗筛+Cross-Attention重排器）结合Gumbel-Softmax采样，基于VLM对终态俯视图的affordance实现评估生成奖励信号，通过LoRA轻量化策略梯度更新重排器参数。

Result: 42人混合设计用户研究（N=42，2×3因子设计）显示：自适应条件相比基线显著降低修正编辑次数（5.62 vs 8.52, t=4.86, p<.001），物理需求与努力显著降低，NASA-TLX整体负荷差异不显著（p=.185）；SUS可用性（78.3 vs 73.2, p=.034）与系统归因、适应性、信任评分均显著提升。离线消融实验表明，引入Local+Global上下文抽象使Profile对齐率从0.422提升至0.511，并将对象级约束占比从0.75降至0.35，有效抑制浅层属性偏见。在几何扰动（缩放、长宽比压缩）下仍能保持拓扑一致的个性化生成。

Conclusion: SPHERE验证了将多模态交互行为抽象为层次化相对拓扑约束（而非绝对坐标）对于几何鲁棒的沉浸式个性化生成的关键作用，显著减少了VR创作中的重复编辑负担并提升了用户对AI协作的感知智能性与信任度；未来工作需探索约束松弛策略、实时会话内适应及真实场景下长期偏好的漂移建模。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: this https URL

</details>


### [270] [Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02036)
*Xin Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"全局一致性"问题（global coherence problem），即多智能体系统中每个智能体局部决策正确但整体结果错误的现象。作者通过观察混叠不可能性定理证明：当多个不可区分的世界需要不相交的动作时，任何策略（包括推理、角色分解、消息传递或随机化）的最坏情况成功率上限为1/k。本文构建了局部到全局的运行时语义框架𝔛=(H,C,G,F;D)，将拓扑、范畴、群胚、层条件和最小历史状态整合为一个相干性harness规范。框架的核心原则是"模型提议，harness决定"。九项研究表明：(1)在修订基准上，当前沿模型在可见决定事件时40/40正确，隐藏时各测试条件仅12-17/40（与1/3随机一致），加入缺失事实后恢复40/40；(2)TeamBench中普通团队5/5超出共享预算，commit强制执行后0/5超额；(3)τ²-bench Telecom中，当承诺的变更被静默撤销时，普通检查得0.07，coherence harness得1.00。关键结论是局部智能不能替代缺失的全局状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体AI系统日益普及，但存在一个根本问题：每个智能体的每一步决策在局部视角下都是合理的，团队整体结果却可能错误。这是"全局一致性问题"——失败源于共享状态的缺失，而非模型智能不足。现有工作将此问题归咎于模型能力不足，但本文认为更强的模型无法看到其上下文之外的信息。智能体工程实践（context engineering和agent harness）目前依赖经验而非规范，亟需将"什么必须放入智能体上下文"和"harness必须拥有和检查什么"转化为精确的数学规范。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1)观察混叠不可能性定理：给出策略保证有效动作的精确边界——当k个不可区分世界的可接受动作集两两不相交时，最优随机化最坏情况成功率为1/k，b位提示最多提升至1/⌈k/2^b⌉。(2)局部到全局框架𝔛=(H,C,G,F;D)：H是记录作用域重叠的拓扑（hypergraph），C是管理状态变化动作的范畴（composition有序，多数不可逆），G是保留可逆翻译的群oid（检查循环是否回到恒等），F是测试局部视图能否粘合为一个世界的层条件，D是仅保留改变合法未来的区分的最小历史状态（Myhill-Nerode最小化）。该框架将数据库的acyclic schemes、群同步、sheaf语义、双向透镜和乐观并发控制整合为统一的运行时语义。Corollary 4.2证明各结构在对应映射存在时是必要的，不存在时可省略。(3)理论扩展：选择最小充分上下文是NP-hard的（Set Cover归约）；连接树结构下配对检查足够，但循环可使配对检查不足（无固定局部性界限通用）；表示间一致性可在O(|V|+|E|)时间用spanning forest验证（β₁=|E|-|V|+c条检查），但最小修复是Max-Cut-hard；共享预算不能由独立局部检查保护，需commit时强制或拆分quota；commit语义需版本检查+原子提交（Proposition 4.1）。

Result: 九项研究系统验证理论边界：(I) 在受控修订基准上，前沿LLM在40个任务中，可见决定事件时40/40正确；隐藏时低/中/高推理努力分别12/17/14/40，规划器+验证器13/40，5样本多数投票13/39，不能读取事件的工具13/40，均与1/3随机无显著差异；一个权威事实句子恢复40/40，查询工具也达40/40。(II) TeamBench角色重分析（164匹配单元）：移除Planner损失11-14个百分点，移除Verifier损失11-12个百分点。(III) 陈旧推导（确定性，8个用例）：仅局部检查8/8不安全，依赖闭包harness 0/8不安全，二者平局。(IV) TeamBench共享预算：普通团队5/5超额，visible_state 4/5超额，coherent_full 0/5超额；LH2任务中ordinary 5/5，query_counter 4/5，conservative_stop 0/5（停在15），quota_escrow 0/5（平均0.960），coherent_full 0/5（平均0.874）。(V) τ²-bench Telecom（预注册，222集）：注入陈旧读取时unguarded 25/25违规、conventional 24/25违规、coherence 0/25违规；静默撤销时unguarded 0.00分、conventional 0.07分、coherence 1.00分（15/15集）；未注入控制组coherence无错误拒绝。(VI) Sobieski：86案例中，一次sweep 0/86一致，三次sweep 0/86，Gauss-Seidel和coherence guard均86/86，平均35.53次更新调用；40个中期修订案例中，接受混合修订0/40，继续两sweep 0/40，provenance guard和版本感知重启均40/40。(VII) 循环套件（1,800实例）：局部/配对/规范ID 0%检测率，3/4/6-环分别18.3%/43.8%/66.2%，随机循环94.5%，生成森林和群胚下降100%。(VIII) OAEI会议网络2018-2024：45个新网络中23个存在不可见的同本体内身份冲突（51%），7/7年出现；2025年7个系统中6个有冲突。(IX) 拆分视图（60任务，冻结）：单一完整视图智能体0/40隐藏冲突；拆分视图无检查9/40，配对检查9/40，网络检查0/40；网络检查修复使平均F1从0.796降至0.774。所有因果研究在评分前冻结设计并保持模型固定，证明了harness在缺失状态处获胜，在传统机制已拥有状态处平局。

Conclusion: 本文将多智能体系统的全局一致性形式化为独立于模型智能的失败类别，并证明：(1)更强的模型不是缺失信息的修复——观察混叠定理给出不可逾越的1/k边界；(2)更多上下文不是共享状态的修复——拥有20次调用预算的Planner-Executor-Verifier团队在可见计数时仍4/5超额；(3)每次交接检查不是修复——OAEI网络中23/45存在配对不可见的同本体内身份冲突；(4)检查当前状态不是修复——τ²-bench中静默撤销使传统检查得分0.07而coherence harness得分1.00。理论预测了七个可证伪的边界条件，且所有测试均得到支持。核心结论是：局部智能不能替代缺失的全局状态——当多智能体系统失败时，首先应问"哪个区分无人拥有"，而非"是否需要更大的模型"。对智能体社区的实际意义是：多智能体AI不仅需要更大的模型，还需要有目标的context engineering和有规范的harness设计。模型保持随机性，harness拥有决定有效性的状态，检查在commit时进行。这为从单体助手向团队和群体转变的智能体系统提供了形式化基础。

Abstract: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence. Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it. We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit. Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

</details>


### [271] [Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02038)
*Yimeng Liu,Mi Zhang,Younsuk Dong,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Mímir，一个物理基础的大语言模型智能体，用于长周期灌溉管理。该系统采用双时间尺度设计，将语言模型的语义推理能力与可量化的物理控制机制严格区分，确保物理真实性和安全边界不被修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长周期物理控制具有独特挑战：动作改变未来状态、错误跨决策累积、代理必须从经验中学习但不能改写保证执行安全的物理规则。现有LLM代理控制器在短周期任务中有效，但大型长期物理控制场景（如每日灌溉决策需与土壤水动态耦合整个生长季）需要新的设计思路。

Method: Mímir采用两时间尺度架构——快时间尺度通过物理接口和确定性模拟器将LLM输出转化为可验证提议，进行数值检查、修订和有界动作选择；慢时间尺度将反复出现的失败模式整合为持久上下文原则，但保持物理模型、评估器和执行约束不变。具体包括三个机制：(1)物理基础代理接口，定义结构化物理状态和可行动作；(2)模拟器基础的决策修复，包括多项验证修订循环和确定性候选选择；(3)有界经验驱动适应，使用ACE框架在保持安全边界的前提下跨剧集更新状态。

Result: 在密歇根、得克萨斯和科罗拉多三个地点、四种作物的多年回溯评估中，Mímir实现了控制代价100.94±1.80，灌溉量2.58±0.12毫米，比历史调度重放少用约51%的灌溉量，为评估引用中最低成本。消融实验表明：移除前向模拟、验证修订或持久上下文会增加控制代价；模型规模和模型族研究表明，未观察到增加LLM总参数能带来一致的提升。

Conclusion: Mímir设计了一个双时间尺度物理基础LLM代理架构，为长周期物理控制提供了一种将适应学习与执行安全分离的解决方案，同时验证了"推理权威而非物理权威"的设计原则。其核心教训是，持久物理智能体可能将语义推理与有界证据驱动自我改进相结合，同时将物理真理和执行权威保留给显式数值机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

</details>


### [272] [HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02048)
*Tianwei Mu,Shengyan Jiang,Mingzhe Yuan,Qing Luo,Min Xiao,Wenhong Wang,Jun Li,Manhong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HydroJEV 系统，使用一种无需训练的"类型化判断"模型 Jev 作为配水网络 SCADA 异常分诊的第一级筛查层。Jev 在约 1.2 秒内返回类别概率分布，仅需无标签的先验校准，在分布内任务上达到与专家编写的规则树相当的准确率（macro-F1 0.62-0.64 vs 0.56-0.61），在训练标签中未出现的子类型上显著优于监督分类器 0.36-0.42，决策速度比前沿 LLM 快 20-40 倍。当 Jev 的良性判定被规则树确认后才放行的"协议门控级联"（agreement-gated cascade）可在不损失 macro-F1 的前提下为 LLM 审阅者节省 35-38% 的工作量，该级联在 C-Town 及两个迁移网络（Net3、Net1）的新密封测试集上均通过非劣效检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水务 SCADA 报警后需要快速区分网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬变与传感器故障这四类成因，但监督分类器缺乏罕见攻击的标签，前沿大语言模型单次决策耗时数十秒，现有检测基准（如 BATADAL）只评判"是否异常"而不评判"何种成因"，缺乏可在控制室实时部署的分诊方案。

Method: 在 EPANET/WNTR 上以 C-Town 网络为底构建四类成因归因基准（含参考族与三个未见族 A/B/C，其中 C 为"模仿族"）。所有方法接收相同机器可读证据状态（系统描述、控制配置、10 项一致性校验、数字孪生残差 z 分、有符号汇总、源水表平衡），仅作单选 5 分类。Jev 输出后仅做无标签先验校正（40 个开发窗口的均值作先验）。对照基线：六分支规则树 R1、带或不带留一子类型的多项 Logistic 回归 R2、7 个云端 LLM（deepseek-v4-pro、glm-5.2、gpt-oss 系列、gemma4 系列、minimax-m2.7）。分诊级联采用"良性判定 + R1 协议确认"才放行的协议门控策略。采用四轮预注册、加密哈希密封的测试协议，主指标为四类 macro-F1，类分层配对 bootstrap 检验 + Holm 校正，非劣效边界 δ=0.03。

Result: Jev 在四轮密封测试上 macro-F1 平均 0.63（分布内）/0.51（新族），与规则树统计不可区分，但决策时间仅约 1.2 秒。在留一子类型测试中 Jev 平均超过监督 R2 0.36-0.42（全部经 Holm 校正显著）。R2 需要每类至少约 4 个标注样本才能在分布内超越 Jev；少于 4 个时 R2 在 96-97% 的抽样中低于 Jev。前沿 LLM（glm-5.2、deepseek-v4-pro）在分布内准确率显著高于 Jev 但单次决策 30-46 秒，为 Jev 的 20-40 倍。协议门控 LLM 级联在新密封集 E1c、E4c 上对审阅者 non-inferior（差值 +0.011、+0.016），节约 34.5-38.0% 的审阅量，平均决策时间从 42.7-44.2 秒降至 30.0-31.3 秒；迁移至 Net3、Net1 后在 4 个集合中有 3 个通过 non-inferiority。无门控的规则级联在新鲜密封集上未优于其组件。Jev 对隐蔽网络攻击召回率最低（均值 0.34），且对 Net1 的爆管召回仅 0.02。先验校正使 Jev 的 macro-F1 从 0.41 提升到 0.57。

Conclusion: 无需训练的"类型化判断"模型 Jev 可作为配水网络 SCADA 异常分诊的第一级快速筛查层，其在标签稀缺的子类型外推上优于监督模型，速度远超前沿 LLM；与规则树协议确认门控后组成的级联可在不降低准确率的前提下承担约三分之一的审阅负载。该方案无需重训练即可迁移到结构不同的网络，但应用前应在自网络仿真事件上验证各事件类型确实能触发相应校验。隐蔽操作仍是训练免费方法最薄弱的类别，需要后续研究加强。

Abstract: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.

</details>


### [273] [External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02066)
*Kingshuk Gupta,Davide Buscaldi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于LLM内部隐藏状态的细粒度、跨度级（span-level）幻觉检测框架，将幻觉检测从传统的句子级二分类扩展为使用BIO标注方案的token级序列标注任务。同时引入了创新的跨模型监督框架，发现外部观察者（包括较小的模型）可以匹配甚至超越生成模型对其自身幻觉起始的检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM幻觉检测方法主要依赖外部知识检索（如RAG），存在延迟高、无法用于本地隐私部署的问题。内部状态探针虽是有前途的替代方案，但现有方法将检测简化为token级二分类，无法捕捉幻觉的连续结构化边界（如起始和延续）。此外，尚不清楚模型的自我检测是否是幻觉定位的性能上限。

Method: 1. **关键层选择**：计算每层正常与异常隐藏状态之间的余弦相似度，选取差异最大的注意力层和MLP层作为"关键层"。2. **特征提取**：从关键层提取神经元激活分数（NAS），即原始隐藏状态向量的拼接。3. **分类器设计**：采用渐进式架构——MLP基线、BiLSTM、BiLSTM-CRF、BiLSTM-Attn-CRF、BERT-CRF，使用BIO标注（O/B-HALL/I-HALL）。4. **跨模型框架**：一个模型（观察者）从另一个模型（生成器）的生成文本中提取的隐藏状态上检测幻觉。

Result: 1. 内部检测在PR-AUC上达到0.362（vs 随机基线0.024），实现15倍提升。2. 在SmolLM2上，BERT-CRF的B-HALL精确率达到0.54。3. 跨模型检测中，Gemma2监督SmolLM2时B-HALL精确率达到0.63。4. 关键发现：较小的SmolLM2（1.7B）观察较大的Mistral（7B）时，PR-AUC达到0.242，超过Mistral自我检测的0.221。5. CRF层显著提升起始token的精确率（如SmolLM2从0.29提升到0.42）。6. 在极端类别不平衡下，BERT-CRF表现最不稳定。

Conclusion: LLM的隐藏状态包含足够的细粒度信息，可在token级别实时追踪幻觉边界。外部观察者可以匹配甚至超越生成模型的自我检测能力，即使观察者参数规模更小，这表明自我检测并非幻觉定位的性能上限。但该方法目前受限于GPU内存（仅适用于离线分析）、模型规模（<7B）、QA任务以及单一随机种子，是初步的概念验证。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.

</details>


### [274] [Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02070)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出因果记忆策略（CMP），一个通过干预检索过程本身来恢复记忆效用可识别性的因果框架。它将记忆效用形式化为检索介导的因果效应，并使用自归一化逆倾向加权估计器在平衡分配设计下进行估计，识别失败会显著影响现有基于效用的记忆系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的记忆增强大语言模型通过估计每条记忆对任务表现的影响来决定保留哪些记忆，但这些估计完全依赖于已被检索的记忆。当某条记忆从未被检索时，存储层面的干预会产生相同的结果，导致其效用无法被识别——这是一种检索层面的正性违反，传统的因果诊断方法无法检测。

Method: 将记忆增强LLM形式化为结构因果模型（SCM），证明记忆效用通过检索因子化为检索概率与条件效用的乘积。提出CMP框架：保留固定数量的上下文槽位（k个），用已知倾向得分从候选池中进行随机抽样以恢复正性条件；使用Hájek自归一化逆倾向加权估计器在平衡分配设计下估计条件效用；推导出不可逆操作下的贝叶斯最优单边弃权决策规则。

Result: 在LongMemEval和LoCoMo上分别有54%和67%的必需记忆存在识别失败，该问题在Mem0部署系统中依然存在。CMP将必需与非必需记忆的区分度从0.54提升至0.66 AUC，每查询估计达到0.78 AUC。识别出的记忆效用本身不足以决定保留策略：没有一种在保留策略中可用的查询聚合方式能预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。

Conclusion: CMP提供了一个检索介导的因果框架来恢复记忆效用的可识别性，但识别出的效用不能直接转化为保留策略，因为保留决策必须在下一个查询之前做出，而任何可用的查询聚合要么衰减信号，要么退化到保留一切。池选择（pool selection）是仍需解决的主要开放问题。

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [275] [PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02072)
*Lorenzo Cardarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PyPottery是一个面向陶器史文档化的AI开源套件，由四个模块组成（Scan/Ink/Trace/Layout）。它在Montale遗址的50张图纸、240幅陶器画上实现约40倍效率提升，OCR准确率高，解析少量示例即可实现高精度，并通过五位领域专家可用性研究验证（SUS 83.5，A等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陶器记录后期处理（扫描、裁剪、OCR、墨绘、矢量化、排版）耗时巨大，形成"发布瓶颈"，且现有AI工具只解决单环节，缺少一体化开源方案。论文主张AI应增强考古学家的能力（augmentation），重新分配而非取代人工判断。

Method: 四模块流水线——Scan用VLM（Qwen2-VL/olmmOCR）做手写识别+少量示例LLM（Qwen3）解析；Trace用形态骨架化、强度引导追踪、RDP简化、Catmull-Rom贝塞尔平滑、专用轮廓提取，并结合SAM 2做语义分割；Layout用自适应网格与二维装箱算法；Ink采用图像到图像深度学习墨绘。采用Flask/Python实现，本地消费级硬件部署。采用CER/WER、EMA/PMS、Hausdorff距离及SUS评估。

Result: 在250幅画上完整流程耗时103分钟（~140画/小时）；OCR平均CER=6.2%±1.2%，WER=18.6%±3.5%；少示例（5-10个）解析精度达93%，EMA从1示例的13.56%跃升至10示例的67.60%，方差大幅下降（±2.65）；矢量化8.8%需人工干预；五位专家SUS=83.5（A级），感知加速中位40倍·范围17.5~120倍；安装被警告为最大难点。

Conclusion: PyPottery证明了开源、本地、可验证、紧凑的AI考古学工具集能够显著缓解后期记录体验，并通过few-shot标注实现众包交互的学习；其模块化设计允许后期记录链上每一步的选择性使用。未来将收集人工标注数据训练YOLO/SAM2以进一步自动化，并将研究成果进一步流程化为教育材料与跨文化产品。

Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

</details>
