### [297] [Query-efficient winner prediction in district-based elections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00577)
*Koustav De,Debajyoti Kar,Swagato Sanyal*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了在查询模型下预测基于选区选举结果的胜出者所需的查询复杂度。针对Dey、Kar和Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) 提出的两候选人问题，作者将查询复杂度从Õ(1/ε⁶ log²1/δ)（任意选区人口）或Õ(1/ε⁴ log²1/δ)（均衡选区）改进为Õ(1/ε² log(m/δ) log(1/δ))，适用于任意选区人口和任意数量的候选人，且对常数候选人数近乎匹配已知下界Ω(1/ε² log(1/δ))。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于选区的选举制度（美、英、印等）通过地理分区聚合选票，预测其结果在出口民调、计算选举和社交选情调查中具有广泛应用。已有工作局限于两候选人情形且查询复杂度对ε的依赖较差（最高达1/ε⁶），亟需一种能处理任意候选人数和任意选区人口的最优查询算法。

Method: 关键技术包括：(1) 利用最优C可行策略将选区分为三类（𝒱₁,𝒱₂,𝒱₃），通过排序h(d)值并结合εN边际保证，引理4证明存在α∈[ε/16,1/2]使得至少有max{αk,1}个选区中h(d) > εN/(2⁵αg(ε)k)；(2) 定义"W-rich"和"C-poor"选区概念，引理7证明W-rich与C-poor选区数量差至少max{αk-1,0}；(3) 通过对数次的ε和α猜测迭代搜索，使用Bhattacharyya-Dey单选区预测器估计各候选人票数份额；(4) 对任意选区人口，按2的幂次将选区分为不同人口类别𝒱^r，并对每类独立估计。算法（Algorithm 2）以自适应随机方式执行。

Result: 主要结果（定理2）：对于具有任意选区人口和任意候选人数的一般δ-胜者预测问题，若MOV(E)≥εN，则存在算法以至少1-δ的概率正确预测胜者，查询复杂度为Õ(1/ε² log(m/δ) log(1/δ))。特别地，当候选人数为常数时，查询复杂度为Õ(1/ε² log²1/δ)，相对于Dey等人(2023)的ε⁴或ε⁶边界有指数级改进，并且对常数候选人数几乎匹配下界Ω(1/ε² log(1/δ))。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种针对一般基于选区选举的胜者预测器，对常数候选人数具有最优（至多polylog因子）的查询复杂度，对候选人数具有额外的logarithmic依赖。提出了若干未来研究方向：能否去除log m因子（开放问题）；研究其他投票规则下的查询复杂度（如批准投票、Borda计数等）；估计整体选举和单选区边议会的胜利边际幅度。

Abstract: In a district-based election, N voters are partitioned into k districts, and each voter votes for one of m candidates. Each district elects a winner using the plurality rule (i.e. the candidate getting the largest number of votes is declared the winner, breaking ties as per some fixed rule), and the overall winner is determined by applying plurality to the district winners; we assume that there is a unique winner amongst the district winners. The margin of victory of such an election is the minimum number of votes that must be altered so that the current winner ceases to be the unique district winner. We study the problem of predicting the winner of a district-based election in the query complexity model, where one has query access to individual votes. The objective is to minimise the number of queries. This setting captures exit polling, where queries correspond to interviewing voters, and is closely related to problems in query complexity and property testing. Assuming that the margin of victory of the election is at least eps N, Dey, Kar and Sanyal (AAMAS 2023) gave algorithms for the case of two candidates with error probability del and query complexity tilde{O}(1/eps^6 log^2 1/del), which improves to tilde{O}(1/eps^4 log^2 1/del) under the additional assumption that district populations are balanced. Our main result is an adaptive randomised algorithm that, for an arbitrary district-based election and any error parameter del, with probability at least 1-del, predicts the winner correctly using tilde{O}(1/eps^2 log m/del log 1/del) queries. In particular, we improve the bounds of Dey et al. for arbitrary district populations and extend their results to any number of candidates. Furthermore, for constantly many candidates, our algorithm nearly matches a lower bound of Omega(1/eps^2 log 1/del) on the query complexity that holds even for two candidates and a single district.

</details>


### [298] [When Is Deletion Ordering Tractable? From Update Dynamics to Permutation Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01149)
*Xinyu Wang,Ziyu Zhao,Yixuan He,Xiaowen Chang Alex Smola*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究机器遗忘中删除请求的执行顺序问题，将其建模为固定请求集上的排列目标函数，并提出两种独立的结构简化：位置可加性（可化归为指派或排序问题）和后缀定位（仅依赖最近请求），刻画了不同更新动态下何种简化成立的条件及其组合效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在近似遗忘中，请求的删除顺序会影响最终模型，但现有工作仅提供排序规则（如基于不确定性、难度），未刻画由此顺序所诱导的排列优化问题的计算结构。本文旨在回答：何时该排列目标函数具有更简单的结构，从而实现高效优化。

Method: （1）将删除排序建模为排列目标函数 $J(\pi)$，识别两种独立简化——位置可加性（$\rightarrow$ 指派/排序）与后缀定位；（2）在共享仿射更新下，刻画平方终端距离引入的二次项交互，量化偏离可加性的残差，给出排序/指派的近似边界（Proposition 1）；（3）证明收缩性带来 $O(\rho^L)$ 的后缀定位界，通过后缀条件化指派将其改进为 $O(\rho^{2L})$（Proposition 2）；（4）证明两种简化互相独立，且共享严格收缩下仍存在 NP 完全实例（Partition 归约，Proposition 4）；（5）实验在冻结头与全网络（NegGrad+、SalUn）场景中验证结构存在性，通过阻尼牛顿扫描因果检验收缩性的效果。

Result: 理论：两种简化独立可组合；共享仿射下排序/指派有近似保证；严格收缩可实现队列长度无关的后缀定位，但精确优化仍可能 NP 难。实验：冻结头目标支持位置可加性（指派主导），全网络 NegGrad+/SalUn 支持后缀定位；阻尼牛顿扫描中收缩增强使目标向后缀短时依赖转变（斜率约 1.97 vs 预测 2）；从紧凑执行集识别出的结构可迁移到未见过的排列。

Conclusion: 删除排序的计算结构由更新动态与终端目标共同决定：位置可加性消除跨请求-位置交互，后缀定位消除远端历史，二者通过收缩实现互补；二者均可在执行目标中观测到，且结构可从有限执行集迁移到未见顺序。建议将删除排序视为结构识别问题，再据此选择合适的求解器。

Abstract: Given a fixed set of pending deletion requests, retraining from scratch after each request is prohibitive, so a prescribed request-wise policy processes them sequentially. The resulting terminal model can depend on their order. Rather than prescribing an ordering rule, we study the permutation objective induced by the fixed policy and ask when it admits simpler structure. We identify two independent reductions: position additivity represents the objective by request--position costs, reducing optimization to assignment and, with a shared positional profile, sorting; suffix localization removes dependence on the distant prefix while retaining interactions among the surviving requests. Under shared affine updates, we characterize the quadratic interactions that obstruct additivity, prove the reductions' independence, and show that suffix-conditioned assignment improves the approximation rate from O(p^L) toO(p^(2L)). Experiments recover both structures in executed objectives. A controlled damped-Newton sweep shows that stronger contraction shifts the objective toward shorter, more suffix-specific dependence, while two full-network policies exhibit distinct positional and within-suffix structure. Structures identified from compact execution sets also predict unseen orders. These results frame deletion ordering as identifying the computational structure induced by the executed updates.

</details>


### [299] [Improved Lower Bound for Steiner Point Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00177)
*Karthekeyan Chandrasekaran,Chandra Chekuri,Qingyun Chen,Weihao Zhu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究了Steiner点删除问题（Steiner Point Removal, SPR）中可实现拉伸度（stretch）的下界。作者将Chen和Tan之前的下界从 Ω(√(log|T| / log log|T|)) 改进到 Ω(√log|T|)，利用相同的低度数高围长图构造，但通过利用展开性（expansion property）进行了更精细的分析。文章还证明该下界对所用构造实例是紧的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Steiner点删除问题（SPR）旨在找到给定图关于终端子集的minor，使得终端之间的距离以最小拉伸度保持。Filtser已证明 O(log|T|) 的上界，Chen和Tan证明了 Ω(√(log|T|/log log|T|)) 的下界。在此之前上界与下界之间存在显著差距，本文旨在缩小这一差距，改进下界以更接近上界。

Method: 1. 使用低度数高围长Ramanujan图（3-正则图，具有展开性 |δ(S)| ≥ |S|/20，围长 ≥ log k /10）作为基础图 G₀。
2. 为 G₀ 中每个顶点 u 添加一个相邻的终端 t_u，连接边长为 L = ⌈√log k⌉，G₀ 内部边长为1。
3. 关键分析步骤：证明在低拉伸度假设下（α ≤ √log k / 200），每个被收缩到终端的团 B_u 大小 ≤ k/2。
4. 利用展开性通过计数论证（鸽巢原理）证明存在长度为 L 的路径，包含至少 L/60 条"特殊边"（special edges，即连接不同收缩团的边）。
5. 利用高围长性质证明最短路径的唯一性，以及Lemma 5表明每条minor边对应的最短路径恰好包含一条特殊边。
6. 通过案例分析（路径包含或不包含展开路径P）推导矛盾，最终得到 Ω(√log k) 的拉伸度下界。
7. 此外通过简单收缩构造证明该下界对所用实例是紧的。

Result: 主要结果（定理1）：对每个正整数 K，存在图 G 和 k > K 个终端，使得 G 的每个 T-minor 的 ℓ_G-stretch 为 Ω(√log k)。这将 Chen 和 Tan 的下界 Ω(√(log|T|/log log|T|)) 改进到 Ω(√log|T|)，去掉了 log log 因子。此外证明该下界对所用构造实例是紧的（Lemma 8 给出 O(√log k) 的匹配上界）。

Conclusion: 本文成功将Steiner点删除问题的无条件下界改进到 Ω(√log|T|)，主要贡献在于更细致地利用了低度数高围长图的展开性。分析过程采用模块化步骤：先证明低拉伸度下收缩团规模受限，然后利用展开性和计数论证构造包含大量特殊边的短路径，最后结合围长性质推出矛盾。同时证明了此下界对所用实例是最优的，表明进一步改进下界可能需要本质上不同的构造。

Abstract: In the Steiner Point Removal problem, we are given a graph $G=(V,E)$ with an edge-length function $\ell_G: E\rightarrow \mathbb{R}_+$ and a subset $T\subseteq V$ of terminals. The goal is to find a minor $H=(T, E_H)$ of $G$ on vertex set $T$ such that the shortest path metric derived from $G$ on the edges of $H$ preserves the distance between every pair of terminals within a small multiplicative stretch. Filtser proved that a stretch of $O(\log |T|)$ can be achieved (in polynomial time), while Chen and Tan more recently proved a lower bound of $\Omega\left(\sqrt{\frac{\log |T|}{\log\log |T|}}\right)$ on the achievable stretch. Their lower bound is via a simple construction involving low-degree high-girth graphs. The existence of such graphs is guaranteed through the existence of low-degree high-girth expanders. In this work, we improve the lower bound to $\Omega(\sqrt{\log |T|})$ using the same simple construction of Chen and Tan but with a more careful analysis that exploits the expansion property.

</details>


### [300] [A Tight Second-Order Lower Bound for Routing Labels in Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00310)
*Hanqing Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文证明了有根树的designer-port路由标签问题的紧致二阶下界：对于所有n个顶点的有根树，任何路由标签方案在最坏情况下都需要 log n + Ω((log log n)²) 位标签，从而与已知的 log n + O((log log n)²) 上界匹配，确定了二阶项的精确阶数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gawrychowski、Janczewski和Łopuszański给出了标签长度的上界 log n + O((log log n)²)，但他们自己的下界仅为 log n + Ω(log log n)，他们明确提出了一个公开问题：二阶项中的平方项是否必需？即最优标签长度是否真的需要 (log log n)² 这一项。

Method: 证明通过对s的归纳，使用两种树上的概率分布 W_s 和 R_s。对于固定解码器D和标签集合S，归纳命题表明：若 |S| ≤ A_s 则 W_s 在S中的嵌入概率 ≤ s⁻¹⁰，若 |S| ≤ d(s) 则 R_s 在S中的嵌入概率 ≤ e^{−m_s²}。构造 R_s 时使用 k ≈ m² 个大小为 s/k 的独立子树的弱归纳假设，而 W_s 则从一个等质量分布的"码本"C中均匀采样子树大小轮廓。C中的不同码字具有足够大的 L¹ 距离，使得任何单个根标签至多覆盖一个码字，从而通过并集界得到失败概率。

Result: 主要定理（定理1）证明了对所有 n ≥ n_0，任何 designer-port 路由标签方案在最坏情况下需要至少 log n + ε(log log n)² − O(1) 位标签（绝对常数 ε > 0）。结合已知上界，定理2得出最优最坏情况标签长度为 log n + Θ((log log n)²)。

Conclusion: 该工作完全解决了 designer-port 路由标签问题中的二阶项问题，确定了平方项 (log log n)² 是必要的。证明不假设端口分配的约束，也不限制编码器或解码器的计算时间，仅要求方案对所有n顶点树都有效。

Abstract: In the designer-port routing-labeling problem, every vertex of a rooted tree receives a binary label and the child edges receive distinct port numbers. Given only the labels of a source and a destination, a decoder must return the first port on their path. Gawrychowski, Janczewski, and Lopuszanski gave labels of length $\log_2 n+O((\log_2\log_2 n)^2)$, whereas the previous lower bound was $\log_2 n+\Omega(\log_2\log_2 n)$. We prove that every scheme for all $n$-vertex trees needs a label of length $\log_2 n+\Omega((\log_2\log_2 n)^2)$ for every sufficiently large $n$. The result allows arbitrary port assignments and imposes no computational restriction on either the encoder or the decoder. Thus the second-order term in the optimal worst-case label length is determined up to constant factors.

</details>


### [301] [Faster Stable Numerical Polynomial Multiplication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00387)
*Hong Duc Bui*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种简化的稳定浮点系数多项式乘法算法，可在 O(n log p + log n log log p) 时间内计算两个多项式乘积的近似值，并保证小的相对 Newton 误差，时间复杂度和误差界与 van der Hoeven [vdH08] 的算法相同，但常数因子更小且实现更简单。此外，该方法可应用于 Bringmann 和 Cassis [BC23a] 的近凸 min-plus 卷积问题，将其时间复杂度优化一个对数因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: van der Hoeven 在预印本 [vdH08] 中已给出 O(n log(np)) 时间复杂度的稳定浮点多项式乘法算法，但该算法较为复杂。本文旨在给出一个更简单、常数更小的等价算法。此外，独立工作 [BC23a] 解决了近凸 min-plus 卷积问题，作者希望利用本文算法将其加速一个 log 因子。

Method: 算法核心思想是基于系数指数的"下凸包"（lower convex hull）结构，将多项式按几何级数分割成多个子矩形（squares/rectangles）。对每个子矩形：
1. 通过线性缩放（linear scaling, Proposition 1）将其映射为整数卷积问题；
2. 利用整数多项式乘法的 Kronecker 替换 + FFT 在 O(M(n)) 时间内完成；
3. 通过贪心构造的覆盖序列 r̄（保证两矩形边长比不超过常数 κ，Proposition 3）保证整体时间复杂度线性化；
4. 误差分析采用"相对 Newton 误差"度量（Definition 5），即用精确乘积的对数凸包 Ǎ 作为分母的逐项相对误差上界。
关键技术包括：Lemma 4（凸函数可被仿射函数近似）、Lemma 6-8（重叠矩形面积界）、Proposition 4（证明总周长 O(n·p)），以及利用方根查找表实现 RescaleRound 的 O(L log L) 时间。

Result: 主要结果：
- Theorem 1：算法 ApproximateConvexConvolution 返回结果的相对 Newton 误差至多为 ε·n。
- Theorem 2：算法可在 O(n log p + log n · log log p) ≈ O(np log(np)) 时间内实现。
- 推论（应用于 min-plus convolution）：将 Bringmann-Cassis 在 [BC23a] 中近凸 min-plus 卷积的时间复杂度从 Δ·logloglogΔ 改进为 Δ·logΔ，减少一个对数因子。
- 另外，论文指出 [vdH08] 中存在分析错误（关于 FFT 范数的等式声明），修正后其误差界与本文基本一致。

Conclusion: 本文给出了一个结构更清晰、常数更小的浮点多项式稳定乘法算法，达到了与现有最佳算法相同的渐近复杂度 O(np log(np))。该方法的核心是利用系数指数的凸性将问题分解为多个几何级数子问题，并通过线性缩放与整数 FFT 卷积高效求解。同时该技术可推广至近凸 min-plus 卷积问题，带来一个 log 因子加速。论文还修正了先前工作中关于误差分析的一个错误，并详细论证了"相对 Newton 误差"这一误差度量作为稳定性指标的合理性。

Abstract: In the preprint [vdH08], van der Hoeven considers the problem of multiplying two polynomials with floating-point coefficients, and give an algorithm to compute the product with small relative Newton error in time $O(np \log(np))$, where $n$ is the degree and $p$ is the required precision. In this paper, we describe a significantly simpler algorithm with the same time complexity and error bound. Independently, Bringmann and Cassis considered the near-convex min-plus convolution problem in [BC23a], and presented an algorithm to solve that problem. We observe that our algorithm can be adapted to that problem to speed up Bringmann and Cassis' algorithm by a logarithmic factor.

</details>


### [302] [Dynamic Connectivity, Minimum Spanning Tree, and 2-Edge Connectivity with Polylogarithmic Worst-Case Update Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00491)
*Simon Meierhans,Maximilian Probst Gutenberg,Yu-Cheng Yeh*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文给出了连通性、最小生成树（MST）和2-边连通性的全动态算法，最坏情况更新时间为 polylog(n)（即Õ(1)）。这些算法是随机化的，对自适应对手以高概率成功，将现有的次多项式更新时间改进为多项式对数级。算法中唯一的随机性来源于静态扩展器分解的计算，确定性扩展器分解算法将直接导致三个问题的确定性算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连通性、MST和2-边连通性是动态图论中的基础问题。此前MST和2-边连通性的最坏情况更新时间为次多项式（subpolynomial），未能达到 polylog 级别。本文旨在将这三个问题的最坏情况更新时间统一改进为 Õ(1)，并探索确定性扩展器分解对去随机化的潜力。

Method: 方法核心是动态核图框架，交错使用动态边稀疏化和点稀疏化构建层次结构。
1. **MST边稀疏化**：利用 Wulff-Nilsen 的核心洞见（Observation 2.1），将边按权重分层。将图分解为低权重边集 E_low 上的 φ-扩展器分解，并区分平衡情形（最大扩展器 ≤ |V|/2）与不平衡情形（存在大型扩展器）。平衡情形递归处理各扩展器并保留跨分量边；不平衡情形为每个小分量顶点保留通往大扩展器的最低权重边。利用最坏情况扩展器修剪处理动态删除，每层仅增加 Õ(1) 边。
2. **2-边连通性边稀疏化**：将图分解为 ϕ-扩展器，对每个扩展器 G[X_i] 维持局部最大生成森林 F̄_X。利用"体积覆盖"和"切割覆盖"概念维护非桥边集合 N。体积覆盖利用扩展器性质隐式维护覆盖信息（小分量体积 < 2γ/φ 时切割覆盖），通过质心分析保证每次更新仅 Õ(1) 条边改变覆盖状态。
3. **完整动态算法**：通过维护 Λ+1 层图 G_0 ⊇ G_1 ⊇ ... ⊇ G_Λ，其中 G_Λ 接近生成森林。每层使用边稀疏化器，层间使用核心图（点稀疏化），并通过周期性重建和背景计算实现最坏情况更新时间。2-边连通性通过嵌套森林 F_0 ⊆ F_1 ⊆ ... ⊆ F_Λ 累积覆盖信息。

Result: 给出了三个问题的全动态算法，最坏情况更新时间为 Õ(1)（polylog(n)）：
- 连通性：确定性扩展器分解假设下，算法最优（Las Vegas 随机化，对自适应对手）。
- MST：将 Nanongkai-Saranurak-Wulff-Nilsen [FOCS'17]、Jin-Sun [FOCS'21] 的次多项式时间改进为 Õ(1)。
- 2-边连通性：将 Jin-Sun-Thorup [SODA'24] 的次多项式时间改进为 Õ(1)。
算法仅在静态扩展器分解步骤使用随机性，确定性扩展器分解将直接去随机化三个算法。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入新的边稀疏化技术（针对MST和2-边连通性），将全动态连通性、MST和2-边连通性的最坏情况更新时间统一推进到 polylogarithmic 级别，结束了MST和2-边连通性长期停留在次多项式时间的局面。新颖的层级构造与扩展器分解的解耦是核心创新，使得确定性扩展器分解成为去随机化所有三个问题的关键突破口，对连通性问题本身的简化也是新颖的贡献。

Abstract: We give fully dynamic algorithms for maintaining connectivity, minimum spanning tree, and $2$-edge connectivity of a graph with worst-case polylogarithmic update time. Our algorithms are randomized and succeed with high probability against an adaptive adversary. For the minimum spanning tree and $2$-edge connectivity problems, this improves over the subpolynomial update time bounds obtained by Nanongkai, Saranurak, and Wulff-Nilsen [FOCS'17], Jin and Sun [FOCS'21], and Jin, Sun, and Thorup [SODA'24], respectively. The only randomized component of our algorithms is the computation of static expander decompositions, and a deterministic algorithm for said problem would directly imply deterministic algorithms for all three problems. This reduction is novel even for the connectivity problem.

</details>


### [303] [Faster Algorithms for Finding Small Induced Patterns in Sparse Host Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00567)
*Priyanshi Agrawal,Balagopal Komarath*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究在稀疏宿主图中检测固定模式图作为诱导子图的高效算法。作者定义了树分解的 (p,q)-宽度新概念，并构造满足自同构避免条件的特定树分解，由此推导出多个模式图在 O~(n^p · m^q) 时间内的检测算法，并在宿主图稀疏时严格优于已有结果。对于二部图中的偶数长路径与偶数圈，作者进一步利用基于模式的结构多项式得到无限模式族的更快算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Nešetřil–Poliak 算法（41 年前）一直是检测固定 k 顶点模式图诱导子图的主要通用上界，唯一更快的结果局限于极少数固定模式族。现实中的宿主图通常是稀疏的（边数远少于 n²），但现有算法对稀疏图的运行时间优化不足。针对该问题，本文希望同时以顶点数 n 和边数 m 为参数推导出更快且适用范围更广的检测算法。

Method: 1. 定义 (p,q)-宽度树分解：若每个 bag 中的顶点在去掉至多 p 个顶点后，其余顶点可被至多 q 条边的端点覆盖，则该树分解具有 (p,q)-宽度。
2. 给出在 O~(n^p · m^q) 时间内为同态多项式构造大小为 O(n^p · m^q) 的算术线路的算法（动态规划，对 Díaz–Serna–Thilikos 方法的精化）。
3. 通过在树分解各 bag 中加入顺序约束作为"自同构避免条件"，并结合在特征为 2（或其他素数）的环上的求值与 Koutis–Williams 的多线性单项检测技术，将同态多项式转化为诱导子图多项式，从而检测诱导模式。
4. 对 5、6、7 顶点的具体模式图（包括 5 顶点的 5 个图、6 顶点的 65 个图、以及 P₇ 与 C₇）显式构造满足条件的树分解。
5. 对二部图中偶数长度路径 P_{2k} 与偶数圈 C_{2k}，引入基于模式的结构多项式（利用树分解结构而非仅宽度），利用二部图中无奇圈的性质自动消除多余超图。

Result: 主要结果包括：
• 至少 5 个 5 顶点连通图可在 O~(nm) 时间内检测。
• 至少 65 个 6 顶点连通图可在 O~(m²) 时间内检测。
• P₇ 与 C₇ 可在 O~(nm²) 时间内检测；其中 C₇ 的算法在标准复杂性假设下最优。
• 对 P₅、P₆、P₇，分别改进了之前 Hoàng–Kaminski–Sawada–Sritharan 的最佳结果（在 m = Θ(n^{1+ε}) 时严格更快）。
• 对二部图中偶长路径 P_{2k}，给出 O~(m^{k-1}) 时间算法；对偶长圈 C_{2k}，给出 O~(nm^{k-1}) 时间算法，均优于一般图上的最佳已知上界。

Conclusion: 本文通过引入 (p,q)-宽度树分解及自同构避免条件，扩展了同态多项式算术线路技术在稀疏宿主图上的应用，对固定模式图的诱导子图检测给出了一系列改进算法。该框架适用于大量 5 至 7 顶点的小模式图，并在稀疏图（m = o(n²)）情形下严格快于现有方法。通过引入基于模式的结构多项式，方法还能推广到二部图中偶长路径与圈等无限模式族。本文对完整分类小模式图的算法复杂度具有积极推动作用。

Abstract: We study algorithms for detecting induced subgraphs corresponding to fixed pattern graphs in host graphs. We show that at least five of the 21 connected graphs on five vertices can be detected in time roughly the product of the number of vertices and the number of edges, and that at least 65 of the 112 connected graphs on six vertices can be detected in time nearly quadratic in the number of edges. We also give algorithms for detecting induced paths and cycles on seven vertices, running in time roughly the number of vertices times the square of the number of edges. Our main technical tool is a generalized notion of tree decomposition width, called (p, q)-width. It yields algorithms whose running times depend on both the number of vertices and the number of edges, and are never worse than existing bounds. Whenever the host graph has fewer than roughly quadratically many edges in its number of vertices, our bounds are strictly faster. For some patterns, including the seven-vertex cycle, our algorithms are optimal under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions. We further develop this approach using pattern-based polynomials that exploit the structure of tree decompositions, not just their width. This gives algorithms for detecting induced paths and cycles on an even number of vertices in bipartite graphs, running in time roughly the (k-1)-th power of the number of edges for paths on 2k vertices, and that same bound times the number of vertices for cycles on 2k vertices. These are faster than the best known algorithms for general graphs.

</details>


### [304] [The Power of Two-Choice Linear Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00688)
*Amir Azarmehr,Michael A. Bender,William Kuszmaul,Rose Silver*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究允许使用两个哈希函数的有序线性探测哈希表，分析不同插入策略对期望插入和查询时间的影响。核心结论：(1)贪心策略将传统单选的 Θ(ε⁻²) 插入和 Θ(ε⁻¹) 查询均改进为多项式级更优；(2)非贪心不可变策略实现 O(log ε⁻¹) 查询和 O(ε⁻¹) 摊销插入（在不可变策略中达到最优）；(3)若允许驱逐（可改变已有元素使用的哈希函数），则可实现 O(1) 查询与 O(ε⁻¹ᐟ²) 插入，即使表满亦然。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Knuth 1962 年证明单选线性探测插入时间为 Θ(ε⁻²)，聚类效应导致查询时间 Θ(ε⁻¹)，远非 Peterson 1957 年期望的 O(log ε⁻¹)。即使近年 Bender 等人的"墓碑哈希"改进了插入，查询仍无法突破 O(ε⁻¹)。自然的问题：引入第二个哈希函数能否打破此瓶颈？理论上对此几乎未被研究。

Method: 三个主要技术贡献：(1) 对经典单选线性探测给出新的"时变"势函数分析（区分正反馈循环与合并/团块两个效应），证明期望势能 ≤ ε⁻²；(2) 通过定义"截断电位"Φ_T 与"长电位"Φ_L，引入"imbalanced"游程袋概念，用 Chernoff/McDiarmid 不等式证明贪心策略使势能以 ε⁻⁽²⁻Ω⁽¹⁾⁾ 增长；(3) 第二部分用分块数据结构（块大小约 ε⁻¹）维持"自由槽均匀随机"不变量，以策略概率 1/2 + (fr(B₁)/|B₁| − fr(B₂)/|B₂|)/(2ε) 选择哈希，使每个自由槽被选概率恰为 fr(B)/(εn)；(4) 第三部分设计"飞镖投掷"算法：Phase 1 用 h₁ 填充至 1−ε₀，Phase 2 为每个自由槽分配约 1/√ε 个"目标槽"，每次插入 h₂ 命中目标槽成功概率 Θ(√ε)。证明目标区域大小、飞镖总次数、j₂−h 均期望 O(1)。

Result: 三个主定理：(1) 贪心两选线性探测插入 O(ε⁻⁽¹⁺ᶜ⁾)，查询 O(ε⁻ᶜ)，c∈(0,1) 常数（实验推测 c>0.5）；(2) 非贪心不可变算法查询 O(log ε⁻¹)，摊销插入 O(ε⁻¹)，并给出 Ω(log ε⁻¹) 匹配下界；(3) 带驱逐算法查询 O(1)，插入 O(ε⁻¹ᐟ²)，对任何 ε 包括表满均成立。实验中 100,000 大小表满载时平均查询仅 ≈2.2 次探测。

Conclusion: "二选一的力量"在线性探测中比负载均衡场景更为惊人：不仅能将查询改进至 O(log ε⁻¹)，通过允许驱逐更可实现 O(1) 查询与亚 ε⁻¹ 插入。该工作揭示了双哈希函数在线性探测中尚未被理论界充分认识的强大能力，并为高负载实际哈希表设计开辟了新方向（实验显示性能与离线最优可表达几乎一致）。配套实验论文将进一步验证实用性。

Abstract: This paper considers the following basic question: If an (ordered) linear-probing hash table is allowed \emph{two} hash functions, instead of one, how does this change the expected insertion and query time, as a function of the load factor $1 - \epsilon$? We prove that the \emph{greedy two-choice insertion strategy} achieves polynomially better bounds than the single choice algorithm, but that one can even do \emph{much better} by using more sophisticated non-greedy strategies. Specifically, we show that there is an insertion strategy that does not evict elements (once an element is inserted, its hash choice is fixed) and that achieves expected query time $O(\log \epsilon^{-1})$ with expected insertion time $O(\epsilon^{-1})$. We then further show that, if one is allowed to evict elements (i.e., to change over time which hash function a given element uses), then it is possible to achieve expected query time $O(1)$ with expected insertion time $O(\epsilon^{-1/2})$. This final result achieves an expected query time of $O(1)$ even when the hash table is filled to $100\%$ full. Combined, the results reveal that there is a surprisingly strong ``power of two choices'' phenomenon for linear-probing hash tables, allowing for a two-choice hash table to achieve significantly better bounds than what might at first seem to be possible.

</details>


### [305] [Sparsification Framework for Directed Densest Subgraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00846)
*Slobodan Mitrović,Theodore Pan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对有向最密子图（DDS）问题，提出了一种新的稀疏化框架 Peel-Sample，通过单次低度顶点剥离加均匀采样将图压缩至 Õ(n) 条边，同时保持 (1-ε) 近似比。该框架在多个内存受限模型（半流式、近线性 MPC、亚线性时间）中均取得了对现有结果的显著改进，特别是首次实现了单遍半流式 (1-ε)-近似 DDS 算法，弥合了有向与无向最密子图在半流式设定下的近似差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有向最密子图（DDS）在欺诈检测、社区挖掘、计算生物学等领域有广泛应用，但在内存受限的子计算模型中（半流式、MPC、亚线性时间）存在根本性困难：均匀采样需要 Ω(n^{1.5}) 条边才能保持常数近似，而剥离方法需要 Ω(log n) 次迭代且只能达到 0.5 近似。核心问题在于：是否存在一种方法能将图稀疏化到 Õ(n) 条边，同时保留 (1-ε)-近似 DDS。

Method: 核心方法 Peel-Sample 框架包含两个关键步骤：(1) 精炼均匀采样——利用参数 D（密度）和 z=√(|S*|/|T*|），以概率 p ∝ max(z,1/z)/(ε²D) 采样，使样本量为 O(n·log n·max(z,1/z)/ε²)；(2) 单次低度剥离——仅在一侧（S 或 T）执行一次剥离，当 z≥1 时移除 T 中度数低于 cDz 的顶点。关键洞察是：第一次剥离后，若结果不是高密度子图，则边数会以 max(z,1/z) 因子大幅减少，与采样开销精确对消，最终得到 Õ(n/ε²) 条边的稀疏化图。此外，对于单遍半流式，提出了一种新技巧：对每个顶点预先移除前 τ-1 条流边，使剥离和采样可在单遍中同步进行。

Result: 本文在三个内存受限模型中均超越现有最优结果：(1) 半流式：两遍算法使用 Õ(n/ε²) 内存达到 (1-ε) 近似；首次实现单遍 Õ(n/ε³) 内存达到 (1-ε) 近似，将先前 [BKV12] 的 O(log n) 遍 (0.5-ε) 近似提升至单遍常数近似，弥合了有向与无向 DS 的差距；(2) 近线性内存 MPC：O(1) 轮 (1-ε) 近似，改进先前 [MP24] 的 O(√log n) 轮 (0.5-ε) 近似；(3) 亚线性时间：Õ(n) 时间/空间/查询的 (1-ε) 近似，较先前 [EHW16] 的 Õ(n^{1.5}) 提升 √n 倍。

Conclusion: 本文通过揭示"第一次剥离的独特作用"这一新洞察，建立了一套适用于有向最密子图的通用稀疏化框架 Peel-Sample，成功将图压缩至近线性规模的同时保持 (1-ε) 近似。该框架统一解决了半流式、MPC 和亚线性时间三个关键场景中的开放问题，特别是彻底关闭了有向与无向最密子图在半流式设定下的近似差距。作者预期该稀疏化思想（剥离与采样的组合）对密集子图及相关优化问题在受限计算环境中的研究具有更广泛的借鉴意义。

Abstract: We develop a new approach for computing approximate directed densest subgraphs (DDS). Our main result is a sparsification procedure that reduces a directed graph $G$ on $n$ vertices to a graph with $n \cdot \text{poly} \log n$ edges while preserving enough structure to recover an approximate DDS of $G$. Instantiating this framework in several memory-constrained settings, we obtain the following improvements over the state of the art: In semi-streaming, we obtain a single-pass algorithm that computes a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate DDS. Previously, the only semi-streaming algorithm that computed a constant approximation of DDS was by Bahmani, Kumar, and Vassilvitskii (2012), providing a $0.5-\varepsilon$ approximation in $O(\log n)$ passes. Hence, our work completely closes the approximation gap between undirected and directed DS in the semi-streaming setting, matching the $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate undirected DS algorithm by Esfandiari, Hajiaghayi, and Woodruff (2016). In the near-linear-memory MPC regime, we obtain an $O(1)$-round algorithm for $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate DDS, improving over the $O(\sqrt{\log n})$-round $(0.5-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm of Mitrović and Pan (2024). In the sublinear-time setting, we obtain an algorithm using $\tilde{O}(n)$ time, space, and oracle queries to compute a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate DDS, improving over the $\tilde{O}(n^{1.5})$ time, space, and query algorithm of Esfandiari, Hajiaghayi, and Woodruff (2016).

</details>


### [306] [Beyond odd characteristic: Faster isomorphism testing of 2-groups of Frattini class 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00874)
*Joshua A. Grochow,Gábor Ivanyos,Youming Qiao,Xiaorui Sun*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对有限群同构问题中的关键难点——特征2下的2-群Frattini类2同构问题——提出了首个亚对数时间的算法。具体而言，作者设计了运行时间为N^{O((log N)^{1/2})}的算法，可判定两个阶为N的Frattini类2的2-群是否同构。这是首个覆盖对数意义上几乎所有2-群的N^{o(log N)}时间同构判定算法（依据Higman-Sims的枚举结果）。其核心技术贡献是首次给出F_2上二次型空间/元组等距问题的非平凡算法，结合代数与组合方法，并首次将Luks的有限矩阵群算法应用于p-群同构的最坏情形复杂性研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有限群同构问题（GpI）的最坏情形时间复杂度长期停留在N^{Ω(log N)}。p-群（特别是类2的p-群）是公认的主要瓶颈。近年来，Sun (STOC'23)、Ivanyos-Mendoza-Qiao-Sun-Zhang (FOCS'24)、Grochow-Qiao-Stange-Sun (STOC'25) 等工作已将奇素数p的类2 p-群同构推进到N^{o(log N)}时间。然而p=2情形（按Pyber型枚举猜想占据群同构类的大多数）几乎无进展。此外，p=2下交替矩阵元组等距算法中至关重要的"提升"步骤因需要除以2而失效，块对角化的唯一性也不再成立。Frattini类2的2-群在渐近对数意义下构成几乎全部2-群（Higman-Sims定理），因此攻克此类问题对推进GpI与图同构（GI）均具有核心意义。

Method: 论文的技术路线分三步：(1) 利用Higman关于Frattini类2 p-群的判据及F_2上对称矩阵与二次型空间的对偶关系（Fact 3.5），将Frattini类2的2-群同构问题归约为F_2上的二次型空间等距问题；(2) 利用张量同构归约算法（Ivanyos等）结合对偶空间与"非退化"化简，将二次型空间等距问题归约为二次型元组等距问题，并建立关键引理（Theorem 4.19）；(3) 设计二次型元组等距算法：先建立交替矩阵元组在F_2上合同作用下的新块对角化理论（Theorem 5.1/Corollary 5.3），定义"标准合同块对角化"，然后将最小左右块按出现频率分为"频繁块"与"稀疏块"。频繁块情形采用基于局部操作的组合方法枚举（时间2^{O(n(ρ+r))}）；稀疏块情形利用矩阵代数𝒜的Jacobson根构造正规2-子群R=[G:G∩(I+Rad(𝒜))]≤2^{nD}，将问题转化为Luks-Miyazaki的单向量传递问题（向量传输问题），在多项式时间内求解；最后用Δ=1/2统一两者得到总时间2^{O((m+n)^{1.5})}。证明Theorem 1.1时将m与n取为log N量级即得N^{O((log N)^{1/2})}。

Result: 论文主要结果：(i) Theorem 1.1——首个针对Frattini类2的2-群同构的N^{O((log N)^{1/2})}时间算法，覆盖对数意义上几乎所有2-群；(ii) Theorem 1.2——F_2上二次型空间等距问题的时间2^{O((m+n)^{1.5})}算法；(iii) Theorem 1.3——F_2上二次型元组等距问题的时间2^{O((m+n)^{1.5})}算法。其中关键技术结果包括：交替矩阵元组合同块对角化理论（Theorem 5.1）、频繁块组合算法（Theorem 6.2）、稀疏块代数算法（Theorem 7.2）及综合分解（Theorem 8.2）。此外，附录A构造了F_2上交替矩阵元组最小合同块对角化不唯一的实例，说明特征2下不能简单沿用奇特征情形的方法。

Conclusion: 本文突破了长期停滞的特征2下p-群同构问题，建立了首个覆盖几乎所有2-群的亚对数时间算法。其方法学贡献在于：首次将Luks的矩阵群算法（向量传递问题/单值群方法）应用于p-群同构的最坏情形复杂性研究；建立了特征2下合同作用的块对角化理论；发展了"频繁/稀疏块"二分与组合-代数混合算法框架。这一进展对群同构与图同构的算法-复杂性理论都有深远影响，并为进一步将结果推广到一般类2 2-群（需要处理ℤ/2^k ℤ上的二次型）和更高阶线性代数同构问题（如张量同构）开辟了道路。遗留的开放问题包括：消除时间复杂度中的2次幂指数（从1.5降至1）以与奇特征情形匹配，以及将方法扩展到非Frattini类2的一般2-群。

Abstract: The finite group isomorphism problem asks whether two finite groups of order $N$ are isomorphic. The first algorithm, attributed to Tarjan (see Miller, STOC '78), runs in time $N^{\log N + O(1)}$. Despite intensive study, the current best known algorithm has a running time of $N^{(1 / 4 + o(1))\log N}$ (Rosenbaum, '13). $p$-groups of class $2$ have been recognized as the major bottleneck for faster group isomorphism. Recent progress has led to $N^{o(\log N)}$-time algorithms for $p$-groups of class $2$ where $p$ is odd (Sun, STOC '23; Ivanyos--Mendoza--Qiao--Sun--Zhang, FOCS '24; Grochow--Qiao--Stange--Sun, STOC '25). However, the case of $p=2$, which represents the majority of $p$-groups of class 2 assuming a well-known conjecture in group enumeration, remained elusive, with essentially no progress until now. In this paper, we present an algorithm for testing the isomorphism of two 2-groups of Frattini class 2 of order $N$ in time $N^{O((\log N)^{1/2})}$. To our knowledge, this is the first $N^{o(\log N)}$-time isomorphism algorithm for a class of $2$-groups that constitutes logarithmically almost all $2$-groups, in the sense that $\lim_{N \to \infty} \frac{\log(\text{\# 2-groups of Frattini class 2 and order } \leq N)}{\log(\text{\# 2-groups of order} \leq N)} = 1$. As our main tool, we present the first non-trivial algorithms for the quadratic form space/tuple isometry problems over $\mathbb{F}_2$. These algorithms rely on combinations of combinatorial and algebraic ideas, including finite matrix group algorithms developed by Luks (FOCS '92). As far as we know, this is the first time that matrix group algorithms are used to make progress on the worst-case complexity of $p$-group isomorphism.

</details>


### [307] [A Faster Auction Algorithm for Weighted Matroid Intersection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00920)
*Tatsuya Terao*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个简单的确定性拍卖算法，用于求解加权拟阵交集问题（weighted matroid intersection）。在独立oracle模型下，给定两个拟阵，算法使用 O(nε⁻²log²n) 次独立oracle查询即可返回 (1−ε)-近似最大权公共独立集。这是首个查询复杂度关于 n 近似线性且关于 1/ε 多项式的确定性 (1−ε)-近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权拟阵交集是组合优化中的基础问题，具有广泛的应用（如二部图匹配等）。在独立oracle模型下，设计查询复杂度关于 n 近似线性、关于 1/ε 多项式的 (1−ε)-近似算法是近年来的研究热点。此前序列工作（SODA'16、ICALP'24、IPCO'26等）虽然取得进展，但Dudeja-Grilnberger的约化方法产生了 (1/ε)^(1/ε) 的ε依赖。本文旨在将Huang-Kobayashi针对无权拟阵交集的拍卖算法和Liu-Ke-Khuller针对加权二部匹配的拍卖算法分析相结合，获得关于 n 近似线性、关于 1/ε 多项式的确定性算法。

Method: 算法（Algorithm 1）通过多个阶段（phase）运行，每个阶段固定当前公共独立集 X* 及对应的效用函数 q*（基于价格 p 和效用 u 的离散化版本），并计算 q*-最大基 B。在阶段内部，扫描所有未在 X* 中的元素 e，根据可接受条件（属于 q*-最大基的span、效用为正、且满足阈值条件）将其加入中间集 Y，并尝试将其加入独立集 X（通过交换或直接插入）。算法维护元素势能 Φ_items = π(X)，并通过二元搜索技术（Lemma 5）以 O(log n) 次查询计算价格 p_X(e)。势能函数 Φ = 2Φ_items + log(1+ε)·Σ R_{λ/(1+ε)}(span_1{q_X(e)≥λ})，其中 R_u(F) 为残差值。最终，通过 Lemma 12 证明 OPT ≤ Φ_items + q*(X*) + (1+ε)Δ，通过 Lemma 17 证明每阶段势能增加 ≥ Δ_t·log(1+ε)，以及 Lemma 19 证明势能上界 8·OPT·log(2n)，从而推出 (1−5ε)-近似。阶段数 T = O(ε⁻² log n)，每个阶段 O(n log n) 查询，总复杂度 O(nε⁻² log² n)。

Result: 本文证明：对于加权拟阵交集问题，存在确定性 (1−ε)-近似算法，使用 O(nε⁻²log²n) 次独立oracle查询（Theorem 1）。这是首个关于 n 近似线性、关于 1/ε 多项式的确定性 (1−ε)-近似算法。此外，通过对Dudeja-Grilnberger约化方法进行微小修改并结合相应分析，算法可推广到流模型，使用 O(ε⁻³log(1/ε)) 次 passes 和 O(r·log(r/ε)) 空间（假设机器字长 O(log n) 位）。

Conclusion: 本文通过将无权拟阵交集的拍卖算法（Huang-Kobayashi）与加权二部匹配的拍卖分析（Liu-Ke-Khuller）相结合，成功为加权拟阵交集问题设计了一个简洁的确定性拍卖算法。该算法将查询复杂度从之前 Dudeja-Grilnberger 的 (1/ε)^(1/ε) 多项式依赖改进到多项式依赖 ε⁻²，同时保持了关于 n 的近线性复杂度，解决了Dudeja-Grilnberger提出的开放问题。算法的核心在于：(1) 维护基于价格和效用的离散化效用函数；(2) 通过势能函数将残差值的下降与项势能的增加联系起来；(3) 利用二元搜索技术高效计算价格。算法亦可推广到流模型。

Abstract: We consider the weighted matroid intersection problem in the independence-oracle model. A sequence of works by Huang--Kakimura--Kamiyama [SODA'16 \& Math. Program'19], Chekuri--Quanrud [SODA'16], Quanrud [ICALP'24], and Dudeja--Grilnberger [IPCO'26] has developed efficient $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithms for this problem. We present a simple deterministic auction algorithm that, given two matroids on a common ground set of size $n$, computes a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate maximum-weight common independent set using $O(n \varepsilon^{-2} \log^2(n))$ independence-oracle queries. This is the first deterministic $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the weighted matroid intersection problem whose query complexity is nearly linear in $n$ and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$. Our algorithm builds on the auction algorithm for unweighted matroid intersection by Huang--Kobayashi ['26], together with the analysis of the auction algorithm for weighted bipartite matching by Liu--Ke--Khuller [APPROX'23].

</details>


### [308] [Best of Two Worlds: Combining High and Low Resolution to Compute Viewsheds on terrains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00941)
*Laura Toma*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于多分辨率方法计算地形上视域(viewshed)的新算法。通过构建低分辨率网格T'来快速过滤掉保证不可见的区域块(blocks),然后仅对可能被可见的块进行高精度计算,在不引入任何近似的前提下,显著优于现有O(n lg n)的最佳理论界,实验上在大型高分辨率网格上实现了超过20倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着Lidar技术提供的超高分辨率地形数据(可达1m水平分辨率,15cm垂直精度)的广泛可用,传统视域计算算法在效率上成为瓶颈。已有最优精确算法的复杂度为O(n lg n),在数十亿点的网格上计算成本仍然过高。因此需要一种既能保持精确性(避免近似)又能利用实际视域通常只占地形很小比例(<5%)这一特性的高效算法。

Method: 算法分为两个步骤,基于参数k(块大小): (1) 构建低分辨率网格T',将原始网格T划分为⌈√k⌉×⌈√k⌉的块,每个块存储最大和最小高程值,T'大小为Θ(n/k)。 (2) **LoRes步骤**:在T'上以前后(front-to-back)顺序遍历块,利用每个块的最小天顶角z_min(B)和最大天顶角z_max(B)作为其horizon的上下界,维护一个不变量:任何被标记为不可见的块保证不包含可见点。复杂度O((n/k)lg(n/k))。 (3) **HiRes步骤**:对LoRes标记为可见的块(共l个点),使用T的完整数据以分层方式计算精确视域。复杂度O(l·lg n + n/k + k·lg k + n)。 整体复杂度为O(n + (n/k)lg(n/k) + k·lg k + l·lg n),当k=Ω(1)且l=o(n)时,优于先前O(n lg n)的最佳上界。关键在于:LoRes视图必须是T上视图的超集,保证HiRes不会遗漏任何可见点,从而实现无近似。

Result: 实验在10个不同规模(从184K到10亿+点)、不同地形(山区/平坦)、不同数据源(Lidar/SRTM)的真实数据集上进行,与R3(朴素算法)和vis-iter(Haverkort等)对比。结果显示: (1) MultiRes在所有数据集上均快于vis-iter; (2) 加速比随网格规模增大而增大:Set1为6.26倍,Washington(10.6亿点)达到22.30倍; (3) Clear Creek(1.14亿点,1m Lidar分辨率)取得最高加速比,约为28倍; (4) 最优块大小k随网格增大而增大(从k=6×6到k=15×15),与地形特征相关; (5) Lidar数据即使在平坦地形上也产生小视域(如Portland仅0.61%),这是高分辨率精度的体现; (6) LoRes视域大小仅为HiRes视域的1.3到40倍(华盛顿异常平坦水导致比值低,阿巴拉契亚山脉比值高),表明低分辨率筛选极为有效。

Conclusion: 本文提出的MultiRes多分辨率视域计算算法,在不引入任何近似的前提下,通过低分辨率网格快速过滤保证不可见的区域块,显著提升了精确视域计算的效率,在大型高分辨率网格上获得超过20倍的实际加速比。该方法的优势源于实践中视域通常远小于地形这一关键观察。算法具有通用性:可与任何(甚至近似的)视域算法结合以进一步加速。未来工作方向包括:从两级扩展到多层级的层次结构(如四叉树方法,根据需求动态调整块大小),以及在LoRes中引入近似以进一步提速。

Abstract: The viewshed of a point $v$ on a grid terrain $T$, viewshed$_T(v)$, is defined as the set of grid points in $T$ that are visible from $v$. We describe a novel algorithm for computing viewshed$_T(v)$ using a multi-resolution approach: Given a parameter $k >1$ that represents the block size, we create a grid $T'$ which is a lower-resolution version of $T$, such that each point in $T'$ corresponds to a block of $\lceil \sqrt k \rceil $-by-$\lceil \sqrt k \rceil$ points in $T$. The key of our approach is using $T'$ to speed up the computation of viewshed$_T(v)$ while not introducing approximation. We compute viewshed$_T(v)$ in two steps: First we compute the viewshed of $v$ on $T'$, while maintaining the invariant that any block in $T'$ that is labeled as invisible may not contain any visible points. Thus, the first step's role is to use $T'$ to filter out blocks in $T$ that are guaranteed to be invisible. The second step considers the blocks that were labeled as visible in $T'$ and computes the visibility of their points with full accuracy using the data in $T$. Overall the algorithm runs in $O(n + \frac nk \lg \frac nk + k \lg k + l \cdot \lg n)$, where $l$ is the total size of visible blocks in $T'$. When $k = \Omega(1)$ and $l = o(n) $, the running time of our algorithm improves on the previous best bound of $O(n \lg n)$. Our experimental results show the performance of the new algorithm in practice and a speedup of more than an order of magnitude compared to previous algorithms.

</details>


### [309] [Settling the Pass Complexity of Streaming Set Cover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01007)
*Sepehr Assadi,Janani Sundaresan*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文完全解决了流模型下集合覆盖问题的"空间-通过次数-近似比"三方权衡，证明了任何α-近似算法在p次通过中需要Ω̃((m/α)·(n/α)^{1/p})的空间，匹配了已有算法的上界，确认了算法进展停滞十年的根本原因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式集合覆盖问题在低近似比（匹配非流式算法的log n近似）方向上的算法进展已停滞近十年，但缺乏能排除"O(m)空间+两通过+log n近似"可能性的下界。Assadi等人在[24]中曾猜想mn^{1/p}的权衡曲线可能最优，但缺乏决定性证据。本文旨在解决这一猜想。

Method: 通过从经典的指针追逐（pointer chasing）通信复杂度问题进行随机归约来证明下界。构造上创造了一个p次通过的困难实例，其底层(p-1)次通过的子实例"嵌入"在一个大小约n^{1-1/p}的未知随机子集中。集合大小约为n/log n，边际上均匀随机但具有轻微相关性，使每个集合"指向"另一个集合——两个指向集合的并集覆盖的元素显著多于两个独立随机集。算法的目标是沿这些"指针链"追踪集合，但底层子实例的真实子集在第一轮结束前不被揭示。分析依赖于Chernoff界和随机集的初等性质。

Result: 证明了定理1：对于p,α,m,n≥1，任何p次通过的α-近似流式集合覆盖算法需要空间Ω̃((m/α)·(n/α)^{1/p})，在条件p≪log n/log log n和p≤α≪n^{1/(p+1)}下成立。该下界与现有算法上界匹配至p的常数因子和n,m的多对数因子。该结果推广了[4]的单通过下界Ω(mn/α²)到所有p≪log n，以及[12]的多通过下界到log n近似比范围。附录中还给出了匹配该权衡的算法上界（命题A.1）。

Conclusion: 本文完全解决了流式集合覆盖问题在三方权衡下的复杂度，确定了正确的权衡曲线为Ω̃((m/α)·(n/α)^{1/p})。这一简洁而具有非技术性的证明依赖于从指针追逐问题的归约，结合随机集的初等性质。该结果解释了为何该问题在低近似比方向上进展停滞十年——因为不存在比现有算法更优的空间-通过次数权衡。同时，本文给出的上界算法（结合[24]和[4]的技术）也确认了下界的紧致性。

Abstract: In the streaming set cover problem, $m$ sets from a universe of size $n$ are arriving one by one in a stream, and the algorithm is allowed to process the stream using one or a few passes and a space of $o(mn)$, which is sublinear in the input size. The goal is to determine the minimal (or approximately minimal) number of sets that cover the universe at the end of the last pass. This problem has been studied extensively over the years with rapid progress that led to several $O(\log{n})$-approximation algorithms in $\tilde{O}(mn^{1/p})$ space and $O(p)$ passes. However, progress on this front has largely stagnated over the past decade, despite the absence of any lower bounds that rule out even an $O(\log{n})$-approximation in $O(m)$ space and just two passes. We provide a simple explanation for this lack of progress by establishing an optimal three-way space-pass-approximation tradeoff for this problem: any $\alpha$-approximation algorithm for streaming set cover requires $$ \widetilde{\Omega}\Big(\frac{m}{\alpha} \cdot \big(\frac{n}{\alpha}\big)^{1/p}\Big) $$ space in $p$ passes whenever $\alpha \ll n^{1/(p+1)}$. In light of prior work, this result is optimal up to constant factors in $p$ and logarithmic factors in $n,m$ for any $\alpha\geq p$. Our bound is optimal with respect to the range of $\alpha$ also, and fully settles the complexity of this fundamental problem in the streaming model. The proof of this result is (surprisingly) simple and non-technical and relies on a randomized reduction from a variant of the standard pointer chasing problem in communication complexity, using elementary properties of random sets.

</details>


### [310] [Coloring 3-colorable graphs with $O(n^{4/23})$ colors via a Gaussian-cover recursion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01071)
*Emile Anand*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文给出了将任意保证3-可着色的n顶点图用 $O(n^{4/23}) \approx O(n^{0.17391})$ 种颜色着色的随机多项式时间算法，改进了之前 Bansal-Huang-Lee 的 $O(n^{0.19539})$ 及 Narang-Tang 的 $O(n^{(13-\sqrt{97})/18+\epsilon})$ 结果。核心方法是从固定层级的半正定规划(SDP)松弛出发，对高斯覆盖(Gaussian cover)做有限深度递归，依赖 Chen 的高斯凸性定理证明的高斯最大值方差界，并在紧致参数域上用有理区间算术验证数值不等式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3-可着色图的近似着色是半正定舍入与凸层次松弛的经典测试问题。已有最好的多项式时间算法需要约 $n^{0.195}$ 种颜色，与常数因子NP硬度之间存在巨大鸿沟。本工作的动机是缩小这一差距：通过对高斯覆盖做更深（但固定深度）的递归，并利用 Chen 的高斯凸性定理改进覆盖复合(composition)步骤的损失因子，从而获得更优的着色数上界。

Method: 方法的核心包含四个组件：(1) 三轮 SoS/Lasserre 松弛获得严格的向量3-着色和一致的局部颜色分布，按根相关性将顶点分入壳层(root-correlation shells)；(2) 基于 Chen 凸性定理的方差界——对 m 个系数范数至多 r、均值 μ、方差 v 的中心化线性形式的最大值，证明 $v \le r^2 - \mu^2/(2\log m)$，并配合方差尺度的下尾估计控制每步扩展的阈值损失；(3) 范数敏感的覆盖复合引理(Lemma 14)及递归提升引理(Lemma 16)，在固定深度内将根条件向量着色的阈值逐级提升；(4) 稀疏情形输出与 Kawarabayashi-Thorup-Yoneda 的稠密进展界($\sqrt{n/\Delta}$)在 $\Delta = n^{D/(D+2)}$ 处平衡，结合参数 $\alpha = 1/(5+3c_*)$ 得到 $\alpha < 4/23$，从而吸收亚多项式损失。有限深度(404)的漂移(drift) $M(q,L,z) - L > 1/1000$ 及初始化不等式通过有理区间算术自适应剖分加以验证。

Result: 主要结论（定理1）为：对任意保证3-可着色的 n 顶点图，存在使用 $O(n^{4/23}) = O(n^{0.17391\ldots})$ 种颜色的多项式时间可找到的合法着色，成功概率至少 $1 - n^{-10}$。这严格改进了 Bansal-Huang-Lee 的 $O(n^{0.19539})$ 与并发工作 Narang-Tang 的 $O(n^{(13-\sqrt{97})/18+\epsilon}) \approx O(n^{0.17506+\epsilon})$。参数取 $c_* = 1/4 + 10^{-6}$，$D = 3(1+c_*)$，$\alpha = 1/(5+3c_*)$，数值上 $\alpha = 1000000/5750003 < 4/23$，而 $4/23$ 处的安全裕度由亚多项式损失与对数因子保证。有限验证在 8,140 个终末盒子上完成漂移检验，在 355 个盒子上完成初始化检验，最小阈值裕度 $2.55 \times 10^{-7}$，最小数值裕度 $2.83 \times 10^{-5}$。

Conclusion: 该工作将保证3-可着色图的近似着色上界推进到 $O(n^{4/23})$，同时为该问题的研究开辟了新方向：(a) Chen 高斯凸性作为组合损失控制工具，提供了比 Borell 等周不等式更精细的、依赖方差的复合界；(b) 稀疏与稠密进展界的最优平衡策略（$\Delta^{1/D}$ 与 $\sqrt{n/\Delta}$ 相等）；(c) 固定深度递归结合精确有理区间算术验证的方法论，可推广到其他依赖紧致域上数值不等式的近似算法分析。作者在备注中指出，稠密情形是否可借助秩展开(rank-expansion)等扩展性结构替代最小度条件是值得探索的方向。AI 辅助写作的事实也被明确披露。

Abstract: We give a randomized polynomial-time algorithm that colors any promised $3$-colorable graph on $n$ vertices with $\smash{O(n^{4/23}) = O(n^{0.17391\ldots})}$ colors, improving on the recent bounds of $O(n^{0.19539})$ by Bansal, Huang, and Lee and Narang and Tang who obtained $O(n^{(13-\sqrt{97})/18+\epsilon})=O(n^{0.17506\dots + \epsilon})$ colors for every fixed $\smash{\epsilon>0}$. To prove our result, we start from a fixed-level semidefinite relaxation, where we use a finite-depth recursion on Gaussian covers. Fixing a root vertex, we group vertices by correlation with the root vector. Here, each step extends a cover of directions by one edge and transfers it to a successor group. Our key analytic ingredient is a variance bound for Gaussian maxima: for a maximum of $m\geq 2$ centered linear forms with coefficient norms at most $r$, mean $\mu$, and variance $v$, we prove $v\leq r^2-\mu^2/(2\log m)$ using Chen's Gaussian convexity theorem. Together with a variance-scale lower-tail estimate, this controls the threshold loss at each extension, which shows that root-conditioned vector colorings can either extract a large independent set from a group or bound its size, forcing a contradiction after constantly many steps. The resulting sparse-case guarantee combines with the dense progress bound of Kawarabayashi, Thorup, and Yoneda, and the recursion's numerical inequalities are verified via rational interval arithmetic.

</details>


### [311] [Factor Three Approximation for Edit Distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01311)
*Egor Gorbachev*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文给出了编辑距离(Edit Distance)的精确3-近似算法：对无权情形在 Õ(N^{11/6}) 时间内、对任意度量权重在 Õ(N^{40/21}) 时间内。核心创新是"中心校正"(center correction)技术——通过在源块到中心的最优对齐中撤销一个编辑，将路由开销从 2r_i 降至 (2-2/W)r_i，从而吸收采样搜索带来的 ε 误差以达到精确因子3。同时证明了非度量权重下近似的困难性：无条件 Ω(N²) oracle 查询下界（即使仅对称或仅满足三角不等式），并在正交向量假设(OVH)下证明了大小为3字母表的对称情形和大小为2字母表的拟度量情形的困难性。作为对比，对二进制字母表上的对称权重给出了 Õ(N^{40/21}) 的3-近似算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编辑距离的精确计算被认为需要 Ω(N²) 时间（基于OVH/SETH）。过去八年来，真正次二次时间内的常数因子近似保证一直停留在 (3+ε)，无法达到精确的3。本文旨在：(1) 突破这一障碍，给出严格3-近似的次二次算法；(2) 澄清权重函数度量性假设的本质必要性——刻画哪些权重条件下3-近似在次二次时间内可行，哪些本质上困难。

Method: 方法核心是"中心路由+校正"框架：(1) 将源串分块，从Y中采样候选中心；(2) 通过三角不等式经中心路由比较，产生 2r_i 的开销上界；(3) **关键创新**：在源块到中心的最优对齐中撤销一次编辑，使半径从 r_i 降为 r_i-1，从而将路由开销从 2r_i 降至 (2-2/W)r_i，节省的 Θ(1/W) 部分恰好吸收采样搜索的 ε 误差；(4) 利用隐式DIST矩阵和全单调性通过SMAWK算法高效处理 O(n²) 条路由短路。无权情形用单字符校正（|U_i*|≤1），度量情形用 O(τW) 长度的子串校正。下界方面：通过精心构造的oracle实例证明无条件 Ω(N²) 查询下界；通过OVH将正交向量问题归约到有界间隔子序列匹配，再编码为加权编辑距离，证明字母表大小为2或3时的困难性。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 无权编辑距离3-近似算法，运行时 Õ(N^{11/6})；(2) 任意度量权重下3-近似算法，运行时 Õ(N^{40/21})；(3) 无条件 Ω(N²) oracle查询下界，适用于对称权重或满足三角不等式的权重（大字母表情形）；(4) 基于OVH的困难性结果：对称权重在三字母表、拟度量权重在二字母表下均无次二次近似；(5) 二进制字母表上对称权重的 Õ(N^{40/21}) 时间3-近似算法（正结果）。参数选择为 W=N^{1/6}、k=N^{1/3}（无权），W=N^{1/7}、k=N^{8/21}、τ=N^{-2/21}（度量情形）。

Conclusion: 本文解决了编辑距离近似中一个长期悬而未决的问题：在真正次二次时间内达到精确的因子3近似，无需 ε 误差。中心校正技术是一个简单而强大的新思想，可应用于多种设置。然而，仍有若干基本问题开放：(1) 是否能实现 (3-ε) 近似？(2) 指数 11/6 和 40/21 是否可降至接近 8/5（目前 (3+ε) 近似的最佳结果）？(3) 能否在 N^{1+o(1)} 时间内实现常数因子近似？非度量权值的近似在一般情形下本质上是困难的——除非权重同时具有对称性和三角不等式（度量性），或为二进制字母表上的对称权重，否则不存在有意义的次二次近似算法。本文的LLM辅助证明过程也值得注意。

Abstract: We give randomized algorithms for $3$-approximate edit distance in $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^{11/6})$ time for unweighted edit distance and in $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^{40/21})$ time for arbitrary metric edit weights, where $N$ is the total input length. For non-metric costs, we prove an unconditional $\Omega(N^2)$ oracle-query lower bound for every approximation factor depending only on $N$, even for symmetric weights or weights satisfying the triangle inequality (but not both). Under the Orthogonal Vectors Hypothesis, we show a similar result for constant-size alphabets. This holds even for symmetric weights over a size-$3$ alphabet or triangle-inequality weights over a size-$2$ alphabet. In contrast, for symmetric weights over a binary alphabet we show an $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(N^{40/21})$-time $3$-approximation algorithm.

</details>


### [312] [Stable and Online Algorithms for Random Matrix Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01591)
*Eren C. Kızıldağ,Shuangping Li*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the average-case matrix discrepancy problem: given independent normalized $d\times d$ Gaussian orthogonal ensemble matrices $A_1,\dots,A_N$ and a fixed margin $\kappa>0$, find signs $\sigma_1,\dots,\sigma_N\in\{-1,1\}$ such that the operator norm of $\sum_{i=1}^N \sigma_i A_i$ is at most $\kappa\sqrt{N}$. Focusing on the proportional regime $N/d^2\to \tau\in(0,\infty)$ as $d\to\infty$ followed by the small-margin limit $\kappa\downarrow 0$, we characterize the density required by stable offline algorithms and by online algorithms. In the offline setting, we construct a polynomial-time \emph{recenter-and-round} algorithm that is noise-stable and succeeds whenever $\tau=\Omega(\frac{1}{\kappa^2\log(1/\kappa)})$, along with a matching lower bound for all stable algorithms. In the online setting where each sign must be chosen irrevocably upon observing the corresponding matrix, we determine the exact limiting performance of the \emph{Frobenius-greedy} algorithm, establishing that it succeeds when $\tau>\tau_{\rm FG}(\kappa)\sim \frac{\pi}{4\kappa^2}$, as well as a matching lower bound for all online algorithms by conditioning on a revealed prefix. At the core of our algorithms lies rotational symmetry, which enables us to transfer Frobenius norm control into operator norm guarantees. Together, our results identify the algorithmic phase transition points for random matrix discrepancy: $\Theta(\frac{1}{\kappa^2\log(1/\kappa)})$ for stable offline algorithms and $\Theta(\frac{1}{\kappa^2})$ for online algorithms. Both thresholds lie far above the satisfiability scale $\Theta(\log(1/\kappa))$, as shown by Maillard~\cite{maillard2025}.

Focusing on the proportional regime $N/d^2\to \tau\in(0,\infty)$ as $d\to\infty$ followed by the small-margin limit $\kappa\downarrow 0$, we characterize the density required by stable offline algorithms and by online algorithms. In the offline setting, we construct a polynomial-time \emph{recenter-and-round} algorithm that is noise-stable and succeeds whenever $\tau=\Omega(\frac{1}{\kappa^2\log(1/\kappa)})$, along with a matching lower bound for all stable algorithms. In the online setting where each sign must be chosen irrevocably upon observing the corresponding matrix, we determine the exact limiting performance of the \emph{Frobenius-greedy} algorithm, establishing that it succeeds when $\tau>\tau_{\rm FG}(\kappa)\sim \frac{\pi}{4\kappa^2}$, as well as a matching lower bound for all online algorithms by conditioning on a revealed prefix. At the core of our algorithms lies rotational symmetry, which enables us to transfer Frobenius norm control into operator norm guarantees. ### [313] [Exact Locality Gaps for Matchable Semi-Matchings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01648)
*Marek Gałązka,Hanna Wdowicka*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对"可匹配半匹配"（matchable semi-matching）问题，在有界半径局部搜索（每次最多移动 r 个任务）和当前服务器最大负载上限 K 下，给出了局部最优解与全局最优解总完成时间比值（locality gap）的精确闭式公式。该公式在所有有限负载上界下均可由一棵客户端度数至多为2的树状实例达到；当 K=2 时精确比值为 1+1/(r+2)（由路径图达到）；无负载上限时上确界为 β₁=3/2（单任务移动）和 β₂≈1.294503159（双任务移动），且 β_r=1+1/(r+2)+O(2⁻ʳ/r)。证明基于比较图上的显式有理势函数（rational potential）以及匹配该界的分层树构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部搜索是组合优化中常用的启发式方法，但在分配问题中，局部最优解可能与全局最优解存在显著差距。已有工作（如 Czygrinow 等人）在"可匹配"实例类上仅给出 1+1/r 的上界。本文动机在于确定该上界是否紧，以及在引入负载上限 K 后的精确 worst-case 比率，并验证最坏情况是否仅出现在简单的图结构（如树或路径）上。

Method: 核心方法分两部分：(1) **上界证明**：利用匹配构造一个"比较有向图"D（每个服务器有一条入弧，出度等于当前负载 a_v），结合 r-非交换性（r-non-swappability），证明 D 中任意长度 ≤r 的有向游走满足 a_v ≤ a_w+1。基于此定义每个顶点的"状态"(a,j)，记录其负载及到最近更高负载祖先的距离；然后构造一个显式有理势函数 P_{a,j}（涉及阶乘和有限求和），并验证所有合法状态转移满足证书不等式 P_{a,j} ≥ c_a − R + a·P_{b,k}，从而通过望远镜求和得到 C(M) ≤ R·OPT。(2) **下界构造**：对每个 (r,K) 构造一个分层树状实例，层数为 H=r(K-1)+1，第 i 层服务器负载为 ⌈i/r⌉，层规模按 N_i = N_{i-1}/a_i 递归定义。证明该实例 r-不可交换且其比值精确等于公式给出的 Γ^match_{r,K}。无负载上限的上确界 β_r 通过取 K→∞ 的极限得到。

Result: 主要结果（定理2）：对任意 r≥1, K≥2，
Γ^match_{r,K} = 1 + (2+E_{r,K}) / (2·Z_{r,K})，
其中 E_{r,K} = Σ_{a=2}^{K-1} 1/(a!)ʳ，Z_{r,K} = r+2 − T_{r,K}，T_{r,K} = Σ_{a=2}^{K-1} 1/[a(a−1)(a!)ʳ]。
该值由一棵客户端度数≤2、服务器度数≤K 的有限树精确达到。当 K=2 时简化为 1+1/(r+2)，由 r+2 个客户端的路径图达到。无负载上限时 Γ^match_r = β_r = 1+(2+E_r)/[2(r+2−T_r)]，其中 β₁=3/2, β₂≈1.294503159, 且 β_r 严格递减，满足 1+1/(r+2) < β_r < 1+1/(r+1)，渐近展开为 β_r = 1+1/(r+2)+O(2⁻ʳ/r)。精确匹配 C(M)=(Q(M)+n)/2 与平方负载目标 Q(M)=Σ a_v² 的关系为 2Γ−1。计算验证覆盖 108 个精确势函数证书（17,730 个转移不等式）和 108 个分层构造，以及所有规模≤6 的 50,069 个标号父映射的穷举验证。

Conclusion: 本文精确确定了可匹配半匹配问题在有界半径局部搜索下的最坏局部性差距，改进并严格化了 Czygrinow 等人的 1+1/r 上界。核心结论：(1) 精确闭式公式同时涵盖所有 r 和 K；(2) 最坏实例出现在极简图结构（树/路径）上，无需复杂资格约束；(3) 排除短改进路径与排除所有≤r 客户端可行重分配等价（引理1）；(4) 渐近行为 β_r = 1+1/(r+2)+O(2⁻ʳ/r) 表明差距快速收敛至1；(5) 相同的精确差距在度数有界条件下也成立（推论8）。这些结果为有界大小局部搜索在匹配半匹配问题上提供了尖锐保证。遗留问题：(a) 最优解需要负载>1 的实例需推广比较图结构；(b) 寻找满足半径条件的分配的分布式复杂度。

Abstract: An assignment of tasks to servers can resist every small improvement and still make tasks wait longer than necessary. We determine exactly how inefficient such an assignment can be when each task requires one unit of service and the eligibility constraints permit all tasks to use distinct servers. For every move size $r$ and maximum current server load $K$, we give a closed formula for the worst ratio between locally optimal and globally optimal total completion time. Local optimality here allows every feasible reassignment changing at most $r$ tasks. Every finite-cap bound is attained on a tree where each task has at most two eligible servers. Thus the worst behavior already occurs under simple eligibility constraints. At load cap two, the exact ratio is $1+1/(r+2)$, attained on a path with $r+2$ tasks. Without a load cap, the worst-case supremum is $3/2$ for single-task moves and approximately $1.294503159$ for two-task moves; its excess above one is $1/(r+2)+O(2^{-r}/r)$ as $r$ grows. The proof uses an explicit rational potential on a comparison graph and matching extremal constructions. These results give sharp guarantees for bounded-size local search on matchable semi-matchings, including exact guarantees under degree bounds.

</details>


### [314] [Safe Hypergraph Contraction via Capacity-Aware Repair Certificates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01678)
*Yu Deng,Xinyi Yang,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文提出"认证安全粗化"（CSC）方法，通过容量感知的修复证书在多层超图划分中识别不破坏全局最优平衡二分的顶点收缩操作，在保持最优性的同时显著提升划分质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在超图划分的多层方法中，顶点收缩会限制粗化图上的可表示划分集合。即使满足块容量约束的收缩也可能消除所有最优平衡二划分，而现有粗化策略（连接强度、谱方法等）缺乏保持最优性的形式化保证。现有安全缩减方法（如HeiCut）未考虑块容量约束，无法直接适用于容量受限的超图划分。

Method: 方法包含三类证书：(1) 过滤对偶支配证书（FPDC）通过排除容量强制切割的网来界定修复成本，结合容量条件保证可行且不增大切割的修复方向；(2) 双向最小割组件证书（BMCC）通过有向网络构造（源点、辅助节点、大容量弧M）将内部切割节省与边界暴露的比较转化为2(|S|-1)次最大流计算；(3) 部分接触方向合并证书（PCDC）通过子集和动态规划枚举可达状态。算法2在每轮迭代中先贪心选择顶点不相交的FPDC认证对，再依次尝试BMCC和PCDC认证组件，每步后在更新商图上重新认证。

Result: 在323个精确可解小超图实例上，三种认证配置（FPDC、FPDC+BMCC、FPDC+BMCC+PCDC）均100%保持最优值，平均顶点缩减率分别为78.16%、94.76%、95.13%。对比基线中，HeiCut变体仅40-42%保持最优，经典启发式（HCM、FC、NC）甚至导致最优值上升或商图不可行。集成到KaHyPar后，在40个ISPD98和Titan23基准测试上，39/40实例匹配或改善最佳切割，最佳切割总和降低3.36%，但总运行时间增加11.3%。

Conclusion: CSC提供了一种实用的最优保持粗化模块，可集成到现有划分工作流中。通过将容量可行性与切割非增性统一在修复方向中，CSC在保持最优性的同时实现显著的顶点缩减（>95%），并在实际基准上带来稳定的切割质量提升，代价为适度的运行时间增加。组件证书相比纯对偶证书能发现更多安全收缩机会。

Abstract: Multilevel partitioners shrink circuit hypergraphs through vertex contractions, yet a contraction that satisfies block capacity can still eliminate every optimal balanced bipartition. We develop certified safe coarsening (CSC) to identify contractions that preserve an optimum without computing that optimum. CSC certifies a repair for any feasible partition that splits a candidate group: the repair must respect the fixed block capacities and must not increase the cut-net objective. Its bounds exclude hyperedges that capacity constraints force to be cut. A pair certificate checks individual merges, while a directed minimum-cut test certifies groups whose savings emerge only when vertices move together. We prove that certified disjoint batches and successive rounds with recertification retain at least one globally optimal feasible partition for hypergraphs with positive integer vertex and net weights. Experiments on exactly solvable instances confirm optimum preservation for every tested configuration; integration with KaHyPar lowers the sum of per-instance best cuts on circuit benchmarks, with additional runtime.

</details>


### [315] [Achieving Optimal Redundancy for Small Dynamic Rank/Select Dictionaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01853)
*Gabriel Marques Domingues*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对动态rank/select字典数据结构，在标准Word-RAM模型中给出了匹配的上界与下界。对于小集合（n=w^O(1)），构造了冗余度为O(n log^{(k)} w)比特、操作时间为O(k)（最坏情况）的字典，并证明该冗余-时间权衡在k≤log*w时是最优的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态rank/select字典是基础数据结构，但现有最优时间复杂度的构造均有Ω(n)级别的冗余度。作者旨在研究是否能将冗余度降至O(n log^{(k)} w)比特并匹配相应的时间下界，从而在最优时间下实现几乎线性的空间开销。

Method: 上界方面：采用superblock/block/buffer的分层存储结构，递归地将置换的编码开销降至O(n log^{(k)} w)；结合Elias-Fano编码、压缩rank索引和部分和技术，支持select、rank以及补集操作（FID）。下界方面：扩展Li-Liang-Yu-Zhou [FOCS 2023]的方法到超多项式宇宙，通过通信博弈（Outer Lemma + Inner Lemma）证明O(n log^{(k)} n)冗余度下需要Ω(k)操作时间。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 构造n=w^O(1)时的动态rank/select字典，冗余O(n log^{(k)} w)比特，时间O(k)；(2) 扩展至FID；(3) 通过cardinality reduction推广到任意n，时间O(k+log_w n)；(4) 下界：O(n log^{(k)} n)冗余的动态字典（含仅支持成员查询）需Ω(k)时间，从而证明上界在n=w^O(1)范围内最优。

Conclusion: 本文在标准Word-RAM模型中为动态rank/select字典提供了最优的冗余度-时间权衡，完全解决了小集合情形下常数时间融合节点（fusion node）的构造问题，并指出了剩余的两个开放问题：小宇宙（log u = o(w)）下的精确权衡，以及如何实现最坏情况o(n)冗余度。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the number of bits required to construct a dynamic dictionary with optimal time for $\texttt{rank}/\texttt{select}$ operations. Using the standard (multiplication) Word-RAM model with $w$-bit words, we construct a data-structure for a dynamic $\texttt{rank}/\texttt{select}$ dictionary for a set $S\subseteq\{0,1,\cdots,u-1\}$ of $n$ elements that, given a parameter $1\leq k\leq \log^*w$, uses $$\operatorname{lg}\binom{u}{n}+\mathcal{O}(n\log^{(k)}w)\text{ bits}$$ taking optimal $\mathcal{O}(k+\log_w n)$ time (worst-case) for all operations. We show optimality for $n=w^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ by extending the lower bound of Li, Liang, Yu, and Zhou [FOCS 2023] to super-polynomial universes: any dynamic dictionary for $n\leq \sqrt{u}$ elements that uses $\operatorname{lg}\binom{u}{n}+\mathcal{O}(n\log^{(k)}n)$ bits requires $\Omega(k)$ time for operations. Lastly, we extend the data-structure to a dynamic fully indexable dictionary (that also supports $\texttt{rank}/\texttt{select}$ on the complement of $S$).

</details>


### [316] [Beating One Half for Online Bipartite Matching with Reusable Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01993)
*Xiaohui Bei,Zhihao Gavin Tang,Wenhao Wu*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文证明了在具有可重用资源（reusable resources）的在线二部匹配问题中，即使持续时间是资源相关的随机变量，经典的Ranking算法也能实现严格大于1/2的竞争比，为(5-2√3)/3 ≈ 0.511966；并通过黑盒归约将此结果扩展到资源加权情形，得到0.500034的竞争比，从而解决了Delong等人在MOR 2024中提出的两个开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线二部匹配是经典的在线算法问题。Ranking算法在不可重用资源（一次性消耗）下能达到最优的1-1/e竞争比，但在可重用资源设置下，其是否能够超越1/2一直悬而未决。此外，对于资源相关的随机持续时间，是否存在超越1/2的竞争比也是开放问题。这两个问题均由Delong等人（MOR 2024）正式提出。

Method: 方法上采用了三个关键技术：(1) 资源视角的分析——不按请求顺序、而是按资源优先级顺序处理Ranking，避免了优先级局部变动引发的连锁变化；(2) 确定性持续时间下将Ranking归约为带覆盖函数的随机序贪心问题，得到0.5096的竞争比；(3) 随机持续时间下，通过残余调度比较（residual schedule comparison）建立基准调度与Ranking调度的期望比较，并引入"基准所有者"（benchmark owners）概念追踪基准请求相对于其所有者排序的位置，再通过排序截断（rank cut）获得第三个不等式。三个不等式加权组合后消去a项、保留非负b项，得到(5-2√3)/3。对于加权情形，使用随机移位的几何桶分组、稀疏激活和过滤边技术，将无加权保证作为黑盒提升加权竞争比。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) Theorem 1.1：无加权可重用资源下Ranking算法达到(5-2√3)/3 ≈ 0.511966的竞争比；(2) Theorem 1.2：黑盒归约——任何无加权竞争比α>1/2都能产生严格大于1/2的加权竞争比；(3) Corollary 1.3：加权情形下具体得到0.500034的竞争比。此外，Appendix C还将排序分析扩展到二阶超模（second-order-supermodular）福利分配问题，将原有0.5104的保证改进到(5-2√3)/3。

Conclusion: 论文证明了单一随机优先级排序即可在可重用资源在线二部匹配中超越1/2竞争比，包括资源相关的i.i.d.随机持续时间情形。核心技术洞察是从资源视角而非请求视角看待Ranking，每一资源服务于被更高优先级资源留下的请求子集。确定性情形下退化为带覆盖函数的随机序贪心，随机情形下通过残余调度比较和排序截断获得改进。这一结果也表明无加权保证的任何严格改进都能传导到加权情形。主要遗留开放问题：确定Ranking在可重用资源下的紧竞争比上限（当前仍距1-1/e有显著差距），以及能否不依赖采样访问实现超越1/2的加权保证。

Abstract: We study online bipartite matching with unit-inventory reusable resources, where requests arrive in an adversarially fixed order, and each use of a resource makes it unavailable for an independent duration drawn from a resource-dependent distribution. The benchmark knows all requests in advance but cannot observe a duration before choosing the corresponding use. The classical Ranking algorithm of Karp, Vazirani, and Vazirani (STOC 1990) fixes a uniformly random priority order of the resources and matches each arriving request to its highest-priority available neighbor. It achieves the optimal competitive ratio $1-1/e$ for unweighted nonreusable resources, but whether it beats $1/2$ for reusable resources has remained open. We prove that, for unweighted resources with resource-dependent stochastic durations, Ranking achieves a competitive ratio of $(5-2\sqrt3)/3\approx0.511966$. We also give a black-box reduction from unweighted Ranking to resource-weighted matching: any unweighted competitive ratio $\alpha>1/2$ yields a weighted ratio strictly above $1/2$. With independent sampling access to the duration distributions, the reduction gives a weighted ratio of $0.500034$. These results resolve two questions left open by Delong et al. (MOR 2024): whether Ranking beats $1/2$, and whether one can beat $1/2$ under stochastic durations. We analyze Ranking resource by resource, rather than request by request. For deterministic durations, this gives a reduction to random-order greedy for a coverage function. We then extend the analysis to stochastic durations by comparing the residual schedules of Ranking and a greedy algorithm, and apply a finer analysis of the random ranks to obtain the stated $0.511$ bound. For the weighted reduction, we apply Ranking within groups of similar weights and uses weighted greedy to control the loss between groups.

</details>


### [317] [Vertex-Failure Distance Oracles and Labeling Schemes: Compact and Constant-Approximate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02016)
*Yaowei Long*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 本文针对无向加权图提出了首个支持多点顶点失效的距离预言机与距离标记方案，填补了边失效与单点失效之间的关键空白。通过引入长度受限顶点扩展器的新工具以及基于扩展器的"捷径稀疏化"技术，作者在乘性常数近似下实现了接近线性的空间复杂度，并通过标记方案将数据分布式地存储在各顶点上，从而将空间预算均摊到整个图上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前针对多点顶点失效的距离查询，唯一已知的距离预言机来自 Duan-Gu-Ren (SODA'21) 的工作，但其空间复杂度为超二次方，且无法在多项式空间内实现常数近似。本文的核心动机是解决这一开放问题。

Method: 基于长度受限顶点扩展器构建扩展器层级，对每一层上的扩展图分别构造稀疏邻域覆盖；利用"重/密性的传播"原则设计新的基于扩展器的捷径稀疏化方法（包括近邻稠密性与邻簇稠密性概念），在簇内和簇间两个层面同时削减捷径数量。对于标记方案，还引入了上升稠密性与下降稠密性两个新概念来应对分布式信息存储的挑战。

Result: 对于任意失败次数 f 与参数 k ≥ 1，得到顶点失效距离预言机：近似比 O(k^6)（多项式时间构造）或 O(k^5)（指数时间构造），空间 Õ(f^2·n^{1+1/k})，更新时间 Õ(f^5·n^{1/k})，查询时间 Õ(f)。同时得到首个非平凡的顶点失效距离标记方案：近似比 O(k^6)，标签大小 f^3·n^{1/k}·log^{O(k)} n。附加得到确定性顶点失效连通性标记方案：标签大小 Õ(f^2)，优于此前最佳的 Õ(f^3)（存在性）与 Õ(f^4)（确定性）。

Conclusion: 本文回答了"是否存在近线性空间、多项式查询时间、常数近似的多点顶点失效距离预言机"这一开放问题，并给出了第一个非平凡的顶点失效距离标记方案。基于扩展器的捷径稀疏化技术与上升/下降稠密性概念可能为更一般的距离相关容错问题开辟新的解决途径。

Abstract: We present new algorithms for the vertex-failure distance oracles and labeling schemes problems in undirected weighted graphs. A vertex-failure distance oracle is a data structure that, given two vertices $x$ and $y$ and a failed vertex set $F$ of size at most $f$, returns an approximation to the distance between $x$ and $y$ in $G \setminus F$. In the labeling-scheme setting, the data structure needs to be stored distributively as labels on the vertices, and each query $(x,y,F)$ must be answered by accessing only the labels of the vertices in $F \cup \{x,y\}$. For any $f\geq 1$ and $k \ge 1$, we obtain a vertex-failure distance oracle with $O(k^{6})$ approximation, space $\tilde{O}(f^{2}n^{1+1/k})$, query time $\tilde{O}(f^{5}n^{1/k})$, and polynomial preprocessing time. In particular, this is the first time-efficient oracle for multiple vertex failures with space close to linear, as well as the first constant-approximation oracle with polynomial space when tolerating $\Omega(\log n)$ vertex failures. The previous results, due to [Duan-Gu-Ren, SODA'21], gave two alternatives: for any constant $c \ge 1$ and $\epsilon>0$, one oracle has $\mathrm{poly}(\log n,f)$ approximation, space $n^{2+1/c}\mathrm{poly}(\log n,f)$, and query time $\mathrm{poly}(\log n,f^{c})$, while the other has $(1+\epsilon)$ approximation, space $n^{2+1/c}(\log n/\epsilon)^{O(f)}$, and query time $\mathrm{poly}(\log n,f^{c},1/\epsilon)$. We also obtain a vertex-failure distance labeling scheme with $O(k^{6})$ approximation and label size $f^{3}n^{1/k}\log^{O(k)} n$. This is the first nontrivial distance labeling scheme for vertex failures. Our techniques build on recent tools related to length-constrained vertex expanders and also introduce a new expander-based shortcut sparsification. The latter also leads to a deterministic vertex-failure connectivity labeling scheme of size $\tilde{O}(f^{2})$.

</details>

### [318] [Detect, Explain, Interpret: An End-to-End Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection, Explainability and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01168)
*Roberto Stanzione,Jules Barbe,Magali Parrino,Jérémie Fourmann,Paul Boniol*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SHAD（Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection Benchmark），一个用于时间序列异常检测（TSAD）的端到端基准数据集，包含215个来自真实分布式云存储系统Scality的多变量高维时间序列，并针对检测（Detection）、可解释性（Explainability）和可解读性（Interpretability）三个层面提供了丰富的标注信息与基线评估。实验表明现有SOTA检测器并非在所有异常类型上都表现完美，简单的维度贡献分析无法实现原生可解释性，且零样本LLM无法可靠地解读异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列异常检测基准主要关注检测精度，缺乏：(1) 端到端的TSAD流水线评估（包含检测、解释、解读）；(2) 细粒度的逐维度（per-dimension）异常标签；(3) 丰富的语义/上下文标注以支持人类可理解的异常解读。这些限制阻碍了TSAD从"黑盒准确率导向"走向"透明且可解读"的研究。

Method: 数据集构建：在Scality Ring分布式存储平台上注入三类受控异常（磁盘故障、服务器故障、存储节点故障），共生成215条多变量时间序列（171维度，约1021个采样点）。每个时间序列附带：(i) 顶层二值标签；(ii) 维度级（根因组件）标签；(iii) 结构化XML注释（异常类型、严重性、文本说明、维度描述等）。评估方法：(a) 检测——对18个SOTA异常检测器（含半监督和监督方法）使用VUS-PR指标评估；(b) 解释性——通过维度贡献分数评估，使用NDCG指标；(c) 可解读性——在零样本条件下评估5个冻结LLM在不同输入表示（Catch22特征、多面板图像、自然语言描述）下的解读能力，涵盖5个任务（异常存在、类型、严重性、维度定位、时间定位），并模拟两个监督级别（提供检测信息、检测+解释信息）。

Result: (1) 检测：半监督方法（OA、USAD、AE、CNN）在细微异常上更精确，但无监督方法KMAD在系统级网络事件上更鲁棒；没有任何方法能在所有异常类型上完全准确。(2) 解释性：最佳检测器的维度级定位性能与随机基线几乎无差异，表明检测精度高并不能天然转化为诊断能力。(3) 可解读性：所有LLM结果均较低（异常类型F1最高仅约21%，维度定位准确率近0%）；添加检测和解释信息作为监督可带来一定提升，但仍不足以可靠地表征异常。图像表示在多数任务中略优，Claude综合表现最佳。

Conclusion: SHAD是首个同时覆盖检测、解释、解读全流程的真实世界高维时间序列异常检测基准。三个核心结论：(i) SHAD对异常检测仍具挑战性，没有万能的检测器；(ii) 简单的维度贡献分析不足以解决SHAD上的可解释性问题，需要专门的可解释性方法；(iii) 零样本冻结LLM无法正确解读SHAD中的异常，需要领域特定的解决方案。SHAD为未来研究在检测鲁棒性、变量贡献的严格评估、以及为LLM提供结构化语义上下文以生成可解读异常解释等方向提供了基础。

Abstract: Time Series Anomaly Detection has received increasing attention, driven by the growing availability of complex time series data. This surge has led to the development of numerous detection methods, as well as a variety of benchmarks aimed at thoroughly evaluating their performance. However, most existing detectors remain largely agnostic to domain context, overlooking explainability and interpretability. One of the main reasons for this gap is that current benchmarks primarily focus on detection accuracy, and only few of them evaluate spatial explainability. Moreover, no benchmark currently provides sufficiently rich semantic annotations to support the generation of human-understandable interpretations of anomalies. To address these limitations, we introduce SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection benchmark), a fully annotated benchmark composed of 215 multivariate, high-dimensional time series collected from real-world distributed cloud storage systems operated by Scality. The proposed dataset includes rich contextual information, covering three families of anomalies with varying degrees of severity. As further contribution, we provide a foundation for future work by evaluating baseline methods for Detection, Explainability, and Interpretability, covering all stages of a TSAD pipeline. For Detection, we benchmark a wide range of existing anomaly detectors, testing their effectiveness on the proposed real-world dataset. Then, we consider explainability by evaluating whether measuring the contribution of each dimension in the generated anomaly score can provide accurate anomaly attributions. Finally, for interpretability, we investigate the effectiveness of frozen LLM baselines in localizing and interpreting anomalies.

</details>


### [319] [SW-KAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Stieltjes-Wigert q-Orthogonal Polynomials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00050)
*Amirhosein Azarpour,Seyyed Moein Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SW-KAN提出了一种用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式替代B样条的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络架构，通过指数-tanh域映射解决无界输入到半无限域(0,∞)的域匹配问题，并利用数值稳定的三项递推实现O(N)计算复杂度。在MNIST、约束Fashion-MNIST和2D函数逼近任务上均优于现有多项式KAN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于多项式的KAN变体面临域失配问题：经典正交多项式（如Chebyshev、Legendre）定义在有界区间[-1,1]上，而神经网络层输入通常是无界实值。常用的tanh归一化在尾部易饱和，导致梯度衰减。此外，B样条KAN计算开销大，且无多项式KAN系统地解决了无界域到半无限/无界域的桥接策略问题。

Method: SW-KAN架构包含三大创新：(1) 边激活函数用Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式参数化，其对数正态权函数定义在半无限域(0,∞)上；(2) 提出指数-tanh域映射ϕ(x)=exp(γ·tanh(x/ι))，将ℝ双射映射到(e^{-γ}, e^{γ})⊂(0,∞)，避免梯度饱和；(3) 利用数值稳定的正交化三项递推公式，每条边O(N)次运算即可计算完整N次多项式展开，无需特殊函数调用。每层共享一个可学习q参数（通过sigmoid约束在(0,1)），控制基函数形状。

Result: MNIST：中等配置（105,856参数）达97.53%准确率，超过同规模Vieta-Pell-KAN（97.49%）等18个基线；大配置（219,907参数）达98.24%，超越Gottlieb-KAN（97.59%）。Fashion-MNIST约束场景（PCA降至40维、仅10,000样本）：83.10%准确率，以14,634参数（少32%）优于B样条KAN（82.65%/21,658参数）。2D函数逼近：仅389参数即可逼近三个不同曲面，测试MSE低至2.5×10⁻⁵。训练时间显著短于多数基线。

Conclusion: SW-KAN通过引入半无限域上的Stieltjes-Wigert q-正交多项式作为平面指数，结合可学习q参数和指数-tanh域映射，在分类与函数逼近任务中均实现了优越的精度-参数权衡。域匹配问题得到原则性处理，计算效率通过O(N)递推大幅提升。但当前验证局限于中小规模任务，域映射参数固定为超参数，且q参数层共享设计存在进一步细化（如边级共享）的空间。Stieltjes-Wigert矩问题不确定性对损失景观与泛化的理论影响尚待研究。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a paradigmatic shift in deep learning by replacing fixed node activations with learnable univariate functions on edges, offering enhanced interpretability and parameter efficiency. While recent polynomial-based KAN variants have addressed the computational overhead of original B-spline implementations, they introduce a fundamental yet underexplored challenge: the domain mismatch between unbounded real-valued inputs and the bounded or semi-infinite support of orthogonal polynomial bases. To address this limitation, we propose the Stieltjes-Wigert Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (SW-KAN), a novel architecture that employs Stieltjes-Wigert q-orthogonal polynomials defined on the semi-infinite domain (0, infinity). We introduce a smooth exponential-of-tanh mapping that stably bridges the domain gap while preserving well-conditioned gradients, and leverage a numerically stable three-term recurrence that evaluates polynomial expansions in O(N) operations without special-function calls. Through comprehensive experiments spanning image classification and continuous function approximation, we demonstrate that SW-KAN achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across diverse tasks. The log-normal weight structure and learnable q-parameter of Stieltjes-Wigert polynomials provide a distinct inductive bias that enables robust performance under resource-constrained conditions, including reduced feature dimensionality and limited training data. The proposed architecture not only outperforms established polynomial KAN baselines on standard benchmarks but also exhibits strong representational capacity for approximating complex multivariate functions with remarkably few parameters, making it a compelling alternative for efficient function approximation and classification in resource-constrained settings.

</details>


### [320] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Nous框架,证明在共享观测下学习与认证有用的记忆决策所需的样本量可以比源校准(估计源可靠性参数)少得多(二次方差距),并给出基于"见证区域"(witness regions)的有限样本认证证书,在MiniGrid等环境中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于信念的智能体记忆面临嘈杂、复制或过时的证据。核心问题:记忆是否必须先校准源才能改进决策?作者将学习、源校准和策略改进认证视为不同的统计任务,质疑必须先恢复源可靠性才能做出有用决策的隐含假设。

Method: 1) 构造一个四模型HMM家族,证明Bayes决策学习需要Θ(ℓ⁻²)条记录,见证证书认证改进需要O(ℓ⁻²)条新记录,而固定精度源估计需要Θ(ℓ⁻²)条记录(ℓ为持续性参数);2) 在未知identity-plus-background报告通道下,刻画策略改进的锐利可识别区间,推导基于观测见证区域的有限样本认证;3) 扩展容忍有界模型误指定与条件复制;4) 集成到Nous Dimensions框架,测试45000个可变状态历史和9000个MiniGrid回合。

Result: 1) Theorem 1(定理1)建立共享观测分离——决策信号在ℓ的一阶项,源尺度仅在二阶项;2) Theorem 3刻画兼容通道下策略改进的锐利可识别增益区间;3) Theorem 4/5给出有限样本见证证书;4) 实验中:新证书在MiniGrid中接受9/9对常数现任者的改进和4/9对LWW(后写赢)的改进,而旧证书接受0/9;5) 但强基线(联合发射HMM、单源0)在多数情况下仍具竞争力甚至更优,作者明确声明这不是通用优越的记忆算法。

Conclusion: 贡献是理论层面的:证明学习与认证有用的记忆决策可以在不恢复源可靠性之前完成,识别改进何时可从观测数据中识别(可识别问题)而非有限样本拒绝(功率问题),提供区分两者的诊断工具。核心启示:并非每个有用的状态决策都需要等待数值源识别;应学习观测支持的决策,通过兼容通道比较替换,并将策略级证据与个体观测更新分开记录。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [321] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究四种构造式分类器在训练过程中动态增加结构的策略，分别评估其收益，并精确诊断其中一种根本无法学习的原因并给出修复方案。核心贡献是证明"完全函数保持"的软决策树加深操作会导致新门控梯度恒为零，子树永远无法分化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式学习器在训练中自行决定架构，但各类增长操作的"合理性"论证往往缺乏实证检验。本文动机在于：哪些增长决策真正带来收益，哪些是无效操作？作者通过统一协议系统比较四种常见策略，并对失败案例给出可证明的诊断与修复。

Method: 方法：在统一协议下（固定超参、相同随机种子与折划分、3种子×5折交叉验证）对四种构造操作进行配对比较，每组比较仅操作差异，其他设置相同；使用合并5×2 CV F检验做统计判断。
四种操作：
1) 加深软决策树——将每个叶子转为门控（g=1/2），子节点继承父节点类分布。
2) GAL网络中放置新隐藏单元——比较随机初始化 vs 拟合残差后零输出权重安装。
3) 逐叶增长——在期望误差最大的叶子处分裂 vs 完整深度树。
4) Omnivariate树节点模型选择——最高准确率 vs 统计显著性检验。

Result: 结果：
1) 加深操作：ε=0时在Iris上损失19.6点、Wine 19.1点、Digits 55.6点；小幅扰动（ε=0.05–0.5）即可恢复接近从零训练的性能，且扰动大小影响很小。F检验在Wine和Digits上拒绝等同性。
2) 隐藏单元放置：所有数据集网络更小（Iris 17.2→6.9，Wine 6.3→4.3，Digits 7.5→5.7），准确率仅在Iris上略升；Digits上反而显著下降2.1点（F=25.18, p=0.0012）。
3) 逐叶分裂：第一组问题上用3.7次分裂达到0.885，优于完整深度6树的0.839；第二组问题上仅4.8次分裂却损失4.3点——稀疏性可靠，准确性不可靠。
4) Omnivariate选择：显著性规则在Breast Cancer和Digits上都使树更大且准确率更低（局部简洁，全局受损）。

Conclusion: 结论：四种操作中三种各换来一种收益，一种完全无效。决定因素在于新结构引入瞬间优化器是否有梯度可依。函数保持型加深是唯一失败者——梯度不仅小，而且恒为零，且更新规则会复现使梯度为零的条件（命题1）。修复方法简单：在插入新参数时给子节点一个小的随机扰动，或更一般地，测试中加一行断言"新参数梯度非零"。经验主义教训：看似最安全的增长操作反而最危险；运行第四个数据集能改变第二、第三个操作的结论符号。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing. The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero. The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate. Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>


### [322] [Useful to Whom? Sample Value Is Defined Only Relative to the Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00221)
*Yangze Liu,Xiao-Long Yin,Zhongyi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验（冻结数据子集，仅切换训练学习器）证明，在固定数据下，core set selection 中"易样本优先"与"几何覆盖"两种策略之间的交叉预算 m₀ 是学习器的属性，而非数据的固有属性。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，将 ResNet-18 加宽一倍（参数约 4×）会使 m₀ 从 57 提升至 85 样本/类；输入网格与容量之间存在显著交互，单独调整卷积步幅即可重现或逆转网格效应；将卷积学习器替换为 ViT 则使"易样本优先"阶段完全消失（m₀<25 左截尾）。本文未提出新的选择方法，而是提供了一套因果归因实验工具集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 coreset selection 研究普遍将样本"有用性"视为数据本身的属性，并据此在不同模型间复用已选子集、在数据集层面报告基准结论。然而，Liu 等人（2026）虽将易优先与覆盖策略间的交叉预算 m₀ 转化为可测量量，但未回答"这一边界究竟归属数据端还是学习器端"。本文旨在通过因果干预实验直接回答这一开放问题。

Method: 以绝对样本数/类为坐标测量交叉预算 m₀（取 LFrac 与 EL2N 作为易学习探针，Herding 作为覆盖锚点）。通过三个学习器旋钮——容量（ResNet-18 的 0.5×/1×/2× 宽度变体）、输入网格（32@32、32@64、64@64 等信息@网格组合）、归纳偏置（替换为 ViT-Tiny）——进行干预。最关键的方法是"移植实验"：冻结已选子集，仅切换训练学习器，以分离选择器侧与学习器侧的混淆。进一步采用步幅控制实验（保留输入网格不变，仅调整层 2 或层 4 或 stem 的步幅）来定位网格效应的结构性载体。在 ImageNet-100 与 ImageNet-1k 上进行低分辨率与原生 224px 两种协议验证。

Result: 1) 在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，将训练学习器从 R18 切换为 2×宽 W2（冻结同一 R18 选择的子集）使 m₀ 从 57 增至 85 样本/类（95% bootstrap 区间 [22.4, 35.8]）；2) 网格与容量存在交互：单纯将输入网格从 32 增至 64 使 m₀ 左移 28 样本/类，但该左移随宽度增加而衰减，至 2× 时差异小于测量 bracket；步幅控制表明移除最后一个下采样步幅即可重现左移；3) ViT 在 25–250 样本/类全范围内覆盖策略占优，m₀<25 左截尾；R18 选择的"易子集"移植到 ViT 上仅比 Uniform 高 0.1–0.9 百分点，排除打分器失败解释；4) 在原生 224px ImageNet-1k 上，宽度影响较小且依赖探针：LFrac 几乎平坦（0.5×→2× 移动 0.7），EL2N 适度右移 6.7（区间 [5.5, 8.7]）。预注册的单标量 load 律被拒绝。

Conclusion: m₀ 归属于学习器侧而非数据侧：样本的价值仅相对于目标学习器定义。容量、输入网格（经由特征图阶梯/步幅结构承载）、归纳偏置均会移动乃至消除这一边界；且 m₀ 是网格与容量的联合属性而非任一单旋钮的属性。本文未给出普适标度律，但其实际含义明确：选择策略的优选预算区间必须针对目标学习器进行评估，"方法 X 在预算 Y 获胜"不再是纯粹的数据集级结论，实验报告应使用绝对样本数/类并明确目标学习器。归纳偏置轴上的结论最强——对卷积学习器有用的易子集在 ViT 上无法恢复对覆盖策略的优势。

Abstract: What kind of data does a model need in order to learn? Coreset selection makes this question concrete: under a budget, keep the samples most useful for training. Easy-first and geometric coverage criteria can win in different budget regimes, separated by a crossover boundary. We ask whether this boundary is fixed by the data or changes with the target learner. Controlled experiments freeze the selected subsets and manipulate only the training learner. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling ResNet-18's width moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class: the learner changes the relative value of the same samples. A wider sweep reveals an interaction between input grid and capacity. Enlarging the grid while retaining the same image information shifts the boundary left, and this shift weakens as width increases. Stride controls reproduce and reverse the grid effect without changing the input grid; removing only the last downsampling stride is sufficient to recover the leftward shift. Under the native-224px ImageNet-1k protocol, width effects are smaller and depend on the probe: LFrac remains nearly flat, while EL2N shifts modestly right. Swapping the convolutional learning system for a ViT makes coverage win throughout the measured range, even when the easy subsets come from the convolutional proxy. These results establish learner dependence through frozen-subset interventions and identify network structure that can move the boundary. They do not yield a universal scaling law. Their practical implication is direct: a selection strategy's preferred budget regime must be evaluated with respect to the target learner.

</details>


### [323] [Partial AUC Maximization from Positive-unlabeled Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00284)
*Atsutoshi Kumagai,Tomoharu Iwata,Taishi Nishiyama,Hiroshi Takahashi,Kazuki Adachi,Yasuhiro Fujiwara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅利用正样本与无标记样本（PU数据）最大化部分AUC（pAUC）的新方法。在经验风险最小化框架下，证明pAUC（包括其依赖于FPR的阈值）可以仅用正类密度和边缘密度表示，并推导出经验估计器；通过对平滑后的pAUC经验估计器进行优化来训练分类器。在10个真实数据集上的实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在网络安全、医疗护理、广告等真实应用中，仅需关注特定FPR范围内的TPR，因此pAUC是更合适的评价指标。但现有pAUC最大化方法通常需要标记的正负（PN）样本进行训练，而实际中负样本因隐私或标注专业性要求而难以获取。已有的PU数据pAUC方法（PUpAUCh）依赖启发式假设（将无标记样本按当前分类器得分排序后，把落在特定排名范围内的样本视为负样本），该假设在实际中常被违反，导致其目标函数与真实pAUC不一致。

Method: 1) 基于经验风险最小化（ERM）框架，利用边缘密度p(x) = πp^p(x) + (1-π)p^n(x)将负类密度p^n(x)用正类密度和边缘密度表示，进而将pAUC（含其FPR依赖的阈值t_α和t_β）也仅用正类和边缘密度重新表达；2) 推导出PU数据下pAUC的经验估计器；3) 用sigmoid函数作为指示函数的平滑替代，得到可基于梯度下降优化的损失函数；4) 在每个小批量内根据排序后的得分估计阈值，并据此计算损失。理论上分析了估计器的有限样本一致性和对类别先验误差的鲁棒性。

Result: 在8个标准数据集（MNIST、FMNIST、SVHN、CIFAR10、SUSY、CODRNA、IJCNN、EPSILON）以及医学（Mammography）和广告（Online-shoppers）相关的数据集，共10个数据集上进行实验。结果显示：在α=0, β=0.1和α=0, β=0.2设置下，所提方法在32个设置中约有15-16个达到最优或与最优方法统计无显著差异；在不同正样本数（30、50、100）、不同类别先验（π=0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3）和不同类别先验估计误差下均优于或与PU学习、pAUC最大化、AUC最大化等对比方法相当，且对类别先验估计具有鲁棒性。训练时间与现有方法相当，且在不同替代损失函数（如logistic loss）下表现稳定。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种新的PU数据pAUC最大化方法，通过将pAUC及其阈值仅用正类密度和边缘密度重新表达，避免了对启发式假设的依赖。理论分析证明了估计器的有限样本一致性和对类别先验误差的鲁棒性，实验结果验证了该方法在10个真实数据集上的有效性，特别是在非平衡程度较高（正类比例不可忽略）的实际场景中优势明显。

Abstract: The partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUC) is an important performance metric for binary classification that summarizes true positive rates within a specific range of false positive rates (FPRs). Classifiers that achieve high pAUC need to be obtained in many real-world applications such as cybersecurity, medical care, and advertising. Although many methods for maximizing the pAUC have been proposed, they typically require both labeled positive and negative data for training. However, in practice, labeled negative data are often difficult to collect due to privacy concerns or the need for high expertise to annotate them. In this paper, we propose a method for maximizing the pAUC from positive and unlabeled (PU) data without negative data. Within an empirical risk minimization framework, we show that the pAUC, including its FPR-dependent thresholds, can be represented using only the positive and marginal densities, and derive an empirical estimator from PU data. A classifier is then trained by maximizing the derived smoothed empirical pAUC estimator. We experimentally demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method with ten real-world datasets.

</details>


### [324] [The Weakest Link: Distilling LLM Reasoning with Worst-Case Constrained Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00332)
*Matthieu Zimmer,Xiaotong Ji,Tu Nguyen,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于LLM推理蒸馏的最坏情况约束强化学习方法，通过在每个轨迹前缀上对教师对数似然施加硬约束，来解决现有方法中软正则化导致的"奖励黑客"和"补偿"问题。该方法将推理蒸馏建模为约束MDP，无需对偶拉格朗日优化或测试时教师访问，并提供了低方差策略梯度分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM蒸馏方法存在根本矛盾：纯RL优化任务奖励会导致"奖励黑客"（学生通过有缺陷的中间逻辑得出正确答案），而软KL蒸馏则允许学生通过在某些步骤高度匹配教师来"补偿"严重逻辑错误。作者认为这种平均化处理与推理特性根本错位，因为"思维链的有效性取决于其最薄弱环节"。

Method: 1. 将推理蒸馏形式化为约束RL问题，在轨迹的每个前缀上对教师对数似然施加最坏情况平均约束。2. 设计无状态增强的约束MDP，利用历史条件化策略结构消除预算跟踪变量。3. 推导低方差策略梯度分解，将其分为单步项（通过教师前向传播在词汇表上解析积分）和长期项。4. 理论证明在惩罚极限下约束几乎必然满足。

Result: 在数学推理（MATH、GSM8K、GSM-Symbolic）和代码生成（MBPP）任务上的实验表明：该方法在三种模型设置（Qwen2.5、Llama-3.2）上均达到了最高的推理成功率（RSR）。在Qwen2.5-GSM-Symbolic上，匹配了纯GRPO的最终答案正确率（76.14% vs 76.24%），同时将约束满足率从1%提升到83.88%。在Llama-MATH上，最终答案正确率超越GRPO（20.54% vs 18.78%）。

Conclusion: 最坏情况约束RL框架成功打破了准确率-忠实度的Pareto前沿。通过严格修剪探索过程中的无效推理路径，该方法在匹配纯RL的高任务性能的同时，显著降低了约束违反，最终在小模型中产生更优、更可信的推理能力。

Abstract: Distilling the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) into smaller students is a central challenge for efficient deployment. Current approaches face a fundamental tension: optimizing purely for verifiable task rewards (e.g., via GRPO) leads to reward hacking, where students arrive at correct final answers through flawed intermediate logic, while regularizing with soft divergence penalties against a teacher (e.g., KL-based distillation) dilutes task performance and, critically, allows the student to compensate for severe logical violations at one step with high teacher agreement at others. We argue that this averaging is fundamentally misaligned with the nature of reasoning: a chain-of-thought is only as valid as its weakest link. Motivated by this observation, we formulate reasoning distillation as a constrained reinforcement learning problem in which the task reward is maximized subject to a worst-case constraint on the teacher log-likelihood along every prefix of the trajectory.
