To avoid the prohibitive cost of dual Lagrangian solvers and the test-time teacher dependence of state-augmented methods such as Saute, we derive an unaugmented constrained MDP whose reward transformation preserves the hard-constraint semantics, admits a low-variance policy gradient decomposition into single-step and long-term terms, and provably satisfies the worst-case constraint almost surely in the penalty limit. Through extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, we demonstrate that our method significantly expands the accuracy-fidelity Pareto front. By matching the high Final Answer Correctness of pure RL and drastically reducing teacher constraint violations, we ultimately achieve the highest rigorous Reasoning Success Rate across all evaluated settings.

</details>


### [325] [Deep Learning for Anomaly Detection in Railway Systems: A Structured Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00363)
*Ammar Bouketta,Smail Niar,Hamza Ouarnoughi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于铁路系统深度学习异常检测的结构化综述，提出四维异常分类法、四种检测范式（分类、预测、重构、混合）的统一框架，并构建了面向部署的决策框架，整合评估指标、硬件平台和模型优化策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有铁路异常检测综述普遍存在碎片化问题：仅聚焦单一子系统或模态，缺乏对深度学习方法的范式级组织，更少涉及硬件约束、延迟和系统集成等部署要素。本文旨在弥合学术性能与实际部署之间的鸿沟。

Method: 采用PRISMA启发的文献检索协议，从IEEE Xplore和Google Scholar筛选2019–2026年间同行评审论文，最终纳入68项研究。从四个维度构建统一框架：(1)异常分类四维法（位置、数据表现、感知模态、时间特性）；(2)四种深度学习检测范式（分类、预测、重构、混合）；(3)面向任务的评估指标体系；(4)部署驱动的七步决策框架。通过表格对比、跨类别观察统计及两个案例分析进行系统性综合。

Result: 纳入68项研究和32个数据集。基于CNN、ViT、YOLO等的有监督分类方法在视觉检测中占主导（准确率80%–99%）；LSTM和GRU等预测方法实现无标签时序异常检测；自编码器、VAE和GAN等重构方法检测未见故障；混合方法（如cGAN+U-Net）通过多范式融合提供更强的鲁棒性。仅71/68（约10%）研究明确报告推理延迟，仅5项报告内存/能耗，PR-AUC等高敏感性指标使用率不足8%。FPGA部署功耗仅2.3–6.9W，延迟<1 ms至10 ms；GPU边缘（Jetson系列）功耗10–30 W。INT8/二值化量化、剪枝和轻量架构是主要优化策略，硬件感知神经架构搜索和知识蒸馏在铁路领域仍属空白。

Conclusion: 该综述通过四项互补要素统一了深度学习铁路异常检测的碎片化文献：四维异常分类法、范式级方法组织、扩展评估框架以及部署驱动决策框架。识别出公开基准缺乏、跨车队泛化性差、部署指标报告不足以及缺乏标准化认证路径等关键开放挑战。未来研究应聚焦于多模态融合、开放数据集与标准化基准、硬件感知神经架构搜索、跨车队领域自适应以及可认证的基础模型在铁路监控中的应用。

Abstract: Ensuring safe and reliable operation of modern railway systems increasingly relies on data-driven monitoring and intelligent fault detection. Deep learning has emerged as an effective paradigm for railway anomaly detection, driven by the growing availability of heterogeneous sensor data from rolling stock and infrastructure. This paper presents a structured survey of deep learning-based anomaly detection approaches for railway systems. The surveyed methods are organized using a unified taxonomy covering anomaly location, data representation and manifestation, sensing modality, and temporal characteristics. Existing approaches, including convolutional, recurrent and attention-based architectures, autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and transformers, are structured into classification-based, prediction-based, reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning paradigms. The survey also examines data-centric challenges, evaluation practices, performance metrics, and practical deployment aspects, including edge-cloud architectures, computational constraints, and hardware-aware optimization. Finally, a decision-oriented framework links anomaly characteristics, data properties, and operational constraints to suitable detection paradigms and deployment configurations. This work provides a structured reference for selecting and deploying deep learning solutions for railway anomaly detection and highlights open challenges toward reliable and scalable intelligent monitoring systems.

</details>


### [326] [Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00365)
*Jinho Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ZeNOVA，一种针对黑盒奖励场景的零阶（gradient-free）初始噪声优化方法，用于确定性少步生成模型的奖励对齐。其核心由三项组件构成：退火软价值引导（annealed soft-value guidance）、流形约束的超球 Langevin 动力学（hyperspherical Langevin）、以及 Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃，分别解决黑盒奖励的梯度信号缺失、零阶梯度估计在高维空间中的不稳定/偏离先验，以及 Langevin 动力学的模式间跳跃困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对少步/确定性生成模型的初始噪声优化方法大多依赖一阶梯度信息，在奖励不可微或仅能黑盒查询时不适用或不稳定。直接用零阶梯度估计替代真实梯度会面临三大失效模式：(1) 黑盒奖励（离散、量化、阈值化等）使梯度信号为零或噪声极大；(2) 高维噪声空间中粒子数 N 远小于维度 d，估计偏差大并导致噪声范数偏离 Gaussian 典型范围，使样本崩溃；(4) 单纯增量 Langevin 难以在模式间快速跳跃。

Method: 1) 退火软价值引导：定义 OU 参考过程下的软价值函数 V_σ(z)，通过递减的 σ schedule 由粗到精采样，使价值梯度即使在离散/不规则奖励下也是连续、行为良好的，并可零阶估计。2) 流形约束超球 Langevin 动力学：将噪声 z = ρ·u 分解为径向 ρ∈χ_d 与角向 u∈S^{d-1}，分别用切向 Langevin + 球面指数映射做角向更新，用包含解析 χ_d 先验分数的一维 Langevin 做径向更新，保持径向随机性但避免噪声范数漂移。3) Metropolis-Hastings 跳跃：以 Gaussian 先验作提议分布，按 exp((R(z')-R(z))/λ) 接受，交错于采样早期提供全局模式跳跃。算法整体只需生成器与奖励模型的前向评估，无需反向传播。

Result: 在 SDXL-Turbo 与 DMD2 文本到图像任务（ImageReward、PickScore、GenEval、Counting、OCR）以及 rCM 文本到视频任务（VideoAlign VQ/MQ/TA）上，ZeNOVA 在所有评估的零阶基线中取得最高奖励与最高的 Aesthetic 分数；在黑盒 OCR 奖励上相较最佳零阶基线提升 +0.046，在 OCR 上提升 +0.088，并使 Count MAE 降低约 40%。在 N=8 颗粒子下，ZeNOVA 仍优于其他基线在 N=64 时的结果；消融实验表明三项组件缺一不可，尤其在 OCR 这类不连续黑盒奖励上价值退火带来最大收益。

Conclusion: ZeNOVA 通过软价值退火、超球 Langevin 与 MH 跳跃的组合，提供了一种稳定且高效的零阶初始噪声对齐方案，适用于各种黑盒奖励对齐场景，包括图像与视频生成。其优势在于：(i) 在低粒子数预算下仍稳健；(ii) 更好保留生成器先验分布与多样性（在 PickScore–Vendi 多样性的 Pareto 前沿占优）；(iii) 在奖励可微时不易发生过拟合/奖励 hacking，验证集表现优于基于一阶梯度的 ReNO、ORIGEN 等。

Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

</details>


### [327] [FAER: Auditable Utility-Aligned Trajectory Replay for Language Model Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00385)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Tianshu Fu,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAER提出一个可审计的完整轨迹回放框架，用于语言模型后训练。它将选择策略与学习效用对齐，通过交叉拟合的 learner-aware 选择器，基于梯度对齐和元数据特征估计下游效用，并在 GSM8K 上以 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 验证优于 uniform、format-feedback 等基线选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的回放选择策略通常依据格式反馈、置信度、新鲜度或响应长度等缓存级指标对缓存轨迹进行排序，但缓存级正确性与下游学习效用是不同的目标。论文形式化了这种"选择-学习鸿沟"（selection-to-learning gap），旨在通过审计化的效用对齐轨迹回放，将选择策略与学习器的下游表现对齐。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 审计协议，将缓存行投影到声明的选择器可见字段，在评估标签连接前冻结选定ID和轨迹摘要；(2) 交叉拟合的 learner-aware 效用选择器，在不相交校准块上拟合，基于轨迹梯度对齐特征和元数据估计下游效用；(3) 可丢弃的 optimizer-aware 虚拟更新提供幅度感知的效用面。提出了两个估计量：选择-学习 Kendall τ 和反转计数 I_SL 来量化选择策略与学习效用的对齐程度。FAER-Fixed 是无训练的固定选择器基线，FAER-Utility 是 learner-aware 选择器。

Result: 在 GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 上的匹配学习研究：FAER-Fixed 达到质量 0.6329，对比 uniform 0.5482 和 format-feedback 0.6037（128次更新）。仅元数据的交叉拟合校准在八个种子达到 0.6476±0.0139（中位数 0.6481，配对区间 [+0.079, +0.122]）。FAER-Utility 达到 0.6624 质量。Format-feedback 选择记录的缓存正确性为 0.6953，远高于 FAER-Fixed 的 0.3594，但下游学习排名不同。六臂描述性间隙的 Kendall τ_SL = 0.33，Spearman ρ_SL = 0.54，含五对反转。

Conclusion: FAER 将回放选择视为带显式审计边界的学习效用估计问题。匹配研究表明，缓存级正确性与学习器持有质量之间的对齐较弱，强调了使用 learner-aware 选择器而非纯缓存级指标的必要性。审计合约确保了选择器边界、轨迹冻结和评估连接的可追溯性。论文通过形式化选择-学习鸿沟、定义审计合约、提出交叉拟合 learner-aware 效用选择器，并在统一证据合约下报告多维度对比，作出了四项贡献。

Abstract: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

</details>


### [328] [T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00388)
*Bo-Wen Zhang,Junwei He,Maoqi Liu,Feiran Li,Song-Lin Lv,Wentao Ma,Rongyi Lin,Shuhan Zhong,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出T2SPO方法，通过利用历史成功轨迹中的中间状态及其对应的剩余完成步数作为监督信号，借助冻结的TabPFN回归器对新轨迹中相邻状态的剩余距离进行预测，从而将状态间距离的差值转化为辅助的步级信用（step credit），叠加在GRPO的优势函数上，为多轮LLM智能体的强化学习提供更细粒度的信用分配，无需额外训练价值网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮LLM智能体的强化学习通常依赖稀疏的最终奖励（如GRPO），所有决策共享同一结果优势，难以区分哪些中间步骤真正推动了任务进展；当同组轨迹结果相同时，优势信号甚至为零。因此需要一种无需引入学习式critic即可提供步级监督信号的方法。

Method: 1) 从历史成功轨迹中提取每个访问状态及其对应的剩余完成步数（y = T - t）作为监督目标；2) 用冻结的Qwen3-Embedding编码器将文本转为特征向量，附加步数和训练轮次等数值特征，经标准化和截断SVD降维；3) 使用冻结的TabPFN回归器在共享的带标签上下文上预测当前状态到成功的剩余距离；5) 计算相邻状态预测距离的势差（potential difference），经arsinh归一化、裁剪和权重缩放得到辅助信号p_{i,t}，叠加到GRPO的优势上：A_hat^T2SPO = A_hat_base + p；6) 训练完成后将新成功轨迹加入历史记忆池（容量256），刷新上下文但保持编码器和TabPFN参数冻结。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，基于Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct的实验显示：T2SPO-GRPO相比GRPO基线在两个模型规模上均稳定提升。1.5B模型：ALFWorld整体成功率从72.8%升至74.7%（+1.9），WebShop成功率从56.8%升至73.7%（+16.9），得分从75.8升至88.5（+12.7）；7B模型：ALFWorld从77.6%升至83.6%（+6.0），WebShop成功率从66.1%升至75.8%（+9.7），得分从79.3升至85.4（+6.1）。引入25%失败样本的上下文在7B模型ALFWorld上将成功率进一步提升至89.3%。离线评估表明TabPFN在不同上下文规模下预测精度均优于kNN基线。

Conclusion: T2SPO是一种利用历史成功轨迹中的中间状态提供步级信用信号的无需学习式critic的方法，通过冻结TabPFN回归器实现上下文式的距离估计，显著提升LLM智能体在多轮交互任务中的表现；在WebShop上的得分和成功率超过了此前最强的GiGPO方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.

</details>


### [329] [MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00389)
*Zihan Shen,Qi Liu,Zixuan Yang,Yiqun Chen,Chenglong Zhao,Xiaozhao Wang,Lei He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MatrixReward，一种用于开放式生成强化学习的奖励框架。它通过构建rollout-by-rubric胜率矩阵，利用列的方差和跨rubric相关性提取数据驱动的rubric权重，并与查询先验权重融合，最后基于加权多维profile到正负理想点的相对距离构造奖励。在Qwen3-8B上的四个开放式问答基准测试中平均得分63.02，超过最强基线约2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式生成缺乏标准答案，现有基于rubric的逐点评分奖励提供的信息有限：分数缺乏稳定的锚点，预定义权重无法保证对当前rollouts的区分度，且rubric间可能高度相关导致冗余；线性加权聚合还会使不同维度的得分相互抵消，掩盖同一prompt下不同回答的质量差异。这些问题在GRPO等基于群组相对优化的方法中尤为突出。

Method: 方法分三步：(1) 对同一查询的G个rollouts，在每个rubric下两两对比（允许平局），构建G×K的rollout-by-rubric胜率矩阵M；(2) 通过列内标准差σₖ衡量该rubric的区分度，通过跨rubric的Pearson相关ρₖₗ衡量冗余度（采用Diakoulaki等人1995年的方法），组合得到数据驱动权重aₖ；再与查询先验权重pₖ通过博弈最小二乘求解组合系数(α,β)，得到最终权重wₖ；(3) 对M按列L₂归一化并加权，取每列观测极值作为正负理想profile，计算每个rollout到正负理想的欧氏距离之比作为质量奖励rᵢᵍᵘᵃˡ∈[0,1]，再叠加格式奖励后由GRPO做组内归一化得到优势。

Result: 在AlpacaEval 2、Arena-Hard v2、WildBench、WritingBench四个基准上，以Qwen3-8B为策略、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B为评判器训练，MatrixReward平均得分63.02，分别超过最强pairwise基线RRC-SCR 1.23点、最强pointwise基线DAPO 6.93点、最强weight-calibration基线SAW 5.60点。消融实验显示：基于矩阵的权重提取优于纯先验权重（+2.78）、熵权重（+1.56）和SVD权重（+0.86）；经验理想点+欧氏距离优于加权聚合（+3.19）、理论理想（+2.21）和Mahalanobis距离（+1.97）；博弈组合优于固定加性（α=0.5时+0.98）和乘性（+3.04）融合；隐式评判变体以74%更少的token取得62.23平均分。Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上同样验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: MatrixReward证明：通过rubric级别的成对比较构建的矩阵可以合理地构造开放式生成RL的奖励。其核心创新在于保留每个回答在每个rubric下的相对质量profile，从矩阵统计量中提取数据依赖的rubric权重，并通过到正负理想点的相对接近度实现多维质量区分，为开放式生成的强化学习提供了一种理论上更合理、经验上更有效的奖励构造方式。

Abstract: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [330] [Interpretable Synthetic Medical Tabular Data Generation for Clinical Decision Support Using Fuzzy Cognitive Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00391)
*Michael Vasilakakis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于模糊认知图(FCM)的合成医疗表格数据生成框架，通过模糊集和因果边权重编码临床特征依赖关系，实现可解释、隐私保护的合成患者记录生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的概率模型和深度生成模型在合成医疗数据时缺乏可解释性，且难以保持临床上有意义的依赖关系，限制了其在安全关键型医疗系统中的应用。

Method: 使用模糊认知图(FCM)框架：将临床特征描述为可语言解释的模糊集，通过模糊集交集计算FCM边权重以编码特征间依赖关系；通过随机初始化的语言激活向量在FCM中传播至收敛，再经去模糊化生成临床一致的数值型合成患者记录。

Result: 在UCI医疗基准数据集上的TSTR（合成训练-真实测试）协议评估中：心脏病数据集上准确率最高达0.81，AUROC最高达0.90；保真度指标KS Complement最高0.91，Correlation Similarity最高0.95；DCR Baseline Protection评分持续优于TVAE；且仅需CPU运行，性能匹配或超过TVAE和高斯Copula基线。

Conclusion: 基于因果关系且可解释的模糊建模为深度生成模型提供了一种计算高效、透明可信的替代方案，适用于计算机医疗系统中可信的合成数据生成。

Abstract: Synthetic medical tabular data generation has become essential for developing and validating computer-based medical systems (CBMSs) when real clinical data is restricted due to privacy, ethical, or data availability limitations. Existing probabilistic and deep generative models often lack interpretability and fail to preserve clinically meaningful dependencies, limiting their suitability for safety-critical applications. This paper proposes a novel application of Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) in a framework for synthetic medical tabular data generation with explicit causality and privacy preservation. Clinical features are described using linguistically interpretable fuzzy sets, and inter-feature dependencies are encoded as FCM edge weights computed from fuzzy set intersections. Synthetic patient records are generated by propagating randomly initialized linguistic activation vectors through the FCM until convergence, followed by defuzzification to produce clinically coherent numerical values. The approach natively handles mixed data types, and domain constraints common in health records. Experimental evaluation on UCI medical benchmark datasets demonstrates competitive performance under a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) protocol. The proposed method achieves accuracy of up to 0.81 and AUROC of up to 0.90 on the Heart Disease dataset, matching or exceeding TVAE and Gaussian Copula baselines while running exclusively on CPU. Fidelity metrics including KS Complement (up to 0.91) and Correlation Similarity (up to 0.95) confirm strong statistical coherence, and DCR Baseline Protection scores consistently exceed those of TVAE, confirming adequate privacy guarantees. These results demonstrate that causally grounded, interpretable fuzzy modeling offers a computationally efficient and transparent alternative to deep generative models for trustworthy synthetic data generation in CBMSs.

</details>


### [331] [Representation Transitions Reveal Emerging Safety Risks in Multi-Turn LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00400)
*Haoyu Wang,Wei Zhao,Yedi Zhang,Christopher M. Poskitt,Jun Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 DART（Detect, Attribute, Remind over representation Transitions），一种针对多轮 LLM 智能体代理攻击的运行时防御框架。核心发现是：多轮攻击会在智能体内部表征中留下可检测的累积迁移痕迹。作者通过构造"去噪安全方向"（denoised safety direction），解决了良性表征漂移对累积信号的干扰问题，并利用该方向实现检测、归因和针对性提醒干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮攻击可以将单独看起来无害的操作组合成有害结果，这对传统的逐步检测防御（如 I/O 防护栏、动作级强制执行）构成根本挑战。现有防御（如 ToolShield、SSH）依赖预计算知识或辅助模型预测，而非直接观察智能体行为在多轮间的变化。需要一种能够从内部表征层面检测跨多轮累积涌现的安全风险的轻量级防御方法。

Method: 1. 表征迁移信号：将每个上下文段诱导的表征变化 δ_i = h_{i+1} - h_i 投影到对比性安全方向 w_ℓ 上，累积得到 A_t = (h_{t+1} - h_0)ᵀu。2. 去噪安全方向构造：先锚定良性均值为零（去除系统性良性漂移），再投影掉良性协方差矩阵的前 p-1 个特征向量（去除随机性良性漂移）。3. DART 运行时框架：检测（累积迁移超阈值）、归因（arg max 定位触发段）、干预（针对性自然语言提醒）。

Result: 在六个模型和两个多轮基准上的评估：DART 将 MT-AgentRisk 的攻击成功率从 84% 降至 25%（100% 检测率，平均 FPR 12%），将 ASEval 从 97% 降至 52%（良性无误报，0% 效用损失）。在 MT-AgentRisk 上优于当前最优 ToolShield（55%）。去噪至关重要：ASEval 上未去噪的检测率仅 7%-40%，去噪后提升至 60%-85%。每步额外开销仅 0.14-0.56 秒，无需辅助模型。

Conclusion: DART 证明了通过监测表征迁移可以在轨迹层面检测多轮攻击中累积涌现的安全风险，且去噪是分离稀疏有害信号与良性漂移的关键。该框架检测、归因和干预三者结合，提供了一种轻量级、与推测性模拟防御互补的代理安全方案。剩余失败主要源于干预而非检测，指向了未来需要更强缓解策略的研究方向。

Abstract: Multi-turn attacks on agentic systems can compose individually permissible actions into harmful outcomes, challenging defenses that assess actions or states in isolation. We show that such attacks leave a detectable signature in the agent's internal representations: harmful behavior emerges as an accumulated representation transition across context updates, whose triggering context can be identified from the same signal. We further find that naive aggregation is confounded by benign representation drift, as a contrastive safety direction need not assign zero to benign transitions. We address this by denoising the direction, anchoring benign traffic at zero and removing its leading variation directions, with no runtime cost. These findings motivate DART, a runtime framework that detects and attributes representation shifts and intervenes with targeted reminders. Across six models and two multi-turn benchmarks, DART reduces attack success from 84% to 25% on MT-AgentRisk, catching every attack at a mean false-alarm rate of 12%, and from 97% to 52% on ASEval, at costs in benign non-refusal of 8% and 0%, respectively. On MT-AgentRisk, it outperforms ToolShield, the state-of-the-art multi-turn defense, on all six models: under the same protocol, ToolShield reaches only 55%. Denoising is critical: on ASEval, the undenoised monitor catches only 7%-40% of attacks, while the denoised monitor catches 60%-85%. The same monitor covers single-turn indirect injection without modification and adds only 0.14-0.56 s overhead per monitored step without requiring an auxiliary model, making it a lightweight complement to computation-heavy speculative defenses.

</details>


### [332] [The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00423)
*S. Aaron McClendon,Jorge Gallego-Feliciano,Antonios Saravanos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer中"巨大激活"(massive activations, 即远大于一般激活幅度的残差流坐标) 的生命周期，结合训练轨迹分析与受控干预实验，刻画其诞生、增长与巩固过程，并揭示权重衰减(weight decay) 是全局激活幅度调控的关键杠杆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巨大激活与注意力汇聚(attention sink) 现象密切相关，既是低精度训练的障碍，又具备功能价值（充当隐式注意力偏置）。先前研究分别从机制（梯度衰减的下界）和发育规律（五参数拟合曲线）给出了部分解释，但未回答：幅度由什么决定、什么使其停止增长、以及为何特定坐标而非其他坐标承担此角色。本文试图回答这些相互关联的问题。

Method: 方法结合三类证据：(1) 对自训练51M/203M/380M模型与Pythia系列(70M–6.9B) 检查点的密集训练轨迹分析；(2) 通过消融与扰动—恢复实验（单通道置零、过驱动、rms匹配的方向控制对比）；(3) 基于AdamW预条件更新的理论建模，提出"预条件增长 vs 权重衰减"的平衡方程 G̃(t*) = λ，并由此推导峰值幅度 ∝ λ^{-1/2} 的标度律。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 通道身份是训练早期的随机对称破缺结果，因种子而异，但早期锁定且对输入鲁棒；(2) 梯度衰减遵循 ‖g_x‖ ∝ 1/rms(x)，由汇聚令牌的整体聚合尺度而非单个通道决定；(3) 权重衰减因果性地控制全局激活尺度的拐点：移除衰减使尺度持续上升，保留衰减则导致下降；(4) 衰减系数λ的扫描使峰值时刻近似log-线性移动，峰值幅度近似服从 λ^{-1/2} 标度；(5) 衰减阶段是"竞争性巩固"——少数冗余载体逐渐取代其余通道，而非守恒量再分配；(6) 原始(raw) 维持力远低于衰减阈值，但AdamW的二阶矩归一化将巨大通道群体抬升到阈值之上，因此汇聚的维持是优化器介导的涌现效应。

Conclusion: 结论将巨大激活的生命周期概括为：随机诞生 → 由权重衰减驱动的尺度拐点 → 竞争性巩固。核心区分在于"通道身份"与"集合幅度"：巨大激活不是架构上的特权坐标，而是早期对称破缺竞争中获胜的、对汇聚令牌集合尺度有贡献的训练选择结果。功能角色（梯度汇聚）与幅度组织化训练动力学在不同层面相互兼容。由于角色是随机的且效应是分布式的，针对单一通道的抑制或量化方法应转向针对令牌整体聚合尺度的策略。局限在于扰动—恢复控制实验仅在51M规模进行，量级匹配对照不适用于充分训练的双峰晚期阶段，且通道群内幸存者选择机制仍未解决。

Abstract: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $\lambda$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $\lambda^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

</details>


### [333] [XOR-Trellis: Ultra-Low-Complexity Dequantization and Curvature-Aware Hadamard-Free LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00432)
*Xiaofan Que,Nir Elkayam,Spandan Pyakurel,Shuokai Pan,Dibakar Gope*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出XOR-Trellis方法，针对大语言模型(LLM)权重的超低比特量化，提出两项关键技术——XOR-Trellis FP4解量化器和曲率感知(无需Hadamard变换)的格型搜索目标——实现在保持量化精度的同时，去除推理时Hadamard变换开销并大幅降低解量化复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超低比特TCQ存在两个部署障碍：1)解量化速度若跟不上推理并行权重吞吐则成为瓶颈；2)通常依赖RHT(随机Hadamard变换)等非相干处理保证量化精度，但带来额外推理开销。研究动机是实现无需Hadamard变换、且解量化极低复杂度的超低比特量化。

Method: 两项互补技术：1) XOR-Trellis解量化器——通过四个掩码奇偶函数(XOR操作)+固定4×4 FP4调色板查找，将状态-值映射分解为约14个XOR2门，无需大型查找表或复杂算术运算；调色板通过秩交错构造在固定FP4码本下满足逐点最优性。2) 曲率感知格型优化——利用LDL分解中的对角因子D加权Viterbi分支代价，替代各向同性欧氏距离，直接在原始坐标系中反映模型敏感度；并提出能量排序(按Hessian块迹降序处理特征块)。两者均在离线进行，不改变压缩表示与运行解码器。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B上，XOR-Trellis + 曲率加权 + 能量排序在原始坐标系(无Hadamard)实现WikiText-2困惑度8.00，优于带Hadamard的QTIP基线(8.48)和无旋转的传统格型量化(8.69)。在Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct、Llama-2、Qwen3、Mistral等多个模型上均验证相同趋势。在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上对比YAQA时，无旋转YAQA完全崩溃(PPL>15000)，而XOR-Trellis+D加权保持稳定。硬件层面，512权重/周期的XOR-Trellis解量化器在N3P标准单元下仅占1917 μm²，远低于QTIP-3INST所需的等效12个32位加/减运算。

Conclusion: XOR-Trellis通过算法-硬件协同设计，实现了超低比特LLM权重量化：(1)极低复杂度、可高度并行的运行重建(约14个XOR2门+小型查找表)；(2)通过曲率感知Viterbi目标去除对Hadamard非相干处理的依赖；(3)在多个模型和量化任务上匹配或超越带旋转的SOTA方法(如QTIP、YAQA)，同时消除在线旋转开销，为FP4权重专用加速器提供高效部署路径。

Abstract: Trellis-coded quantization enables high-dimensional compression of large language model (LLM) weights at ultra-low bit widths without the exponentially large codebooks required by conventional vector quantization. Practical deployment, however, presents two challenges: reconstructing compressed weights at sufficient parallel throughput to avoid making dequantization an inference bottleneck, and maintaining quantization accuracy without costly incoherence transformations. We address these challenges with two complementary techniques. First, we introduce an ultra-low-complexity trellis dequantizer that uses a structured, hardware-efficient state-to-value mapping while preserving diverse reconstruction choices for trellis search. Second, we reformulate discrete trellis path optimization with a curvature-aware objective that reflects model sensitivity directly in the original coordinate space. Together, these techniques enable high-quality ultra-low-bit trellis quantization with inexpensive, highly parallel runtime reconstruction and without relying on Hadamard-based incoherence processing.

</details>


### [334] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF)，一种利用自回归（AR）模型的 Gumbel-max 采样所诱导的非相交直线噪声-数据配对，将 AR 教师模型蒸馏为支持少步（甚至单步）并行生成的连续流映射语言模型，并在多个基准上刷新了少步生成的性能-效率前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型虽然生成质量强，但其串行生成过程计算昂贵；现有的离散扩散或连续流并行生成模型需要较多采样步数，且以往基于 AR 教师蒸馏的工作（如 Gumbel-Distill）依赖离散扩散骨架，仍需多步细化。作者希望利用 AR 教师的高性能上界，并借助其诱导的直线轨迹提升少步并行生成的效率与质量。

Method: 1) 利用 AR 模型的 Gumbel-max 采样在 one-hot 连续空间构造 Gumbel 噪声与 token 序列之间的确定性耦合；2) 理论上证明该耦合产生的线性插值路径互不相交（直线），并给出半离散最优传输解释——教师 logits 即为 OT 对偶权重；3) 提出 GSF-FM 目标，通过 Gumbel-to-Gaussian 元素变换将先验高斯化以适配现有架构，并基于耦合解码错误率设计更温和的时间重参数化；4) 采用流映射（flow map）半群目标，将对角损失由 AR 教师直接监督（而非 FLM 教师），获得 GSF 完整方法。

Result: 在 OpenWebText、LM1B、TinyStories 等无条件生成任务上，单步 GSF 取得 GM=0.94、PPL=114.9 的少步 SOTA；在 4 步时 PPL=99.7、Entropy=5.32；在 OpenWebText 前缀补全与 XSum 摘要等条件下任务中同样优于 FMLM、SDTT、Di4C、DCD 等基线；LLM-as-a-judge 显示 1 步 GSF 在超过 91% 的对比中胜过 4 步 Gumbel-Distill。模型规模从 168M 扩展到 419M 时性能持续提升，且在效率-性能 Pareto 前沿上优于 AR 教师本身。

Conclusion: GSF 证明了 AR 模型天然提供连接连续噪声与离散 token 的最优直线轨迹；通过对这些非相交路径上的流映射进行蒸馏，可在少步并行生成中同时获得 AR 教师的性能上界与较以往方法更优的效率-质量权衡，为将 AR 模型蒸馏为快速并行采样器提供了一个有前景的框架，与基于辅助网络的分布匹配方法形成正交路线。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [335] [Random Recursive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00541)
*Jama Hussein Mohamud,Mirco Ravanelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 随机递归模型（RRM）是一种神经网络架构，通过从一个 $L$ 个可学习层的池中每次随机采样一层并执行 $T$ 次递归步骤，解耦了模型大小与计算深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归模型要么重复使用单一变换，要么使用固定顺序的变换序列，限制了计算路径的灵活性。RRM 希望打破固定层顺序，同时保持递归的参数效率优势。

Method: RRM 维护一个包含 $L$ 个已学习层的池 $\mathcal{F}=\{f_1,\ldots,f_L\}$，在每次递归步 $t$ 从中独立均匀采样（带放回）一层 $f_{r_t}$，对当前隐藏状态执行 $h_{t+1}=f_{r_t}(h_t, E(x))$。训练时采用标准反向传播，仅更新被采样的层；通过蒙特卡洛推断和概率测试时缩放（如 PTRM）进一步提升性能。$T$ 可在训练和测试时独立调整，无需新增参数。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10、Sudoku、Zebra、Maze-Hard、Sudoku-Extreme、ARC-AGI-1 等任务上，RRM 以 50–75% 更少的参数匹配或超越基线；在 Maze-Hard 和 Sudoku-Extreme 上通过增加测试时深度超越 TRM 等强基线（如 Sudoku-Extreme 达 89.21%，ARC-AGI-1 达 47.38%）；与概率测试时缩放（PTRM）结合在 Sudoku-Extreme 达到 99.50%。

Conclusion: 随机层复用是一种有效的正则化形式，能提升泛化能力并缓解过参数化；固定阶数和固定递归深度可视为 RRM 的特例。RRM 在测试时可灵活改变深度，支持蒙特卡洛推断和概率测试时缩放，为架构设计开辟了新方向，但学到的路由策略在本工作中未带来收益，仍是未来研究方向。

Abstract: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

</details>


### [336] [Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00563)
*Mariano Rivera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"Soft Dominance Layer"——一种用逐坐标阈值比较与sigmoid松弛替代传统仿射变换的神经网络层原语，通过MNIST单次实验初步验证其可训练性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络几乎全部基于"仿射变换+非线性激活"这一基本原语。作者希望探索一种本质上不同的可微计算规则：基于逐坐标不等式比较而非点积投影，从而赋予参数直接的阈值/参考向量解释，并探究其归纳偏置和几何特性。

Method: Soft Dominance Layer将每个输出单元定义为：y_i = Σ_j σ(α(W_{ij} − x_j)) + b_i（可选择归一化为除以d）。其中W_i被视为d维参考向量，每个坐标独立与输入x_j比较，sigmoid实现软化指示函数，锐度参数α控制向硬阈值的过渡。W通过tanh(Θ)约束在(−1,1)以匹配输入范围。文章还提出α的退火调度策略（每10个epoch乘以1.3，从epoch20开始）。给出PyTorch实现。

Result: 单次MNIST实验（100 epoch，Adam）：Soft Dominance最高准确率0.9061（无退火，128单元）和0.9173（有退火，512单元），对应MLP基线为0.9827（256单元）。退火运行在所有宽度上均高于非退火。损失/精度曲线显示训练-测试差距小。学习到的阈值向量呈现非均匀空间结构。论文明确指出：单次实验无法建立可靠的配置排序或统计显著的退火收益。

Conclusion: Soft Dominance Layer概念上区别于仿射神经元——参数代表逐坐标阈值而非投影方向；初步证明可端到端训练，并学习到有意义的空间结构。但当前加法形式受限于"逐单元关于每个输入单调非增"的归纳偏置，且准确率低于MLP基线约6.5个百分点。论文明确强调这只是可行性证明，需多随机种子实验、更广泛数据集、计算成本与表达能力分析才能得出关于实用性的结论。

Abstract: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $\alpha$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

</details>


### [337] [ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00592)
*Oleg Shchendrigin,Egor Cherepanov,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ALER（Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting），一种结合LSTM与槽位记忆（slot memory）的部分可观测强化学习智能体，并形式化了部分可观测强化学习中三类记忆更新需求：保留（retention）、重写（rewriting）、经验融合（experience fusion）。同时构建了Rune-Mazes基准测试环境，用以系统评估智能体对存储信息的重写与按规则变换能力。ALER在重写任务（Endless T-Maze）和融合任务（Rune T-Maze、Rune-Mazes）上均显著优于七种基线方法，并通过探针分析验证了其记忆机制的合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部分可观测强化学习中的记忆研究主要聚焦于保留（retention），即长期保持信息不变。然而，后来的观测可能使存储的信息失效或改变其含义。本文识别出两类被忽视的记忆需求：(1) 重写：将决策相关内容设为独立于旧值的新值；(2) 经验融合：依据后续观测指定的规则变换旧内容。现有的记忆架构与基准测试对这两类需求缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 1) 形式化定义三类记忆更新类别（retention/rewriting/experience fusion），并给出任务所需记忆状态数的理论下界（命题1、命题2）。2) ALER架构：LSTM跟踪每步变化的状态，槽位记忆保持持久内容；独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入机制可在一步内覆盖单个槽位；学习门控融合检索内容与循环状态。3) Rune-Mazes基准测试：包含Rune T-Maze（向量）、Rune Multi-Corridor（向量，多分支）、Rune MiniGrid Memory（像素观测），通过Invert、SkipNext、ResetRules、RepeatPrev等符文（rune）测试不同更新规则。4) 与7种基线对比：PPO-LSTM、GTrXL、Resettable S5、FFM、SHM、DNC、PPO-MLP。5) 通过线性探针与门控消融分析ALER内部表征与机制。

Result: 1) Endless T-Maze（重写任务）：ALER在全部16个配置上成功率均≥0.82（其中15个为1.00），在3倍训练走廊长度下仍保持1.0分辨率，显著优于多数基线。2) Rune T-Maze（融合任务）：ALER在全部5种符文组合上成功率均≥0.99。3) Rune Multi-Corridor（K=4分支）：在含Invert符文时，ALER平均成功率为0.83±0.17，为最高。K≥8时，所有架构成功率均较低。4) Rune MiniGrid Memory（像素观测）：在10个配置中有8个，ALER平均成功率高于PPO-LSTM。5) 机制分析：探针显示ALER的存储行为符合理论中的"延迟求解"模式——槽位记忆存储初始线索，循环状态解码符文标志；在符文步骤上，门控变化幅度显著高于匹配的非符文步骤，表明门控承担了按规则变换记忆的融合角色。6) 极限情况：K≥8的Rune Multi-Corridor对所有架构仍是开放难题。

Conclusion: 本文系统化了部分可观测强化学习中三类记忆更新需求（保留、重写、经验融合），提出了相应的理论下界与组合任务最简自动机分析方法。ALER将三类需求分配到不同模块（LSTM+槽位记忆+学习门控），在重写与融合任务上均取得领先性能，并具备良好的长度泛化能力。Rune-Mazes基准测试弥补了现有评测对融合任务的空白。未来工作需解决更大目标空间（K≥8）下的记忆与推理难题。

Abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [338] [MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00604)
*Egor Cherepanov,Nikita Kachaev,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIKASA-Robo-VLA是一个面向长视野操作任务的基准测试,包含90个语言条件操控任务,系统性地评估VLA模型的记忆能力。通过控制提示消失后的信息间隔,提供了10种记忆类型和3种视野分层,并发布了22,500条示范轨迹用于训练评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常仅依赖当前帧或极少的历史帧进行决策,难以系统评估其对任务中已消失信息的利用能力;现有基准如CALVIN和LIBERO侧重技能组合与知识迁移,而记忆专项基准如MemoryBench、RoboMME等覆盖范围有限,缺乏对记忆内容与保留间隔的精细控制。

Method: 在ManiSkill 3中扩展MIKASA-Robo,从32个任务扩展至90个语言条件操控任务,涵盖10种记忆类型(物体、空间、容量、时间、负集、序列、程序、前瞻、追踪、清单)和26个任务家族;通过环境阶段时序定义信息间隔,分为Short/Medium/Long三层视野(25-2160步);发布RLDS与LeRobotDataset v3双格式的22,500条oracle示范;提供统一的观测-动作接口、稠密奖励和固定种子评估协议;以π₀.₅作为无记忆参考基线,并分析OpenVLA-OFT与μVLA在记忆增强架构上的对比。

Result: 基准包含90个任务、22,500集、6,306,953帧(10Hz下约175小时);70个任务有明确信息间隔,其中28个超过最宽固定上下文窗口(16帧);参考π₀.₅基线在14个任务上微调后平均任务成功率0.211±0.044,Long分层表现受开环分块与子集记忆类型混淆影响;μVLA相比无记忆OpenVLA-OFT在记忆依赖任务上有显著提升(如RememberColor5:0.04→0.94);机会水平接近零(4500集仅1次成功)。

Conclusion: MIKASA-Robo-VLA提供了标准化的任务套件、数据集和诊断工具(分类法、信息间隔指标、机会下界),作为评估VLA记忆能力的基础设施;而非对记忆策略优劣的结论性回答。其26个任务家族与oracle轨迹为后续训练和比较记忆增强VLA策略提供了固定目标,统一的任务族奖励与成功定义可供任何方法对比。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $\pi_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [339] [Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00620)
*Yongding Tian,Zaid Al-Ars,Maksim Kitsak,Peter Hofstee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于模式连接和低损失区域几何的分析框架，论证grokking现象的根源在于训练集与验证集所诱导的低损失区域之间的"错位"(misalignment)，并通过在OpenAI模运算设置中构造一个"反grokking"反例来验证该框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Grokking（先过拟合训练集、之后才在验证集上泛化）作为深度学习中的一种涌现现象，其底层机制至今未有统一答案。既有研究（Fourier电路、Slingshot效应、训练集阈值、Hessian几何、权重衰减、信息论解释等）虽揭示了多种相关指标，但未能给出完整的因果解释。本文旨在建立一个能统一解释这些观察的因果框架。

Method: 1) 建立低损失区域（LLR）的形式化定义：LLR(M,D,L_th)为参数空间中损失低于阈值的区域，由架构、数据集和损失函数唯一确定，与优化器无关。2) 利用LLPF算法在M_grok架构与D_mod(x+y,97)上验证模式连接（mode connectivity），并提出Conjecture 1：低损失区域是单一路径连通区域。3) 在权重空间中建立训练LLR与验证LLR的几何关系（重叠与非重叠区域），将Liu et al.(2022)的四种学习阶段（理解、顿悟、记忆、困惑）对应到不同空间轨迹。5) 构造"反grokking"反例：保持模加法对称性f(a,b)=f(b,a)，让所有对称对(a,b)和(b,a)属于同一划分，从而消除grokking。6) 引入"对称感知训练覆盖率C_sym(T)"作为有效信息熵的经验代理。7) 设计嵌套数据集D_mod1997(f,n)，通过学习率与权重衰减网格扫描得到的相图作为低损失区域对齐程度的间接探针。8) 通过改变模型规模（×0.5、×1、×2）验证模型容量对错位程度的影响。

Result: 1) 成功复现OpenAI的grokking设置，并在M_grok、D_mod(x+y,97)上验证了模式连接（路径上最大损失<1.5×10⁻³，最小准确率>99.85%，10次重复稳定）。2) "反grokking"反例成功：保持架构、优化器、数据集大小、任务族不变，仅将对称对分配到同一划分后，验证准确率不再恢复，10个随机种子稳定复现。3) 该反例证伪了三种既有grokking指标：(a) Slingshot效应仍出现但无grokking；(b) Fourier成分仍有差异但不能预测grokking；(c) 固定训练集大小时grokking仍可消失。4) 在反grokking设置中，将同一划分比例从100%降至70%时grokking逐渐重现。6) 嵌套数据集相图显示：随n从97增至1997，Memorization格子减少直至消失，Comprehension格子增多，表明对齐程度提高，Grokking格子不再出现。7) 模型规模实验显示：较小模型Comprehension格子更多（更对齐），较大模型Comprehension格子稀少（更错位）。8) 不同函数对比：f(x,y)=x²+y²的LLR最对齐，f(x,y)=x+y居中，f(x,y)=2x²+y最错位；f(x,y)=xy²与f(x,y)=x²+2y²各自可训练，但其和f(x,y)=x²+2y²+xy在相同扫描下不可训练。9) 对称感知训练覆盖率在随机划分40%与45%之间（0.637→0.695）以及反grokking的70%与60%之间（0.648→0.680）发生异常转化，过渡区间存在重合。

Conclusion: grokking由两个分层因素共同决定：(1) 主因——训练集与验证集诱导的低损失区域的错位，由架构与数据集决定；错位更可能发生在训练信息相对模型表达能力较少时；(2) 次因——训练轨迹，由权重衰减、学习率、初始化等超参数共同决定。当主因导致低损失区域充分对齐时，仅靠次因无法产生grokking，训练动态坍缩为可训练或不可训练。grokking与记忆化均表明训练数据相对于模型架构不足。grokking不应被视为神经网络的某种隐藏能力，而应被理解为数据不足导致延迟泛化的预警信号。论文的局限性：模运算数据无噪声、对称性知识在通用数据集中无直接对应、50%训练划分在实践中不常见。

Abstract: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

</details>


### [340] [Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00661)
*Yue YU,Bowen Zuo,David Crandall,Yinglun Zhu,Dongruo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出StepRS-GRPO，一种针对扩散语言模型(dLLM)的按状态调度风险敏感强化学习方法，通过在去噪过程中对不同去噪状态分配不同的风险系数，在数学推理任务上同时提升准确率、解覆盖度和输出多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)通过多步去噪并行生成token，但其RLVR(可验证奖励强化学习)训练将终端反馈均匀地复用于所有去噪步去噪决策，忽略了不同去噪状态的上下文差异。已有研究表明更高的pass@1不一定意味着更好的pass@k覆盖度，也不一定意味着推理策略的多样性，因此核心挑战在于：如何在不坍缩搜索分布的前提下提升dLLM的推理准确率？

Method: 1. 在RS-GRPO(风险敏感GRPO)基础上引入按状态调度的风险系数，对每个去噪决策根据其归一化状态坐标u∈[0,1]查询调度表b(u)，获得状态相关的风险系数β=b(u)；2. 对二元奖励，证明该变换精确等价于对中心化优势进行依赖于提示和状态的重缩放A_j^c c_j = c_β(p̂_q)·A_j^0；3. 提出能力导向的系数标度选择β*=−log(1−p̄)，匹配失败率降低比例；4. 默认采用线性半衰减调度，将较大风险系数分配给更遮蔽的状态；5. 通过C1(移除状态变化)、C2(反向调度)、C3(优势RMS匹配)三个机制对照验证各部分贡献。

Result: 在SDAR-1.7B-Chat、SDAR-4B-Chat和Qwen3-0.6B-MDLM三种dLLM骨架上，在MATH500、AMC23、AIME2024、AIME2025、GSM8K等数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO在所有评估的pass@k预算下均优于中心化GRPO。例如SDAR-1.7B在AIME2024上pass@1从3.90提升至9.60，AIME2025从2.40提升至8.30；pass@64在AIME上分别获得10.00和6.68个百分点的提升。唯一答案比和推理轨迹多样性(Self-BLEU-4互补和嵌入距离)也均提升。在匹配优势RMS后增益依然存在，表明增益并非仅来源于优势幅度变化。

Conclusion: StepRS-GRPO通过按去噪状态调度风险系数，在保持原生训练器不变的前提下同时改善了dLLM的推理准确率、解覆盖度和输出多样性。能力校准为系数选择提供了实用起点，线性半衰减是有效的默认调度。局限性包括：能力规则指导端点选择但不确立最优方案；评估聚焦于二元奖励的数学任务；三个推理种子量化了固定检查点的采样变异性而非训练运行的变异性。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

</details>


### [341] [LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00675)
*Bo Yuan,Wenqian Ye,Zelin Zhao,Lama Moukheiber,Henry Kautz,Aidong Zhang,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LabBook，一种用于LLM驱动科学发现的轻量级单智能体框架，通过agent维护的自然语言记忆（LabBook）与只读检索接口，将完整实验日志保留与选择性上下文构建解耦，在58个发现任务上以更低成本取得与或优于进化基线的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的进化式发现系统通常从少量"祖先程序"生成新方案，上下文可控却会丢弃大量有用实验证据；而若引入完整历史又会产生冗长低效的上下文。核心信息瓶颈在于"实验保留"与"提案上下文构建"两个决策被耦合在一起，缺少一种既能无损记录所有实验、又能按需构建紧凑相关上下文的机制。

Method: 将发现过程形式化为"实验历史→下一提案上下文"映射 Γ。提出LabBook：单智能体维护一份自由形式的自然语言记忆（记录尝试思路、关键实现细节、教训与未解决方向），配合一个只读的"粗到精"检索接口（History概览、按索引返回Code(i)/Result(i)、Done终止），作用于一个append-only的完整实验记录上。每只调同时输入最新一次实验、LabBook与确定性的best-so-far进度信号，由同一智能体在至多K=5次检索后联合输出新程序与更新后的LabBook。不显式维护种群或分支搜索结构，无需采样器超参数或多智能体分工。

Result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题+9个数学/系统/启发式设计任务（共58个）上，使用DeepSeek V4 Flash与Qwen 3.6 Flash两个骨干，相比OpenEvolve、AdaEvolve、EvoX三个进化基线：成本-性能权衡更优；在Frontier-CS均值上较最强基线提升6.13（DeepSeek, +16.3%）与6.91（Qwen, +20.9%）分；达相同AdaEvolve终值成本降低30.2%–48.8%；在9任务上获得7–9个最佳/并列最佳；消融显示"持久记忆+全检索引"协同贡献最大（归一化均值0.9982 vs Full History 0.9488且成本减半）；Heilbronn凸包案例显示LabBook能跨越44只调回溯检索iter 33的强基线并产出新最佳0.947325。

Conclusion: 证明有效的LLM驱动发现不必依赖日益复杂的搜索结构；将"无损实验日志+agent维护的紧凑语义状态+选择性检索"三者解耦即可在广泛任务上同时改善质量与成本，并支持跨长程迭代的远端代码回收。Análise de extensões a fluxos científicos ruidosos, parcialmente observados e não programáticos é apontada como direção futura promissora.

Abstract: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at this https URL .

</details>


### [342] [Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00676)
*Mohammad Amin Abbasfar,Farbod Azimmohseni,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出USB+ATR方法,通过目标条件双模拟学习动作感知时序表示(ATR)与可迁移技能发现(USB),在单一训练布局上学习能在未见布局中有效迁移的通用技能,显著优于现有离线目标条件RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法存在两大缺陷:距离最大化方法(如HILP)过度拟合训练布局的全局时序结构,无法迁移到未见布局;行为克隆方法虽泛化性好但依赖专家/高质量数据,在次优数据上表现差。需要一种既能利用次优数据又能在布局变化时保持技能行为一致性的方法。

Method: 两个核心组件:(1) ATR(动作感知时序表示):用动作ℓ1距离(而非奖励)作为度量训练目标条件双模拟嵌入ψ,使具有相似动作序列的状态-目标对在表示空间中接近;再通过公式φ(s)-φ(s')=ψ(s,s')-E[ψ(s,s)]约束局部时序依赖与三角不等式,实现函数等变性。(2) USB(双模拟技能发现):基于ATR的时地位移差异用双模拟训练β表示,将动态相似状态映射到相近嵌入;技能策略π^l(·|β(s),z)仅以β而非完整状态为条件,迫使技能忽略布局无关特征。训练时使用动力学模型f构造匹配动作对以适应离线设定,技能方向奖励定义为R=⟨φ(s')-φ(s), z⟩。

Result: 在OGBench的pointmaze和antmaze扩展基准上(新增随机布局生成功能):(1) 分层RL设置中,USB+ATR平均成功率82.85%,远超HILP(52.33%)、OPAL(44.05%)和flat策略(0.63%);在antmaze-stitch-large等任务上从HILP的65.2%提升至78.9%。(2) 测试时规划设置中,USB+ATR平均52.19%,优于GCIQL(45.59%)、QRL(30.81%)等;在antmaze任务上以巨大优势领先(66.3% vs 14.0%最佳基线)。(3) 消融实验证实ATR与USB具有协同性,缺一不可;对动力学模型容量的鲁棒性较好(小模型MSE高10×仍达59.1%)。(4) 人工控制实验表明四个学习的技能足以驱动ant通过未见迷宫。

Conclusion: USB+ATR通过结合功能等变性的时序表示和基于动态相似性的条件化技能,有效解决了无监督技能发现中布局迁移的难题,为离线目标条件RL中的分布外泛化提供了新范式。未来方向包括将对称度量空间扩展到拟度量架构、处理随机环境以及在机器人操作等任务上定义新的布局泛化基准。

Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [343] [Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00707)
*Mansi Sakarvadia,Marco Ciccone,Colin Raffel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM驱动发现（LLM-driven discovery）中初始化的重要性。作者构建了12种"Modular"发现框架变体，在5个不同发现任务上进行实验，发现：(1) 顺序发现框架虽常优于纯并行发现，但最佳框架设计因任务和LLM而异；(2) 顺序发现容易发生"模式坍缩"，且多样性干预措施（如SOTA框架ShinkaEvolve、OpenEvolve、optimize_anything）增益不稳定；(3) 早期发现质量可预测最终成功。据此提出一种通用干预方法：先用一部分计算预算进行并行探索以生成高性能初始种群，再用其预热顺序发现框架。该方法在多种框架和任务上一致带来2%–21%的性能提升，验证了初始化在LLM驱动发现中的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已被用于算法、药物、定理等的自动化发现，但现有工作多关注harness（提示词框架）的顺序设计，对初始化策略关注不足。作者观察到LLM驱动发现结果对初始种子和框架选择很脆弱，亟需理解初始发现与下游发现质量之间的关系。

Method: 1. 泛化OPRO框架，提出"Modular"harness套件（4种突变策略×3种父代采样策略=12种变体）。2. 在5个多样化发现任务（CloudCast、Can't Be Late、Circle Packing、TSP、Prompt优化）上，对比顺序与并行发现。3. 分析模式坍缩现象及多样性干预措施（相似度阈值、LLM判断器、去重）。4. 提出初始化干预：用部分预算并行生成候选池，按相似度阈值s=0.98筛选高性能初始种群（m=15）来初始化顺序框架。5. 基于收敛准则（最佳候选在N%预算内未提升δ）自动确定初始化预算比例。6. 在SOTA框架（ShinkaEvolve、OpenEvolve、optimize_anything）上验证初始化效果。

Result: 1. 顺序发现通常优于并行发现，但最佳框架因任务/LLM而异，LLM驱动发现具有脆弱性。2. 顺序发现普遍出现模式坍缩（多样性下降）。4. 多样性干预和SOTA框架虽提升种群多样性，但未带来一致的性能提升。5. 前15个发现的中位分数与最终最佳分数呈正相关。6. 提出的初始化方法在所有任务、LLM和框架上一致优于纯顺序(r=0)和纯并行(r=1)发现；在SOTA框架上带来2%–21%的额外提升。7. 收敛准则在9/13场景下成功预测最佳初始化预算比例。

Conclusion: LLM驱动发现结果对harness设计高度敏感（脆弱性），且多样性诱导干预措施效果不稳定。早期发现质量是最终成功的强预测因子。本文提出的简单、与harness/任务/LLM无关的初始化干预方法（并行预算→高性能初始种群→预热顺序框架）一致提升了发现性能，证实了初始化在LLM驱动发现中的核心重要性。未来工作应进一步研究LLM参数化知识对发现质量的影响。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

</details>


### [344] [Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00728)
*Ruizhe Huang,Qidong Yang,Jonathan Giezendanner,Sherrie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个基于真实气象站观测的生成式数据同化受控基准测试，在11,849个NOAA MADIS气象站上评估了5种生成式方法与2种经典基线，得出三大结论：学习到的生成先验优于3D-Var的高斯先验（RMSE降低35.7% vs 33.3%）、全梯度引导优于停止梯度和初始噪声优化、扩散模型与流匹配在匹配条件下表现几乎相同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式数据同化方法通常在合成观测或不同数据集与评估方案下进行评估，导致难以判断哪些设计选择真正改善了真实世界的数据同化性能。此外，生成式方法尚未在受控条件下进行系统比较，无法回答生成式与经典方法在真实站观测上的相对优劣、不同生成框架（扩散 vs 流匹配、像素 vs 潜空间）的影响以及哪些设计选择驱动性能提升。

Method: 在固定数据集、观测算子和深度学习架构的条件下，比较3D-Var基线、Diffusion-SDA、Flow Guidance、FlowDPS、D-Flow、Latent 3D-Var和Latent Flow Guidance七种方法。生成式学习包括扩散模型和流匹配（共享U-Net骨干，约3.8M参数），先验使用EDM框架统一表述。条件注入策略包括：全梯度引导（通过去噪器/速度网络反向传播）、停止梯度引导（FlowDPS在终端空间优化）、初始噪声优化（D-Flow端到端优化x₀）。潜空间方案使用卷积VAE，变量分组G∈{1,4}控制跨变量混合，下采样深度S∈{2,3,4}。观测算子使用双三次插值将网格场映射到站位。评估指标为360个快照的RMSE相对于ERA5基线的改进百分比，涵盖稠密（11,849站）和稀疏（1,000站）两种基准。

Result: 在稠密基准上，Flow Guidance和Diffusion-SDA均达到约35.7%/35.4%的RMSE改进，分别优于3D-Var的33.3%约2.4个百分点，优于D-Flow约5个百分点（30.5%）。Flow Guidance使用半倍显存（3.05 vs 6.12 GB）和单一超参数。在稀疏基准上，生成式方法的优势从2.4pp扩大到7.9pp，停止梯度引导崩溃至7.6%，D-Flow降至12.6%。扩散与流匹配在两种基准下均达到统计平价。潜空间方案在稠密基准上不优于像素空间（最佳配置低1.4pp），但在稀疏基准上可匹配像素空间精度且节省约40%显存。变量混合（G=1）与空间混合（G=4）在自编码器中表现相当。所有方法在风场上的改进均大于温度和露点（归一化信号比约2.4倍）。空间传播分析表明，生成式方法的修正可延伸至约120公里（四倍ERA5网格间距），且在距离站位较远处优于3D-Var；但在远离站位的区域缺乏ERA5回退，温度和露点估计可能比ERA5更差。

Conclusion: 学习到的生成先验比3D-Var中的ERA5背景场提供更有效的正则化，使生成式方法在有真实站观测的情况下优于经典变分方法。全梯度引导是唯一在稠密和稀疏两种基准上均优于3D-Var的条件注入策略。Flow Guidance是实际最佳选择：与Diffusion-SDA精度相当，显存减半，仅需调一个超参数。扩散和流匹配在该任务上达到平价，潜空间和变量混合未提供可测量的收益。稀疏观测放大了方法间的泛化差异。未来方向包括：将ERA5作为生成先验的回退机制、引入时间一致性约束、耦合降尺度模型以及加入集合校准指标（如CRPS）进行更全面的评估。

Abstract: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

</details>


### [345] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了网络宽度对自监督学习中贪心逐层训练（greedy layer-wise training）与端到端反向传播训练性能关系的影响，发现在较浅且非常宽的网络中，贪心逐层训练可以匹配甚至超越端到端反向传播训练的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播在生物学上不太合理，因为它需要全局的信用分配方式。相比之下，大脑中的网络较为浅层且宽，可能更适合局部学习规则。然而，先前的研究尚未系统阐明在何种架构条件下，限制信用分配范围的局部训练（如贪心逐层训练）能够产生与端到端训练相媲美的表征。本研究旨在填补这一知识空白，特别是在自监督学习（SSL）的背景下。

Method: 使用 Barlow Twins 损失函数（主要实验）和 SimCLR 损失函数，在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 数据集上训练了不同宽度的卷积神经网络（Conv4 和 Conv8）。对比了贪心逐层训练与端到端反向传播训练两种方式。此外，分析了网络的表示几何性质（信号-信号分解度（SSF）和信号-噪声分解度（SNF））以解释性能差异。

Result: 1. 在较窄网络中，端到端训练表现更优；增加宽度时，两种方法的性能差距缩小。2. 在较浅且非常宽的 Conv4 网络中，贪心逐层训练的表现超过了端到端训练。3. 表示几何分析显示，非常宽的贪心训练网络具有更高的 SSF 和 SNF，表明类间差异在表征空间中分布更均匀且类内变化相对较小。4. 此外，在 SimCLR 损失和 CIFAR-100 数据集上也观察到了类似的趋势。

Conclusion: 网络宽度可以弥补信用分配范围的限制，特别是在较浅的网络中，宽度的增加使得贪心逐层训练能够达到甚至超过端到端反向传播训练的性能。表示几何差异可能是这一现象的原因之一。这些结果支持使用较浅且较宽的网络与局部学习规则作为生物学上更合理的替代方案。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [346] [Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00767)
*Peter Nutter,Dani Roytburg,Clément Dumas,Jinghua Ou,Shi Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"嫁接"(grafting)方法，通过在基础模型而非后训练模型上训练SDF适配器，再将学到的权重更新加到后训练模型上，从而在保持能力的同时减少现实漂移和偏好一致性损失，并实现适配器的复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前SDF干预通常直接施加于后训练模型，会损害偏好一致性并引发"现实漂移"(模型将无关虚构实体误认为真实)，而将合成文档混入预训练又需重跑昂贵的后训练，因此需要一种快速迭代预训练干预的方法。

Method: 嫁接法：在基础模型上训练LoRA适配器(Δ_SDF)，将其直接加到后训练模型上(θ_post + Δ_SDF)，等价于先做中间训练再加现有后训练更新，从而避免SDF与后训练权重直接交互造成的损伤。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B、Llama-3.3-70B、DeepSeek-V4-Flash(284B)、Nemotron Super 120B上验证：嫁接以与原生SDF相当的强度安装目标信念，同时将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失减少过半；同一适配器可复用至所有后续后训练检查点(SFT/DPO/RL)；还成功迁移了涌现失准和宪法中间训练干预的效果。

Conclusion: 嫁接是一种廉价且忠实的预训练干预迭代方案，单个适配器可在多个后训练检查点间复用，在假事实、模型生物和对齐干预中均有效，但仍存在表达-损伤权衡、有限后训练、需在匹配表达强度下比较等局限。

Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

</details>


### [347] [Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00814)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于线性理论的合成数据选择方法TATC（Training-Aware Target Coverage），用于LLM微调中的合成数据选择。该方法同时考虑输入的覆盖度和合成响应引入的训练误差，通过小型标记真实探针集评估候选样本的训练效果，并选择能扩展目标相关方向覆盖度的样本。在GSM8K数学推理任务上微调Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct时，TATC在各种选择预算下均优于现有合成数据选择方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据虽然能大规模扩展LLM训练，但并非越多越好——冗余样本信息量有限，含错误的样本甚至会降低性能。现有方法（基于质量、多样性、梯度相似性等）分别捕获有用数据的不同方面，但未能回答：合成样本如何贡献于既有训练集并影响目标任务？一个样本可能增加欠表示区域的输入信息，但其生成响应可能同时引入有害训练效应；反之，训练效应有利的样本，若其特征区域已被充分表示，则增加的信息有限。因此需要一种联合考虑训练效应和边际信息贡献的选择方法。

Method: 1. **线性理论框架**：在下游二次风险定义下，将合成集的价值分解为信息增益G_info、随机噪声成本C_noise和系统偏差成本C_bias三项的差。分析了方向性价值（哪些特征方向有用）、最优合成数据量（多少数据最优）、边际价值（添加一个样本的收益取决于已有数据集）。  
2. **TATC方法**：利用真实数据微调得到的检查点θ₀，提取prompt表征。对每个候选样本计算两个互补得分：  
- h_j（二次训练得分）：评估候选样本在探针集上的预测损失减少，基于AdamW更新差异的局部二次模型  
- a_j(S)（目标覆盖度）：通过Sherman-Morrison公式计算候选输入对目标相关方向的边际覆盖增益  
3. **选择算法**：按h_j降序排列，在每步从前κ·s个候选中选a_j(S)最大的，迭代至预算B。

Result: 1. **理论验证**：在SetFit/subj文本数据上，覆盖度得分AUROC仅为0.519，而完整边际得分AUROC达0.99；在CIFAR-10图像数据上，探针估计的有用数据量与测试最优量吻合（Kendall τ=1.00）。  
2. **GSM8K实验**：B=128时，TATC达到87.34%精确匹配，超过最强对手OptimSyn（86.07%）和TATC(Coverage)消融（85.19%），消融差距2.15分；在B=512时差距扩大至2.99分。在预算64、64、256时均优于OptimSyn，B=512时两者均值实际持平。

Conclusion: 本文为合成数据选择提供了原则性方法，通过量化和最大化其对目标任务的价值。线性理论揭示了合成数据的价值具有方向性、数量依赖性和边际性——同一个样本可以是增值的、冗余的或有害的，取决于现有数据和错误的存在。TATC将这一洞察转化为实用的选择方法，在LLM微调中联合考虑训练效应和目标覆盖度，推动合成数据流水线从孤立评估转向考虑数据上下文和下游任务。

Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

</details>


### [348] [On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00820)
*Fabio J. Fehr,Philip Torr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"即时权重生成"框架，使用超网络从少量示例直接生成紧凑专用模型的完整参数，并在ARC-1D测试床上验证其可行性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用大模型可从上下文适应多任务，但专用模型容量更小却需任务特定训练；作者探索能否仅凭少量演示直接生成专用模型参数，从而将任务推断与执行解耦。

Method: 采用编码器-解码器超网络：Transformer任务编码器压缩支持集为episode表征，两层MLP权重解码器通过低维瓶颈生成完整目标参数（三层Canon Transformer，含RoPE）。损失在支持集与查询上联合监督，训练中可有/无显式任务ID条件化。

Result: 单独训练的1.4K参数小模型可达98.9%准确率，联合训练仅74.0%；超网络生成的专用模型恢复专家性能；生成参数形成按变换组织的结构化权重空间（无任务ID时60.9%线性探针可分）；生成的专家可脱离超网络重复使用；在组合泛化和未见变换的留一法测试中，去除任务ID显著提升迁移能力（组合token精度+7.8%，未见token精度+13.4%，未见精确匹配+8.85%）。

Conclusion: 证明了从少量演示即时编译出紧凑可执行模型参数的概念可行性；权重空间具有可结构化、可重用与可泛化的特性；移除显式任务标识符反而提升分布外泛化能力，为模型即工具、即时个性化部署等方向奠定基础。

Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

</details>


### [349] [SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00838)
*Xinchen Du,Zhengze Zhou,Wenhui Zhu,Han Yu,Sen Na,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHARPO是一种用于智能体强化学习的信用分配机制，通过在交互段层级上利用组内成功rollout构建教师上下文，计算师生对数概率间隙衡量参数间的局部反馈，并以此产生GRPO优势的有界乘数，从而在稀疏终端奖励下对中间决策进行差异化信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多轮交互任务中，最终结果仅提供稀疏的轨迹级奖励信号，无法区分导致成功的有用中间动作和造成失败的局部错误动作，这导致了智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题。

Method: SHARPO包含五个步骤：1)识别交互段（动作或推理）；2)从同一GRPO组内选择一个成功rollout构建教师上下文；4)教师是策略参数的副本，评估学生的师生对数概率间隙；5)用sigmoid函数将间隙映射为有界权重w；6)经过长度平衡后，插值计算段级优势，以此最大化策略目标。理论上证明了与终身胜负参考具有相同符号的方向性与相近局部价值的一致性。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，SHARPO在ALFWorld和WebShop上均优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD，ALFWorld从70.57%提升至84.90%，WebShop从66.15%提升至75.26%。在多个ALFWorld任务类型和WebShop任务得分上均有提升，且对混合权重λ的取值不敏感。

Conclusion: SHARPO利用成功对端反馈在中间交互段上细化GRPO信用，为智能体训练提供了一种有效的段级信用分配方法，通过理论分析和实验结果证明了其在多轮交互任务中的有效性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

</details>


### [350] [Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00861)
*Melika Shirian,Kianoosh Vadaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于重要性引导的稳健性分配机制，用于在共享ℓ₁全局预算和坐标级局部容量约束下的对抗优化。核心思想是分离扰动的可行性（feasibility）与分配偏好（allocation preference）：通过固定的清洁梯度先验构造中心化的重要性图，引导扰动集中于高重要性位置，但不改变可行扰动集。在十个鲁棒模型-数据集配置上，相对匹配基线ASR提升2.52-17.70个百分点。消融实验证实中心化非均匀重分配与模型重要性对齐分别贡献了改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享ℓ₁预算与坐标级局部容量约束下，对抗优化不仅需要决定扰动量的大小，还需决定有限预算的分配位置。已有ℓ₁攻击（如ℓ₁-APGD）能够集中扰动到少数位置，但当这些位置达到局部容量上限后，剩余预算必须分配到其他可行坐标，此时缺乏明确的分配引导机制。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 威胁模型：可行集C(x,E,b)由全局均值ℓ₁预算（b=4/255）、坐标级异质局部容量（μE=12/255，σE=2/255）和图像范围约束[0,1]^D共同定义；(2) 清洁梯度重要性先验：从真实类别logit的梯度构造空间重要性图，经分位数裁剪、均值归一化、幂函数（γ=1.0）变换和clip截断[0.05, 8.0]处理；(3) 中心化分配目标：R_alloc(δ,M)=(1/(Db))∑(Mᵢ-1)√(δᵢ²+τ²)，通过Mᵢ-1实现高于均值的奖励、低于均值的惩罚。优化采用动量梯度法（μ=0.75）、余弦衰减步长、顺序可行性恢复（局部裁剪→图像范围→ℓ₁球投影），候选选择基于概率边际。

Result: 在十个鲁棒模型-数据集配置（CIFAR-10/100的WRN、XCiT模型；ImageNet的ConvNeXt-L、ViT-B-ConvStem、Swin-L等）上，本文方法相对APGD-CE、APGD-DLR和PMA匹配基线的ASR提升2.52-17.70个百分点（ImageNet/Peng et al.提升最大）。分配分析显示：基线在高重要性10%空间位置上放置约10.6-11.3%的扰动质量（接近均匀），而本文方法提升至19.15-30.36%。实现全局ℓ₁预算（≈3.91-3.97/255 vs 4.0）。消融实验表明：无分配指导时ASR下降9.4-14.0百分点；非中心化变体性能下降；随机掩码相比无掩码仍提升4.0-5.2百分点（证实非均匀重分配自身有益）；模型先验提供额外提升。所有30个配对比较p_Holm值均<10⁻¹⁸，统计显著。

Conclusion: 研究确认扰动分配是共享预算局部约束威胁模型下一个独立且实用的优化维度。中心化重要性引导分配通过在不改变可行集的前提下引导优化偏好，能显著提升匹配对抗优化器性能。该机制可推广至多种对抗损失（cross-entropy、margin、DLR、probability margin），且在均匀容量设置下同样有效。但本文未声称对专门ℓ₁攻击（如ℓ₁-APGD、FMN-ℓ₁）的普遍优越性——这些攻击在参考比较中仍更强。重要性图基于清洁梯度，未来可研究动态或学习型分配信号；λ按数据集在独立校准集上选择并在模型间冻结。

Abstract: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

</details>


### [351] [Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00873)
*Hongyu Cao,Xinyuan Wang,Arun Vignesh Malarkkan,Kunpeng Liu,Haifeng Chen,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对协变量偏移下表格数据稀缺与不平衡问题，提出IGDPR框架，通过不变性引导的潜在扩散模型合成任务相关数据，并结合基于原型的结构化重加权策略，在四个工业基准数据集上实现最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业表格数据面临协变量偏移问题，现有数据增强和重加权方法存在两大缺陷：生成模型仅模仿过时的源分布（误导性生成引导），点式重加权方法过拟合验证噪声（结构不稳定性）。

Method: 1）任务不变VAE（TI-VAE）通过多环境风险方差惩罚构建不变潜在空间；2）不变性引导的潜在扩散模型在反向去噪时利用冻结TI-VAE的任务、密度、重建信号作为奖励梯度引导生成；3）原型重加权在不变潜在空间进行K-Means聚类，以簇级别可靠性评分（任务+不变性损失与密度损失的综合函数）分配样本权重。

Result: 在C-MAPSS、MetroPT-3、Scania APS、Gas Sensor四个工业数据集上，IGDPR（Guided Latent Diffusion + Prototype）综合所有指标均达到最优；消融实验验证两模块协同性；信息平面分析显示域信息I(Z;E)降低35–65%，任务信息I(Z;Y)提升40–200%；超参数β≈1.0、γ∈[0.5,1.0]存在宽性能平台。

Conclusion: 不变性是目标监督不可用时的有效替代目标，可在协变量偏移下统一生成与重加权；未来方向包括无需先验结构的不变性发现、流式环境中的漂移域定义以及端到端不变子空间学习。

Abstract: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

</details>


### [352] [Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00888)
*Prachi Badarayani,Aidan Jay,Chenghui Zhou,Dayquan Julienne,Yuan Gao,Tianwei Chen,George Zerveas,Ishmam Zabir,Xiren Zhou,Chris Quirk,Xia Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出对冻结推理模型进行轻量级后训练来构建多令牌预测(MTP)头，仅需约2.5B训练token即可达到或超过联合预训练基线(如MiMo-7B)的吞吐量加速；同时提出链感知近似验证规则和自适应K值控制器，进一步优化MTP推理系统的吞吐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开源MTP家族(MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3)均需在完整预训练过程中(数万亿token)联合训练MTP头，drafter质量在预训练阶段就被锁定。本文质疑联合预训练是否是MTP高质量的必要条件，探索在冻结骨干模型上进行轻量级后训练构建MTP头的可能性，并优化相应的推理服务系统。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1)在冻结Qwen3-8B上使用自蒸馏(目标生成的思维链数据)进行交叉熵后训练，训练3个链式MTP头，每头约200M参数；(2)提出链感知近似验证规则(Eq1)，用链的运行几何平均概率阈值τ代替严格逐位置分布匹配，允许有界分布漂移；(3)提出在线Lower Confidence Bound(LCB)bandit控制器，动态选择MTP draft depth(K=1..6)，根据批量大小和文本难度优化吞吐量。

Result: 在GSM8K、MATH500、AIME24/25数学推理及MMLU-Redux、MBPP、MT-Bench、Alpaca、CNN/DailyMail等基准上：(1)后训练MTP头在MAL上达到或超过MiMo-7B，训练token减少10^3-10^4倍；(2)链感知验证在数学基准上平均提升MAL达+14%(从2.91到3.31)，任务准确率保持；(3)自适应控制器在高批量(bs=64/128)下恢复固定K=6损失的11-14%吞吐量，相对K=3达97-99%。自适应Mamba选择器策略可产生额外约4%的MAL提升。

Conclusion: 研究表明：在目标生成思维链数据上的轻量后训练可替代MTP头的联合预训练，计算效率提升10^3-10^4倍；链感知验证松弛在保持准确率前提下显著提升推理吞吐；自适应K值bandit解决了固定draft depth在高批量场景下的吞吐量崩溃。这套方案使MTP成为推理时可插拔的优化层，无需重新预训练骨干模型。

Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

</details>


### [353] [Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对 Kimi K2.7 Code（1T 参数 MoE 模型）仅使用 1,700 个专家构建的编码任务进行一轮 GSPO + rank-32 LoRA 的强化学习后训练，在六个外部基准（含四个训练数据收集后才发布的基准和两个训练中未使用过的智能体框架）上全部取得 pass@1 提升（4.7–20.0 pp），并通过配对轨迹分析揭示所迁移的是"完成工作的方式"（理解需求、测试需求、保护既有行为、重建真值），而非领域知识本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 编码智能体训练后的评估多在与训练数据同分布的格式上进行，难以区分模型学到的是领域知识还是"完成任务的一般能力"。本文旨在回答：仅在专家级智能体编码任务上做 RL，学到的东西能否跨基准、跨智能体框架、跨时间跨度迁移？即"完成工作的方式"是否可迁移？

Method: （1）数据：1,700 个专家构建任务（1,000 仓库任务 + 700 终端任务），均与六个评估基准无重叠；（2）奖励：部分信用（通过的检查比例）× pass-to-pass 测试硬门控（任一回归即零奖励）；（3）优化器：GSPO（序列级比率，适配 MoE）+ rank-32 LoRA 适配器，无 KL、无 SFT 预热、无熵奖励；（4）评估：六个外部基准 × 三个框架（mini-swe-agent、Terminus 2、Claude Code），其中四个基准晚于训练数据；（6）统计：Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel、Boschloo 精确检验。

Result: 六个基准全部提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8、DeepSWE 31.0→43.4、Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0、Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1、Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6、SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0；五个独立 task set 合并 p<0.001；训练后发布的三个 task set 合并 p=0.004；DeepSWE 与 Terminal-Bench 3 中位步数减少 24–35%；83% 的基础模型 DeepSWE 失败为近失（missed）；配对分析识别四种失败模式（遗漏需求、窄测试、静默回归、弱真值）及其被纠正后的行为。

Conclusion: 在 1,700 专家编码任务上仅做一轮 RL 即可在六个评估基准、三种框架（含两个训练未见框架）、多小时时间跨度和训练后发布的数据上稳定迁移；迁移的内容不是基础模型已具备的领域知识，而是一种"完整完成工作的工程习惯"——将规范视为合同、将自身工作视为待检验的假设。

Abstract: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

</details>


### [354] [GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00948)
*Geyi Yang,Zikun Qu,Xiang Li,Zhiyong Wang,Min Zhang,Shipei Zeng,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GUI-HARVEST 是一个针对 GUI 代理的自动 harness 优化框架，通过证据驱动的诊断、跨任务聚类和可执行代码编辑，使冻结骨干模型的 GUI 代理在 OSWorld-Verified 上取得稳定的留出表现提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
