Motivation: GUI 代理的性能严重依赖其外部可执行 harness（观察组装、动作执行、验证、恢复、终止控制）。现有针对非 GUI 代理的通用 harness 优化方法（如 Self-Harness、Meta-Harness）未解决三个 GUI 特有挑战：(1) 模型意图与视觉效果的脱节（如声称保存但对话框仍打开）；(2) 同一任务重复运行结果可变性（11.8–20.4% 的任务在三次执行中出现零分与正分翻转）；(3) 任务特定发现需提炼为可复用 harness 修改，且需验证修改确实针对失败模式。

Method: GUI-HARVEST 围绕四个角色形成自改进闭环：(1) Evidence Analyst 将模型输出/动作与前后截图对齐，生成有截图证据支持的 finding；(2) Cross-task Clusterer 将经验证的 finding 按确定性结果类别分组，聚类为跨任务行为模式（行为模式），保留任务本地证据链接；(3) Harness Engineer 将行为模式翻译为有边界的源代码补丁，并预先记录可观察的行为预测；(4) Validator 通过 L0/L1 代码检查、Search/Validation 效用硬门槛（任一分割正增长且无下降）以及基于任务级判定的行为软门槛验证补丁；通过则提升并开启下一轮，否则回滚。优化上限为 B=10 轮，每轮 P=5 次评估机会，Search K=3 次运行。

Result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上（361 任务，80 搜索/80 验证/201 测试），六个冻结骨干模型 15 步全部提升：Qwen3-VL-32B 测试 53.18% (+10.16)、完整套件 50.94% (+12.33)；OpenCUA-32B 测试 34.31% (+1.49)；Gemini 3.1 Pro 100 步达 79.14%；GPT-5 测试 61.86% (+5.51)。同骨干/同初始 harness 起点下，GUI-HARVEST 优于 Self-Harness (+2.00)、Meta-Harness (+4.38)，并在 LFF 的基础上更好。WAA 迁移 50 步 GPT-5 提升 13.87 分（50.88% → 64.75%），无 WAA 优化。消融实验表明视觉证据作用最显著（去掉后全量 40.69%）。GPT-5 在 15 步下准确率达 62.4%，API 成本约 72 美元，相比 Agent S3 100 步 62.6%/260 美元成本降低约 72%。

Conclusion: GUI-HARVEST 通过将多次多模态执行证据转化为可复用的 harness 修改并经效用与预测行为双重验证，证明 GUI 特定的诊断和验证机制能让 harness 改进更好地泛化到未见任务。所有六个冻结骨干在 OSWorld-Verified 上均获得留出测试集提升，其学习到的运行时机制可跨平台迁移。残留错误多为动作执行成功但目标错误、路线错误或评估相关状态错误的情况，此类轨迹缺乏明确的本地信号，使 harness 单独修正难度加大。

Abstract: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [355] [Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00968)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SaCRL提出了一种无需先验因果结构知识的因果表示学习框架,通过HSIC违规度量与SoftMin聚合实现结构自动识别与不变表示的联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法存在三难困境:基于结构的方法需已知DAG,分布不变方法强制固定不变性而在结构错配时失效;遗漏架构会丢弃预测信息,且无方法在结构识别不确定时给出理论保证。

Method: 1) 形式化三种典型因果结构(反因果𝒢₁、混淆后代𝒢₂、混淆结果𝒢₃)及其对应不变性约束;2) 用HSIC及其条件形式量化各候选不变性的违规程度Vₖ;3) 通过SoftMin聚合(自适应权重αₖ)将离散结构搜索松弛为连续优化;4) 用随机傅里叶特征(RFF)近似HSIC以降低计算复杂度;5) ERM热启动+温度退火+多起点初始化优化策略。

Result: 在合成数据上n=5000时结构识别准确率≥95%;半合成贝叶斯网络基准(ASIA/ALARM/SACHS)上达75-95%;Colored MNIST OOD准确率45.2%(优于ERM 27.2%、IRM 21.3%、CIRCE 10.3%);DomainBed三个基准(PACS/VLCS/OfficeHome)上平均提升+2.1/+4.2/+3.1pp;在结构错配和低环境多样性下优雅退化;识别准确率从n=500的68-78%单调提升到n=5000的95-97%。

Conclusion: SaCRL是首个联合识别因果结构并学习对应不变表示的统一端到端可微目标,填补了现有方法的理论空白;提供结构识别(包括RFF近似下)、不变性满足和OOD泛化的理论保证;对临床预测、算法公平、领域泛化等多领域具有应用价值。

Abstract: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [356] [Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00978)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TS-Router，一个用于时间序列异常检测（TSAD）的"通用表示 + 专用检测"框架。它利用冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提取可迁移的时间表征，再由一个轻量路由器根据该表征预测一组异构异常检测器（专用模型）的相对适用性（competence），从而为每个目标序列自适应地选择并组合最合适的检测器。训练阶段无需真实异常标签，通过在有标签的模拟任务上构造软性能力监督信号来训练路由器；部署阶段无需目标异常标签，先路由、再仅对被选中的检测器进行无监督适配与得分融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构时间序列具有不同的时序动态和"正常性"概念，单一的异常评分准则难以泛化。现有基于基础模型（TSFM）的 TSAD 方法通常将可迁移表征与固定的预测/重构异常评分耦合，效果往往不如简单的局部统计基线。因此需要重新思考基础模型在 TSAD 中的角色：与其直接定义异常准则，不如让其作为"协调者"，根据序列上下文选择最合适的专用检测器。

Method: 1) **合成能力监督**：基于 Syn-RCD 构建大量带标签的模拟任务，将 11 个轻量、异构的无监督异常检测器（覆盖子空间重建、密度、邻域、一类分类、孤立森林、原型距离、谱残差等不同归纳偏置）在模拟任务上评估 VUS-PR 能力，并转化为 softmax 软目标。2) **基础模型引导的能力路由**：冻结 TSFM 编码器（如 TimeRCD、Chronos、MOMENT），取末层 token 嵌入均值池化得到序列级表征 z；训练一个轻量 MLP 路由器 g_θ 将 z 映射为 K 个专用模型的能力分布，以 KL 散度匹配软目标。3) **离线路由与检测（route-before-fit）**：部署时无需目标异常标签，路由器先预测能力并选 Top-k（默认 k=3）专用模型，再对这些被选中模型在目标序列训练前缀上无监督拟合，对其归一化得分进行均值融合和 min-max 缩放作为最终异常得分。4) **理论分析**：在表征覆盖和条件能力稳定假设下，证明了模拟到真实任务的 Top-k 集合能力遗憾上界（Theorem 1），并推导了在边界分离条件下的集合恢复与融合得分一致性（Corollary 1）。

Result: 在 16 个真实 TSAD 基准（11 个真正单变量 + 5 个多变量）和 4 种互补评估指标（VUS-PR、Affiliation-F1、F1_T、Standard-F1）上，TS-Router 取得最优的平均排名（Overall Rank 2.66），并在 64 个数据集-指标组合中 26 次第一、39 次进入前二，全面优于直接零样本 TSFM 模型（TimeRCD、DADA、Chronos、MOMENT、TimesFM、Time-MoE）和目标拟合无监督模型（OmniAnomaly、USAD、TranAD、TFMAE、DCdetector）。受控消融显示：(i) Top-3 路由优于 Best Fixed、Best Fixed Top-3、Router Top-1 和 Full Ensemble 等策略；(ii) 三种冻结 TSFM 编码器（TimeRCD/Chronos/MOMENT）作为路由器输入均优于 Catch22、TSFresh、BasicStats、MiniRocket 等手工特征，验证了预训练表征对能力估计的有效性；(iii) 在合成到真实、留一数据集出、域内有限支持三种算法选择迁移设置下，TS-Router 均优于或与经典算法选择器（SATzilla、ARGOSMART、MetaOD、ISAC、MSAD、UReg）相当，且无需真实标签历史。

Conclusion: TS-Router 重新定位了时间序列基础模型在 TSAD 中的角色：可迁移的时间表征用于评估和路由专用检测器，而非直接充当统一的异常评分器。理论分析在显式迁移假设下给出了 Top-k 集合能力的遗憾界，实验在多个冻结 TSFM 编码器和大规模基准上验证了"通用表征 → 专用能力估计 → 自适应选择与融合"路径的有效性。该方法受模拟任务分布覆盖范围影响，且当前多变量处理采用逐变量路由，未显式建模跨变量交互。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [357] [Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01028)
*Sung Ho Jo,Seonghwi Kim,Wonsang Yun,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出POTER，一种基于最优传输（OT）的样本重加权框架，用于在虚假相关性和标签噪声双重挑战下实现鲁棒学习。核心创新在于利用OT对偶势能从训练分布与参考分布之间的传输几何中推导样本重要性，无需基于损失的样本选择或重训练阶段，仅需单次ERM训练即可在标准基准和噪声标签设置下取得最优最差组精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚假相关性缓解方法依赖基于损失的代理信号来识别有信息量的样本，但在标签噪声下该假设脆弱——被错误标注的样本同样会产生大损失，从而污染后续的重加权或重训练流程。此外，现有方法多需重训练，计算开销大；在标签噪声集中于少数子群的"子群集中标签噪声"设置下，性能进一步恶化。

Method: 1. **参考分布构建**：利用有限验证集的组注释，构建按组加权混合的经验参考分布，对偏差冲突的少数组赋予更高权重。2. **类条件最优传输**：求解训练分布与参考分布之间的OT问题（仅在同类别样本间传输，代价为预训练特征空间的欧氏距离），获得对偶势能 f*。3. **样本重加权**：通过KL正则化优化将 f* 转化为指数形式权重 w_i* ∝ exp(-f_i*/τ)，对与参考分布对齐良好的样本赋予更高重要性。

Result: 在CMNIST、Waterbirds、CelebA、CivilComments四个标准基准上，POTER在使用验证组标签的方法中达到最优最差组精度（CMNIST 72.5%、Waterbirds 90.9%、CelebA 90.4%）。对称标签噪声下，30%噪声时在Waterbirds上达到85.3%（KNN-RAD为68.9%）。子群集中标签噪声下显著优于KNN-RAD（如Waterbirds 60%噪声时78.3% vs 7.5%）。OT计算开销极低（最大数据集仅4.52秒），无需任何重训练阶段。

Conclusion: POTER是首个基于OT的虚假相关性缓解重加权框架，通过基于参考分布对齐的样本重要性机制，以单一统一的加权规则同时处理虚假相关性和标签噪声，无需代理样本选择或重训练管道。其类条件对偶势能有效识别偏差冲突样本并抑制错标样本，揭示了先前被忽视的子群集中标签噪声失败模式，为子群体偏移下的鲁棒学习提供了新方向。局限性在于仍依赖具有代表性且类别标注的验证集。

Abstract: Machine learning models often suffer performance degradation under subpopulation shift, particularly when spurious correlations cause models to rely on shortcut features that fail to generalize across subgroups. A recent line of work mitigates this issue by using loss-based signals to identify informative samples, but these signals can become severely distorted under label noise: mislabeled samples may also incur large losses and contaminate subsequent reweighting or retraining. Despite its practical importance, this intersection remains largely underexplored. We propose POTER, a reweighting framework based on optimal transport that derives sample importance from the transport geometry between the training distribution and a reference distribution constructed from limited validation group annotations. By measuring alignment at the individual-sample level rather than relying on loss, POTER downweights mislabeled or strongly bias-aligned samples while assigning higher importance to samples better aligned with the reference distribution. In addition, POTER requires only a single ERM training stage, moving beyond the retraining paradigm common in recent work. Across standard benchmarks and noisy-label settings, POTER achieves state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy, including cases where label corruption is concentrated within minority subgroups.

</details>


### [358] [Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01133)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Ruihan Guo,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"策略空间缩放"(policy-space scaling)新范式，通过SURGE方法从已完成的RL训练历史中构建出比最优检查点更强的单一部署策略，无需额外训练或增加推理计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的推理能力提升依赖延长RL训练或增加推理时计算。作者质疑这一假设：已完成的RL训练历史是否已包含足够结构来构建更强的策略，从而开辟一条新的"策略空间缩放"维度。

Method: SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion) 是一种无梯度的权重融合方法：(1) 从同一RL运行中选取高精度anchor和响应更短的donor两个检查点；(2) 将两者表示为相对于共享初始化的delta更新；(3) 对anchor的delta做SVD谱分解，保留其保护块（前k个主导奇异方向）；(4) 用donor的互补分量替换anchor保护块外的部分。融合控制(FC)参数通过权重中保留的能量比例（τ=0.95）自动校准，无需精度扫描。该构造是参数空间中的非仿射操作，生成的策略与任何标量插值都不同。

Result: 在三个RL训练历史上验证：(1) DeepSeek-1.5B数学推理：AIME24达54.17%，超越19个原生检查点中最优的50.83%，平均精度提升2.08点，token减少5.3%；(2) Nemotron-1.5B：平均精度提升1.78点，token减少12.8%；(3) OLMo-7B代码：HumanEval+达83.7%，超越最优原生82.8%，token减少10.3%。消融实验证明delta-first SVD（54.17% vs 41.67%绝对权重SVD）、保护块几何、donor互补贡献均不可或缺，标量插值、checkpoint平均、随机子空间等基线均无法复现增益。

Conclusion: RL训练历史是可复用的缩放资源。优化器访问的检查点不必代表该训练历史的能力上限。策略空间缩放将已有的RL更新重新组合为单一可部署策略，与训练时缩放和推理时缩放互补，为RL扩展策略提供了新维度。

Abstract: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

</details>


### [359] [Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01143)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DR-TFM，一种参数高效的分布鲁棒适配框架，通过仅微调查询缩放网络（仅更新TabPFN-3的0.016%参数）来缓解子群体偏移下表格基础模型的性能退化，无需真实组标签即可在多个表格基准上显著提升最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFMs）虽然在平均准确率上表现强劲，但在子群体偏移（训练和部署数据中各子群体比例发生变化）下，对代表性不足群体的性能可能严重下降。现有TFM适配方法未明确针对子群体偏移，且传统鲁棒学习方法需要真实组标签或修改大量模型参数。

Method: DR-TFM框架将分布鲁棒优化（DRO）与TFM适配相结合，通过两种方式构建模糊集：(1) DR-TFM (GR) 基于聚类预训练TFM嵌入估计的伪组使用GroupDRO；(2) DR-TFM (MS) 使用多源DRO，通过聚类或重采样构建源子集。两种方法都仅通过微调一个轻量级的查询缩放网络（query scaling network）来调整查询向量各坐标的缩放因子，从而重新加权查询对上下文样本的注意力，保持所有其他预训练参数固定。

Result: 在5个表格基准测试和ACS Income数据集上，DR-TFM (GR)和DR-TFM (MS)的平均最差组准确率分别比TabPFN提升24.63和21.37个百分点，且保持竞争力的平均组准确率。查询缩放策略仅更新0.016%参数，比TabPFN全模型微调快7-9倍。该方法在TabPFN-3.5、EXAONE、TabFM和Causilo四个其他TFM上也取得一致的最差组准确率提升。仿真分析显示适配后少数群体样本将更多注意力分配给自身组的上下文样本。

Conclusion: DR-TFM是首个明确针对子群体偏移且无需真实组标签的TFM适配框架，通过查询缩放实现参数高效、内存高效且可扩展的鲁棒适配。该方法在多个TFM上一致提升最差组性能，为表格基础模型在分布偏移下的可靠部署提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

</details>


### [360] [Looping Beyond Twice: A Scalable Recipe for Looped Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01153)
*Di He,Pengxiang Li,Da Chang,Qingyan Meng,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LOOM，一种可扩展的循环 MoE 架构方案，通过残差缩放与嵌入重注入稳定循环状态，通过逐循环路由器与循环残差实现专家计算多样化，使 MoE LLMs 能稳定扩展到 9–12 个循环，在 FLOPs 匹配条件下实现有效深度扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环 Transformer 在 MoE 大模型、FLOPs 匹配条件下难以扩展到两个循环以上。原因是：(1) 循环放大了"深度诅咒"——残差累积导致隐状态方差爆炸、表示漂移；(2) 共享路由器导致"专家选择坍缩"——各循环反复选中相同专家，新增计算缺乏多样性。该论文旨在系统分析并解决这两大障碍。

Method: 核心设计原则：每个循环都应贡献新计算同时保持循环状态稳定。具体技术包括：(1) 稳定循环状态：残差缩放 γ=λ/(H√M) 限制累积，输入嵌入每轮以 g_t=λ/(t√M) 重注入以防漂移；(2) 多样化循环计算：每个循环配备独立路由器（共享专家权重），引入基于固定衰减 EMA 的 Looping Residual（含全局记忆与局部记忆）将先前输出向前传递；(3) 采用分段反向传播（K=3），限制梯度深度以降低显存与提升稳定性。

Result: 在 100M–1.7B 参数规模、5B–60B token 上的实验：(1) 近等 FLOP 条件下，700M 模型 5 循环最优（困惑度 18.36→16.54，零样本平均准确率 38.84%→39.53%）；(2) 非 FLOP 匹配条件下，1.7B/60B tokens 模型在 9 循环时达最佳（困惑度 9.62→7.77，平均准确率 42.4%→47.7%）；(3) 各规模模型可稳定扩展至 9–12 循环，优于仅使用残差缩放或仅嵌入重注入的基线。消融实验验证了四个组件（残差缩放、嵌入重注入、MoE RMSNorm、Looping Residual、逐循环路由）均为必要。

Conclusion: LOOM 成功将 MoE LLM 的循环深度扩展至远超两个循环，证明循环深度是 MoE 语言模型一条计算高效的新扩展轴线。其稳定化（残差缩放+嵌入重注入）与多样化（逐循环路由+Looping Residual）的双重设计可推广到不同参数规模，且无需重新调优循环相关超参数（λ、β、K）。

Abstract: Looped Transformers introduce recurrent depth as a new scaling axis for LLMs: by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, they increase effective depth without increasing parameter count. However, the benefits of looping remain unclear for large MoE LLMs under FLOPs-matched comparisons. The main reason is that the gains from additional iterations diminish quickly and can even turn into degradation, so the extra FLOPs spent on looping yield little substantial improvement. Consequently, prior work typically settles on two loops. We identify two main obstacles to scaling looped MoE. First, looping inherits and amplifies the curse of depth: hidden-state variance grows with each iteration as residual updates accumulate, which destabilizes deep recurrence and causes representations to drift. Second, looped MoE suffers from expert selection collapse: routers repeatedly select the same experts across loops, so extra iterations add computation without adding computational diversity. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose LOOM, built on a single principle: each loop should contribute new computation while keeping the recurrent state stable. LOOM stabilizes recurrence by scaling residual updates to bound variance growth and re-injecting the input embedding at every loop, and diversifies it through per-loop routers that engage different experts and a Looping Residual that carries earlier outputs forward. Experiments across 100M-1.7B models show stable scaling to 9-12 loops. Under near-iso-FLOP, the 700M model performs best at 5 loops, reducing perplexity from 18.36 to 16.54 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 38.84% to 39.53% over the non-looped baseline. Without FLOP matching, the 1.7B model trained on 60B tokens peaks at 9 loops, reducing perplexity from 9.62 to 7.77 and improving average zero-shot accuracy from 42.4% to 47.7%. Code is available this https URL .

</details>


### [361] [Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching: Coupling-Sensitive End-to-End Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01193)
*Yunrui Guan,Krishnakumar Balasubramanian,Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对反事实生成任务，提出基于流匹配（flow matching）的端到端框架，结合样本分割的双重鲁棒训练目标和学得的源-目标耦合（通过熵最优传输），并采用基于高斯平滑插值的得分修正随机SDE采样器。核心理论贡献是给出耦合敏感（coupling-sensitive）的KL散度上界——其有限步Euler离散误差由源-目标耦合的位移矩 $D_5=(\mathbb{E}\|Y_1-Y_0\|^5)^{1/5}$ 控制，而非由速度场的全局一致正则性控制，且具有关于环境维度的近线性依赖。作者还建立了速度场与得分场的有限样本非参数保证，将逼近误差、耦合替换误差、混杂估计误差、泛化误差与蒙特卡洛误差分离，最终得到关于原始反事实目标的端到端 $W_1$ 保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在观察数据中进行反事实推断需要生成反事实干预下的完整结果分布，但处理分配机制的选择偏差使得直接生成困难。现有方法主要解决双重鲁棒训练问题，但忽略了源-目标耦合质量与有限步离散误差之间的联系，且其分析依赖全局正则性假设，无法直接控制由耦合位移决定的误差。

Method: 1. 高斯平滑插值 $X_t = Y_0 + t(Y_1-Y_0) + \sigma G$；2. 样本分割——辅助集估计倾向性、预测oracle和熵最优传输耦合 $\widehat{Q}_n$，训练集用双重鲁棒目标学习速度和得分场；3. 得分修正SDE采样器 $dZ_t = (v_t(Z_t) + \tau^2 s_t(Z_t)/2)dt + \tau dB_t$；4. Girsanov论证获得KL上界，利用后验导数恒等式将速度/得分导数表示为 $D=Y_1-Y_0$ 与高斯 $G$ 的条件矩，再通过条件方差收缩与高斯矩控制得维度近线性依赖。

Result: 1. 耦合敏感KL采样界：当 $\varepsilon_{vel}=\varepsilon_{score}=0$，取 $\tau^2=\sigma D_5/d$，KL误差 $\lesssim hdD_5^2/\sigma^2 + h^2 d^2 D_5^3/\sigma^3$，对应Euler步数 $\widetilde{O}(d[D_5^2/(\varepsilon_{target}^2\sigma^2) + D_5/\sigma])$，相比已有 $O(d^2)$ 改善为近线性 $O(d)$；2. 双重鲁棒速度/得分场有限样本界 $O(\mathcal{A} + (1+2\pi_{\min}^{-1})\sigma^{-(d+1)} n^{-2/(d+5)})$；3. 端到端样本复杂度 $n \gtrsim \max\{[\max\{(2+\varepsilon_{OT}^{-1})\overline{D_5}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-7}, \overline{D_5}\varepsilon_{OT}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-9}\}]^{d+2}, [(1+2\pi_{\min}^{-1})\max\{\overline{D_5}^{-1}\varepsilon_{target}^{-(d+6)}, \overline{D_5}\varepsilon_{target}^{-(2d+9)}\}]^{(d+5)/2}\}$，得到 $W_1(\mu_1, \mathcal{L}(\widehat{Z}_N)) \lesssim \varepsilon_{target}$；4. 在合成和半合成图像基准上验证耦合依赖性，并显示在有限步预算下随机SDE优于确定性ODE。

Conclusion: 本文建立了反事实流匹配的完整框架，将耦合学习、场估计与有限步离散误差联合分析。核心创新在于：证明有限步采样误差由耦合位移矩 $D_5$ 控制而非全局正则性，并改善维度依赖至近线性。双重鲁棒学习界清晰分离多种误差来源，端到端保证为反事实生成提供了首个将耦合质量显式纳入的理论保证。实验表明，得分修正随机采样在固定步数下能改善ODE基线。

Abstract: Counterfactual generation seeks to sample outcomes under a hypothetical intervention or decision using observational data collected under the factual assignment mechanism. We develop a flow-matching approach that combines a sample-split, doubly robust training objective with a learned coupling between observed source outcomes and target outcomes drawn from a fitted conditional outcome model. To enable finite-step generation, we leverage a score-corrected stochastic sampler based on a Gaussian-smoothed interpolation. Our main theoretical contribution is a coupling-sensitive KL bound for constant-step Euler discretization: the error is controlled by moments of the source--target displacement under the chosen coupling, rather than by global uniform regularity of the velocity field, and has near-linear dependence on the ambient dimension. We also establish finite-sample non-parametric guarantees for the learned velocity and score fields when both the conditional outcome model and the source-target coupling are estimated from data. These bounds separate approximation, coupling-replacement, nuisance-estimation, generalization, and Monte Carlo errors and, combined with the sampler analysis, yield an end-to-end guarantee for counterfactual generation. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic image benchmarks support the coupling-dependent theory and show that, at finite discretization budgets, the stochastic sampler can outperform the corresponding deterministic ODE sampler.

</details>


### [362] [Have an LLM Write Your Anomaly Detector: Autonomous Discovery of Compact, Interpretable Detectors for Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01223)
*David Berghaus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种LLM驱动的自动研究循环，将大语言模型用作时间序列异常检测器的"作者"而非检测器本身。循环通过反复编辑一个简短的NumPy程序，在无泄漏目标函数下保留最优检测器。最终发现了两个紧凑的检测器(单变量和多变量)，在TSB-AD基准上领先所有基线方法(包括Time-RCD基础模型)，且无需GPU训练神经网络，运行速度优于所有同等性能的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测在准确性、计算效率和可解释性之间存在权衡。传统检测器便宜但需手工调参，深度模型减少调参但成本高且不透明。作者希望探索LLM驱动的程序搜索能否作为实际工具，自动发现准确、高效、透明的时间序列异常检测器。

Method: 1. **自主研究循环(Autoresearch Loop)**：LLM智能体迭代编辑单个Python/NumPy程序，每轮包括：(i)检查当前程序和得分，(ii)提出修改，(iii)运行验证评估，(iv)读取得分。完整轨迹(包括降低得分的尝试)保留在上下文中。2. **搜索空间约束**：候选检测器限定为短NumPy程序，固定签名(接收训练段和测试段，返回每时间步异常分数)。3. **无泄漏合成验证**：仅在每个序列训练区域的保留切片中注入合成异常(GutenTAG类型)，不接触真实标签。4. **驱动模型对比**：Opus 4.8、GPT 5.6 Terra、较小的开源MiniMax-2.5，以及ShinkaEvolve进化搜索框架。5. **发现的单变量检测器**：滑动窗口→Hann锥化→FFT功率谱→19维谱组织签名(熵、峰值集中度、质心、对数能量、对数平坦度、低/高频比、对数-对数谱斜率、复杂度坍缩项+11个对数间隔频段功率)→通过收缩全协方差马氏距离(λ=0.95)与正常训练窗口的高斯分布比较→多尺度(dyadic)融合+尾部强调权重。6. **发现的多变量检测器**：窗口长度L=80，6个频段/通道，去DC+汉宁窗后拼接所有通道为n_b×C维描述符，用池化岭正则化协方差(η=10⁻²)拟合高斯模型，用平方马氏距离评分；窗口跨步采样并硬限上限(4000)以保证近线性运行。

Result: 1. **TSB-AD基准**：Opus 4.8环路在四个指标(隶属F、F1-T、标准F1、VUS-PR)的16个数据族中获得第一名最多。VUS-PR上获得8个第一，标准F1上获得9个第一。多变量侧TSB-AD上GPT 5.6 Terra环路略胜Opus，但TAB上Opus领先。2. **效率**：多变量检测器是所有方法中最快的(0.054秒/序列)；单变量约5μs/步，与LOF相当。比GPU深度检测器快40-120倍。Time-RCD仅因GPU批量前向略快。3. **消融研究**：驱动模型最重要(Opus大幅领先)，搜索程序影响较小。但agentic循环产生单原理、紧凑、可读的程序；ShinkaEvolve进化搜索即使在相同提示下也收敛到标准方法的臃肿集成。4. **新颖性验证**：用catch22特征替代发现的谱签名后VUS-PR从53.9降至28.4，说明优势来自特定描述符组合而非新颖性框架本身。5. **TAB基准验证**：多变量侧Opus在所有四个范围感知指标上第一；单变量侧Opus在ROC指标上领先，KMeans在精度指标上领先；区域隶属F上Opus仅为中游(因其产生尖锐峰值而非宽区域)。6. **发现成本**：每个检测器在约1小时会话、约100次编辑评估迭代中产生，可通过20美元订阅计划访问。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的程序搜索是发现准确、高效、透明时间序列异常检测器的实用路径。Opus 4.8环路发现了两个基于谱-高斯新思想的紧凑单原理检测器，在TSB-AD基准上领先所有经典、深度和基础模型基线(包括Time-RCD)，同时无需GPU训练、无神经网络、单CPU运行、代码可审计。这一方法将人类工作从设计检测器转移到设计评估harness、合成异常生成器和优化目标，同时保持成本可承受。限制包括：对合成异常先验的依赖、TSB-AD上的优势不完全推广到TAB所有指标、需更广泛基准验证。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection trades off predictive accuracy, computational efficiency, and interpretability. We use a large language model not as the detector but as the author of one: an autonomous research loop in which the model repeatedly edits a single short NumPy program under a leakage-free objective, keeping the best-scoring detector it finds. The loop discovers two compact detectors, one for univariate and one for multivariate series, that describe short windows by their local spectral features and compare them with the training-region distribution through a covariance-aware distance. On the TSB-AD benchmark these detectors lead the field across metrics, ahead of the strongest classical, deep, and foundation-model baselines including Time-RCD, yet they train no network and use no GPU, and the multivariate detector is faster than every similarly performing baseline. LLM-driven program search is thus a practical route to accurate, efficient, and transparent detectors.

</details>


### [363] [Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01284)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于EEG、OCT、临床和多中心数据模型验证方法的教程性论文，系统综述了各类验证策略（留出法、k折交叉验证、分层、留一/留p、分组感知、嵌套交叉验证等），并通过八个受控场景对比了有缺陷设计与防泄漏设计，强调"独立单元须匹配部署目标，且所有数据相关操作必须排除用于性能估计的样本"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型验证常因划分不当产生乐观且稳定的错误结果，导致泛化性能被高估，尤其在医学与神经科学数据（具有层级结构、重复测量、多中心来源）场景下尤为严重。本文旨在系统梳理常见验证方法、剖析常见泄漏来源，并为实践者提供可复现的对照实验与决策指导。

Method: 1. 文献综述与原则提炼：归纳独立单元、观测单元、部署目标、数据依赖操作（特征选择、归一化等）与性能估计的隔离原则；2. 八种验证策略系统讲解：hold-out、train/val/test、repeated random subsampling、k-fold与repeated stratified CV、LOO/LpO、group-aware、nested group CV；3. 八个受控仿真场景：七组采用锁定混淆矩阵+可审计指标（含ICI/McNemar等），一组采用可复现重复研究仿真，覆盖全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、测试集复用、估计器不稳定等；4. 偏差-方差-度量聚合-不确定性-计算成本五维度评估；5. 提供数据规模矩阵、决策树、报告清单与MATLAB/scikit-learn模板。

Result: 结果显示没有"普适最优"的验证方法；当独立单元与部署目标不匹配时，所有指标均偏向乐观；当特征选择或归一化跨越训练测试边界时，准确性可显著虚增；分组感知与嵌套CV在依赖数据上能恢复无偏估计但代价更高；锁定混淆矩阵与重复研究仿真均能定量揭示泄漏量级；不确定性随折数与重复次数可被合理量化。

Conclusion: 核心结论：模型验证的有效性取决于独立单元是否匹配部署目标，以及所有数据依赖操作（特征选择、归一化、超参搜索等）是否严格隔离于性能估计样本；研究者应根据数据结构（EEG epoch、双眼配对OCT、重复临床测量、多中心）选择相应验证策略，并遵循报告清单，使用可复现模板以确保审计与重现。

Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

</details>


### [364] [Feature Selective Model Collapse in Diffusion Models: Total Replacement versus Fixed-Budget Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01318)
*Hanna Malet,Gabriel Turinici*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在递归训练下的"模型坍缩"现象，研究了一种介于完全替换（last generation）和无限累积（accumulate）之间的"固定预算（fixed-budget/accumulate-subsample）"协议。理论分析与实验均表明：完全替换导致快速、全面的退化；而固定预算协议下，特征呈现"脆弱/鲁棒"二分——大特征值方向（脆弱特征，如分布尾部/稀有样本）在少量代数内即丢失，而小特征值方向（鲁棒特征）可在极长代数内近似保留，从而调和了文献中看似矛盾的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有文献对模型坍缩得出看似矛盾结论：Shumailov等认为合成数据替换真实数据导致坍缩；Gerstgrasser等认为累积真实与合成数据可避免坍缩。作者聚焦于有限预算训练管线中常见的"既累积所有历史数据、又保持每代训练集固定大小"的中间协议（accumulate-subsample），该协议使真实数据占比渐趋于零但永不丢弃数据，旨在从特征层面调和前述争论并解释实践中常见的"部分坍缩"。

Method: 1) 提出"末代（last generation）"与"固定预算（fixed budget）"两种递归训练协议；2) 对扩散训练采用DDPM训练+DDIM采样，并假设数据集与模型参数一一对应（"扩散模型假设"）；3) 在参数空间对重训练映射做NTK式一阶Taylor线性化，得到对称正定压缩矩阵M与加性噪声ε；4) 在"特征基"下将多代参数动力学化为随机递推（VAR(1)形式与Borkar型递推），分别用经典随机递推收敛引理推导两种协议的逐点/分布收敛性与逐特征"半衰期"；5) 在2D螺旋、MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10上以FID、pixel-FID、W₂进行实证验证。

Result: 1) 末代协议：模型参数不逐点收敛，而是收敛于某个非零方差的平稳分布π^LG_T∞，均值以(1−λ)^n指数衰减，半衰期为⌈log2/−log|1−λ|⌉，所有特征在有限代内（最坏约69代）即丢失；2) 固定预算协议：目标参数逐点趋于零，逐特征衰减遵循∏(1−λ/k)≈n^−λ/Γ(1−λ)，半衰期≈e^−γ·2^{1/λ}，小λ（≈0.01）下半衰期高达10^29量级，几乎永不失忆；3) 实验：图像基准与2D螺旋下，末代协议快速退化为接近白噪声；固定预算协议仅丢失部分特征，整体结构（数字形状、衣物类别、场景纹理）得以保留，FID与W₂增长显著低于末代；4) 特征二分为"脆弱特征"（λ~1，关联分布尾部/低密度区域）和"鲁棒特征"（λ~0），为实践中需要真实数据刷新/溯源的内容提供了量化指导。

Conclusion: 两种协议不是程度之差而是质的不同：末代协议在有限代内抹去所有特征；固定预算协议使数据特征分化为脆弱与鲁棒两类，脆弱特征快速丢失而鲁棒特征在实际意义上永久保留。这一结果从特征动力学层面统一了Shumailov、Gertsgrasser、Seddik、Barzilai-Shamir等工作的结论，并为大规模训练管线中针对脆弱特征进行真实数据刷新、合成内容披露与溯源追踪提供了理论依据。局限包括：理论为NTK式一阶线性响应、假设较强；特征与语义属性的对应为基于实验的解释性关联；实验采用无条件DDIM采样、小模型从头训练，未涉及大规模预训练微调、引导采样或数据池策展等。

Abstract: Model collapse arises when generative models are trained on synthetic data produced by earlier models. The phenomenon has attracted considerable attention because of its societal and technical implications. However, previous studies have reached seemingly contradictory conclusions: replacing real data with synthetic data causes collapse (Shumailov et al.), yet accumulating real data alongside synthetic data can prevent it. For diffusion models, we study an intermediate regime typical of finite-budget pipelines: all past datasets and the real data are kept, but each new model is trained on a fixed-size sample from this growing pool, so the real fraction vanishes without any data being removed. Experiments on a 2D spiral dataset as well as the image benchmarks (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10) show that replacement protocol degrades dataset rapidly as in the literature, whereas the fixed budget degrades only partially, sparing some features. A linear-response model of the multi-generational parameter dynamics, analyzed by stochastic recursion, confirms that the two protocols differ: some features will be fragile and lost within a few generations for both protocols, while some will be robust and preserved over practically unbounded horizons under the fixed budget protocol.

</details>


### [365] [Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01355)
*Alessandro Micheli,Andrea Zerio,Samir Bhatt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于离散Wasserstein几何的有限状态空间一步生成建模框架"Discrete Drifting"，通过目标相对KL梯度流定义在可逆马尔可夫核上的转移，借助Markov跳跃在粒子层面实现概率流，并将迭代传输更新分摊到潜变量条件生成器中，使训练时使用迭代动力学但推理保持一步完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型和流式生成器在推理时需要迭代传输，而Drifting模型通过在训练时摊销迭代实现一步生成。将Drifting扩展到离散数据面临两大障碍：(1)有限状态空间上的粒子无法做无穷小移动；(2)有限空间上标准W₂度量无法诱导有用的无穷小传输结构(W₂~O(√δt)，当δt→0时发散)。因此需要为有限空间找到合适的传输几何及兼容的粒子动力学。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1)基于Maas (2011)的离散Wasserstein几何，使用对数均值移动度(logarithmic mean mobility)和可约、可逆马尔可夫核K定义动态传输距离W_K，使离散热方程成为熵的W_K梯度流；(2)将目标相对KL泛函ℱ_p(q)=KL(q∥p)替换熵泛函，推导出边电流J_{p,q}和归一化无关的logit drift Δ_g(x)，其分解为"模型排斥"和"目标吸引"两项，并通过stop-gradient目标实现Euler离散化；(3)通过取电流的正向部分构造非负跳跃率的Markov跳跃过程作为粒子实现，证明其与law-level梯度流和logit更新均通过前向Euler步精确或二阶一致地等价，并用摊销损失将迭代传输分摊到潜变量条件MLP中。

Result: 在32×32周期网格(1024状态)上，控制实验验证了三项结果：(1)精确表格流(无估计/表示/优化误差)显示KL从1.85降至约1.3×10⁻¹⁰，TV从0.71降至7.7×10⁻⁶，且KL耗散与Maas几何预测的离散Fisher信息一致(误差<1%);(2)冻结跳跃转换在law层面与Euler步以机器精度完全等价(残差~10⁻¹⁶)，与logit更新的残差呈拟合斜率2.00的二阶一致性，粒子直方图以O(M^{-1/2})速率收敛；(3)有限容量MLP(3层×128宽，256个潜变量)成功跟踪1600步条件oracle，每步最终训练/留出/边际误差 TV为图1.09×10⁻³，最终边际恢复三个不同权重目标模式。增大拟合批量b可使神经与oracle差距降低一个数量级以上。

Conclusion: 结论验证了离散漂移的基本构造：相对KL梯度流在Maas几何下实现，一步生成通过冻结Markov转换摊销保持不变。提出的对数图(logit chart)中归一化无关的漂移和边最优的粒子实现为将Discrete Drifting扩展到结构化离散数据提供了基础。未来工作将聚焦于可扩展的局部比率估计和与强离散扩散及一步基线在真实离散数据上的评估对比。

Abstract: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. We further show that a finite-capacity neural generator can track these exact transport targets while retaining one-step generation. These results validate the basic construction and provide a foundation for scaling Discrete Drifting to structured discrete data.

</details>


### [366] [FedMIX-P: Mixing Local and Global Preconditioners for Federated Vision and Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01515)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedMIX-P提出在联邦学习每一步局部训练中,将共享预条件子与客户端局部自适应预条件子进行凸混合的机制,以抑制异构数据下预条件子差异与梯度异质性耦合导致的聚合偏差;理论证明在光滑非凸随机目标下取得 O(R^{-1/2}) 平稳性界,实验在视觉与语言任务上较对应局部优化器提升最高 19.47 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中将客户端自适应优化器(如 SOAP、Sophia、Muon)直接本地化使用时,异构数据会使不同客户端的预条件子发散,从而即使在共享模型点评估梯度,聚合方向也会因预条件子-梯度耦合项而偏离真实全局梯度方向,降低联邦训练效果,需要新的机制来协调局部与全局预条件子。

Method: 服务器维护并下发共享预条件子参考 P^r;每轮起始客户端重置局部状态 P_i^{r,0}=P^r;每一步使用混合算子 H_i^{r,k}=(1-λ_r)P^r+λ_r P_i^{r,k} 作用于梯度,λ_r 按 Θ(R^{-1/2}) 衰减,服务端聚合终端预条件子更新参考;理论针对有界线性对称正定预条件子,在光滑非凸、随机梯度、部分参与假设下,通过分解聚合方向为全局项+偏差项+噪声项,推导平稳性界,并构造两客户端反例说明固定 λ>0 可保持非平稳不动点。

Result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 Tiny-ImageNet 上针对 ResNet-18、ViT-Tiny/ViT-Base,Dir-0.05 异构下 FedMIX-P Muon 较 Local Muon 在 ResNet-18 提升最多 17.01 pp,在 Tiny-ImageNet 提升 19.47 pp;在 C4 上对 60M–350M LLaMA 联邦预训练,FedMIX-P SOAP 取得最低验证困惑度 27.49/27.28/25.23;消融显示 λ=0.5 平衡局部适应与共享几何,共享状态压缩版以 1.1× 通信量恢复 0.56 pp 之内的精度增益。

Conclusion: 预条件子的局部-全局协调是联邦视觉与语言模型训练的有效设计原则,逐步混合能以 λ^2 \bar{D}_P 控制实际应用算子的失配,在有界漂移下无需预条件子收敛即可获得 O(R^{-1/2}) 平稳性;但理论仅覆盖线性对称正定预条件子,完整的非线性正交化(如 Muon)、裁剪与动量更新仍需另行分析。

Abstract: Adaptive preconditioners accelerate model training, but heterogeneous client geometries can bias federated updates even when gradients are evaluated at the same model. Round-start synchronization alone cannot prevent this mismatch from reappearing during local training. We propose \texttt{FedMIX-P}, which mixes shared and local preconditioners at every local step, retaining local adaptation while reducing mean-squared operator mismatch by a factor of $\lambda^2$. For smooth nonconvex objectives with stochastic gradients and partial participation, we establish an $O(R^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound using suitable stepsizes and a horizon-dependent mixing weight, without requiring local preconditioners to converge to one another. A two-client counterexample shows that fixed positive mixing can preserve a nonstationary fixed point. The theory covers bounded linear symmetric positive-definite preconditioners. Experiments with SOAP, Sophia, and Muon variants across vision and language tasks show improvements over corresponding local optimizers, including accuracy gains of up to $19.47$ percentage points and lower validation loss for 60M--350M language models. Full nonlinear and momentum-based updates require separate analysis.

</details>


### [367] [Auto-Formalizing Neuro-Symbolic Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01519)
*Samuele Bortolotti,Weixin Chen,Han Zhao,Andrea Passerini,Stefano Teso,Antonio Vergari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了auto-nesy-bench基准和端到端流水线，利用大语言模型（LLM）将自然语言描述的领域知识自动形式化为符号约束（命题逻辑CNF），并集成到神经符号（NeSy）预测器（如SPL语义概率层和SL语义损失）中。研究系统评估了11个开源LLM在不同提示策略（零样本/思维链）和输出格式（DIMACS、NAT、PySAT、CPMpy、SymPy）下的形式化能力，并通过18个NeSy任务检验生成约束对下游预测性能的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NeSy预测器的核心前提是事先提供符号约束，但这一过程依赖领域专家手动编写，限制了该范式在高风险应用中的推广。本文旨在探究LLM能否作为"虚拟专家"，将自然语言知识自动转化为可插入NeSy预测器的符号约束，从而降低部署门槛。

Method: 方法包含三阶段：(1) 形式化阶段：LLM接收任务自然语言描述和接地变量，输出DIMACS/NAT/PySAT/CPMpy/SymPy五种格式之一的CNF公式，通过自验证迭代修正语法错误；(2) 评估阶段：使用模型计数（MC）计算生成公式与真值公式的混淆矩阵，导出F1/精确率/召回率，并引入Rel（关系分类：equal/strict/permissive/incomparable）和MC-R（模型计数比）衡量语义等价性；(3) 下游集成：将公式编译为SDD电路接入SPL，或作为软约束用于SL，在auto-nesy-bench的18个任务（涵盖自动驾驶、医疗图像数学、视觉推理等）上评估端到端性能。

Result: 在形式化阶段，gpt-oss-120b和gemma4-31b表现最优（F1分别达0.786和0.706），代码格式（CPMpy、SymPy）优于直接生成DIMACS，详细提示和思维链显著提升效果（详细描述使F1从0.330升至0.455）。下游SPL集成上，gpt-oss-120b在全部18个任务中均生成有效公式，使用CPMpy+CoT+详细提示配置时，与专家提供约束的SPL性能差距极小（平均ΔF1<0.03），其中"宽松"公式（包含额外无效赋值）对预测影响较小，而"严格"公式（排除有效赋值）会显著降低F1。SL对不完美公式更具鲁棒性，但非等价公式仍会损害一致性。提示细节程度对结果影响很大：详细提示下几乎所有生成公式与真值等价，非详细提示下仅约一半等价，下游性能明显下降。

Conclusion: 本文首次提出了面向NeSy预测器的LLM自动形式化基准与完整流水线，证明最佳LLM可生成与专家手工编写约束性能相当的公式，且任务规范的详细程度与LLM选择同等重要。生成约束保持可审计性，可由专家检查修正，因此该方法并非替代而是辅助领域专家，有望促进NeSy AI在高风险场景的落地。未来工作包括扩展到一阶逻辑、SMT约束以及模型微调方向。

Abstract: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) predictors incorporate prior knowledge into the prediction process of neural networks, ensuring that outputs satisfy specified constraints, making them particularly suitable for high-stakes applications where compliance with domain knowledge is essential. A key bottleneck in this paradigm is the acquisition of symbolic constraints: encoding domain knowledge into logical formulas remains a manual and expert-intensive process. In this work, we investigate the extent to which auto-formalization via LLMs can systematically translate textual knowledge into symbolic knowledge that can be plugged into NeSy predictors. To this end, we introduce auto-nesy-bench, a new benchmark for evaluating constraint formalization and its impact on downstream accuracy of NeSy predictors. Through an extensive evaluation across several domains, we find that LLMs can formalize constraints to a meaningful extent, generating formulas that are often similar to those provided by human experts. Moreover, when the generated formulas are syntactically valid, they can lead to high-quality downstream predictions. The code and benchmark are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [368] [Exact Distinguishability in Non-Markovian Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01527)
*Kabir Murjani,Nisarg Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在固定行为策略下，两个候选正则决策过程（RDP）何时可被数据区分。证明观测等价的候选模型的后验保持先验比例不变，提出基于乘积自动机的线性时间判定算法PEC，并验证了现有可区分性假设在基准环境上失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线RDP学习保证依赖一个关于行为策略的可区分性假设，但未提供验证手段。当假设失效时，多个不同模型可同样解释数据。需精确判定给定行为策略下的数据能否区分两个候选RDP。

Method: 定义π-观测等价，证后验凝固定理；在候选模型的乘积自动机上定义分歧对集合B_π与归责语言L_B_π，证明其概率为零当且仅当π-等价成立；由此在乘积大小上得O(|Q|·|Q'|·|A|·|O|)线性算法PEC，可同时返检或命名缺失实验；用Lean 4形式化核心证明。

Result: PEC在3700对模型上与暴力枚举一致，运行时间随乘积大小线性增长（100至1,001,000状态对）；区分性参数μ_0在4个测试环境中3个上为精确零；分离质量作为结构指标，既给出小数据交叉，也给出实验设计所需的前瞻深度。

Conclusion: PEC在线性时间内精确判定一对候选RDP在给定行为策略下的可区分性，无需参考历史长度；多因子分析表明状态覆盖不等于可识别性；该方法补全了现有离线RDP保证留下的可区分性验证缺口，并定位恢复检验所需的缺失实验。

Abstract: Non-Markovian environments are often modeled as Regular Decision Processes (RDPs), where dynamics depend on the interaction history through a finite automaton. Existing offline guarantees for RDPs rely on a distinguishability assumption on the behaviour policy but provide no means of verifying it. When the assumption is violated, distinct models may explain the data equally well. We study when data collected under a fixed behaviour policy can distinguish two candidate RDPs. We prove that the posterior odds between observationally equivalent candidates remain equal to the prior odds at every sample size, even when the policy visits every automaton state, and verify both results formally in Lean 4. We then characterize this equivalence exactly and derive PEC, an algorithm that decides it in time linear in the size of the product automaton. The distinguishability assumption of prior work fails on three of our four test environments, and the experiment identified by PEC restores it in each case.

</details>


### [369] [Beyond Pointwise Error: A Multi-Metric Evaluation of Spatial Climate Downscaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01579)
*Loys Masquelier,Etienne Le Naour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个多指标基准测试框架，系统比较了五种空间气候降尺度方法在ERA5温度、风速和降水数据上的表现，揭示了空间保真度与高频细节保留之间的系统性权衡，强调单一指标无法全面评估降尺度质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候降尺度方法的评估面临核心难题：低逐点误差往往以牺牲高频细节为代价，而逼真的空间变率可能伴随局部结构定位不准。传统单一指标（如MAE）的评估会误导方法选择，因此需要建立多维度评估框架来揭示不同方法的真实权衡。

Method: 构建五方法×五指标的多维基准：（1）方法包括残差U-Net、INR-SR（隐式神经表示）、SE-OT（稀疏熵最优传输）、CLR（对比潜空间检索）和双线性插值基线；（2）指标涵盖MAE、SSIM、Wasserstein距离、功率谱密度误差和Sobel梯度误差；（3）数据为1940-2020年法国区域ERA5日均数据，含温度、u10、v10风速和降水四个变量，高分辨率61×42，低分辨率7×9，共29,586样本。

Result: （1）方法排名随指标和变量变化：U-Net在逐点和空间对齐指标（MAE/SSIM/Wasserstein/梯度）上最优，但谱误差较大；SE-OT和CLR谱得分达0.95-1.00，显著优于U-Net的0.45-0.75；（2）存在系统性权衡：逐点保真度与高频保留互相制约，检索类方法因引入参考样本天然保留更多谱变率；（3）重建难度随空间复杂度递增：温度最易（MAE=0.040），降水最难（MAE=0.163），且空间复杂度越高，两类指标的排名差异越显著；（4）INR-SR在风和降水上表现居中且具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 不存在通用的"最佳"降尺度方法，最优选择取决于下游应用对何种气候属性的保留更重视。评估协议本身定义了降尺度问题的含义——选择指标即隐含选择奖励哪种"气候真实性"。未来基准测试应报告互补的多维度指标而非追求单一排名，并需扩展至更多区域、尺度、生成式方法及下游气候影响评估。

Abstract: Climate downscaling aims to reconstruct fine scale spatial fields from coarse resolution inputs. Evaluating the quality of these reconstructions is challenging: low pointwise error can come at the cost of fine scale variability, while realistic spatial variability can be achieved with inaccurate local structures. The evaluation metric can therefore change which method appears to perform best. This work presents a multi metric benchmark comparing five spatial downscaling methods on ERA5 temperature, wind, and precipitation fields. Five criteria assess complementary properties: pointwise error, structural similarity, distribution error, spectral error, and gradient error. The results reveal a systematic trade off between spatial fidelity and fine scale variability. Some methods perform best on pointwise and spatially aligned metrics, but lose high frequency content, while others preserve substantially more spectral variability at the cost of less accurately positioned local structures. Consequently, method rankings change across metrics and variables. These results show that there is no single best downscaling method. Multi metric evaluation is therefore essential for assessing which properties of a climate field are preserved.

</details>


### [370] [Permutation-Robust Decision Modeling with Candidate-Independent Block-Causal Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01601)
*Guy Amit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出候选无关块因果注意力（CI attention），通过掩码阻断候选间的信息流并重置候选位置，解决决策模型对候选排列顺序的敏感性，同时保持决策质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生成式系统中的System 1决策场景中，候选动作可能被以不同顺序提出或排列。标准因果交叉编码器虽然表达力强，但候选得分可能依赖序列化顺序而非决策问题本身，产生排列敏感性问题。需要一种架构性解决方案来保证决策的排列鲁棒性。

Method: 1. 提出候选无关块因果注意力（CI）架构，通过定义特殊的注意力掩码矩阵M_uv，允许共享前缀和同一候选块内的因果注意力，但完全阻断不同候选块之间的信息流动；2. 候选位置在每个块开始时重置为逻辑位置p=q-s_i，使相同候选文本获得相同的旋转位置序列；3. 在Gemma 3 1B、Qwen3 1.7B和Qwen3 4B三个骨干模型上，与标准因果注意力和冻结双编码器基线进行匹配比较；4. 在Gemma 3 1B上进行消融实验，分离掩码隔离、位置重置和排列增强三个机制；5. 使用组感知配对评估（5000次组级bootstrap）量化质量与排列鲁棒性；6. 训练Qwen3-4B 250K样本的大规模研究工件，涵盖六个异构数据源。

Result: 1. CI在所有三个骨干模型上提升了测试准确率，且与因果模型的OOD准确率差距在0.72分以内；2. 测试翻转率大幅降低：Gemma 3 1B从8.3%降至0.1%，Qwen3 1.7B从18.2%降至1.2%，Qwen3 4B从7.2%降至0.7%；3. Qwen3 1.7B上CI在所有测试指标上均优于因果模型（准确率+3.12分，95% CI [+0.82,+5.63]），但OOD区间跨越零；4. 消融实验表明隔离是主要鲁棒性机制（仅隔离将测试翻转率从8.30%降至3.82%），位置重置单独使用反而恶化（12.16%翻转率，79.64%准确率），排列增强主要影响优化和泛化；5. Qwen3-4B 250K工件在平衡验证集上达到95.61%准确率和0.183%翻转率，OOD准确率83.84%。

Conclusion: 候选无关块因果注意力通过架构手段将候选排序从序列化意外变为可控属性，在多个骨干模型上一致降低排列敏感性同时保持竞争力决策质量。候选隔离是核心机制，位置重置完成对称性。因果注意力在需要候选交互时仍有价值，双编码器适合需要精确不变性和缓存的场景。作者明确声明该方法的范围限于架构层面，不涉及计算稀疏性、通用质量改进或最优目标匹配的双编码器。

Abstract: Decision models often score a variable-sized set of candidate actions encoded in a single sequence. This setting is increasingly relevant for System 1 components inside generative systems, where candidates may be proposed or ordered differently across runs. Standard causal cross-encoding is expressive, but it can make a candidate's score depend on serialization order rather than on the underlying decision problem. We introduce candidate-independent block-causal attention, which preserves causal computation within the shared context and each candidate while blocking cross-candidate information flow and resetting candidate positions. We compare this architecture with standard causal attention and complementary invariant baselines across Gemma 3 1B, Qwen3 1.7B, and Qwen3 4B backbones. Candidate-independent attention consistently reduces permutation sensitivity while retaining competitive decision quality; ablations indicate that candidate isolation is the primary source of the effect, with position resetting completing the intended symmetry. A larger Qwen3-4B study further examines the behavior of the proposed architecture with substantially more training data. Code is available at the \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{blue}{project repository}}, and the \href{ this https URL }{\textcolor{blue}{Qwen3-4B model artifact}} is available on Hugging Face.

</details>


### [371] [Exposing the Cost of Deep Learning Audio Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01619)
*Constance Douwes,Paul Magron,Romain Serizel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Grid5000共享计算平台作业日志的方法，用于估算深度学习音频项目开发阶段的能耗与碳排放。该方法结合硬件静态功耗估算（Green Algorithm）与BMC动态测量，并以LORIA实验室Multispeech团队的四个音频项目为案例研究。结果显示，开发阶段的能耗是训练最佳模型的3到256倍，远超以往仅关注训练阶段的研究结论，呼吁在整个项目生命周期中系统报告能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的深度学习能耗与碳排放研究主要集中于模型训练和推理阶段，而对开发阶段（架构原型设计、反复试验、超参数搜索等）的能耗关注不足。音频深度学习领域尤其缺乏对开发阶段能耗的系统量化分析。

Method: 1) 基于Grid5000平台的作业日志元数据（用户、资源、时长、命令等），采用两种互补方法估算每个作业的能耗：Green Algorithm静态硬件估算法（基于TDP）和BMC动态功率测量法（kwollect工具，按GPU分配比例分摊）。2) 分析范围覆盖实验室（LORIA，2014-2025年）、团队（Multispeech，2023年9月至2024年12月）和单个项目四个层级。3) 通过与作者协作的注释流程，根据启动目录和执行命令将作业分配到特定项目。4) 通过重新训练部分模型若干epoch来估算每epoch能耗，进而外推总训练能耗。5) 结合Grid5000的PUE（1.5）和法国/美国电力排放因子估算碳排放。

Result: 实验室层面：LORIA实验室在Grid5000 Nancy集群的能耗从2014年的169 MWh增长至2025年的741 MWh；近四年GPU计算虽仅占约20%的core-hour，却贡献了一半以上能耗。团队层面：Multispeech团队日均GPU服务器能耗约260 kWh（年约95 MWh），占Nancy集群年消耗的近六分之一，相当于一个法国居民8年的用电量。项目层面：四个音频项目的开发能耗为最佳模型训练能耗的3-256倍，为所有报告模型训练能耗的2-77倍。具体而言，Cui et al. 2023项目开发能耗35,288 kWh（Dev/Best=3）；Ayilo et al. 2024为4,095 kWh（Dev/Best=18）；Ayilo et al. 2025为9,462 kWh（Dev/Best=256）；Magron et al. 2027为24,239 kWh（Dev/Best=53）。在法国电力排放因子下，开发阶段碳排放与往返会议的飞行碳排放相当或略低。

Conclusion: 深度学习音频项目的开发阶段能耗远高于仅训练最终模型的能耗，当前仅报告训练能耗的做法严重低估了项目的整体环境成本。本文提出的基于作业日志的方法具有通用性，可推广至其他云计算平台。研究呼吁在整个项目生命周期中系统、持续地监测和报告能耗，以促进更可持续的深度学习实践。局限性包括：仅估算运营电力碳排放，未包含硬件隐含排放及水/资源等其他环境影响；Cui et al.项目部分作业在Jean Zay平台运行未被纳入。

Abstract: The environmental impact of deep learning has attracted increasing attention over the past decade. Existing studies mainly focus on the energy and carbon emissions of model training and inference, while the whole development phase is often overlooked. Yet, architecture prototyping and intensive experiments are conducted during this stage, which is highly energy-demanding. In this article, we propose a methodology to estimate these costs, based on activity logs from the Grid5000 shared computing platform used by the LORIA laboratory. As a case-study, we focus on audio projects developed in the Multispeech research team. We evaluate the overall energy cost of four projects, and we compare them to those of training the reported models. Our results show that the energy required for the development phase is 3 to 256 times greater than that required to train the best-performing model alone. These results advocate for a more systematic reporting of energy consumption across the entire life cycle of deep learning-based audio projects.

</details>


### [372] [MCIR: A Feature Dependence-Aware Explainability Method with Reliability Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01641)
*Poushali Sengupta,Sabita Maharjan,Frank Eliassen,Shashi Raj Pandey,Yan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MCIR-M（互相关影响比方法）是一种面向强相关/冗余特征的全局特征归因方法，通过将每个特征在其依赖邻居条件下进行条件互信息归一化，量化其独特预测信息贡献。该方法输出[0,1]区间分数，在精确条件冗余下为零，并具备轻量级计算策略以降低计算负担。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有特征归因方法（SHAP、LIME、HSIC、MI/CMI、SAGE等）在存在多重共线性或近重复预测因子时，难以稳定区分共享预测信息，导致排序不稳定且可能将重要性分配给冗余特征。现有CIR族方法虽涉及依赖处理但未能直接量化特征相对于特定依赖邻居的独特条件信息贡献。

Method: MCIR-M定义互相关影响比（MCIR）为 C_i = 2U_i/(U_i+J_i)，其中 U_i = I(Q;X_i|X_Φ(i)) 为特征X_i相对其依赖邻居X_Φ(i)的条件互信息，J_i = I(Q;X_Φ(i)∪{i}) 为扩展特征块的联合互信息。该方法基于标准Borel空间上的混合变量条件互信息，通过依赖筛选构建嵌套候选邻域，使用Auto-Φ在排序稳定性、残余依赖和条件维度之间平衡选择邻域大小，并采用高斯copula或k-NN等MI/CMI估计器。提供轻量级计算策略，通过表示分布、排序、Top-K和忠实性诊断评估与全样本最小化解释的协议一致性。

Result: 在受控冗余实验中，MCIR在注入近重复预测因子时展现出最佳的依赖感知排序行为，保留指定锚定特征更多归因质量并更好保持原始特征排序；在UCI HAR数据集上展现中等的轻量级保真度（Kendall τ_b在头部排序0.72-0.89之间）；与SHAP、SAGE、HSIC等基线在真实数据上的比较结果各异；高斯copula实现比k-NN更快但估计精度依赖样本量和条件维度。总体上MCIR-M为强特征依赖下的全局解释提供实用的依赖感知诊断工具。

Conclusion: MCIR-M提供了一个统计定义的框架来解释强特征依赖下的固定模型，其独特预测信息解释相对于选定特征空间和联合特征-输出律是相对的，有限样本可靠性依赖于邻域充分性、估计器适用性、样本量和排序分离度。未来工作将研究高阶和时间邻域构造、高维和混合类型CMI估计、分布偏移下的稳健性以及与基于统计的变量重要性方法的更广泛比较。

Abstract: Modern machine-learning models often contain strongly dependent or redundant features, making feature attribution difficult because shared predictive information can be distributed across correlated predictors. Existing methods such as SHAP, LIME, HSIC, MI/CMI, and SAGE may therefore produce unstable rankings under multicollinearity or near-duplicate predictors. We propose the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio Method (MCIR-M), a dependence-aware global feature-importance approach that quantifies the unique predictive information contributed by each feature beyond a selected dependence neighbourhood. MCIR-M introduces the Mutual Correlation Impact Ratio (MCIR), which conditions each feature on strongly dependent neighbours and computes a normalized ratio of conditional to block-level information. The population score lies in [0,1] and equals zero under exact conditional redundancy. We also introduce a lightweight estimation procedure that computes MCIR using a fraction of the available data and evaluates agreement with full-data explanations. Across controlled synthetic redundancy experiments and the UCI HAR benchmark, MCIR shows dependence-aware ranking behaviour, with its clearest advantage under injected near-duplicate predictors. Comparisons with independent and conditional SHAP, SAGE, HSIC, MI-based scores, and CIR-family baselines are mixed across real-data criteria. Reduced explanation samples lower computational burden in the evaluated configurations, while agreement with full-data explanations is assessed separately through ranking, head-set, and faithfulness diagnostics. Overall, MCIR-M provides a practical dependence-aware diagnostic for global explanation under strong feature dependence.

</details>


### [373] [Iterative Policy Refinement through Semantic Rollout Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01652)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Qi Xu,Zhifei Deng,Zhigang Hua,Luke Simon,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种闭环框架，通过LLM对结构化策略rollout的语义化分析来迭代修正其计算图结构。该方法将rollout记录为语义表格数据，并让LLM生成诊断分析代码以定位结构-演示之间的不一致性，无需人类专家介入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM基于预训练知识直接生成的结构化策略可能与专家演示存在建模假设冲突（例如错误的方向或系数符号），现有方法依赖大量人类输入或静态领域知识来缓解该问题，亟需自动化修正机制。

Method: 1) 用LLM根据任务描述生成初始策略计算图（PyTorch语义计算图）；2) 通过模仿学习拟合连续参数；3) LLM根据策略结构和期望行为生成Python诊断分析代码；4) 收集rollout的表格轨迹（含观测、动作、语义latent、参数）；5) 执行分析代码并将结果反馈给LLM以修订结构（增删latent变量、操作、依赖、参数约束）；6) 结构收敛后可选RL继续优化连续参数。

Result: 在Car Racing任务中，精炼后的结构化策略比zero-shot LLM生成结构在IL下性能提升约15%（882.0 vs 766.5），且RL达到相同性能所需计算量减少约75%（404 vs 2000 resets）；Door Opening任务将手柄到目标距离减少约80%；仅用9次LLM调用即超过MLES用2016次调用的性能；分析代码反馈仅需表格直接反馈约25%的输入token。

Conclusion: 结构化策略的稀疏语义latent为LLM提供了可测试、可追溯的编程式接口；通过类软件调试的"测试-执行-修订"闭环，表格化rollout分析可作为有效的环境反馈信号，无需人类参与即可使LLM生成的结构与演示对齐，并显著提升后续模仿学习和强化学习的效率。

Abstract: Structured policies improve efficiency, robustness, and interpretability in imitation learning by introducing task-specific inductive bias, but existing structure generation methods rely either on extensive human input or on static domain knowledge encoded in LLMs, which may be inconsistent with the expert demonstrations. We propose a closed-loop framework that iteratively refines structured policies using LLM-guided analysis of policy rollouts. By logging rollouts as semantically meaningful tabular data and prompting the LLM to generate diagnostic analysis code, our method identifies suboptimalities in the policy structure and iteratively corrects them without requiring human instruction. Experiments on car racing and door opening tasks show that our approach improves imitation learning performance by up to 15% over zero-shot LLM-generated structures and requires 75% less compute to achieve the same reinforcement learning performance. These results demonstrate that tabular rollout analysis provides an effective feedback signal to align LLM-generated policy structures with expert demonstrations, and we can utilize it to generate good policy structures automatically.

</details>


### [374] [Removing spurious minima for planar features by skip connections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01728)
*Jakob Paul Zimmermann,Moritz Grillo,Andrei Balakin,Georg Loho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了浅层无偏置ReLU网络在高斯总体损失下的损失景观问题。在教师-学生框架下，证明了加入可学习线性跳跃连接（skip connection）能消除所有具有非负学生输出权重的伪局部最小值（当学生网络宽度不小于教师网络时）；同时构造了一个反例表明，仅增加宽度无法消除某些伪最小值，即使在任意过参数化下仍持续存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解神经网络损失景观是解释训练过程的核心问题。即使在简单模型中，损失景观结构仍未完全理解。已有研究表明过参数化和残差连接都能改善训练，但尚不清楚何种条件下增加宽度或添加线性跳跃连接能排除伪局部最小值。本文旨在通过teacher-student框架精确刻画这些架构修改对损失景观的影响。

Method: 方法论包括：(1) 利用恒等式[z]₊ = ½|z| + ½z将跳跃网络分解为居中网络与线性映射之和；(2) 通过残差表示将损失及其导数用核函数表达；(3) 在平面情形下，利用束算子L=(D²+1)²和Green函数分析角度残差的结构，证明严格交错性质并构造下降方向；(4) 采用Safran-Shamir范式的箱式证书方法（结合强凸性和精确有理区间算术）构造过参数化下持续存在的严格伪局部最小值；(5) 将主要结果通过最小值稳定性定理（Bastin等人）从总体损失转移到经验损失。所有结果均通过Lean 4形式化验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 当教师网络具有正输出权重和共面特征方向，且学生跳跃网络至少与教师同宽时，所有非负质量的局部最小值都是精确拟合（Theorem 10）；(2) 构造了一个平面教师网络（三个隐藏神经元，正输出权重），其伪局部最小值在任意学生宽度≥3下持续存在（Theorem 11），证明仅增加宽度不足以消除伪最小值；(3) 任何正输出权重学生网络的局部最小值都学习教师特征张成的子空间（Proposition 8）；(4) 在二维情形下，关键点处学生有效宽度至多为教师宽度的2倍（Proposition 12）；(5) 良性结果可转移到固定半径稳定性下的经验损失（Theorem 13）。此外还证明了跳跃网络的损失分解引理和零质量单位蕴含精确拟合的命题。

Conclusion: 本文证明可学习的线性跳跃连接能够消除在任意过参数化下持续存在的伪局部最小值，确立了一个比单纯增加宽度更强的损失景观良性条件。关键数学洞察是将跳跃网络分解为居中网络与线性项之和，并将角度残差解释为弹性环在点力作用下的径向位移。主要限制包括：(1) 平面性假设在主定理中是必要的——证明高度依赖圆上的一维序结构，推广到更高维特征秩是公开问题；(2) 分析仅限于单隐层网络；(3) 经验损失转移需要固定半径稳定性假设。研究展示了人类-AI协作在数学发现和形式化验证中的新范式。

Abstract: Understanding loss landscapes is central to explaining neural-network training, yet their structure remains only partially understood even in simple models. We study the Gaussian population loss of shallow, bias-free ReLU networks in the teacher--student setting. This provides a simple model for studying essential aspects such as feature learning and overparameterization. For teacher networks with positive output weights and planar features, we show that including a learned linear skip removes all spurious local minima with non-negative student output weights once the student network is at least as wide as the teacher network. In contrast, without the skip, we construct a fixed teacher network with positive output weights and only three hidden neurons in input dimension two whose spurious local minima persist at every student width at least three. Thus, a learned linear skip can remove spurious minima that persist under arbitrary overparameterization. Furthermore, we show that a positive output weight student network always learns the subspace spanned by the teacher features: student features at local minima with non-negative student output weights lie in the span of the teacher features. For ReLU networks in two dimensions, even heavily overparameterized student networks have effective width controlled by the teacher width: every critical point with positive student output weights has at most twice as many distinct student feature directions as teacher neurons. Finally, we transfer the benignity result to empirical minima over parameter balls of any prescribed radius, with the required sampling accuracy depending on that radius.

</details>


### [375] [iADD: Improving Alignment and Diversity in Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01789)
*Ashok Prasad Neupane,Saugat Adhikari,Pramish Paudel,Ajad Chhatkuli,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出iADD方法，通过稀疏增量时间步更新和离散Feynman-Kac（FK）路径引导（包括重加权与分支），在无需偏好数据的奖励微调中同时改善扩散模型的奖励对齐、多样性与罕见事件成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于RL的扩散模型后训练（如DDPO）在优化奖励时，常以多样性与图像质量为代价，表现为模式坍缩与卡通化、过饱和伪影。已有方法（如B²-DiffuRL）主张仅更新后段（late）时间步以缓解稀疏终端奖励问题，但其选择缺乏严格理论依据，且尚未在统一理论框架下研究"对齐-多样性"权衡。

Method: 1. 时间步选择理论分析（命题1-2及备注2）：证明在固定优化预算下，均匀采样比late-only更新对x0有更大的扰动幅度（生成可达性），且稀疏更新比全量更新更好地保留先验概率体积；由此推出最优课程为对活跃时间步集S进行"稀疏增量"扩展。2. 稀疏增量时间步更新（Sec 4.2）：采用DDIM，按阶段将更新步数从{5,10,15,20}逐步增加，优先更新高杠杆的早时间步。3. 离散Feynman-Kac路径引导（Sec 4.3）：训练时对反向扩散路径构造分支采样树；以max-potential G_t在中间时间步对粒子进行重采样/剪枝以提升对齐，对高潜力粒子进行分支以提升多样性。4. 罕见事件形式化（Sec 4.4）：定义罕见条件集A_c(η)与稀有度ρ(c;η)。整体基于Stable Diffusion v1.4+LoRA、MiDiffusion，并兼容GRPO式分组优势（iADD+GRPO）。

Result: 在图像生成（动物-动作组合、稀有颜色-物体绑定、空间关系）、消失点几何校正与3D室内场景合成三项任务中，于各自Pareto前沿最优工作点评估：iADD在Reward、IS、Rarity与Reward-Diversity AUC上均优于DDPO与B²-DiffuRL；稀有提示Rarity从约24%提升至66.85%（图像生成）与95.11%（消失点校正），3D场景碰撞率更低（6.13% vs 63.39%/7.726%）。与AIG、DanceGRPO、BranchGRPO对比中，iADD+GRPO取得最高CLIP 0.4126、Rarity 88.33%、LPIPS 0.7778。用户研究（40名评估者、4800次盲评）显著偏好iADD。消融验证FK重加权、FK分支与增量课程各自贡献，且实证支持命题1-2（均匀更新δx0更大、稀疏更新log|det J|=-25,963 vs -27,568）。代价：训练GPU时间约7.43小时，高于DDPO的2.55小时（主要来自粒子采样）。

Conclusion: iADD从理论角度阐明了时间步选择对多样性的影响，并通过稀疏增量时间步课程与离散Feynman-Kac分支/重加权，在多个任务上同时提升对齐、多样性与罕见事件表现；其引导机制与时间步课程可与DDPO乃至GRPO等策略优化器互补。主要局限是训练成本较高以及从含噪中间状态估计奖励的可靠性，未来工作将探索更准确的中间奖励估计、更强奖励模型以及向视频扩散模型的扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post training of diffusion models, such as Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO), optimizes a reverse diffusion process under a reward function. However, current approaches to reward optimizations do so at the cost of diversity and quality. In this paper, we provide better tradeoffs through careful theoretical considerations and method design. We analyze the theoretical framework and mathematically demonstrate that \emph{only-latter timestep} updates of diffusion model may be harmful for diversity contrary to the conclusions presented in a previous work. Additionally, we propose an incremental Feynman-Kac training based on strong theoretical foundations in order to achieve the best-yet alignment-diversity tradeoffs. We perform extensive experiments and compare our method against related diffusion policy optimization approaches in three different tasks and also provide strong ablations for each component, thus validating strong performance gains in both alignment and diversity.

</details>


### [376] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OMAF提出了一种基于一步Flow模型的在线多智能体强化学习框架,通过Transformer速度场实现单步动作生成,并结合Softmax Q值估计与同步联合策略优化,在MPE和MAMuJoCo基准上以更低开销实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习(MARL)需要同时兼顾策略的表达性(以建模复杂多模态协调行为)与训练/执行的高效性。现有扩散策略虽表达力强,但迭代去噪开销难以扩展到在线多智能体场景;已有Flow策略也几乎只在离线或单智能体设置中被研究。因此需要在在线MARL中实现既表达又高效的生成式策略。

Method: 1) 采用因子化策略π(a|s)=∏π_i(a^i|s),每个智能体用基于Transformer的速度网络v_θ参数化Flow策略,反向从a_1~N(0,I)经单个Euler步得到a^i=tanh(a_1^i - v_θ(a_1^i,s,1));2) 引入路径评分替代量(path score surrogate)ℓ^i逼近联合对数似然,用于最大熵策略优化;3) 中心化Critic采用Softmax Bellman算子Q_soft进行K个联合动作采样的加权Q值估计,稳定价值引导;4) 同步联合策略目标L_π联合优化所有智能体Flow;5) 逐智能体自适应温度α_i;6) 理论方面证明策略收敛到软最优策略(Theorem 1)及单步近最优性(Theorem 2)。

Result: 在10个MPE/MAMuJoCo连续控制任务上,OMAF一致优于HATD3、HASAC、OMAD(扩散)、MAFlowRL、MAMFPO等基线;回报最高提升3.4×,样本效率最高提升10.5×;训练仅用单步Flow生成,训练时间和GPU资源远低于扩散方法OMAD;在N=10/20的Cooperative Navigation上也展示出良好的可扩展性;消融实验证明Softmax Q(K)、Transformer架构及温度自调均为关键设计。

Conclusion: OMAF首次将一步生成式Flow模型引入集中式训练去中心化执行(CTDE)的在线多智能体RL,兼具表达性与高效率,为生成式在线MARL提供了实用且可扩展的方案。未来工作可探索离散动作空间中的Flow策略扩展。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [377] [Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01892)
*Feiyu Gavin Zhu,Xiaoyu Zhu,Jiqi Yang,Rui Yang,Arnab Kumar Mondal,Yancheng Wang,Xinke Deng,Jean Oh,Reid Simmons,Joerg Liebelt,Xiang Kong,Zhongyu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SSR提出将多模态搜索智能体中的自由形式推理重构为从预定义可复用自然语言候选中进行选择，通过教师强制并行评分消除逐token自回归生成推理的开销，在保持竞争力的任务成功率的同时，将每轮推理延迟降低90%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型多模态智能体在执行ReAct式推理时，自由形式的逐步推理生成既消耗大量推理延迟，又因为模型容量有限，对动作生成的指导价值有限。需要一种正交的效率优化路径，改变推理的表征形式而非仅压缩输出。

Method: 构建一个小型可复用的自然语言推理候选库（如6条），每轮使用语言模型本身对各候选在共享上下文KV缓存下进行长度归一化似然的并行教师强制评分，通过softmax采样选择一条候选作为该轮推理，再据此自回归生成动作。训练支持SFT和GRPO/GSPO/SAPO等RL目标，引入分离竞争者（detached competitor）梯度近似以降低优化开销。

Result: 在7个多模态搜索基准、2B与4B Qwen3-VL模型上，4B SSR+GRPO平均成功率61.37%，匹配同规模SOTA（如TAPO+GSPO 61.25%），优于MMSearch-R1与SenseNova-MARS等4B基线。每轮推理延迟降低超过90%，每问题模型推理延迟降低28–54%，有效推理吞吐量提升约35–50倍；推理库规模从1增至6带来单调性能提升（37.24%→61.37%），且选择分布在不同基准间呈现合理的语义差异。

Conclusion: 小型搜索智能体无需在每步覆盖整个语言空间进行推理；将高频出现的推理组织成紧凑可复用的选择空间，可在保持任务竞争力的同时显著提升推理效率，为高效多模态智能体提供了一条与提示压缩、效率奖励等正交的新路径。

Abstract: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: this https URL .

</details>


### [378] [Asynchronous LLM Post-Training: Group-Mass Capping and Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01896)
*Qijia He,Ruinan Jin,Jun Luo,Shaofeng Zou,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GMC-GRPO方法，通过组级质量封顶(group mass capping)对异步强化学习中GRPO类算法的重要性比率进行修正，理论分析表明相比TIC-GRPO将延迟项从O(ε⁻⁴)改善至O(ε⁻²)，并在Qwen3模型上验证了对陈旧rollout数据的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步RL训练中rollout与学习解耦导致数据陈旧(stale rollouts)，现有算法缺乏理论指导来理解陈旧性对GRPO类算法收敛性的影响，也缺乏针对性的重要性比率修正方法。

Method: 1) 推导GRPO类算法通用收敛界，揭示梯度估计的二阶矩与偏差的权衡；2) 定义满足统一二阶矩保证的加权梯度估计器类；3) 通过最小化偏差上界得到组级质量封顶(GMC)规则：对整组施加统一缩放因子α*=min{1,(1+ε)/ρ̄}，仅在组平均重要性比率超过阈值时介入；4) 建立异步环境下GMC-GRPO的收敛理论，并与TIC-GRPO对比。

Result: 1) 理论结果：GMC-GRPO相比TIC-GRPO将紧裁剪区间内延迟项的阈值依赖从O(ε⁻⁴)改善至O(ε⁻²)；在策略局部重叠条件下，延迟项随组大小以G^{-2/5}衰减；组重缩放偏差随G→∞消失，而逐轨迹裁剪偏差持续存在；2) 实验结果：在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B模型和六个数学推理基准测试中，GMC-GRPO在固定延迟和模拟异步延迟下均取得最佳平均性能，显著优于vanilla GRPO和GAC/VCPO等异步稳定方法；在延迟128时Pass@1达59.03% vs TIC-GRPO的55.41% vs GRPO的35.33%。

Conclusion: GMC-GRPO通过组级而非逐轨迹的重要性比率控制，在统一二阶矩保证下最小化偏差，显著提升了GRPO类算法对异步训练中陈旧rollout的鲁棒性。理论框架为设计面向异步训练的RL算法提供了原则性指导，组大小带来的优势在局部策略重叠条件下具有实际意义。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves the efficiency of large language model post-training but introduces stale rollouts generated by earlier policies. Theoretical understanding of how this staleness affects convergence and how to mitigate its impact remains limited. We derive a convergence bound for GRPO-style algorithms that explicitly characterizes the tradeoff between the gradient estimator's second moment and bias. For trajectory-level importance-weighted estimators, our analysis shows that once the second moment is uniformly controlled, delay enters the bound through the bias introduced by clipping or rescaling. Guided by this insight, we propose a novel group mass capping GRPO (GMC-GRPO) method, which minimizes a ratio-based bias bound within a class of weighted estimators sharing a common second-moment guarantee. We establish convergence guarantees for asynchronous GMC-GRPO and show that, compared with TIC-GRPO, it improves the threshold dependence of the fourth-order delay term from $O(\epsilon^{-4})$ to $O(\epsilon^{-2})$ as $\epsilon\to0$, where $1+\epsilon$ is the ratio threshold. Under local policy overlap, the delay-dependent term decreases as $G^{-2/5}$ after tuning the step size, where $G$ is the group size. For fixed behavior and current policies, the bias introduced by group rescaling also vanishes as $G\to\infty$, whereas the bias from trajectory-wise clipping can persist. Experiments across Qwen3 models and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness to stale rollouts, with GMC-GRPO achieving the best performance among stable baselines under large rollout delays.

</details>


### [379] [On Language Drift during RLVR Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02015)
*Michael Sullivan,Alexander Koller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）后训练中大语言模型出现的"语言漂移"现象，即CoT中非标准甚至不可读的语用问题。理论上证明了RLVR允许无界语言漂移而SFT不会，并证明约束语言漂移必然损害期望奖励；实验上利用GSM8K和小模型表明语言漂移仅在任务对基模型而言是"新任务"（无法通过行为锐化解决）时发生，且不同RLVR训练会发展出独特且互不兼容的语言漂移方向，威胁CoT可监控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿推理LLM在RLVR后训练后常出现非标准、不合语法甚至难以理解的CoT语言使用（语言漂移），严重威胁CoT可监控性与安全对齐，但原因不明。论文旨在弄清RLVR中语言漂移的产生条件、是否存在不可调和的监控性-性能权衡。

Method: 1) 定义"语言漂移"为模型相对于人类语言分布 P^(HL) 的期望KL散度；将SFT与RLVR训练建模为具有单调非增交叉熵/非减期望奖励的检查点序列族。2) 理论上证明：RLVR允许无界语言漂移（构造性证明，对初始模型与最优策略插值）；SFT存在有限上界（通过交叉熵递减和总变差上界证明）；约束语言漂移必然降低最大期望奖励（通过KL球的插值论证）。3) 经验上使用Llama-3.2-1B、Gemma-3-1B-pt、Qwen2.5-1.5B三个基模型与DAPO/GRPO RLVR及SFT在GSM8K上训练（共30次运行，5种子×2方法×3模型），用三个指令模型的CoT可读性估计语言漂移，并对比行为锐化潜力和自可读性（self-legibility）实验。

Result: Qwen主要通过行为锐化（学会发EOS）提升性能，未表现出相对SFT的额外语言漂移；而Llama和Gemma的RLVR训练显著产生语言漂移，表现为RLVR生成CoT对外部指令模型及其他同种RLVR模型的可读性均低于SFT（负AUC差异）。同时RLVR模型间自可读性降低，表明每次训练漂移到不同方向，漂移具唯一性/不可预测性。

Conclusion: 语言漂移是RLVR在"新颖推理任务"上发现新行为时的副产物：此时行为锐化不可行，优化压力使CoT远离人类语言；SFT则因交叉熵目标维持有限上界。定理3进一步说明CoT可监控性与期望奖励不可同时优化，意味前沿能力进展必须伴随日益严重的CoT不可监控，且因漂移方向唯一性，监控模型自身也无法可靠理解目标模型的推理过程，威胁未来安全性与对齐验证。

Abstract: Recent advances in LLM reasoning models---driven primarily by the paradigm of post-training via reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR)---have enabled them to accomplish impressively complex tasks. However, in parallel with their rising capabilities, LLMs have increasingly displayed signs of language drift in their chains of thought (CoTs): unusual, non-standard, and seemingly nonsensical language use. Although it is well-documented---and can potentially impair CoT monitorability---the causes of language drift are thus far poorly understood. In this paper, we identify the conditions under which language drift occurs: we prove theoretically that RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift, while supervised fine-tuning does not. We then show empirically that language drift specifically arises during RLVR on novel reasoning tasks---i.e. when the target behavior cannot be drawn out of the base model. Finally, we prove that it is not possible to constrain language drift without constraining expected reward, suggesting that CoT monitorability cannot be improved without harming performance during RLVR post-training at the frontier.

</details>


### [380] [CARM: Cancellation-Aware Response Masking for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02039)
*Yafei Zhang,Songshuo Lu,Sicong Liao,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CARM（Cancellation-Aware Response Masking），一种用于大语言模型强化学习的序列级响应掩码方法，通过对token对数比的绝对值取平均来防止正负概率变化相互抵消，从而更可靠地控制off-policy偏差。在数学推理和代码生成任务上均优于现有的GeoMean等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM的RL后训练中，由于策略更新延迟、actor-learner延迟以及rollout与训练引擎差异，采样响应会出现off-policy偏差。现有的序列级掩码方法（如基于token概率比的几何平均）通过有符号对数比的平均来判断响应是否保留，但正负对数比会相互抵消，使得存在严重双向策略漂移的响应被错误地接受，导致优化质量下降。

Method: 提出CARM方法，将响应级掩码分数定义为token对数比绝对值的平均值（即d_CARM = (1/T)Σ|log r_t|），而非先对有符号对数比求平均再取绝对值。这从根本上防止了正负概率变化的抵消。同时给出三个理论结果：(1) 有符号聚合存在抵消问题（Proposition 1：可构造每个token比例都超出给定带但GeoMean分数为1的响应）；(2) CARM接受集是GeoMean接受集的子集（Proposition 2：由三角不等式保证）；(3) 被CARM接受的响应满足token比例超出给定带[ℓ,u]的比例p_out与平均违规严重程度δ̄_out之间的联合预算约束（Proposition 3），从而为阈值提供了token级别的解释。CARM仅作为响应级门控，不改变token级PPO/GRPO替代损失。

Result: 在数学推理任务上（使用Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B在DAPO Math上训练，评估AIME 2024/2025/2026和BeyondAIME），CARM在四个数据集上的平均mean@16优于GeoMean、TRM、IcePop和Null基线，相对于GeoMean最高提升3.13个百分点。在代码生成任务上（Qwen3.5-9B在TACO训练集上训练），CARM在TACO测试集、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval+和MBPP+四个基准上的平均pass@1比最强基线IcePop提升2.88个百分点。分析表明过滤率相近时CARM准确率更高，且准确率与过滤率之间不存在单调关系。CARM还在采样一致性（best-of-k和worst-of-k）上优于基线。

Conclusion: CARM是一种有理论基础且有效的方法，用于LLM强化学习中的响应级off-policy控制。它通过在聚合前取绝对值解决了有符号聚合的抵消问题，同时为响应级阈值提供了token级别的频率-严重程度联合预算解释。实验验证了在数学推理和代码生成任务上的优越性，支持其作为PPO/GRPO优化的补充响应选择准则。

Abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid adoption of reinforcement learning (RL) in large language model (LLM) post-training, with substantial gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation. In practical systems, however, policy updates and differences between rollout and training engines can make sampled responses off-policy. Sequence-level masking addresses this mismatch by deciding whether an entire response should contribute to optimization. A common masking rule uses the length-normalized geometric mean of sampled token probability ratios. Its signed log-ratios can cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional policy drift. We propose \emph{Cancellation-Aware Response Masking} (CARM), a sequence-level mask that takes the absolute value of each token log-ratio before averaging, preventing opposing probability changes from canceling. We prove that accepted responses satisfy a joint bound on the fraction of sampled-token ratios outside a prescribed band and their mean log-distance beyond its boundaries. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that CARM improves mean@16 averaged over AIME 2024/2025/2026 and BeyondAIME by up to $3.13$ percentage points over geometric-mean masking, and increases average pass@1 across four code benchmarks by $2.88$ points over the strongest evaluated baseline. These findings support CARM as a theoretically grounded and effective method for response-level off-policy control in LLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [381] [Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02043)
*Jinhwan Sul,Panagiotis Theodoropoulos,Vincent Pacelli,Jaemoo Choi,Evangelos Theodorou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分布鲁棒薛定谔桥（DRSB），通过在初始分布的歧义集上极小极大优化，学习一个对初始分布偏移具有鲁棒性的单一随机传输控制器，并推导了基于Wasserstein和Sinkhorn距离的两种算法变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准薛定谔桥（SB）只在名义初始分布下训练，当测试时初始分布发生偏移时，相同的控制器可能无法恢复目标分布。需要一种能在初始分布不确定下保持鲁棒传输的方法。

Method: 将SB与分布鲁棒优化（DRO）结合，构造关于初始分布歧义集的极小极大目标；通过KL散度的变分表示引入终端代价网络；连接固定终端代价子问题与随机最优控制（SOC）和DRO的对偶形式；利用SOC最优性条件近似对抗梯度，开发Wasserstein（迭代更新对偶变量）和Sinkhorn（线性化后高斯采样+闭式对偶变量）两种变体，采用交替算法更新对抗初始分布、终端代价网络和控制器。

Result: 在2D高斯/GMM传输任务和FFHQ图像到图像翻译任务上，DRSB在多种扰动（噪声、平移、最坏情况输入）下均优于标准DSBM基线，具有更好的鲁棒性；Sinkhorn变体在多数条件下优于Wasserstein变体；在未见噪声水平上优于固定水平噪声增强方法；但名义性能略有下降。

Conclusion: DRSB提供了一种原则性的框架来学习对初始分布偏移鲁棒的传输映射，通过两种歧义集变体提供了计算效率与性能的权衡；未来工作可探索其他距离的歧义集、提高高维对抗训练的稳定性，以及建立完整的收敛性保证。

Abstract: Schrödinger bridge (SB) learns stochastic transport between prescribed initial and target distributions. When the initial distribution shifts at test time, the learned dynamics can fail to recover the target distribution. We introduce the Distributionally Robust Schrödinger Bridge (DRSB), which learns a single controller that accounts for uncertainty in the initial distribution. The DRSB objective consists of control energy and a KL penalty between the resulting terminal distribution and the target distribution. DRSB seeks a single controller that minimizes the worst-case value of this objective as the initial distribution varies within an ambiguity set around the nominal distribution. We derive an exact variational formulation of this objective and connect its fixed-terminal-cost subproblem to stochastic optimal control and distributionally robust optimization. This formulation motivates an alternating algorithm that updates the adversarial initial distribution, estimates the terminal log-density ratio, and trains the controller. We develop Wasserstein and Sinkhorn variants using stochastic control optimality conditions to approximate the gradients required for adversarial updates. Experiments on two-dimensional transport tasks and image-to-image translation show improved robustness to input perturbations relative to standard SB, with a tradeoff in nominal performance. On Gaussian mixture transport, Sinkhorn DRSB also achieves lower mean sliced Wasserstein distance than fixed-level noise augmentation at both tested unseen noise levels.

</details>


### [382] [Local Support Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02126)
*Assaf Ben-Kish,Akarsh Kumar,James Glass,Raja Giryes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Local Support Learning(LSL)框架,通过将梯度更新限制在当前训练分布的输入激活空间内,有效解决大预训练模型中的灾难性遗忘问题。LSL为每个权重矩阵配备基于高斯混合模型(GMM)的门控函数,使适配器仅在当前阶段数据激活时生效,在保留预训练和微调能力的同时,实现多阶段持续学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在多阶段微调中面临灾难性遗忘问题,预训练和先前微调阶段获得的能力常被覆盖。现有方法(LoRA、OP-LoRA、LwF等)均对所有输入施加梯度更新,这在理论上是不利于保留的——任何与更新不正交的先前输入其映射都会被改变。需要一种无需访问先前数据即可保留先前能力的方法。

Method: 核心方法包括:(1)问题分析:从几何角度证明梯度更新作用于权重矩阵的所有可能输入,任何非正交的先前输入都会被干扰。(2)保留目标:更新应仅作用于当前阶段分布的输入空间(support,即支持集)。LSL由两部分组成——标准权重适配器(类似LoRA)按常规训练,以及门控函数g(x)=x·𝕀{x∈M},仅当输入落在当前阶段数据分布支持集内时启用适配器。(3)GMM门控:对当前阶段输入激活拟合正GMM(Φ_pos),对通用预训练参考数据(仅约1M tokens)拟合负GMM(Φ_neg);通过比较两者似然判断门控开关。利用高斯密度随距离指数衰减的特性,实现对未见过数据保持关闭的自然归纳偏置。(5)时间平滑:采用指数移动平均对token级决策进行平滑处理。(6)逐矩阵门控:为每个权重矩阵单独设置门控,从各层深度特征做决策,单次前向传播即可获得。(7)复杂度优化:通过Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理压缩门控输入维度,采用对角协方差GMM,共享相同输入矩阵的门控。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct模型上,LSL在三个多样化下游任务(网络安全指令调优、英语到Igbo低资源翻译、化学指令调优)上均接近最优保留,同时完整学习新任务。关键实验结果:(1)在化学/网络安全/翻译任务上,LoRA和OP-LoRA均显著遗忘,LwF虽有改善但仍逊于LSL。(2)多阶段实验中,LSL在三个连续微调阶段后仍完整保留预训练能力(LoRA在第一阶段后即下降44%);三个微调任务性能也在训练阶段结束后保持。(3)LSL对学习率、适配器秩、批大小等超参数鲁棒,而传统方法在学习与遗忘之间存在权衡。(4)规模扩展性良好,从1.5B到7B参数规模保留性能均提升。(5)消融实验:GMM本身将保留率从76.6%提升至96.6%,时间平滑进一步提升至98.8%;Union of Spheres门控获得同等效果(证实局部支持是关键),而MLP门控显著差于GMM(在OOD数据上泛化差);单路由器直退化学习与保留效果。(6)效率:仅13.8MB额外存储用于GMM(每阶段6.9MB),推理延迟增加86ms,训练时间约1.64×LoRA。

Conclusion: LSL通过将权重更新限制在其训练数据所在输入空间的局部区域,有效解决大预训练模型的灾难性遗忘问题。理论分析表明,密度估计器可恢复最优正则门控,基于此设计的GMM门控提供了天然的归纳偏置使其在未见过的先前数据上保持关闭。实验证明LSL在高达70亿参数的大语言模型上,在多阶段持续学习场景中能完整保留预训练和先前微调能力,同时具备良好的超参数鲁棒性、规模扩展性和计算效率。主要局限包括:适配器无法合并至基础权重(推理开销随阶段数线性增加,虽可并行化);理论分析限于单矩阵,全网络推广仅获经验验证;依赖基础模型表征质量(对GMM拟合的适用性)。未来工作可拓展至更大模型、其他模态、强化学习目标、数百阶段场景以及测试时训练等方向。

Abstract: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), whose likelihood decays rapidly away from its training data, giving it a natural tendency to stay closed on data from prior phases. We show that this post-training approach can resolve forgetting in LLMs of up to 7 billion parameters, retaining both pretrained and finetuned capabilities across multiple training phases, while being efficient in memory and compute, robust to hyperparameter choice, and showing scaling potential.

</details>


### [383] [Finetuning with Sampling: SFT Learns Better Than You Think](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02140)
*Aayush Karan,Sitan Chen,Yilun Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战"SFT泛化弱、易灾难性遗忘"的传统观点，提出通过MCMC采样将离策略专家数据逐步转化为更接近基础模型分布的"近策略"数据，从而使标准SFT在科学推理、数学推理和开放性问答等任务上媲美甚至超越RL和自蒸馏等强在线策略方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练阶段面临的核心矛盾是：SFT能利用高质量离线专家数据但泛化差且会灾难性遗忘原有能力；RL及其变体（如自蒸馏）虽能保持原有能力并更好泛化，但依赖模型自身采样能力，对困难任务无训练信号。现有方法要么修改学习目标（如KL约束、重要性采样）来适应离线数据，要么通过GRPO变体引入专家上下文，但都未从根本上解决"如何让离线数据本身变得更易学"这一问题。

Method: 提出"投影采样"（Projection Sampling）：1）形式化定义信息投影——将基础模型分布p约束到与专家轨迹语义等价的集合𝒞上，得到目标分布p_C(x) ∝ p(x)·1(x∈𝒞)，即保留专家信息的同时最接近基础模型；2）采用Metropolis-Hastings MCMC算法，以专家轨迹初始化，通过"信息保持型"建议分布κ_C（利用LLM上下文学习能力，在给定专家轨迹和部分前缀的条件下续写）迭代精化轨迹，理论证明每步MCMC都单调降低数据策略与基础模型的KL散度；3）针对LLM实现，采用分块（block size B=32）逐段MCMC采样，并使用近似简化（接受更高似然候选）降低推理开销。
