On eight schools the centered and non-centered programs are the same measure to $5.7\times10^{-14}$, yet their weights differ by $6.1\times$; importance weighting reduces this only to $2.2\times$, and reproducing the inference LLB actually runs, a full-covariance Gaussian matched to the posterior moments, still leaves $1.9\times$ on eight schools and $8.9\times$ in $64$ dimensions. Across likelihood families, dimensions and funnel severities the discrepancy reaches $31.9\times$ and reverses sign, so no single writing is uniformly preferable. It inverts Bayes factors against eight natural competitors, and the induced error in the model posterior, and in any downstream target, is controlled by the spread $\Delta$ of the bound shortfalls through a known sharp Hilbert-distance bound. Across $360$ programs from six language models the parameterisation written ranges from $0\%$ to $100\%$ centered and is stable within a model. Detecting equivalent programs statistically can falsely merge genuinely different models at practical sample budgets; verifying reparameterisations we generate ourselves cannot, and closes the window.

</details>


### [411] [MOVE: Multimodal Open-world Verification and Expansion for Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00268)
*Zekai Chen,Jiayang Xing,Xun Wu,Miao Zhang,Xunkai Li,Kairui Yang,Zhengyu Wu,Xu Wang,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了MOVE框架，将多模态开放世界图学习重新定义为一个从知识不足到语义发现再到知识演化的渐进过程，通过不确定性感知的多模态编码、基于证据的类别归纳和选择性类别扩展三个耦合阶段，解决了未知节点识别、LLM生成类别验证和类别空间扩展中的三个关键失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态图在部署后会持续演化（出现新产品、新话题等新类别），但现有开放世界图学习方法存在三个关键缺陷：(1) 仅依赖单一模态相似性识别未知节点，可能遗漏多模态联合解释失败的节点；(2) 直接采用LLM生成的语言描述作为新类别，未在多模态空间中验证其可靠性；(3) 直接添加候选类别会引入冗余或干扰性的类别。作者通过实证研究验证了这三个挑战，为统一框架设计提供了经验基础。

Method: 提出了MOVE（Multimodal Open-world Class Verification and Expansion）框架，包含三个耦合阶段：
1. **不确定性感知多模态类别编码**（Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Coding）：将每个节点的视觉、文本和图上下文编码为模态特定的高斯分布，通过对称KL散度衡量类别兼容性、基于Bhattacharyya距离捕获跨模态分歧，使用已知类参考集进行校准，将节点划分为known/pending/unknown三态。
2. **基于证据的类别归纳**（Evidence-Grounded Class Induction）：通过多模态LLM（Qwen3-VL-Flash）为未知节点群生成候选类别描述，将文本描述编码为共享语义空间的候选先验分布，与基于Product-of-Experts融合的多模态证据分布进行尺度保持精度池化（scale-preserving precision pooling），结合Proposal/Validation子集避免过拟合。
3. **选择性类别扩展**（Selective Class Expansion）：基于验证子集使用单侧下置信界（LCB）衡量泛化增益，联合考虑冗余惩罚（与已有类的Bhattacharyya距离加权相似度）、复杂度代价（高斯参数有效维度）和对旧类分配的JS散度干扰，构造最终接纳评分，仅当评分超过阈值时才将候选类别并入类别空间。

Result: 在Toys、Grocery、Movies和Reddit-S四个多模态属性图基准上进行了全面实验。实验涵盖UCR（已知类识别与未知节点拒绝）、UCA（语义标签质量）和下游任务（节点分类与零样本模态匹配）。MOVE在所有数据集上取得最优性能：已知类准确率最高，UCR在Coverage和Precision上均位列前二，UCA的G-to-U语义相似度提升（K-to-G相似度降低），下游节点分类在所有数据集上优于对比标注方法。同时比最快基线快14.1×–18.1×，LLM API调用量从数百次降至3–25次。在10%–80%未知节点比例下保持稳健的Coverage和Precision，消融实验表明移除HCV或CSU会使Reddit-S上的节点分类准确率下降超过18个百分点。

Conclusion: 论文从渐进式知识演化的视角研究了开放世界多模态图学习，通过实证分析揭示了未知概念需要多模态联合解释、LLM生成概念需要基于证据的验证以及朴素的类别扩展会引入冗余类别三个关键问题。提出的MOVE框架通过不确定性感知多模态编码识别未解决的观测，通过多模态LLM与证据融合归纳候选概念，并通过可靠的、非冗余的概念选择性扩展类别空间。大量实验表明MOVE在未知类识别、语义标注和下游图学习方面均取得显著提升，同时保持了可靠且动态演化的类别空间。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning faces a fundamental challenge: new classes may emerge after deployment, while models are trained with a fixed label space. Existing approaches typically detect unknown nodes and use LLMs to generate candidate class descriptions, but they do not determine whether existing classes are insufficient to cover these nodes or whether a generated class is reliable enough to expand the class space. Our empirical study reveals three challenges: multimodal information beyond individual modalities is required for unknown-node identification, LLM-generated class descriptions may not fully capture multimodal class characteristics, and directly adding candidate classes can introduce redundant categories. Based on these observations, we propose MOVE, a multimodal open-world class verification and expansion framework. MOVE identifies nodes that cannot be assigned to existing classes by jointly considering visual tokens, textual attributes, and graph context, leverages a multimodal LLM to generate candidate classes, and selectively expands the class space only when candidates are consistently supported by multimodal evidence without introducing unnecessary categories. Experiments demonstrate that MOVE achieves an average improvement of 11.87\% across unknown recognition, open-domain annotation, and downstream graph learning tasks.

</details>


### [412] [Coupling Perception and Reasoning in Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00277)
*Zekai Chen,Xun Wu,Hailin Zhang,Xunkai Li,Yu Liu,Kairui Yang,Muyan Huang,Xuaner Chen,Rong-Hua Li,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedCORE提出通过共享低维潜在状态统一表征多模态编码器与GNN的联邦适配，解决现有联邦多模态图基础模型中模块独立更新导致的感知-推理协调丧失问题，将Encoder-GNN配对差距减少80.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦多模态图基础模型(GFM)适配方法主要冻结多模态编码器、仅更新图侧模块，限制了"提取什么信息"的适应性。同时，独立参数化的Encoder和GNN更新在联邦聚合后丧失局部建立的协调关系，导致跨客户端组合不兼容。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) 潜在状态建模——为每个客户端维护r×r的共享核心C，通过预训练矩阵的秩-r截断SVD构建固定坐标系，线性解码器D_j将C映射为各模块(Encoder、融合层、GNN)的低秩更新；(2) 协同状态学习——通过联合预测与仅感知/仅推理的反事实前向传播，定义协同裕度损失L_syn，并利用解码器的伴随将异构模块梯度精确回传至共享状态空间；(3) 联邦状态演化——基于感知-推理梯度一致性Γ_k与状态漂移D_k^t计算质量感知权重，对共享核心进行加权聚合。

Result: 在节点分类、链接预测、多模态检索、图到文本/图像生成等8个多模态图基准上，FedCORE平均超越最强基线2.27%，Encoder-GNN配对差距从30.6降至5.9(降低80.7%)，每轮通信量仅5.12×10²标量(相比独立联合LoRA减少99.89%)。

Conclusion: 多模态编码器与GNN的适配在联邦多模态GFM中本质耦合，感知适应受图关系条件化，且独立学习的模块更新存在跨客户端组合不兼容性。通过共享潜在状态统一表征并联邦演化感知-推理适配，可在保持低通信开销的同时维持模块协调，验证了协调式感知-推理适配在去中心化多模态图学习中的重要性。

Abstract: Federated multimodal graph foundation models (GFMs) aim to adapt pretrained multimodal models to decentralized graph data, where each client owns a private multimodal graph and cannot share raw information. These models typically combine a multimodal Encoder that extracts semantic evidence from heterogeneous modalities and a graph neural network (GNN) that performs relational reasoning over graph structures. However, existing federated GFM adaptation methods mainly update graph-side modules while keeping the multimodal Encoder frozen, limiting adaptation to \emph{how information is propagated} while fixing \emph{what information is extracted}. Through empirical studies, we reveal that Encoder and GNN adaptations are not independent: Encoder adaptation is affected by graph relations, while cross-client module swapping reveals substantial pairing sensitivity between separately parameterized Encoder and GNN updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{FedCORE}, a federated adaptation framework that represents Encoder and GNN updates through a shared low-dimensional latent state. FedCORE jointly optimizes this core from multimodal and structural signals and performs federated evolution directly in the shared state space, preserving compatibility between perception and reasoning adaptations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedCORE reduces the Encoder--GNN pairing gap from $30.6$ to $5.9$, corresponding to an $80.7\%$ reduction over independent joint adaptation.

</details>


### [413] [Stable and Counterfactually Robust Physical World Models from Imposed Structure and Learned Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00280)
*Yufeng Wang,Parivesh Priye,Lu Wei,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结构化物理世界模型框架，通过硬编码通用物理结构（辛括号、约束能量类、单向耗散端口、因子化参数映射）并从数据中学习系统特异性的物理内容（能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率），同时实现四项关键性质：与热力学第二定律兼容的耗散、对物理参数干预的正确响应、远至100倍训练时域的稳定性、以及对扰动的鲁棒性。该框架在电磁腔、粒子网格和浅水流体三个系统中得到验证，仅使用约9000个参数即可恢复本构函数、区分保守与耗散世界（相差四个数量级）、传递未见参数值的干预，并在结构缺失时明确拒绝干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的世界模型在物理一致性方面存在严重缺陷：违反守恒律、在长时域推演中漂移或发散、对训练中观察到的物理规律的变化查询仍然使用训练时的规律回答。物理真实性基准测试表明，即使强大的视频模型也会违反守恒律、创造能量，并在"反物理"探测上失败。本文的核心问题是：需要在世界模型中硬编码多少通用物理结构，才能从数据中学习系统特异性物理，使四项行为同时成立？

Method: 本文采用"硬编码通用形式 + 从数据学习系统特异性内容"的分工策略。具体方法包括：(1) 通过固定反对称算子作用于学习能量梯度生成保守动力学；(2) 能量限制在约束类（confining class）中确保水平集紧致；(3) 单向耗散端口（one-way port）只能移除能量而不能注入能量（σ≥0由架构保证）；(4) 驱动通道已知且单独审计；(5) 可干预的物理参数通过可分离映射G(z;θ)=θg(z)+h(z)进入。模型从数据学习能量泛函、本构关系、耗散率和耦合。设计了两条数学保证：命题3保证二次型诊断能量的二次收缩，命题1保证形式选择器的边际覆盖率。同时提出了反事实可回答性的构造准则：当且仅当干预参数通过已提供映射进入，且查询值离开训练边际支持时，反事实可由构造保证正确回答。

Result: 在电磁环形腔、64×64粒子网格（PIC）和浅水流体三个物理系统上验证：仅约8.6-11.5k参数的模型在所有四项行为上均显著优于等容量非结构化基线。具体结果包括：(1) 区分保守与耗散世界达四个数量级（σ_cons=1.2×10⁻⁵ vs σ_diss=0.481）；(2) 恢复本构函数斜率约为1.000（R²=1.0000）；(3) 电荷符号翻转干预成功率为10/10种子（p=0.001），而基线为2/10；(4) 重力从1.0到1.5的干预误差为6.8×10⁻¹¹，而非可分离控制失败达10¹⁰倍；(5) 在50000步（100倍训练时域）保持有界且能量漂移平缓；(6) 未提供参数映射的干预被正确拒绝（误差增加111×至10⁹×），而oracle模型成功；(7) 非线性本构律V'(h)=h²被恢复且曲率保持，预测保留干预比线性模型好2-17倍。此外，11个日常物理系统全部通过测试卡，4个边界条件有明确机制说明。

Conclusion: 本文证明了：通过施加少量几何和热力学支架（辛括号、约束能量类、port-Hamiltonian耗散通道、因子化参数映射），可以构建行为如同校准仪器而非黑箱的世界模型。该模型能清晰区分保守与耗散机制、学习非线性本构律、在同等表达能力的基线失败之处传递干预，并在长时域保持稳定。通用几何结构有助于而非阻碍学习，因为它提供了数据可用于确定具体物理的坐标系框架。局限包括：耗散保证仅适用于二次型端口通道能量；有界性仅对保守动力学证明；势能仅在Casimir常数范围内可识别；模型需要用户提供括号、通道和核（非无监督定律发现）；结果依赖合成经典模拟器而非实验。

Abstract: A world model learns to forecast how a physical system evolves from recorded trajectories, yet the systems it imitates obey physical laws that are neither fully supplied nor reliably respected. The model may create energy, drift or diverge over long rollouts, and answer a changed law query using the law observed during training. We ask how much general physical structure must be hard coded into a world model, and how much system-specific physics can then be learned from data, for four properties to hold simultaneously: second law compatible dissipation, correct responses to interventions on physical parameters, stability out to one hundred times the training horizon, and robustness to disturbances. The imposed structure is general: dynamics are generated from the gradient of a learned energy through a fixed reversible operator, the energy is restricted to a confining class, a one way port can remove energy but never inject it, the drive channel is known, and the intervened parameter enters through a separable map. The model learns the energy functional, constitutive relations, dissipation rate, and couplings. Across an electromagnetic cavity, a particle in cell grid, and a shallow-water fluid, models with roughly nine thousand parameters recover constitutive functions with unit slope, separate conserving from dissipating worlds by four orders of magnitude using a single set of weights, and transfer changes in sign, magnitude, rate, and gravity to unseen values, where equal-capacity models without the same structure perform at chance or worse. A nonlinear constitutive law is recovered with its curvature preserved and predicts a held-out intervention $2$-$17\times$ better than a converged linear model.

</details>


### [414] [Bellman-Certified Rounding for Sparse Policy Deployment in MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00325)
*Zhaojun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限折扣MDP中将连续行混合策略四舍五入到稀疏二进制部署策略时的回报保证问题。通过2d+2次Bellman求解构建可重用的敏感性包络（Bellman envelopes），提供统一和候选特定的预舍入证书，并利用秩二有理表示对执行路径进行加权曲率积分。证明了预算与维度呈线性依赖是不可避免的，且精确全局曲率阈值计算是NP难的。在结构化测试中，候选特定证书将预舍入认证覆盖率从48.2%提升至74.1%；在耦合实例（γ=0.95）上，局部积分将中位数界-损比从402.3降至2.08。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续策略优化天然将更新分散到多个状态，但实际部署可能仅允许少量完整的状态级修改（每行要么采用基线动作，要么完全采用提议动作）。这种连续松弛与二进制可行类之间的间隙（Gap）造成了部署阶段的回报损失。由于策略依赖的访问性耦合了各行的修改，且长视界使得全局曲率界过于保守，如何在舍入前获得可用的回报保证成为一个核心挑战。

Method: 方法包含四个层面：（1）Bellman包络（Bellman Envelopes）：构造2d+2次辅助Bellman求解，得到策略值和可达性的极值界，推导敏感性量的区间证书；（2）预算感知统一证书 B_unif = τ̂ + c_{d,k}β̂，其中预算系数 c_{d,k} = q_{d,k}(d-q_{d,k})/(4d)，q_{d,k} = min{k,⌊d/2⌋}；（3）候选特定证书 B_cand(x) = Σ Δᵢτ̂ᵢ + β̂_{F(z)}Φ(z)/4，利用候选策略几何信息避免额外Bellman求解；（4）基于秩二有理表示 g(t)=p(t)/q(t) 的加权曲率积分 B_loc，通过Bernstein多项式界实现可靠上界。在算法层面，提出Algorithm 1的两阶段舍入（确定性填充+成对交换），最多需d-1次交换和2(d-1)次回报评估。理论层面证明B_cand ≤ B_unif ≤ B_Bell（遗留界），以及通过MAX-CUT归约证明连续曲率阈值问题的NP困难性。

Result: 在144个结构化测试用例（gridworld、queue、maintenance、garnet）中，有139个活跃案例：（1）候选特定证书将预舍入认证覆盖率从67/139（48.2%，遗留界B_Bell）提升至103/139（74.1%，B_cand），且无需额外Bellman求解；中位数界-损比从70.8降至12.1。（2）20个闭式族案例验证了B_cand(x*)=B_Bell/2，且加权积分界精确等于Gap(C_k)。（3）在24个耦合实例（d∈{6,8}）上，γ=0.95时中位数界-损比从402.3（B_cand）降至2.08（B_loc），路径积分界覆盖全部24个案例。（4）验证算术比精确有理流水线快14.8倍（S=d=16），验证区间包含所有6个审计参考案例的精确重计算，而朴素FP64在Bellman审计中无一通过。（5）算法在119/144结构化案例中达到精确二进制最优，贪心法为26次评估中位数（均值间隙0.178%），本文算法仅需6次评估（均值间隙0.185%）。（6）贪心法与本文算法在S=d=16时的计算时间对比：直接舍入7.60ms，秩二舍入9.43ms，局部积分36.19ms。

Conclusion: 稀疏部署改变了策略优化问题的性质，因为每行编辑会改变未来访问性。研究表明，Bellman包络可统一控制此耦合，而预算和候选几何在舍入前即可锐化保证。对于已执行的交换路径，秩二有理表示支持加权曲率积分，避免为远离路径的策略付出代价。预舍入认证覆盖率的提升（48.2%→74.1%）和长视界下界-损比的大幅改善（402.3→2.08）区分了证书的两种用途：部署前的可重用保证与舍入路径已知后的更紧审计。遗留界B_Bell = τ̂+(d-1)β̂/8的预算感知版本B_unif ≤ B_Bell始终成立。线性维度依赖在预算与维度成比例时不可避免（Ω(d)下界）。精确曲率阈值计算是NP难的（通过受限MDP类𝔅_3上从MAX-CUT的归约），因此Bellman包络界在多项式时间内不可被精确替代。开放问题包括最佳通用维度常数、连续曲率阈值问题的NP成员性、以及路径界在验证浮点中的实现。

Abstract: Continuous policy optimization may spread an update across many states, even when deployment permits only a few complete state-level changes. We study how much discounted return can be retained when continuous row mixtures are rounded to sparse binary policies in finite MDPs. Policy-dependent visitation couples the row edits, while long horizons make global curvature bounds conservative. From $2d+2$ Bellman solves, we derive reusable envelopes that support uniform and candidate-specific guarantees before rounding. A rank-two rational representation of each exchange further permits weighted curvature integration along the realized trajectory. We prove that linear dimension dependence is unavoidable when the budget scales, and that exact global curvature thresholding is hard. Candidate-specific bounds raise pre-rounding certification coverage from $48.2\%$ to $74.1\%$ on the structured suite. At $\gamma=0.95$, local integration lowers the median bound-to-loss ratio from $402.3$ to $2.08$ on coupled instances.

</details>


### [415] [Beyond Diagonal State Space Models: Exact Non-Abelian Group Tracking, Solvability Barriers, and Geometric Physical Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00329)
*Zeyu Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非交换状态空间模型（NC-SSM），将状态转移参数化于紧致李群（SU(2)、SO(3)、SO(N)），通过Euler-Rodrigues闭式映射和有理Cayley变换实现严格的范数保持等距性，突破了传统对角SSM（Mamba、S4D、LRU）的交换性与可解性障碍，首次在单层架构下实现对非可解单群A₅及对称群S₅的精确跟踪，并在连续物理流形保持、层级语法建模和联想记忆等多领域取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对角SSM因转移矩阵交换性（Ā_t Ā_t' = Ā_t' Ā_t）只能生成可解变换群（推导长度≤2），数学上无法忠实嵌入非可解单群（如A₅，其中[A₅,A₅]=A₅）；多层堆叠虽可逼近但面临电路深度下界Ω(log L / log d_model)及优化鞍点问题，导致深度对角基线在A₅上崩溃至6.60%。

Method: 1）李代数参数化：利用Euler-Rodrigues闭式公式实现SU(2)/SO(3)精确矩阵指数，保证‖U_t‖=1严格等距；2）纯Hopf纤维化Bloch投影读出（S³/{±1}≅S²）消除SU(2)双覆盖符号歧义；3）四元数关联并行前缀扫描（9.06×加速，T=2048）；4）恒等门控李SSM消除稀疏语法相位漂移（g_t→0⇒U_t→I）；5）有理Cayley变换推广至SO(N)（N≥4），突破Klein 1884上界（A₅为SO(3)最大有限子群），实现S₅嵌入（V₄⊂ℝ⁵）。

Result: 14组实验显示：(1) NC-SSM在S₃/D₄/Q₈/A₅上达100%跟踪，3层对角基线在A₅上仅6.60%（p=8.81×10⁻⁴）；(2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM在S₅上达50.92%±2.01%（对角5.25%，方差降低7.8×）；(3) SO(3)-SSM在300步3D刚体动力学中正交性漂移<3.12×10⁻⁶（>580,000×优势），MAV特技飞行测距误差1.64° vs 基线110.79°；(4) Dyck-2零泄漏协议达74.36%，Python AST L=128达30.26%（p=0.0081）；(5) 严格等距性消融实验验证其为无损长程联想记忆的数学必要条件。

Conclusion: 通过将状态转移从交换对角矩阵提升至紧致李群上的非交换旋转，NC-SSM框架在理论上突破了传统SSM的可解性代数障碍（Lemma 1、Corollary 2），实验上在离散群跟踪、连续物理流形保持与层级推理的统一任务中均取得显著突破，并证明了严格等距性是非耗散长程记忆的数学先决条件，为非交换基础模型架构开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Selective state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, S4D, and LRU, are bounded by transition matrix commutativity (A_t A_t' = A_t' A_t) and solvable affine transformation groups (Aff_D of derived length <= 2). Consequently, stacked multi-layer diagonal networks face severe optimization degradation on non-solvable simple groups such as A_5 due to the exponential circuit emulation depth required to simulate non-abelian commutators. We propose Non-Commutative State Space Models (NC-SSM), their real-orthogonal counterpart SO(3)-SSM, and arbitrary-dimension Cayley-SSM, lifting state transitions to compact Lie groups SU(2), SO(3), and SO(N). Via closed-form Euler-Rodrigues maps and rational Cayley transforms, NC-SSM achieves exact norm-preserving isometry (||U_t|| = 1). We introduce pure Hopf-fibration Bloch projective readouts (S^3/{+-1} =~ S^2 =~ SO(3)) to eliminate sign ambiguity, true quaternion parallel prefix scans (9.06x speedup at T=2048), and Identity-Gated Lie SSMs to eliminate sparse syntax phase drift. Extensive benchmarks across 14 experimental regimes show: (1) NC-SSM achieves 100% tracking on S_3, D_4, Q_8 and simple group A_5, where a 3-layer deep diagonal baseline collapses to 6.60% (p = 8.81e-4); (2) Cayley-SO(5)-SSM breaks Klein's 1884 ceiling on symmetric group S_5 (50.92% vs diagonal 5.25%, p = 0.0015, delivering 7.8x variance reduction over SO(3)); (3) SO(3)-SSM preserves Riemannian manifolds across 300 steps (< 3.12e-6 drift, > 580,000x advantage), achieving 0.04 deg dead-reckoning error and active tangent denoising; (4) NC-SSM achieves 74.36% on Dyck-2 and 30.26% on deep AST scope tracking (p = 0.0081); and (5) ablation confirms strict isometry is mathematically necessary for lossless long-range associative memory.

</details>


### [416] [Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00346)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在统一评测框架下，对8个来自6个家族的System One决策模型（含托管模型Jev）与2个生成式对比模型、监督/零样本分类器进行了对比，覆盖工作流、意图和社科任务。结果表明模型排序取决于条件：有任务标签时小分类器在意图任务最优；无标签时多数决策模型优于零样本推理分类器；通过选项键似然读取的大生成模型与Jev在工作流和意图上持平。论文同时评估了选项数量、选项名称、渲染方式、选择性预测、置信门控级联的成本-精度权衡，并推导了条件相关的工程设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化决策门需要的是带校准概率的声明选项，现有评估分散在不同任务家族、不同提示和评分代码下，数字无法横向比较；不同模型类（监督分类器、零样本分类器、生成式模型与新型决策模型）在统一条件下孰优孰劣，以及阈值、选项模式、范围外拒绝和级联等工程条件如何决定选择，尚缺乏受控基准。

Method: 构建统一评测harness：通过同一TypeSafe请求格式向托管模型API和本地checkpoint（8个决策模型+2个生成式Qwen对比器）发送相同状态、问题与选项文本，输出归一化后比较。三种概率臂：shipped/raw/scaled（温度由命题1无需再前向传播即可恢复）。三种数据集家族D1（typed-decisions，4种工作流）、D2（CLINC-150，含150意图+范围外）、D3（4个社科任务）。度量包括准确率、Brier、NLL、ECE（10等质量箱）、风险-覆盖曲线、AUROC；配对cluster bootstrap（10000次），Holm校正。压力测试：选项基数扫描（5/20/50/150）、选项命名（数字/对齐/极性翻转/随机串）、选项渲染；置信门控级联成本-精度（命题2层级准确率与命题3级联准确率）。所有输入冻存为JSONL并附SHA-256清单以可复现。

Result: （i）有任务标签时，BERT-base/BGE-small在意图上达0.940/0.948，优于Jev的0.913；Jev、Kev-9B、Nimble-9B在工作流上与训练分类器无显著差异。无任务标签时，除两个Laya编码器checkpoint外所有决策模型均显著优于DeBERTa-v3零样本推理分类器。（ii）Qwen3.6-27B通过选项键似然读取在工作流和意图上与Jev持平（0.733/0.912），并在5%风险下接受更多工作流决策；其JSON陈述概率因160/600意图回复键不匹配而严重退化。（iii）Kev存储温度（拟合于少选项）升至150选项时校准误差骤增，Kev-9B从0.051升至0.377。（iv）选项极性翻转使Jev每百个二元回答翻转50.5个，Laya为91.3，4个基于解码器的checkpoint≤6.5；中性标识符可将Jev的影响降至接近重测底线。（v）Jev在5%风险阈值下接受0.310的范围外请求；显式声明"out-of-scope"选项可降至0.195。（vi）this-that-model-1.0升级至Jev在意图上以0.43倍成本匹配Jev准确率（0.927 vs 0.913）。

Conclusion: 模型类的排名取决于条件：有稳定标签训练集时小型分类器最优；无标签且大生成模型以选项键似然读取时与Jev持平；决策模型间排序亦随任务、选项数、命名与范围外检测能力而异。条件依赖的工程规则包括：阈值必须按模型与任务在留出数据上设定并验证其经验风险；存储温度需在目标任务与选项计数下重校准；选项标识宜使用中性键；选项文本长度须适配模型输入预算，超出时以层级分类补救；范围外请求需单独评估并配合显式"out-of-scope"选项或第二阈值；级联仅在第二阶段对升级子集的准确率高于第一阶段时才能节省成本或提升精度。限制包括：工作流标签源于教师模型、情绪标签为远监督标签、范围外风险为经验估计而非分布自由保证、托管模型与若干checkpoint会更新。

Abstract: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

</details>


### [417] [MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00367)
*Yushuai Sun,Zikun Zhou,Lin Gao,Jun Yu,Wenjie Pei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoRA提出一种针对MoE模型的结构化专家剪枝框架，通过学习路由器偏置识别关键专家，再利用保留下来的专家对剪枝专家的输出做仿射近似，以在少量开销下保持模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝方法存在两个缺陷：基于统计的专家排序（如激活频率）倾向于保留处理常见功能词的专家，与预测性能相关性差；基于重构的子集搜索计算成本高且忽略了被保留专家之间的冗余性。

Method: MoRA包含两个阶段。第一阶段为每个路由专家引入可学习的路由器偏置，通过LM损失与路由多样性正则项联合优化，使偏置同时反映预测重要性和路由多样性，偏置作为专家排序分数用于剪枝。第二阶段为后剪枝增强，为每个目标被剪专家在保留专家中寻找最佳代理，并用通道级仿射变换（通过加权岭回归拟合）近似其输出，仅当代理保真度超过阈值时启用。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Moonlight-16B-A3B三种模型上以C4为校准集、九个零样本基准测试，MoRA在25%和50%剪枝率下均优于Activation Count、Average Gate Mass、MoNE、MC-SMoE、HC-SMoE等基线。50%剪枝率下，Qwen3-30B-A3B平均分提升6.43点（57.50→65.83）。仿射变换参数仅占保留参数量的不到0.08%，推理FLOPs增加不超过0.0005%。消融实验表明LM损失与多样性正则项均不可或缺，且偏置排序显著优于偏置-调整后的门控概率排序。专家删除一致性r=Spearman相关性分析显示，学习到的偏置与删除专家导致的损失增加呈正相关，深层MoE层中相关性更强。

Conclusion: MoRA通过学习路由器偏置并结合仿射近似，实现了高效且性能优越的专家剪枝，为MoE模型的部署压缩提供了一种新方案。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.

</details>


### [418] [M$^2$Weather: A Benchmark for Joint Multi-Station and Multi-Variable Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00370)
*Rongwen Li,Xiao Wang,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 M²Weather 基准,用于联合多站点多变量气象预报。核心贡献包括:收集 2,809 个高质量站点、5 个物理耦合气象变量,覆盖 France/Europe/Global 三个空间尺度;设计统一的训练与评估协议;提出一种轻量级、即插即用的无反向传播适配器,可在不重训模型的前提下补全缺失的站点或变量交互。基于 16 个代表性模型的系统评估显示,联合建模站点与变量关系具有显著优势,HiSTGNN(MSMV)在三个数据集上均达到最优,而适配器补全交互进一步降低了所有模型的 MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 站点气象预报受到站点间空间依赖和气象变量间物理耦合的双重影响。然而现有研究通常分别考察这两种关系,且使用不同的数据集和实验设置,导致无法系统评估二者的单独及联合贡献。本文旨在填补这一空白,系统回答"站点与变量交互如何单独和联合影响站点气象预报"这一基础性问题。

Method: 1) 数据集构建:基于 CDS 全球陆面观测,通过多标准质量控制和站点分层(2,504 M²-CS 核心站 + 1,637 M²-RA 区域站),筛选 5 个物理耦合变量(气温、露点温度、站点气压、风速、风向),形成 France(176)/Europe(983)/Global(2,504)三个空间尺度。2) 统一训练评估协议:60%/10%/30% 时序划分,48→72 小时预报,标准化空间下的 MSE/MAE。3) 即插即用适配器:包含校准分支、变量交互分支(去对角的线性映射)和站点交互分支(基于 8 邻 KNN 的两跳空间对比),通过闭式岭回归求解,无需反向传播。5) 评估四种范式(SSSV/SSMV/MSSV/MSMV)共 16 个基线模型。

Result: 关键结果:1) MSMV 模型 HiSTGNN 在 France/Europe/Global 三个数据集上均达到最低 MSE(分别为 0.3079/0.2908/0.2961),验证了联合建模价值。2) 范式排序一致:SSSV > SSMV > MSMV,且 MSSV 优于 SSMV,说明空间信息更具价值。3) 适配器使 15 个非 MSMV 模型的 MSE 在三个数据集全部降低,相对降幅 0.32%-19.08%;SSSV 范式获益最大(France 组均值降 10.2%)。4) 去掉校准分支仅用交互分支时,所有 30 个模型-数据集对的 MSE 仍持续降低,证明增益源于真正的交互补全。5) 适配器参数量极少(1,152-2,016),拟合时间仅为骨干单轮训练的 21.1%-45.3%。

Conclusion: M²Weather 基准通过三层级数据、统一协议和即插即用适配器,证实联合建模站点与变量交互是提升站点气象预报的关键资源。HiSTGNN 的最佳成绩、所有适配后模型的持续改进、以及无校准仅交互消融实验的支撑,共同指向需要更多关注同时显式捕捉站点与变量交互的预报架构。M²Weather 为开发更丰富的联合架构、更长预报时效和更复杂天气条件的研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Station weather forecasting is fundamentally shaped by both complex spatial dependencies across stations and strong physical coupling among weather variables. However, existing studies often consider these relationships separately and use different datasets and experimental settings, hindering systematic assessment of their individual and joint contributions. In this paper, we introduce $M^2$Weather, a benchmark for joint multi-station and multi-variable weather forecasting. Through multi-criteria quality control and station stratification, we collect 2,809 high-quality stations with 5 physically coupled weather variables across three spatial scales: France, Europe, and Global. This multi-scale design lets us examine whether conclusions persist from national to global station networks. We also introduce unified training and evaluation protocols to enable fair comparison of different station-variable modeling paradigms. To further examine the benefits of modeling station-variable relationships, we design a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter. With a trained weather forecasting model, this adapter can introduce missing station or variable relationships without retraining the model. This enables fair and efficient investigation of station-variable relationships. Systematic evaluation of 16 representative models shows the benefits of jointly modeling station and variable relationships. Completing missing relationships further reduces MSE for all adapted models on all three datasets. Together, these results identify the complementary information across stations and variables as an important resource for improving station weather forecasting. Our code can be obtained at this https URL .

</details>


### [419] [When Do Attention-Head Ablations Support Causal Claims? Projection-Level Confounds, Floor Effects, and Matched Controls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00373)
*Juli Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统性地审计了注意力头消融（attention-head ablation）方法在因果推断中的可靠性，以 GPT-2 small 为案例，指出当前实践中三个常被忽视但会显著影响结论的环节——干预位置、指标选择、控制组设计——并提出了一套严谨的验证协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力头消融是解释语言模型行为的常用手段：置零某个头后观察性能变化，据此推断该头是否对任务有因果贡献。然而，该论文认为这一推断链在实践中非常脆弱，干预语义、评估指标和控制组的选择往往未经审查，导致因果声明不可靠。论文聚焦一个具体问题：单头补齐手段在何种条件下才能支撑一个站得住脚的因果解释？

Method: 论文以"归纳式随机提示"复制任务为目标任务、"a+b"算术任务为离靶对照，采用 GPT-2 small（12 层 × 12 头）作为主模型、DistilGPT2 作为复制模型。设计了两种消融方法：naive_post_projection（在注意力模块输出端对 head-sized 通道切片置零，但此时 W_O 已混合了多头贡献）和 head_ablation（在投影前的拼接输入端置零，即正确的"单头置零"）。指标上对比了二元精确率与教师强制下 gold-token 对数概率。头选择基于发现集的逐头Δ 对生成数概率排名，候选为前 5。控制组包含 1,000 次随机头抽取与层匹配头抽取，所有抽取均基于已算好的 Δ 向量重采样，不增加前向传播开销。数据集按 50/50 划分发现/留出两部分，候选头仅在发现集选择、仅在留出集验证。统计推断采用 2,000 次百分位 bootstrap CI 和带有限样本修正的蒙特卡洛单侧 p 值。

Result: 三项主要发现：(RQ0) 干预语义至关重要：朴素后置削与正确前削的逐头效应 Pearson r=0.057（Spearman ρ=0.110），前 5 重要头集合完全不重叠（0/5）。这种不一致源于评估方法而非调优或输入差异。(RQ1) 二元精确率存在地板与天花板效应：在算术任务上 GPT-2 精确率为 0.0%，无法再检出退化；在复制任务上为 99.5%，可能遗漏不跨越决策边界的信心变化。对数概率在两个区间均提供连续信号。(RQ2) 使用正确前消融、对数概率指标与留出验证，10 个候选头中前 5 在复制任务上的留出平均效应为 0.412 nats，远超随机头控制（均值 0.029，p=0.001）和层匹配控制（均值 0.051，p=0.001）。144 头的发现/留出排序 Spearman ρ=0.974，排序稳定。然而任务特异性较弱：目标 vs. 离靶效应差为 0.139 nats，蒙特卡洛 p=0.078，未过 0.05 阈值；N=500 的预承诺复现中 p 升至 0.274。DistilGPT2 复制中 RQ0/RQ1/控制组发现均成立，特异性更强（p=0.001），但复制任务准确率为 90.0%，GPT-2 的近天花板情形未复制。

Conclusion: 单头消融结果本身并不能自我证明因果角色：朴素钩子可能选择性切除所评对象，二元精确率在地板/天花板下被截断，留出控制才可将真正的可复制效应与任意干扰分开。此外，任务特异性可能在原模型上不成立。一个站得住脚的因果声明需要三件事：(i) 验证干预在投影语义上的正确性；(ii) 使用未饱和的连续指标；(iii) 在留出数据上用匹配控制评估。论文完整提供了代码、种子与每个数字对应的 JSON 字段，以可复现的方式展示了"单一数值结果远不足以支撑因果声明"这一方法论论点。

Abstract: Attention-head ablation, zeroing a head and measuring the resulting change in task performance, is a common method for inferring which components of a language model are causally responsible for a behavior. We show using GPT-2 small that this inference can be fragile unless the intervention semantics, evaluation metric, and controls are carefully validated. A natural post-projection implementation of "zeroing a head" is nearly uncorrelated with a corrected pre-projection ablation (Pearson r = 0.057) and selects a completely disjoint top-5 set of important heads. We also show that binary accuracy can hide effects at behavioral floors and near ceilings, whereas gold-token log-probability remains graded. Using a discovery/held-out split and 1,000 matched random-head and layer-matched-head control draws, the corrected per-head effect ranking is highly stable across splits (Spearman rho = 0.974), and the top-5 selected heads significantly exceed both control distributions (Monte Carlo p = 0.001). However, evidence for task specificity is not robust on GPT-2. Replication on DistilGPT2 preserves the intervention-semantic and matched-control findings. These results show that single-head ablation does not by itself justify a causal claim; defensible interpretation requires correct intervention placement, a non-saturated continuous metric, and matched held-out controls.

</details>


### [420] [A First Glance at Jev for Network Traffic Classification: Accuracy, Processing Time, and Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00376)
*Shenghe Xu,Lifan Mei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对通用决策模型Jev在网络流量应用分类任务中的表现进行了实证研究,使用CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集的前10个QUIC包大小、方向和间隔时间作为输入,对10个应用标签进行分类。研究发现:40个标注示例将Jev准确率从9.80%提升至28.42%,但仍低于用8000条记录训练的Random Forest(69.95%)和Extra Trees(66.80%)。在配对100条记录的子集上,Jev(40示例)准确率29%、中位请求时间0.750s、API费用更低;而GPT-5.6 Sol(高推理,经Azure)准确率37%、中位时间6.036s。标记示例虽显著改善Jev,但在所有测试周中仍不及训练好的树集成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究通用决策模型(以Jev为代表)能否通过少量标注样本直接用于网络流量应用识别,以替代传统监督学习方法。该研究动机源于:加密流量限制了直接可读内容,而基于包大小、方向和时间间隔的紧凑表示可作为替代;通用模型通过指令和示例即可完成任务,无需更新权重,为网络科学提供了灵活性和适应性。验证这一灵活性在准确性、处理时间和运行成本方面是否带来实际收益。

Method: 使用CESNET-QUICEXT-25数据集(2024年6-12月),从每周原始记录中选择2000条(共52000条主测试集)进行应用分类。输入为每个流前10个包的包间时延(毫秒)、方向(-1/+1)和传输负载大小(字节)。方法对比包括:(1)Random Forest和Extra Trees:用前4周(8000条)训练,500棵树,固定后用于所有测试周;(2)Jev:OpenRouter模型typesafe/jev-1.13,使用0/40/150个标注示例;(4)GPT-5.6 Sol:通过Azure部署,高推理努力,JSON输出。在第5周的100条记录子集上进行配对对比。评估指标为准确率、宏F1、请求时间和API成本。

Result: (1)完整测试集:RF准确率69.95%(Macro-F1 0.7155),ET为66.80%(0.6898),Jev-0为9.80%(0.0338),Jev-40为28.42%(0.3799),训练多数类常数为22.79%。(2)跨26个测试周:RF和ET在所有周都优于Jev-40;RF准确率从第5周72.70%降至第30周69.50%。(4)上下文扩展:Jev-150在第5周达到34.50%,比Jev-40提升8.6个百分点。(5)配对对比(Sol vs Jev):Sol-40为37% vs Jev-40为29%(p=0.2005,差异不显著);Sol-40中位时间6.036s vs Jev-40为0.750s;Jev费用显著更低。(6)批量总成本约36.42美元(Jev约21.90s + Sol约14.01s)。

Conclusion: 研究表明:标记上下文能有效提升Jev在网络流量应用分类中的表现(从9.80%到28.42%,增加上下文到150个示例可进一步提升至34.50%),且Jev在请求时间和API成本方面优于高推理配置的GPT-5.6 Sol。然而,在所有测试周中,用8000条记录训练的树集成模型(RF/ET)仍显著优于所有测试的Jev配置,准确率差距超过40个百分点。由于不同的监督预算和固定配置,无法将这一差距归因于单一原因。研究支持一个有边界的结论:示例有助于适配此决策服务,但达到替代受监督测试的准确性仍未实现。未来工作应包括替代表征、系统化示例选择、匹配的标签预算树对照以及在多网络和多采集周期的评估。

Abstract: We evaluate Jev on ten dataset-defined application labels in CESNET-QUICEXT-25 using only the first ten packets' sizes, directions, and inter-packet times. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of general-purpose decision models, represented here by Jev, for application classification of network flows. Across 52,000 records from 26 collection weeks following the training period, 40 fixed labeled examples raise Jev's accuracy from 9.80% to 28.42%. Random Forest and Extra Trees trained on 8,000 records achieve 69.95% and 66.80% and outperform Jev in every week. Increasing Jev's context to 150 examples yields 34.50% on the first test week. On a paired 100-record subset, Jev with 40 examples achieves 29% accuracy at a median request time of 0.750 s, versus 37% and 6.036 s for the generative language model OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol with high reasoning effort through Azure; Jev also incurs lower API charges. The paired subset does not establish an accuracy advantage for either service, and the timing reflects different service configurations. Thus, labeled examples substantially improve Jev, but the tested Jev configurations remain less accurate than trained tree ensembles; unequal supervision budgets and fixed configurations prevent attributing the gap to a single cause.

</details>


### [421] [STCFormer: Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Modeling with Dynamic Cluster Transformer for Station-based Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00377)
*Rongwen Li,Haixin Xie,Mingyang Wang,Hongwu Liu,Kun Fang,Changjian Chen,Zhuo Tang,Kenli Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出STCFormer，一种用于站点气象预报的自适应时空Transformer模型，通过在每个时间片内根据局部演化动态分组站点，结合局部-全局注意力机制，在三个真实数据集、八个预报任务上取得了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于聚类的选择性建模方法存在两个关键问题：(1) 在整个观测窗口内共享固定分组会模糊站点关系的局部变化，且纯组内交互可能遗漏重要的全局上下文；(2) 选择性交互相对于密集连接的理论优势缺乏充分解释。

Method: 提出STCFormer模型，核心包括：(1) 联合时空块嵌入，保留局部空间上下文；(2) 双视图时间表示（状态视图用于预测，演化视图用于分组）；(3) 聚类引导注意力块（CGAB），包含动态EM式聚类、硬路由局部注意力和跨区域的全局站到区域注意力；(4) 理论分析：推导聚类条件局部注意力的Lipschitz上界，证明其不超过全连接对应物的上界，并基于互信息设计InfoLoss正则化项。

Result: 在French、Hunan、Global三个真实气象数据集的八个温度和风速预报任务上，STCFormer在所有任务的24小时MSE上达到最低，相对第二优平均降低2.2%；在48个指标-任务-时间跨度的综合比较中，47次排名第一或第二。消融实验证实了局部自适应分组、InfoLoss正则化以及局部-全局互补交互的各自贡献。案例研究表明动态分组具有最高的组内演化一致性（中位数0.385）。效率分析显示STCFormer相比Crossformer训练时间减少26.0%、内存减少35.4%。

Conclusion: STCFormer通过演化驱动的逐时间片动态分组，结合局部精细注意力与跨区域全局上下文，有效建模了站点间时变的空间依赖关系。理论分析从Lipschitz敏感性和互信息角度为选择性聚类交互提供了支撑，并启发了InfoLoss设计。实验全面验证了该模型在精度、效率和鲁棒性方面的优势，为基于站点的精细化气象预报提供了一种有效的选择性空间建模范式。

Abstract: Station-based weather forecasting supports daily life and economic activity, yet accurate forecasts require modeling complex spatial dependencies among stations. Recent clustering-based selective modeling offers a promising alternative to dense inter-station interactions. However, a grouping shared across an observation window may obscure local changes in station relationships, while intra-cluster interactions alone may miss important global context. The theoretical advantages of selective interactions over dense connectivity also remain insufficiently understood. We therefore propose STCFormer, an adaptive spatio-temporal Transformer that dynamically groups stations according to their local evolution within each temporal patch. Its Cluster-Guided Attention Block combines fine-grained local attention within clusters and global attention over regional state summaries, allowing each station to access information beyond its own cluster. We further show that a derived Lipschitz upper bound for cluster-conditioned local attention is no larger than its fully connected counterpart, explaining a potential robustness benefit and motivating the design of InfoLoss. Experiments on three real-world weather datasets spanning eight temperature and wind forecasting tasks show that STCFormer achieves the lowest 24-hour mean squared error on all eight tasks and ranks first or second in 47 of 48 comparisons across metrics and forecasting horizons. Ablations and case studies further confirm the benefits of locally adaptive grouping and complementary local-global interactions. Our code can be obtained at this https URL .

</details>


### [422] [Fusion techniques of time frequency-based images to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00380)
*Wael Korani,Md Fahimul Kabir Chowdhury,Mohammed Aledhari,Reza Rostami,Reza Kazemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出两种时频图像融合技术（montage和blending）结合轻量级CNN，用于基于EEG预测rTMS治疗抑郁症的疗效。关键发现在于：当使用段级交叉验证时，模型准确率高达99.90%；但采用严格受试者独立（subject-disjoint）交叉验证后，除montage CWT_ST在主队列上达到AUC 0.874外，其余所有配置均降至接近随机水平（p=0.703），揭示了段级验证存在患者级别的数据泄露问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于EEG预测rTMS抗抑郁治疗反应是一个重要临床问题。现有方法面临高受试者间变异性和单域分析特征有限的挑战，且文献中普遍未明确报告交叉验证的构建方式（段级vs受试者级），导致结果难以解读。

Method: 使用四种时频方法（CWT、DWT、ST、SSWE）将EEG信号转换为图像，引入两种图像级融合策略（montage并排放置和blending叠加），并设计轻量级自定义CNN。在两个独立队列（15例和46例患者）上进行段级和受试者独立交叉验证实验，对比14种架构（含5个预训练模型、3个EEG专用模型、CNN-LSTM混合模型和4个经典ML分类器）。采用Bootstrap置信区间、患者级置换检验和Brier分数进行评估。

Result: 段级验证下montage CWT_ST融合在主队列达99.90%准确率，次队列91.90%。但严格受试者独立验证下，除montage CWT_ST在主队列达AUC 0.874±0.183、82.7%准确率（p=0.005）外，其余所有配置AUC均落在0.31-0.54之间，95%置信区间均包含0.5，最佳独立方法的置换检验p=0.703。该最佳结果在frozen ImageNet backbone等不同架构上也能复现，但在次队列仅达0.514。

Conclusion: 交叉验证的构建方式（段级vs受试者级）对结果的影响远超表征方法、架构或融合策略的选择。未明确说明折叠构建方式的研究结果无法解读。在输入表征层面，montage CWT_ST是区分应答者与非应答者的关键，输入构造比网络设计更值得探索。未来需在更大的独立队列上验证该结果。

Abstract: Depression is a mental condition that can lead to suicide and self-harm. Predicting the outcome of depression treatment is one of the most difficult tasks for clinicians. Among various treatment options, repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (rTMS) is a widely used non-invasive method. Predicting rTMS response using Electroencephalogram (EEG) data is difficult because of high inter-subject variability and limited features from single-domain analysis. We introduce two fusion techniques, montage and blending, to overcome these limitations and extract richer features from EEG-derived Time-Frequency (TF) images. We then propose a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) trained on fused TF representations. \textcolor{black}{We use a primary dataset of 15 patients and a secondary dataset of 46 patients. We run two sets of experiments. The first set uses segment-level 10-fold cross-validation. In this setup segments from the same patient can appear in both training and testing. The Montage CWT\_ST fusion reaches 99.90\% accuracy on the primary dataset and 91.90\% on the secondary dataset. The second set uses strict subject-disjoint cross-validation. All segments of a patient stay in one fold and no patient appears in both training and testing. Performance collapses. We test four time-frequency methods, six fusion mechanisms, and fourteen model architectures. With one exception, every configuration on both cohorts falls between AUC 0.31 and 0.54 and every 95\% confidence interval contains 0.5. A patient-level permutation test on the best standalone method returns $p = 0.703$. The best subject-level result is Montage CWT\_ST on the primary cohort, which reaches AUC $0.874 \pm 0.183$ and 82.7\% accuracy.

</details>


### [423] [OmniMed-Jev: Calibrating LVLM Confidence for Trustworthy Medical Multimodal Decisions via System One](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00381)
*Luyao Tang,Cheng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniMed-Jev，通过将医学决策（诊断、发现、计数）表示为对运行时候选集的显式概率分布（Choice/Noul/Score），而非生成文本，使大型视觉语言模型报告的置信度与正确率对齐，从而显著降低校准误差（最高 126 倍）而保持准确率相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用医学多模态大模型（MLLM）将诊断、发现、计数等有界决策序列化为生成文本，导致模型报告的"概率"实为下一标记的概率而非决策本身的概率；现有文献反复测量出模型系统性过度自信，校准在专科间不一致，弃权策略行为不可预测，因为所消耗的置信度从未是决策的真实概率。

Method: 基于 MedGemma-1.5-4B 医学骨干，设计三类决策接口：Choice（互斥类，如鉴别诊断）、Noul（二元存在，如放射学发现）、Score（有序有界值，如细胞计数或射血分数）。候选集作为输入语义而非固定输出头，通过统一候选条件评分机制产生归一化概率；同一状态可在一次前向传播中并行产生多个决策，训练采用单一交叉熵目标，所有三种决策类型共享。基线为相同骨干、数据、调度下训练的生成式 SFT 模型，其概率通过对候选延续的 token 对数似然进行 softmax 归一化重构（Eq. 5）。两模型训练相同 23,558 个状态（OmniMed-Jev 分解为 155,729 个决策目标），在 726 个保留状态上比较。

Result: 在分类、多标签、计数、回归四类任务上的接口控制对比显示：OmniMed-Jev 的报告概率显著追踪观察正确率，ECE 从 0.26/0.30/0.42/0.13 降至 0.08/0.01/0.04/0.09（降幅 3×–26×）；多标签可靠性误差从 0.1294 降至 0.0010（126×），AURC 从 0.2474 降至 0.0126（20×）；四类任务全部位于 Murphy 分解的"分辨率 > 可靠性"绿色区，而生成基线在三类中跨越至可靠性主导的锈色区。点预测性能相当（分类、多标签、回归差异配对检验下不包含零，McNemar p=1.00, 0.64）；计数 MAE 是唯一显著差异（+0.37，95% CI [+0.0952, +0.6429]），利于生成基线，原因是 Score 网格上期望折叠使极端值向中心收缩。DDx@0.9 在所有族中缩小；候选空间可在运行时操纵（排列、短列限制、移除金标准），无需额外评分机制。

Conclusion: 将决策分布作为模型的输出对象不是格式变化，而是使医学模型报告的数字成为"名副其实的概率"：使异质医学决策（类、发现、网格值）表达为可比较的同类型概率，支持下游决策规则可审计消费。实验支持显式决策建模作为在评估任务范围内使报告置信度有意义的途径；然而该比较无法分离接口与伴随的更密集监督及额外决策头，因此不构成临床就绪声明。

Abstract: Medical models are judged not only on correctness, but on whether reported confidence matches actual accuracy. Generalist multimodal medical models have expanded what a single model can perceive, yet they still express bounded decisions such as diagnoses, findings or cell counts as generated text, so the reported probability reflects the next token rather than the decision itself. Motivated by decision-native interfaces such as Jev, we introduce OmniMed-Jev, which represents each medical decision as a Choice, Noul or Score decision over a runtime-supplied candidate set and returns a full distribution over that set: mutually exclusive classes, binary presence of a finding, or a bounded ordered value. The design is omni in three respects: it accepts diverse imaging modalities, covers different prediction tasks, and expresses them through one candidate-conditioned probability model, so heterogeneous outputs become comparable probabilities rather than task-specific strings. In an interface-controlled comparison against a generative baseline trained on the same backbone, data and schedule, OmniMed-Jev's reported probabilities track observed correctness far more closely, reducing calibration error by up to an order of magnitude and reliability error by up to two, while point-prediction performance remains comparable; counting is the one family where the generative baseline stays ahead. Making the decision distribution the model's output is not a format change but what turns reported numbers into probabilities that mean what they say. These results support explicit decision modeling as a way to make reported confidence meaningful within the evaluated tasks, and they are not evidence of clinical readiness: the comparison cannot separate the interface from associated training differences, which we state alongside the results. Code is available at this http URL .

</details>


### [424] [EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00383)
*Jiabin Luo,Yinan Liu,Chunlei Meng,Yufei Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoGen-Harness 框架，通过 Trace 机制在冻结的 T2I 生成器外部，对五种 harness 职责（Policy、Tools、Skills、Middleware、Memory）进行多职责协同演化，利用轨迹相对归因指导搜索、渐进式重归因协调跨职责更新，并以 No-Patch 与保留集验证防止有害修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 T2I 系统的外部适配方法通常只优化单一预设维度（提示、路由或工作流），限制了生成失败可被修正的空间；允许多个生成器外部职责共同演化虽能扩大适配空间，但视觉反馈仅揭示"哪里错了"，却无法指出"应在何处持续演化"以及"如何高效探索"这一新挑战。

Method: 定义五项持久化职责 $\mathcal{H}_t=(\Pi_t,\mathcal{T}_t,\mathcal{S}_t,\mathcal{W}_t,\mathcal{M}_t)$；在 $K$ 次随机执行下聚合约束级轨迹证据 $\mathcal{E}_t$；使用固定 LLM 作为 Harness Localizer 输出六类（含 No-Patch）的归因分数 $s_{\text{loc}}$，保留 Top-$r$ 前沿；LLM 按职责条件化提议候选编辑 $\Delta_z$；在匹配随机条件 $\omega_k$ 下计算相对改进 $\Delta Q_\ell(\delta)$，结合保留惩罚 $R_{\text{pres}}$ 与执行成本 $C$ 形成效用 $U_\ell(\delta)$ 选取最优编辑；每次接受更新后对残余失败再归因，演化路径 $\bm{\pi}$ 可跨越多个职责；通过 No-Patch 决策与保留/保留外验证（$\epsilon=0.01$）防止不必要或有害更新。

Result: 在 GenEval2（Soft-TIFA GM 0.7089）、T2I-CompBench++（平均 0.6807）、WISE（WiScore 0.6780）上分别以 +0.2633、+0.0720、+0.0752 超过最强基线；归因召回率 87.9–91.4%，No-Patch 准确率 94.8%，回归率仅 1.9%；在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image、Janus-Pro 三个冻结骨干上均稳定提升；消融显示轨迹聚合、归因引导、匹配评估、渐进重定位、No-Patch 与安全验证缺一不可；提议 LLM 在 Qwen3.5-27B/GPT-4.1/GPT-5.5 间结果稳健；复合职责故障下 Both Recovered 88.9%、Repair Success 83.5%。

Conclusion: 归因引导的多职责 harness 演化能够在不修改生成器参数的前提下，显著且稳健地提升冻结 T2I 系统性能；轨迹相对证据 + Top-$r$ 归因前沿 + 匹配评估 + 渐进重定位 + 回归安全验证共同构成可泛化、可解释且低回归的演化机制，为自改进图像生成系统提供了切实路径。

Abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems can be improved without modifying generator parameters by adapting the external system around frozen generators. However, existing approaches typically optimize a predefined dimension, such as prompts, routing, or workflows, restricting the space in which generation failures can be corrected. Allowing multiple generator-external responsibilities to evolve provides a broader adaptation space, but introduces a new challenge: visual feedback reveals what failed, but not where persistent evolution should occur or how this space should be explored efficiently. We introduce EvoGen-Harness, a generator-agnostic framework for multi-responsibility image-generation harness evolution, together with Trace (Trajectory-Relative Attribution and Coordinated Evolution). Trace aggregates evidence across stochastic executions, uses failure attribution as a search prior to focus candidate updates, and progressively re-attributes residual failures to coordinate evolution across responsibilities, while No-Patch and held-out validation prevent unnecessary or harmful updates. Across GenEval2, T2I-CompBench++, and WISE, EvoGen-Harness improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by +0.2633, +0.0720, and +0.0752, respectively, while achieving 87.9-91.4% attribution recall, 94.8% No-Patch accuracy, and only 1.9% regression. These results demonstrate that attribution-guided multi-responsibility evolution can substantially enhance frozen T2I systems beyond single-dimension adaptation.

</details>


### [425] [Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00394)
*Shanbin Yu,Shaoyang Guo,Haoran Zhao,Danni Yu,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种称为"分叉"(forking)的泛化失败现象：当带有过度编码n-gram记忆分支的模型在数据回放训练时，训练损失与验证损失在epoch边界处急剧分离，曲线形状类似叉子。该现象最初在NanoGPT自动研究中发现，作者在受控的NanoGPT环境和DeepSeek风格的Engram模型中复现并分析了其机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型智能体被广泛用于自动化架构和训练策略搜索，这些搜索可能产生未预期的副作用。本文旨在揭示并分析由自动研究智能体提出的过度编码n-gram记忆技巧与数据回放结合时产生的一种新型泛化失败现象——"分叉"，警告研究者对自动研究产物的结果保持谨慎。

Method: 1. 使用OPHIS方法定位分叉现象到n-gram记忆通路；2. 在最小化NanoGPT设置(8层、6头、hidden=768、词表8192)中复现并控制实验；3. 采用因果干预(低频检索掩码、表冻结、哈希重置、骨架冻结)验证机制；4. 在DeepSeek风格12层模型(含MLA-lite、MoE、mHC、Engram)中验证可复现性；5. 在持续训练(SFT)和静态RLVR-like代理场景中测试分叉效应；6. 通过频率依赖分析、上下文遮蔽实验和覆盖率模型(Good-Turing估计、条件尾部分析)定量分析机制。

Result: 1. 过度编码(n-gram记忆)放大了数据回放时训练损失与验证损失的分歧，分歧以阶梯状在epoch边界处增长；2. 低频上下文贡献了大部分分歧，分歧与上下文频率近似服从幂律关系(bigram指数≈0.25，trigram≈0.47)；3. n-gram表为不同上下文创建弱交互的独立子空间，使回放驱动每上下文独立锐化训练中见过的延续而抑制未见过的延续(排挤效应)；4. 表格冻结后骨架仍可继续拟合并产生分叉，证实上下文特定表示的影响；5. 在小预算SFT和静态RLVR-like回放场景中同样观察到分叉；6. 低频掩码(F≤8可移除72%净分歧)和哈希重置可有效缓解分叉。

Conclusion: 分叉是深度学习中继grokking和双下降之后又一新奇的泛化失败现象，是自动研究智能体提议的技巧带来的意外副作用。其机制是n-gram表的固定路由将优化分割为弱交互的上下文子空间，回放在每个子空间内独立锐化训练中观察到的延续而抑制未见的替代选项。低频上下文贡献最大，大语料和单遍训练可抑制它，但在SFT和RL等小预算重放场景中尤其有害。未来工作应在生产规模模型中定位分叉的下游性能危害并开发缓解方法(如低频掩码或基于BPE聚合限制过度编码词表)。

Abstract: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. We also observe forking in short-budget, heavily repeated SFT and RL-like regimes. The contributions of this paper are twofold: (1) Forking reveals yet another curious phenomenon in deep learning, in addition to grokking and double descent. (2) Forking is an unexpected and unpleasant by-product of tricks proposed by autoresearch agents. While these agents produce an enormous number of results that seem useful, we should always be careful with their results.

</details>


### [426] [Specificity-Aware Diffusion Steering via Variance-Reduced Sequential Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00395)
*Luran Wang,Linrui Ma,Hannes Stärk,Regina Barzilay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种特异性感知（specificity-aware）的扩散模型推理时引导框架，通过重叠目标设计（overlap-based target design）和方差最小化的序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样器，在保留期望分布的同时抑制不期望分布。核心贡献包括：(1) 基于似然比门控的显式目标分布推导；(2) 局部方差最小化的双场SMC提案设计；(3) 固定噪声优化过程。在合成任务、CIFAR-10、文生图以及pMHC结合物设计等任务上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的扩散模型推理时引导方法（如分类器引导、无分类器引导、负提示引导等）通常定义隐式目标分布，当期望分布与不期望分布存在重叠时，排斥性引导会抑制有效模式并导致模式偏移（mode shift）。需要一个原则性的框架来在保留期望分布的同时选择性抑制不期望分布，最小化对正分布的扭曲。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 目标分布设计——通过重叠目标函数J(q) = OVL(q, p^A) - γ·OVL(q, p^B)推导最优目标，保留期望密度在期望-不期望比值超过阈值γ的区域，并使用Bernoulli熵正则化得到软松弛版本；(2) 局部SMC提案设计——引入双场前向提案b^(ρ₁,ρ₂)和匹配的后向漂移a^⋆，通过高斯权重代理推导对数权重的渐近展开（命题2），包含α（标量系数）和Γ（曲率项，含Jd和dd^T两部分）；(3) 固定位移JVP近似——通过固定ρ₁重用ρ₂=0的位移，所有候选点只需一次参考模型的分数JVP计算。优化目标为最小化累积权重相对方差（等价于最大化nESS）。

Result: 在四个任务上验证：(1) 40分量高斯混合合成任务——视觉上最接近真实目标分布，减少了DNG的模式偏移问题；(2) CIFAR-10类别移除和多类选择——在FID-Wrong%、Recall-Wrong%等Pareto前沿上取得最佳权衡；(3) Stable Diffusion v1.4文生图——在DNG 5提示套件上，整体margin为0.1666（次优DAS为0.1611），相关负提示下margin比DriftLite提升6.6%；(4) pMHC结合物设计——相对于最强的BoltzGen基线，平均margin提升3.9%、中位数提升14.8%、Q75提升16.6%。还展示了权重方差优化的消融结果。

Conclusion: 本文提出的特异性感知扩散引导框架在理论上具有分布原则性，无需重训练基础模型，通过似然比门控和方差最小化SMC采样器有效解决了期望与不期望分布重叠时的模式偏移问题。实验证明该方法在多种任务上优于负引导基线。局限性包括：仅适用于随机SDE推理、确定性求解器扩展待研究；引入了额外的超参数和计算开销；pMHC设计评估基于预测iPTM而非实验验证。

Abstract: Inference-time steering enables pretrained diffusion models to satisfy new constraints without full retraining. However, specificity-aware generation is difficult: repelling samples from a negative reference distribution can also erode the positive distribution where the two overlap. The key challenge is to suppress negative mass while minimally distorting the positive distribution. We address this problem by formulating specificity-aware steering as a target-design problem and deriving a target distribution from an overlap-based objective. The resulting target keeps the desired reference distribution only in regions where it is sufficiently preferred over the undesired reference distribution, giving a likelihood-ratio interpretation of specificity. To sample from the corresponding time-dependent target path, we develop a Sequential Monte Carlo sampler with a variance-minimized local proposal. We further introduce a practical fixed-noise optimization procedure with the Jacobian--vector products with the desired and undesired score fields. Experiments on synthetic task, class-contrastive generation, text-to-image tasks and peptide-MHC (p-MHC) binder show that the proposed method suppresses undesired regions more effectively, reduces mode shift, and improves sampling stability by decreasing the SMC weight collapse compared with negative-guidance baselines. Code is available at: this https URL

</details>


### [427] [NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00397)
*Ali Alavi,Donald S. Williamson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroToken模型，通过条件流匹配（AttuneFlow）头和推理时集成策略（QuadTrack与Env-Flow），将方向AAD、源AAD和包络重建三项任务统一在单一网络中，在5秒窗口内显著提升跨被试听觉注意解码（AAD）的精度和方差表现，并在严格试验分割协议下揭示了现有方向AAD基准的虚高问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AAD研究存在三个断裂：(1) 判别式方向AAD仅分类左右侧，无法映射到具体声源；(2) 基于回归的源AAD依赖单次Pearson相关系数，在1-5秒短窗口中因标准误过大而失效；(3) 包络重建缺乏原生AAD决策规则。作者认为根本问题在于现有方法使用单统计量而非条件似然比 p(e|EEG) 作为判别准则。

Method: NeuroToken采用双前端的EEG编码器（多尺度时-空CNN + 0.5-9Hz带通扩张卷积）配合三个头：(1) 闭式CSP+带功率空间头做方向分类；(2) 扩张CNN+线性mTRF的包络重建头；(3) AttuneFlow条件流匹配头，以整流流公式学习速度场，通过Monte Carlo速度残差积分输出似然比评分。推理时引入QuadTrack（四种互补相似度：Pearson、Spearman、滞后互相关、δ-θ相干）以及z归一化的Env-Flow集成。训练分两阶段：Stage1训练前端和包络头（6个损失项），Stage2冻结前者仅微调流匹配头（3个损失项，权重比0.3:0.5:10）。

Result: 在KU Leuven（16人）、DTU（18人）、NJU（21人）三个公开数据集的5秒窗口上：AttuneFlow-Flow单段源AAD较最强非生成基线QuadTrack-Multi提升9-16pp（KU: 76.1→86.4%，DTU: 74.4→83.6%，NJU: 70.1→86.0%），跨被试标准差缩减约3倍（±2.6/3.3/5.1 vs ±9.5/9.2/14.1pp）；试验级融合在KU和NJU超过93%（KU达99.1%，NJU达93.9%）。复制实验表明，在严格试验分割协议下，主流方向AAD模型报告的95-97%精度实际下降17-45pp，证明现有基准存在数据泄漏。

Conclusion: 本文证明用条件似然比替代单一统计量是解决短窗口AAD噪声限制的正确框架。流匹配评分通过在流时间和噪声维度上的边缘化平均掉单次实现的方差，提供了Neyman-Pearson最优检验的Monte Carlo近似。架构和损失设计选择都基于经验诊断（如每被试Pearson差距仅约0.008的信息论上限）。但跨被试短窗AAD在DTU和NJU上仍存在结构性天花板（约51-60%），需要未来工作引入基础模型规模预训练或主体不变表示才能突破。

Abstract: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.

</details>


### [428] [WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00398)
*Felix Oury,Harley Day,Karina Mayoral,Ville-Pekka Seppä,Sejal Saglani,Reiko J. Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WIPSNet，一种基于3D ResNet和连续小波变换(CWT)尺度图的深度学习模型，用于从整夜阻抗呼吸描记(IP)信号中检测儿童夜间喘息。在15名患儿(60夜，281小时)的数据集上，AUC达到0.783±0.026，显著优于临床标量指标EVI(0.633)及多种现代基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童哮喘急性发作与学龄前喘息密切相关，但夜间症状难以在家中识别。现有商用Ventica系统仅将整夜IP信号压缩为单一标量EVI，缺乏个体级诊断效用。现有深度学习方法面临整夜IP信号超长(~10⁷采样)、不规则、含运动伪迹等挑战。亟需充分利用IP波形全部信息的新方法。

Method: WIPSNet流程：(1)对IP信号高通滤波(0.2 Hz Butterworth)去除基线漂移；(2)以4分钟为窗口分割(60,000样本)；(3)对每个窗口做Z-score归一化后用复Morlet小波做CWT，生成224×224尺度图；(4)将D=8个连续尺度图堆叠成3D体(对应32分钟时序上下文)；(5)用Bottleneck3D ResNet([2,2,2,2]层)处理，输出喘息logit；(6)逐段预测经均值池化得到整夜预测。使用Optuna做50次超参搜索。基线包括EVI、Mamba、AttnSleep、SleePyCo、catch22+XGBoost、手工特征+XGBoost。评估采用患者级留一交叉验证(LOOCV, 15折)，跨5个随机种子。

Result: 主要结果：WIPSNet AUC=0.783±0.026，AUPRC=0.634±0.047；优于AttnSleep(0.764)、catch22(0.704)、Mamba(0.689)、EVI(0.633)、SleePyCo(0.577)和Mamba-Scalogram(0.569)。体深度D=8(32分钟)时性能最优，短窗口(4-16分钟)性能平坦(约0.74)，超过32分钟则下降。Mamba在不同上下文窗口下表现非单调且不稳定(0.61-0.69)，其差距并非源自上下文不足。小波散射(STFT)替代CWT则性能大幅下降(0.670/0.578)。推理速度约0.34秒/夜(NVIDIA RTX 4070)。

Conclusion: 结构化时频表示(CWT尺度图)结合3D卷积架构，是建模超长、不规则、振荡性生理时间序列的有效方法。显式的双时间尺度设计(单尺度图内捕捉呼吸级频谱，堆叠后追踪数十分钟级演化)优于固定状态SSM对高频原始波形的压缩方式。WIPSNet相对EVI的大幅提升(+0.15 AUC)有望成为临床决策支持工具，但仍需在更大、更多样化的人群中进行外部验证。

Abstract: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

</details>


### [429] [Metacognitive Reasoning in Energy Based Models using Instance Based Learning Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00399)
*Tailia Malloy,Prateek Kumar Rajput,Serge Lionel Nikiema,Cleotilde Gonzalez,Tegawendé F. Bissyandé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MERITED框架，将基于实例的学习理论(IBLT)与能量基Transformer(EBT)相结合，使AI系统具备类人式判断能力——在推理时根据不确定性动态分配计算资源。作者训练了一个191M参数的EBT模型，并在ARC-Easy和OpenBookQA两个问答任务上验证了两种IBL策略(深度选择和最优停止)优于静态深度设置及GPT-2基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在输出前无法估计自身不确定性，且不能动态分配计算资源，难以实现类人式判断过程。EBT虽然能建模不确定性和动态分配资源，但缺乏决定计算分配策略的机制。需要一种认知启发的方法来填补这一空白。

Method: 核心方法为MERITED框架：(1) EBT部分利用Transformer骨干网络参数化能量函数，通过MCMC采样迭代优化候选输出，能量越低表示输出越合理；(2) IBL部分基于Instance-Based Learning Theory构建认知模型，将能量分布和嵌入作为状态特征，通过softmax选择概率公式决定MCMC步数/步长或最优停止时机。提出两种集成策略：一次性选择推理深度(Step Selection)和在线最优停止(Optimal Stopping)。

Result: 在ARC-Easy和OpenBookQA两个QA任务上：MERITED深度选择准确率51.8%，最优停止52.2%，均优于最佳静态深度(48.2%)和GPT-2(44.0%)。ARC-Easy上两种MERITED策略均达58%，超过GPT-2的42%(p=0.012)。最优停止策略比深度选择快64.9%，比深度10快76.1%，仅损失0.5个百分点的平均准确率。GPT-2-CogRouter在两个任务上的表现均弱于MERITED策略。

Conclusion: MERITED框架成功展示了认知模型可通过提供自适应判断控制机制来改善AI系统的运行。这是一种不同于以往将AI用于增强认知模型的研究方向——使用认知模型来提升AI系统的自适应能力。局限性在于EBT参数量(191M)远小于当前大型LLM，且未涉及思维链等高阶推理策略。未来工作应评估更大规模的EBT、推理型任务以及代理AI、逻辑数学推理等更复杂领域。

Abstract: Metacognition involves reasoning about cognitive processes themselves. An example is in resource allocation where we choose how much time and effort to put into a reasoning task before we begin based on our confidence. Current Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) cannot estimate their uncertainty about an output without first responding, and cannot dynamically allocate resources to producing an output, making this type of metacognitive process difficult. A recently proposed alternative to classic transformer architectures that addresses these two concerns is the Energy Based Model (EBM) which allows for interpretable uncertainty modeling and dynamic allocation of compute resources. While EBMs can allow for control of these two processes, the actual metacognitive task of determining compute allocation based on uncertainty is not directly addressed. Instance-Based Learning Theory (IBLT) provides an approach to modeling human-like decisions from experience that has previously been applied to predicting human metacognitive reasoning. In this paper we introduce a framework for MEtacognitive Reasoning with Instance-based Learning Theory and Energy Dynamics (MERITED). Grounded in IBLT, this framework allows for control of the computational effort allocated in an EBM to allow for metacognitive control over reasoning effort based on uncertainty while remaining computationally efficient. This work has two main contributions, the training and open weight sharing of a 191M parameter reasoning EBM, and an implementation of the MERITED framework for dynamic compute allocation using an IBL model.

</details>


### [430] [The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Learning Higher-Order Interactions in Shallow MLPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00403)
*Gongyue Zhang,Honghai Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究单隐层MLP在拟合训练样本与恢复生成规则之间的分离现象，通过控制交互阶数和干扰输入的合成任务，系统比较SGD、Adam/AdamW、Muon等优化器在不同条件下的规则泛化能力，揭示干扰权重学习、隐藏层偏置和优化器选择对高阶规则学习的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络可以拟合训练样本但未必能恢复生成标签的规则——这一"记忆"与"逻辑"的分离在固定模型容量下受优化器动力学制约。当标签依赖于多个因子的高阶组合时，网络必须发展对联合交互的敏感性，同时避免对无关输入的样本特异性拟合。论文以单层MLP为最小可控场景，探究在哪些条件下成功的拟合能转化为可复用的规则。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 构建纯k阶奇偶性任务，控制交互阶数并保持总信号能量一致，建立贝叶斯最优精度上限；(2) 命题1证明纯奇偶性任务不含任何低阶预测边际信息；(3) 命题2给出在干净潜在输入上用宽度k的rank-1权重单隐层ReLU网络精确表示奇偶函数的构造；(4) 命题3证明无偏置单隐层ReLU网络在k≥3奇阶奇偶性上存在结构性障碍；(5) 混合阶序八类任务（4+18+9+9+8+8+8+60+3000维输入）对独立高斯噪声块的训练时冻结vs测试时消融进行因果干预；(6) 比较SGD、Adam/AdamW、Muon（含Newton–Schulz正交化）在阶数2–4、噪声干预、偏置消融、紧凑阶5–20四个实验序列上的峰值测试精度；(7) 使用统一种子42、8192训练/测试样本、batch size 128、单64单元ReLU隐层架构。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 阶数2–4匹配扫描中，三种优化器在阶2均达到100%峰值测试精度；阶3时SGD达96.25%，Muon达76.82%，Adam仅50.87%；阶4时Muon达99.21%，SGD达95.14%，Adam仍仅51.25%——呈现非单调的优化器排序。(2) 混合任务中冻结独立噪声块的首层权重使AdamW的epoch-10总体准确率从44.73%提升至95.07%，而仅在测试时消融噪声仅提升至48.38%——训练时干扰权重的可塑性而非测试时噪声本身是损害规则获取的关键。(3) 偏置实验中，隐藏层偏置的可学习性使SGD阶3准确率从53.02%提升至97.17%，Muon从51.16%提升至79.71%；阶4时偏置移除影响很小——验证了命题3关于奇阶目标的偏置依赖性。(4) 紧凑32输入信号域下，SGD和Muon均能学习阶5–8（精度>97%），阶9–11时SGD（92.42/82.75/66.05）优于Muon（86.29/75.57/52.76），阶12起两者均降至约51%而贝叶斯上限约99.48%——揭示了该架构在训练预算内的高阶学习极限。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个具体结论：(1) 在受控设置下，独立噪声权重的可学习性对规则泛化的损害远超测试时噪声暴露本身——证实优化历史而非即时预测效应起关键作用；(2) 隐藏层偏置的可获取性通过ReLU对称性区分奇偶阶目标，存在结构性而非纯量级的奇阶目标学习限制；(4) 在固定隐层宽度下优化器选择决定学习到的高阶函数。论文强调：纯奇偶目标不提供低阶预测捷径，rank-1干净构造表明权重矩阵秩与逻辑阶数必须区分；权重秩、谱分离或隐式学习的下阶规则序列并非已观察到函数的必要解释机制。范围限于单种子、有限学习率网格和测试选峰值，结果描述了观察到的函数与受控参数干预而非最优调优比较。

Abstract: A network can fit its training examples while failing to recover the rule that generated their labels. We examine this separation in single-hidden-layer multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), using synthetic tasks that control interaction order and the presence of nuisance inputs. We establish elementary benchmark properties: pure parity contains no predictive lower-order marginals, admits an exact Bayes posterior, and can be represented on clean latent inputs by a width-$k$ ReLU network. Experiments then identify distinct optimization outcomes. In a matched order-2--4 sweep, SGD, Adam, and Muon all reach 100\% peak test accuracy at order two; at order three they reach 96.25\%, 50.87\%, and 76.82\%, respectively, while Muon reaches 99.21\% at order four. In a separate mixed-order task, freezing only the first-layer weights connected to independent nuisance inputs raises AdamW's epoch-10 accuracy from 44.73\% to 95.07\%. Removing the same inputs only at test time raises it to 48.38\%. Thus, nuisance-weight learning changes the training outcome beyond its immediate effect on prediction. Bias interventions expose a connection between target symmetry and shallow ReLU representations. In a compact signal-only regime, both SGD and Muon learn orders five through eight, with higher SGD peak accuracy at orders nine through eleven. Together, the results show how optimization and nuisance learning constrain the higher-order rules realized by a shallow network.

</details>


### [431] [RACE: Residual-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Neighbor-Rich Time-Series Foundation Model Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00405)
*Hao-Nan Shi,Tong Wu,Chen-Cong Sun,Yuan Jiang,Han-Jia Ye,De-Chuan Zhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RACE 提出了一种基于残差感知的测试时适配方法，通过两阶段框架（残差证据构建 + 效用感知校正门控）利用同领域历史邻居改进冻结时序基础模型的预测，无需修改骨干模型参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序基础模型（TSFM）在逐序列推理时未能利用部署领域中已完成的相邻历史序列（如 CGM 轨迹和 Web/云工作负载），而这些历史残差中蕴含可重用的局部错误模式。现有方法要么对每个目标域微调 TSFM（成本高、跨骨干迁移性差），要么盲目拼接检索序列而不验证其残差是否支持当前预测。

Method: RACE 是一个两阶段框架：(1) 残差证据构建——使用联合上下文-预测描述符检索 K=60 个查询兼容邻居，通过 MAD 标准化对齐残差尺度，经均值中心化一致性过滤后聚合为无训练的共识均值提议（RACE-TF）；(2) 效用感知校正门控——基于 XGBoost 的轻量级门控器利用 30 维推理可见特征判断是否应用校正，训练流程可跨 TSFM 骨干复用。

Result: 在四个 TSFM（Chronos-2、Chronos-Bolt Base、TimesFM-2.5、Toto-2.0-313m）和两个领域（CGM、Web/cloud）上，所有领域聚合指标均获改善；在高误差查询上提升最大。跨骨干门控迁移实验中，全部 72 个跨骨干指标对比均优于匹配冻结目标；在 34 个 GIFT-Eval 子集的更广泛诊断中 11/12 骨干-指标聚合得到改善。

Conclusion: RACE 通过聚合兼容的同领域历史残差并通过轻量级效用门控选择性应用校正，在保持 TSFM 骨干冻结的前提下实现了跨骨干一致的领域级预测增益，确立了历史模型错误作为可重用测试时证据的范式。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) perform strongly across forecasting tasks, but their per-series inference is ill-suited to neighbor-rich forecasting, where each query has access to related but nonidentical historical series. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) and Web/cloud workloads exemplify this setting: CGM trajectories share physiological patterns but vary across individuals, devices, and conditions, while Web/cloud workloads combine common operating regimes with non-stationarity, heavy tails, and bursts. These histories share useful structure, yet neighbors are not equally relevant. Existing methods either fine-tune TSFMs for each target domain, incurring additional costs and offering limited transferability across backbones, or append retrieved series without verifying whether they support the current forecast. The key challenges are conflicting residual evidence from neighboring series and residual patterns that vary across TSFMs and forecasting tasks. We formulate test-time neighborhood scaling: using same-domain neighbor evidence without modifying the backbone. We propose RACE (Residual-Aware Correction of Forecasting Errors), a two-stage framework for using historical neighbors. We first retrieve query-compatible neighbors, align their residuals to the query scale, and aggregate coherent evidence into the training-free RACE-TF correction. Full RACE then uses a lightweight, domain-specific Gate to determine when applying the correction is beneficial, with a reusable training workflow across TSFM backbones. Across four TSFMs, RACE improves all three domain-aggregate metrics on both primary domains, with the largest gains on high-error queries. Within each domain, a Gate trained on one TSFM transfers to other backbones without adaptation, and the resulting pipeline improves all 72 cross-backbone metric comparisons over the matched frozen targets.

</details>


### [432] [VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00411)
*Jeremy Levy,Ariel Larey,Yury Nahshan,Raizy Kellerman,Elay Dahan,Amit Bleiweiss,Guy Leib,Omri Nayshool,Dan Ofer,Tal Zinger,Dan Dominissini,Gideon Rechavi,Marissa Wirth,Simon Lee,Dung Hoang,Noam D. Beckmann,Shane O'Connell,Nicole Bussola,Alexander W. Charney,Yoli Shavit,Nati Daniel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VANDAM是一个将DNA分子先验整合到基因组基础模型(GFM)训练中的框架，通过局部特征注入(LFI)和区域属性预测(RPP)两种机制，将DNA视为分子而非仅作为符号序列，在四个架构家族和九个基因组任务上一致提升下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型沿用NLP的DNA-as-a-string范式，采用掩码token预测目标进行预训练，但该抽象未明确建模对生物功能至关重要的生化、结构和物理特性。然而，许多分子特性可由序列通过既定生物物理模型估算，其价值不在于提供独立模态，而在于引入训练目标可显式利用的先验。

Method: 1. **局部特征注入(LFI)**：将14个序列衍生的分子描述符（来自DNAshapeR的13个结构特征加小沟静电势）通过均值池化对齐到token，线性编码后与token嵌入拼接并投影回骨干输入维度；仅在多任务训练(VANDAM-MT)中使用，因任务梯度可奖励其使用。2. **区域属性预测(RPP)**：将序列划分为非重叠tile，对骨干隐藏状态做注意力池化，通过轻量线性头预测6个tile级序列衍生属性（固有曲率、AT含量、熔解倾向、G-四链体倾向、十字结构倾向、Z-DNA倾向），在自监督预训练(VANDAM-PT)和多任务训练(VANDAM-MT)中均使用。3. 训练目标为原生token损失加线性warmup的RPP损失。

Result: 在四个架构家族（NTv3-8M卷积-Transformer混合、Caduceus-PS双向Mamba、DNABERT-2-117M扁平Transformer、HyenaDNA-small-32k Hyena算子）和九个留出任务上，VANDAM在预训练36个对比中29个点估计提升（25个统计显著），多任务36个对比中33个提升（23个显著）。消融实验表明RPP比MFM（局部特征重建）和随机/算法控制更优，生物学控制证明增益来源于生物学内容而非额外容量。qDNA探针实验表明RPP对6/8个未见的电子和光物理描述符提高了线性可及性（残差化后仍保持），证明分子先验使用可泛化到未见属性。

Conclusion: VANDAM将基因组基础模型训练重新定位为"DNA既是序列也是分子"。通过对区域分子属性的直接监督（自监督预训练阶段）以及在功能标签可奖励使用时注入局部分子描述符（多任务训练阶段），提供了目标适配的途径将表征锚定于序列衍生的生物物理性质。在多样化架构、分词方案和token身份目标下，这些干预改善了下游基因组表征；RPP还增强了对留出分子描述符的访问。分子先验可帮助基因组基础模型捕获DNA的序列依赖物理性质。

Abstract: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

</details>


### [433] [EchoPress: Query-Agnostic KV Cache Pruning via Virtual Context Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00412)
*Jiawei Lin,Saibo Geng,Thomas Bourgeat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EchoPress 提出了一种无需训练的查询无关（query-agnostic）KV cache 剪枝方法，通过复用 prefill 阶段已计算的 queries 和 keys 来近似 KVzip 的重建式重要性评分，并仅对第一个 chunk 进行精确重建以校准其余 chunk 的虚拟评分。该方法在长上下文场景下以显著更低的开销实现了与 KVzip 相当甚至更优的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV cache 随序列长度线性增长，带来显著的内存开销。现有方法面临权衡：prefill-based 方法开销低但精度有限；重建式方法（如 KVzip）精度高但需要额外的完整前向传播（overhead 是普通 prefill 的 2.1–2.2 倍）；基于学习的方法需要针对特定模型训练。因此需要一个训练免费、精度接近重建式方法、开销显著降低的查询无关压缩方案。

Method: EchoPress 分析了 KVzip 重建评分与 prefill 状态之间的三个差异：(1) 键的可见范围（重建时每个 query 可看到整个 chunk 的 key，prefill 时是因果遮蔽）；(2) RoPE 位置偏移（重建 query 被移到 context 之后的位置）；(3) 上下文条件（重建 query 由完整上下文条件化，prefill query 仅由因果前缀条件化）。基于此分析，EchoPress 提出虚拟上下文重建（virtual context reconstruction）：复用 prefill 的 queries/keys，通过共享旋转矩阵 R_Δ 校正 RoPE 位置偏移，并加入因果虚拟副本（causal virtual copy）分支。该方法将 attention 评分分为两个分支：(a) 旋转后的 query 对完整 cached chunk 做 softmax（利用 full visibility）；(b) 旋转后的 query 对因果虚拟副本做 softmax。由于共享旋转，第二个分支可直接复用 QK^T 不需要重新计算。随后，仅对第一个 chunk 运行一次精确重建（KVzip 方式），并基于首个 chunk 的精确评分和虚拟评分构建逐层、逐 KV head 的分位数映射（quantile map），将后续虚拟评分映射到精确评分的尺度上。复杂度从 O(LHdn²) 降至 O(LHdnC)，其中 C 为 chunk 大小。评分使用融合的 Triton kernel 实现。

Result: 在 LongBench（12 个任务）和 RULER（4K/32K/64K）上，使用 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 进行评估：精度方面：在 50%–75% 驱逐率下，EchoPress 与 KVzip 差距在 0.9 分以内；在 90% 驱逐率下，EchoPress 在所有四个模型-基准组合上均优于 KVzip。RULER-32K/64K 上，两者差距在 2.8 分以内。延迟方面：在 A100 GPU 上，4K–128K context 下压缩开销降低 1.7×–19.6×；128K context 下总 prefill 时间减少约 2.9×（Qwen: 112.16s → 38.16s；Llama: 98.26s → 34.02s）。消融实验显示：RoPE 位置校正贡献最大（Spearman 相关性从 0.208/0.237 提升至 0.678/0.740）；full visibility 和 causal copy 分支进一步改善。校准方式对比中，逐层、逐 KV head 的 virtual→exact 分位数映射优于全局映射和反向映射，在 90% 驱逐率下 RULER-4K 上达到 87.6% 平均精度（KVzip 为 87.5%）。

Conclusion: EchoPress 是一种训练免费的查询无关 KV cache 压缩方法。它通过分析重建评分与 prefill 状态之间的差异，复用 prefill 阶段的信息近似 KVzip 的重建评分，并通过单次精确首块重建进行逐请求校准。实验证明该方法在保持与重建式方法相当精度的同时，大幅降低了压缩开销，将长上下文 LLM 推理的预填充时间压缩了 2–3 倍。

Abstract: KV cache pruning reduces long-context inference memory usage by evicting less important key-value pairs. KVzip estimates importance through context reconstruction: prompting a model to repeat the context chunk by chunk. This achieves strong compression quality at the cost of additional forward passes. Learned approximations reduce this cost but require model-specific training. We analyze how KVzip identifies important cached information and show how to approximate its reconstruction scores using information already computed during prefill. These findings motivate EchoPress, a training-free method that approximates reconstruction attention using queries and keys from standard prefill. For each request, it reconstructs only the first chunk to calibrate importance scores for the remaining context. Experiments on LongBench and RULER with Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct show that EchoPress matches KVzip in task accuracy across eviction ratios from 50% to 90%, while reducing compression overhead by a factor of 1.7-19.6 and total prefill time by a factor of up to 2.9. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [434] [Do Better Scores Mean Better Physics? Physics-Grounded Explanations for Sim2Real Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00415)
*Somyajit Chakraborty,Xizhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对NACA4418翼型Sim2Real神经算子预报，提出物理学诊断协议，揭示基准分数低不代表物理量预报准确。通过平均保持输入干预和输出衰减压力测试，表明四个算子（FNO/CNO/Transolver/混合参考）对高能区波动的移除更敏感，且CNO在速度场误差更低时波动能误差反而更高，二者出现指标排名反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习代理虽加速物理仿真，但预测误差低未必代表物理相关流场统计量（如波动能）误差低。在Sim2Real迁移中，模型仅靠聚合分数可能被误导，亟需补充物理诊断。

Method: 使用NeurIPS 2026 RealPDE竞赛的配对CFD/PIV数据。设计两类干预：(1) 均值保持输入干预——在高能、随机、低能等面积掩膜区域内用局部时均值替换速度波动，量化预报响应对比 $A_H - A_R$；(2) 输出衰减压力测试——对预测施加diag(0.975,0.935)增益，保留时均值但缩小波动幅度。对四个神经算子（参考/FNO/CNO/Transolver）计算Rel-L2场误差、相对波动能误差 $e_{TKE}$、MVPE、能量比 $R_E$、空间TKE相关及top-decile MSE，并使用5000次轨迹自助法估计置信区间。

Result: 1) 高能区移除在四个模型上均产生显著大于随机移除的响应（轨迹级23/23为正），但等面积不等能量，无法区分物理重要性与扰动量级；2) CNO在两个子集上场误差更低（ΔRel-L2≈−0.019）但TKE误差显著更高（ΔTKE≈+0.12），18/23轨迹出现排名反转，FNO场优势稳健但TKE差不显著；3) 衰减虽降低 $e_{Rel-L2}$ 与 $e_{TKE}$，却使 $R_E$ 从0.815恶化至0.756，top-decile MSE上升约3.9%，空间TKE相关几乎不变——基准分数与区域能量赤字排名不一致。

Conclusion: 单一基准分数无法全面刻画Sim2Real预报的物理保真度；应在聚合预测分数之外报告互补的物理诊断（如波动能误差、能量比、空间相关、top-decile误差）。本文结果仅证明干预敏感性与指标分歧，并未确立反事实物理正确性；更强结论需等能量对照、平滑掩膜、求解器验证的干预及轨迹独立评估。

Abstract: Machine-learning surrogates accelerate physical simulation, but lower prediction error need not coincide with lower error in physically relevant flow statistics. We examine this question for flow around a NACA4418 airfoil using paired computational-fluid-dynamics simulations and experimental particle-image-velocimetry measurements. A mean-preserving input intervention removes velocity fluctuations from selected regions of observed flow histories. Across four neural operators, removing fluctuations from the most energetic 10% of valid observed cells changes forecasts more than equal-area random removal. Because the masks are not matched for removed fluctuation energy, this contrast measures sensitivity, not independent evidence of physical importance. Separately, a CNO has lower velocity-field error but substantially higher two-component fluctuation-energy error than the reference on both analysis subsets. An output attenuation stress test also demonstrates disagreement between benchmark errors and domain-summed fluctuation energy. These single-benchmark results motivate reporting complementary physical diagnostics alongside aggregate prediction scores; they do not establish counterfactual physical correctness.

</details>


### [435] [Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00417)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在合成数据递归训练中，源识别（provenance）能否作为筛选有用训练样本的依据。作者在金融风险文本上测试了生成器归属（generator attribution）在改写后的鲁棒性，并对比了基于源检测器的选择规则与基于参考模型困惑度的选择规则在三轮回代训练中的效果。结论是：源识别与训练效用是两个独立问题，两种选择规则选出不同数据但未检测到稳定的递归性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反复在模型生成数据上训练会导致模型退化（model collapse）。源信息（provenance）被视为控制生成数据再利用可能性的手段，但源识别能否可靠恢复、以及是否真正有助于筛选更好的训练数据，尚未被严格区分和验证。论文的核心动机是将"数据来源识别"与"训练样本质量筛选"这两个常被混淆的问题解耦验证。

Method: 方法分两部分：(1) 源识别实验——在金融风险文本上，用七个语言模型生成文本并与人类语料对比，分别训练生成-人类二分类器、七分类生成器归属器（含/不含改写样本），并测试 roundtrip 翻译、跨家族复述、风格迁移、通用规避四种改写下的鲁棒性；用 split conformal prediction 实现弃答；用留出源模型测试未知源识别。(2) 递归训练实验——以 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 为起点，每轮生成 160 条候选，用四种规则（源检测器置信度、参考模型困惑度、随机、固定抽取）各保留 80 条进行微调，循环三轮（G0–G3）；在冻结的人类语料上计算困惑度斜率作为主要结局指标，用精确双侧置换检验比较源规则与困惑度规则的均值斜率差异。

Result: 源识别结果：原始文本上 98.7% 的生成器归属准确率；改写后分别降至 96.7%（roundtrip）、53.1%（复述）、29.0%（风格迁移）、46.9%（通用规避）；Transformer 分类器在风格迁移后仅 9.4%。生成-人类二分类 AUROC 在所有改写下均 >0.9999（仅限该人类基线）。未训练源模型 AUROC 范围 0.770–0.993。风格迁移下弃答机制失效，错单标签率达 0.408。递归训练结果：困惑度规则均值斜率 7.543，源规则 7.367，差 +0.176，置换检验 p=0.746，95% 置信区间 [−0.794, +1.267]；两规则选中样本重叠仅约 36/80，显著低于随机预期 40，表明选择不同但未产生可检测的递归性能分离。功效分析显示该设计仅在真实差异约 1.48 点/代时达 80% 功效。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个分离的结论：(1) 源识别中的生成-人类检测、生成器归属、未知源识别是不同任务，生成器归属在改写下显著退化；(2) 改写族内鲁棒性不代表新类型变换的鲁棒性，风格迁移下弃答机制仍给出大量错误单标签；(3) 递归训练中，基于源信息的规则与基于参考困惑度的规则选出实质不同的样本，但未检测到下游退化的稳定差异——这既不证明两规则等价，也不证明源信息更优。核心论断是：识别数据来源与识别哪些数据对训练有用是两个独立问题，"面对准则的信号"（criterion-facing signal）并不等于"对递归结果充分的信号"，需要建立递归信息接口（recursive information interface）的理论框架。

Abstract: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

</details>


### [436] [CommunityKV: Efficient Long-Context Decoding via Graph Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00418)
*Joe McKenna,Anastasios Alexandridis,Nathan Susanj,Jing Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CommunityKV是一个无需训练的稀疏注意力框架，通过将稀疏注意力建模为令牌图上的社区检测问题来实现高效的长上下文解码。利用预填充阶段已计算的QK^T分数构建令牌图，使用Leiden算法进行社区划分，并通过常数时间的局部更新规则支持流式解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer处理长上下文时面临自注意力二次方计算成本和KV缓存线性增长的瓶颈。现有的无训练方法存在两难：要么使用语义粗糙的启发式方法导致准确率下降，要么依赖难以在解码过程中高效更新的昂贵聚类方法。

Method: 1) 图构建：从预填充阶段的QK^T矩阵构建结合直接注意力边和共注意力边的稀疏令牌图（E=O(n)）；2) 初始划分：使用Leiden算法按模块度最大化进行社区检测，计算社区质心（O(n log n + nd)）；3) 增量更新：新生成的令牌通过查询与质心评分检索候选集合，在常数时间O(d)内通过贪心模块度增益分配到社区，无需全局重划分。支持查询组聚合以减少辅助内存。

Result: 在Qwen3（4B/8B/14B）和Llama-3.1-8B模型上的LongBench v2、BABILong和RULER基准测试中：每查询头配置实现1.08-1.25×端到端吞吐量加速（峰值内存增加17-29%）；查询组聚合实现1.39-1.71×加速（峰值内存仅增加0.5-8.5%），准确率与密集注意力相当。例如Qwen3-14B在LongBench v2上4096预算达到32.0%，完全匹配密集基线。

Conclusion: CommunityKV通过将稀疏注意力重新表述为社区检测问题，实现了亚线性检索成本O(√n·d)和常数时间增量更新O(d)，同时保持接近密集注意力的准确率。这证明了语义结构应引导动态检索而非永久上下文删除，为无训练稀疏注意力提供了一个有竞争力的方案。

Abstract: Scaling Transformers to long contexts is constrained by the quadratic cost of self-attention and the linear growth of key-value cache memory transfer. Sparse attention mitigates this by retrieving only relevant tokens, but current approaches either require large-scale training or, within the training-free regime, rely on semantically coarse heuristics or expensive clustering that is difficult to update efficiently during decoding. We introduce CommunityKV, a framework that formulates sparse attention as a community detection problem. CommunityKV constructs a token graph from the $QK^T$ scores already computed during standard prefill, and partitions the graph into communities to enable retrieval of semantically coherent token groups. A local update rule assigns newly generated tokens to communities in constant time, enabling sparse retrieval throughout streaming decoding without global re-partitioning. We evaluate CommunityKV on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models across three long-context benchmarks. With one graph per query head, CommunityKV delivers up to $1.25\times$ the end-to-end generation throughput of dense attention, while query-group graph aggregation yields up to $1.71\times$ with comparable accuracy.

</details>


### [437] [IrekoGPT: Turning Structured Pruning into Post-Hoc Slimmable LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00426)
*Pietro Moriello,Pietro Buzzega,Angelo Porrello,Simone Calderara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IrekoGPT提出了一种将预训练大语言模型转换为"可瘦身"（slimmable）模型的后处理方法。该方法基于SliceGPT，保留完整的PCA投影矩阵而非直接剪枝，使单一模型可在推理时动态选择宽度，暴露不同宽度的嵌套子网络。通过多压缩比扩展校准数据集（ECD）提升鲁棒性，并利用无梯度岭回归修正下游线性层（如值投影WV）。在Llama和Qwen模型上的实验表明，该方法在高压缩比下相对朴素PCA瘦身有显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结构化剪枝方法（如SliceGPT）需要为每个目标压缩比维护独立的模型，存储成本和运行时开销较高。而传统的可瘦身网络（slimmable networks）通常需要从零开始训练，与当前依赖预训练基础模型的范式相冲突。因此需要一种能够将预训练模型后处理转换为可瘦身模型的技术，以适应动态变化的资源约束场景。

Method: 1. **核心观察**：SliceGPT的PCA投影矩阵列按特征值降序排列，截取前d列形成嵌套结构，因此保留完整投影矩阵即可支持动态宽度选择。2. **扩展校准数据集（ECD）**：在每层校准时，并非仅在全宽度下计算PCA，而是维护K+1个并行激活流，对应压缩比集合R={r1,...,rK}加上全宽度（r=1），将所有流的激活拼接后联合计算PCA，使投影基能捕捉不同宽度下的分布偏移。3. **基于岭回归的权重修正**：针对输出维度保持不变的线性层（如自注意力中的值投影WV），通过闭式最小二乘求解一个正则化残差ΔW，使压缩流下的输出逼近全宽度模型的输出，目标函数为各压缩比输入对应的MSE损失加λ||ΔW||²正则项。

Result: 在Llama-2-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-1B和Qwen3-1.7B四个模型上，以WikiText-2困惑度为评测指标，对比PCA-only、ECD、IrekoGPT及非可瘦身的SliceGPT。实验在25%、35%（训练集外压缩比）和10%、20%、30%压缩比下进行。结果显示：PCA-only与SliceGPT接近；ECD进一步缩小差距；IrekoGPT在高压缩比下提升最明显，多个场景下匹配甚至超过SliceGPT。25%与35%压缩比未包含在校准集中，证明了对未见宽度的泛化能力。逐层MSE和CKA分析进一步表明，IrekoGPT显著降低了压缩与全宽度激活之间的表示误差，差距随稀疏度上升而扩大。Qwen3-1.7B是例外，ECD单独使用更优。
