Result: 1. 理论贡献：完整刻画了所有有效仿射增强规则，扩展了现有MILP增强方法；2. 在D-MIPLIB和MILP-Evolve数据集上的实验表明ReMILP在二进制解嵌入、约束活跃度和嵌入预测等任务上优于随机编码器和FORGE基线；3. 冻结编码器在MILP任务上展现良好迁移能力，提供有用的微调初始化。

Conclusion: 本文证明了已知重构行为可有效塑造潜在空间，使自监督预训练的MILP表示在多个下游任务中受益。等变自监督是MILP表示学习的一个有前景的方向。

Abstract: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.

</details>


### [464] [Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00751)
*Sakin Kirti,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络中信号-噪声因子化（SNF）和信号-信号因子化（SSF）两种表示几何性质，设计了显式的正则化方法。研究发现，增强SNF可提升模型性能并改善分布外鲁棒性，而SSF无明显收益；SNF通过将噪声变化驱逐到可识别、可分离的子空间实现性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多停留在对训练后表示结构的描述性诊断，缺乏对几何性质与性能之间因果关系的操纵性验证。此外，L₂正则化虽能同时改善多种几何性质，但其各机制的独立贡献尚不清楚。本文旨在通过显式正则化针对性地塑造表示几何，建立几何性质与下游任务性能之间的因果联系，并探索在分布外（含图像失真）场景下提升鲁棒性的机制。

Method: 基于Wakhloo等（2026）理论，将泛化误差下界分解为与SSF（f）和SNF（s）相关的项。SSF正则化器惩罚类间协方差偏离缩放单位矩阵；SNF正则化器惩罚信号子空间内的Schur补方差（即去除类别预测成分后的残余方差）。实验平台包括CIFAR-100标准基准和受MedMNIST-C损坏的生物医学BloodMNIST细胞分类任务，模型为ResNet-18，正则化作用于倒数第二层。机制分析包括：计算扰动矩阵Δ=Z_corrupted-Z_clean的截断SVD、对比扰动方差在信号子空间内外分布、以及通过投影噪声子空间在独立验证集上估计并投影出噪声方向来恢复精度。

Result: 在CIFAR-100上，SNF正则化小幅提升精度并改善对未见增强强度的迁移能力，SSF无明显收益。在MedMNIST-C损坏的BloodMNIST上，L₂+SNF在所有损坏严重度上都显著优于L₂基线和L₂+SSF（如defocus模糊下提升达5.7%），平均提升3.1%（相对5.35%）。机制分析表明：SNF模型将83.7%的损坏诱发方差驱逐至信号子空间正交补中，而L₂和L₂+SSF分别仅39.1%/42.2%位于子空间外；在独立验证集上估计的噪声子空间投影可在k=10时将测试精度从60.9%提升至69.3%（约13.8%相对提升）。

Conclusion: SNF正则化通过将噪声变异从信号子空间驱逐到可分离、可移除的子空间，显著提升分布外鲁棒性，尤其在医学影像中具有跨站点泛化的实用价值。SSF正则化未带来显著效益，表明隔离干扰变量比维持类别表征的正交性更重要。研究将正则化-可解释性文献与显式机制正则化相结合，揭示了L₂正则化通过多种独立机制发挥作用，并提供了针对OOD鲁棒性的明确几何目标。

Abstract: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

</details>


### [465] [Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00758)
*Allen Tran,Jia Wan,Nathan Kallus,Aurélien Bibaut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LowRank，一种基于源环境锚定logits低秩假设的多任务逆强化学习方法。该方法通过共享k个基函数池化多个任务（不同奖励函数）的数据，在最大熵IRL框架下同时实现：1）放宽单任务覆盖要求；2）将新环境下多任务评估的计算成本从按任务数N降至按基函数数k；3）提供有限样本下的奖励恢复与目标策略学习理论保证。实验在FourRooms、Highway和RecSim三个领域验证了该方法在有限覆盖、离支持奖励恢复、目标环境迁移和计算可扩展性方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单任务IRL受限于演示数据对状态空间的覆盖不足，尤其在最大熵框架中存在温度与覆盖的权衡。当存在多个异质任务时，独立处理每个任务继承单任务的覆盖问题。挑战在于：如何在不要求每个任务覆盖全部状态的前提下，利用多任务间的结构相关性实现奖励恢复，并使多任务在目标环境中的评估计算成本随任务数增长而可控。

Method: 方法核心是低秩结构假设：将N个任务的源策略logit矩阵Θ∈ℝ^{N×SA}分解为Θ=WΦ，其中W∈ℝ^{N×k}为任务特定系数，Φ∈ℝ^{k×SA}为k个共享基函数。具体流程为：1）通过带核范数正则化的联合softmax最大似然估计拟合共享锚定logits矩阵；2）利用奖励恢复算子L_μ（其与log策略呈仿射关系）从拟合的log策略恢复每个任务的奖励；3）关键的计算加速来自于只需对k个基函数而非N个任务分别求解FQI（拟合Q迭代），然后通过线性组合得到所有任务的奖励。为理论分析引入了一个"汇聚覆盖条件"c₀(d,Θ*)>0，允许某些任务-状态块完全未被观测，只要其他任务跨越了潜在方向。

Result: 理论结果：定理1（在核范数正则化估计器下）给出对数似然估计误差的有限样本界ε_n，分解为三种效应：覆盖系数c₀的倒数、目标访问通过L_μᵀρ₂的放大、以及主导统计项√(kν log/N)。同步得到目标价值估计误差、目标遗憾和占用加权KL策略误差的界。实验结果：1）因果覆盖干预验证了方向性覆盖机制（删除特定方向观测会增加该方向的离支持误差）；2）在所有数据预算和三个领域上，LowRank均实现最高的离支持奖励相关性（如RecSim n=500时0.776 vs per-task GenPQR 0.196）；3）在RecSim的目标扰动迁移中，LowRank的归一化回报随离支持占比基本保持平坦（斜率+2.6%/0.1，95%CI [-3.2, 8.3]），而IQ-Learn和GenPQR分别下降17.1和17.6点；4）计算时间以N^{0.21}的亚线性规模增长，在N=128时比per-task GenPQR快4-13倍。

Conclusion: 本文将多任务IRL从N个独立估计问题转化为一个共享估计问题，在低秩假设下打破了传统单任务覆盖要求的限制。理论贡献包括有限样本保证和一种新的方向性覆盖条件，实验验证了池化在跨任务覆盖、目标环境迁移和计算可扩展性方面的优势。未来方向包括将有限样本保证从表格MDP扩展到函数近似、刻画秩k近似的对数配分残差误差，以及放松共享奖励归一化假设。当前局限在于理论分析限制于已知源转移核的表格MDP，且实验环境为合成数据。

Abstract: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

</details>


### [466] [Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00771)
*Yimiao Yu,Florentin Guth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过受控的记忆化实验，系统研究并定位了随机输入-输出映射间的迁移学习机制，发现了"等价迁移"与"非等价迁移"两种反直觉现象，并将迁移效应分解为幅度驱动和结构驱动两部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习中预训练任务如何促进下游任务加速收敛的机制尚不清晰。传统解释（如"可复用特征"或"数据低阶统计"）假设上下游任务共享结构，但这一假设是否必要、迁移效应能否被精确定位于网络权重中，尚待解答。

Method: 1. 在CIFAR-10上构建受控的记忆化任务（随机标签/随机像素），以训练准确率S型曲线的拐点t₀作为有效训练时间的定量度量；2. 设计三种预训练任务（相同图像、共享分布、随机像素）对比迁移效率；3. 通过权重消融实验分别保留BN参数、FC权重或卷积权重；4. 通过Frobenius范数缩放实验区分幅度与结构效应；5. 对卷积权重做SVD分解，分别保留U或(S, V)（即协方差C），并结合Guth等人[2024]的层间对齐程序进行验证。

Result: 1. 发现"等价迁移"：共享分布下每个预训练epoch可节省约一个下游epoch（斜率≈-1）；2. 发现"非等价迁移"：在随机像素上预训练在一定epoch范围内比直接训练下游任务更高效；3. 重采样实验表明标签一致性（而非数据一致性）是迁移的必要条件；4. 权重消融与缩放实验表明FC权重的迁移完全可由其幅度增长解释（"平凡"效应），而卷积权重的迁移无法由幅度解释（"非平凡"结构效应）；5. SVD实验表明部分卷积迁移效应可归因于权重协方差结构C，但仅保留协方差会随预训练时间饱和，提示仍存在更精细的定位方式。

Conclusion: 迁移可在没有共享特征或共同数据分布的任务间发生，挑战了"协方差对齐解释"必须共享数据分布的假设；迁移效应可分解为最后一层的幅度驱动部分与卷积层中的结构驱动部分，后者部分编码于权重协方差中。这些发现为设计更简洁高效的预训练策略提供了原则性指导。

Abstract: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

</details>


### [467] [Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00778)
*Daisuke Yamada,Travis Pence,Vikas Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReQRL方法，通过有限时间可达性约束准度量critic的梯度，结合状态约束Hamilton-Jacobi理论将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦，在OGBench上实现优越的离线GCRL性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有准度量学习方法（如QRL和EikHiQRL）的局部约束存在局限：QRL仅在稀疏采样转换上施加约束，无法传递其他可行运动的cost信息；EikHiQRL使用各向同性动力学模型，无法反映方向依赖的控制组合效应和领域可行性。这些约束未能充分捕捉有限时间范围内控制组合产生的运动方向（如Lie括号效应），也未明确编码边界可行性。

Method: 1. **有限时间Hamiltonian约束**：通过对critic进行一阶线性化，推导出有限时间Hamiltonian $H_\tau(s, \nabla_s d_\theta) = \frac{1}{\tau}\sup_{\delta \in \mathcal{R}_\tau(s)}\langle -\nabla_s d_\theta, \delta\rangle - 1 = 0$，保留控制组合产生的可达方向信息。
2. **解耦策略**：借鉴状态约束Hamilton-Jacobi理论，将可达性分解为：
   - **内部动力学可达性**：通过仿射动力学模型和zonotope误差包络估计 $\hat{\mathcal{R}}_k^{\text{dyn}}(s)$，具有闭式支撑函数 $\langle -\nabla_{x_s}d_\theta, c_s\rangle + \|G_k^\top \nabla_{x_s}d_\theta\|_1 = 1$。
   - **边界可行性**：通过栅格化离线观测和形态学闭运算估计边界法向 $\hat{\nu}(x_s)$，施加 $\hat{\nu}(x_s)^\top \nabla_{x_s}d_\theta \geq 0$。
3. **整体目标**：最大化距离同时施加软约束的内部Hamiltonian惩罚和边界正则化。
4. **策略训练**：使用k步hindsight waypoint的AWR训练，horizon $k$ 通过比较控制生成项与漂移项的比率 $\chi_\tau$ 选择。

Result: 在OGBench的pointmaze、antmaze、humanoidmaze以及carmaze环境中，ReQRL在绝大多数任务上优于QRL和EikHiQRL，并达到或超越当前最先进的GCRL方法（OTA、GAS）。具体地：
- humanoid-large-stitch上达到89%（QRL仅3%，EikHiQRL 63%）；
- antmaze-giant上比EikHiQRL在navigate和stitch上分别提升21和26个百分点；
- collision rate低于QRL和EikHiQRL，与OTA、GAS相当；
- 在非完整约束的carmaze上所有设置均最优。

Conclusion: ReQRL通过有限时间Hamiltonian框架成功将控制组合效应融入准度量critic的局部监督，并通过解耦动力学可达性与边界几何提供互补的训练信号。该方法在理论上具有值近似的误差界保证（定理B.4），实践上在多种离线GCRL任务上展现出卓越性能和安全性。局限性在于仿射动力学模型可能无法完全捕捉非线性效应，且当前仅适用于确定性系统和离线设置。

Abstract: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

</details>


### [468] [Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00818)
*Ayesha Tanveer,Khandakar Ahmed,Assefa Teshome,Oyetunde Gbadeyan,Ziad Nehme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这是一项针对澳大利亚维多利亚州2020年1月至2024年3月间约285万次救护车出诊的回顾性探索性数据分析（EDA），通过将救护车服务时间分解为五个操作阶段、进行Pareto集中度分析、小时交叉相关分析、医院到达并发性分析和按优先级分层的运营比较，系统量化了救护车ramping（从医院到达患者交接之间的延迟）的规模、趋势和运营关联。核心发现包括：累计损失救护车时间（AHL）达149万小时（约每天96个10小时班次），前10家医院承担了57.8%的AHL但仅接收50.9%的病例，年AHL在2022年峰值上升57%而同期ED运输量下降3.7%，表明恶化源于每个案例交接时间的增加而非需求增长，且ramping时长在每小时内均随前一小时到达医院的救护车数量单调上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ambulance ramping作为急诊医疗服务（EMS）系统的关键运营瓶颈，其系统级规模和动态特征在大规模数据上尚未得到充分表征。现有研究多将其作为描述性初步步骤而非主要分析框架，且缺乏对延误在整个EMS工作流中如何分布以及是否随患者病情严重程度系统变化的理解。鉴于该现象与医院拥堵、救护车可用性和响应时间的关联日益紧密，亟需在州级规模上量化其分布、时间演变和运营驱动因素，以确立"医院状态感知路由"（hospital-state aware ambulance routing）的经验前提。

Method: 采用回顾性队列研究设计，基于维多利亚大学和Ambulance Victoria的伦理批准，分析2020年1月至2024年3月间共2,850,575次救护车出诊记录，经数据清洗后形成2,026,569次ED运输的分析队列（涵盖59家具备急诊科的医院和79个地方政府区域）。将总救护车服务时间分解为五个操作阶段（Call to dispatch、Dispatch to scene、On-scene、Transport、Ramping、Clearance），通过中位数和第90百分位数按Dispatch Code（Priority 0、Code 1-3）和Transport Priority（1-4）进行分层分析。采用Pareto集中度分析评估AHL在医院间的分布，计算小时级时间序列的交叉相关函数分析需求波动的滞后效应，并构建"前一小时到达并发数"（Hospital Arrival Concurrency）这一衍生运营特征变量，通过按小时和并发分箱同时分层的热图分析区分时间效应和并发效应的独立贡献。所有分析使用Python 3.11、DuckDB 1.1、pandas 2.1、matplotlib 3.8和Seaborn 0.13实现。

Result: 研究发现：第一，全系统ramping导致累计1,491,127小时救护车时间损失，相当于研究窗口期内每天约96个10小时救护车班次的损失；第二，AHL在医院间高度集中——59家医院中前10家承担了57.8%的AHL但仅接收50.9%的运输病例，且大都会墨尔本承担76.7%的AHL负担；第三，年AHL从2020年的255,523小时上升到2022年峰值的401,981小时（增长57.3%），同期ED运输量从479,203下降到461,418（下降3.7%），平均每例ramping从32.0分钟增至52.3分钟（增长63%），表明恶化源于单例交接时间延长而非需求增长；第四，ramping时长与患者病情严重程度关联有限，仅Priority 1（最高紧急度）获得适度加速，而Priority 4呈现最长的尾部延迟（第90百分位达116.2分钟）；第五，小时级需求与2-4小时后ramping呈中等正相关（r=0.365），ramping峰值滞后到达峰值约7小时、滞后需求峰值约8小时；第六，在控制小时因素后，ramping时长随前一小时到达同一医院的救护车数量单调上升（并发数为0时中位数23.6分钟，10+时升至45.2分钟，第90百分位从66.1升至127.5分钟），且该效应在所有医院和每个小时均持续存在。

Conclusion: 救护车ramping在表面上稳定的系统中实际上呈现出集中化、时间可预测且状态依赖的特征。AHL的负担高度集中在前25-30家医院（尤其是大都会墨尔本），年度恶化并非由运输需求增长驱动，而是由救护车-急诊科接口的恶化所致。ramping与患者病情严重程度关联有限（仅最高紧急度获得适度保护），而与接收医院前一小时的到达并发量呈持续的单调正相关，独立于小时效应。这些发现——ramping的集中性、时间可预测性和状态依赖性——构成了预测建模和医院状态感知救护车路由策略的经验前提，但当前研究为观察性和探索性设计，所报告的关联不能直接推断因果干预效果。研究存在若干局限：仅基于救护车侧数据无法解析医院端机制、缺乏大流行前基线、单一司法管辖区的发现可能无法推广。

Abstract: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

</details>


### [469] [AnyJev Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00831)
*Jiamu Zhang,Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Evan Chen,Zixiang Nie,Kelly Wan,Liangjie Hong,Ninghao Liu,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AnyJev 是一种无需梯度更新或参数修改的方法，可从预训练指令微调语言模型的单次预填充中读取"类型化决策"（在固定选项集合上的概率分布）。它通过标签先验校正和选项列表的循环旋转平均来消除标签偏差和位置偏差，显著降低了顺序翻转率，并在 vLLM 上实现 2.2 倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统需要类型化决策时通常依赖专门训练的决策模型。该论文认为该能力已内嵌于预训练指令微调模型中，问题出在读取方式而非模型本身。直接读取下一个 token 分布会引入两类缺陷：（1）无论输入如何，模型对某些标签赋予更高概率（标签偏差）；（2）对选项列表中某些位置赋予更高概率（位置偏差），导致决策结果对选项排列顺序敏感。在 20 选项任务上，反转选项列表会使 33% 的样本答案发生改变。

Method: AnyJev 构建单一提示，运行一次预填充，从答案位置读取下一个 token 分布并限制为选项标签 token。两个无梯度修正：(1) 标签先验校正——用未标注输入上模型输出的运行均值作为估计的标签先验 q̂，以 p_dbs ∝ p̃/q̂^α 形式修正，α=0.75；(2) 位置偏差消除——对 K 个循环旋转（每个选项遍历每个位置）在对数空间平均 z̄_i = (1/K)Σ log q_t(i)，再经 softmax 得到 p_L0。该方法在加性偏差模型下精确恢复无偏决策。此外，引入基于 log-odds 间距的停止规则，配合 Clopper-Pearson 上置信界，可减少读取旋转次数；使用 van der Corput 序列读取顺序优化收敛。温度参数 T 通过少量标注数据校准置信度。

Result: 在 banking20 和 newsgroups 两个 20 选项任务上，旋转平均使 11 个模型全部降低顺序翻转率（banking20: 0.328→0.138；newsgroups: 0.334→0.183），并提升准确率（11/11 模型，p=4.9×10⁻⁴）。二元 injection 任务上翻转率从 0.180 降至 0.000。在 JevBench 公共子集（平均 3.6 选项）上，去偏对准确率无可测量影响（+0.006，95% CI [-0.004, +0.018]），但温度使 7/8 模型降低 ECE。在完整 BEV Decision Mix 测试分割（46,320 决策）上，Qwen3.5-9B 旋转平均达 68.01%（vs. 原始 67.85%），ECE 0.0490；最优带标签先验配置反而降至 65.01%。服务方面，在 18 选项问题上停止规则读取 7.3/18 旋转，vLLM 上达 37.2 决策/秒（全旋转为 16.7），2.22 倍加速。验证实验证实：在 4 个单元中 2 个达到 ≤0.008 的经验边界，读取 10.6/18 旋转。

Conclusion: AnyJev 表明，类型化决策能力存在于基础模型中，只需修正读取方式（标签先验校正 + 旋转平均），无需任何参数更新。该方法显著降低位置依赖性，在多选项任务上效果尤为突出。停止规则结合 vLLM 提供高达 2.22 倍的实际吞吐量增益。AnyJev 在 4 个单元中 2 个通过严格验证达到 1% 错误率目标；其余受选择-验证分割样本量限制。作为开源技术报告，AnyJev 在完整 BEV Decision Mix 上落后专用系统 Bespoke-Nimble-9B 约 2.56 个百分点，但 ECE 更低；先验强度 α 的优势因任务而异。代码已开源。

Abstract: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

</details>


### [470] [TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00835)
*Jiawei Yu,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TrueMuse，这是首个面向文本到音乐（text-to-music）数据归因（data attribution）的受控基准数据集与评测平台，旨在解决现有音乐生成模型数据归因方法缺乏可靠真值（ground truth）而无法严格评估的问题。TrueMuse通过DreamBooth式微调三个扩散式文本到音乐模型（AudioLDM2、Mustango、Stable Audio Open），构建了四种归因场景（旋律、乐器、艺术家风格、流派），共涵盖133个属性、648个微调模型、95,456个生成样本。研究在四种音乐编码器与对比学习mapper增强方法下，从四个维度系统评估了黑盒归因方法，结果表明现有方法在不同设置下波动显著，揭示了音乐数据归因任务仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型依赖于大规模音乐数据集训练，其商业价值本质上来源于对原创艺术家作品的学习，由此产生了如何按训练样本贡献度公平分配版税的问题。然而由于单个生成作品同时受多个训练样本的复杂影响，精确量化各样本贡献仍是根本性挑战。现有白盒方法（如影响函数、机器反学习）依赖参数估计但难以验证其准确性，而黑盒方法（如基于相似度的检索）因训练样本间纠缠难以隔离个体贡献。同时，尽管图像生成领域已建立归因基准，文本到音乐领域仍缺乏具有可靠真值的受控基准，无法支持系统化的归因方法评估与未来研究。

Method: TrueMuse采用受DreamBooth启发的微调框架：对预训练扩散式音乐模型，使用稀有标识符"sks"绑定目标音乐属性（如"sks melody"、"sks instrument"），对精心策划的属性样本集进行微调，使模型生成结果与已知源集对应。四种属性集分别为旋律中心（50个旋律，1片段/属性）、乐器中心（25种乐器，3或6片段）、艺术家中心（50位艺术家，3或6片段）、流派中心（8种流派，3或6片段）。评估阶段将归因形式化为检索任务：以生成样本为查询，在含已知真值片段及22.8万JamendoMaxCaps干扰片段的库中检索，使用Recall@k（主要为R@10）评测。基线方法采用冻结的四种音乐编码器（MERT-v0、MERT-v0-public、Music2Vec-v1、DAC-16k）的余弦相似度检索；增强方法在冻结编码器上添加由对称NT-Xent对比损失与Frobenius正则化训练的mapper组，分别用于映射真值片段与生成样本。此外从四个维度评测：微调改进（mapper vs 原始embedding）、提示类型难度（语境型 vs 风格型）、多任务训练（单任务 vs 四任务联合）、微调数据规模（3片段 vs 6片段）。

Result: 在R@10指标下，MERT-v0-public表现最佳（0.397），其后依次为MERT-v0（0.357）、Music2Vec-v1（0.226）、DAC-16k（0.129），表明音乐专用自监督目标显著优于编解码器重建目标。三个生成器中，Stable Audio Open最易归因（R@10=0.487），Mustango次之（0.205），AudioLDM2最难（0.140），这与其受限提示格式或记忆倾向有关。四种属性集中乐器中心最易（R@10=0.465），其后为艺术家（0.305）、旋律（0.04）、流派（0.101），抽象程度越高归因越难。Mapper在MERT编码器上有提升（MERT-v0: 0.357→0.400；MERT-v0-public: 0.397→0.441），且Mustango上提升最大（+0.084），Stable Audio Open上几乎无提升，因其嵌入空间接近饱和。风格提示优于语境提示（MERT-v0-public: 0.478 vs 0.400），旋律中心对提示类型最敏感（0.178→0.365）。单任务与联合任务训练差异极小（平均变化仅0.003），表明各任务占据嵌入空间中相对正交区域。增加微调片段数从3到6导致R@10从0.309降至0.210，各条件下均下降，反映更多片段扩展了候选源集使单个片段更难以检索。

Conclusion: TrueMuse是首个面向文本到音乐数据归因的受控基准，提供了已知微调源集作为可靠真值。系统化评估表明现有黑盒归因方法在不同编码器、生成器、属性类型、提示类型及数据规模下表现波动显著，整体归因任务仍具挑战性。研究揭示了几个核心规律：音乐专用自监督编码器显著优于编解码器；属性抽象程度与归因难度正相关；风格提示提供更清晰的训练信号；mapper在线性可校正空间内有增益但存在饱和限制；更多微调片段降低归因性能。TrueMuse作为初始基准聚焦代表性音乐属性与生成场景，旨在推动音乐归因方法向可靠、可解释、适用于真实信用分配的方向发展。

Abstract: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [471] [Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00858)
*Saram Abbas,David Thomas,Naeem Soomro,Rishad Shafik,Rakesh Heer,Kabita Adhikari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在BOXIT试验数据上发现，无约束XGBoost模型学到了与临床知识相反的关联——更高的肿瘤分期和原位癌预测更低的复发概率。作者开发了一种反事实方向测试来检测此类反转，并使用单调约束加以修正，在不损失判别性能的情况下消除了所有违例性变更，并优于EORTC评分体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的临床预测模型普遍仅通过判别度、校准度和SHAP解释来评估，而这些方法无法捕捉模型学习到的特征方向性错误。本研究的动机是揭示并解决这一评估盲区。

Method: 作者利用BOXIT试验中435例患者的数据，构建了反事实方向测试框架（对每个有临床先验方向特征的最差值进行扰动，观察预测风险是否反向）和单调约束修正框架（基于EORTC和EAU风险系统对7个特征施加单调约束），在50折交叉验证下与无约束XGBoost、逻辑回归及EORTC进行比较。

Result: 无约束模型在90.2%的原位癌反事实和74.3%的分期反事实中逆转了风险方向；判别度（AUC差0.005，p=0.47）、校准度和SHAP均未能发现错误，且SHAP方向违规显著（AUC 0.723 vs 0.718）单调约束施加后违规反转归零所有违例（高AUC，消除了AURTC 50/50），胜出于EORTC（p=8.9e-16），并保留了地理可迁移性（脱离站点AUC 0.721 vs 0.627）。

Conclusion: 无约束模型可能学到违背医学知识的关系且无法被检测出来。单调约束能以零性能代价修正方向错误；反事实方向测试是更长效的贡献——应纳入临床模型部署前的常规验证流程。本研究为单中心试验数据，外部验证仍需进一步完成。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($\Delta$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [472] [Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00894)
*Yair Schiff,Omer Belhasin,Roy Uziel,Matan Rusanovsky,Ran Zilberstein,Marianne Arriola,Gilad Turok,Guanghan Wang,Volodymyr Kuleshov,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Clock Diffusion 提出了一种基于位置相关噪声调度的半自回归连续扩散语言模型框架 ClockDLMs，解锁了连续扩散模型的变长生成与 KV 缓存能力，并在 OpenWebText 上取得扩散语言模型的 SoTA 困惑度，在 GSM8K 数学推理上超越连续基线；进一步提出的 Cache Grab 采样器（基于置信阈值与自推测解码）显著加速推理并提升质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的连续扩散语言模型虽然性能已可与离散扩散模型媲美，但仍缺乏变长生成与 KV 缓存支持，且质量落后于自回归与离散扩散模型，限制了其作为实用语言模型的部署。

Method: 方法核心是 Clock Diffusion 框架：使用位置相关（per-position local clock）的噪声调度，将全局扩散时间映射为每个位置的局部时间，从而将序列位置划分为"唤醒"（活跃去噪）与"休眠"（未开始或已完成）两类；据此提出块式（Block）与滑动窗口（Sliding Window）两种 SAR 实例化，设计对应的 KV 缓存采样算法与向量化训练掩码；将滑动窗口版本与高斯噪声作用于 token 嵌入结合，构建 ClockDLMs；进一步提出 Cache Grab-Confidence（基于置信阈值的提前提交）与 Cache Grab-SSD（自推测解码）加速采样器。

Result: 在 OpenWebText 上，ClockDLM (S=4) 的 PPL 为 19.5，相对 BD3LM (S=4, PPL=20.7) 缩小与 AR 基线的差距约 38%，刷新连续扩散 LM 的 SoTA；在 TinyGSM/GSM8K 上，ClockDLM (S=32) 达到 59.6%，配合 Cache Grab-SSD 进一步达到 67.6%，超越 AR 基线 64.3%，远超此前连续扩散基线（RePlaid 44.5%，𝕊-FLM 18.0%）；在 CNN/DailyMail 摘要任务上，ClockDLM (S=32) 以约 8.5× 更少的 NFEs 超越 RePlaid (T=1024)；Cache Grab-Confidence 实现约 3–4× 推理加速且准确率基本无损。

Conclusion: Clock Diffusion 通过位置相关噪声调度统一了变长生成、KV 缓存与连续扩散质量，确立了连续扩散语言模型在困惑度与下游任务上的新标杆；Cache Grab 采样器进一步释放了推理效率潜力，使连续扩散 LM 兼具高质量与高吞吐量；未来工作包括任意顺序滑动窗口、规模化训练以及离散-连续混合参数化探索。

Abstract: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [473] [Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00895)
*Sidney Bender,Benedikt Kunz,Ahmed Zeid,Shinichi Nakajima,Klaus-Robert Müller,Marco Morik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DiDAE（Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders），一种将冻结的视觉基础模型与条件扩散解码器及解耦字典结合的方法，通过在字典方向上做闭式编辑来生成反事实样本，无需梯度计算，速度比现有最优方法快达2000倍，并可用于揭示和修复下游分类器对虚假相关性的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型（尤其是基础模型）容易依赖虚假相关性（Clever Hans策略），而现有的视觉反事实解释方法存在三大缺陷：基于梯度的迭代优化速度慢、产生对抗性噪声而非语义性修改、以及编辑之间相互纠缠。同时，缺乏对基础模型本身的可解释性工具。CFKD（反事实知识蒸馏）方法的效果受限于反事实生成的质量和速度。

Method: DiDAE将冻结的基础模型作为编码器，在其表征空间中使用解耦字典（支持Procrustes有监督对齐、SVD无监督分解、或稀疏自编码器SAE过完备字典），通过沿字典单个原子方向做闭式线性编辑（步长由验证集上的经验范围设定），并利用条件扩散解码器（含DDIM或可编辑DDPM反演）将编辑后的表征解码为像素级反事实图像。其核心组件包括：(1) 冻结的基础模型编码器；(2) 预训练的条件扩散解码器；(3) 解耦字典与分量编码器；(4) 自适应信任域确定编辑步长。此外，还提供"排序模式"——通过对分类器沿字典分量做lasso回归，再用经验反演筛选和实分类器验证，得到该分类器真正依赖的方向排名。

Result: 在6个数据集（Square合成、CelebA-Blond、Camelyon17病理、Sparse Numbers、NICO++、ImageNet）上评估：在Square上47.8 CF/s（梯度方法仅0.02-0.03 CF/s）；在反事实质量的Gain指标上，CelebA-Blond达35.5±2.3（SCE为23.4），Camelyon17达35.0±10.0；在CFKD下游修复中，Square上Gain 80.1（NICO++上16.3），显著优于GroupDRO、DFR、P-/RR-ClArC等元数据基线；排序模式在ImageNet的freight car任务上发现了文献未报道的"铁轨"捷径；总体上与SCE相当或更优，但速度快达2400倍。

Conclusion: DiDAE通过将搜索移入字典基空间，实现了闭式反事实生成，速度提升达三个数量级，使基于反事实的模型修复在CFKD所需规模下变得实用。其排序模式可独立于分类器训练，从已有字典中发现分类器因果依赖的方向。DiDAE的可靠性建立在Gain指标上（基于真实、留出、平衡数据的下游准确率），而非容易被对抗模式欺骗的desiderata指标。其局限在于继承字典和生成器的质量，对多模态数据集（如ImageNet）的最小编辑效果较弱。作者开源了Peal库并发布预训练模型。

Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

</details>


### [474] [When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00898)
*Ada Fang,Nikitha Thoduguli,Lukas Fesser,Hanlin Zhang,Sham M. Kakade,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文质疑"生物推理模型"（结合LLM与生物基础模型表征的模型）是否依赖生物输入做出预测。通过对六个模型进行输入扰动、证据冲突、线性探针和推理轨迹分析，发现Evo2和ESM3表征对BioReason/BioReason-Pro性能贡献很小，这些模型本质上依赖文本注释做预测；而ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2、CellWhisperer则确实利用了生物表征。后训练（SFT/RL）虽提升了准确率，但未增加对生物输入的依赖，且常无法泛化到未见基因组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生物推理模型的基准测试准确率被默认等同于LLM"真正推理"了生物表征（如DNA序列、蛋白质结构、单细胞表达谱）。然而，模型可能仅依赖伴随的基因/通路文本注释就能答对问题，因此需要系统性检验这些模型是否真正使用了其生物输入，而非仅依赖文本捷径。本研究借鉴视觉-语言模型领域的输入敏感性测试方法，将其应用于生物多模态场景。

Method: 提出四类测试：(1) 扰动测试——固定查询和其他输入，扰动单一生物输入后测量预测变化；(2) 证据冲突测试——将来自两个不同基因组/蛋白质的输入配对在同一输入中，看其遵循哪个输入的预测；(4) 提出四类测试——在未扰动输入上构建证据冲突，测量模型偏好哪个证据源；(3) 线性探针测试——当输入贡献小时，训练线性探针检验该表征是否仍编码任务目标信息；(4) 推理轨迹测试——检验生成的推理链是否与生物输入一致。研究涵盖六个模型：BioReason、Evo2；BioReason-Pro、ESM3；ChatNT；Prot2Text-V2；Cell2Sentence-Scale (C2S-Scale) 2B/27B；CellWhisperer，覆盖DNA、蛋白质、单细胞三种模态。还分析了42个BioReason后训练检查点和一个辅助监督实验（让模型预测编辑碱基对）。

Result: (1) Evo2/ESM3对BioReason/BioReason-Pro性能贡献极小：打乱DNA序列后BioReason疾病预测准确率几乎不变（0.847 vs 0.847），模型在97.9%证据冲突中遵循文本；BioReason-Pro在99.7%冲突中遵循GO-GPT文本而非ESM3。(2) 但线性探针证实Evo2/ESM3表征确实编码任务相关信息。(3) 相比之下，ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2、CellWhisperer确实利用了各自的生物表征。(4) SFT和RL提升了BioReason/BioReason-Pro准确率但不增加对生物输入的依赖；该现象在42个BioReason检查点上一致成立。(5) C2S-Scale从2B扩展到27B时，准确率提升同时DEG贡献也增大。(7) BioReason推理轨迹误报核苷酸替换（正确率仅3.6-7.6%）；BioReason-Pro在证据冲突下讨论未在预测中输出的功能；C2S-Scale 27B推理理由过度引用核糖体蛋白基因。(8) 辅助监督让BioReason的编辑碱基预测对序列更敏感，但提升主要来自训练中见过的基因组，未见基因组上准确率仅0.148，疾病预测准确率变化很小。

Conclusion: 当前的后训练策略并不能保证生物基础模型表征真正贡献于任务性能。基准准确率、后训练增益、生成的推理链均不能作为模型"使用了生物输入"的证据。模型可能仅依赖预测性文本注释（如基因名、通路定义）就达到高性能。未来工作应设计直接奖励正确使用生物输入的训练目标，并评估此类代表性在促进更多生物输入依赖方面的作用。生物推理模型的设计与评价需将"正确使用任务相关生物输入"作为独立于预测准确率的目标。

Abstract: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

</details>


### [475] [Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00903)
*Zhanming Zhang,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"入口状态锐化"(entry-state sharpening)框架：在测试时强化学习(TTRL)之前，使用无数据训练(data-free training)将通用检查点调整为更集中的策略分布状态，以提升后续TTRL将"可达能力"转化为"可靠输出"的效率。作者以Qwen3-4B为基础模型，比较了五个无数据检查点，发现入口策略熵与端点转换效率(η=mean@16/best@16)呈强负相关(Spearman ρ=-0.90至-0.99)。R-Zero因入口熵过高(3.39 nats)表现最差，SPIRAL因入口熵最低(0.07 nats)表现最佳；自蒸馏干预证实入口状态可被主动调控。论文主张将检查点准备视为"状态控制问题"，以入口熵作为无标签控制信号，以可达能力作为约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时强化学习(TTRL)利用模型自身样本的一致性作为监督信号，在无标签测试问题上微调语言模型。然而现有研究很少关注TTRL开始时检查点的"入口状态"：当策略过于弥散(diffuse)时，自监督信号噪声大，且有限的适应预算首先需用于集中概率质量，导致模型难以高效表达其已具备的可达能力。论文提出核心问题：在TTRL之前应将模型置于何种状态才能使标签自由适应更高效？

Method: 1. **框架**：在标准TTRL (π_target = A_T(π_0; X)) 之前插入无数据准备阶段 π_entry = P_m(π_0; τ_m)，使 π_target = A_T(π_entry; X)。
2. **核心度量**：
   - 转换效率 η = mean@16 / best@16（分离可达能力与可靠表达）
   - 入口策略熵 H_entry(π)（基于模型自身rollouts的token级平均熵，无标签）
3. **五个无数据检查点**（均基于Qwen3-4B）：Base、R-Zero（不确定性课程自演化）、SPIRAL@32（Kuhn扑克游戏自弈早期检查点）、SPIRAL@400（多游戏自弈完成版）、领域内自蒸馏检查点。
4. **TTRL协议**：15步优化、32奖励投票、每题16个采样更新和16个验证采样、GRPO优化多数票奖励、固定种子。
5. **偏相关分析**：控制入口best@16后检验入口熵与转换效率的关联强度。

Result: 1. **冻结能力≠TTRL就绪性**：R-Zero在MATH上起始准确率高于Base（0.717 vs 0.672），15步后反低于Base（0.713 vs 0.771），转换效率0.911 vs 0.941；R-Zero在MATH/GPQA/AMC的6次比较中全部输给Base。
2. **入口熵强排序转换效率**：五个检查点上 Spearman ρ=-0.90（控制可达能力后ρ=-0.99）；跨种子ρ=1.00（p=0.017）；GPQA上ρ=-1.00；AMC上ρ=-0.80。
3. **极端对比**：R-Zero（3.39 nats）vs SPIRAL@400（0.07 nats）——SPIRAL尽管从未在数学数据上训练，仍取得MATH和GPQA最高TTRL后准确率。
4. **直接干预证据**：领域内自蒸馏将Base从1.186 nats降至0.183 nats，转换效率从0.941升至0.945；但高强度下best@16从0.820降至0.811，揭示可达能力为锐化约束。
5. **自弈强度递增**：SPIRAL@32（0.344 nats, η=0.937）→ SPIRAL@400（0.073 nats, η=0.957），自弈越强入口越集中、转换效率越高。

Conclusion: 论文将TTRL的检查点准备重新框定为"状态控制问题"：使用无数据训练在适应前重塑模型分布，使已具备能力被更高效地转化为可靠输出。入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号可有效预测TTRL就绪性，但其作用受可达能力约束——锐化的目的是改善转换效率而非最小化熵。未来需在更多模型族、适应步长与任务分布上验证，并探索答案级/语义级不确定性是否能提供比token级熵更精确的入口状态表征。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $\rho=-0.90$; $\rho=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

</details>


### [476] [In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00921)
*Oliver Obst,Frieder Stolzenburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"交叉审计"(crossed audit)方法，将CEM中世界模型的"评分"和"提议生成"两个角色分离，并通过一次性精英集替换(one-update splice)实验，证明在第一次更新时使用环境排名而非模型排名可降低最终选定序列的实际成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在CEM规划中同时承担两个角色：一是对当前候选动作排序，二是拟合下一轮采样的提议分布。但这两个角色通常被混合评估，难以分辨评分错误如何影响当前决策和未来候选。该研究旨在分离这两个角色，并检验一次精英集决策如何通过提议机制影响最终的序列选择成本。

Method: 采用4×4交叉设计：四种预测代理(Identity、Learned nonlinear、Anchored nonlinear、Random nonlinear)分别在冻结的Dreamer背景上生成CEM轨迹，每个代理保存的候选池被所有四种代理重新评分(交叉矩阵)。环境执行提供参考精英集。然后设计"一次性精英集拼接"干预：在迭代0用环境排名替换模型排名拟合下一提议，两分支后续保持相同评分器和随机样本。实验在Walker和Cheetah任务上各6个种子(原始)+6个种子(扩展)上运行。

Result: 关键发现：(1)预指定的提议距离D从迭代0到迭代3下降(平均从0.254降至0.235)，但成对排序一致性在Walker上接近随机、在Cheetah上反而下降；(2)距离下降主要来自宽度比的对数项减小，而均值项D_μ反而上升；(3)在Cheetah上，评分器列占66.2%的方差，而提议来源行仅占10%；Walker上三方较均衡；(4)Random nonlinear的对角残差在所有6个原始单元上为正，被选为干预目标；(5)一次性精英集替换使Walker最终成本对比降至-0.329、Cheetah降至-0.766(以初始池十分位距归一化)，所有12个单元均为负。

Conclusion: 世界模型在CEM中同时决定当前排序和未来查询分布；提议距离下降不等于决策一致性改善(因宽度收缩掩盖了均值分歧)。交叉矩阵揭示了Cheetah上评分器主导、Walker上三方混合的结构差异。一次性环境精英集替换可降低最终选定序列的实际成本，方向在6个选择单元和6个保留单元上一致。审计需要可重置环境和候选执行，属模拟诊断工具，拼接使用实际不可用的预言信息。

Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update. Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

</details>


### [477] [Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00927)
*Kihyun Yu,Honghao Wei,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了对抗性线性约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），提出了首个无需 Slater 条件即可达到 √K 速率最优的算法，解决了先前工作中 O(K^{3/4}) 与最优 √K 之间的差距，同时支持对抗性约束并保持计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的对抗性线性 CMDP 算法面临两难：要么计算上依赖状态空间大小（Yu et al. 2026a），要么遗憾和约束违反只能达到 O(K^{3/4}) 且需要 Slater 条件（Yu et al. 2026b）。本文旨在同时实现速率最优 √K、计算高效（与 |S| 无关）、支持对抗性约束且无需 Slater 条件。

Method: 算法结合三项关键技术：(1) 自适应 Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) 用于策略更新，避免对概率单纯形 KL 直径的依赖；(2) 自适应对偶正则化器 R_k 与指数 Lyapunov 函数 Φ(x)=e^{γx}-1 相结合，设计出无 KL 散度项的对偶漂移分析，避免策略混合；(3) 对偶变量 Y_k 在多项式阈值 K^8 处截断以控制覆盖数。价值估计采用收缩特征与乐观估计。

Result: 在概率至少 1-δ 下，Regret(K) 和 Violation(K) 均为 Õ(√(d³H⁴K) + √(dH⁵K) + d³H⁴)；计算复杂度为 O(d³HK + d²|A|HK²)，与 |S| 无关；无需 Slater 条件；可处理对抗性约束。在链式 CMDP 数值实验中表现优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 本文通过避免策略混合并采用自适应 FTRL 与自适应对偶正则化，首次实现了对抗性线性 CMDP 的速率最优且计算高效的算法。局限在于仅能处理累积约束违反而非硬约束违反，未来工作将探索硬约束违反保证。

Abstract: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.

</details>


### [478] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"柏拉图任务算术"(Platonic Task Arithmetic)，通过引入通用任务描述符(Universal Task Descriptors, UTDs)实现跨异构视觉-语言/音频-语言模型的任务知识迁移与组合，无需架构对应或逐图像标签，仅需任务的描述符及其无标签探测图像和类别名提示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的权重空间任务算术(weight-space task arithmetic)要求所有模型共享同一参数空间，无法在异构架构间迁移任务知识。论文受柏拉图洞穴寓言启发，假设不同模型针对同一任务的微调更新是某个共享的、与模型无关的"柏拉图任务向量"在不同坐标系中的"影子"，并试图验证这一假设并使其可操作化。

Method: 核心方法是引入Universal Task Descriptor (UTD)：一个N×M矩阵，记录微调前后图像嵌入与类别名提示之间余弦相似度的变化量。UTD的形状与嵌入维度无关，因此可在不同架构间直接相加、取负、组合。传输流程定义为：找到目标模型的一个编辑(edit)，使其在任务的探测图像和提示上产生的描述符与源描述符匹配。两种实现方式：(1) 闭式解——描述符可分解为图像嵌入的偏移场，通过岭回归正则化最小二乘求解一个线性算子A，折叠为(I+αA)施加于目标最后一层权重；(2) 低秩适配器(LoRA)——在目标视觉编码器所有注意力层上以梯度下降拟合同一目标。命题1证明闭式解的解映射在满秩下关于U是线性的，因此一个目标可存储算子库(bank)，组合操作退化为算子的符号加和。理论方面还给出跨网格组合的边界条件(命题2)和保持裕度的充分条件(推论1)。

Result: 在6个模型家族(CLIP, OpenCLIP, SigLIP, SigLIP2, MetaCLIP, EVA-CLIP)、8个分类任务、跨3,360个加法单元和240个取反单元的实验表明：(1) 跨模型任务加法在两个任务上分别提升18.11和11.63点(零样本之上)，保留Oracle自身描述符收益的80%和74%；(2) 取反操作以λ=1去除35.2点目标任务仅损失4.5点CIFAR-100控制；(3) 在未参与拟合的遥感数据集上组合仍能提升5-7点；(4) 描述符一致性余弦仅0.473但传输仍保留大部分增益；(5) 适配器实现更精确但每个编辑需一次优化；(6) 扩展到音频-文本CLAP模型同样有效。

Conclusion: 权重空间任务算术被限制于单一模型，因为其操作于坐标；柏拉图任务算术操作于这些坐标所"影子"的共享对象，通过与架构无关的描述符来观察，并将编辑问题转化为让目标重现该描述符。闭式解将编辑折叠为作用于最后一层的一个算子，组合退化为算子加法；适配器则更精确但成本更高。核心限制是假设1的残差与共享分量大小相当，且任务间干扰无小量保证；未来工作方向是缩小该残差。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

</details>


### [479] [Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00976)
*Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Minseon Gwak,Soon Hoe Lim,Pan Li,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VSF提出了一种在物理时间中进行的概率预测方法,通过变分潜变量扩展流式流(SF),解决了非潜变量SF在分叉动力学中确定性速度场只能产生单一未来轨迹的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准流式流(SF)虽在物理时间中高效生成轨迹,但只能学习确定性速度场,对同一观测历史只能产生单一未来。在分叉动力学中,不同未来分支共享相近的物理状态,迫使速度场对微小的状态差异极度敏感,导致保真度-灵敏度权衡问题。

Method: VSF在物理时间速度场上引入一个潜变量z(每次预报采样一次并固定),训练时通过变分编码器从观测的未来局部动力学推断z,使用广义能量重建损失(L_ES)结合KL正则化优化。在推理时,直接从先验p(z)=N(0,I)采样一个潜变量并固定整个预报过程。

Result: 在确定性系统(双摆、Rössler、Lorenz)的1000步长视野预报中,VSF在CRPS、RMSE、MAE上均优于DeepAR、扩散模型、SF和Chronos-2等基线;在随机系统上也获得了最低的CME、CSE、Wasserstein距离和能量距离。作为JEPA世界模型的预测器,在PushT、Cube、TwoRoom和Reacher四个任务上将规划成功率平均提高7.34%。

Conclusion: VSF成功将SF从确定性预报扩展为概率预报,通过潜变量编码分支特定信息,既保持了物理时间生成的计算效率(每次想象转移仅需一次速度场评估),又改善了长视野预报精度和分布保真度,可作为即插即用模块集成到现有JEPA世界模型中。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

</details>


### [480] [HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00984)
*Junke Wang,Hongshun Ling,Li Zhang,Jinjing Wu,Tong Shao,Fang Wang,Yuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HADRec 框架，用于基于电子健康记录（EHR）的药物推荐任务。该框架融合了 LLaMA-7B 编码的临床文本表征与 ChemBERTa 编码的药物 SMILES 分子语义，通过跨注意力机制实现患者状态与药物分子特征的多模态深度融合，并引入层级化预测器与一致性约束损失以严格遵循 ATC 解剖学治疗化学分类系统的逻辑依赖关系。在 MIMIC-III 数据集上的实验表明，HADRec 在 Jaccard、F1 和 PR-AUC 三项核心指标上均达到最先进水平，并在 MIMIC-IV 外部验证中表现出良好的泛化能力与校准性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法存在两大关键局限：其一，将药物抽象为离散标记，忽略了分子结构和药理机制；其二，采用"扁平化"推荐范式，未能利用 ATC 分类系统的层级逻辑。这些局限限制了推荐结果的可解释性、临床合理性以及对分布漂移的泛化能力。

Method: HADRec 框架包含四个核心模块：(1) 多模态表征学习模块——采用 LoRA 适配的 LLaMA-7B 编码临床文本获得患者表征，使用 ChemBERTa 编码药物 SMILES 字符串构建全局分子知识库；(2) 多模态融合模块——通过跨注意力机制以患者嵌入为 Query、分子知识矩阵为 Key/Value，实现患者状态与药物特征的深度语义耦合，并结合残差连接与层归一化输出融合表征；(3) 层级化预测模块——构建四级 ATC 层级预测架构（L1-L4），通过链式跨层注意力机制实现自顶向下的渐进式推理；(4) 一致性约束模块——提出基于软掩码的层级一致性损失，通过融合上层预测概率与当前层预测概率构建软掩码，对违反 ATC 依赖关系的高激活进行惩罚。最终损失为各层 BCE 损失与一致性损失的加权和。

Result: 在 MIMIC-III 数据集（6,350 名患者，110 种药物）上，HADRec 达到 Jaccard=0.5517、F1=0.7010、PR-AUC=0.7994，DDI 率为 0.0774，平均推荐药物数 20.51，均优于 GAMENet、SafeDrug、RASNet、EGNeT、DEPOT、MoleRec、AMGNet 和 StratMed 等基线模型。消融实验验证了分子知识表征（MKR）、层级预测（HP）和一致性损失（CL）各组件的必要性。层级监督实验表明，去除任何中间层级监督均会导致级联性能退化。在 MIMIC-IV 外部验证中，F1 达到 0.6408，ECE=0.04，Brier=0.06，表现出良好的校准性能。跨数据集迁移实验（MIMIC-III→MIMIC-IV）中 DDI 率最低（0.0493）。反事实评估显示模型能正确区分疾病特异性治疗与常规护理。推理时间为 3.14 秒/样本，GPU 内存占用 12.75GB。

Conclusion: HADRec 成功将分子结构信息与 ATC 层级逻辑整合到药物推荐框架中，通过多模态融合与层级一致性约束实现了高性能、可解释且临床合理的药物推荐。框架为将领域知识（如分类法、本体）嵌入神经架构提供了可迁移的范式，在医疗 AI 领域具有广泛的应用前景。未来工作将聚焦于更系统的药物-药物相互作用建模、模型压缩与实时部署、纵向治疗轨迹建模以及药物基因组学整合。

Abstract: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). HADRec employs LLaMA-7B to encode clinical notes for rich patient representations and ChemBERTa to encode drug Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System strings, building a global molecular knowledge base. A cross-attention mechanism then performs deep multimodal fusion between patient states and drug features. The framework further incorporates a hierarchical predictor and a novel consistency constraint loss to enforce strict adherence to ATC logical dependencies. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III demonstrate that HADRec achieves state-of-the-art performance across Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC. External validation on MIMIC-IV confirms strong generalization under distribution shifts, and calibration analysis shows well-calibrated predictive confidence on MIMIC-IV with ECE = 0.04, and Brier = 0.06. Counterfactual evaluation reveals clinically aligned reasoning, disentangling disease-specific treatments from general care. Together, these results establish HADRec as a high-performance, interpretable, and clinically grounded pathway toward safe and reliable AI-driven medication recommendation.

</details>


### [481] [Neural scaling laws and evolution of learnable activation functions of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00985)
*Tilen Cadez,Sanghoon Lee,Kyoung-Min Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了三种Kolmogorov-Arnold网络变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN）在图像分类和科学回归任务中的神经缩放定律（BNSL），发现测试损失呈现任务依赖的分段幂律行为（图像分类为RG-FS-SS三段式，科学回归为RG-LS两段式），并通过PCA揭示了学习过程中可学习激活函数的形状多样性受限、复杂度饱和的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN因其将可学习激活函数置于边上的设计而具备优于MLP的可解释性，在科学领域（如物理）具有独特应用潜力。然而，KAN存在计算开销大、损失景观复杂等瓶颈。如何随数据集规模 $N_D$ 扩展KAN性能（即神经缩放定律），以及可学习激活函数的形状如何随数据量演化，仍是未解决的开放问题，这对KAN的高效部署至关重要。

Method: 1. 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST（图像分类）以及扭曲双层CrI₃磁纹理图像的哈密顿参数(θ, J, D)回归任务上，系统评估BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN三种KAN变体在不同隐藏神经元数 $n_h$（4至256）下的测试损失与训练集规模 $N_D$ 的关系（对数网格采样）。<br>2. 使用**平滑断裂幂律（SBPL）** $\mathcal{L}(N_D) = [(N_D/N_F)^{-\alpha\eta} + (N_D/N_S)^{-\beta\eta}]^{1/\eta}$ 拟合分段幂律缩放行为，提取快速缩放指数α、慢速缩放指数β及交叉点 $N_\times$。<br>3. 对Gottlieb-KAN训练后的边函数 $\Phi(x)$ 进行**主成分分析（PCA）**，通过首主成分解释方差比 $p_1$ 和有效秩 $r_{\text{eff}}$ 量化形状多样性与复杂度演化。<br>4. 使用AdamW优化器，分别训练15/200轮，跨15/15/10次随机种子实现取均值。

Result: **图像分类（MNIST/Fashion-MNIST）**：三种KAN变体均呈现三段式BNSL——随机猜测（RG）平台 → 快速缩放（FS，$\mathcal{L} \propto N_D^{-\alpha}$）→ 慢速缩放（SS，$\mathcal{L} \propto N_D^{-\beta}$，α>β）。α ∈ [0.4, 1.5]，β ∈ [0.06, 0.6]，具体数值依赖于架构与任务。Gottlieb-KAN的RG平台最持久（归因于全局多项式基），其α、β、 $N_\times$ 在所有 $n_h$ 下均为三变体中最大；BSRBF-KAN和Faster-KAN随 $n_h$ 增大更早离开RG平台。<br><br>**科学回归（磁参数）**：损失呈RG→线性缩放（LS）的两段式跨越，LS指数α ∈ [1.28, 2.59]，其中θ回归指数（1.77–2.59）显著高于J（1.38–1.93）和D（1.28–2.00）；KAN的缩放指数总体高于MLP基线（0.82–2.29）。模型尺寸对指数影响很小（呈现饱和），且结果对基函数超参数具有稳健性。<br><br>**边函数演化**：Gottlieb-KAN在两种任务下，其训练后的边函数在每一层内均塌缩到共享形状家族，主要变化体现为标量乘子的分布调整而非形状多样化——PCA显示 $r_{\text{eff}} \approx 1$，且不随 $N_D$ 增大而增加，即便测试损失下降多个数量级。BSRBF-KAN的边函数形状多样性更高，但单边符号化分析不具可扩展性。

Conclusion: KAN的神经缩放行为显著依赖于具体架构与任务类型，呈现分段幂律（BNSL）：图像分类为RG-FS-SS，科学回归为RG-LS。KAN的缩放指数（特别是LS指数接近2.0）通常超过MLP，证实KAN在大规模应用中具有可扩展性潜力。然而，Gottlieb-KAN边函数在训练后保持单一形状家族（ $r_{\text{eff}} \approx 1$ ），表明实际利用的表示复杂度远低于标称可学习参数数量，这对可解释性分析（边符号化提取）和未来架构选择有重要启示。研究为基于KAN的科学计算部署提供了量化路线图，强调需针对任务和数据分布特征谨慎选择KAN变体。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a compelling alternative to traditional Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based neural networks. By employing activation functions as learnable elements, KANs offer superior interpretability, making them suited for scientific domains. In this work, we investigate the neural scaling laws of KANs and the structural evolution of their learnable activation functions under dataset expansion. Specifically, we evaluate the scaling behavior of three KAN variants---BSRBF-KAN, Gottlieb-KAN, and Faster-KAN---across standard image classification benchmarks (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and a specialized scientific regression task (magnetic parameter estimation from domain images of moiré magnetic textures). Our results demonstrate that the test loss ${\cal L}$ exhibits a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) behavior as a function of the dataset size $N_D$. After passing through a random-guess regime, the loss follows architecture- and task-dependent scaling behavior. The loss crosses from a faster- to a slower-scaling branch, ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-\alpha}$ and ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-\beta}$ with $\alpha>\beta$ for image classification tasks. The exponents $\alpha$ and $\beta$ depend strongly on both the specific network architecture and the dataset-size regime, ranging from 0.4 to 1.5 and from 0.06 to 0.6, respectively. For the magnetic parameter-regression task, the loss follows a single scaling law with its exponent ranging from 1.28 to 2.59. Additionally, we provide a structural analysis of how activation functions refine their complexity as data volume increases, finding that dataset expansion drives a transition from simple linear-like approximations toward stable, interpretable symbolic forms. These findings provide a quantitative roadmap for the efficient application of KANs while managing the trade-off between model expressivity and computational overhead.

</details>


### [482] [Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00988)
*Shan Yu,Xuening Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于从apo结构预测隐匿性配体结合口袋的可监督代数计数场（ACF）方法，将显式几何、物理化学和拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表，每个预测分数可完全从特征值、训练计数、表权重和空间聚合重建。ACF在外部验证集上优于P2Rank，但在官方测试集和匹配预算F1上未呈现稳定优势，且扩展特征在冷冻电镜外部验证中未确认增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构预测器（几何方法、深度学习、图神经网络、蛋白质语言模型）虽有效但缺乏可追溯性，无法直接从结构测量和训练计数机械重建每个残基得分。本文旨在构建一个兼具竞争力与完全可审计的预测器，使每个预测分数可从显式局部测量和训练计数分解得到。

Method: ACF基于645条"线"（43个基础量×不同变换），通过链内秩离散化为4级，16轮置换生成5152张查找表（每张16格），每格存储正/总残基数。整数权重通过岭回归正则化求解并取整。部署分数为加权得分之和加上18Å邻域均值与标准差比值的空间门控。推理无需神经网络前向传播或外部数据库搜索。

Result: 官方测试集（192单元）ROC-AUC 0.799，配对差P2Rank未解决（+0.0058 [-0.0168, +0.0276]）；外部Set A（57单元）ROC-AUC 0.8411，优于P2Rank +0.0443（调整后95% CI [+0.0102, +0.0792]）；外部Sets B+C（45冷冻电镜单元）扩展字段对比部署字段未解决（+0.0063）；匹配预算F1优势未解决。残基得分可在5×10⁻¹⁶精度内精确重建。

Conclusion: ACF提供了紧凑、可审计的基于结构的预测，推理时不依赖同源性或模板搜索。外部验证集证实了相对P2Rank的可转移信号，但官方测试集ROC-AUC和匹配预算F1差异未解决，扩展特征在冷冻电镜数据上的收益未确认。本文支持一个可审计的监督预测器，但未建立查找表架构相对于其他读出的优越性或口袋开启的因果解释。

Abstract: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.

</details>


### [483] [Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00991)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci Karthik R. Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"适配器丛林"(Adapter Thickets)方法：将固定的RLVR训练预算分散到K个独立训练的LoRA适配器（各自分配一个不相交的数据分片）上，比将全部预算集中训练一个适配器，在测试时多数投票中表现更好，且随着投票数增加优势扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准流程（用RLVR训练一个策略，然后多次采样投票）被证明是有损的。RLVR在提升单样本准确率的同时，会收窄采样分布并增加投票者错误相关性，损害多数投票所需的多样性。在固定推理预算下，集中式RLVR训练反而会使投票准确率低于未训练的基线模型。

Method: 方法核心：适配器丛林(Adapter Thickets)。将RLVR训练池划分为K个不相交的随机分片，每个分片训练一个独立的LoRA适配器（使用1/K的训练预算和rollout预算），推理时K个适配器各贡献160/K个完成构成160票固定预算。主要对比方法：(1) Base未训练基线；(2) GRPO-single-adapter集中训练单适配器；(3) GRPO-single(matched)步骤匹配控制（单适配器在丛林成员对应步数停止）。实验覆盖Qwen2.5-{1.5B,3B,7B}和Llama-3.1-8B四个模型，数学（MATH等5个基准）和代码（MBPP等3个基准）两个领域，三个种子。

Result: 主要结果：(1)集中RLVR在四个模型上都提升单样本准确率(+7.3,+1.0,+0.7,+9.7pp)，但在固定160票下，四个模型中有三个的多数投票低于未训练基线(最多-4.8pp)；(2)训练过程中错误相关性ρ̄单调上升，投票准确率在约125步达峰后下降(最多-7.0pp)；(3)丛林在所有16个(model,K)投票设置上都优于完全训练的单适配器，K≥4时与基线差距在0.8pp内；(4)丛林同时保持大部分单样本增益：K≤4时保留85-95%，K≥8时保留63-78%；(5)集中成本随投票预算增长：单适配器对基线从16票时+0.15pp变为160票时-2.58pp，丛林相对优势从+1.33扩大到+3.28pp；(6)置信过滤投票对前三个方法都有增益(+0.43至+0.53pp)，但对完全训练的单适配器无增益(+0.01pp)；(7)随机分片不劣于学科专家分片。

Conclusion: 当计划是采样并投票时，RLVR预算应"广撒"而非"深挖"——应分散到多个独立适配器上，而非集中在单一策略。适配器丛林是一种即插即用的修复方案：不改变推理方式，只改变训练资源分配；部署时K个LoRA适配器共享同一冻结基模型，现代多适配器服务器可近单模型成本批处理；训练可完美并行，K个工作节点完成时间为单适配器的1/K；唯一的额外超参数是K本身，且K≥4时对K的选择宽容。结论是：当目标是投票时，训练一片"丛林"而非一个"冠军"。

Abstract: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

</details>


### [484] [Reliability-aware short-term roll prediction for unmanned surface vehicles via multi-task learning and adaptive centralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00996)
*Kaizhen Li,Xi Zhou,Zihao Wang,Dan Zhang,Jianjian Liu,Xiaowei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向无人水面艇（USV）短时横摇预测的可靠性感知框架，通过多任务学习联合执行回归预测与置信度评估，并设计自适应中心化策略以应对时变工况下的分布漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有USV横摇预测方法多聚焦于确定性点预测的精度提升，对预测可靠性（置信度）的量化不足；同时，小型USV横摇频率高、序列短，传统在线自适应和统计标准化方法难以有效应对快速变化的短时扰动所导致的泛化性能退化。

Method: 1. 自适应中心化（AdaC）：对输入序列去均值中心化，并利用移动平均提取局部趋势，通过MLP预测输出序列的均值漂移δ，补偿输入-输出间的均值偏移；2. 多任务学习架构：以Bi-LSTM为共享特征提取骨干，并行接入回归头（点预测）和分类头（离散化置信度评估，输出40个roll区间上的概率分布），通过KL散度监督置信度分支；3. 一致性损失：采用Soft-Argmax使回归输出与分类头最大置信区间对齐；4. 高质量（HQ）预测区间构建：通过选取累积概率首次超过α的最小子集箱体来形成预测区间。

Result: 基于7米高速艇在真实海况下的多工况数据集（#0训练，#1、#2测试），AdaC在RMSE/MAE上显著优于No-standardization、Z-Score、RevIN、Dish-ts和San（p<0.05）；HQ区间在80%/90%/95%置信度下PICP最接近标称水平（81.5%/89.5%/94.0%），AWD较ND和TD降低40%以上；置信度加权parity图与误差-置信度曲线均证明置信度估计与预测误差高度一致；Wilcoxon检验证实改进具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 该可靠性感知预测范式不仅能输出精确的多步横摇预测，还能提供逐步置信度评分和高质量预测区间，模型具有架构无关性，在不同特征提取骨干（CNN/Transformer/Informer）下均适用；局限在于仅依赖历史横摇序列、尚未融合风速浪高等外部环境变量，长时预测性能可能退化，未来将探索多变量耦合与机理模型集成以提升可解释性和物理一致性。

Abstract: Reliable roll prediction of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is essential for ensuring navi?gational safety and enhancing autonomous decision-making. While existing studies primarily focus on improving prediction accuracy, the quantification of prediction reliability remains insufficiently addressed. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a reliability-aware prediction paradigm that integrates confidence assessment into the predictive pipeline. The architecture utilizes a multi-task learning structure where a shared feature extraction backbone feeds into dual heads: a regression head for precise roll prediction and a quantification head for confidence scoring. This configuration provides accurate prediction and corresponding confidence for risk?sensitive downstream tasks. In addition, an adaptive centralization strategy tailored for short?term real-time roll prediction is introduced to improve model generalization under varying operational conditions. Experiments conducted on a real-sea dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies the reliability of prediction results and maintains superior generalization under varying conditions, offering significant potential for practical engineering applications.

</details>


### [485] [SLIM: Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01037)
*Seongcheol Jeong,Masahiro Suzuki,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SLIM（Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging），利用经典混料设计中的Scheffé {T,2}单纯形格子设计，以最小评估预算（T(T+1)/2次目标指标评估，即单独专家+等权专家对）构建LLM合并系数的二次代理模型，并在单纯形上优化该代理以选择合并系数。在Gemma-2-9B和Llama-3.1-8B两种架构（各8位专家、5个领域）上的实验表明，SLIM以36次评估即可准确预测未见混合的AVG性能，并在受限预算下优于MAP等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM合并中系数选择依赖昂贵的基准评估；现有代理方法（如MAP）拟合随机采样点上的二次代理，但代理构建的前期评估成本依然高昂。核心问题是：能否以尽可能少的真实目标指标评估构建代理，并仍支持具有竞争力的合并性能？

Method: 将合并系数限制在单纯形Δ^{T-1}（非负、和为1）上，把线性任务向量合并视为经典混料实验。SLIM采用Scheffé {T,2}单纯形格子设计：评估T个顶点（单个专家）和C(T,2)个边中点（等权专家对），共T(T+1)/2次评估，构建唯一的二次插值代理\hat M(λ)（Eq.7）。然后用SLSQP在单纯形上数值优化\hat M（解析梯度），无需额外目标指标评估。代理可通过域分解的线性性直接在AVG上插值。此外比较了三次扩展（120点）和随机设计+岭回归的消融。

Result: 在150个Dirichlet(1,…,1)采样的内部混合点上，二次代理预测AVG的Spearman ρ=0.936（Gemma-2-9B）、0.959（Llama-3.1-8B），MAE分别为1.93和1.07。匹配预算36次时，格子设计在预测保真度上全面优于随机设计（含岭正则化），胜率99.5–100%。合并性能：SLIM（36次评估）在四个架构×分布设置中有三处优于MAP@45，且与使用150–200次评估的进化合并相当；仅在Llama ID上MAP/进化合并通过总和>1的系数获得更高得分。三次扩展带来小的ID增益但降低OOD。三次扩展花费120次评估但并未一致提升合并性能。

Conclusion: 评估点的结构化放置在二次代理框架内对预测保真度至关重要。T(T+1)/2是该二次模型在单纯形上的辨识下界，而非普适的"好合并"下界。SlLM以最少评估实现竞争性合并；但当更高表达力的代理或更大的系数尺度（突破单纯形约束）能改善泛化时，仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Optimizing merging coefficients for large language models can require many costly benchmark evaluations. We propose \textbf{Simplex-Lattice Interpolation Merging (SLIM)}, which constructs a quadratic surrogate of aggregate performance on the coefficient simplex using a classical mixture design. Evaluations of individual experts and equal-weight pairs determine the surrogate with the minimum number of measurements needed to identify a general quadratic on this domain. SLIM then optimizes the surrogate without further target-metric evaluations. Experiments on two model architectures demonstrate accurate prediction of unseen multi-expert mixtures and competitive merge performance under limited evaluation budgets. Matched-budget comparisons show that structured evaluation points improve prediction fidelity over random designs, including those using regularized fitting.

</details>


### [486] [Kernelized Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01062)
*Laziz U. Abdullaev,Minh-Hieu Pham,Bach Do,Khoat Than,Tan M. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS)，一种将激活值引导提升到再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)的统一框架。通过核技巧，KAS将Difference-in-Means (DiM)推广为非线性、激活依赖的引导机制，能产生局部自适应的引导场，在线性核下严格恢复DiM。KAS在越狱攻击、CAA行为控制和图像风格控制等任务上表现优于或持平于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的DiM类激活引导方法应用一个全局、与输入无关的引导向量，无法捕捉激活空间中的局部几何结构和非线性流形。这导致在分布外激活上效果不佳，或在增大引导系数时破坏模型无关能力。需要一种能感知几何结构、输入自适应的引导方法。

Method: 方法核心是将DiM提升到RKHS：在特征空间中定义隐式引导分数Π(x) = ⟨φ(x), v_φ⟩，其中v_φ是源集与目标集核均值嵌入之差。通过核技巧，该分数仅依赖核评估。然后通过梯度上升最大化正则化目标F(x) = Π(x) - (λ/2)‖x-x₀‖²。RBF核下得到闭式局部自适应更新：每个参考点贡献按核相似度加权的吸引力(目标)或排斥力(源)。文章证明在线性核下KAS精确恢复DiM，并将引导分数与MMD双样本检验的联系形式化。

Result: 在三个设置上评估：(1)越狱引导——KAS在Gemma-2-9B-IT上取得86% ASR(超过ActAdd 10个百分点)、Qwen2.5-7B上96% ASR(超5个百分点)，Llama上持平；(2)CAA行为引导——在4种非空行为(Corrigibility、Hallucination、Myopic Reward、AI Coordination)上取得最高概率；(3)图像风格控制——KAS在cyberpunk风格上多数干预强度下优于Mean-AcT，且CLIPScore更高。Nyström近似(64个landmark)在CAA任务上有效但越狱ASR大幅下降。单对比对数据效率测试中KAS保持有效且降低困惑度。

Conclusion: KAS是DiM的严格推广，通过核技巧实现局部自适应、几何感知的引导场，无需训练且计算开销极低(1.49%额外时间)。局限包括：对所有token使用固定梯度步数缺乏token自适应调度、缺乏针对特定任务的核函数选择原则。论文同时讨论了双刃剑式的社会影响，强调负责任使用和下游安全评估的必要性。

Abstract: Activation steering provides a simple, training-free mechanism for controlling attributes of generative models such as sentiment, style, and helpfulness. However, standard approaches such as Difference-in-Means apply a single input-independent steering vector across all activations, limiting expressivity and ignoring the local geometry of the activation space. We propose Kernelized Activation Steering (KAS), a unifying framework that lifts activation steering into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. KAS formulates steering as an optimization problem expressed purely via kernel evaluations, yielding an implicit, activation-dependent steering score without constructing explicit feature maps. Unlike DiM, KAS induces locally adaptive steering: each activation is modified according to its relative position with respect to source and target reference sets, producing a nonlinear steering field over the representation space. Importantly, DiM is recovered as a special case under a linear kernel, while richer kernels enable geometry-aware interventions. Across standard activation steering tasks, including jailbreaking LLMs and image style control, KAS outperforms or is on par with the existing methods.

</details>


### [487] [GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01076)
*Chaiho Shin,Kwangsoo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLoC-EHR提出了一种多模态大语言模型,通过全局轨迹记忆与局部事件记忆的双路由接口连接结构化电子健康记录(EHR)与语言模型,并结合证据支持的奖励训练,实现可引用证据的临床推理。在MIMIC-IV三个临床结局预测任务上达到最高宏AUROC,并能迁移到EHRSHOT外部队列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化EHR回答临床问题需要兼顾整体轨迹上下文与具体支持事件。现有方法存在局限:文本序列化上下文过长、以往EHR推理强化学习仅奖励答案正确性而不区分有据与无据发现。需设计既能压缩长EHR序列又能生成有证据支持推理的模型。

Method: 1) 描述信息增强的EHR编码器(融合概念描述嵌入与代码ID嵌入,采用白化+ℓ2归一化处理LLM描述向量);2) 双路由接口:全局路由用学习查询重采样器生成固定64个轨迹记忆token,局部路由选取Top-64事件通过门控交叉注意力;3) 双层文本对齐:全局路由用BHC生成对齐轨迹,局部路由用掩码概念描述恢复对齐事件;4) 证据感知GRPO训练:奖励包括答案正确性、证据支持精度(词法匹配+IDF加权Dice)、格式与长度惩罚,辅助证据充分性损失。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV三个任务(院内死亡、长期住院、30天再入院)上,GLoC-EHR直接预测宏AUROC达0.879(任务专属)与0.873(多任务),优于零样本LLM和EHR-BERT;证据引用推理宏AUROC为0.866,接近直接多任务模型。证据奖励将不支持率从0.58降至0.44,局部路由在严格匹配下增加不同支持发现。无需重训练即可迁移到EHRSHOT,与EHR-BERT持平,并在未见过的实验室问题(钠、血小板)上优于零样本Qwen3-1.7B。

Conclusion: GLoC-EHR通过全局-局部双路由接口和证据感知强化学习,成功连接结构化EHR与语言模型,在临床结局预测上达到最先进性能,同时生成的推理具有记录支持性。两条路由实现功能特化(全局支持轨迹,局部支持事件),证据奖励有效减少无依据引用且不损失判别力。模型具备跨机构迁移潜力,但需进一步语义匹配验证与临床校准。

Abstract: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.

</details>


### [488] [Dataset Identity, Not Novelty: The Source of an Inflated OOD Detection Gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01096)
*Donghoon Lee,Shinjin Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出后验OOD检测器在常规评估协议下报告的性能增益大部分并非源于对"新颖性"的识别，而是源于对特定数据集身份的拟合。通过对比"内协议"(within protocol)与"留出整个数据集"的"留出协议"(hold-out protocol)，作者在ImageNet和CIFAR-100上系统测量了这一"膨胀效应"，发现参数容量并非主导因素，而拟合输入是否暴露类别身份才是关键，并给出了封闭形式公式用于预测该效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后验OOD检测评估协议仅在待测OOD数据集的保留样本上验证拟合结果，这只能排除对单个图像的记忆，却无法排除拟合识别了数据集本身（数据集身份）而非真正的分布外新颖性。这种"数据集身份"贡献在常规报告数字中无法被检测或量化，导致文献中报告的增益具有误导性。作者将这种差距定义为"inflation"（膨胀）。

Method: 1. 提出两种协议：内协议 w(t)（拟合时可看到目标数据集的一半样本）和留出协议 h(t)（拟合时完全看不到目标数据集），定义膨胀 I = w(t) - h(t)。
2. 引入零容量参考 VarRatio = log min_c d_c - log Var_c(d_c)，无需任何OOD数据或调谐常数，作为测量的基准点。
3. 设计"组合器序列"：从单常数 α，到2/4/8/13通道的岭判别，再到MLP和直接在白化特征 z 上的岭/MLP，覆盖从1个参数到6.6×10^5个参数。
4. 设计两组对照实验，仅改变"是否暴露类别身份"：(a) 排序 vs 未排序的类别距离轮廓；(b) 通道清单 vs 随机/PCA方向的白化特征视图。
5. 推导封闭形式公式：膨胀 = ‖Δ_t‖ · (1 - cos θ_t)，其中 Δ_t 是该OOD集相对于ID的位移，θ_t 是其与留出协议方向的夹角。
6. 在ImageNet-1k的11个公开骨干网络和CIFAR-100的6个自训练架构（3个种子）上进行实验。

Result: 1. 在ImageNet上从零容量到特征空间岭判别，报告列AUROC上升9.78点，留出列仅上升2.52点；在CIFAR-100上报告列上升13.67点，留出列反而下降6.14点。
2. 参数扫描（13通道输入，参数从13到5.4×10^5）：报告列上升1.61点，留出列仅移动-0.34点，证明参数规模并非主因。
3. 类别感知输入比置换不变输入的膨胀高出2.7-3.1倍（ImageNet）和2.5倍（CIFAR-100），且在所有17个骨干上一致（符号检验 p ≤ 0.031）。
4. 验证调谐单常数（OpenOOD指定验证集上调谐）在两个基准上均无膨胀（-0.02和+0.01 AUROC），是唯一安全的拟合步骤。
5. 封闭公式预测与测量的秩相关达0.973（Pearson 0.975），在双正态尺度上提供逐点预测（斜率0.90），无需运行留出协议。
6. 提出的VarRatio无需任何拟合在16/17个骨干上优于Mahalanobis++，距离诚实拟合上限仅0.22 AUROC。

Conclusion: 拟合的OOD分数报告的数字无法被其自身的验证所证明。通过将报告增益分为"留出数据集后存留的部分"与"不存留的部分"，可发现大部分增益源于数据集身份而非新颖性。参数数量几乎不影响存活列，而输入是否暴露类别身份则是关键决定因素。封闭形式公式 inflation = ‖Δ_t‖·(1-cos θ_t) 从拟合行即可计算，无需运行留出协议。实践中唯一安全的步骤是在指定验证集上调谐的单常数；任何在此之上的拟合都会报告留出协议无法复现的增益。

Abstract: A post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detector reads the activations of a trained classifier and returns a score. It fits that score on in-distribution data, and the benchmarks that evaluate it supply a second piece of OOD data for the fitting itself. Some detectors tune a constant on it. Others fit a direction in feature space or train a flexible combiner and report the number that it reaches as the gain that is still available. Every such fit is validated on held-out samples of the same OOD dataset. That check rules out memorizing individual images. It says nothing about a fit that has instead learned which dataset it is looking at, and a direction that recognizes one OOD dataset rather than novelty passes it perfectly. The detector that a practitioner installs meets OOD data from a source that nobody fitted it on, so the difference decides what the reported number is worth. We measure it by holding out the whole OOD dataset rather than a sample of it, and we call that gap the inflation. We read it across a range of combiners on ImageNet and CIFAR-100 backbones. Most of the gain that the usual protocol reports turns out to be dataset identity rather than novelty. The size of the fit does not move what survives, so the effect is not ordinary overfitting. The share depends instead on whether the input exposes class identity, and two controls that vary that property alone separate the inflation on every backbone of both benchmarks. A closed form accounts for the effect and computes it from the fitting rows, so a practitioner can tell which fits will inflate without running the hold-out protocol. One of these fits survives, namely the single constant that the field already picks on a designated validation dataset. Anything above it reports a gain that the hold-out protocol does not return, and on one benchmark what survives falls while what is reported climbs.

</details>


### [489] [How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01110)
*Bangji Yang,Jingyuan Li,Jiajun Fan,Yi Evie Zhang,Ruihan Guo,Hongba Ma,Neil He,Chumeng Liang,Qinglong Zheng,Zhanghan Ni,Ge Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍SELF-POT基准与评估框架，在数学(0)、代码和智能体四个领域、350个密封测试任务上，统一衡量测试时计算（test-time scaling）对深度学习（DL）模型带来的直接（Direct）准确率增益，并将每一次模型调用（含选择与评判）以美元计费。通过对比五个低成本推理模型与Claude Opus 5.5直接推理的参考表现，强调"生成正确候选"与"成功提交"之间的转换损失是关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法的对比多限于单一领域，且很少将选择/评判成本计入预算，缺少跨域、以美元计费的统一度量。本文试图回答：(1)扩展测试时计算在哪些领域带来收益；(2)静态任务中机会丢失在生成、选择还是保留阶段；(3)低成本模型借助测试时扩展能否在不超过成本的前提下匹配更强模型。

Method: 提出SELF-POT评估框架：固定模型、预算规则下对比Direct、Parallel@2（两候选，无模型token的规则选择）、Parallel@4（三候选+同模型评判）、Revise@4（自评判-修改一轮）。所有调用按美元计费。在350个密封任务（数学APEX/Omni-MATH、LiveCodeBench AtCoder、AppWorld工作流、Terminal-Bench终端）评估5个低成本推理模型，以Claude Opus 5.5 Direct为锚点。随后在保留候选池上进行受控重放，分离候选覆盖率（candidate coverage）、选择规则与失败处理对最终准确率的影响。

Result: 关键发现：(1)失败处理可反转测量增益：编程Parallel@4相对Direct在冻结提交规则下损失8.6 pp，但保留首个非空候选使其转为+3.6 pp增益；(2)公共示例选择可将编程正确提交从376提升至453/500，同时节省12-49% API成本；数学中评判+回退186对 vs. 投票229对，投票节省12-21%成本；(3)智能体工作流阶段失败率高（GPT-OSS达117/160、MiniMax达159/160），主要衡量接口而非决策价值；(5)Flash Direct在加入replay后仍为编程Pareto前沿，折扣后数学vote@3提供更廉价的运营点，但Opus Direct在数学/工作流/终端任务中仍最准。

Conclusion: 测试时扩展的真实价值取决于领域、选择规则与失败处理。生成正确候选与成功提交之间存在显著转化损失，应优先改进受限阶段（如确保选择阶段返回可用候选）。公共示例选择等任务适配的廉价选择规则往往优于模型评判。报告应同时给出Direct运行点、候选覆盖率、选择阶段结果与美元成本，单独看精度可能掩盖部署价值。

Abstract: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

</details>


### [490] [Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01126)
