*Seungjun Lee,Ensieh Khazaei,Dimitrios Hatzinakos,Baturalp Buyukates,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ASFL（激活共享联邦学习），通过在客户端之间直接交换隐藏层激活来减轻联邦学习中的客户端漂移问题，在保持低通信开销和隐私保护的同时显著提升模型精度和训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在非IID数据场景下面临严重的客户端漂移问题，导致收敛变慢。现有正则化方法（FedProx）和方差缩减方法（SCAFFOLD）要么无法根本解决异质性，要么带来大量额外通信开销。本文旨在从表征层面探索新的协作机制。

Method: ASFL将网络划分为输入侧子网络y和输出侧子网络z，通过gossip通信模式在随机配对的客户端之间交换y产生的中间激活。在尾部轮次中，各客户端使用本地与远程激活的并集来训练尾部子网络z。方法包含：(1)基于成本-方差权衡的层选择机制；(2)通过子采样和复用远程激活的通信高效方案；(3)基于PixelDP的差分隐私保护机制；(4)针对非凸平滑目标的收敛性理论证明。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、FEMNIST四个基准测试中（Dirichlet α=0.1的非IID设置，100客户端，每轮10个活跃），ASFL相比FedAvg在CIFAR-10上提升约7.5%准确率，同时仅增加8MB通信开销。壁钟时间分析显示ASFL每轮训练时间最高减少33%，在所有数据集上均优于FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto、MOON、FedImpro、SplitFed等基线方法。结合PixelDP后，即使在中等噪声下ASFL仍优于无隐私保护的基线方法。t-SNE可视化显示ASFL的客户端类中心聚类更为紧凑。

Conclusion: ASFL是一种实用且高效的联邦学习加速方案，通过表征共享直接缓解数据异质性，在精度、通信开销和计算效率之间取得了优异平衡。理论分析证明了其收敛性，隐私分析验证了PixelDP下的隐私-效用优势。未来可研究服务器端激活聚合及更广泛的利用策略。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.

</details>


### [491] [Persistent Depth Ordering amid Shifting Block-Bypass Responses in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01165)
*Shengye Tao,Yinzhu Cheng,Haihua Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过在预训练多个检查点对Transformer块进行单块恒等旁路（identity bypass）干预，系统考察了语言模型深度敏感性的纵向演化。研究发现深度排序在训练中保持高度可识别，但响应幅度会重新分布，且大变化集中在可重复出现的特定位置和跨领域迁移的位置。控制实验表明，局部缺失更新幅度与下游匹配响应在训练中呈相反变化趋势，且依赖于扰动强度与方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往的语言模型可解释性研究大多仅考察单一训练检查点的层干预响应，忽略了预训练过程中表征与计算的演化。该研究旨在回答：哪些深度依赖的干预响应反映持久的内部组织结构，哪些只是训练的瞬态后果。深度作为直接坐标无需对齐学习特征或电路，为纵向持久性研究提供了天然切入点。

Method: 方法核心是在固定教师强制上下文上对单个Transformer块执行恒等旁路（用恒等映射替换完整块），测量下一个token预测的变化。关键步骤包括：(1) 在5条已发布的预训练轨迹（OLMo-2 1B/7B/13B、SmolLM2 1.7B、Pythia 1.4B）和Pythia-160M的6次复现训练上，覆盖11个模型-领域组合；(2) 评估5个训练阶段检查点（约10%-100%），使用WikiText-2、GSM8K、MBPP三种文本领域；(3) 通过Spearman秩相关比较深度排序持久性，通过最大变化位置的留出窗口分析和跨领域留一模板评估变化的位置集中度与跨域迁移；(4) 引入Jensen-Shannon散度等连续输出度量，并将自然旁路效应分解为局部缺失更新RMS与匹配相对扰动幅度下的下游响应，通过4个缩放尺度（γ∈{0.25,0.5,0.75,1}）和方向控制分离局部与下游变化。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 在11个模型-领域组合中，相邻检查点的深度秩相关中位数为0.906，端点相关中位数为0.675（范围0.380-0.785），且每个组合的相邻相关均高于端点相关，深度排序具有持久性；(2) 最大变化的⌈0.2L⌉个位置承担了65.5%的绝对端点变化（中位数），这些位置在留出窗口上仍保持51.0%-86.8%的变化份额（随机期望为21.4%-22.7%）；(3) 跨领域端点变化向量的Pearson相关中位数为0.954，留一领域模板预测的相关系数达0.944（范围0.875-0.993）；(4) 在Pythia-160M的6次复现中，自然局部相对RMS从0.3946增至0.5927（每次运行均增加），但匹配相对扰动幅度下的池化JS响应从0.02903降至0.02641，且该变化在γ=0.25时为正、γ≥0.75时为负，呈现尺度依赖性；(5) OLMo-2 7B呈现不同模式：局部相对RMS几乎不变，匹配响应与自然响应均下降；(6) 方向控制实验未发现预注册标准所要求的定向自然方向补偿证据。

Conclusion: 该研究得出结论：纵向层敏感性是结构化但非静态的。深度排序在训练中保持可关联，但响应幅度在特定位置发生集中且跨域可迁移的重新分布。块旁路效应不能简化为单一的下游敏感度——局部缺失更新幅度与匹配下游响应在Pythia中呈相反的池化趋势，且依赖于扰动强度与方向。因此，单检查点干预响应应结合扰动通路在训练中的演化来解读。研究的局限性包括：单轨迹比较、独立运行复现集中于Pythia-160M、未识别语义电路或因果分配、未验证安全联合剪枝、有限检查点与文本样本等。

Abstract: Layer interventions are widely used to probe the internal organization of language models, yet most analyses examine a single training checkpoint even though model representations and computations evolve throughout pretraining. This leaves open which depth-dependent intervention responses reflect persistent organization and which are transient consequences of training. We study this question using single-block identity bypass on fixed teacher-forced contexts across five released trajectories and 11 model-domain combinations. We find that block-bypass responses retain recognizable depth ordering while their magnitudes redistribute: nearby checkpoints preserve stronger rank correspondence than distant ones, and large changes concentrate at positions that recur across text samples and transfer across evaluation domains. Controlled experiments further show that changes in the natural bypass effect cannot be reduced to a single downstream sensitivity: in replicated Pythia runs, local missing-update magnitude grows while the pooled matched downstream response decreases, whereas OLMo-2 7B exhibits a different balance. These matched responses also depend on perturbation strength and direction, without identifying targeted compensation. Together, our results show that longitudinal layer sensitivity is structured but not static, and that single-checkpoint intervention responses should be interpreted in the context of how the underlying perturbation pathway evolves during training.

</details>


### [492] [Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01172)
*Jimin Seo,Gyubok Lee,Yeonsik Jo,Kiwoong Yoo,Yeongoon Kim,Minhae Oh,Jin Woo Koo,Suhwan Kim,Nakyung Lee,Minsik Seol,Idris Nechnech,Jaehyeon Kim,Giho Lee,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合Transformer-SSM架构中的学习率（LR）迁移问题，发现原始的μP参数化方案与AdamW优化器组合，在实际有限宽度（256-2048）下可实现近乎零的LR迁移差距（0.0%），并通过将LR迁移分解为"全局更新-权重不变性"和"局部逐组件平衡"两个条件来解释这一现象，且在生产级混合模型Nemotron-H上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合Transformer-SSM架构（如Mamba-2-Hybrid、Nemotron-H、Jamba等）已在生产级大语言模型中广泛应用，但训练此类模型需要对每个模型尺度重新调整超参数（尤其是学习率），这一过程成本高昂。理论上SSM操作超出了标准μP的Tensor Programs框架可表示性条件，导致现有理论无法解释实际混合架构中为何能实现LR迁移，理论与实践之间存在明显差距。

Method: 1. 对比四种参数化方案（标准参数化SP、朴素μP、逐块μP近似版、忠实μP块版本）在7种混合架构（MM、TT、MTMT、MHMH、HMHM、HHHH、HTHT）上的LR迁移表现；2. 在WikiText-2/103和FineWeb-Edu数据集上，使用AdamW优化器进行2k至60k步训练，扫描宽度256-2048和深度4-32；3. 通过坐标检查（coordinate check）诊断验证μP正确性；5. 提出"两条件分解"理论框架解释迁移机制；7. 在Nemotron-H生产模型和GLA-Transformer混合上验证泛化性；8. 进行优化器消融实验（AdamW vs SGD、Sophia、Muon）隔离各组件贡献。

Result: 1. 朴素μP+AdamW在所有7种测试架构上实现η*=1.0的LR迁移，转移差距高达0.0%（vs SP的1.1-8.7%差距）；2. 成功从代理模型（w=256, d=8, ~58M参数）迁移到目标（w=1024, d=32, ~624M-830M参数），约11-14倍参数放大；3. 在w=2048（1.24B-1.66B参数）上验证8×宽度迁移仍保持0.0%差距；4. 24.9B token的Chinchilla-horizon训练收敛；5. Nemotron-H上实现0.0%迁移差距；6. 优化器消融显示Adam的g/√v逐参数归一化是LR迁移的load-bearing组件，而动量和权重衰减非必需；7. 逐组件scaling test显示Vankara的ηA∝Nu规则在简化ZOH Mamba下不适用，反而在AdamW下与g/√v冗余导致性能下降5.6-7.7%；8. 朴素μP+AdamW相比SP基线节省78-82%的调参成本（4.5-5.6倍加速）。

Conclusion: 混合Transformer-SSM架构在实践中可通过原始（朴素）μP参数化与AdamW优化器组合实现LR迁移，跨越宽度8×和深度8×至十亿参数规模，迁移差距接近0%。该现象源于两条件分解：μP提供全局更新-权重不变性，AdamW的g/√v逐参数归一化提供跨SSM边界的局部逐组件平衡。标准坐标检查诊断不能预测混合架构上的LR迁移。所有测试的μP变体均未能通过坐标检查，但朴素μP仍能迁移。Vankara等的SSM特定规则在简化ZOH、固定Nx=16的实际设置下不传递条件二。这为实践者提供了使用μP+AdamW无需逐尺度调参训练混合架构的实证依据，并为未来弥合理论与实践差距提供了研究方向。

Abstract: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $\mu$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $\mu$P correctness. We attribute this to a two-condition decomposition of LR transfer in hybrid architectures: a global update-to-weight invariance, enforced by $\mu$P's initialization and LR scaling; and a local per-component balance, provided by AdamW's per-parameter normalization. Our observations show that the optimal LR is invariant to width up to 8$\times$, that this width invariance holds across depth, sequence length, batch size, and Transformer-to-SSM ratio, and that it transfers to Nemotron-H, a production hybrid outside our custom architecture set. We hope these findings fill the gap between theoretical scaling rules and practical hybrid implementations, and stimulate further research toward bridging it.

</details>


### [493] [CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01173)
*Santiago Florido Gomez,Stéphane Rivaud*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAGE-NAS提出了一种基于函数空间证书的渐进式神经网络生长方法，通过功能性梯度下降(FGD)的相对误差认证条件来决定何时停止优化并触发结构扩展，在固定参数预算内无需枚举即可发现性能处于前0.2%的紧凑架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有渐进式NAS方法（GradMax、Firefly、FRAGrow等）依赖启发式准则决定生长时机，但缺乏对当前表示在函数空间中跟随优化方向能力的直接刻画。训练与生长需要由一个共同的、关于表示是否充足的优化条件统一驱动。

Method: 1) 在函数空间中定义可接受性证书：对函数梯度r的有限维近似g_t，若相对误差ε_t=‖g_t−r‖/‖g_t‖<1/2，则FGD步被认证，保证充分下降。2) 主近似族来自切空间T_{A,θ}=range(J_{A,θ})，通过阻尼λ正则化的Tikhonov投影得到g_λ=Ju_λ；λ搜索通过SVD自适应设置（λ=ρσ²_max）。3) 当切空间族无法认证时，尝试非线性参数位移族（通过训练克隆网络跟随功能性下降轨迹）；两者均失败时触发函数保持的结构扩展（加神经元）。4) "在哪里生长"通过对每个候选位置ℓ比较一步扩展后的最小相对误差ℓ*∈argmin_ℓ ε_min(A⊕e_ℓ, θ⁺_ℓ)；外层步骤则使用最大表达瓶颈准则。

Result: 在控制合成基准（4维输入单值输出，sin非线性+交互+线性混合，无噪声，训练/验证1024、测试8192）上，从[2,2,2]起始：四个种子产生的架构[16,19,9]、[9,18,18]、[13,16,15]、[11,17,17]（参数560–593），测试RMSE 0.0613±0.0060；在严格≤600参数预算内对76,646个架构进行筛选（12,240个超参数对调优），CAGE-NAS在测试RMSE上位列>99.8百分位（种子0: 99.95，种子1: 99.88，种子2、3: 100.00），且全程不枚举备选方案。与固定架构从零重训对比（相同种子+验证选择）：生长在4个种子中赢3个（RMSE 0.0613 vs 0.0700）。

Conclusion: CAGE-NAS提供了一个基于优化理论（而非启发式）的train-and-grow统一准则：将"何时/何处/如何生长"完全由函数空间功能性梯度近似的可认证性决定。在受控环境下（含精确Jacobian、完整训练集用于认证），所发现的架构在同等参数预算内持续位于RMSE极端下尾，证明构造性搜索具有极高的效率。局限包括：评估限于固定深度3隐层MLP与单调加神经元；切空间族在p_A≥s时可能被插值效应绕过；缩放性效率（墙钟、FLOPs、内存、能耗）尚待未来工作。

Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

</details>


### [494] [Rethinking the Information Bottleneck: Structured Decomposition under Label-Induced Partitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01175)
*Jingyao Zhang,Yuxuan Li,Lu Han,Ali Anaissi,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于标签诱导分区的结构化双瓶颈信息瓶颈(IB)正则化方法DualKL。该方法通过标准KL项控制全局信息容量,条件KL项控制类内信息,并使用单纯形结构化条件先验实现可控的潜在几何。理论分析表明,条件KL可精确分解为类内信息项和先验不匹配项。在BloodMNIST、CIFAR-100以及视网膜血管/GLAS分割基准上的实验显示,该方法在低数据分类场景下增益最为显著,在密集预测任务中也有一致改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准信息瓶颈(IB)正则化通过单一标量I(Z;X)约束表示,将所有信息视为同质化,导致标签相关结构与类内残差变化耦合在一起。这种单一全局压缩控制无法独立调节标签相关结构与类内变化的分配,允许干扰信息在所学表示中持续存在。在数据有限场景下,模型容易过拟合此类变化,损害泛化能力。现有正则化方法虽然能稳定训练、控制容量或塑造几何结构,但未能显式分离类干扰变化与任务支持结构。

Method: 方法核心包括三个组成部分:(1)双瓶颈目标函数:在任务损失外同时加入标准KL项J_std(全局容量控制)和条件KL项J_cond(类内信息控制);(2)结构化条件先验:使用正单纯形顶点构造高斯条件先验r_ψ(z|c)=𝒩(μ_c,τ²I),其中μ_c=ρQs_c+b_0,实现对称可分离的几何结构;(3)共享固定方差参数化:固定τ=1,避免中心几何与方差适应耦合。理论上证明了条件KL的精确分解J_cond=I(Z;X|C)+𝔼_p(c)KL(q̄_θ(z|c)∥r_ψ(z|c)),以及任务约束下双轴上界控制定理。

Result: 在BloodMNIST上,DualKL在标准、1%训练数据、4-shot三种设定下均优于No Reg、CondKL和StdKL。1%数据下BAcc从63.49提升至72.22,4-shot下从45.31提升至48.72。在CIFAR-100低数据设定下也有类似趋势(4%数据BAcc从56.01提升至58.04)。视网膜血管分割(DRIVE、STARE、CHASEDB1)及GLAS分割任务中DualKL均取得最佳IoU和Dice。消融实验验证了单纯形先验加共享固定τ作为默认配置在所有测试变体中最优。

Conclusion: 本文提出了基于标签诱导分区的双瓶颈正则化视角,将全局容量控制与类内残差控制分离。主定理证明该双正则器同时上界两个结构上不同的残差信息轴——可见的类内干扰依赖和条件不可见的条件级编码——这是任何单术语瓶颈单独无法控制的。方法通过单纯形结构化条件先验和共享方差参数化实现,可无缝集成到现有分类或分割流程中。在低数据分类场景下增益最为显著,在密集预测基准上也表现稳定。局限在于其经验增益依赖于模型族、优化、任务损失以及类内变化是否真正为残差而非任务相关。未来可探索更丰富的条件先验族、更灵活的几何结构以及异质条件依赖残差结构。

Abstract: Standard information bottleneck (IB) regularization constrains representations via a single scalar I(Z;X), implicitlytreating all information as homogeneous. However, a single global compression control couples label-relevant structurewith residual within-condition variation, rather than regulating their allocation independently, allowing nuisanceinformation to persist in learned representations. For example, in medical imaging applications, residual variation oftenstems from acquisition conditions, background factors, or subject-specific appearance. This issue becomes particularlypronounced in data-limited settings, where models tend to overfit such variation, hindering generalization. While existingregularization methods can stabilize training, control capacity, or shape representation geometry, they do not explicitlyseparate nuisance-like variation from task-supporting structure. To address this limitation, we revisit IB from a structuredperspective based on a label-induced partition, where condition-level structure and within-condition information playdistinct roles. This leads to a dual-bottleneck formulation: a standard KL term controls global information capacity, while aconditional KL term targets within-condition information. We show that the conditional KL admits an exact decompositioninto a within-condition information term and a prior-mismatch term, explaining its alignment with the design this http URL a simplex-structured conditional prior, the method provides controllable latent geometry and integrates seamlesslyinto existing pipelines. Experiments on classification and segmentation show the clearest gains in low-data classificationand consistent improvements across dense prediction benchmarks.

</details>


### [495] [Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01181)
*S. Rasoul Etesami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对具有独立受控马尔可夫链且转移核未知的随机博弈，提出了一种完全在线、去中心化且无需同步的镜像下降算法。每个时间步仅使用单一样本进行更新，在对偶占用测度空间下近似求解平稳纳什均衡。核心贡献是高概率固定比较器遗憾上界为Õ(T^{-1/2})，复杂度仅依赖于各玩家局部状态空间的覆盖时间，避免了联合状态空间维度带来的指数依赖，并据此导出粗相关均衡保证；在附加变分稳定条件下，还证明了算法末次迭代渐近收敛到平稳ε-NE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中，局部受控动态、全局耦合收益与有限局部观测同时存在，使得去中心化均衡学习极具挑战。现有结构化博弈（如零和博弈、马尔可夫势博弈）的算法常需强结构性假设，难以涵盖局部动态独立但全局收益耦合的一般情形；而现有针对独立链博弈的工作多依赖已知转移核或分段同步协议，缺乏完全在线、无同步、可扩展的学习框架。此外，由于一般博弈中计算ε-NE为PPAD难问题，亟需给出不依赖额外博弈结构的有限时间均衡保证。

Method: 将原始随机博弈在对偶占用测度空间重新表述为虚拟静态博弈，使每个玩家在本地占用测度多面体上进行优化；提出"完全在线单样本占用镜像下降"算法（Algorithm 1），每个原始时间步采样一次动作与转移并执行一次近端更新；采用基于二元阈值的惰性置信集更新机制，置信集变化仅发生对数次数；通过延迟耦合将非平稳轨迹与冻结策略平稳过程比较，使用局部覆盖时间、混合系数和动作下界等参数控制跟踪与采样误差；通过将遗憾分解为优化误差、占用跟踪误差与单样本梯度估计误差三部分，依次给出镜像下降近端不等式、收缩条件下的占用差距界、以及基于延迟鞅差的梯度估计界；在附加变分稳定条件下，利用Lyapunov函数和可信集收敛性分析末次迭代收敛。

Result: 在一致遍历和有限覆盖假设下，以至少1−γ的概率证明：时间平均的固定比较器遗憾为Õ(T^{-1/2})，其中常数项包含S_{max}、H、δ、κ、n与对数因子，且复杂度仅依赖局部状态-动作空间大小与覆盖时间H，避免了乘积状态-动作空间的指数依赖；由此推出经验策略分布构成(ε_T+ε_δ)-粗相关均衡；在全局变分稳定（唯一稳定NE）与递减步长η_t∝(t+1)^{-a}（a∈(1/2,1]）条件下，置信可行占用q̂^t与真实占用q^t均收敛至虚拟博弈的唯一稳定NE q*，诱导的平稳策略构成原博弈的ε_δ-NE，其中ε_δ→0当动作下界δ→0。

Conclusion: 独立受控链结构足以在不依赖已知转移核或玩家间同步的前提下支撑完全在线去中心化学习；论文给出的单样本占用镜像下降算法在有限时间内具有Õ(T^{-1/2})的遗憾界，复杂度仅依赖局部参数，并能保证粗相关均衡；在附加稳定条件下，末次迭代可收敛至平稳ε-NE。该框架将在线MDP中的置信集占用优化拓展到多智能体场景，作为一种可独立利用局部结构的主对偶方法，为无线通信、能源管理与机器人导航覆盖等大规模去中心化系统的均衡学习提供了首个可扩展的在线方案。

Abstract: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space, avoiding exponential dependence on the number of players and the sizes of the joint state and action spaces. The resulting finite-time regret bound further yields an approximate coarse-correlated-equilibrium guarantee, which is natural for arbitrary reward functions since computing a stationary $\epsilon$-NE is PPAD-hard in this setting. Under an additional global variational-stability condition, we show that the same fully online algorithm converges asymptotically in the last iterate to a stationary $\epsilon$-NE. Our results provide a fully online and scalable learning framework for stochastic games with unknown independent chains. The algorithm can also be viewed as a primal-dual framework for Markov games that exploits the independence and local structure of the players' controlled transition chains.

</details>


### [496] [Low-Budget Active Learning through Entropic Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01199)
*Rim Hajal,Mathieu Besançon,Jérôme Malick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FW-Swap算法，利用熵正则化最优传输中的Sinkhorn散度作为低预算主动学习的核心集选择准则，结合Frank-Wolfe算法与基于交换的局部搜索，并提供了维度无关的泛化界与算法次优性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在标签获取成本高昂的场景（如医学应用）中，传统主动学习方法在极低预算下难以选出最具代表性的样本，导致下游分类器精度不足。现有方法（如k-medoids、k-centers、TypiClust、ProbCover、MaxHerding等）要么缺乏理论保证，要么在高预算下表现良好但低预算下退化。Sinkhorn散度提供了可微、可计算、且具有良好统计性质的代表性度量，但其在低预算组合选择问题中的使用尚缺乏针对性算法与理论分析。

Method: 1) 在预训练自监督模型（如SimCLR、DINOv3）提取的特征空间中，将核心集选择建模为离散组合优化问题：在B个点子集中最小化Sinkhorn散度D_ε；2) 提出FW-Swap两阶段算法：第一阶段用Frank-Wolfe（blended pairwise conditional gradient）求解松弛问题获取活跃集A，第二阶段对A中每个顶点运行基于梯度的交换局部搜索（沿负梯度方向单步交换）；3) 引入混合项λ=（1-λ）μ_x + λ μ_D以稳定边界处的Sinkhorn势计算；4) 理论上证明与D_ε相关的维度无关泛化界和算法次优性界（Theorem 1、Theorem 2）。

Result: 在STL-10、SVHN、GasHisSDB（病理图像）以及EEGMMIDB、WBCIC-SHU（脑电信号）共5个数据集上，FW-Swap在B∈[2, 60]的极低预算下几乎一致地优于随机采样、k-medoids、k-centers、TypiClust、ProbCover和MaxHerding等基线。Sinkhorn cost在正则化参数较大时会产生中心偏差，导致选择退化到质心（Proposition 1），而Sinkhorn divergence通过对称修正可消除该偏差。在EEGMMIDB B=2时FW-Swap达到0.805，远超次优Medoid（0.588）。算法轨迹分析显示其具有长尾+短循环结构，且核心集在90%以上的预算中保持稳定。Sinkhorn散度作为核心集选择准则具有O(1/n)收敛率且与维度无关。

Conclusion: FW-Swap是首个为低预算主动学习的组合结构量身定制的基于熵最优传输的方法，同时具备Sinkhorn散度的优良统计性质（维度无关泛化界）和针对组合搜索的次优性保证。低预算（极小B）下表现尤为突出，对医学应用（脑电、病理图像）有较高实用价值。局限性在于依赖自监督特征质量、O(n²)成本矩阵对大数据集计算昂贵、以及高预算下性能优势减弱。

Abstract: We consider low-budget active learning, which consists of selecting a limited number of points, the coreset, such that a model can be trained to high accuracy on the selection only. This problem is particularly relevant in contexts where labeling requires costly expert intervention, as in medical applications. We leverage features extracted from a pretrained self-supervised model to represent the data, and perform coreset selection directly in this feature space. In this paper, we use entropic optimal transport, specifically the Sinkhorn divergence, as the coreset selection criterion, which first allows us to get dimension-free sample complexity results, and second admits computationally efficient gradient evaluations. This opens the way to using gradient-based algorithms to rapidly compute solution candidates, further improved by a swap-based local search, with guarantees on the solution quality. Experiments on image benchmarks and medical datasets show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art heuristics in low-budget settings.

</details>


### [497] [Autoregressive Drillhole Modelling Under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01204)
*Yihao Ding,Daniel Yitian Su,Yiran Zhang,Christopher M. Gonzalez,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将矿物勘探钻孔数据建模为自回归序列预测任务，提出了DrillBench基准（含49,671个西澳钻孔）和一个"迁移安全"的训练-推理配方，揭示了直接条件化（坐标+地球化学）会形成"迁移边界"，而自回归层序建模在跨域迁移中更稳健；通过结合大规模预训练（PT）与空间邻域检索（R），在保持分布内性能的同时显著提升跨省地质迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有钻孔建模方法主要依赖空间插值/重建或掩码建模，缺乏严格的自回归预测范式。作者将钻孔过程（由浅入深逐层揭示岩性）视为天然的自回归预测场景，旨在填补这一研究空白。核心动机是：直接条件化（坐标与地球化学）在分布内表现优异但在强分布偏移下急剧恶化，形成"迁移边界"；因此需要一种在不暴露绝对坐标与化验值的前提下兼顾本地适应与跨域泛化的方法。

Method: 1) DrillBench基准：49,671个钻孔、37类标准化岩性词汇、六类数据划分（in-distribution + 两级空间偏移ood-regional/ood-distal + 跨省迁移pilbara-test）；任务包括下一层预测（Task 1，macro-F1）与自由生成（Task 2，联合KL）。2) 层级别自回归骨干（GRU/Transformer），仅以岩性序列为输入。3) 多任务预训练（PT）：在~112k孔的WA-DASC-full档案上训练，引入gap token化与地球化学辅助损失。4) 空间检索（R）：利用k=10最近邻（来自train+档案，排除25m内重复孔），以逆距离加权投票获取邻域岩性分布，经MLP融合但不直接暴露坐标。5) 统一评估协议：所有方法输出1m网格上的{CONT, 岩性}分布，使用相同的校准与评分代码。

Result: 1) 直接条件化暴露迁移边界：GRU+location的test macro-F1达73.6%，但pilbara-test骤降至0.5%。2) 序列自回归模型迁移更稳健：层级别GRU在test/OOD-R/OOD-D/Pilbara上分别达59.4%/37.4%/28.3%/28.2%。3) 检索与预训练互补：GRU+R在分布内达70.0%（+10.7点），GRU+PT在跨省迁移最佳（Pilbara 31.7%）；全配方（GRU+PT+R）在OOD-D达37.2%、Pilbara达30.6%。4) Task 2生成：全配方在OOD-D与Pilbara的联合KL最低（0.408与0.458）。5) 零样本LLM（如GPT-6）在跨域迁移中表现反常地优于分布内，暗示其依赖广泛地质先验。6) 失败集中于源域支持稀少的岩性类别。

Conclusion: 钻孔岩性序列建模应建立在层级别自回归骨干之上以获得迁移稳健性；直接条件化（坐标/地球化学）虽然在分布内有效，但会形成清晰的迁移边界。大规模历史档案预训练提供跨地质域的可迁移先验，空间检索则提供本地连续性证据，二者在不同地质体制（风化覆盖vs基岩）下互补。该工作表明有效的地下建模不仅需要更强的序列模型，更需要围绕地质结构、数据稀疏性与区域偏移设计的机制。

Abstract: Autoregressive modelling has achieved remarkable success in language and sequence tasks by learning to predict future states from previous observation. Mineral-exploration drillholes provide a natural but largely unexplored setting for this paradigm: as drilling proceeds, lithology is revealed sequentially from shallow to deep, making prediction of deeper strata inherently autoregressive. Existing drillhole modelling, however, is dominated by spatial interpolation and reconstruction, or largely rely on masked modelling, leaving strictly autoregressive prediction largely underexplored. We introduce DrillBench, a benchmark of 49,671 Western Australian drillholes for next-layer prediction and autoregressive stratigraphic generation across a graded transfer spectrum, from local prediction through spatial shift to cross geological province transfer. Benchmarking classical, geostatistical, and neural models reveals a clear \emph{transfer boundary}: spatial and geochemical conditioning provides large local gains but deteriorates sharply under stronger shift, whereas lithology-sequence autoregressive models transfer more robustly. Guided by this finding, we develop a backbone-agnostic recipe combining large-scale pretraining on historical drillholes with spatial retrieval of neighbouring lithology. Retrieval is most effective in weathered cover, when local spatial continuity remains informative, whereas pretraining contributes more strongly in bedrock and under broader geological shift. Together, they retain strong local performance while improving generalisation under spatial and cross-province shift, most markedly on the most distant splits. The benchmark and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [498] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对潜在世界模型（latent world model）在潜在空间规划中无法保留任务成功判定所需物理量精度的问题，提出一种以成功判定量（success-criterion quantities）作为训练目标的辅助损失。该方法在训练时通过共享线性头从编码器与预测器输出回归成功判定量，训练后丢弃头部，推理过程与基线一致。在PushT和cube任务上分别带来3.5%和3.4%的绝对成功率提升（均具有统计显著性），并在冻结编码器系统中得到复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过潜在空间距离对候选动作序列排序以进行规划，但任务成功与否由物理量（即成功判定量）决定。现有潜在世界模型通常仅将成功判定量作为输入而非训练目标，导致潜在状态对成功判定量的编码精度超过公差，无法区分成功与失败候选。作者发现，在所考察的四种潜在世界模型中，末端执行器位置在潜在状态中的线性读出误差均超过成功判定公差。

Method: 方法为附加辅助损失：在编码器与预测器输出上各接一个线性头（共享权重），回归成功判定量，将回归误差加至训练损失。线性头仅在训练时使用，训练后丢弃，因此推理时模型结构、计算开销与输入均不变。损失公式对每个成功判定量p^(k)设置权重λ_k与归一化因子d_k，分别在编码器输出与预测器输出上计算均方误差。

Result: 在五个操控任务上评估LeWM与冻结编码器系统。四个任务的某种监督方案带来统计显著的成功率提升：PushT全部监督+3.5%、cube物体监督+3.4%、stack全部监督+5.05%、coffee物体监督+3.9%；Reacher无显著提升。按试验层级（reach-only与manipulation）分析发现，仅监督部分量时存在互补性退化：手监督改善reach-only但退化manipulation，反之亦然；同时监督所有量则避免退化。冻结DINOv2编码器系统在stack上复现提升。冻结V-JEPA 2为反例：读出改善但成功率反而下降。

Conclusion: 成功判定量明确了世界模型在潜在状态中必须保留的信息，可作为训练目标使用。实践规则：任务附带成功判定时，监督其中所有物理量。该规则不改变测试时的模型，且同时监督所有量在任何任务上均未导致显著退化。然而，读出精度提升与成功率提升不完全对应，潜在世界模型中辅助损失提升成功率的机制尚未完全阐明。局限包括：每种条件仅使用单一训练种子、辅助损失权重仅在stack上扫描、冻结V-JEPA 2复现失败。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [499] [Mixture-Trained Merging for Unified Multi-Objective Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01238)
*SeongHyeon Kim,Chaeyun Jang,Seungyoo Lee,Jiyeon Ham,Yunju Bak,Boseop Kim,Juho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM)方法，通过在多个目标的数据混合上训练每个分支而非单一目标，使分支在权重空间保持兼容性，从而解决硬专家合并时的领域性能退化和think/non-think模式崩溃问题。MTM通过迭代机制结合多目标贝叶斯优化(qNEHVI)搜索合并系数，在Qwen3-4B-Base和OLMo-7B上均优于现有合并方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建统一多目标语言模型时，传统单轨迹训练对训练顺序、数据比例敏感，工程成本高；而权重空间合并硬单目标专家时会出现两类失败：(1)领域专家合并时各领域性能剧烈下降；(2)think/non-think专家合并时模式崩溃为单一行为。作者将此归因于独立训练的专家在权重空间中漂移到不兼容区域，其插值路径不在共享低损失盆地内。

Method: MTM包含两个变体：MTM-Single（单轮，训练软专家后选择合并权重）和MTM-Multi（迭代多轮）。核心方法：(1)每个分支在偏向其目标域的混合数据上训练（软专家），而非纯单目标；(2)利用MergeMix近似——合并行为≈混合训练行为——将混合比例搜索转化为合并评估；（4)使用qNEHVI多目标贝叶斯优化在合并单纯形上高效搜索候选集X_t；(3)每轮三步：训练软专家→评估合并景观→选择全局合并系数提升基准模型，并基于领域偏好选择带约束的合并系数更新下一轮分支混合比例；(5)跨轮迭代将合并回退到共享参考模型，防止分支累积漂移。

Result: 在多领域设置（math/code/IF，Qwen3-4B-Base和OLMo-7B）：MTM-Multi取得最高平均分（Qwen: 69.74，OLMo: 64.10），是唯一在三个目标上同时接近单目标专家水平的方法。在混合模式设置（OLMo-7B）：Linear Merge出现模式崩溃（长度-准确率段几乎退化），MTM保持模式分离同时将前沿向左上推移（no-think更短、think准确率匹配或超过Mixture Training）。跨架构迁移（Qwen3-4B→Qwen2.5-0.5B）平均37.53，高于Merge(34.14)和Mixture(33.37)。三元热力图显示软分支在合并单纯形内部产生更平坦、更高值的区域，几何上证实合并性是分支属性而非合并器属性。训练预算仅为单轨迹基线的0.70-0.75倍。

Conclusion: 硬单目标专家合并的不兼容源于权重空间几何漂移；通过将各分支训练为目标偏向的数据混合（而非单目标），可使分支在权重空间中保持兼容。MTM通过合并驱动的高效信号选择分支混合、迭代进行分支专门化和再对齐，并以合并评估同时承担混合搜索和模型构建，在统一多目标模型上取得最佳性能，证实"可合并性应由训练阶段培养而非仅靠后处理合并规则实现"。局限：仅在SFT阶段验证，扩展到更大目标集和RL后训练是未来方向。

Abstract: Unified language models are increasingly expected to combine heterogeneous capabilities, such as mathematics, code, instruction following, and controllable thinking behavior, within a single set of parameters. A common solution is sequential post-training on multiple objectives, but this entangles all objectives along one optimization trajectory and makes the final model highly sensitive to training order, data ratios, schedules, and stopping criteria. Weight-space merging offers a modular alternative, but naive merging of single-objective experts often fails: domain capabilities degrade sharply, or think/non-think modes collapse into one dominant behavior. We attribute both failures to incompatible weight-space geometry: experts trained on single objectives drift to distant regions of parameter space, placing their interpolations outside any shared low-loss basin. We propose Mixture-Trained Merging (MTM), which trains each branch on an objective-biased data mixture rather than a single objective, exposing it to cross-objective interactions and making branches compatible at merge time. MTM uses merged-model evaluations as a low-cost signal for selecting branch mixtures, avoiding expensive data-mixture ablations. The procedure is iterative: each round promotes the base model using globally selected merge coefficients and refines each branch mixture using domain-preferred coefficients under constraints that preserve other objectives. To scale beyond simplex grid search, MTM uses qNEHVI-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization. Across code, mathematics, instruction following, and think/non-think control, MTM outperforms naive merging and preserves behavioral separation where single-objective merging collapses, suggesting that effective unified models require branches trained to be mergeable.

</details>


### [500] [Context-Aware Error Mitigation Orchestration for Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning on NISQ Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01253)
*Bisma Majid,Shabir Ahmed Sofi,Mir Mohammad Yousuf*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出APGEM框架，将误差缓解从静态预处理转变为QRL训练循环内的自适应上下文感知决策层，基于LinUCB上下文老虎机在ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM和NoMitigation之间动态选择，在30个CVRPLIB基准实例上达到oracle策略效用的94.2%，显著优于固定策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在NISQ设备上运行的量子强化学习受退相干、门不完美和测量误差影响，现有误差缓解技术（ZNE、PEC、CDR、REM）通常作为静态固定修正应用，无法适应动态噪声环境或训练状态的演变，导致QRL策略质量下降和学习不稳定。需要一种上下文感知的自适应编排机制。

Method: 1. 混合QRL-CVRP框架：变分量子电路作为策略网络，REINFORCE策略梯度+精确参数移位规则训练；2. 可行性保证解码器：覆盖保持构造+最便宜插入修复，确保完整可行路径；3. 显式NISQ噪声建模（去极化、去相位、振幅阻尼、读出）；4. APGEM控制器采用LinUCB上下文老虎机，17维上下文向量（基特征+噪声轴的RBF基特征），代价感知效用函数U=σ(k(F_M-F0))-αC_M-βV_M平衡保真度增益、采样成本与估计方差；5. 期望效用oracle作为上界参考。

Result: 1. 经典基线验证：OR-Tools和Clarke-Wright最强（AR≈1.04，统计不可区分），Friedman检验p=1.5×10⁻²⁴；2. 量子策略可行性100%，在P-n16-k8上从629.3降至610.8（2.08%改进），但绝对质量随规模增长劣于经典（AR从1.16升至3.35）；3. APGEM上下文依赖选择：2600次决策中ZNE 39.8%、PEC 25.4%、NoMit 15.9%、REM 13.4%、CDR 5.5%，低噪声选NoMit，低噪声+读出选REM，低中噪声选PEC（74%），中噪声选ZNE（73%），严重噪声选CDR；4. 60个条件下APGEM达到oracle效用94.2%，显著优于固定修复（p=5.05×10⁻²³）；5. 期望遗憾0.0151接近不可约噪声层0.0171；6. 噪声鲁棒性：噪声0.10时保真度0.794 vs 无修复0.684。

Conclusion: APGEM将误差缓解转变为QRL训练循环内的自适应运行时组件，学习可解释的上下文感知缓解策略，逼近oracle水平性能且显著优于静态修复方法。量子策略组件是可行性与学习的演示而非量子优势声明；自适应缓解层是框架的核心贡献。量子策略在大规模实例上的表示能力是主要遗留挑战。

Abstract: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) integrates reinforcement learning with parameterized quantum circuits and is a promising approach to combinatorial optimization. On Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices, however, decoherence, gate imperfections, and measurement errors reduce policy quality and make learning less reliable. Existing error mitigation techniques are generally applied as fixed corrections that do not adapt to changing noise conditions or to the evolving state of training. This work presents Adaptive Policy-Guided Error Mitigation (APGEM) as a context-aware orchestration layer of the hybrid quantum-classical training loop that dynamically selects the most suitable mitigation strategy during QRL training. APGEM evaluates Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Clifford Data Regression (CDR), and Readout Error Mitigation (REM) using policy-level indicators, including quantum-state fidelity, policy entropy, cumulative reward, and approximation ratio, and integrates the selected strategy directly into the reinforcement learning loop. The framework is evaluated on the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), a representative NP-hard problem in urban logistics, under a range of NISQ noise models and noise levels. APGEM consistently outperforms conventional static mitigation methods, reaches approximately 94% of the utility of an oracle strategy, maintains higher quantum-state fidelity as noise increases, and produces more stable learning behaviour throughout training. Ablation studies show that the framework learns context-aware mitigation policies that adapt to different noise environments and circuit execution conditions. These findings demonstrate that integrating adaptive error mitigation into the learning process substantially improves the robustness and reliability of QRL on NISQ hardware.

</details>


### [501] [IQS-BO: In-Context Query Selection for Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01269)
*Luca Geminiani,Nadja Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IQS-BO，一种基于PFN的上下文贝叶斯优化方法，将查询选择问题转化为在候选集上的监督分类任务，通过交叉熵损失学习选择最优候选的后验概率，支持完全上下文或结合固定代理模型两种模式，并提出混合先验以提升优化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化（BO）在每一轮都需要重新拟合代理模型并数值优化采集函数，计算成本高。现有基于PFN的上下文方法（PFNs4BO、FIBO、NAP等）各有局限：PFNs4BO仍需采集函数优化，FIBO固定决策规则且无法结合代理模型，NAP等通过强化学习学习评分但训练信号稀疏。本文旨在通过监督学习在合成先验上直接学习查询决策规则。

Method: 1）将查询选择转化为多分类任务，标签为噪声-free 真实函数在候选集中最大值的索引；2）用Transformer处理观测和候选token，通过交叉熵损失训练，最优解为候选为最佳的后验概率；3）三种变体：无代理模型（IQS-BO）、结合PFN代理（IQS-BO-PFN）、结合GP代理（IQS-BO-GP）；4）提出混合先验，融合GP样本与输入扭曲、局部高斯凸包、平台函数等难以被平稳核GP建模的函数族；5）批量BO通过顺序选择与pending token实现多样化。

Result: 在10个3D和5个4D基准测试上，IQS-BO在混合先验下预训练后，其三种变体在平均秩和胜率上一致优于PFNs4BO、FIBO和NAP，并与基于GP的BO（GP-MAP/GP-FB）相当或更优。批量优化（q=10,20,50）方面，IQS在每个批量大小下均达到最高GAP，且提案速度比GP方法快1-3个数量级，比PFNs4BO快两个数量级以上。消融实验验证了候选集组成（含最优观测扰动）、批量顺序选择和混合先验的重要性。

Conclusion: IQS-BO通过将BO查询选择重新定义为监督分类问题，实现了一种高效、可扩展的上下文BO方法。其交叉熵目标的最小值对应于候选为最佳的后验概率，使其逼近贝叶斯最优决策规则。混合先验的引入进一步提升了性能，尤其是在小上下文和早期评估阶段。未来的方向包括训练跨维度和批量大小的统一模型、联合学习候选集设计以及超越单步选择的目标。

Abstract: Bayesian Optimisation (BO) is a powerful framework for the optimisation of expensive black-box functions, but typically requires refitting a surrogate and maximising an acquisition function at every evaluation step. In-context approaches based on Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) amortise part of this cost by pre-training transformers on functions drawn from synthetic priors. PFNs4BO amortises the surrogate but still relies on a numerically maximised acquisition function, while FIBO performs BO fully in-context by sampling optimiser locations from a learned density, which fixes the decision rule and admits no surrogate. Learned acquisition functions score a finite candidate set with a trained network, but, lacking a label for the query, learn the score by reinforcement learning on previously solved tasks. We propose IQS-BO, a PFN that learns the query decision by supervised learning on synthetic priors. In a single forward pass, IQS-BO predicts the probability that each candidate maximises the objective over the set, and we show that the minimiser of its objective is the posterior probability of this event. The model can be pre-trained without a surrogate for fully in-context BO, or take the predictions of a fixed probabilistic surrogate as additional input, amortising only the decision step. Our method proposes queries at a fraction of the cost of acquisition-based methods, while either matching or outperforming standard BO with Gaussian processes (GPs) and available in-context methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. Finally, we propose a mixture prior for pre-training PFNs which combines samples from GPs with functions exhibiting warped inputs, isolated narrow optima, or plateaus that are poorly modeled by stationary kernels common in GP surrogates. We show that pre-training on this prior can lead to improved optimisation performance.

</details>


### [502] [Not All Is Lost: Repairing Lossy User Preference States of Personalization Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01270)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Dhiraj Golhar,Ummesalma Diwan,Sourish Dasgupta,Manjunath Joshi,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出REPAIR方法，通过利用冻结编码器缓存的逐时间步表征来修复被压缩的用户偏好状态，无需重新编码历史或修改编码器，在12个推荐模型上均能显著提升排序性能，并在个性化生成任务中改善个性化响应指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化编码器将交互历史压缩为单一偏好状态供下游任务头使用，但压缩过程中可能丢失有用的偏好证据，导致任务头仅基于该状态时性能受限。现有工作多关注改进编码器内部表示或修改冻结行为，但未探讨是否可以利用同一冻结前向计算中已缓存的逐时间步表征来选择性修正已形成的偏好状态。

Method: REPAIR被插入到冻结编码器与原始任务头之间：1)将缓存表征与当前偏好状态映射到共享空间，计算状态相对残差；2)通过K=128维低秩学习坐标读取修正信号；3)使用长/短/情景支持三种时序基函数解析修正证据的时序结构；4)通过自适应top-ν选择器筛选贡献最大的时间步-坐标组合；5)将聚合修正通过残差门控融合加回原始状态。训练目标包含任务效用、时步溯源、源一致性三个损失家族。

Result: 在MovieLens、PENS、MIND、Amazon Reviews 2023四个数据集、12个推荐模型上，冻结编码器和任务头仅训练REPAIR即可在MRR和nDCG@10上全面超越仅微调任务头的基线（如Mamba4Rec在MovieLens上MRR提升3.96对比0.19）。K=128为最优修正维度，三个时序分支联合使用在11/12设置中最佳。在个性化生成中，IMPerSumm在PerSEval加权变体上提升高达25.23%。

Conclusion: 压缩后的偏好状态仍可通过同一冻结前向计算中缓存的逐时间步表征进行有效修正，区分了偏好证据的可获得性与下游使用方式，为无需更新编码器即可改进已部署个性化模型提供了新途径。未来工作可探索更紧凑缓存预算下的证据保留及下游接口对修复状态的更好利用。

Abstract: Personalization encoders compress evolving interaction histories into preference states used to rank items or condition text generation. A task head operating only on this state can miss useful evidence that remains in the frozen encoder's cached representations for individual timesteps. We study this recoverability gap and propose REPAIR, which compares cached representations with the current preference state in a compact learned coordinate space. It resolves corrective evidence over extended history, recent interactions, and localized bursts. It then selects which patterns at which timesteps contribute and adds their aggregate correction to the state before the task head. Encoder-host repair reuses representations from the existing forward computation without re-encoding the history. Across MovieLens, PENS, MIND, and Amazon Reviews 2023, training only REPAIR improves MRR and nDCG@10 for all twelve representative recommendation hosts while both encoder and task head remain frozen. Head-only finetuning of the same hosts yields smaller gains. For example, Mamba4Rec on MovieLens gains 3.96 MRR points, compared with 0.19 from head-only finetuning. Rank and temporal diagnostics support a compact, host-dependent corrective structure. In personalized generation, IMPerSumm improves the two reported weighted PerSEval variants, which assess responsiveness to user preference, by up to 25.23%. These results support post-compression state correction and distinguish the availability of preference evidence from its downstream use.

</details>


### [503] [EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01315)
*Qiuliang Liu,Liming Wu,Qi Li,Zhonglong Peng,Chang Chen,Xiaolong Chen,Wenbing Huang,Shifeng Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EP-Flow提出了一种用于无位点标注的无序晶体结构预测的流匹配框架，通过占据分布矩阵（ODM）在公式依赖的传输多面体上进行生成，在COD和MPDS基准上达到了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有晶体生成器假设有序结构或需要位点级无序标注，而近47%的ICSD结构存在某种形式的无序；仅给定化学公式时，如何从全局化学式推断位点级占据分布是一个关键挑战。

Method: 1）将无序晶体表示为占据分布矩阵（ODM），满足行和、列和及非负性约束，位于公式依赖的传输多面体上；2）通过log域双中心化将异构多面体映射到共享的零边际子空间；3）在该子空间学习保边际的流匹配；4）通过Sinkhorn逆映射恢复有效ODM；5）联合生成占据、分数坐标和晶格参数。

Result: 在COD和MPDS四个子集（Sub-20/50、Disorder-20/50）上，EP-Flow的匹配率达到17.10%-60.82%，显著优于适配的FlowMM、OMatG和DMFlow基线；案例研究显示该方法可恢复化学上有意义的局部无序模式（如氧空位局域化于CuO₂平面外、间隙N占据等）。

Conclusion: EP-Flow通过几何流匹配框架统一处理有序晶体、取代无序、空位无序和间隙占据，将异构传输多面体规范化到共享子空间并通过Sinkhorn恢复实现严格的组分约束，为无位点标注的无序晶体生成提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

</details>


### [504] [Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01317)
*Pascal Janetzky,Yuxin Wang,Michael Klar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PPNAS提出了一种基于预测驱动推理（PPI）的神经架构搜索方法，通过结合少量带真实性能标签的架构和大量仅有零成本代理（ZCP）分数的架构的排序监督信息，实现了标签高效NAS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS中候选架构评估面临固有矛盾：可靠的真实性能标签获取成本高但数量有限，而零成本代理（ZCPs）虽可大规模廉价计算但存在噪声。如何有效结合这两种监督信号尚不明确。

Method: PPNAS采用预测驱动推理框架，将真值排序监督与ZCP诱导的排序监督相结合。具体包括：(1)构建成对排序监督表示；(2)设计整流目标函数L^Y(θ) + λ[L_ZCP^Z(θ) - L_GT^Z(θ)]，其中整流项修正ZCP排序与真值排序之间的系统差异；(3)使用架构级Hájek贡献自适应调整ZCP权重λ；(5)通过单个拟合模型的参数协方差实现UCB不确定性感知采集。

Result: 在NB201/NB101/TNB基准上的实验表明，PPNAS在标签受限NAS中达到SOTA：中位数排名1.5 vs. 第二名3.0；在不同ZCP（synflow、jacov、nwot、grad_norm、snip、grasp）、不同初始预算n∈{5,20,50}、不同未标注集大小N∈{50,...,3000}、不同架构编码（one-hot、arch2vec）、不同搜索空间下均保持最佳排名；在ZCP方向误指定的压力测试下仍具鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PPNAS是首个将预测驱动推理应用于标签高效NAS的工作，通过原则性融合稀缺的真值监督和大规模ZCP诱导排序，实现了跨数据集、搜索空间和ZCP的一致性能提升。未来可扩展至LLM和标度律研究。

Abstract: Evaluating candidate architectures in neural architecture search (NAS) faces an inherent trade-off: on the one hand, reliable performance labels are limited because training and evaluating architectures is costly; on the other hand, zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) are cheap to compute at large scale but can be noisy. Yet, how to effectively combine these two sources of supervision remains unclear. In this paper, we propose PPNAS, a novel prediction-powered inference (PPI) approach for NAS. PPNAS fuses (1) a small set of architectures with observed performance labels and (2) a large set of architectures with ZCP information. To combine these two sources of supervision, PPNAS exploits the ordinal information provided by ZCPs to construct additional pairwise ranking supervision, while PPI debiases systematic discrepancies between ZCP-based and true performance rankings. We evaluate PPNAS in end-to-end predictor-based NAS, where it achieves state-of-the-art under limited evaluation budgets. To the best of our knowledge, PPNAS is the first prediction-powered approach for label-efficient NAS.

</details>


### [505] [Clifford Sheaf Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01322)
*Kotaro Kamiya,Joel Nicholls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN)，一种等变的几何图神经网络，通过将Clifford代数置于细胞层（cellular sheaf）的每个stalk上，并沿边传输多重向量（multivector）特征。核心创新是用"K项三明治"（K-term sandwich）替代传统的versal共轭作为限制映射（restriction map），从而在保留正半定性的同时实现跨grade特征混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 几何图学习需要尊重空间对称性的架构。Clifford代数提供等变的多grade特征表示，但传统的versal共轭限制映射表达力弱且无法跨grade传输。细胞层Sheaf的图拉普拉斯算子允许学习传输，但versal约束在训练中难以维持。需要一种既能保持拉普拉斯算子正半定性、又允许跨grade信息流动的架构。

Method: 1. 将Clifford代数Cl(p,q,r)置于每个stalk，定义K项三明治限制映射 ∑_k a_k·x·b_k，其中a_k, b_k为多重向量。
2. 引入归一化反转三明治 s_c(x) = c·x·c̃/q(c) 作为具体实例，c为限制元素。
3. 限制元素由节点自身特征和边几何通过等变多重向量神经元（MVN）模块协变生成。
4. 利用Clifford标量积定义伴随，保证 ℒ = δ*δ 形式的正半定性。
5. 从三个轴刻画限制映射族：grade耦合（grade coupling）、可达性（reachability，即在End空间中的覆盖范围）和条件性（conditioning）。证明K项三明治在Cl(3,0,0)中恰好覆盖与中心pseudo scalar对易的半部分（64维中的32维）。

Result: 1. CSNN的Sheaf Laplacian ℒ = δ*δ 构造上正半定，无需versal约束。
2. 反转三明治 s_c 在Cl(3,0,0)中限于grade {0,1}和{2,3}，因此CSNN是一阶模型（仅含L=0和L=1表示），与PaiNN同类而非Equiformer等高阶张量模型。
3. 在Cl(3,0,0)中达到SO(3)等变，在Cl(3,0,1)中达到SE(3)等变。
4. 表达力随项数K增长：Cl(3,0,0)中可达维度为14→24→30→32（K=1到4），Cl(3,0,1)中为31→60→87→112→…→128。
5. 反转三明治是单比条件化：κ = ((1+r)/(1-r))²，其中r = ‖w_vec‖/w₀。
6. 显式给出了嵌套三明治形式（公式12）和反向传播所需的伴随公式（公式10）。

Conclusion: CSNN将Clifford多重向量stalk与Sheaf Laplacian统一，通过反转三明治族提供正半定的等变架构，无需versal假设且支持跨grade信息混合。三轴分析表明反转三明治是条件化的grade-confined一阶角落，K项三明治覆盖End空间的半部分，表达力随K递增。该架构被定位为图级等变回归的首个Sheaf构造。

Abstract: We introduce the Clifford Sheaf Neural Network (CSNN), an equivariant sheaf neural network for geometric graphs that places a Clifford algebra on each stalk of a cellular sheaf and transports multivector features along edges. The canonical choice of restriction map for sheaves with algebra-valued stalks is algebra homomorphism. Adding the constraint of equivariance, the naive choice becomes versor conjugation. However, versor conjugation is expressively weak, so we drop algebra homomorphism and arrive at the K-term sandwich. The resulting sheaf Laplacian is positive semidefinite by construction, needs no versor constraint, and still mixes grades. Our main contribution characterizes the resulting family of restriction maps along three axes: which grades a map couples, how much of the endomorphism space it reaches, and how well it is conditioned. The K-term sandwich spans half of the endomorphism space, and in Cl(3, 0, 0) it corresponds to the maps that commute with the central pseudoscalar. The number of terms controls expressivity. CSNN is the reversion member, a first-order model by construction and the grade-mixing corner of this family, developed as a sheaf construction for graph-level equivariant regression.

</details>


### [506] [Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01343)
*Anthony Dugois,Vincent Fagnon,Giorgio Lucarelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非透明（non-clairvoyant）单机调度问题中最小化完工时间总和的鲁棒优化方法，提出了一种基于分类器混淆矩阵的新型鲁棒性框架。该框架将不确定性刻画为每个预测类别内作业的排列集合，规避了经典鲁棒度量（如Min-Max、Min-Max Regret）的计算困难。研究首先证明了Min-Cost（非自适应算法）对三种鲁棒准则均为最优；随后证明了在Min-Max Regret和Min-Expectation问题中，自适应或随机化算法可以超越非自适应算法，特别是在Min-Expectation问题中两者性能差距渐近大于4/3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典非透明调度问题中，由于作业处理时间未知，不存在常数竞争比的算法。现有学习增强算法通常用一个标量衡量预测质量，无法捕捉分类器预测的结构化错误模式（如将某些类别系统性误分类）。本文旨在利用分类模型的混淆矩阵所提供的结构化信息，弥合这一空白，构造可处理的鲁棒性保证。

Method: 1. 提出基于混淆矩阵的鲁棒性框架：作业被分为K类，每类的真实处理时间未知，但分类器的K×K混淆矩阵已知，从而将不确定性建模为每个预测队列ℛ_k内作业的排列。2. 定义三种鲁棒准则：Min-Max、Min-Max Regret和Min-Expectation。3. 提出非自适应算法Min-Cost（按平均处理时间升序处理每个队列）。4. 设计随机化算法Rand-Half（从三个序列中按概率抽样）以改善Min-Max Regret。5. 设计动态规划DP算法求解Min-Expectation的最优自适应策略，并提出启发式Half-and-Check用于构造渐近性能比下界。6. 利用块分解和递归分析，对特定实例族M_{K,x}证明非自适应与自适应算法的性能比下界。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）Min-Cost对Min-Max问题是最优算法（定理1），自适应或随机化算法也无法超越（引理1）；（2）Min-Cost对Min-Expectation问题在非自适应算法类中最优（定理2）；（3）对二元分类器，Min-Cost的Min-Max Regret上界为s_2·L_1·(λ_L-λ_s)（定理3），且任何确定性算法的下界亦相同（定理4）；（4）随机化算法Rand-Half在特定混淆矩阵结构下可打破确定性下界（定理5）；（5）DP算法为Min-Expectation问题的最优自适应算法，复杂度为O(K·e_max^{K²})（定理6）；（6）最优非自适应与最优自适应算法的期望成本比渐近大于4K/(3K+1)（定理7）。

Conclusion: 本文成功建立了一种新的基于分类模型与混淆矩阵的鲁棒优化框架，能够有效处理非透明调度中的不确定性。所提出的Min-Cost算法在多种鲁棒准则下同时达到最优，表明混淆矩阵所提供的结构化信息具有显著的算法价值。同时，文章证明了自适应和随机化算法在特定条件下能够突破非自适应的局限。未来工作包括：设计兼具一致性（对角矩阵情况下达到最优）和鲁棒性的学习增强算法，研究混淆矩阵结构对鲁棒性的影响，以及将模型推广至多标签分类与加权完工时间目标。

Abstract: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

</details>


### [507] [Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks for Systems with Multiple Asymptotically Stable Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01356)
*Simon Heilig,Jens Püttschneider,Mohammad Itani,Asja Fischer,Timm Faulwasser*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对现有的稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络(s-PHNN)只能表示具有单一全局吸引子的动力系统的局限性，提出了一种扩展模型ms-PHNN，通过将Hamiltonian参数化为由单个输入凸网络(FICNN)生成的Bregman散度的乘积，使模型能够表示具有多个渐近稳定平衡点的系统（如双势阱能量景观）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: s-PHNN通过构造保证渐近稳定性，但其作为全局Lyapunov函数的Hamiltonian仅具有单个全局最小值，因此无法表示具有多个吸引子的动力系统（如buckled beam、pendulum over magnets等）。即使简单的Duffing振荡器也因双势阱结构而被排除在外。

Method: 提出一种乘性(multiplicative)Hamiltonian结构，其中每个因子对应一个稳定平衡点，捕获一个能量最小值。所有m个因子由同一个FICNN生成，共享隐藏层，仅在最终的凸读出层有所不同。对于可分机械系统，Hamiltonian分解为动能T和势能V，势能采用乘积结构编码多个稳定位置，动能使用单平衡点s-PHNN结构。

Result: 在Duffing振荡器、非对称Duffing振荡器和四磁铁摆三个系统上验证：ms-PHNN能够恢复能量表面特征，相比未约束的神经ODE收敛速度提升1.8×-8.5×。理论证明了：1) 最小能量平衡点的局部Lyapunov稳定性；2) 多稳定平衡点的共存迫使其他非渐近稳定平衡点存在（通过mountain pass theorem）；3) 所有平衡点位于有界区域内；4) 在超双曲性假设下，几乎处处稳定性成立（其他平衡点的吸引域为Lebesgue零测集）。数值验证也证实了假设的成立。

Conclusion: 本文通过显式乘积结构扩展了渐近稳定port-Hamiltonian神经网络，使其能够建模多稳定平衡点系统，同时保留了稳定性保证。匹配的归纳偏置使ms-PHNN比未约束的神经ODE收敛更快，为具有多个吸引子的物理系统建模提供了具有稳定性保证的高效架构。

Abstract: Stable port-Hamiltonian neural networks certify asymptotic stability by construction. Yet, their Hamiltonian is a global Lyapunov function with a single global minimum, so they can represent only dynamic systems with {one} attractor. We demonstrate that this excludes even simple systems with energy landscapes forming a double well, and we overcome the restriction by parametrising the Hamiltonian as a {product} of Bregman divergences generated by one input-convex network. We prove that the resulting model is locally Lyapunov stable, that the coexistence of stable equilibria forces additional non-asymptotically-stable equilibria to exist, that all equilibria lie in a bounded region, and under a hyperbolicity assumption that almost-everywhere stability holds. On three systems our approach is able to recover the energy surface characteristics and improve the convergence speed by 1.8$\times$-8.5$\times$.

</details>


### [508] [From Redundancy to Minimality: Fixed-Point-Guided Hierarchical Reduction of Learned Piecewise-Linear Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01369)
*Hiroto Tamura,Gouhei Tanaka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"学习-约简-再训练"策略，通过固定点引导的分层约简程序，将高容量Almost-Linear RNN（AL-RNN）逐步转化为最小动力表示。以3-scroll Chua系统为实验对象，将高保真最小实现的成功率从直接训练P=3时的20%提升至约71%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从最小非线性容量训练AL-RNN以获得极简动力表示时，优化过程极不可靠。虽然理论上3个ReLU单元足以重构Chua系统，但仅有少数随机种子能成功。本文旨在探索能否利用高容量模型作为"脚手架"，先训练冗余模型，再系统性地约简为最小动力表示。

Method: 1. 提出固定点（FP）下界理论：重构Q个不同不动点至少需要Q个FP符号；2. 设计固定点引导的分层图约简程序——通过逐步线性化ReLU单元来合并符号区域，同时禁止合并包含不同不动点的符号，生成reduction tree；3. 提出"学习-约简-再训练"流程：先用P_parent=10训练父模型，从父模型参数初始化学生模型，以父模型自主轨迹作为教师信号进行再训练；4. 在3-scroll Chua系统上对比直接训练P=3与约简引导再训练P_D=3的效果。

Result: 在3-scroll Chua系统上：直接训练P=3时高保真最小实现成功率仅20%（6/30）；而通过P=10父模型的约简引导再训练，同等最终非线性容量下成功率提升至约71%，改善3.5倍。26/30的父模型约简后可达到符号数下界5，25/30可达非线性容量下界3。所有高保真最小实现均收敛到相同的五节点链式符号组织结构。

Conclusion: 高容量AL-RNN的冗余非线性可作为结构与优化双重脚手架，用于发现和实现最小动力表示。该框架将结构简化与容量边界处的优化解耦，为从时间序列学习可解释的简约非线性动力表示提供了可靠途径。固定点下界为符号级最小性提供了理论证书。

Abstract: Understanding a nonlinear dynamical system from time series requires not only reproducing its trajectories, but also identifying a simple representation that preserves its essential dynamical structure. Almost-linear recurrent neural networks (AL-RNNs) are piecewise-linear RNNs in which only a subset of units use ReLU nonlinearities, so that nonlinear capacity is explicitly controlled by the number of ReLU units. Their activation patterns define linear regions, represented as symbols, whose observed transitions form a symbolic transition graph. However, directly training AL-RNNs with few ReLU units to realize minimal dynamical representations can be unreliable. We ask whether an AL-RNN with more ReLU units can instead be trained first and systematically reduced to a minimal dynamical representation. We introduce a fixed-point-guided hierarchical reduction procedure that progressively linearizes selected ReLU units, merging neighboring linear regions and graph nodes while preserving distinct symbols containing fixed points (FPs). The resulting reduction tree defines a hierarchy of progressively simpler candidates. Each reduced candidate is initialized from the parent parameters and retrained under guidance from the parent dynamics. We also prove that reproducing $Q$ distinct fixed points requires at least $Q$ FP-containing symbols, providing a certificate of symbol-level minimality when this bound is attained. On the 3-scroll Chua system, direct training with the theoretical minimum of three ReLU units achieves high-fidelity minimal realizations in only 20% of seeds, whereas our learn-reduce-retrain strategy increases the seed-macro success rate to approximately 71% at the same final nonlinear capacity. These results show that redundant nonlinear capacity can serve as a scaffold for discovering and realizing minimal dynamical representations.

</details>


### [509] [Learning Commute-Time-Preserving World Models for Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01373)
*Michael Hauri,Peter Buttaroni,Fabian A. Mikulasch,Friedemann Zenke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CTWM（Commute-Time-Preserving World Models），一种无需重建的自监督世界模型，通过残差预测与logdet正则化结合，理论上证明可在确定性可逆动力学下恢复缩放后的拉普拉斯表示，使潜在空间的L2距离精确对应环境的通勤时间距离。在六个连续目标到达基准上以一半参数匹配或超越LeWM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规划需要潜在表示中距离反映环境的通勤时间；图拉普拉斯谱嵌入可提供此表示，但现有自监督方法（如SIGReg、VICReg）鼓励各向同性表征，破坏了正确的特征值依赖缩放（λ_k^(-1/2)），导致通勤时间表示不准确。如何在无需重建的联合嵌入框架下学习保留通勤时间的表示是未解决的问题。

Method: CTWM采用两个关键设计：(1) 残差预测（displacement predictor）T预测潜在空间位移，并通过β项惩罚大预测值以防止编码器将时间相邻状态映射到远处；(2) logdet正则化（-γ/2·log|Σ|）替代各向同性正则化，避免强制等方差。损失函数结合残差预测项、平滑性惩罚项和logdet正则化项。理论上证明在确定性动力学和预测器固定点下，编码器收敛到缩放拉普拉斯表示 ϕ*(s) = √(γ(1+β)/(4β))·ψ(s)，其中ψ(s) = (λ_k^(-1/2)·u_k(s))。

Result: 在离散MNIST环面环境上验证：CTWM子空间相似度接近退并本征谱天花板0.91，方差比精确跟踪λ_1/λ_k，L2距离与真实通勤时间拟合R²=0.95，优于VICReg(0.84)、WM-GDO(0.73)和ALLO(0.67)。在六个连续像素观测基准（Reacher、Cube、Two-Room、PushT、Scene、Pointmaze）上，CTWM以9M参数（LeWM一半）匹配或超越LeWM(18M)；长目标距离（100步）下优势更显著（如Pointmaze: 98.8% vs 28.2%）。Pointmaze验证CTWM潜在方差呈λ_k^(-1/2)衰减，潜在距离接近真实通勤时间。

Conclusion: CTWM通过纯自监督、免重建的目标函数恢复了经典图论中可逆环境下规划最优的几何结构——缩放拉普拉斯表示，使潜在L2距离直接等同于通勤时间距离，且只需一半参数。这表明环境固有的通勤时间是任务无关表征的自然目标，类似于Tolman大鼠在奖励出现前先构建认知地图的机制。该工作将可扩展的自监督世界模型与基于谱嵌入的规划理论相连接。

Abstract: World models allow agents to plan in latent space by choosing a sequence of actions that most reduces the distance to a given goal state. Thus, planning can benefit from latent representations whose distances mirror commute-times in the environment. The spectral embedding space of the graph Laplacian provides such a representation, if it obeys a specific eigenvalue-dependent scaling. Unfortunately, instantiating the graph Laplacian is intractable in large, continuous environments. Self-supervised learning offers a natural route to such commute-time-preserving embeddings at scale. However, here we show that existing methods, which commonly encourage isotropic representations to prevent representational collapse, tend to degrade the "correct" eigenvalue-dependent scaling, leading to an inaccurate representation of commute times. To address this problem, we introduce Commute-Time-Preserving World Models (CTWMs), combining a latent displacement predictor and a log-determinant regularizer that prevents collapse, which provably recover the correctly scaled Laplacian representation under reversible deterministic dynamics and at the predictor's fixed point. In numerical simulations, CTWM matches or outperforms LeWM, a task-agnostic baseline, on several complex, continuous goal-reaching benchmarks, while using half the parameters.

</details>


### [510] [Action-On-Item Preference Flow: A Shared Event Schema for Predictive and Generative Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01375)
*Parthiv Chatterjee,Kashish Kanjaria,Vashisth Purani,Sourish Dasgupta,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"动作-条目"偏好流统一事件模式，将电影、新闻、对话等异构交互历史映射为共享更新机制；基于多时间尺度状态假设（MTSH）实现PerTIDE编码器，在统一架构下支持预测和生成任务，并通过理论分析（不变性、稳定性、池化训练界）和五领域实验验证了跨域历史更新学习的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统对不同领域（电影、新闻、对话）的用户交互历史采用各自独立的建模方式，无法共享历史更新机制；作者希望验证异构交互历史能否训练一个可重用的更新机制，从而在预测和生成任务间复用学习到的结构。

Method: 1. 定义"动作-条目"事件模式：将原生交互映射为动作角色+内容嵌入；2. 建立理论性质：原生标签不变性、条目嵌入扰动下的状态变化有界、兼容条件下的池化训练界；3. 提出多时间尺度状态假设（MTSH），分解为动作门控输入、三状态空间轨迹（长/短/情景式）、自适应融合、命令条件读出；4. 实现PerTIDE编码器，共享三轨迹谱参数化，通过DistilGPT2解码器配合UFI/UGI注入支持生成任务。

Result: PENS上同一编码器支持下一条新闻预测和个性化标题生成；PENS→MovieLens冻结核心迁移比随机初始化核心提升15.23 MRR；MIND上PerTIDE比相同输入三分支SSM控制提升4.12 MRR；情景式（E）轨迹单独仅24.18 MRR但加入L+S后提升至46.65，验证了互补贡献。

Conclusion: 理论分析和实验支持在兼容数据源间学习历史更新并通过任务适配的消费者进行复用；动作门控、三轨迹互补保持、命令条件读出均有独立贡献；研究为异构个性化数据的统一建模提供了形式化框架和实证证据。

Abstract: A user's movie, news, and dialogue histories differ in their native actions and outputs, yet each interaction supplies evidence that can update user memory. We study whether these histories can train one reusable update mechanism. An action-on-item schema pairs a mapped interaction role with a content embedding, allowing shared update parameters to operate on separate user states. We establish invariance to native relabeling, bounded state changes under item-embedding perturbations, and a pooled-training bound under explicit compatibility conditions. The Multi-Timescale State Hypothesis (MTSH) specifies how this evidence enters, persists, and is consumed; PerTIDE implements it with action gating, three state-space traces, fusion, and command-conditioned readout. On PENS, the same history encoder supports both next-news prediction and personalized headline generation. In a controlled PENS-to-MovieLens experiment, a frozen source-trained core exceeds an identically structured random core by 15.23 MRR points after fitting the same target consumer. On MIND, PerTIDE retains a 4.12-point MRR advantage over a same-input three-branch state-space control. Action, readout, and trace interventions identify complementary contributions to these gains. Together, the theory and experiments support learning history updates across compatible sources and reusing them through predictive and generative consumers.

</details>


### [511] [Minimax Optimal Regret for Causal Logistic Bandits with Counterfactual Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01377)
*Junhyuk Huh,Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带有反事实公平性约束的因果逻辑老虎机问题，针对仅能观测事实性奖励而需同时识别高奖励动作与公平动作的挑战，建立了必要性覆盖条件证明、匹配极小极大率的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果逻辑老虎机工作或缺少覆盖条件，或施加过强的覆盖条件且未给出匹配下界。需要厘清事实性观测是否足以识别反事实公平性所依赖的参数方向，并确定该约束老虎机问题的最优遗憾-违反权衡。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 构造两个观测历史完全相同但最优公平动作不同的环境，证明无覆盖条件时联合损失线性增长；(2) 在合并事实协方差满秩条件下，定义目标尺度 V_⋆ 量化事实观测估计奖励与反事实效应的局部方差难度，构造两环境三动作族及多环境多动作族得到匹配下界；(3) 设计定长探索-利用(ETE)算法(已知 V_⋆ 时调优)与自适应 ETE 算法(无需 V_⋆)，基于逻辑回归 MLE 和乐观筛选规则处理公平集合。

Result: 主要结果：命题3.2表明无覆盖时联合损失为 Ω(T)；定理4.1给出二元下界 Ω(V_⋆^{1/3}T^{2/3})；定理4.2给出一般下界 Ω([V_⋆ min{log K, d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3})；定理5.3和5.4给出匹配的上界 Õ([V_⋆ min{log K, d}]^{1/3}T^{2/3} + κd/σ₀²)；实验验证两种 ETE 算法在累积违反和惩罚遗憾上优于 CCLB、DO-LogB 和 GLB-OMD 基线。

Conclusion: 本文建立了因果逻辑老虎机反事实公平性问题的首个极小极大最优结果。证明了覆盖条件的必要性，并在弱化的满秩条件下获得了关于 T、V_⋆ 和 min{log K, d} 主项依赖相匹配的上界和下界。探索-利用框架成功平衡了探索代价与利用阶段遗憾，自适应算法无需已知难度参数 V_⋆。该工作深化了对硬部分监测类问题中 T^{2/3} 速率来源的理解。

Abstract: We study causal logistic bandits with counterfactual fairness constraints. The causal structure is given through known factual and counterfactual feature maps that share an unknown logistic reward parameter, but the learner observes only factual rewards. Consequently, the directions determining counterfactual feasibility need not be identifiable from the available feedback. The closest prior analyses either omit a coverage condition or impose a comparatively strong one, and do not establish matching lower bounds. We first show that some coverage condition is necessary: without a coverage-type restriction, factually indistinguishable environments with different optimal fair actions force $\Omega(T)$ expected joint loss. Under a weaker full-rank condition on the factual covariance pooled across actions, we identify a target-specific information scale $V_\star$ that measures the difficulty of estimating rewards and counterfactual effects from factual feedback. We construct worst-case families satisfying this condition on which every policy incurs expected joint loss $\Omega\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}\right)$. We also give an explore--then--exploit procedure tuned using $V_\star$ and an adaptive algorithm that does not require its value. Both algorithms achieve $\max\{R_T,V_T\}=\widetilde{O}\left(\left[V_\star\min\{\log K,d\}\right]^{1/3}T^{2/3}+\kappa d/\sigma_0^2\right)$, where $R_T$ is regret relative to the best fair action and $V_T$ denotes the cumulative stage-wise positive violations. Thus the upper and lower bounds match in their leading dependence on $T$, $V_\star$, and $\min\{\log K,d\}$, up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [512] [Robust Evidential Learning Through Latent Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01384)
*Charmaine Barker,Daniel Bethell,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLEAR提出了一种轻量级、任务无关的后处理方法，通过在潜在空间中生成扰动视图并衡量其与校准几何结构的冲突度，选择性地降低证据深度学习模型对分布外和对抗输入的证据强度，从而在不重新训练或改变基础预测的前提下提升不确定性量化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证据深度学习（EDL）虽能单次前向传播提供不确定性估计，但仍会为对抗输入等表示学习不充分的样本分配高证据强度。现有的后处理方法虽能改善EDL鲁棒性，但通常需要多次前向传播或随机采样，牺牲了EDL的效率优势，且可能在分布内输入上过度抑制证据。

Method: CLEAR包含两个阶段：（1）潜在校准：利用冻结的证据模型从保留的校准数据中提取潜在表示，估计每个输出组（分类类别/分位数分箱）条件下的潜在均值和特征空间（协方差及其Cholesky分解），并计算各组的特征尺度；（2）推理时冲突评估：在潜在空间中基于预测组的特征尺度采样扰动视图，经白化变换后度量视图对之间的跨维度冲突，通过与校准参考冲突（中位数）对比计算有界冲突分数，进而通过指数衰减因子调整证据强度。分类任务调整Dirichlet证据，回归任务调整NIG分布参数，均保持基础预测（类别/均值）不变。

Result: 在ImageNet→CUB设置上，CLEAR将OOD和对抗AUROC分别提升+8.29和+5.01，推理速度比竞争性后处理方法快17.4×。在MNIST、CIFAR10、Oxford Flowers等分类基准上，CLEAR在ID覆盖、OOD检测和对抗检测上整体达到最优或具有竞争力；在California Housing、Wine Quality等回归基准上显著降低OOD和对抗覆盖；在CelebA+YOLO11n目标检测任务上将不确定性与定位误差的Pearson相关系数从0.003提升至0.168。

Conclusion: CLEAR是一种通用、高效的后处理框架，通过潜在一致性检验有效识别证据深度学习模型中缺乏支撑的置信度，可扩展至多种不确定性目标（OOD、对抗、协变量偏移）和任务类型（分类、回归、目标检测），未来工作将探索语义分割等更密集的结构化预测任务。

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification is essential for deploying deep learning models in high-stakes settings, where out-of-distribution and adversarial inputs can induce confident but unreliable predictions. Evidential Deep Learning provides efficient uncertainty estimates in a single forward pass, but can still assign high evidential strength to inputs that are poorly supported by the learned representation, such as adversarial inputs. We introduce CLEAR, a lightweight, task-agnostic post-hoc method that improves evidential robustness without retraining or altering the base prediction. Using held-out calibration data, CLEAR characterises the group-conditioned geometry of the model's latent space. At inference, it efficiently generates perturbation views directly in the latent space and measures their conflict relative to the calibrated geometry of the predicted group. High latent conflict indicates unsupported evidence, which CLEAR uses to selectively reduce evidential strength while retaining evidence for latent-consistent inputs. On ImageNet$\rightarrow$CUB, CLEAR improves OOD and adversarial AUROC by $+8.29$ and $+5.01$ while running 17.4$\times$ faster than competing post-hoc methods while preserving predictive performance across classification, regression, and object detection benchmarks.

</details>


### [513] [AF-Muon: An AdamW-Free Muon Optimizer for Tied-Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01395)
*Arash Lagzian,Paniz Halvachi,Junming Zhang,Zhouhan Lin,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AF-Muon 提出了一种 AdamW-free 的 Muon 优化器扩展，专门针对共享词嵌入/LM 头表格（tied vocabulary table）的优化。通过使用支持感知的有限上限线性最小化 oracle（LMO）替代 AdamW 的辅助分支，在九种绑定 token 设置中实现了优于 Hybrid Muon 和 SCION-style Sign 端点的性能，同时减少约 20% 的优化器状态内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 优化器在大规模训练中通过谱范数最速下降更新矩阵权重，但对非密集矩阵几何的参数块（如绑定词表）仍依赖 AdamW 辅助分支。这些绑定张量块实际上是别名参数——同一存储张量同时用于稀疏输入查找和稠密输出分类，导致异构梯度合并。现有方法（Hybrid Muon 配 AdamW、SCION-style Sign 端点）未能完全适应这一角色几何特性。

Method: AF-Muon 保留 Muon 的谱 LMO 用于隐藏权重矩阵，为一维辅助参数引入 RMS 归一化更新，核心创新是为绑定词表设计支持感知的有限上限裁剪行 LMO（clipped-row LMO）。该 oracle 通过行级 ℓ₂ 球与逐元素上限框的交集实现，公式为：‖U‖_{tie,c} = max{‖U‖_{row}, ‖U‖_{max}/c}，参数 c 调节 Sign 端点（c=1）到行 RMS（c≥√d）之间的几何形状，标量 s 控制更新幅度。该方法无需第二矩状态，仅使用单一首矩缓冲区。理论上还建立了别名-拉回框架（alias-pullback framework）来描述多角色共享参数的优化几何。

Result: 在九种绑定 token 设置中（涵盖 124M-1B 参数的仅解码器语言模型、完全共享的 T5 风格编码器-解码器、ImageGPT 风格图像 token、蛋白质序列、稀疏 MoE），AF-Muon 在所有设置中均获得最低的均值验证损失和困惑度，优于 Hybrid Muon 和 SCION-style Sign 端点。具体数据示例：NanoGPT 上验证损失 3.4919（vs Hybrid Muon 3.5177），Llama-3.2-1B 验证损失 3.5056（vs Hybrid Muon 3.5388）。优化器状态内存减少约 20%（18-22%），训练时间开销仅约 1%。长周期运行（最高 ~10B tokens）和超参数敏感性研究证实增益稳健。消融实验表明有限上限（finite cap）而非仅仅移除 AdamW 是性能提升的关键。

Conclusion: 绑定词表应被视为具有独特优化几何的别名参数块，而非通用辅助张量。AF-Muon 提供了一个完全 AdamW-free 的 Muon 变体，在模型规模、模态和架构上保持稳健性。研究还表明功能别名（functional aliasing）而非仅仅存储张量形状应是优化器设计的一阶考量。论文同时强调：权重共享本身并不要求新的几何——当重用具有相同算子类型的密集层时，标准方法应当并行使用；而异构角色共享则需要构造联合可行几何。

Abstract: Muon improves large-scale training by applying a spectral-norm steepest-descent update to matrix parameters, but practical models also contain parameter blocks that do not fit dense-matrix geometry. One important case is the tied vocabulary table, which appears in language models and other token generators and can receive multiple structurally different gradient sources, from sparse input lookups to dense output-classifier updates. In the reference recipe these blocks are handed to an auxiliary AdamW optimizer, which restores second-moment state and updates the aliased table as a generic tensor. We propose AF-Muon, an AdamW-free extension of Muon that keeps the Muon matrix update for hidden weight matrices while using a support-aware finite-cap linear minimization oracle for tied vocabulary tables and an RMS-normalized update for one-dimensional auxiliary parameters. AF-Muon therefore trains every parameter class with a single first-moment buffer and no second-moment state, saving around 20% optimizer-state memory relative to Hybrid Muon in our benchmark. Across nine tied-token settings - decoder-only language models from 124M to 1B parameters, a fully shared T5-style encoder-decoder, and ImageGPT-style image-token, protein, and sparse-MoE variants, spanning text, image, and protein-sequence data - AF-Muon improves mean validation loss and perplexity over both Hybrid Muon and a SCION-style Sign endpoint. Long-horizon runs and hyperparameter sensitivity studies confirm the gain is robust, and identical-momentum diagnostics attribute it to the finite cap, which preserves more within-row magnitude than Sign while bounding the coordinate concentration of row-RMS. These results identify tied vocabulary tables as a distinct optimizer geometry and yield a robust AdamW-free Muon variant across models, modalities, and architectures, with about 1% step-time overhead in matched training.

</details>


### [514] [Reusing Past Samples in Proximal Policy Optimization: When and How Does It Help?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01399)
*Alessandro Montenegro,Riccardo Venturelli,Marco Mussi,Matteo Papini,Alberto Maria Metelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了PPO算法中的样本复用机制，通过多重重要性加权框架提出了两种变体ωPPO-U（均匀加权）和ωPPO-BH（平衡启发式校正加权），在保留PPO核心机制的前提下复用最近ω次迭代的样本，为两种损失函数推导了策略改进下界作为理论支撑，并在MuJoCo连续控制任务上进行了全面的受控实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PPO作为事实标准的在线策略深度强化学习方法，虽然性能稳定但样本效率低下（每次采集的数据仅用于少量更新即被丢弃）。现有方法如GePPO、SARD-PPO、PTR-PPO等已尝试将离线策略数据复用到PPO中并展示了改进，但缺乏对"何时复用有效、在哪些场景下有效、改进程度如何"的系统性受控研究，且多数方法依赖优势重评估、修改截断机制或启发式策略，难以孤立分析样本复用本身的贡献。

Method: 方法核心是在多重重要性加权（MIW）框架内实例化两种PPO变体：（1）ωPPO-U使用目标策略与各行为策略之间的普通重要性权重均匀加权窗口内所有样本；（2）ωPPO-BH使用目标策略与窗口内行为策略均匀混合之间的平衡启发式校正权重。两者均保留陈旧优势（不重评估过去样本）且仅在最新数据集上更新评论家。理论上为两者推导了考虑陈旧优势的策略改进下界，揭示了与优化变量无关的惩罚项。实验上设计三种对照设置（固定mini-batch大小B、固定mini-batch数量N_B、减少数据采集量H/ω），在6个MuJoCo任务上进行10次独立运行的实证比较，并使用截断比例和有效样本量（ESS）作为分布偏移诊断指标。

Result: 实验表明：（1）样本复用对PPO的改进主要源于额外数据本身而非更多梯度步数；（2）适度的窗口大小（如ω=4）在大多数环境下能持续提升最终性能；（3）改进主要体现在最终性能而非收敛速度（除Reacher和Ant外）；（4）过大的窗口会因陈旧优势、策略多样性增加和新鲜数据稀释而损害性能（特别是在Hopper-v5中ω=8时表现崩溃）；（5）ωPPO-BH对老样本的截断比例更低（因混合分母），但可能从一开始就截断部分新数据；两种加权方案无一致优劣之分；（6）减少数据采集（H/ω）的最严格设置中，复用方法整体失效（新鲜数据不足导致评论家质量下降）。消融实验表明评论家仅在最新数据D_k上训练是合理的选择。

Conclusion: 本文通过受控实验设计，证实了中等程度的样本复用能持续改善PPO在多种连续控制任务上的最终表现，但过度复用反而有害。两种MIW变体各有优势但无一致主导者。未来工作应将该分析扩展至其他深度在线策略方法（如GRPO），并系统性地分离现有PPO复用变体中优势重评估、修改截断等各自独立组件的贡献。

Abstract: Among on-policy deep reinforcement learning methods, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) has become the de facto standard, due to its consistently strong empirical performance across diverse application domains. However, on-policy methods are inherently sample inefficient: fresh data collected under the current policy is used for just a few updates before being discarded. Off-policy methods avoid this inefficiency via experience replay, achieving notable sample efficiency gains, but at the cost of training instabilities or extensive tuning. This motivated the rise of hybrid strategies that augment PPO with off-policy data reuse. Existing sample-reuse variants of PPO demonstrated improved sample efficiency over vanilla PPO, yet a systematic study of when reuse helps, in which scenarios, and to what extent remains missing. In this work, we study the effectiveness of sample reuse in PPO by instantiating two variants within a multiple importance weighting framework. Both retain the core PPO mechanics, reusing only samples from a window of recent iterations, thereby isolating the effect of data reuse from other factors. The variants, termed wPPO-U and wPPO-BH, employ vanilla importance weights or balance-heuristic-corrected ones, respectively. For both, we derive policy improvement lower bounds providing theoretical grounding for their respective losses. We use them to empirically study when and how data reuse improves sample efficiency or final performance of PPO across continuous control tasks.

</details>


### [515] [Why Does Train-Validation Separation Emerge? Update-Pressure Density Dynamics in Pretrained Backbones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01425)
*Yuchen Li,Mingyu Du,Zongqi Fan,Ken-Tye Yong,Nguyen H. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种动态结构性解释来理解预训练模型微调过程中训练-验证差距的产生机制：通过测量固定训练探针上的归一化逐样本梯度分配散度（D_den），无需使用验证数据即可观测模型从广泛可复用支持向窄化低迁移支持的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型微调中训练-验证差距（train-validation gap）的演化机制尚不清晰，现有研究主要从输出或样本分数角度切入，缺乏对内部更新压力分布如何随训练演化的结构性解释，也缺少仅用训练数据即可观察这一过程的方法。

Method: 1. 理论框架：提出"支持窄化"动态结构性解释——早期训练依赖高迁移广泛支持，后期转向低迁移窄支持；构建条件局部模型，形式化为β对（batch coherence + 需求动态 + 残差异质性+ 验证迁移效率），推导出D_den与训练-验证差距的耦合增长定理。2. 观测方法：利用固定训练探针，在监测的backbone接口坐标上计算逐样本归一化绝对梯度分配q_i(t)，定义理想池化散度D_den^ideal，并提出整体读数D_den和训练探针加权类内读数D_within^wt。4. 实验验证：受控ResMLP五级层次模拟（p=0.3/0.5/0.7）、10轮NLP队列（RoBERTa/DeBERTa/Qwen3 × 6数据集 × 5运行 = 90次）、40轮ResNet-18视觉实验。

Result: 1. 受控层次模拟：随私人特征份额p从0.3增至0.7，最终平均准确率差距从0.185升至0.331升至0.527；验证-训练私人掩码损失份额差距也对应增大。2. NLP实验（90次运行）：整体读数D_den和加权类内读数D_within^wt与准确率差距的原始及LOWESS水平相关在所有90次运行中均为正；约一个时间间隔的原始变化配对在87/90和86/90次运行中正相关。3. 视觉实验（ResNet-18 × 3数据集）：两读数与准确率差距在全部15次运行中均正相关。

Conclusion: 该论文提出了一种动态结构性解释，说明预训练backbone适配过程中训练-验证差距的演化源于从广泛可复用支持向窄化低迁移支持的转变。固定训练探针测量使更新压力分配的相应演化可被观测，无需验证数据进入结构性读数。受控层次、NLP和视觉实验共同支持了这一可观察预测性关系。

Abstract: Train-validation separation is the evolving difference between performance on observed training examples and a finite held-out validation set. We propose a dynamic structural account of how this gap develops during adaptation of pretrained models: continued fitting can shift update demand from broadly reusable support toward narrower support with weaker held-out transfer. A conditional local model links this shift to increasing heterogeneity in gradient allocation and train-validation separation. Fixed training probes make this structural evolution observable without validation examples entering the readouts; held-out performance is used separately to evaluate its relation to the gap. In a constructed hierarchy implemented with a residual multilayer perceptron (ResMLP), increasing the target share of example-private features from $p=.3$ to $.5$ to $.7$, while preserving the relative mixture $1{:}2{:}3{:}4$ among the four shared feature levels, increases the final mean accuracy gap from $.185$ to $.331$ to $.527$ across five runs per condition. Masked-input losses measured separately on training and validation examples expose the corresponding transfer asymmetry. The natural language processing (NLP) analysis uses 10-epoch runs of RoBERTa, DeBERTa, and Qwen on six datasets (90 runs): the training-probe-weighted within-class and overall dispersion readouts each have positive raw and smoothed level correlations with the accuracy gap in all 90 runs. Raw changes paired at approximately one-epoch intervals remain positively associated in 86/90 and 87/90 runs, respectively. A 40-epoch ResNet-18 study tests both readouts on three vision datasets. Together, controlled simulation, NLP, and vision support the dynamic structural account across settings, with real-model evidence testing its observable predictions under the specified monitors.

</details>


### [516] [Least-time Gradient Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01426)
*Alessandro Betti,Marco Gori,Stefano Melacci,Jinwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究优化理论中的梯度流时间最小化问题。通过指定风险驱动的耗散调度函数 u(e)，将梯度流动力学改写为 $\dot{w} = -u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/|\nabla E(w)|^2$，使得风险 e(t) 严格满足 $\dot{e} = -u(e)$。由于仅最小化到达时间是不适定的，作者引入 Tikhonov 正则化泛函 $F(u) = \int_0^{e_0}(\frac{\lambda}{2}|u'|^2 + 1/u)\,de$（惩罚粗糙度 + 时间代价）。主要结论为：该变分问题的极小化解存在且唯一，其参数形式为缩放的旋轮线（cycloid），由 Bernoulli 最速降线问题导出；零点附近渐近行为为 $u^*(e) \sim (9/(2\lambda))^{1/3} e^{2/3}$，指数 2/3 落在 Hölder 窗口 (1/2, 1) 内，确保有限时间到达且权重速度为零。证明路径经典：直接法证存在、严格凸性证唯一、显式积分 Euler-Lagrange 方程识别解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准梯度流（如 $\dot{w} = -\nabla E$）在二次风险下仅产生指数衰减 $e(t) = e_0 e^{-2t}$，风险永不归零；而除以 $|\nabla E|^2$（即 $u \equiv 1$）虽能在有限时间 $e_0$ 到达，代价是抵达速度无穷大。两者均不理想。实际应用（如过参数化网络训练）中需要"软着陆"——风险有限时间内归零、且抵达速度趋于零。核心动机：在所有满足 $u(0)=0$ 的耗散调度中，寻找以最快方式软着陆的调度。由于仅最小化时间是不适定的（$u \equiv c$，$c \to \infty$），需要正则化。

Method: 方法分为四个层面：a) 模型设定：耗散调度族 $\dot{w} = -u(E(w))\nabla E/|\nabla E|^2$ 保证 $\dot{e} = -u(e)$，从而 $T(u) = \int_0^{e_0} de/u(e)$ 与景观 E 的具体形状无关；b) 正则化泛函：$F(u) = \int_0^{e_0}(\frac{\lambda}{2}|u'|^2 + 1/u)\,de$，第一项惩罚速率的粗糙度（Dirichlet 项），第二项即为到达时间；c) 变分求解：在 $H^1$ 函数类上证明存在唯一极小化解，采用直接法（紧性 + 下半连续性，Lemma 3.1 处理极限函数零点集测度问题）+ 严格凸性 + Euler-Lagrange 方程的间接法；d) 显式解形式：将 Euler-Lagrange 方程乘以 $u'$ 得首次积分 $\frac{\lambda}{2}u'^2 = 1/u - 1/A$，代换 $s=A\sin^2\phi$ 后导出旋轮线参数化（与重力下滑最速降线问题同源）。

Result: 主要结果（定理 1.1）：对 $e_0 > 0, \lambda > 0$，$F$ 在 $X = \{u \in H^1((0,e_0)): u \geq 0, u(0)=0\}$ 上有唯一极小化解 $u^*$，由参数形式 $e(\theta) = \frac{2e_0}{\pi}(\theta - \sin\theta\cos\theta)$，$u^*(\theta) = \lambda^{-1/3}(2\sqrt{2}\,e_0/\pi)^{2/3}\sin^2\theta$，$0 \leq \theta \leq \pi/2$ 给出。推论 1.3（尖点）：$u^*(e) = (9/(2\lambda))^{1/3} e^{2/3}(1+O(e^{2/3}))$，$e \to 0$。推论 1.4：$F(u^*) = \frac{3}{2}\lambda^{1/3}(\pi^2 e_0)^{1/3}$，$T(u^*) = \lambda^{1/3}(\pi^2 e_0)^{1/3}$，Dirichlet 惩罚恰为到达时间的一半。备注 3.5 给出 $e(t) = \varepsilon(\frac{\pi}{2}(1-t/T(u^*)))$ 的闭式表达。第 4 节验证：幂律调度 $u(e) = e^\alpha$ 在 $F$ 下有有限能量当且仅当 $\alpha \in (1/2, 1)$；$2/3 \in (1/2, 1)$ 属 Hölder 区间，终端权重速度 $|\dot{w}| \asymp e^{1/6} \to 0$，终端向量场 Hölder 指数为 1/3，恰与 Zak 标准终端吸引子一致。注：$\lambda$ 仅重新缩放速率与时间，尖点指数 2/3 不变。

Conclusion: 本文完整解决了最小时间正则化梯度流的变分求解问题，证明了极小化解存在唯一，且为缩放旋轮线，与 Bernoulli 最速降线问题同源。从变分角度自然选择了 Hölder 区间 $(1/2, 1)$ 中的特定幂律指数 $\alpha = 2/3$（此指数早前由幂律 ansatz 在前期工作 [2] 中获得），赋予终端权重向量场 Hölder 指数 1/3 的"软着陆"性质。这一结论具有以下意义：a) 变分结构自然筛选出 Hölder 区间内的最优调度，而非该窗口的全部；b) 该调度对初始风险 $e_0$ 和正则化参数 $\lambda$ 具有良好的缩放性质；c) 有限能量条件排除了其他区间（$\alpha \leq 1/2$ 与 $\alpha \geq 1$），说明 Hölder 窗口是泛函的内在约束而非最优性的推论。遗留问题：包括振幅项（[2] 中的 $\int u^p/p$ 项）情形下尖点指数的行为；以及按 $u^*$ 离散化梯度流的实际梯度计算复杂度依赖于 E 在极小值点附近的曲率，属于独立的后续工作。

Abstract: Prescribing the speed of gradient flow on the risk itself, by the dynamics $\dot w=-u(E(w))\nabla E(w)/\abs{\nabla E(w)}^{2}$, makes the risk $e(t)=E(w(t))$ obey $\dot e=-u(e)$ exactly, whatever the landscape~$E$; the time needed to reach zero risk from $e_0$ is $\int_0^{e_0}\dd e/u(e)$. Minimizing this time alone is ill posed, and we study the regularized problem $\inf\{\int_0^{e_0}(\tfrac\lambda2\abs{u'}^{2}+1/u)\,\dd e:\ u\in H^{1}(0,e_0),\ u\ge0,\ u(0)=0\}$, $\lambda>0$. We prove that the minimizer exists, is unique, and is a linearly scaled cycloid, and we show that the optimal rate behaves like $u^{*}(e)\sim(9/(2\lambda))^{1/3}e^{2/3}$ near zero risk: the exponent $2/3$ is the one found in \cite{betti2026holder} by a power-law ansatz, and it lies in the Hölder window $(\tfrac12,1)$ where the arrival is in finite time with vanishing weight speed. The proof follows the classical route: existence by the direct method, uniqueness by strict convexity, positivity of the minimizer away from the origin, and the explicit integration of the Euler-Lagrange equation.

</details>


### [517] [Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models into Efficient Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01435)
*Minho Jeong,Dooho Lee,Jinmo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将表格基础模型（TFM，如TabICLv2、TabPFN v3）通过知识蒸馏压缩为轻量化的数据集特定学生模型（TabM、XGBoost），以解决TFM因上下文学习导致的推理成本高昂问题，并提出了一个简单而有效的蒸馏配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）通过上下文学习实现出色的预测性能，但每次推理都需要处理标注上下文，计算成本高昂。现有方法（上下文选择、路由、压缩、缓存）虽提升效率，但仍依赖上下文计算。知识蒸馏可将TFM能力转移到独立服务的学生模型，但TFM依赖上下文与查询双重输入的特性引出两个关键设计问题：教师监督的构建方式以及扩展查询覆盖范围是否有助于蒸馏。

Method: 提出蒸馏配方包含两个核心设计：1）监督构建——使用完整标注训练集作为教师上下文（Full-Context, FC），学生仅从教师预测中训练（α=1），无需真实标签监督；2）查询覆盖扩展——在真实查询基础上增加CutMix合成查询（将每个特征独立地从两行采样行中等概率选取），合成与真实查询比例为2:1。在两个TFM教师（TabICLv2、TabPFN v3）和两类学生（神经模型TabM、树模型XGBoost）共四种配对上展开实验，基于TabArena（51数据集）和TALENT（300数据集）进行评估。

Result: 在TabArena上，蒸馏后的学生以默认配置比同架构调参+集成模型高出57-98 Elo点；在TALENT上，同样的配方在300数据集中有236-258个数据集上优于基线，中位主误差降低4.0-6.4%。推理加速达3.0-21.6倍（教师上下文≥10K行时加速达23.9-53.7倍）。教师相对学生的优势越大，KD收益也越大（Spearman相关系数0.67-0.82），蒸馏学生可保留约68-71%的教师优势。

Conclusion: 完整上下文的教师预测可替代真实标签监督；简单合成查询（CutMix最佳）可将有效监督扩展到观测样本之外。由此得出的蒸馏配方在两种基准上均无需重新选择设置即生效，在大上下文场景下推理效率优势尤为显著，是一种实用的性能与重复推理成本权衡方案。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance through in-context learning, yet repeatedly conditioning on labeled data makes inference expensive. Knowledge distillation can reduce this cost by transferring their predictive ability to lightweight, dataset-specific students. However, the dependence of TFM predictions on both a labeled context and a query introduces two design questions: how to construct teacher supervision and whether expanding query coverage improves distillation. We examine these questions across two TFMs and both neural and tree-based students, and derive an effective distillation recipe. The recipe uses the full labeled training set as teacher context and trains students solely on teacher predictions for observed and synthetic queries. On TabArena, the resulting students outperform their supervised trained tuned-and-ensembled counterparts by 57-98 Elo points. Applied unchanged to TALENT, the same recipe improves matched default students on 236-258 of 300 datasets and reduces median primary error by 4.0-6.4%. The distilled students also achieve median inference speedups of 3.0-21.6 times over their teachers, offering a practical trade-off between predictive performance and repeated inference cost. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [518] [ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01445)
*Bin Chen,Yumeng Xue,Patrick Paetzold,Yunhai Wang,Oliver Deussen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ibUMAP，一种基于场评估的UMAP优化替代方案。该方法将吸引力和排斥力从同一嵌入快照中评估并同步应用，通过基于插值的FFT方案高效计算三个标量矩所表示的度加权排斥场，避免显式的全对计算，同时改变标准在线UMAP的优化动态。在CPU上比umap-learn实现3.29倍（无种子）和5.79倍（有种子）的中位加速，在百万规模GPU数据集上比cuML实现1.44倍加速，并带来更高的运行稳定性，但需权衡保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
