Motivation: UMAP通过随机负采样实现可扩展布局优化，但这种随机性导致跨运行嵌入不稳定，排斥力估计对采样事件顺序敏感。需要一种能够保证一致性和可重复性的替代优化方案。

Method: 1. 保留UMAP的图构建和初始化算法，仅修改布局优化阶段。2. 用度加权排斥场替代随机负采样排斥力，从固定嵌入的条件期望推导。3. 通过三个标量矩（1, y_x, y_y）将排斥力分解为N体求和问题。4. 采用基于插值的P2M-FFT-M2P方案高效评估场（p=1，每维度B个盒子），避免O(n²)全对计算。5. 同步更新：从同一快照评估吸引力和排斥力后再统一应用。6. 引入安全保障：标量核封顶c_K=4、排斥更新范数裁剪为4α_t、基于99百分位加权度的吸引阻尼。7. 通过固定顺序累积和无随机对选择实现同设备位级可重复性。

Result: 性能加速：CPU对umap-learn中位加速3.29×（无种子）和5.79×（有种子）；GPU对cuML在百万规模数据集上无种子中位加速1.44×；对TorchDR中位加速1.53×。保真度权衡：TW、NP、RTA和ρ_D均值分别降低0.0051、0.0209、0.0037和0.0179；连续性C基本匹配。机制分解发现：同步性在全部59个数据集上降低TW和NP；核封顶以邻域重叠换取连续性和全局保真度；FFT评估对最终质量影响很小（均值变化≤0.0016）。可重复性：两种CPU实现均在66/66数据集上产生位级相同嵌入；中位有种子/无种子时间比为0.961（ibUMAP）对比1.664（umap-learn）。运行稳定性：在58/66（vs umap-learn）和66/66（vs TorchDR）数据集上15-NN重叠改善。BRAQUE衍生案例：固定种子下，ibUMAP嵌入时间7.10s对比UMAP的49.06s（6.91×加速）；但几何稳定性不保证聚类可重复性，UMAP有20.80%分配变化，ibUMAP有22.01%。

Conclusion: ibUMAP通过基于场的评估和同步更新实现UMAP优化的连贯性。三个标量矩和插值FFT使密集排斥场在CPU和GPU上高效评估。在固定图和初始化对比中，同步性以局部保真度为代价，核封顶以邻域重叠换取其他度量，FFT评估影响很小。连贯性允许有种子CPU运行保持并行但位级可重复，且无中位运行时间惩罚。加速和稳定性提升以可测量的保真度权衡为代价，且二维嵌入的保真度不能直接转化为下游聚类一致性。局限：ibFFT构造仅适用于二维输出；同设备可重复性窄于可移植可重现性；机制研究使用单一固定初始化和一种图构建方式。

Abstract: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. Controlled experiments show that synchrony and kernel capping alter the local-global fidelity trade-off, whereas FFT evaluation produces small average changes in final quality. End-to-end benchmarks show median speedups of 3.29x unseeded and 5.79x seeded over umap-learn on CPU, and 1.44x over cuML on million-scale datasets under unseeded GPU execution. These gains accompany greater run-to-run stability and measurable fidelity trade-offs.

</details>


### [519] [Repurposing Obsolete Representations for Post-Deployment Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01453)
*Daniel Bethell,Charmaine Barker,Simos Gerasimou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Repurposing (DR)，一种后处理、无梯度的分析式框架，用于在任务过时（部分输出空间不再有效）时修复已部署的深度网络。DR通过估计潜在几何、剥离支持废弃区域的成分并将有用结构重定向至保留区域，在不更新模型参数的情况下，同时抑制废弃预测并保留/提升保留任务的性能。在多个分类、回归和分割基准上，DR在保留精度上匹配或微调超基线与对比方法，速度最高提升60倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的深度网络常面临任务过时问题——原有输出空间中的部分类别、预测区域或习得行为因任务阶段调整、硬件退化或部署后分析而变得无效、不可靠或不再有用。已有方法要么保留、要么微调，要么通过遗忘/编辑方法简单擦除过时行为，未能区分过时的"身份"与可服务于保留任务的有用结构，亟需一种轻量级、可重定向过时结构的后处理机制。

Method: DR采用两阶段分析式机制：①离线校准——冻结预训练模型，提取校准集的潜在表征，为每个过时与保留区域拟合高斯原型（均值μ_c与方差σ²_c），构建成对的过时-保留移除方向v_{o,r}（由分类器权重差异或原型轴定义）和重定向方向t_{o,r}（由原型几何定义），并在保留样本上拟合可靠性调整的残差精炼原型δ̃_a；②在线推理——使用修复掩码M(x)仅在模型当前将输入分配到过时区域时启动干预：从潜在表征中剥离过时支持成分z⁻=z⁻αv_{o*,r*}，评估贝叶斯对齐后的保留原型证据和对比增益，通过softmax生成保留责任向量，再施加由过时责任门控的残差精炼，并投影回保留单纯形；最终通过保留头部一致性和零空间重建修复潜在z*和原始证据。对回归和分割场景，提供基于保留值支持的解码及按保留头部分数一致性的SVD伪逆重建。

Result: 在CIFAR10/100、Flowers102、ImageNet、FishNet、MSL、ADE20K、UTKFace、Bike Sharing九个数据集上：DR将过时保留效果降至0、观测概率降至≈0，在保留精度上匹配甚至优于全量重训练（如CIFAR10上DR=0.91与重训练0.91相同），并优于SSD、LFSSD、Boundary Shrink/Expand、FCR、Fisher Forgetting、Class Vector、Fine-tuning等方法；且速度比竞争性遗忘方法最高快60倍（CIFAR10上1.62s vs 重训练162.17s，ImageNet上28.82s vs 重训练1167.15s）。在火星车与深海鱼的真实任务场景下，DR分别在~15s和~7.53s内完全消除100%过时预测，宏F1分别提升+0.097和+0.007（相关类提升≈0.03）。表示层指标（MIA-AUC、临近过时质心率、过时方向得分）显示DR有效去除潜在空间中的过时几何，校准上保留ECE与NLL接近基线，难度四分位分析显示对困难样本亦有改善。

Conclusion: Deep Repurposing提供了一种轻量级、分析式且无需梯度更新的后处理框架，能在不过时性任务下同时抑制过时输出、保留/提升保留任务性能并修复内部表征。其成功依赖于明确定义的过时区域和具有代表性的校准数据；未来工作将扩展至基础模型、多模态模型及自动过时行为检测。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in long-lived systems, where task requirements may change after training. In such settings, part of the original output space may become obsolete: a class, prediction region, or learned behaviour may no longer be valid. Existing approaches either leave the obsolete behaviour intact or require fine-tuning, which can be expensive. We propose Deep Repurposing (DR), a post-hoc framework for adapting models under task obsolescence. DR estimates the latent geometry of obsolete and retained regions, removes obsolete-supporting components, and reallocates retained-compatible evidence through an analytic repair map without gradient updates. This yields repaired predictions and representations in which obsolete regions no longer act as valid outputs, while useful obsolete structure can support the retained task. Across multiple task settings, DR removes obsolete behaviour while preserving retained utility. More importantly, across classification benchmarks, DR matches or exceeds competing unlearning and editing baselines in retained accuracy, eliminates obsolete predictions, and adapts up to $60\times$ faster than competing unlearning methods.

</details>


### [520] [Streaming algorithms for robust max-min diversification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01456)
*Andrea Pietracaprina,Geppino Pucci,Stefano Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对带离群点的max-min多样化问题，提出一种基于确定性coreset的单遍流式算法，在低倍增维度度量空间下，仅使用与n无关的内存即可返回(2+ε)-近似解，且解中必包含k个内点，完全避免了前作在内存消耗、解可行性和概率保证方面的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的max-min多样化问题对噪声点（离群点）高度敏感。AAAI23[Amagata]提出的鲁棒公式虽解决了这一脆弱性，但其基于coreset的流式算法存在三大缺陷：(1) coreset构建需要O(n)的离线内存，与流式处理目标相悖；(2) 单遍扫描可能永久丢弃远离当前解的点，导致返回少于k个点（不可行解）；(3) 离群点排除保证仅是概率性的，且随coreset缩小而弱化。本文旨在彻底解决这些缺陷。

Method: 1. 在更精细的内外点分离假设下（α>β，区分内外点最近邻距离界），提出简化的2-近似顺序算法及CoresetMMD顺序算法，通过GMM迭代构建(1+ε)-coreset，最终coreset大小为O(k(8(1+ε)/ε)^D + z)；2. 设计StreamingCoreset单遍流式算法：调用k-center的Scaling Algorithm维持k+z个中心，使用Insert（基于距离阈值添加/合并）和Shrink（半径加倍时按距离阈值重建）三个阶段维护加权coreset T；3. 利用权重和最近邻距离精确识别并剔除z个离群点，最后在T\X_out上调用顺序算法𝒜求解。

Result: 在α>β+ε'/2的内外点分离假设下：确定性1遍流式算法返回k个内点的(2+ε)-近似解；工作内存为O((k+z)(1/δ)log(1/δ) + M + s_𝒜(M))，最坏更新时间为O((k+z)²(1/δ)log(1/δ) + M²)；最大coreset大小M=O((k+z)(32(2+δ)(1+ε)/ε)^D)，在ε、δ、D为常数时与n无关；摊销更新时间在长流下为O(M)，亦与n无关。

Conclusion: 本文提出的确定性coreset流式算法在内存、更新时间和近似比三个维度均严格优于前作[Amagata, AAAI23]：(2+ε)近似比仅比无离群点情形下最好的多项式时间比2多一个可忽略的ε；解严格包含k个内点；内存与n无关，适配低倍增维度空间；为大规模含噪数据集的鲁棒多样化提供了理论与实践兼顾的解决方案。

Abstract: Given a set of $n$ points $X$ in a metric space and an integer $k$, max-min diversification aims to select $k$ points of $X$ maximizing their minimum pairwise distance. This objective function is however highly vulnerable to noisy points. In[Amagata, AAAI23], a robust formulation is proposed which addresses this vulnerability by excluding solutions containing any of $z$ outliers, defined as the $z$ points in $X$ with the largest nearest-neighbor distances. That paper also presents a coreset-based streaming algorithm for the new formulation, based on a suitable inlier-outlier separation assumption. However, we identify three shortcomings in the algorithm by [Amagata, AAAI23]: its coreset construction requires an offline computation over $X$, which needs memory linear in $n$, in stark contrast with the typical goals of stream processing; the one-pass procedure used to extract the solution from the coreset may return fewer than $k$ points (hence, an unfeasible solution) because it permanently discards points too far from the current solution; and its outlier-exclusion guarantee is only probabilistic and weakens as the coreset size shrinks. In contrast, we present a deterministic coreset-based algorithm that, under a natural inlier-outlier separation assumption (similar to the one used in [Amagata, AAAI23]), returns exactly $k$ inliers which are a $(2+\varepsilon)$-approximate solution, for any $\varepsilon>0$, thus only $\varepsilon$ above the best polynomial-time sequential approximation, even without outliers. Its one-pass streaming implementation adapts obliviously to the dataset's doubling dimension $D$ and, for wide ranges of $k$, $z$, $\varepsilon$, and $D$, it uses memory independent of $n$. For sufficiently long streams, its amortized update time is proportional to the coreset size, thus also independent of $n$.

</details>


### [521] [Tight Transition Time Bounds for Separable Logistic Regression at the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01459)
*Haodong Wen,Kaiyue Wen,Jiaye Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了在大常数步长梯度下降下，线性可分逻辑回归的"边缘稳定性"（EoS）转变时间的最坏情况严格界。核心结论是：对于固定的n≥2和足够小的间隔γ，最坏情况的转变时间恰为Θ((log η)^{min{n−2, d−2}})，对d≥2一致成立。这推翻了先前关于步长无关界在高维成立的猜想，并揭示出每个min{n, d}的单位增加允许一个额外的对数因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前Crawshaw & Liu (2026)仅在d=2下证明步长无关的转变时间上界，并猜想该结论对高维仍成立。该论文旨在严格刻画任意维度下EoS转变时间对步长η的精确依赖关系，填补d≥3情形下转变时间依赖性的空白。

Method: 上界：通过对样本矩阵的递归投影降秩，每层递归贡献一个log η因子。结合全局系数质量预算（∑c_t ≤ O(η)）限制外层块数为O(1)，在每个外层块内对保留的子集进行低秩投影迭代分析。下界：通过递归构造Gram矩阵K_r，在每一项新增一个gate维度，使前一层轨迹的深度按固定因子减少，从而拼接出长度Θ((log η)^k)的精确轨迹，并通过使末端损失严格增加证明σ_η的下界。两种方法均通过对维数n和样本量d的归纳实现。

Result: 严格证明：对于每个n≥2，存在γ_n∈(0,1]使得对每个固定0<γ≤γ_n，最坏情况精确转变时间 σ_η(D) = Θ((log η)^{min{n−2, d−2}})，对所有d≥2一致成立。当n=2或d=2时转变时间与η无关；当n,d≥3时呈现对数多项式增长。这同时推翻了Crawshaw & Liu关于阈值转换时间τ_n(D)具有步长无关界的猜想。此外，对有限时域优化给出新保证：选择η=exp(aT^{1/k})可在T次迭代内获得F(w_T) ≤ (C/T)exp(−aT^{1/k})的损失界，显著优于之前的Õ(T^{−2})。

Conclusion: 可分逻辑回归在大步长梯度下降下的EoS转变时间严格依赖于维数和样本量，由Θ((log η)^{min{n−2, d−2}})刻画。每个对数因子对应动力学中一个额外的交互层级——上界通过降秩投影限制其数量，下界通过递归构造实现所有因子。该结果否定了步长无关性的高维猜想，并将最小维度情形识别为特殊而非一般性。技术核心是控制"主导样本反复切换"这一高维动力学难题，方法可推广至其他可分损失函数的大步长分析。

Abstract: We study logistic regression on linearly separable data under gradient descent with a large constant stepsize $\eta$. Such dynamics may exhibit a characteristic Edge of Stability phenomenon, in which the loss initially oscillates before transitioning to a stable phase of monotone decrease. Existing work provides a tight $\Theta(1)$ bound in dimension $d=2$ as $\eta \to \infty$ and conjectures a bound independent of $\eta$ in arbitrary dimensions $d\geq 2$. In this paper, we disprove this conjecture by showing that, for every fixed sample size $n\geq 2$ and sufficiently small margin $\gamma$, the worst-case transition time is $$\Theta\!\left((\log\eta)^{\min\{n-2,d-2\}}\right)$$ uniformly over $d\geq2$. The key challenge in establishing a tight bound is that the sample contributing most strongly to the gradient can change repeatedly across iterations. To address this issue, we control such changes by induction on dimension and sample size, and construct matching hard instances.

</details>


### [522] [Let the Heads Talk: Beyond Diagonal Graph Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01494)
*Riccardo Ali,Alessio Borgi,Mario Severino,Alessio Gravina,Davide Bacciu,Pietro Liò,Christopher Irwin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过代数表示论中的箭图表示(quiver representations)视角,将Sheaf Neural Networks中的矩阵值传输(matrix-valued transport)与标准多头注意力机制(multi-head attention)联系起来,提出了一种新的图注意力机制Topological Attention (Top-A),通过允许边依赖的跨注意力头传输来扩展标准注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. Sheaf Neural Networks中矩阵值传输的作用与整体sheaf-diffusion构造纠缠在一起,难以独立分析其计算本质。2. 标准多头注意力本质上只实现对角边的传输映射,缺乏跨注意力头之间的信息交互。3. 需要明确跨注意力头通信是否可被简单的后聚合线性变换所替代,以及这一计算原语的独立价值。

Method: 1. 使用箭图表示(quiver representations)理论将矩阵值传输作为独立原语进行刻画。2. 将每个注意力头视为局部传输空间的一个维度,标准注意力对应于对角边映射。3. 提出Topological Attention (Top-A):在保留原始同头路径(same-head paths)的基础上,学习边依赖的跨头(off-diagonal)路由。4. 当额外路由消失时,Top-A精确恢复vanilla attention。5. 通过理论证明,跨头传输操作一般情况下无法被单一共享线性映射吸收。6. 在关系推理、异质图学习、算法推理(含分布外泛化)任务上评估,并以异亲性(heterophilic)节点分类作为对比。

Result: 1. 跨头传输矩阵不能被单一的聚合后共享线性映射所吸收,是一个独立的计算原语。2. Top-A在关系推理、异质图学习、算法推理及分布外泛化任务上表现有效。3. 异亲性(heterophily)本身并不能为跨头传输提供系统性优势——其优势主要体现在任务本身需要交互依赖变换时。4. 标准多头注意力仅允许对应头之间的对角传输,限制了表达性。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了边条件化的跨注意力头通信(edge-conditioned cross-head communication)作为矩阵值传输中一种独立的计算原语。Top-A在不破坏原有同头路径的前提下,通过学习边依赖的跨头路由,丰富了图上的注意力机制;其价值取决于任务结构是否需要交互依赖的变换,而非简单的拓扑异亲性。箭图表示为分析这类广义消息传递提供了有力的理论框架。

Abstract: Sheaf Neural Networks generalize scalar-weighted message passing by replacing scalar edge weights with linear transport maps between local feature spaces. Yet the role of this matrix-valued transport is entangled with the broader sheaf-diffusion construction. We isolate the transport primitive through quiver representations and establish a direct connection with multi-head attention. Treating attention heads as coordinates of a local transport space reveals that standard multi-head attention implements diagonal edge maps: along each directed interaction, a source head can contribute only to the corresponding receiver head. Allowing off-diagonal entries instead enables edge-conditioned communication across heads before neighborhood aggregation. We show that this operation cannot, in general, be absorbed into a single shared linear map applied after aggregation. Building on this characterization, we introduce Topological Attention (Top-A), a multi-head attention that learns edge-dependent off-diagonal routes while preserving the original same-head paths and exactly recovering vanilla attention when the additional routing vanishes. We evaluate Top-A on relational reasoning, heterogeneous graph learning, and algorithmic reasoning, including out-of-distribution generalization, with heterophilic node classification as a contrast setting. The results show that cross-head transport is most useful when the task benefits from interaction-dependent transformations, while heterophily alone provides no systematic advantage. These findings identify edge-conditioned cross-head communication as a distinct computational primitive of matrix-valued transport.

</details>


### [523] [Learned End-to-End Guidance Schedules for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01502)
*Aneesh Barthakur,Mathias Niepert,Luiz F.O. Chamon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LEEGS（Learned End-to-End Guidance Schedules），一种为损失引导扩散模型学习时间相关引导调度的方法。通过在少量样本上以随机梯度下降最小化引导函数，LEEGS能在仅10%的采样步数下匹配恒定引导效果，或在相同预算下超越现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导扩散模型在生成满足附加约束的样本时面临数据质量与约束满足之间的权衡：小的引导尺度需要长采样轨迹才能同时满足两者，计算成本高昂。现有方法（恒定引导、信任域、线性调度）均需要精心调节超参数，且固定调度形状在不同任务间并非最优。

Method: LEEGS通过沿整个扩散轨迹（而非仅终端）累积引导函数值作为训练目标，使用随机梯度下降学习每个扩散步的时间相关引导尺度w_s。为解决沿轨迹反向传播的计算与内存开销，采用两种关键技术：(1) 梯度检查点（rematerialization）使峰值内存与步数S无关；(2) 近似梯度——在反向传播时对引导梯度g_s施加stop-gradient，仅保留采样器Jacobian的传播，将每次迭代训练时间削减约4倍。训练完成后学到的调度在推理时无额外开销。

Result: 在50或100 NFEs预算下，LEEGS在四项任务上一致优于基线：(a) 图像修复（CelebA-HQ/ImageNet上200 NFEs时在所有掩码类型上优于RePaint）；(b) 含噪图像逆问题（FFHQ/ImageNet上5种退化算子，100 NFEs时在大多数子任务上击败1000-NFE DPS参考）；(c) 人脸ID引导生成（CelebA-HQ上FaceID分数和FID均最优）；(d) PDE正/反问题（Poisson/Helmholtz/Darcy，6个子任务中100步时有5个达到最低相对误差）。此外可在S=10的极低预算下保持竞争力，且学到的调度形状在不同任务间差异显著（逆问题偏好递增，PDE问题偏好递减），验证了任务特定学习的必要性。

Conclusion: LEEGS是一种简单、通用的方法，可在仅30个训练样本上学习损失引导扩散的时间相关调度。该方法揭示两个核心结论：(1) 学习调度在匹配预算下优于恒定引导；(2) 有效调度形状具有任务依赖性，应通过学习而非启发式固定。方法对采样器选择具有鲁棒性（DDPM/Euler/重噪采样器均适用），且可从小S训练的调度通过插值与重缩放迁移到大S，降低大预算训练成本。局限性包括训练成本随S线性增长、梯度近似在引导场对x_s高度敏感时可能失效，以及当前调度为任务特定而非条件自适应。

Abstract: Diffusion models are a powerful generative paradigm used across multimedia and scientific applications. Guided diffusion methods impose requirements on the generation by adding the gradient of a differentiable loss (the guidance function) as a drift term during inference. The weight of this drift (the guidance scale) is critical for the trade-off between data quality and requirement satisfaction. To achieve both of these goals, guided diffusion must resort to small guidance scales and lengthy sampling, incurring high computational costs. This work proposes learned end-to-end guidance schedules (LEEGS) to achieve these objectives with fewer sampling steps. LEEGS trains a time-dependent schedule by minimizing the guidance function over a small set of examples using stochastic gradient descent. Backpropagating through guided sampling is computationally expensive, so LEEGS uses an approximation of the gradient that cuts training time by a factor of 4. We evaluate LEEGS on diverse guidance tasks, including (a) image inpainting, (b) noisy image inverse problems, (c) face-ID-guided generation, and (d) forward and inverse PDE problems, outperforming baselines at equal budget (50 or 100 NFEs), or matching constant guidance with only 10% of the steps.

</details>


### [524] [Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning: Replacing Target Samples by Black-Box Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01522)
*Vladimir R. Kostic,Karim Lounici,Hélène Halconruy,Timothée Devergne,Michele Parrinello,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL)，一种从偏差源样本中利用黑盒反馈恢复目标 Langevin 动力学的新型框架。通过 Dirichlet 表示学习学习目标无穷小生成元的慢谱结构和投影漂移，策略上进行有限样本充足保证。球面变体适用于潜空间转向。结合分子动力学、生成模型、钴纳米粒子磁化及公平性微调等实验，证明谱算子学习在分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多科学和机器学习系统由具有低维慢结构的随机动力学驱动，但目标轨迹通常不可获取——仅有偏差或静态样本可用且只能获得黑盒评估反馈。现有转移学习方法主要依赖重新训练或微调，且谱方法局限于L2/偏，无法恢复投影漂移。

Method: LITL 框架分两阶段：(1) 通过重要性加权修正偏差，采用 Sobolev/Dirichlet 表示学习 (损失函数式7-8) 近似 resolvent R_μ 的前导不变子空间；(2) 在学习子空间内求解广义特征值问题 (式12)，恢复生成元谱分解及投影梯度 (式14)。球面变体在 S^{d-1} 上进行纯扩散目标势能重建，用于转向归一化潜表示。

Result: 理论层面首次证明了特征值、特征函数及投影漂移估计在 Sobolev 范数下的有限样本保证 (Theorem 4.1)；经验层面因子 (双重势井特征值恢复优于现有方法；丙氨酸二肽转移学习将慢时间尺度从2.6提升至350；BioEmu 生成样本与 MD 动力学定量比较；钴纳米粒子精度5e-3；Adult 数据集上 TPR 差距降低94%且不需要重训练) 验证框架有效性。

Conclusion: LITL 将转移学习重新定义为转移生成元结构而非参数适配，使谱算子学习成为分布偏移下恢复随机动力学的实用框架，并拓展至机器学习系统调控。该框架目前限于可逆 Langevin 动力学，需向非可逆或时变动力学拓展。

Abstract: Many scientific and machine learning systems, from molecular dynamics to diffusion models and beyond, are governed by stochastic dynamics with low-dimensional structure, evolving on slow timescales. However, target trajectories, used to identify and interpret such dynamics, are often inaccessible: only biased or static samples that explore the underlying manifold are available. We introduce Langevin-Informed Transfer Learning (LITL), a framework for recovering target Langevin dynamics from biased source samples using only black-box feedback. LITL learns the leading spectral structure of the target infinitesimal generator and the projected drift through Dirichlet representation learning, enabling kinetic reconstruction in spectral form and slow-manifold gradient field estimation. We further introduce a spherical variant well suited to steering normalized latent representations commonly used in learning systems toward desired objectives. We establish finite-sample guarantees for eigenvalue, eigenfunction, and projected drift estimation in Sobolev norms, thereby ensuring generalization of these quantities and their first-order derivatives. Empirically, LITL recovers physical transition timescales from biased molecular simulations, builds kinetic structure from static samples of generative models, reconstructs spherical symmetries of physical systems, and enables post-hoc latent steering of trained neural networks under black-box feedback. Together, these results position spectral operator learning as a practical framework for recovering stochastic dynamics under distribution shift and unlock applications across machine learning and the physical sciences.

</details>


### [525] [Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01530)
*Tugrul Cabir Hakyemez,Ener Uras Gokhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测中，早期与晚期预测误差代价不对称的问题，将优化目标本身视为设计变量，系统比较了单目标（R²最大化、NASA评分最小化）与多目标（NSGA-II+Entropy-CRITIC）超参数优化策略在5种架构（MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer）和2个数据集（NASA C-MAPSS、BackBlaze）共75种组合上的表现。核心发现是：在C-MAPSS上，三种策略的R²几乎相同（≈0.89），但多目标优化将方向不平衡（DI）降低约33%；在BackBlaze上两目标从互补转为冲突，导致显著泛化差距（最佳R²≈0.34）。算法排名具有配置依赖性，简单架构常优于复杂时序模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在预测性维护中，RUL预测的早期误差（导致过早维护）和晚期误差（导致灾难性故障）具有不对称代价，但标准超参数优化通常使用对称精度指标（R²、RMSE），忽略了这种不对称性。此外，多目标优化在RUL文献中应用有限，且缺乏对不同优化目标如何影响预测行为（尤其是时效性/方向性偏差）的系统理解。模拟数据集C-MAPSS的广泛使用也限制了结论在真实噪声数据上的泛化性。

Method: 1）数据集：NASA C-MAPSS四个子集（FD001–FD004，RUL上限125周期）+ BackBlaze硬盘数据集（Q1–Q3 2024，2444块故障硬盘，14个SMART特征，RUL上限60天）。2）五种架构：MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN、Transformer。3）三种HPO策略（均在Optuna框架内，TPE采样器，30次试验）：单目标R²最大化、单目标NASA评分最小化、多目标NSGA-II同时优化两者。4）多目标Pareto前沿采用Entropy-CRITIC加权法自动选择单一配置。5）评估指标：R²、RMSE、NASA评分、α-20%精度、方向不平衡（DI）。6）总计75种模型-数据集-策略组合，严格无泄漏时序验证。

Result: 1）C-MAPSS上：三种策略R²几乎一致（0.886–0.889），但多目标优化将平均DI从9.06–9.11降至约6.07，降幅33%，且优势随数据集复杂度提升而扩大（FD001的23%→FD004的45%）。2）BackBlaze上：策略显著分化，R²从0.335（单目标R²）到0.221（单目标NASA），目标从互补转为冲突；Entropy-CRITIC权重在架构间出现0.38–0.75的显著分歧。3）算法排名具有配置依赖性：XGBoost在FD001/002/003上最优（R²=0.907–0.916），LSTM在FD004多工况场景下反超（R²=0.891，DI=1.88最低），TCN和Transformer在C-MAPSS上垫底但在BackBlaze排名上升。4）BackBlaze出现严重泛化差距，R²从0.86–0.92骤降至0.24–0.30，NASA评分数量级暴增。5）多目标优化对MLP/TCN等高DI架构收益最大（DI降幅43%–76%），对LSTM几乎无影响。

Conclusion: 优化目标的选择显著影响RUL预测的时效性校准，而非聚合精度——三种策略在C-MAPSS上R²相同但DI差异显著，多目标优化提供了一种无需人工偏好表达的原理性方法来获得方向均衡的预测。Entropy-CRITIC权重可作为部署诊断工具：均衡权重表明单指标调优足够，发散权重则提示需多目标搜索。从模拟到真实数据的转变揭示了目标关系从互补到冲突的质变，警示不应不加验证地将仿真目标直接迁移。算法排名依赖配置表明架构选择应由运行复杂度而非单一基准性能指导，结构化中等规模退化数据上良好调优的简单架构仍具竞争力。局限性包括固定计算预算可能不利于深层架构、多目标仅限两个目标、BackBlaze仅代表单一工业领域、Entropy-CRITIC为静态事后方法。

Abstract: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. On C-MAPSS, all strategies achieve comparable accuracy ($R^2 \approx 0.89$), yet multi-objective optimization reduces directional imbalance by approximately 33%, improving calibration of early versus late predictions. Model rankings prove configuration-dependent, with simpler architectures frequently outperforming deeper temporal models. On BackBlaze, the objectives shift from complementary to conflicting, producing divergent Entropy-CRITIC weights and a substantial generalization gap (best $R^2 \approx 0.34$). These results demonstrate that the optimization objective materially shapes prognostic behavior and that multi-objective search provides a practical mechanism for calibrating prediction timeliness in RUL modeling.

</details>


### [526] [FedFit: Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Vector-Bank Parameterization and Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01537)
*Hang Zou,Chao Zhang,Yuzhi Yang,Yu Tian,Samson Lasaulce,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedFit提出了一种面向联邦LLM微调的通信高效框架，通过不相交向量库参数化、交替优化调度和残差谱校正解决LoRA在联邦学习中的通信瓶颈与聚合困境，并结合分块量化与误差反馈实现高达100×的压缩比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在隐私敏感的医疗、金融以及带宽受限的IoT/边缘场景中，集中式LLM微调不可行。联邦学习（FL）虽能保护隐私，但LLM巨大的参数规模导致通信开销成为关键瓶颈。此外，将LoRA应用于联邦微调时，存在Sum-of-Products（SoP，精确但破坏低秩结构）与Product-of-Sums（PoS，通信高效但不精确）之间的根本性"聚合困境"。尽管已有工作分别研究向量库LoRA、量化LoRA，但尚无工作将向量库参数化、SoP/PoS聚合权衡与激进量化三者结合用于联邦LLM微调。

Method: FedFit框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 不相交共享向量库参数化——使用两个不相交的紧凑全局向量库 v_A 和 v_B，通过固定等距稀疏投影矩阵 P_A、P_B 重构各层LoRA适配器矩阵A和B，从而大幅减少传输参数量；(2) 交替优化调度——通过相位指示器在"A-only"、"B-only"和"A+B"三种阶段间循环，单库更新阶段使PoS聚合与精确的SoP聚合完全等价（SoP=PoS），而"A+B"联合阶段采用残差谱校正（RSC）机制，通过QR分解和SVD高效计算残差矩阵R的最佳秩-1近似来弥补聚合偏差；(3) 分块RTN量化与客户端误差反馈——对向量库进行分块round-to-nearest量化，上行链路使用误差反馈累积器补偿量化误差，上下行可采用不同位宽配置。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct模型上的Dolly数据集实验中，FedFit在7项常识推理基准（BoolQ、PIQA、HellaSwag、WinoGrande、ARC-e、ARC-c、OBQA）上 consistently优于FedIT、FFA-LoRA、Flex-LoRA、RoLoRA、Quantized-LoRA、LoRA-FAIR、LA-LoRA等基线方法，同时实现6-106×的压缩比（4-bit RTN量化下Qwen2.7B达106×）。在GSM8K/MMLU数学任务上亦保持竞争力。非IID Dirichlet划分实验显示平均分仅在0.33分范围内波动，表明对数据异质性具有鲁棒性。客户端数量从4扩展到32时性能保持稳定。理论分析证明交替调度下SoP=PoS成立，A/B-only阶段和A+B阶段均具有 O(1/T) 收敛率。

Conclusion: FedFit证明了：(1) LoRA适配器的高维参数存在大量冗余，通过不相交共享向量库参数化可在保持表达能力的同时构造各客户端模型；(2) 通过交替优化调度（含A+B联合修复阶段）不仅能缓解SoP与PoS的聚合困境，还能实现精确聚合；(3) 结构化参数共享与训练后量化耦合时，可实现极端压缩（通信成本降至标准方法的1-3%）。这些成果为在高度受限的无线网络上部署数十亿参数模型迈出了重要一步。未来需进一步研究LLM模型效应、客户端异质性与部分参与、传输错误与延迟以及新数据获取等问题。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet the massive communication overhead remains a critical bottleneck. Furthermore, applying Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) in FL faces a fundamental "aggregation dilemma" between the accurate Sum-of-Products (SoP) and the communication-efficient Product-of-Sums (PoS) implementations. To tackle these challenges, we propose FedFit. First, to significantly reduce communication overhead, we introduce a disjoint shared vector-bank parameterization that reconstructs high-dimensional adapter matrices from two compact and disjoint global vector banks. Second, to address the aggregation dilemma, we devise an alternating optimization schedule. By cycling between decoupled single-bank updates (which allow for accurate aggregation) and joint updates corrected by a Residual Spectral Aggregation mechanism, we resolve the conflict between SoP and PoS. Additionally, we integrate blockwise quantization with client-side error feedback to further compress the transmitted vectors. Furthermore, we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for the proposed algorithm. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5 models demonstrate that FedFit achieves perplexity performance comparable to standard federated LoRA methods, while providing compression ratios up to 100x higher.

</details>


### [527] [Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01548)
*Ryunyi Lee,Kangjun Noh,Somin Kim,Heedong Kim,Kyungwoo Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Range-GRPO提出了一种半监督的后训练框架，通过将LLM-as-a-Judge的标量伪奖励转化为共形校准的奖励区间，并在GRPO框架内进行成对区间比较来构建优势函数。该方法允许区间不确定性同时影响学习信号的幅度和方向，理论证明在区间退化为点时退化为Dr.GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大语言模型后训练中，无参考答案或可执行验证器的领域获取可靠监督成本高昂。LLM-as-a-Judge虽然提供可扩展的伪奖励，但单一标量分数无法表达奖励的不确定性，导致点奖励可能传递误导性的学习信号。现有方法如UARM虽然利用区间宽度重新缩放优势，但无法改变由点奖励确定的优势方向。

Method: 1. 使用Robust Weighted Conformal Inference (RoWCI) 在低基数判断状态空间上构建共形校准的奖励区间，处理策略更新带来的分布漂移。2. 提出Range-GRPO目标函数：对每对响应计算权重ω_{ij}=λ/(h_i+h_j+λ)（基于组合半宽度），并计算成对信号g_{ij}=ω_{ij}(c_i-c_j)，通过聚合这些信号构建响应级优势。3. 理论证明：当所有区间退化为点时，Range-GRPO优势等于Dr.GRPO优势；命题2表明成对区间比较可使优势符号反转，而点约简或响应级重加权无法实现。4. 训练流程结合标记源数据拟合状态评分器、构建校准非一致性分数、在线更新密度比率估计。

Result: 在合成候选选择任务（GPT-2-small）上，Range-GRPO以39.40%的测试准确率超越所有标量约简基线7.63个百分点，区间宽度最小（0.3595）。在真实推理基准测试（Qwen2.5-Math-7B）上，使用1024个标记数学提示和1024个未标记MMLU-Pro提示进行训练，Range-GRPO在9个基准中的8个上取得最佳成绩，分布内平均准确率42.7%，分布外平均准确率56.6%，相比最强半监督基线分别提升5.2%和7.0%。同时响应预算比TraPO减少约18.2%，训练时长（16.3小时）与UARM相当但少用一个GPU。定性分析展示了区间感知成对加权如何反转正确响应的优势符号，使其与oracle偏好一致。

Conclusion: Range-GRPO是一种有效的半监督后训练框架，通过成对奖励区间比较构建学习信号，能够利用区间不确定性同时调整学习信号的幅度和方向。理论分析表明它包含Dr.GRPO作为零宽度区间的特例，实验证明它在分布内和分布外任务上均优于评估的半监督方法，同时需要更少的训练资源。未来可将该框架扩展到奖励监督不确定且专家标注有限的领域。

Abstract: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the this http URL advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

</details>


### [528] [QK-Wanda: Coupling Queries and Keys for Unstructured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01554)
*Ivan Ilin,Peter Richtárik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QK-Wanda 提出了一种针对大语言模型非结构化剪枝的新方法，通过耦合 Query 和 Key 投影的权重重要性评分，在不更新保留权重的情况下显著降低了 QK 重建误差，并在多个模型上提升了困惑度和零样本准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Wanda 方法独立评估每个线性层内的权重，忽略了注意力机制中 Query 和 Key 通过点积相互作用的特性，导致剪枝决策可能无法最优地维持注意力计算的质量。

Method: 推导单权重删除在 QK 重建目标下的精确闭式评分（包含 GQA 和偏置），将 Wanda 评分乘以对侧投影的激活能量；支持因果掩码、RoPE 和中心化等扩展；采用共享或独立的 QK 预算。

Result: 在 15 个模型（0.5B–72B）上，QK 重建误差平均降低 60%（50% 稀疏度）和 45%（80% 稀疏度）。Llama-2-70B 在 80% 稀疏度下 WikiText-2/C4 困惑度分别降低 20.3% 和 13.5%，零样本准确率提升 5.94 个百分点；但 Llama-3.1-70B 困惑度却显著恶化。计算开销仅比 Wanda 增加 1.3%（A100）和 3.1%（H200）。

Conclusion: 耦合剪枝准则具有实用价值，但局部重建质量不能完全预测下游模型表现；未来需考虑传播误差和保留权重的补偿更新。

Abstract: Wanda (Sun et al., 2024) prunes large language models by scoring weights independently within each linear projection, although queries and keys interact through dot products. We introduce QK-Wanda, which scores query and key weights by their individual deletion costs under an unmasked pre-RoPE reconstruction objective. It augments Wanda scores with information from the opposite projection (keys for query weights, and queries for key weights), allowing both projections to share a pruning budget. Its closed-form scores require no gradients or weight updates; full pruning takes 1.3% longer than Wanda on A100 and 3.1% longer on H200 with the calibration used in our main experiments. We evaluate QK-only pruning across 15 models from TinyLlama, Llama 2, Llama 3, and Qwen2.5, spanning 0.5B-72B parameters. Relative to Wanda, QK-Wanda reduces QK reconstruction error by an average of 60% at 50% sparsity and 45% at 80%. Downstream gains depend on the model. At 80% sparsity on Llama 2 70B, WikiText-2 and C4 perplexity decrease by 20.3% and 13.5%, while mean zero-shot accuracy rises by 5.94 percentage points. Qwen2.5-72B also improves, but Llama-3.1-70B has substantially higher perplexity despite lower reconstruction error. These results show both the promise of coupled pruning criteria and the limits of local reconstruction as a predictor of model quality.

</details>


### [529] [Towards Optimal Policy Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01566)
*Yaniv Oren,Viliam Vadocz,Wiktor Zabka,Thomas Evers,Jan Robine,Wendelin Böhmer,Matthijs T. J. Spaan,Martha White,Hendrik Baier,Fenghui Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理研究强化学习中的策略改进,定义了在状态受限约束下的最优策略改进等价于求解诱导MDP,并在此基础上推导出在近似评估条件下的最优贪心化算子ℐ_opt,该算子通过概率决策框架明确考虑评估不确定性,泛化了常用的正则化算子ℐ_reg。实验证明该算子在GumbelAlphaZero、SAC、ReBRAC和广义策略迭代等算法中均能提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际RL算法在近似评估存在的情况下通过迭代策略改进求解MDP,但如何设计在实用约束(如近似评估)下的最优策略改进算子仍是一个重要的研究方向。现有方法通常通过正则化隐式处理评估误差,但缺乏显式的、不确定性感知的决策目标来推导最优算子。

Method: 方法包含两部分:(1)理论层面证明状态受限的最优策略改进等价于求解诱导的半MDP(sub-MDP),将最优策略改进与基于模型的规划联系起来;(2)在近似评估下将贪心化建模为不确定性下的概率决策问题,采用广义贝叶斯推断框架,以KL散度为先验、以异方差高斯似然为效用因子,经确定性等价近似后推导出最优算子ℐ_opt,其形式为ℐ_opt(π,Q̂)(a|s) ∝ π(a|s)exp(Â(s,a)/η(s,a)),其中η(s,a)是依赖于每个(s,a)对评估方差的动作相关温度参数。理论上证明ℐ_opt满足贪心化性质并在GPI框架下几乎必然收敛到最优策略。

Result: 实验在四种设置中验证了ℐ_opt的有效性:(1)有噪声策略迭代:在20个网格MDP上,ℐ_opt优于argmax、ℐ_reg、Conservative Policy Iteration以及基于LCB的悲观变体;(2)GumbelAlphaZero在9×9围棋和国际象棋上:加入Q_φ评论家后,Elo提升107-277;(3)SAC在10个DeepMind Control任务上:使用双评论家集成作为不确定性估计即可改善基线;(4)ReBRAC在D4RL离线RL上:在halfcheetah、hopper、walker2d、ant四个medium-replay数据集上均改善最终性能。

Conclusion: 论文从第一性原理刻画了最优策略改进,将其与基于模型的规划联系起来,并通过显式的概率决策框架推导出考虑评估不确定性的最优贪心化算子ℐ_opt。该算子在不改变各基线算法主要设计选择的前提下,模块化地提升了多种RL算法的性能,为设计更强的策略改进算子提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Practical Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms learn to solve Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) through iterative policy improvement in the presence of approximate evaluation. We study policy improvement from first principles, defining optimal policy improvement as producing the best policy attainable in a single update under specified constraints. We show that optimal improvement restricted to a set of states is equivalent to solving an induced MDP, characterizing planning with an explicit or implicit model as a path towards optimal policy improvement. Because practical methods commonly solve such induced problems through iterative improvement in the form of greedification, we take steps towards optimal greedification under the central practical constraint of approximate evaluation. We formulate greedification under this constraint as probabilistic decision-making under uncertainty and derive a novel operator that is optimal with respect to the resulting objective. Empirically, the operator and its practical gradient-based approximations improve aggregate performance across GumbelAlphaZero, SAC, ReBRAC and Generalized Policy Iteration, in experiments spanning discrete and continuous actions, model-based and model-free, online and offline RL.

</details>


### [530] [Two Routes to the Middle: Placement Search and Brain Readouts Converge on Where Continual Learners Should Specialize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01590)
*Yuan Huang,Zihan Chen,Runbin Zhang,Hongwei Ding,Changzeng Fu,Shiqi Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究持续学习中Vision Transformer的适配器放置问题，从算法（放置搜索）和神经科学（fMRI脑读出）两条路线出发，提出LS-B方法在不依赖标签或反向传播的情况下确定哪些块需要任务特定容量，并发现两种路线都指向中间深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基于预训练ViT的类增量持续学习中，若每个块都保留任务特定适配器（如BiLoRA），存储随任务数线性增长；若仅在少数块保留任务特定容量，则面临"应该将任务特定容量放在哪些块"这一结构性问题。现有方法（放置搜索、内部信号如权重谱或激活统计）各有局限，且未能从神经科学视角提供无需搜索的指导。视觉皮层的层次组织与中间阶段可塑性（如V4区的可塑性）启发了利用外部神经测量指导层分配的思路。

Method: 1. 放置搜索路线：在Split ImageNet-R上训练所有9个连续四块的放置方案，发现最终准确率呈倒U型，在中间深度达到峰值，差异达3.5pp；权重谱和激活统计等廉价准则倾向于最深块，错过最优点。2. LS-B（神经科学路线）：（a）离线阶段，使用NSD subj01的图像-fMRI数据对，为每个ViT-B/16 backbone（AugReg、iBOT、DINO）拟合一个冻结的FactorTopy编码模型，将12个视觉区（V1–VWFA）的保留顶点的响应映射到backbone的12个块；（b）观察阶段（前K=3个任务），无适配器副本的backbone处理每个任务的无标签图像，产生读出矩阵D_t；（c）通过双向中心化和分解为公共成分C与任务残差E_t，计算每块的层特化分数ρ_l = m_l/(s_l+ε)，即任务间变异相对于稳定结构的比率；（d）承诺阶段，一次性将top k=4个ρ_l最高的块设为任务特定集S，其余块共享一个适配器。LS-B无需标签、反向传播或放置搜索，运行时增加不到0.6%。

Result: 1. 放置搜索在AugReg上峰值在块4–7，在iBOT上峰值在块3–6，呈倒U型；权重谱和激活准则均偏向最深块。2. LS-B在三个backbone上产生稳定且backbone特定的分配；在AugReg和iBOT上，所选块与放置搜索确定的中间深度区域重叠（4个中有1–3个块重合）。3. 在匹配存储（72 slots）和观察预算下，LS-B选择的块优于最浅和最深的四块配置。4. 在Split ImageNet-R上，LS-B仅使用完整BiLoRA 60%的存储（72 slots vs 120 slots），最终准确率差距在1.5pp以内。5. LS-B展现出backbone特定的皮层签名。

Conclusion: 算法路线（放置搜索）和神经科学路线（LS-B脑读出）在持续学习的层分配问题上殊途同归，都指向ViT的中间深度块。LS-B提供了一种无需标签、反向传播或搜索的一次性层分配方法，在显著减少存储的同时保持接近完整适配器的性能，并揭示了深度网络与视觉皮层之间的对应关系具有backbone特异性。两条路线的收敛表明中间深度是任务特定容量的自然归属，但读出与搜索最优的重合仅部分，说明两种信号捕获的是互补而非完全重叠的信息。

Abstract: Continual learners that keep a task-specific adapter in every block of a pre-trained vision transformer accumulate storage linearly with the number of tasks; keeping task-specific adapters in only a few blocks curbs this growth but raises the question of where to place them. We investigate this question from two perspectives. Algorithmically, training all contiguous four-block placements yields an inverted U: final accuracy peaks at intermediate depth and varies by up to 3.5 percentage points (pp), while inexpensive criteria based on weight spectra or activation statistics favor the deepest blocks. From neuroscience, the hierarchical organization and intermediate-stage plasticity of the visual cortex motivate us to ask whether a measurement taken outside the learner can guide layer specialization without placement search. LS-B observes the first tasks through a frozen fMRI encoding model of twelve human visual areas and commits task-specific capacity once to the blocks whose readouts vary most across tasks relative to their stable structure. Across three ViT-B/16 backbones, LS-B yields stable, backbone-specific allocations. On the two backbones with placement search, AugReg and iBOT, the selected blocks overlap the intermediate-depth region identified by search. Under matched storage and observation budgets, the selected blocks outperform the shallowest and deepest four-block configurations. On Split ImageNet-R, LS-B uses 60% of full-BiLoRA adapter storage while remaining within 1.5 pp of its final accuracy. The allocation requires no labels or backpropagation, adds under 0.6% runtime, and exhibits backbone-specific cortical signatures.

</details>


### [531] [Generalization in Neural Networks Through the Lens of Magnitude Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01633)
*Sahel Torkamani,Henry Gouk,Rik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"幅度势"（Magnitude Potential, MP）及其比值（MP ratio），一种基于度量幅度理论的点-集合表示度量。MP ratio在神经网络logit层计算时，能在无需大量重训练的情况下检测逐样本的"记忆"程度（与Feldman记忆分数强负相关），跟踪决策边界结构变化，作为模块加法"顿悟"（grokking）的早期几何指示器，且在神经坍缩被显式抑制时仍然有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络的泛化机制仍是一个开放性问题。现有方法（权重衰减、损失景观几何、统计物理等）各有局限，缺少一种统一的、逐样本可计算、不依赖架构与损失函数的通用几何工具来揭示训练动态中的结构变化（如记忆、顿悟、决策边界演变）。

Method: 1. 定义幅度势：ρ^t(z,X) = Σ ζ(x,z) w_X(x)，其中ζ=exp(-t·d)，w_X为基于ζ_X⁻¹𝟙的幅度权重，给出z被集合X在尺度t下的"软覆盖"评分；2. 定义MP ratio = ρ^t(z,X_c)/ρ^t(z,X)，度量点相对于自身类与整个数据集的覆盖比；3. 证明MP具有Lipschitz连续性、尺度极限性质及类内方差消失时的极限行为，并给出闭式留一法（Leave-One-Out）公式（Theorem 6）；4. 在logit空间计算MP ratio，分析其与Feldman记忆分数、决策边界结构、顿悟转变的关联；5. 在CIFAR-100/10、2D高斯玩具数据、模块加法顿悟基准及神经坍缩抑制模型上实验验证。

Result: 1. 在CIFAR-100上，MP ratio与Feldman记忆分数呈强负相关（Spearman ρ最高达-0.763, t=0.20, 10-seed平均），优于单一checkpoint基线（max softmax、logit margin、entropy、cross-entropy）；2. 在2D玩具数据中，MP ratio标准差的下降与决策边界从线性向类特定曲线的转变同步，标准差上升指示过拟合；3. 在模块加法顿悟中，训练MP ratio均值的上升先于验证精度的跃升，与权重范数等领先指示器一致；4. 在Anti-NC正则化抑制神经坍缩时，MP ratio轨迹与标准模型几乎相同，证明其独立于神经坍缩。

Conclusion: MP ratio是一种与架构和损失函数无关的几何工具，能在单checkpoint下有效揭示样本级记忆、决策边界演变和顿悟等训练动态，其信号独立于神经坍缩现象。局限包括尺度参数t需经验调整、大规模矩阵求逆的计算成本以及顿悟实验受限于标准的小规模设定。

Abstract: Explaining generalization and training dynamics in neural networks remains a challenge, and various approaches have been developed to study different aspects of these phenomena. In this paper, we introduce the idea of {\em magnitude potential} -- a quantity based on the theory of metric magnitude -- that reflects how well an arbitrary point is represented by a given set. We find that this basic quantity can be applied to examine various features in neural generalization. The ratio between the magnitude potential with respect to a class and with respect to the entire data, computed at the logit layer, is informative of the representation of the point. In experiments, these ratios for individual training points are found to be correlated with the Feldman memorization scores. Magnitude potential ratios aggregated across points detect structural changes in the decision boundaries and provide a geometric indicator of grokking in modular arithmetic. Although the magnitude potential ratio and neural collapse are both closely associated with intra-class and inter-class geometric structure, the magnitude potential ratio remains informative even when neural collapse is explicitly suppressed.

</details>


### [532] [FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01638)
*Wentao Yue,Tianyou Lai,Hongji Li,Qingyu Mao,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedSAP将异构联邦学习中的结构化剪枝重构为预算约束下的三状态通道分配问题（Global/Private/Dropped），通过域引导分配和类型匹配聚合，在Digits和Office-Caltech基准上分别以76.00%和72.67%的全局准确率超越最强基线DapperFL 1.70和4.92个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的联邦学习面临系统异构性（设备算力/内存差异）和数据域偏移的双重挑战。现有资源自适应方法仅决定每个客户端保留多少容量，不决定容量应分配在何处及如何共享；联邦域泛化方法通常要求共享完整架构。均匀压缩可能丢弃高价值通道，单一聚合路径会混淆可迁移特征与域敏感更新，需要联合决策层间预算、通道角色与共享范围。

Method: 1) 自适应层间预算分配：将客户端级keep ratio按层效用非均匀分配到各层；2) 域引导分配（DGA）：基于首层梯度余弦相似度推断伪域分组；3) 选择性全局保护（SGP）：根据跨域激活离散度将稳定通道分入Global池、域敏感通道分入Private池、低效用通道标记为Dropped；4) 类型匹配聚合：Global通道跨全部客户端聚合，Private通道限制在对应伪域组内聚合；5) 局部训练采用交叉熵损失加轻量表示正则化。

Result: 在Digits（ResNet10）和Office-Caltech（ResNet18）两个多域基准、10客户端、剪枝率{0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%}的设置下，三随机种子平均全局准确率达76.00%和72.67%，分别超过最强基线DapperFL 1.70和4.92个百分点。消融实验表明DGA与SGP具有互补性（完整76.0% vs 移除DGA 75.5%、移除SGP 75.4%、均移除74.3%）。超参数敏感性低，全局通道比例g_target=0.9、离散度阈值τ_var=0.05、EMA系数β_EMA=0.5为最优组合。附加计算开销约3–5%。

Conclusion: FedSAP将异构联邦剪枝重构为关于层容量与共享范围的联合决策，其三状态分配分别池化可迁移证据、保留伪域特化、满足客户端预算。全局均值提升支持角色感知的容量分配理念，但存在局限：首层梯度代理仅适用于外观驱动的域偏移；上传信号存在隐私暴露风险；全局均值提升可能掩盖部分域的性能下降；当前验证限于两个视觉基准和ResNet骨干。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. This partition lets broadly useful features benefit from cross-client pooling while isolating domain-sensitive updates from incompatible clients. Domain-Guided Assignment infers pseudo-domains from shallow-gradient similarity, while Type-Matched Aggregation restricts each channel to its intended sharing scope. Across three random seeds, FedSAP reaches 76.00% and 72.67% mean global accuracy on Digits and Office-Caltech, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.70 and 4.92 percentage points while supporting client pruning ratios of up to 80% across heterogeneous clients.

</details>


### [533] [Beyond Demographic Balance: Multi-Metric and Intersectional Evaluation of Fairness in MIMIC-IV Mortality Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01645)
*Abdullah Al Noman,Fahmid Al Rifat,Tahrima Hashem,Syed Muhammad Ibne Zulfiker,Rishov Paul,Tanzima HAshem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对 MIMIC-IV ICU 死亡率预测任务，系统性地揭示了公平性评估结论对所选指标和人口学分辨率（边缘 vs. 交叉性）的强依赖性，并提出一种仅在人口学表示层面（不含结局标签）进行交叉性平衡的轻量级分类头微调策略（IBHFT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床风险预测模型在不同人口学群体上的性能差异可能导致错误的临床决策。现有研究在评估公平性干预时往往依赖单一指标（如 AUROC 或单一误判率）以及单一属性边缘分析，可能掩盖真实的异质性错误结构。论文旨在厘清：不同指标选择和不同人口学分辨率下，干预评估结论是否一致。

Method: 1) 任务与基模型：基于 Gupta et al. (2022) 流水线在 MIMIC-IV 上构建 ICU 死亡率预测任务（训练 17,883 例，阳性率 12.0%；测试 4,400 例，阳性率 11.2%），采用时间序列 LSTM 作为基模型。2) 提出 IBHFT（Intersectionally Balanced Head Fine-Tuning）：冻结 128 维表示层，按 ethnicity × gender × insurance 三维交叉分组（最多 30 个交叉组），将每个交叉组下采样至最小组大小 n_min，并以此构成对策略优化的 lib 数据集训练替换的 128→512→256→1 MLP 分类头。关键设计：mortality 标签 y 不参与分组，仅平衡人口学表示。3) 比较器：无干预基线、敏感属性抑制、样本重加权、温度缩放（作为校准对照）、IBHFT。4) 评估协议：双维度——指标维度（accuracy/AUROC vs. TPR/FPR@0.5）与人口学分辨率维度（单属性边缘 vs. 三维交叉）；交叉分析聚焦于 N≥100 且 N+≥5 的支撑较好的子群。

Result: RQ1（指标依赖性）：重加权在边缘人口学分析中虽取得极低 FPR，但 TPR 显著下降（族裔组中位 TPR 约 0.15–0.45 vs. 基线 0.70–0.96），呈现"高 AUROC/高准确率—低灵敏度"的反差；IBHFT 在保留接近基线的 TPR 同时降低 FPR。各干预方法在不同指标下排名不一致，无统一最优。RQ2（分辨率依赖性）：交叉分析显示同一边缘组内存在差异巨大的子群错误分布。例如 Black 女性边缘灵敏度 0.805，但 Black 女性 Medicare 交叉组灵敏度 0.944（AUROC 0.946），而 Black 女性 Other 保险组仅 0.400（AUROC 0.774）；"Other"族裔组边缘 FPR 为 0.282，四个较大交叉组 FPR 介于 0.211–0.371；White 患者边缘灵敏度 0.747、FPR 0.206，但 Medicare/Other 交叉组灵敏度范围 0.683–0.782、FPR 0.153–0.230。这种差异不仅限于小样本子群。

Conclusion: 论文得出三项核心结论：(1) 指标选择至关重要——accuracy/AUROC、灵敏度与 FPR 对同一干预可给出不一致的评估；(2) 人口学分辨率至关重要——边缘汇总会掩盖交叉性子群内异质的错误结构；(3) 干预目标应明确区分——人口学表示平衡、人口学-结局联合平衡与误差率优化三者不等价。此外，公平性评估应配套报告子群统计支撑（样本量 N 与阳性数 N+）与不确定性区间（如 95% Wilson 区间）。该研究强调在临床公平性报告中需结合互补的效用与误差指标，并将子群分辨率与干预目标匹配，同时披露更细粒度估计的统计可靠性。论文也提示保险类型不应被直接解读为社会经济地位的代理变量。

Abstract: Fairness conclusions in clinical prediction can depend strongly on both the metrics reported and the demographic resolution at which performance is evaluated. We revisit these evaluation choices for ICU mortality prediction on MIMIC-IV, comparing predictive-utility and subgroup-error metrics across several fairness interventions. As a complementary case study, we introduce a lightweight adaptation strategy that jointly balances ethnicity--gender--insurance representation without conditioning on mortality outcomes, allowing demographic representation balancing to be examined separately from outcome-conditioned or direct error-rate interventions. We evaluate its behavior at both marginal and corresponding three-way intersectional subgroup levels, while accounting for the statistical support of finer-grained estimates. The results show that interventions can receive substantially different assessments across accuracy/AUROC, sensitivity, and false-positive rate, and that marginal demographic summaries can conceal heterogeneous error profiles within their constituent intersections, including among larger subgroups. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating fairness interventions at both complementary metric and subgroup resolutions, while accounting for the intervention target and the reliability of subgroup estimates.

</details>


### [534] [CrossGMN: Graph Metanetworks for Cross-Architecture Weight-Space Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01649)
*Adir Dayan,Yam Eitan,Haggai Maron*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CrossGMN是一个图元网络，通过对称性保持的跨网络消息传递，学习跨架构权值空间变换（将一个训练好的源网络映射到不同架构的目标网络）。作者将其应用于模型压缩任务，能显著加速后续知识蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的等变权值空间架构仅处理保持网络架构的变换，但许多实际任务（模型压缩、跨架构知识迁移、模型扩展）需要将源网络映射到不同架构的目标网络。由于源和目标具有不同的置换对称性作用在不同的参数空间上，跨架构变换的等变性难以直接定义。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 核心思想：将跨架构算子重新定义为同时接受训练好的源网络和目标网络初始化作为两个输入。定义跨架构算子F: V_src × V_tgt → V_tgt，对源网络置换不变，对目标网络置换等变。基于此提出CrossGMN：1) 将两个网络分别表示为参数图；2) 通过跨边连接成联合图；3) 在联合图上执行对称性保持的消息传递。采用"跨步（strided）"跨边策略避免边数随深度二次增长。理论证明：CrossGMN对紧集上连续跨架构算子在一般位置假设下具有通用逼近能力，并可扩展到有限个源架构映射到共同目标架构的情形。

Result: 在模型压缩（通过知识蒸馏加速）任务上的实验结果：1) MNIST INR：宽度+深度压缩加速达8.89倍（宽度压缩11.3倍达5.20倍）；2) ModelNet40 3D INR：深度压缩加速达6.85倍；3) 分类器（MLP/CNN/ViT）：多数设置加速1.04-1.25倍；4) 跨数据集迁移：MNIST训练的模型直接用于FashionMNIST，加速达3.78倍无需重训练；5) 异构架构压缩：单一CrossGMN可处理多种源架构映射到共同目标；6) 消融实验验证跨边通信的重要性，移除跨边或替换为FiLM条件化均显著降低性能。

Conclusion: CrossGMN是首个能够学习不同神经网络架构之间权值空间变换的框架，通过将变换重新定义为基于初始化的精炼操作，成功定义了源不变-目标等变的对称性结构。理论上的通用逼近性保证了表达力，实验上在多种架构（INR、MLP、CNN、ViT）和压缩设置上证明了实用价值，包括跨数据集迁移和对未见架构的部分泛化能力。这表明架构改变的变换可以直接在权值空间中被学习和摊销。

Abstract: Weight-space networks operate directly on parameters of other neural networks, enabling tasks such as predicting model properties, editing trained models, and generating weights. Weight-space symmetries such as neuron permutations make equivariance a key design principle. However, existing equivariant weight-space architectures have primarily been studied for transformations that preserve the network architecture. In contrast, many practical transformations, including model compression and upscaling, map a trained source network into a target network with a different architecture. In this setting, the source and target permutation symmetries act on different parameter spaces, making equivariance less straightforward to formulate. Our key idea for addressing this mismatch is to reformulate cross-architecture operators with two inputs: a trained source network and an initialization of the target network. This lets us define equivariant cross-architecture operators that refine the initialization of the target network using information from the source network, while being invariant to source-network permutations and equivariant to target-network permutations. Based on this formulation, we introduce CrossGMN, a graph metanetwork that jointly processes both networks through symmetry-preserving cross-network message passing. We prove CrossGMN is universal for continuous cross-architecture operators on compact sets under a general-position assumption. We evaluate CrossGMN for model compression, predicting a smaller network's parameters to accelerate subsequent knowledge distillation. Across 2-D and 3-D INRs and image classification with MLPs, CNNs, and Vision Transformers, CrossGMN speeds up distillation by up to 8.89x, transfers across datasets without retraining (3.78x), and a single model can accelerate compression from heterogeneous source architectures into a common target architecture.

</details>


### [535] [pCoMole: Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing with Discrete Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01663)
*Tong Chen,Maximilian Holsman,Lin Zhao,Pranam Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: pCoMole是一个基于离散流匹配(Edit Flows)的框架，用于在变长离散生物序列空间中进行Pareto约束的多目标分子编辑。通过Doob-h变换和增强Tchebycheff效用函数实现偏好引导，并使用蒙特卡洛短滚动进行实用化近似。该方法在GFP缩小、Cas9缩短和肽模拟物设计任务上得到验证，并包含湿实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物分子治疗通常从已知序列开始，通过定向编辑改善多个属性并满足硬性生化/制造约束。现有生成方法无法同时支持多目标优化、硬可行性约束和离散变长空间的序列编辑。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 基于Edit Flows的CTMC编辑过程，支持插入/删除/替换；(2) 增强Tchebycheff效用(ATC)定义可行性门控的终端偏好G(x)；(3) Doob-h变换将偏好倾斜引入编辑过程，修改后的速率正比于u_t(y|x)·h_t(y)/h_t(x)；(4) 蒙特卡洛短滚动近似调和函数h_t，支持对数域logsumexp数值稳定计算；(5) 候选采样+剪枝策略提高计算效率；(6) 理论保证：ATC效用最大化器保证Pareto最优性，Doob-h变换保证终端分布匹配偏好倾斜分布。

Result: 主要结果：(1) GFP缩小：固定213残基长度下，pCoMole亮度49.01 vs RayGun 9.42/SCISOR 19.03，激发波长偏差8.44 vs 22.36/20.13；湿实验中两个229残基eGFP变体(10个删除+1/2个替换)在大肠杆菌BL21中保留绿色荧光。(2) Cas9缩短：四种直向同源物均实现大幅缩短(SpCas9减少157aa)，PAM匹配率100%，CICERO独立评估显示PAM引导将匹配率从4-20%提升至72-88%。(3) 肽模拟物：在15个PDB靶点上实现20-50%长度缩减，7个药物相关性质综合改善。计算效率方面，pCoMole是唯一在高约束条件下仍能产生可用设计的方法。

Conclusion: pCoMole为离散变长生物序列空间的约束感知、Pareto对齐编辑提供了原则性框架，统一了多目标优化、硬可行性约束和序列编辑。湿实验验证证明该方法可产生保留生物功能的缩短蛋白。该方法为生成式建模与生物分子优化之间搭建了桥梁，对递送受限的治疗开发具有实用价值，但需配合实验验证和安全筛选。

Abstract: Biomolecular therapeutics often start from known sequences and require targeted editing to improve multiple properties while satisfying hard biochemical and manufacturability constraints. However, existing generative methods do not jointly support multi-objective optimization, hard feasibility, and sequence editing in discrete, variable-length biological spaces. In this work, we introduce Pareto-Constrained Molecule Editing (pCoMole), a framework built on discrete flow matching that steers a pre-trained Edit Flow toward user-specified preferences while enforcing terminal feasibility. pCoMole defines a feasibility-gated terminal distribution using an augmented Tchebycheff utility and realizes the resulting preference tilt through a Doob-h transform of the underlying edit process. To make this construction practical, we approximate the required harmonic function using short Monte Carlo rollouts over candidate edits, yielding an efficient guided editor with provable preference consistency. We validate pCoMole by shrinking GFP while retaining fluorescence-related properties, shortening diverse Cas9 orthologs while preserving PAM specificity, and compressing peptide binders into short peptidomimetics that optimize seven drug-related properties under hard constraints. In wet lab testing, two 229-residue pCoMole-designed eGFP variants retained clear green fluorescence in BL21 cells after 10 deletions, with either one or two substitutions. Together, pCoMole enables constraint-aware, Pareto-aligned editing of biomolecular sequences in discrete, variable-length spaces.

</details>


### [536] [Invent a Dataset: Measuring dataset generation abilities with zero seed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01674)
*Shivalika Singh,Andrija Djurisic,Gbemileke Onilude,Sudip Roy,Sara Hooker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Invent-a-Dataset系统，旨在解决AI开发中零数据场景下的数据集生成难题。该系统能从单一数据集描述出发，通过单次API调用生成高质量、高多样性的训练数据。在与Anthropic、Google、OpenAI、DeepSeek、Z.ai等五个前沿模型API的对比中，Invent-a-Dataset在质量（17%相对提升）和多样性（19%相对提升）上均显著领先，且其多样性优势随数据集规模扩大而扩大（从200样本的持平到20K样本的37%相对提升）。下游SFT实验证明，使用Invent API生成数据训练的模型在多个架构上均表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据集构建是AI开发中最手动且脆弱的环节。在零数据场景（zero data regime）下，实践者没有任何数据来学习目标能力，这是现实中最常见但也最具挑战性的情形。现有方案存在局限：数据集检索代理无法保证格式和质量；现有合成数据方法多依赖种子提示或现有数据集；LLM输出多样性低，且专有模型的ToS常禁止用于训练。

Method: 提出Invent-a-Dataset系统，通过单次API调用从自然语言描述生成大规模训练就绪数据集。评估设置包括：8种任务类型（涵盖多语言、多领域），约束与非约束查询两种设置；数据集规模从200到20000样本；与Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini-3.1-pro、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek-V4-Pro五个前沿模型对比；评估指标包括语义多样性（DCScore）、词汇多样性（n-gram多样性、压缩率、重复率）和质量（LLM-as-Judge的提示/补全质量评分及相关性评分）；下游验证包括在Llama-3.3-70B、Gemma-4-31B-it、Qwen3.5-9B三个模型上用LoRA SFT进行20K样本的Medical QA数据集微调，并通过LLM judge对held-out测试集进行排序评估。

Result: 1. 在5000样本规模上，Invent API质量得分7.90，比最强基线（Claude Opus 5和GLM-5.3，均约6.75）高约17%；多样性（DCScore）比次优模型GLM-5.3高19%；2. 多样性优势随规模扩大：从2K样本的17%相对提升扩大到20K样本的37%相对提升，基线模型多样性随规模下降或停滞，而Invent API反而上升；3. 添加约束使所有基线的多样性下降15-22%，但Invent API保持不变，约束下领先次优者58%；4. 词汇多样性指标上，Invent API在所有规模和指标上均为最优，重复率为0%，而基线达6.2-19.2%；5. 下游微调：Llama-3.3-70B的Invent API微调版本在54%的测试提示上排名第一（远超基线25%和最佳基线微调9%），Gemma-4-31B-it上Invent API微调版本占41%；6. 多语言表现稳定，印地语语言一致性最高（错误率仅0.15%，远低于DeepSeek-V4-Pro的7.25%）；7. 相关性得分方面，Invent API（7.47）略低于Claude Opus 5（8.86）和GLM-5.3（8.66），这是一个明确的局限性。

Conclusion: Invent-a-Dataset是解决零数据场景下合成数据生成难题的重要进展。它通过单次API调用生成的数据在多样性和质量上均显著优于直接使用前沿模型API，优势随规模扩大。其许可协议明确允许商业训练用途。局限性包括：当前仅支持文本模态，不支持工具调用轨迹或智能体多步轨迹生成；在相关性指标上略逊于最佳基线。未来的工作将扩展到多模态数据集生成和智能体轨迹数据集生成。

Abstract: Building datasets remains one of the most manual and brittle parts of AI development. In this technical report, we focus on the most extreme but also most prevalent setting real world practitioners face: a zero data regime. Here, practitioners don't have any data for the capability they want to learn. We introduce Invent-A-Dataset which is a prompt based system to go from dataset description to realistic and large scale post-training datasets. We evaluate Invent-A-Dataset against five frontier model APIs including Anthropic, Google, Open AI, DeepSeek, Zai. Across eight task types and dataset sizes up to 20K samples, Invent-A-Dataset significantly outperforms with both the highest quality (17% relative gains) while simultaneously producing the most diverse samples (19% relative gains). Its diversity advantage widens with scale of training dataset size (from parity at 200 samples to 37% relative gains at 20K samples). This translates into considerable downstream training gains, resulting in far more performant post-trained models. Invent-A-Dataset fine-tune consistently ranks higher compared to other generator fine-tunes across different post-trained model architectures.

</details>


### [537] [MiLoop: Selective Memory Propagation for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01685)
*Changliang Zhou,Yuanyao Chen,Rongsheng Chen,Zhiyun Lin,Zhenkun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MiLoop提出了一种基于纯强化学习的构造式神经组合优化框架，通过在RL rollout的多步计算过程中引入选择性记忆传播机制，使浅层策略（仅3层注意力）能够学习有效的动态嵌入，无需外部求解标签或训练时的搜索空间剪枝。该方法在TSP、CVRP、PDTSP和KP四个组合优化问题上均表现出色，并展现出从100节点到1000万节点的强跨尺度泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态嵌入构造式神经组合优化方法存在两个主要局限：(1) 依赖监督标签或伪标签进行训练；(2) 训练时采用激进搜索空间剪枝，可能排除高质量解所需的动作。此外，这些方法通常需要较深的Transformer栈（如6层）来从零重建子问题表示。该研究旨在通过利用RL rollout本身已有的多步计算过程实现表示复用，使浅层策略也能学习有效的动态嵌入。

Method: MiLoop（Memory-in-the-Loop）框架的核心方法包括三个组件：(1) 逐步记忆融合：在注意力层之前，通过三个角色特定的融合矩阵将历史记忆与当前输入嵌入拼接融合；(2) 选择性记忆更新：在注意力层之后，通过基于sigmoid的自适应门控机制（角色特定参数）对每个节点和特征通道进行细粒度记忆更新，公式为 m̃=(1-g)⊙m + g⊙h̃；(3) 记忆引导的动作选择：使用更新后的记忆通过兼容性模块计算动作分数。训练采用无参考的DPO变体，基于完整解的目标值生成偏好对。模型仅使用3层注意力层，嵌入维度128。

Result: 实验在TSP、CVRP、PDTSP和KP四个问题上验证：(1) TSP和CVRP在100-10K节点上，MiLoop (M=100) 在所有设置上优于所有神经基线，TSP100上达到0.02% gap；(2) PDTSP在100-1K节点上，PDTSP500和PDTSP1K上MiLoop分别达到-0.27%和-0.35% gap（优于LKH3）；(3) KP在200-1000项上，12个设置中有11个达到最低gap；(5) 解决全部81个TSPLIB和110个CVRPLIB实例；(6) 在TSP上泛化至1000万节点；(7) 消融实验证明记忆融合和门控更新具有互补作用，3层MiLoop优于6层无记忆的动态嵌入基线（10K上2.56% vs 4.39%）。

Conclusion: MiLoop通过将RL rollout的多步计算转化为优势，实现了选择性记忆传播，使浅层策略能够学习有效的动态嵌入，无需外部方案标签或训练时的搜索空间剪枝。在四个组合优化问题上的广泛实验证明了高质量解和强跨尺度泛化能力，记忆融合和门控更新的互补作用得到消融验证。未来工作将探索更有效的记忆融合和更新机制，并将MiLoop扩展到多任务学习场景。

Abstract: Constructive neural combinatorial optimization (NCO) has emerged as a promising paradigm that learns to construct solutions to combinatorial optimization problems (COPs) step by step, which reduces reliance on handcrafted rules and enables fast inference. While many methods with dynamic embeddings generalize well, they typically rebuild subproblem representations from scratch at each step using deep attention stacks. Many high-performing methods in this category rely on solution labels or pseudo-labels for efficient training, or on aggressive search space pruning during reinforcement learning (RL). To address these limitations, we propose Memory-in-the-Loop (MiLoop), a purely RL-based constructive framework that leverages the multi-step computation already required by a rollout for selective memory propagation. Each rollout provides solution-quality feedback for learning while propagating historical representations, thereby enabling a shallow policy to learn effective dynamic embeddings without external solution labels or training-time search-space pruning. Specifically, MiLoop fuses current embeddings with historical memory before the attention layers and applies adaptive gated updates afterward. The updated representations support both current decisions and stepwise reuse. Extensive experiments across four COPs demonstrate that MiLoop consistently produces high-quality solutions on instances ranging from 100 to 10 million nodes, highlighting its strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [538] [Artifact Annotations Partially Substitute for Per-User Calibration: SAFE-EDA and a Normalization-Controlled Evaluation of Wrist-EDA Affect Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01692)
*Haochen Chai,Xinbi Luo,Zining Liu,Fangfang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SAFE-EDA 卷积网络，通过在 EDABE 数据集的专家伪迹标注上预训练再迁移到 WESAD 情绪识别任务。研究系统考察了归一化统计量来源（训练受试者 vs. 被测用户自身记录）对预训练效果评价的关键影响，发现在 WESAD 上预训练增益从 0.078-0.227（使用训练集统计）降至 0.020-0.050（使用被测用户统计），即二者存在部分替代关系；而在第二个数据集上方向相反。文献调查显示 50 项研究中仅 5 项明确报告了归一化统计量来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腕带式 EDA 信号在不同受试者间幅度差异显著，因此归一化是情绪识别模型的标准预处理步骤。然而现有研究中很少明确报告归一化统计量究竟来自训练受试者还是被测用户自身记录——后者实际上引入了"首次使用"时设备并不具备的信息（即"逐用户校准"），可能虚增预训练或个性化方法的报告性能。作者旨在量化这一实验设计选择对预训练收益评估的影响。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) SAFE-EDA 紧凑型多尺度卷积网络（359,739 参数，茎和残差块共 296,822 参数从伪迹识别任务迁移，分类头重新初始化），源任务在 EDABE（43 受试者、74.5 h、32 Hz、逐样本伪迹标注）上训练，目标任务在 WESAD（15 受试者，留一受试者交叉验证）和 PhysioNet Wearable 数据集（26 受试者）上微调；(2) 2×4 协议网格：归一化源（global-train 仅用训练集统计 vs. per-subject-z 用被测用户完整记录）× 窗口跳距（1/4/60/240 样本，对应 99.6%–0% 重叠）；(3) 三类预训练对照——真实伪迹标签、随机打乱的伪迹标签、自监督预训练——以分离"监督机制本身"与"标注内容"的贡献。统计推断基于受试者配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验（Holm 校正）与配对-自偏 Bootstrap 区间。文献部分系统编码了 50 项 WESAD 研究的方法学报告情况。

Result: 主要结果包括：1) 归一化源影响巨大——LOSO 评估下，仅将归一化统计量从训练集切换为被测用户记录，scratch 模型 macro-F1 即从 0.5015 升至 0.6762（+0.1747, p=0.00537）；2) 在 WESAD 全局训练归一化下，预训练增益随跳距从 +0.0779 升至 +0.2268（全部 Holm 校正后显著），而 per-subject-z 下增益压缩至 0.0202–0.0495（均不显著）；最大交互效应在跳距 60 处（差值 +0.1773, p=0.000427）；3) 监督消融显示伪迹标签预训练贡献 +0.0779，约为自监督预训练 +0.0075 的 10 倍，打乱标签保留 58.3% 增益，正确标签贡献其余 41.7%；4) Wearable 数据集方向相反——per-subject-z 下增益反而增大（+0.0569 vs. global-train +0.0188）；5) 文献调查中仅 5/50（10%, Wilson 95% CI 4–21%）报告归一化统计量来源，而 26/50 报告窗口长度；6) 13 个跨数据集配置中预训练在 12 个中胜出。

Conclusion: 作者得出以下结论：(1) 伪迹标注预训练与逐用户校准在 WESAD 上提供部分可替代的信息——预训练使模型对幅度的受试者间差异更具鲁棒性，因此用户自身统计量能补充的内容减少；(2) 最大预训练增益恰出现在首次使用场景下（global-train 归一化），即设备首次佩戴、无该用户任何既往数据的情形；(3) 在第二个数据集上交互方向反转，表明该交互依赖具体数据的幅度分布；(4) 应将归一化统计量来源视为必备报告项，与受试者划分、窗口长度、跳距、归一化公式及用户数据可用时点并列；(5) "首次使用"评估须仅使用预测时刻可获取的信息，完整记录校准回答的是不同问题，明确区分二者方可使发表结果具有可比性。

Abstract: Wrist electrodermal activity (EDA) differs in amplitude from one person to the next, so affect-recognition models normalize their input before classification. Studies that test such models on held-out subjects seldom report where the normalization statistics come from, yet statistics computed from the held-out subject's own recording give the model information that a device does not have when it is first worn. We asked how this choice alters the measured benefit of pretraining. A compact convolutional network, SAFE-EDA, was pretrained on expert artifact annotations from 43 subjects and compared with the same network trained from scratch on the Wearable Stress and Affect Detection (WESAD) dataset (15 subjects, leave-one-subject-out), with two normalization sources crossed with four window hops. When the statistics came only from training subjects, pretraining raised macro-F1 by 0.078 to 0.227; when they came from the held-out user's full recording, the gain fell to between 0.020 and 0.050 and was no longer significant. Artifact supervision was far more useful than self-supervised pretraining on the same recordings (0.078 versus 0.008). Across 13 configurations in two datasets, the pretrained network was better in 12, but on the second dataset (26 subjects) per-user normalization increased the gain instead of reducing it, so the interaction depends on the data. Only five of 50 published WESAD studies state which data were used for normalization. Reporting this choice is necessary to separate first-use performance from performance after calibration.

</details>


### [539] [Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01697)
*Jan Tauberschmidt,Jephte Abijuru,Samuel Okon,Naukshatro Bose,Sophie Fellenz,Marius Kloft,Jonas Latz,Sebastian Josef Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Green's Observation Operator (GObO)，一种直接在低维源子流形与观测子流形之间学习含时Green核的方法。GObO通过谱分解参数化核，获得指数收敛率与流式递归状态，在3D热传导和对流-扩散问题上实现了跨源零样本泛化（误差比黑盒代理低4–8倍，查询速度1.4 ms），并支持跨分辨率迁移和轻度非线性修正而无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多物理系统（如激光加热金属增材制造、地面排放测量）的源与观测都位于高维环境域的低维子流形上。传统全域PDE求解器计算开销巨大，而黑盒代理（如FNO、DeepONet）既无法利用环境介质固定的结构，又无法对训练分布外的新源进行零样本泛化，因此需要一种既能保留源线性性又能高效泛化的方法。

Method: GObO将环境Green核限制到源与观测子流形上，并通过M项谱截断进行参数化：K_{α,M}(ξ,η,τ) = Σ_{k=1}^{M} e^{-λ_k τ} ψ_k(ξ) φ_k(η)。在空间侧用有限维基函数展开，并通过秩L>1的因子分解处理非凸优化。指数衰减率允许精确的有限流式状态：g_k^{i+1} = e^{-λ_k Δ} g_k^i + (∫_0^Δ e^{-λ_k s} ds) V_k(α)^T f̂^i，其维度与预测视野无关且稳定。轻度非线性通过Strang分裂（辐射反馈）或Kirchhoff变换（温度相关电导率）在不重训练线性核的前提下进行修正。

Result: 在3D热传导（64³网格）和对流-扩散（9×9×2 km域，64³网格）上，GObO在静态源训练后对移动源实现零样本预测，相对误差比FNO-2D低4–8倍（热：0.012 vs 0.101；对流-扩散：0.101 vs 0.430）。每个新源的查询时间为1.45 ms（CPU）/0.45 ms（GPU），比FNO-2D快134倍（CPU），比有限体积求解器快约2750倍。核可跨分辨率（64→128）迁移且仅引入0.025的误差（达到数值离散化下界）。辐射反馈修正将误差从0.31降至0.027；Kirchhoff变换将温度相关电导率的误差从0.232降至0.010，无需重训练。定理1证明了谱截断以e^{-c τ_0 M^{2/d}}指数收敛。

Conclusion: GObO通过在学习代理中显式编码源线性性和子流形间Green核结构，实现了对新源的快速零样本泛化，同时支持跨分辨率迁移和轻度非线性修正。其主要局限是在分布内精度略低于直接预测的黑盒模型（FNO在静态源上比GObO精确约10倍）。未来工作可将该方法的逼近与稳定性保证推广到更广泛的PDE和子流形设置，并探索更一般的非线性动力学。

Abstract: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.

</details>


### [540] [In-context Learning of Single-index Targets: Comparing Kernel and Feature Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01712)
*Haotian Gu,Yizhou Xu,Lenka Zdeborová*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非线性上下文学习（ICL）中两种单层注意力架构——核学习器与特征学习器——在同一族单指标任务上的性能对比。利用副本法推导了二者的记忆化与泛化误差的解析预测，并通过数值实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL理论主要聚焦于线性目标函数，对非线性情况下不同架构选择的理解不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，比较固定核方法与特征学习方法在非线性单指标任务中的表现。

Method: 研究两种单层线性自注意力架构：(1) 核学习器——先通过固定的球谐函数特征映射再进行线性注意力；(2) 特征学习器——先对原始输入进行注意力再学习非线性读出。采用副本法（replica method）进行理论分析，导出序参数的状态方程，并通过数值实验验证。

Result: 推导出了两种学习器在记忆化和泛化误差方面的解析公式，刻画了它们在不同预训练规模、任务池多样性和训练/推理上下文长度下的性能差异。识别出特征学习器在较少预训练数据下表现更优，而核学习器在小任务池下记忆化更精确。还发现不同的上下文长度缩放规律：核学习器对k阶谐波分量需要L=O(d^k)的上下文长度，而特征学习器只需L=Θ(d)即可同时利用所有Hermite分量。

Conclusion: 架构选择与数据集特性的交互决定了非线性ICL的性能。特征学习器具有更低的样本复杂度且能同时学习多个Hermite分量，但核学习器在特定条件下可能更优。这些结果为理解Transformer架构在ICL中的作用提供了理论指导。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables a pretrained model to infer a task from demonstrations without updating its parameters. While much of the existing theory focuses on linear target functions, in this paper we study nonlinear cases by comparing two one-layer attention architectures on the same family of single-index tasks. A kernel learner first maps inputs through a fixed nonlinear feature map and then applies linear attention, whereas a feature learner applies attention to the original input, followed by a learned nonlinear readout. We derive predictions for their memorization and generalization errors using the replica method, retaining the effects of pretraining size, task-pool diversity, and training and inference context lengths. The resulting predictions closely match numerical experiments across a broad range of regimes. Our analysis yields phase diagrams that characterize when each architecture is advantageous as the amount of pretraining data, task diversity, and context lengths vary. We further identify qualitatively different context-length scalings for the two learners. Together, these results clarify how architectural choices interact with the dataset and govern nonlinear in-context learning.

</details>


### [541] [Anomaly Detection and Localization for the Pantograph-Catenary System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01721)
*Francesco Vitale,Hangli Ge,Francesco Flammini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对受电弓-接触网系统(PCS)监测中现有CNN方案缺乏空间定位能力的问题,提出了一种结合GPS坐标对齐与LSTM自编码器的集体异常检测与定位框架,并在意大利铁路真实数据集上进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于卷积神经网络的车载视频监测方案能够跟踪接触线高度和拉出值(PCS height/stagger),但忽略了列车的地理位置信息,无法将异常与具体地理位置关联,限制了预测性维护的实用性。

Method: 1) **标准化**:将原始遥测数据按22米间距的离散网格与参考路线GPS坐标对齐,使用Ball Tree和Haversine距离进行空间匹配;2) **分段**:将轨迹按参数L=4划分为多个地理区块;3) **训练**:为每个区块独立训练双向LSTM自编码器(输入长度10,隐藏维度8,3层,dropout=0.2),仅使用健康数据,以MSE损失训练500个epoch;4) **注入合成异常**:在测试集中注入悬臂偏移(常量加法,750mm)和自动张紧装置失效(半正弦曲线衰减)两类故障;5) **检测**:以验证集MSE的99百分位为动态阈值,重建误差超限即判定为异常。

Result: 在四个分区上的AUC分别为0.898、0.968、0.868、0.967;所有分区精确率均>0.820(FP≤21),但召回率存在波动,Zone 2召回率最低为0.644(FN=53);整体表明区域特定模型能有效抑制自然几何变化引起的误报。

Conclusion: 该空间感知框架成功地将GPS空间上下文集成到PCS异常检测中,能够定位结构缺陷并减少因拓扑自然变化产生的误报,为铁路预测性维护提供了实用工具;未来工作将聚焦边缘计算实时处理、真实故障数据验证以及图神经网络等时空架构。

Abstract: Monitoring the Pantograph-Catenary System (PCS) provides insight into the health conditions of the pantograph and the railway infrastructure. Recent industrial solutions trace the pantograph's contact wire height and stagger (PCS height/stagger) using video monitoring through convolutional neural networks. However, these solutions do not account for the train route's geographic location. Therefore, in this paper we propose a novel framework for 1) localization of the PCS height/stagger by alignment with the nominal GPS coordinates of the reference route, and 2) collective anomaly detection to evaluate the health conditions of the PCS. We apply and assess the localization and detection performance of the methodology to a case-study based on a real-world industrial dataset provided by a railway transportation company, which includes the PCS height/stagger of several train journeys across Italian railway routes.

</details>


### [542] [RelICL: Training-free Relational Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01725)
*Simon Forbat,Rainer Gemulla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RelICL，一种基于表格基础模型（TFM）的免训练关系学习方法。它通过沿模式图逐步传播和融合行嵌入（而非聚合列）来避免深度特征合成（DFS）的两大缺陷：特征爆炸和交互盲区。在RelBench的实验中，RelICL与最强DFS方法性能持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度特征合成（DFS）虽然简单且性能强，但在应用于关系学习时存在两个固有缺陷：（1）特征爆炸——DFS特征数量随模式复杂度快速增长，限制可扩展性和性能；（2）交互盲区——列级聚合无法捕获跨列特征交互，限制表达能力。作者希望保留DFS"利用TFM进行免训练关系预测"的优点，同时规避这两个缺陷。

Method: RelICL的核心思想是使用同一个表格基础模型（TFM）同时完成三件事：（1）特征提取——通过TFM的编码器提取上下文表的行嵌入；（2）特征融合——沿模式图（推断DAG）按拓扑顺序逐步将子表信息池化并融合进父表；（3）最终预测——在扩展后的任务表上运行完整TFM。它分为三个阶段：外向遍历确定相关行、内向遍历传播与融合嵌入、预测阶段。基于"行嵌入是良好特征"的核心假设（Assumption 1），将表的原始特征列替换为行嵌入，从而将特征数量从依赖整个模式缩减到仅依赖局部邻域，并能自然捕获跨列交互。

Result: 在RelBench v2的21个实体任务上的实验结果表明：（1）RelICL与最强DFS方法（TabPFN-Rel、RDBLearn）性能持平；（2）在受限深度和交互盲区的合成任务上，RelICL远优于DFS（如受限深度任务AUROC 100.0% vs 50.8%；交互盲区任务99.3% vs 46.5%）；（3）RelICL无需关系预训练即优于关系预训练模型（RT、PluRel）；（4）底层的TFM可灵活替换（TabICL、TabPFN均适用）。但作者指出Assumption 1并非在所有表上都成立（如philippine数据集损失8.9点AUROC）。

Conclusion: 特征爆炸和交互盲区是DFS在基于TFM进行关系学习时的两个固有缺陷。RelICL通过让TFM同时承担特征提取、特征融合和最终预测三个角色，以一种简单的方案避免了这两个缺陷，并在实验中表现出强劲表现。该方法保留了DFS免训练的核心优势，同时摆脱了对深度限制和手工特征工程的依赖。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve state-of-the-art performance on single-table tasks without any training. Recent work suggests that they are also well-suited for relational learning via deep feature synthesis (DFS), which flattens a relational schema into a single table by adding aggregates of the other tables' columns as features. This approach is appealing because it directly benefits from improvements to or customization of the underlying tabular foundation model. In this paper, we identify two key problems with DFS: feature explosion and interaction blindness. The first problem arises because the number of DFS features grows quickly as the schema becomes more complex, limiting scalability and performance. The second problem arises because column-wise aggregates do not account for feature interactions, limiting performance. We propose and explore an alternative method termed RelICL, which keeps the benefits of DFS but alleviates these two problems. At its heart, RelICL propagates and fuses information step by step through the schema graph, using the same tabular foundation model that is eventually used for prediction to do so. In our experimental study using RelBench tasks, RelICL was on par with the strongest approach based on deep feature synthesis.

</details>


### [543] [Function-Structured Reinforcement Learning with Executable Verifiers for Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01729)
*Zihan Liu,Xurong Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FSG-RL 是一种将子问题函数图、可执行 Python 实现与多验证器奖励相结合的分阶段 SFT-to-RL 框架，用于提升大语言模型的算法数学推理可靠性。核心实验表明，验证器引导的 GRPO 在最终答案准确率（43.25%→67.50%）和完整解题成功率（32.25%→52.25%）上显著优于纯 SFT，且经过微调的 9B 策略超越了 Qwen3.8-27B API 参考。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯最终答案奖励对中间错误信号不足，而成功执行并不保证数学正确性；需要一个能同时约束接口规范、中间函数行为与最终答案的框架来弥合“代码能跑”与“解题正确”之间的鸿沟。

Method: 1) 构建有向无环函数图 G=(V,E)，每个节点有标识、子问题、输出类型与 Python 签名，私有验证规范含单元/属性测试与目标函数调用。2) SFT 阶段训练 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 用 QLoRA 学习生成函数图与代码。3) GRPO 阶段采用多验证器奖励 R = M[λ_M + λ_S·S + g(Y)(λ_E·E + λ_U·U + λ_P·P + λ_D·D) + λ_Y·Y + λ_B·B]，其中 g(Y)=γ_Y·η+(1-η)Y 为答案门控；按节点和总分在 K=4 的 rollout 组内分别做组内归一化，将归一化优势分配到节点对应 token。4) FC-GRPO 阶段在 60 道难题上由 gpt-5.6-terra 教师诊断失败样本后继续 RL。5) 评测指标区分执行、隐藏测试通过率、程序–答案一致（B）、最终答案准确（Y）与全成功（Full）。

Result: 在 GSM8K、MathQA、MATH（Level 1-3）与 Omni-MATH 精选的 866 训练题 / 400 评测题上：SFT 后 Final Ans=43.25%，Full=32.25%；FSG-RL（GRPO）后 Final Ans=67.50%，Full=52.25%，McNemar p=1.72e-18；FC-GRPO 在 60 题继续训练后 Final Ans=69.00%，Full=53.50%；独立评估下 9B 策略在全部指标上超越 Qwen3.8-27B API 参考（后者 Full=49.87%）。

Conclusion: 学习符合接口规范只是起点；验证器引导的 GRPO 能同时提升最终答案准确率与完整解题成功率，证明将中间函数正确性、依赖一致性与最终结果挂钩的细粒度奖励设计有效；教师监督可作为验证器训练的补充，带来进一步收益。

Abstract: Algorithmic mathematical reasoning requires reliable decomposition, computation, and aggregation. Final-answer rewards provide limited guidance on intermediate errors, while successful execution does not guarantee mathematical correctness. This work proposes Function-Structured Graph Reinforcement Learning (FSG-RL), connecting subproblem graphs and Python implementations with multi-verifier feedback. The policy first learns to generate code from function graphs through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) then optimizes the policy using answer-gated rewards and span-level credit assignment. The framework also supports teacher supervision and structured memory. A benchmark curated from Grade School Math 8K (GSM8K), MathQA, MATH, and Omni-MATH pairs public function graphs with private verification specifications. Under a unified evaluation protocol, GRPO improves final-answer accuracy from 43.25% to 67.50% and full solution success from 32.25% to 52.25% over SFT. Continued reinforcement learning (RL) with teacher supervision yields additional gains. The gains extend beyond producing correctly formatted code, supporting verifier-guided reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [544] [Fixed-point neural samplers on discrete spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01739)
*Jiajun He,Denis Blessing,Mouyang Cheng,Yuanqi Du,Carles Domingo-Enrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DIG-IN，一种用于离散无归一化分布的固定点神经采样器。通过引入Gibbs软标签（基于单点能量差）替代one-hot重建目标，结合ESS控制下的温度重要性加权，在理论上证明收敛，并扩展到任意一对分布之间的离散插值。实验表明该方法避免了有序相的模式坍缩，可扩展到D=2500的高维系统，并准确恢复了Ag-Pd和Cu-Au合金的相图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散神经采样器存在三个主要问题：1）易发生模式坍缩（mode collapse）；2）通过固定点迭代训练时缺乏收敛保证；3）往往绑定于特定的参考过程（如masked或uniform diffusion）。本文旨在同时解决这三个局限性。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) Gibbs软标签——将单点能量差转化为目标条件分布的离散类比梯度，替代one-hot标签，降低方差且保持相同最优解；(2) 温度重要性加权——通过自适应ESS控制调整指数ν，平衡方差与偏差；(3) 固定点迭代——在自生成样本上进行训练，使用温度校正对分布偏差进行修正。理论上证明：固定揭示顺序时任意ν∈[0,1)均全局收敛；任意揭示顺序时条件2D(1−ν)<1保证收敛。方法还从masked diffusion扩展到一般前向-反向互逆的离散插值（最小动能局部通量）。

Result: 实验结果：1) 在Ising（25×25）和Potts（16×16）格点模型上，DIG-IN是唯一在有序相避免模式坍缩且给出准确ln Z估计的方法；2) 在Ising 50×50（D=2500）和Potts 24×24（D=576）上实现了跨热力学条件(β, h)的摊销采样；3) 在Ag-Pd（D=125）和Cu-Au（D=128）合金上成功恢复相图，自由能误差比FrOGS基线低1-2个数量级，ESS显著更高，且正确恢复了相边界而不产生虚假边界。消融实验表明Gibbs标签、ESS温度控制和proximal阻尼三个组件缺一不可。

Conclusion: DIG-IN是首个同时具备以下特性的离散神经采样器：在有序相避免模式坍缩、具有固定点迭代的收敛保证、不绑定特定参考过程。Gibbs标签提供强学习信号，温度重要性加权平衡方差与偏差，离散插值框架支持任意一对分布间的传输。未来工作包括：开发针对黑盒能量的更廉价标签估计器，以及将方法推广到生物学和化学中的离散采样应用。

Abstract: Sampling from discrete, unnormalized distributions without access to data is a challenging problem. Neural samplers offer a promising approach by training generative models from density evaluations directly. Despite recent progress, existing discrete neural samplers are prone to mode collapse, come without convergence guarantees when trained via fixed-point iterations, and are often tied to a specific reference process such as masked or uniform diffusion. In this work, we introduce Discrete Gibbs Iterative Neural Sampler, a fixed-point neural sampler that addresses these limitations, enabling efficient, scalable learning, substantially reducing mode collapse in practice. Our framework builds on masked diffusion and also extends to transport between pairs of distributions. We demonstrate that the resulting method scales effectively to high-dimensional systems, supports amortized sampling across different conditions, and enables accurate estimation of alloy phase diagrams.

</details>


### [545] [Evidence-Gated Research: Statistically Controlled Model Adoption in Adaptive Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01751)
*Yifan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Evidence-Gated Research (EGR)框架，将自适应模型搜索中的模型替换视为独立的统计控制点，通过冻结挑战者、构建可预测路由的多环境任意时有效证据、组合持久候选e-value，并结合在线e-value控制器（如e-LOND）来控制持久目标的FDR。实验表明EGR能在5,000轨迹闭环基准中将持久FDR降至0（开发专用e-LOND为0.621），同时显著降低证据成本（Stagewise EGR减少56.1%证据）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代模型开发呈闭环特性：提案、评估、决策、生成下一提案。在AutoML、自动化研究代理等系统中，一旦挑战者被采纳便成为后续提案的参照系，构成"状态改变"决策。现有统计方法（可重用holdout、LTT、aLTT等）未能处理：(1)开发环境中有效的改进可能在采纳目标的其他环境中失效；(2)顺序获取证据需保持候选层推断有效；(3)重复候选测试产生流级多重性；(4)固定采集计划在已解决环境上浪费观测。因此模型替换本身需要作为独立的统计控制点。

Method: EGR包含四个核心机制：(1) 候选冻结——在打开决策证据前固定挑战者，防止候选时间泄漏；(2) 多环境任意时有效分量——通过预先承诺的博弈网格构建各环境下的e-process，确保联合历史条件下的有效性（假设1：序列有效证据单元）；(3) 可预测路由——三种路由规则（Stagewise固定顺序、EGR-ALLOC预算回收、最弱分量平衡），定理1保证路由不影响e-process有效性；(4) 持久候选e-value组合——通过各环境e-value取最小值（引理1），无需跨环境独立性。定理2证明该组合与e-LOND等在线控制器结合，可在条件有效性与可预测性条件下控制持久目标FDR（通过调整阈值也可控制FWER）。理论贡献：将模型替换形式化为历史依赖的移动占位假设序列，给出持久候选e-value的条件有效性充分条件。

Result: 实验涵盖五个层面：(1) 5,000轨迹合成闭环（T=20, M=16）：开发专用e-LOND持久FDR达0.621，未审计EGR变体在有限运行中无观测到的持久错误采纳路径（0/5000，二项式95%上界≈6×10⁻⁴）；(2) 流级控制器敏感性：e-LOND、e-LORD、e-SAFFRON、e-FWER的持久替代功率分别为.619/.890/.888/.415，控制器选择显著影响长期功效；(3) 证据有效性诊断：ρ=0.95聚类相关性下，将相关原始行误作新鲜序列单元使跨越率升至.728，而聚合为有界单元后降至.0127；(4) 候选时间泄漏：q=20, L=64下冻结协议跨越率仅0.052%，泄漏+重用升至3.802%（约73倍），泄漏+重启恢复至0.063%；(5) 600对匹配重放：Stagewise EGR与固定任意时IUT跨域事件完全一致（功率.6477），但证据从1600降至702.4（减少56.1%，95%配对bootstrap CI 878.1–917.3）。三环境公开数据扩展（digits, N=800）和40,000样本控制神经基准（E32, N=500）重现证据效率模式：Stagewise EGR证据量分别减少67.6%和62.9%，EGR-ALLOC功率提升至.3349和.2666，所有审计方法FDR为0。最弱分量平衡规则在|ℰ|∈{2,3,5,8}下与oracle的证据比保持在0.970–1.034。

Conclusion: EGR将模型替换确立为自适应模型开发中的独立统计控制点。实验分离五种易混淆的失效模式：目标错配（开发有效不等于持久有效）、候选级任意时有效性无法消除跨候选多重性、有效分量证据在依赖结构下需正确聚合、候选时间泄漏（重用塑造候选的证据）、以及在目标/证据单元/候选身份/流修正固定后证据放置仅为效率问题。可预测证据放置可在不改变Stagewise跨域决策的前提下大幅降低验证成本。EGR模块化设计允许替换更强大的兼容在线e-value控制器；但保证条件于声明的效用、环境、边际、有效证据单元及候选冻结/重启协议，不蕴含对未声明偏移的稳健性，且公开数据研究基于有限经验池，40k神经基准为控制/合成数据。更大规模的图像、语言模型及全自主搜索循环仍为重要的外部范围测试。

Abstract: Adaptive model search is path dependent: once a challenger is adopted, it becomes the reference from which later candidates are generated. A statistically unsupported replacement can therefore alter hypotheses that have not yet been proposed. We introduce Evidence-Gated Research (EGR), a statistical adoption layer for moving-incumbent search. EGR freezes each challenger before decision evidence is revealed, builds anytime-valid evidence across a predeclared set of environments, routes evidence predictably toward unresolved components, composes a persistent candidate e-value, and passes that e-value to an online controller. Under explicit conditional-validity and predictability conditions, the resulting procedure controls false discovery rate for the declared all-environment adoption target even though earlier adoptions change later challengers. In a 5,000-trajectory closed-loop benchmark, development-only e-LOND attains persistent FDR 0.621, whereas no persistent false-adoption path is observed for the audited EGR variants in that finite run. In matched replay over 600 challenger--incumbent pairs, Stagewise EGR preserves fixed-anytime alternative crossing decisions while using 56.1% less decision evidence at the representative threshold. A three-environment public-data study and a 40,000-sample controlled neural benchmark reproduce the evidence-efficiency pattern. These results identify model replacement as a distinct statistical control point in adaptive model development.

</details>


### [546] [Physics-Refined Spatiotemporal Forecasting on Open-Boundary Hydrologic Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01765)
*Haoyang Jiang,Zhengui Wang,Shenghan Gao,Y. Joseph Zhang,Xingquan Zhu,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对开放边界水文图（河流/沿海）的时空预测任务，提出PRSOBG框架，通过"幽灵节点代理+物理精炼器"两阶段机制，解决外部强迫未知与自回归误差累积两大挑战，在多瑙河与切萨皮克湾两个真实数据集上显著优于9个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放边界水文系统中，边界节点接收的外部强迫（上游来流/潮汐信号）在预测时不可观测，导致自回归预测误差从边界向下游不断累积放大，长期预测性能急剧下降。现有方法缺乏对"缺失边界强迫"的显式建模与对误差传播的物理约束。

Method: 1) 幽灵节点代理（What）：基于离散Robin边界条件，用轻量MLP从边界节点状态与邻域内点状态的差分中学习外部强迫代理；有向图采用显式上游幽灵节点，非结构网格采用隐式融合/镜像层/可学习耦合三种方案。3) 局部边界精炼器：构建关于ghost-boundary-interior三节点一致性的严格凸二次优化，推导闭式ghost更新。4) 全局物理精炼器（How）：分别对有向图（平流方程先验）与非结构网格（线性化浅水方程/阻尼波方程先验）设计显式和凸化半隐式两种精炼器，半隐式版本转化为SPD线性系统并用可微PCG层近似求解。

Result: 在多瑙河（T=30）上PRSOBG-Convexified达到RMSE 0.4268，相对STGNN骨干提升27.95%，优于最强基线PhysicsCorrect；在切萨皮克湾（T=30）上达到0.9269，提升51.19%。极端流量场景下IW-RMSE提升59.98%。综合平均较STGNN骨干降低38.3% RMSE。在合成控制实验中，幽灵代理与真实边界信号的Pearson相关性达0.961，显著优于虚拟节点基线的0.206。物理参数±20%扰动下RMSE变化不超过2.29%。

Conclusion: PRSOBG首次将开放边界时空预测问题分解为"What-How"两层挑战，通过幽灵节点代理补偿缺失的外部强迫，结合局部一致性精炼与全局物理正则化，有效抑制了自回归长程预测中的边界误差放大问题，为中等尺度水文预报提供了一种兼具数据驱动灵活性与物理稳定性的新范式。未来工作将面向突变强迫事件与概率化预测。

Abstract: Spatiotemporal forecasting on hydrologic graphs is especially prone to instability in open-boundary systems, where the forecast domain exchanges fluxes with an unobserved exterior.
